### Stored Procedure (`P`) — 709

#### `dbo.a`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[a]
	@ano int,
	@semana int,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime, @hi1 nvarchar(max), @hf1 nvarchar(max), @a int, @s int
	set @di1 = @di
	set @df1 = @df
	set @hi1 = @hi
	set @hf1 = @hf
	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1
	--select @di, @df, datepart(weekday,@df), datepart(hh,@df)

	----declare @h_trb int = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and dateadd(dd,-1,@df)) + ((case when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) < 13 then datepart(hh,@df) when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) >= 13 then datepart(hh,@df) -1 else 8 end)-8)
	declare @h_trb int = (select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df1))
	
	--select @h_trb

	select sum((case when offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as Barcos, 
		sum((case when offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 then of_coeficiente + 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then of_coeficiente + 0.1 
			when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 then of_coeficiente + 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then of_coeficiente + 0.2
			when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 4 when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 8 else of_coeficiente end) + 
				(case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)) + (case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(rt.coef_Return,0) else 0 end) as coefs,
		sum((case when offp_return = 0 then 0 else 1 end)) as rtns, isnull(culpado,0) as culpado,
		fp_nome as fp,
		(case when e_fp_id <> offp_fp_id then '(*) ' + e_nome when e_chefe = 1 then e_nome else 'Ajudante: ' + e_nome end) as e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then coalesce(f.faltas,0) else 0 end) as faltas, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then coalesce(x.h_ext,0) else 0 end) as h_Ext, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
		coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) else isnull(perd_fase.h_perd,0) * -1 end) as h_Perdidas,
		coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
		fp_hora_coef
	from of_fp 
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id 
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as perd_tot on e_id = perd_tot.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, movent_fp_id,  
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and offp_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
		left join  (select Funcionario, Fase, sum(rtns) as rtns, sum(case when culpado = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as culpado, sum(coefs) as coef_Return from dbo.retornosFuncionario where cast(dataRep as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date) group by Funcionario, Fase) as rt on isnull(e_id,1) = isnull(Funcionario,1) and fp_id = Fase
	where offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
	group by 
		isnull(culpado,0), fp_nome, offp_fp_id, (case when e_fp_id <> offp_fp_id then '(*) ' + e_nome when e_chefe = 1 then e_nome else 'Ajudante: ' + e_nome end), e_id, e_fp_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0), coalesce(x.h_ext,0), coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), fp_hora_coef, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) else isnull(perd_fase.h_perd,0) * -1 end), rt.coef_Return
	union
	select 0 as Barcos, 0 as coefs, 
		0 as rtns, 0 as culpado, 
		fp_nome as fp,
		e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0) as faltas, coalesce(x.h_ext,0) as h_Ext, @h_trb as h_Trb, coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, 
		isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) as h_Perdidas, coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, fp_hora_coef
	from entidade_tipo inner join entidade on ent_id = e_ent_id and e_chefe = 1 inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as perd_tot on e_id = perd_tot.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, movent_fp_id,  
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and e_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
	where e_activo = 1 and e_id not in (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id where cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)/* and offp_return = 0*/) and e_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38))
	group by fp_nome, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, perd_tot.h_perd, perd_fase.h_perd, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0), coalesce(x.h_ext,0), coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), fp_hora_coef
	union
	select 0 as Barcos, 0 as coefs, 
		0 as rtns, 0 as culpado, 
		fp_nome as fp,
		'Ajudante: ' + e_nome as e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, sum(coalesce(f.faltas,0)) as faltas, sum(coalesce(x.h_ext,0)) as h_Ext, @h_trb as h_Trb, coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, 
		isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) as h_Perdidas, coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, fp_hora_coef
	from entidade_tipo inner join entidade on ent_id = e_ent_id and e_activo = 1 and e_chefe = 0 inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as perd_tot on e_id = perd_tot.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, movent_fp_id,  
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and e_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
	where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38))
		and e_id not in (select distinct offpeq_e_id from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offpeq_chefe = 1 and cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
			and offp_return = 0 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)))
	group by fp_nome, fp_id, fp_sequencia, e_nome, perd_tot.h_perd, perd_fase.h_perd, e_id, coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), fp_hora_coef
	order by fp, barcos desc, e_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.A_Reparar_Upd`(@offp_id int, @offp_of_id int, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offpeq_e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[A_Reparar_Upd]

@offp_id int,
@offp_of_id int,
@offp_problemas nvarchar(max),
@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max),
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null,
@offpeq_e_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @offp_datafim_ant smalldatetime, @arm_id int
	select @offp_datafim_ant = offp_datafim, @arm_id = offp_arm_id from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id

    update 
		of_fp
	set
		offp_problemas = @offp_problemas,
		offp_observacoes = @offp_observacoes,
		offp_datainicio = @offp_datainicio,
		offp_datafim = @offp_datafim
	where
		offp_id = @offp_id

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @offp_of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 1, 14, @offp_id

	if (@offp_datafim_ant is null and @offp_datafim is not null)
	begin
		if (select p_tp_id from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @offp_of_id) in (82,83)
		begin
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@offp_of_id, 15, @offp_datafim)

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 15, of_numutil = 0 where of_id = @offp_of_id
		end
		else if (@arm_id = 1)
		begin
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@offp_of_id, 9, getdate())

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 9 where of_id = @offp_of_id
		end
		else
		begin
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@offp_of_id, 12, getdate())

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 12 where of_id = @offp_of_id
		end
	end

END


--************************************************************************************
--5)
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acelerador_Acabamento_Competicao]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		sum(of_coeficiente)/(select equipas * dias * barcos from acelerador_variaveis where tipo = 'Acabamento Competição') 
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
	where 
		of_fp_id in (33,22) and p_tp_id = 6 and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Acelerador_Laminagem_Epoxy]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		sum((case when p_nome like 'K4 %' then 2.0 else 1.0 end))/(select equipas * dias * barcos from acelerador_variaveis where tipo = 'Laminagem Epoxy') 
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
	where 
		of_fp_id in (11,32) and p_tp_id not in (7,9)
END
```

#### `dbo.Act_Prods`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Act_Prods]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare curAct cursor for
	select act_id, act_tipo, act_id_prod, act_id_ant, act_id_novo, act_tipo_comp, act_tp_id, act_fp_id, act_qtd from [dbo].[actualizacoes] where act_completo = 0

	open curAct
	declare @prod int,
			@sub_prod_ant int,
			@sub_prod int,
			@tpcomp_id int,
			@tp int,
			@fp int,
			@of_id int,
			@quant float,
			@qtd float,
			@mov int,
			@mov_mov_id int, 
			@act_tipo nvarchar(max),
			@act_id int

	fetch next from curAct into @act_id, @act_tipo, @prod, @sub_prod_ant, @sub_prod, @tpcomp_id, @tp, @fp, @qtd while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		if (@act_tipo = 'Const/Barco')
		begin
			declare cur11 cursor for
			select distinct of_id from ordemfabrico inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
				where of_p_id = @prod and of_fp_id = 11 and p_tp_id = 84 and p_id = @sub_prod_ant

			OPEN cur11 

			fetch next from cur11 into @of_id while @@fetch_status=0
			begin

				if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id = @sub_prod) = 84)
				begin

					exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio null, 1, @of_id, 84

					exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @sub_prod, 1, @of_id, 84

				end
			
			fetch next from cur11 into @of_id

			end
			close cur11
			deallocate cur11
		end
		else if (@act_tipo = 'Prod/Barco ant n nulo')
		begin		
			select @tp = p_tp_id, @fp = fp_sequencia from produto inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id inner join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id where p_id=@sub_prod

			declare cur12 cursor for
			select distinct of_id from ordemfabrico inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
				 inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
					where of_p_id = @prod and fp_sequencia < @fp and p_tp_id = @tp and p_id = @sub_prod_ant

			OPEN cur12 

			fetch next from cur12 into @of_id while @@fetch_status=0
			begin

				exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @sub_prod, @qtd, @of_id, @tp

			fetch next from cur12 into @of_id

			end
			close cur12
			deallocate cur12
		end
		else if (@act_tipo = 'Prod/Barco ant nulo')
		begin		
			select @tp = p_tp_id, @fp = fp_sequencia from produto inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id inner join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id where p_id=@sub_prod

			declare cur12 cursor for
			select distinct of_id from ordemfabrico inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
				 --inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
					where of_p_id = @prod and fp_sequencia < @fp-- and p_tp_id = @tp and p_id = @sub_prod_ant

			OPEN cur12 

			fetch next from cur12 into @of_id while @@fetch_status=0
			begin

				exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @sub_prod, @qtd, @of_id, @tp

			fetch next from cur12 into @of_id

			end
			close cur12
			deallocate cur12
		end
		else if (@act_tipo = 'Associado/Prod')
		begin
			declare cur10 cursor for
			select distinct of_id, m1.mov_id, m.mov_quantidade * @qtd, m.mov_id
				from fases_producao inner join ordemfabrico on fp_id = of_fp_id inner join movimento as m on of_id = m.mov_of_id 
					left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id and m1.mov_p_id = @sub_prod 
				where fp_sequencia < @fp and m.mov_p_id = @prod

			OPEN cur10 

			fetch next from cur10 into @of_id, @mov, @quant, @mov_mov_id while @@fetch_status=0
			begin
				if (@mov is null)
				begin
					exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @sub_prod, @quant, @of_id, @tp, @mov_mov_id
				end
				else
				begin
					exec ProdutosAssociados_Upd @sub_prod, @quant, @of_id, @mov
				end

			fetch next from cur10 into @of_id, @mov, @quant, @mov_mov_id

			end
			close cur10
			deallocate cur10
		end
		else if (@act_tipo = 'Componente/Prod')
		begin			
			declare @dif float
			select @dif=(p_stock-p_necessidades-p_stockmin) from produto where p_id=@prod

			if (@dif)<0
			begin

				update produto set p_necessidades=(case when (p_necessidades+((@dif*-1)*@qtd))>0 then (p_necessidades+((@dif*-1)*@qtd)) else 0 end) where p_id=@sub_prod

			end
		end

		update [dbo].[actualizacoes] set act_completo = 1 where act_id = @act_id

	fetch next from curAct into @act_id, @act_tipo, @prod, @sub_prod_ant, @sub_prod, @tpcomp_id, @tp, @fp, @qtd
	end
	close curAct
	deallocate curAct
	END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[AddModelo_Add]

@M_NOME nvarchar(max),

AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.Agente_Faturacao_Classificar`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 11:55*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		NR
-- Create date: 
-- Description:	
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Agente_Faturacao_Classificar] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	UPDATE ENTIDADE
	SET e_bench_classe = classe,
		e_fact_epoca = epoca
	FROM entidade INNER JOIN
		(SELECT e_id, e_nome, SUM(etotal - ettiva) as total, SUM(etotal - ettiva)/dbo.inlinemax(MAX(YEAR(fdata)) - MIN(YEAR(fdata)), 1) as epoca, CASE WHEN SUM(etotal - ettiva)/dbo.inlinemax(MAX(YEAR(fdata)) - MIN(YEAR(fdata)), 1) > 100000 THEN 1 WHEN SUM(etotal - ettiva)/dbo.inlinemax(MAX(YEAR(fdata)) - MIN(YEAR(fdata)), 1) > 50000 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END as classe
		FROM ENTIDADE INNER JOIN
			[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft ON e_phc_id = ft.no
		WHERE e_phc_id IS NOT NULL
			AND ndoc IN (1, 4, 5)
			AND anulado = 0
			AND (MONTH(GETDATE()) > 9 AND fdata BETWEEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE())-3, 10, 1) AND DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 9, 30)
				OR MONTH(GETDATE()) <= 9 AND fdata BETWEEN DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE())-4, 10, 1) AND DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE())-1, 9, 30))
		GROUP BY e_id, e_nome) cl ON cl.e_id = ENTIDADE.E_ID

	
	-- Isto podia estar na query de cima, mas é mais simples assim
	UPDATE ENTIDADE SET e_fact_trimestre = e_fact_epoca/4 WHERE e_phc_id IS NOT NULL
			
END
```

#### `dbo.Agente_Faturacao_Updtate`(@reset bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 11:52*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		NR
-- Create date: 
-- Description:	
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Agente_Faturacao_Updtate] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@reset bit = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF @reset = 1
		BEGIN
			DELETE FROM AGENTE_FATURACAO
			DELETE FROM AGENTE_FATURACAO_UPDATE
			INSERT INTO AGENTE_FATURACAO_UPDATE (AFU_DATA) VALUES ('1990-01-01')
		END

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	DECLARE @ultUpdate datetime

	-- Ultima data de actualização
	SELECT @ultUpdate = MAX(afu_data) FROM AGENTE_FATURACAO_UPDATE

	-- Actualizar registos ja existentes
	UPDATE AGENTE_FATURACAO
	SET 
		AF_VALOR = AF_VALOR + res.total
	FROM
		AGENTE_FATURACAO INNER JOIN
			(SELECT e_id, YEAR(fdata) as ano, DATEPART(q, fdata) as trimestre, SUM(etotal - ettiva) as total
			FROM ENTIDADE INNER JOIN ENTIDADE_PHC ON e_id = ephc_e_id INNER JOIN
				[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft ON ephc_phc_id = ft.no
			WHERE e_phc_id IS NOT NULL
				AND ndoc IN (1, 4, 5)
				AND anulado = 0
				AND fdata > @ultUpdate
			GROUP BY e_id, YEAR(fdata), DATEPART(q, fdata)) as res 
		ON res.E_ID = AF_E_ID AND AF_ANO = ano AND AF_TRIMESTRE = trimestre


	INSERT INTO AGENTE_FATURACAO (AF_E_ID, AF_ANO, AF_TRIMESTRE, AF_VALOR)
	SELECT e_id, YEAR(fdata) as ano, DATEPART(q, fdata) as trimestre, SUM(etotal - ettiva) as total
	FROM ENTIDADE INNER JOIN ENTIDADE_PHC ON e_id = ephc_e_id INNER JOIN
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft ON ephc_phc_id = ft.no
	WHERE e_phc_id IS NOT NULL
		AND ndoc IN (1, 4, 5)
		AND anulado = 0
		AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM AGENTE_FATURACAO WHERE AF_E_ID = e_id AND AF_ANO = YEAR(fdata) AND AF_TRIMESTRE =  DATEPART(q, fdata))
	GROUP BY e_id, YEAR(fdata), DATEPART(q, fdata)


	MERGE INTO agente_fatura
	USING (SELECT e_id, fno, anulado
				FROM ENTIDADE INNER JOIN ENTIDADE_PHC ON e_id = ephc_e_id INNER JOIN
					[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft ON ephc_phc_id = ft.no
				WHERE e_phc_id IS NOT NULL
					AND ndoc IN (1, 4, 5)) as faturas
	ON agente_fatura.aft_e_id = faturas.e_id AND agente_fatura.aft_f_no = faturas.fno
	WHEN MATCHED AND aft_contabilizar = 1 AND anulado = 1 THEN
		UPDATE SET aft_contabilizar = 0 -- existe um trigger nesta tabela para fazer o desconto na AGENTE_FATURACAO
	WHEN NOT MATCHED AND anulado = 0 THEN
		INSERT (aft_e_id, aft_f_no, aft_contabilizar) VALUES (faturas.e_id, faturas.fno, 1);


	INSERT INTO AGENTE_FATURACAO_UPDATE (AFU_DATA) VALUES (GETDATE())

END
```

#### `dbo.Armazem_Lista_Stock`(@arm_id int, @movimentacao bit, @lista int, @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-10-25 15:23* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Armazem_Lista_Stock]

@arm_id int,
@movimentacao bit = 0,
@lista int = null,
@e_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if @e_id is null or (select e_tipo_util from entidade where e_id = @e_id) = 1
    select distinct
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0)) * p_uni_mov_factor as stock_arm, 
		(case when @movimentacao = 0 then (coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0)) * p_uni_mov_factor else 0 end) as acerto, 
		(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end) / p_uni_mov_factor as p_precocusto, p_precovenda, p_uni_mov_factor, p_qtdencomenda * p_uni_mov_factor as p_qtdencomenda, p_stockmin * p_uni_mov_factor as p_stockmin
	from 
		produto inner join 
		produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id inner join
		unidade on p_uni_id_movimentos = uni_id left join
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_arm_id = @arm_id and mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id left join
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_arm_id = @arm_id and mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id
		left join lista_produto on p_id = lp_p_id
	where	
		p_tem_stock = 1 
		and p_activo = 1 
		and p_descontinuado = 0 
		and isnull(@lista,1) = (case when @lista is null then 1 else lp_l_id end) 
		and p_arm_id = @arm_id
	order by
		tp_nome, p_nome
else
	select distinct
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0)) * p_uni_mov_factor as stock_arm, 
		(case when @movimentacao = 0 then (coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0)) * p_uni_mov_factor else 0 end) as acerto, 
		(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end) / p_uni_mov_factor as p_precocusto, p_precovenda, p_uni_mov_factor, p_qtdencomenda * p_uni_mov_factor as p_qtdencomenda, p_stockmin * p_uni_mov_factor as p_stockmin
	from 
		armazem
		inner join produto on arm_id = p_arm_id inner join 
		produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id inner join
		unidade on p_uni_id_movimentos = uni_id left join
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_arm_id = @arm_id and mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id left join
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_arm_id = @arm_id and mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id
		left join lista_produto on p_id = lp_p_id
	where	
		p_tem_stock = 1 
		and p_activo = 1 
		and p_descontinuado = 0 
		and isnull(@lista,1) = (case when @lista is null then 1 else lp_l_id end) 
		and (arm_e_id_resp = @e_id 
			or ARM_E_ID_AJUD = @e_id)
	order by
		tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.audit_manage`(@aud_id int, @aud_desc nvarchar(max), @aud_causa nvarchar(max), @aud_prop nvarchar(max), @aud_dataconc smalldatetime, @aud_datacriac smalldatetime, @aud_dataconcreal smalldatetime, @aud_result nvarchar(max), @aud_obs nvarchar(max), @aud_audt_id int, @aud_e_id int, @aud_aud_id int, @aud_pontosit nvarchar(max), @aud_responsaveis nvarchar(max), @aud_eliminado bit, @tp int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[audit_manage]

@aud_id int, 
@aud_desc nvarchar(max) = '', 
@aud_causa nvarchar(max) = '', 
@aud_prop nvarchar(max) = '', 
@aud_dataconc smalldatetime = null, 
@aud_datacriac smalldatetime = null, 
@aud_dataconcreal smalldatetime = null, 
@aud_result nvarchar(max) = '', 
@aud_obs nvarchar(max) = '', 
@aud_audt_id int = null, 
@aud_e_id int = null, 
@aud_aud_id int = null, 
@aud_pontosit nvarchar(max) = '', 
@aud_responsaveis nvarchar(max) = '', 
@aud_eliminado bit = 0,
@tp int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@tp = 1) -- novo
	begin
		insert into audit (aud_desc, aud_causa, aud_prop, aud_dataconc, aud_datacriac, aud_dataconcreal, aud_result, aud_obs, aud_audt_id, aud_e_id, aud_aud_id, aud_pontosit, aud_responsaveis, aud_eliminado)
		values (@aud_desc, @aud_causa, @aud_prop, @aud_dataconc, getdate(), @aud_dataconcreal, @aud_result, @aud_obs, @aud_audt_id, @aud_e_id, @aud_aud_id, @aud_pontosit, @aud_responsaveis, @aud_eliminado)	

		select id = @@identity
	end
	else if (@tp = 2) -- update
	begin
		update audit set aud_desc = @aud_desc, aud_causa = @aud_causa, aud_prop = @aud_prop, aud_dataconc = @aud_dataconc, 
			aud_datacriac = @aud_datacriac, aud_dataconcreal = @aud_dataconcreal, aud_result = @aud_result, aud_obs = @aud_obs, 
			aud_audt_id = @aud_audt_id, aud_e_id = @aud_e_id, aud_aud_id = @aud_aud_id, aud_pontosit = @aud_pontosit, 
			aud_responsaveis = @aud_responsaveis, aud_eliminado = @aud_eliminado
		where aud_id = @aud_id

		select id = @aud_id
	end
	else if (@tp = 3) -- delete
	begin
		update audit set aud_eliminado = 1 where aud_id = @aud_id
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.CentroTreino_Analise`(@data_I smalldatetime, @data_F smalldatetime, @centro int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CentroTreino_Analise]
	
@data_I smalldatetime,
@data_F smalldatetime, 
@centro int = 7

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @t_dias table (dt smalldatetime, ano int, mes int, dia int, num_Pess int, fact float, nosso float)
	declare @dia int
	set @dia = 0

	while (@dia <= datediff(dd,@data_I, @data_F))
	begin

		insert into @t_dias (dt,ano,mes,dia,num_Pess, fact, nosso) 
		(select dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I),year(dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I)), month(dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I)), day(dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I)), 
				coalesce(sum(crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3),0), coalesce(sum((crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3)*crq_preco),0), 
				coalesce(sum((crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3)*crq_preco) - sum((crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3)*crq_preco_nosso),0)
		from centro_reserva_quartos inner join centro_reserva on crq_res_id = res_id inner join entidade on res_e_id = e_id
		where dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I) between crq_data_ent and dateadd(dd,-1,crq_data_sai) and res_ce_id = @centro and res_tpcr_id = 3
		)

		set @dia = @dia + 1
	end

	-- Noites/Dia
	--select * from @t_dias order by dt

	-- Facturado/Mês
	declare @t_fact table (ano int, mes int, noites int, fact float)

	insert into @t_fact (ano, mes, noites, fact)
	select ano, mes, sum(num_Pess) as noites, sum(fact) as fact from @t_dias group by ano, mes order by ano, mes

	--Pessoas/Mês
	declare @t_noites table (ano int, mes int, MedNoites int)
	--insert into @t_noites (ano, mes) (select distinct ano, mes from @t_dias)

	insert into @t_noites (ano, mes, MedNoites)
	select ano, mes, sum(crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) as MedNoites
	from (select distinct ano, mes from @t_dias) as n inner join centro_reserva_quartos on ((n.ano = year(crq_data_ent) and n.mes = month(crq_data_ent)) or (n.ano = year(crq_data_sai) and n.mes = month(crq_data_sai)))
	inner join centro_reserva on crq_res_id = res_id where res_ce_id = @centro
	group by ano, mes
	--order by ano, mes

	declare @t_MedDias table (ano int, mes int, MedDias int)

	insert into @t_MedDias (ano, mes, MedDias)
	select year(res_data_ini) as Ano, month(res_data_ini) as Mes, round(avg(datediff(dd, res_data_ini, res_data_fim)),0) as MedDias
	from dbo.centro_reserva where res_data_ini between @data_I and @data_F and res_ce_id = @centro
	group by year(res_data_ini), month(res_data_ini)
	--order by Ano, Mes

	select f.ano, f.mes, f.noites, f.fact, coalesce(mn.MedNoites,0) as MedNoites, coalesce(md.MedDias,0) as MedDias
	from @t_fact as f left join @t_noites as mn on f.ano = mn.ano and f.mes = mn.mes left join @t_MedDias as md on f.ano = md.ano and f.mes = md.mes
	order by f.ano, f.mes

END
```

#### `dbo.Construcao_Lista`(@p_descontinuado bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Construcao_Lista]

@p_descontinuado bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select distinct
		p_id, 
		p_nome,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 1) as d1,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 2) as d2,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 3) as d3,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 4) as d4,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 5) as d5,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 6) as d6,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 7) as d7,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 8) as d8,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 9) as d9,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 1 and cam_sequencia = 10) as d10,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 1) as c1,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 2) as c2,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 3) as c3,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 4) as c4,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 5) as c5,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 6) as c6,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 7) as c7,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 8) as c8,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 9) as c9,
		(select cam_descricao from produto_camada where cam_p_id = p_id and cam_tpcam_id = 2 and cam_sequencia = 10) as c10,
		p_descontinuado
	from 
		produto --inner join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_p_id
	where 
		p_tp_id = 84 and 
		p_activo = 1 and
		p_descontinuado = @p_descontinuado
	order by 
		p_nome

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Construcao_Lista_Upd]

@p_id int,
@p_nome nvarchar(max),
@d1 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d2 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d3 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d4 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d5 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d6 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d7 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d8 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d9 nvarchar(max) = null,
@d10 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c1 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c2 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c3 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c4 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c5 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c6 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c7 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c8 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c9 nvarchar(max) = null,
@c10 nvarchar(max) = null,
@p_descontinuado bit = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	update produto set p_nome = @p_nome, p_descontinuado = isnull(@p_descontinuado, p_descontinuado) where p_id = @p_id

	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 1, @d1
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 2, @d2	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 3, @d3	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 4, @d4	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 5, @d5	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 6, @d6	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 7, @d7	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 8, @d8	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 9, @d9	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 1, 10, @d10
	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 1, @c1
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 2, @c2	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 3, @c3	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 4, @c4	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 5, @c5	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 6, @c6	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 7, @c7	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 8, @c8	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 9, @c9	
	exec Construcao_VerificaCamada @p_id, 2, 10, @c10	
	
END
```

#### `dbo.Construcao_VerificaCamada`(@cam_p_id int, @cam_tpcam_id int, @cam_sequencia int, @cam_descricao nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Construcao_VerificaCamada]

@cam_p_id int,
@cam_tpcam_id int,
@cam_sequencia int,
@cam_descricao nvarchar(max) = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (exists(select * from produto_camada where cam_p_id = @cam_p_id and cam_tpcam_id = @cam_tpcam_id and cam_sequencia = @cam_sequencia) and @cam_descricao <> '' and @cam_descricao is not null)
		update produto_camada set cam_descricao = @cam_descricao where cam_p_id = @cam_p_id and cam_tpcam_id = @cam_tpcam_id and cam_sequencia = @cam_sequencia
	else if (@cam_descricao <> '' and @cam_descricao is not null)
		insert into produto_camada (cam_p_id, cam_tpcam_id, cam_descricao, cam_sequencia)
			values (@cam_p_id, @cam_tpcam_id, @cam_descricao, @cam_sequencia)
	else if (@cam_descricao = '' or @cam_descricao is null)
		delete produto_camada where cam_p_id = @cam_p_id and cam_tpcam_id = @cam_tpcam_id and cam_sequencia = @cam_sequencia
	
END
```

#### `dbo.ConstrucaoDetalhe_Duplica`(@p_id int, @p_criador nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2020-04-23 10:35*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ConstrucaoDetalhe_Duplica] 
	@p_id int,
	@p_criador nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @id int, @dt datetime = getdate(), @t as time = cast(getdate() as time)

    insert into produto
		(p_np_id, p_nome, p_datacriacao, p_p_id, p_descricao, p_tp_id, p_criador)
		(select 
			p_np_id, p_nome + ' (' + cast(@t as nvarchar(max)) + ')', getdate(), p_p_id, p_descricao, 84, @p_criador
		from 
			produto 
		where 
			p_id = @p_id)


	select @id = @@identity


	insert into produto_camada
			(cam_p_id, cam_tpcam_id, cam_descricao, cam_sequencia)
		(select @id, cam_tpcam_id, cam_descricao, cam_sequencia from produto_camada where cam_p_id = @p_id)



	insert into produto_componente
			(comp_p_id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id, comp_data_alt, comp_fase_final, comp_atrib_id, comp_fp_id)
			(select @id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id, @dt, comp_fase_final, comp_atrib_id, comp_fp_id from produto_componente where comp_p_id = @p_id)

	select id = @id
END
```

#### `dbo.ConstrucaoDetalhe_Lista_Associados`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-12-12 11:24* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ConstrucaoDetalhe_Lista_Associados]

@p_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		tp_nome, comp_p_p_id, p_nome, uni_nome as Unidade, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id, comp_id, 
		case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end as p_precocusto, comp_obs
	from
		produto_componente 
		inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
	where
		comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1 and p_tp_id <> 84
END
```

#### `dbo.ConstrucaoDetalhe_Lista_OFs`(@const_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `v_of`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ConstrucaoDetalhe_Lista_OFs]

@const_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

select 
	mov_p_id, of_id, p.p_nome, dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as cores, --p1.p_nome as CorCasco, p2.p_nome as CorDeck, 
	of_fp_id, offpeq_e_id,
	of_pago, of_datapagamento, of_referencia, of_oftu_id, of_transportedoc
FROM 
	ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
	--left join produto as p1 on of_p_id_ccasco = p1.p_id
	--left join produto as p2 on of_p_id_cdeck = p2.p_id
	inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 8
	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id
	inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id
	left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
where
	mov_p_id = @const_id
order by 
	of_pago, tr_data desc

END
```

#### `dbo.Construcoes_Upd_OF`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Construcoes_Upd_OF] 
	
@p_id int

AS
BEGIN

	declare @of_id int
	declare cur11 cursor for
	select distinct of_id from produto_componente inner join ordemfabrico on comp_p_id = of_p_id where comp_p_p_id = @p_id and of_fp_id in (11,32)

	OPEN cur11 

	fetch next from cur11 into @of_id while @@fetch_status=0
	begin

		exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio null, 1, @of_id, 84

		exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @p_id, 1, @of_id, 84

	fetch next from cur11 into @of_id

	end
	close cur11
	deallocate cur11
END
```

#### `dbo.Contabilidade_Barcos`(@ano int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Contabilidade_Barcos]

@ano int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @mes int,
		@Tipo nvarchar(max),
		@Produzidos int,
		@Vendidos int,
		@Emprestados int,
		@Emprestados_Valor float,
		@Desmoldados int,
		@Desmoldados_Valor float,
		@Acabados int,
		@Acabados_Valor float

create table #p
(
	Ano int,
	Mes int,
	Tipo nvarchar(max),
	Acabados int,
	Acabados_Valor float,
	Desmoldados int,
	Desmoldados_Valor float,
	Emprestados int,
	Emprestados_Valor float,
	Cedidos int,
	Cedidos_Valor float,
	Vendidos int,
	Vendidos_Valor float
)

while (@ano <= year(getdate()))
begin

	set @mes = 1

	while (@mes <= 12)
	begin
		if (@ano = year(getdate()) and @mes = month(getdate())+1)
		begin
			set @mes = 13
		end
		else
		begin
			insert into #p (Ano,Mes,Tipo,Acabados,Acabados_Valor,Desmoldados,Desmoldados_Valor,Emprestados,Emprestados_Valor,Cedidos,Cedidos_Valor,Vendidos,Vendidos_Valor)
			select 
				@ano, @mes, tp_nome,
				(select count(of_id) from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(of_datafim) = @ano and month(of_datafim) = @mes and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Acabados,
				(select sum(coalesce(p_precovenda*0.4,0)) from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(of_datafim) = @ano and month(of_datafim) = @mes and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Acabados_Valor,
				(select count(of_id) from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(offp_datafim) = @ano and month(offp_datafim) = @mes and p_tp_id = tp_id and offp_fp_id = 6/* and of_datafim is null*/) as Desmoldados,
				(select sum(coalesce(p_precovenda*0.3,0)) from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(offp_datafim) = @ano and month(offp_datafim) = @mes and p_tp_id = tp_id and offp_fp_id = 6/* and of_datafim is null*/) as Desmoldados_Valor,
				(select count(distinct(ofoftu_of_id)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @ano and month(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 2 and p_tp_id = tp_id)
				- (select count(distinct(ofoftu_of_id)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_datasaida) = @ano and month(ofoftu_datasaida) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 2 and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Emprestados,
				(select sum(coalesce(p_precovenda,0)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @ano and month(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 2 and p_tp_id = tp_id)
				- (select sum(coalesce(p_precovenda,0)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_datasaida) = @ano and month(ofoftu_datasaida) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 2 and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Emprestados_Valor,
				(select count(distinct(ofoftu_of_id)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @ano and month(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 59 and p_tp_id = tp_id)
				- (select count(distinct(ofoftu_of_id)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_datasaida) = @ano and month(ofoftu_datasaida) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 59 and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Cedidos,
				(select sum(coalesce(p_precovenda,0)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @ano and month(ofoftu_dataentrada) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 59 and p_tp_id = tp_id)
				- (select sum(coalesce(p_precovenda,0)) from of_of_tipouso inner join ordemfabrico on ofoftu_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(ofoftu_datasaida) = @ano and month(ofoftu_datasaida) = @mes and ofoftu_oftu_id = 59 and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Cedidos_Valor,
				(select count(of_id) from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(of_datatransporte) = @ano and month(of_datatransporte) = @mes and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Vendidos,
				(select sum(coalesce(p_precovenda,0)) from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where year(of_datatransporte) = @ano and month(of_datatransporte) = @mes and p_tp_id = tp_id) as Vendidos
			from
				produto_tipo
			where
				tp_tp_id = 1


			set @mes = @mes + 1
		end
	end

	set @ano = @ano + 1

end


select 
			Ano,
			Mes,
			Tipo,
			Acabados,
			coalesce(Round(Acabados_Valor,2),0) as Acabados_Valor,
			Desmoldados,
			coalesce(Round(Desmoldados_Valor,2),0) as Desmoldados_Valor,
			Emprestados,
			coalesce(Round(Emprestados_Valor,2),0) as Emprestados_Valor,
			Cedidos,
			coalesce(Round(Cedidos_Valor,2),0) as Cedidos_Valor,
			Vendidos,
			coalesce(Round(Vendidos_Valor,2),0) as Vendidos_Valor
from 
			#p
order by
			Ano,
			Mes,
			Tipo
END

drop table #p
```

#### `dbo.Contabilidade_Foenecedores`(@ano int, @mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Contabilidade_Foenecedores]

@ano int = null,
@mes int = null

as
begin
	set nocount on;

if (@ano is null)
begin
	select e_nome, convert(varchar(10), mov_data, 103) as data, p_nome, mov_quantidade, p_precocusto, mov_quantidade * p_precocusto as total
	from entidade inner join movimento on e_id = mov_e_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
	order by e_nome, mov_data
end
else if (@ano is not null and @mes is not null)
begin
	select e_nome, convert(varchar(10), mov_data, 103) as data, p_nome, mov_quantidade, p_precocusto, mov_quantidade * p_precocusto as total
	from entidade inner join movimento on e_id = mov_e_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
	where year(mov_data) = @ano and month(mov_data) = @mes
	order by e_nome, mov_data
end
else if (@ano is not null and @mes is null)
begin
	select e_nome, convert(varchar(10), mov_data, 103) as data, p_nome, mov_quantidade, p_precocusto, mov_quantidade * p_precocusto as total
	from entidade inner join movimento on e_id = mov_e_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
	where year(mov_data) = @ano
	order by e_nome, mov_data
end

end
```

#### `dbo.Contabilidade_Fornecedores_Data`(@ano int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Contabilidade_Fornecedores_Data]

@ano int

as

begin
	set nocount on;

	select 
		e_nome, 
		year(mov_data) as ano, 
		month(mov_data) as mes, 
		convert(nvarchar(max),month(mov_data)) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),year(mov_data)) as data, 
		sum(mov_quantidade * p_precocusto) as total
	from 
		entidade inner join 
		movimento on e_id = mov_e_id inner join 
		produto on mov_p_id = p_id
	where 
		year(mov_data) >= @ano and mov_tpmov_id = 1
	group by 
		e_nome, year(mov_data), month(mov_data)
	order by 
		e_nome, year(mov_data), month(mov_data)

end
```

#### `dbo.Contabilidade_Fornecedores_Data_Detalhe`(@ncont nvarchar(max), @dt_i smalldatetime, @dt_f smalldatetime)

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Contabilidade_Fornecedores_Data_Detalhe]

@ncont nvarchar(max),
@dt_i smalldatetime,
@dt_f smalldatetime

as

begin
```

#### `dbo.CopyPasteInventario`(@COMP_ID_COPY int, @COMP_ID_PASTE int, @COMP_TPCOMP_ID int)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nuno Andre
-- Create date: 11/05/2007
-- Description:	copia a composicao um produto
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CopyPasteInventario]

@COMP_ID_COPY INT,
@COMP_ID_PASTE INT,
@COMP_TPCOMP_ID INT

AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	IF (@COMP_ID_COPY<>@COMP_ID_PASTE)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO PRODUTO_COMPONENTE (COMP_P_ID, COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, COMP_TPCOMP_ID, comp_atrib_id)
			(SELECT @COMP_ID_PASTE, COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, @COMP_TPCOMP_ID, comp_atrib_id FROM PRODUTO_COMPONENTE WHERE COMP_P_ID = @COMP_ID_COPY AND COMP_TPCOMP_ID = @COMP_TPCOMP_ID)
	END
END
```

#### `dbo.DB_Defragmentation`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-08-07 11:37 · modificado 2021-06-22 13:46*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DB_Defragmentation] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	DECLARE @TableName VARCHAR(255)
	DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(500)
	DECLARE @fillfactor INT

	SET @fillfactor = 80 

	DECLARE TableCursor CURSOR FOR
	SELECT '[' + OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME([object_id])+'].['+name+']' AS TableName
	FROM sys.tables

	OPEN TableCursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM TableCursor INTO @TableName
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @sql = 'ALTER INDEX ALL ON ' + @TableName + ' REBUILD WITH (FILLFACTOR = ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(3),@fillfactor) + ')'
		EXEC (@sql)
		FETCH NEXT FROM TableCursor INTO @TableName
	END

	CLOSE TableCursor
	DEALLOCATE TableCursor

END
```

#### `dbo.DB_FragmentationCheck`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DB_FragmentationCheck] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	SELECT 
		a.index_id, 
		name, 
		avg_fragmentation_in_percent  
	FROM 
		sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats (DB_ID(N'MAR-KAYAKS'), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL) AS a  
		JOIN sys.indexes AS b ON a.object_id = b.object_id AND a.index_id = b.index_id
	order by 
		avg_fragmentation_in_percent desc;
END
```

#### `dbo.DB_LogErrors`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DB_LogErrors] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
	CREATE TABLE #errorLog (LogDate DATETIME, ProcessInfo VARCHAR(64), [Text] VARCHAR(MAX));

	INSERT INTO #errorLog
	EXEC sp_readerrorlog -- specify the log number or use nothing for active error log

	SELECT * 
	FROM #errorLog a
	WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * 
				  FROM #errorLog b
				  WHERE [Text] like 'Error:%'
					AND a.LogDate = b.LogDate
					AND a.ProcessInfo = b.ProcessInfo)


	DROP TABLE #errorLog;
END
```

#### `dbo.DB_Search_SPs_Triggers`(@SEARCHSTRING varchar(255), @notcontain varchar(255))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DB_Search_SPs_Triggers]

	@SEARCHSTRING VARCHAR(255), @notcontain Varchar(255)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    --DECLARE @SEARCHSTRING VARCHAR(255), @notcontain Varchar(255)

	--SELECT @SEARCHSTRING = '%@%', @notcontain = ''

	SELECT DISTINCT sysobjects.name AS [Object Name] ,
	case when sysobjects.xtype = 'P' then 'Stored Proc'
	when sysobjects.xtype = 'TF' then 'T Function'
	when sysobjects.xtype = 'TR' then 'Trigger'
	when sysobjects.xtype = 'V' then 'View'
	when sysobjects.xtype = 'IF' then 'I Function'
	else sysobjects.xtype
	end as [Object Type]
	FROM sysobjects,syscomments
	WHERE sysobjects.id = syscomments.id
	--AND sysobjects.type in ('P','TF','TR','V')
	AND sysobjects.category = 0
	and syscomments.text like @SEARCHSTRING
	and syscomments.text not like @notcontain
	--AND CHARINDEX(@SEARCHSTRING,syscomments.text)>0
	--AND ((CHARINDEX(@notcontain,syscomments.text)=0 
	--or CHARINDEX(@notcontain,syscomments.text)<>0)) 
END
```

```sql
AS

END
```

#### `dbo.Deslocacoes`(@dI smalldatetime, @dF smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Deslocacoes]

@dI smalldatetime, 
@dF smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		tr_data, tr_descricao, paises_nome, trdesptp_nome, trtp_nome,
		sum(trdesp_qtd * trdesp_valor) as valor, 
		(case when n.noites is null or n.noites = 0 then 1 else n.noites end) as noites, n.pess, 
		round(desp.valor/(case when n.noites is null or n.noites = 0 then 1 else n.noites end),2) as despDia, 
		round(ht.valor/(case when n.noites is null or n.noites = 0 then 1 else n.noites end),2) as hDia,
		sum(trdesp_valor_estimado) as valor_estimado
	from 
		transporte as t left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id
		inner join transp_desp on tr_id = trdesp_tr_id inner join transp_desp_tipo on trdesp_trdesptp_id = trdesptp_id
		left join (select tre_tr_id, count(*) as pess, sum(tre_noites) as noites from transp_entidade group by tre_tr_id) as n on tr_id = n.tre_tr_id
		left join (select trdesp_tr_id, sum(trdesp_qtd * trdesp_valor) as valor from transp_desp where trdesp_trdesptp_id in (3,6) group by trdesp_tr_id) as desp on tr_id = desp.trdesp_tr_id
		left join (select trdesp_tr_id, sum(trdesp_qtd * trdesp_valor) as valor from transp_desp where trdesp_trdesptp_id = 1 group by trdesp_tr_id) as ht on tr_id = ht.trdesp_tr_id
	where
		tr_data between @dI and @dF and trtp_trtp_id = 19
	group by
		tr_data, tr_descricao, paises_nome, trdesptp_nome, trtp_nome, (case when n.noites is null or n.noites = 0 then 1 else n.noites end), n.pess, desp.valor/(case when n.noites is null or n.noites = 0 then 1 else n.noites end), ht.valor/(case when n.noites is null or n.noites = 0 then 1 else n.noites end)
	order by 
		tr_data, tr_descricao, trdesptp_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_Empregados`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_Empregados]

as

SELECT        TOP (100) PERCENT E_ID,  (CASE WHEN e_activo = 0 THEN E_NOME + ' ** Out' /*WHEN e_fp_id <> efp_fp_id THEN e_nome + ' ** Noutra'*/ ELSE e_nome END)  as E_NOME, E_ENT_ID, efp_fp_id
FROM            dbo.ENTIDADE left join  dbo.ENTIDADE_FASE ON dbo.ENTIDADE.E_ID = dbo.ENTIDADE_FASE.EFP_E_ID and dbo.ENTIDADE_FASE.EFP_QUALIFICADO = 0
WHERE        e_ent_id not in (2,17,18)
UNION
SELECT        TOP (100) PERCENT null AS e_id, ' ' AS e_nome, - 1 AS e_ent_id, -1 as efp_fp_id
ORDER BY E_NOME
```

#### `dbo.DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs`(@arm_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs]

@arm_id int = 1

as

select 
	of_id as OrdFab,
	e.e_nome as Cliente,
	p.p_nome as Modelo,
	p1.p_nome as Deck,
	p2.p_nome as Casco,
	e1.e_nome as Emp,
	tr_data as Transporte,
	Dias = datediff(dd, offp_datainicio, getdate()),
	of_fp_id,
	enc_nome as Encomenda,
	of_supervisao,
	of_supervisaolaminagem
from 
	ordemfabrico left join
	entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join
	of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id left join
	offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
	entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id inner join
	produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join 
	produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join 
	produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
	encomenda on of_enc_id = enc_id  left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
where
	of_fp_id in (1,2,3,4,5,22,7,8,9,10,13,14,33) and (of_id > 89000 or of_id < 70000) and offp_datafim is null and of_arm_id = @arm_id and of_id < 10000000
order by of_fp_id, of_id
```

#### `dbo.DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs_ComPintura`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `KPI`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs_ComPintura]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

select 
	of_id,
	p.p_nome,
	p.p_np_id,
	p1.p_nome as cdeck,
	of_deckpintura, 
	p2.p_nome as ccasco,
	of_cascopintura,
	e.e_nome as cliente,
	of_referencia,
	of_sequencia,
	offpeq.offpeq_e_id as laminador,
	offpeq1.offpeq_e_id as colador,
	offpeq2.offpeq_e_id as desmoldador,
	offpeq3.offpeq_e_id as acabador,
	(select top 1 convert(nvarchar(max),tr_data,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(tr_descricao,'') 
			from transporte left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
			where trof_of_id = of_id and trof_enviado = 1 order by tr_data desc) as UltTR,
	of_tr_id,
	mov_p_id,
	of_fp_id,
	of_observacoes,
	of_supervisao
from
	ordemfabrico left join
	produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join
	produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
	produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
	entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join
	of_fp as offp on of_id = offp.offp_of_id and offp.offp_fp_id = 1 left join
	offp_eq as offpeq on offp.offp_id = offpeq.offpeq_offp_id and offpeq.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
	of_fp as offp1 on of_id = offp1.offp_of_id and offp1.offp_fp_id = 4 left join
	offp_eq as offpeq1 on offp1.offp_id = offpeq1.offpeq_offp_id and offpeq1.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
	of_fp as offp2 on of_id = offp2.offp_of_id and offp2.offp_fp_id = 6 left join
	offp_eq as offpeq2 on offp2.offp_id = offpeq2.offpeq_offp_id and offpeq2.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
	of_fp as offp3 on of_id = offp3.offp_of_id and offp3.offp_fp_id = 8 left join
	offp_eq as offpeq3 on offp3.offp_id = offpeq3.offpeq_offp_id and offpeq3.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
	movimento on of_id = mov_of_id and mov_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 81)
	left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
where
	of_fp_id in (7,8) and (of_p_id_cdeck = 20598 or of_p_id_ccasco = 20598)
order by 
	of_deckpintura, of_cascopintura, tr_data

END
```

#### `dbo.DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs_EmEstado`(@of_eof_id int, @of_arm_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-05-17 10:14* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs_EmEstado]

@of_eof_id int,
@of_arm_id int = 1

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@of_eof_id = 9)
begin
	select 
		of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		p.p_np_id,
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as cores, --p1.p_nome as cdeck, p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		e.e_nome as cliente,
		of_referencia,
		coalesce(dias.dt,0) as dias,
		of_sequencia,
		of_arm_id,
		of_parapintarfora,
		d.offpeq_e_id as acabador,
		g.offpeq_e_id as lixador,
		--b.offpeq_e_id as colador,
		--coalesce(b.fp, 0) as colado,
		h.offpeq_e_id as pintoracabador,
		coalesce(h.fp,0) as pintado,
		convert(nvarchar(max),ant.data_ant,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(ant.descr_ant,'') as UltTR,
		of_tr_id,
		mov_p_id,
		of_fp_id,
		of_observacoes,
		a.offpeq_e_id as laminador,
		c.offpeq_e_id as desmoldador,
		c.offpcl_desc as gravidade,
		of_supervisao,
		of_supervisaolaminagem,
		ant.data_ant as UltData,
		ant.descr_ant,
		tr_data,
		tr_descricao
	from
		ordemfabrico left join
		produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
		outer apply 
			(select top 1 offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_return = 0 and OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM desc) as a 
		outer apply 
			(select top 1 offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, offpcl_desc, offpcl_sequencia from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id left join offp_cl on offp_offpcl_id = offpcl_id where offp_fp_id = 6 and offp_return = 0 and of_id = offp_of_id order by OFFP_DATAFIM desc) as c 
		outer apply 
			(select top 1 offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 33 and offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_return = 0 and of_id = offp_of_id order by OFFP_DATAFIM desc) as d   
		outer apply 
			(select top 1 offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 22 and offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_return = 0 and of_id = offp_of_id order by OFFP_DATAFIM desc) as g 
		outer apply 
			(select top 1 offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, (case when offp_datafim is null then 0 else 1 end) as fp from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_return = 0 and of_id = offp_of_id order by OFFP_DATAFIM desc) as h  
		left join
		movimento on of_id = mov_of_id and mov_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 81)
		left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id left join 
			(select max(tr_data) as dt_ant, trof_of_id
				from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id where trof_enviado = 1 group by trof_of_id) as x on of_id = x.trof_of_id 
		left join
			(select tr_data as data_ant, tr_descricao as descr_ant, trof_of_id
				from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id where trof_enviado = 1) as ant on ant.trof_of_id = x.trof_of_id and ant.data_ant = x.dt_ant 
		left join
			(select offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, datediff(dd,max(offp_datainicio),getdate()) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (9,10,13,14) and (offp_of_id > 89000 or offp_of_id < 70000) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as dias on of_id = dias.offp_of_id and of_fp_id = dias.offp_fp_id
	where
		of_fp_id in (9,10,13,14) and (of_id > 89999 or of_id < 70000) and of_id < 10000000 --and E_NELO = 0 and of_arm_id = @of_arm_id
	order by tr_data desc, tr_descricao, c.offpcl_sequencia, of_fp_id, cliente
end
else if (@of_eof_id = 7)
begin
```

#### `dbo.DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs_Moldes`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[DisposicaoFabrica_Lista_OFs_Moldes]

as

select distinct
	of_id as OrdFab,
	of_nome as Nome,
	p.p_nome as Modelo,
	--p1.p_nome as Deck,
	--p2.p_nome as Casco,
	of_fp_id,
	of_supervisao 
from 
	ordemfabrico left join
	entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join
	of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id left join
	offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
	entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id inner join
	produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join 
	--produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join 
	--produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
	encomenda on of_enc_id = enc_id
where
	of_fp_id in (21,11,1,2,7,8,13,14,15,16,20) and of_id between 70000 and 89999
order by of_fp_id, of_id
```

#### `dbo.DouroAcademy_Aulas`(@aulaId int, @aulaTipoId int, @aulaModalidade nvarchar(max), @aulaNAulas int, @aulaPreco float, @aulaDesconto float, @aulaObs nvarchar(max), @aulaData smalldatetime, @tar int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-03-28 16:00 · modificado 2022-09-29 10:14* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DouroAcademy_Aulas]
	@aulaId int,
	@aulaTipoId int,
	@aulaModalidade nvarchar(max),
	@aulaNAulas int,
	@aulaPreco float,
	@aulaDesconto float,
	@aulaObs nvarchar(max) = '',
	@aulaData smalldatetime,
	@tar int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@tar = 0)
	begin
		delete from DOURO_AULA_MONITOR where AM_AULA_ID = @aulaId
		delete from DOURO_AULA where AULA_ID = @aulaId
	end
	else if (@tar = 1)/*inserir*/
	begin
		insert into DOURO_AULA(aula_data, aula_qtd, aula_preco, aula_desconto, aula_obs, aula_p_id, aula_mov_id, aula_modalidade)
		values (@aulaData, @aulaNAulas, @aulaPreco, @aulaDesconto, @aulaObs, @aulaTipoId, null, @aulaModalidade)

		select @aulaId = @@IDENTITY
	end
	else if (@tar = 2)/*actualizar*/
	begin
		update DOURO_AULA
		set
			aula_data = @aulaData, 
			aula_qtd = @aulaNAulas, 
			aula_preco = @aulaPreco, 
			aula_desconto = @aulaDesconto, 
			aula_obs = @aulaObs, 
			aula_p_id = @aulaTipoId, 
			aula_modalidade = @aulaModalidade
		where
			AULA_ID = @aulaId
	end

	select id = @aulaId
END
```

#### `dbo.DouroAcademy_AulasMonitor`(@aulaId int, @monitorId int, @horas int, @valor float, @tar int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-03-29 14:40 · modificado 2022-03-29 15:41*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE DouroAcademy_AulasMonitor
	@aulaId int,
	@monitorId int,
	@horas int = 1,
	@valor float = 0,
	@tar int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@tar = 0)
	begin
		delete from DOURO_AULA_MONITOR where AM_AULA_ID = @aulaId and AM_E_ID = @monitorId
	end
	else if (@tar = 1)/*inserir*/
	begin
		insert into DOURO_AULA_MONITOR(AM_AULA_ID, AM_E_ID, AM_HORAS, AM_VALOR_PAGO)
		values (@aulaId, @monitorId, @horas, @valor)
	end
	else if (@tar = 2)/*actualizar*/
	begin
		update DOURO_AULA_MONITOR
		set
			AM_HORAS = @horas, 
			AM_VALOR_PAGO = @valor
		where
			AM_AULA_ID = @aulaId 
			and AM_E_ID = @monitorId
	end

	select foto = E_FOTO from entidade where e_id = @monitorid
END
```

#### `dbo.DouroAula_ThumbsUpDown`(@UpDown bit, @aula_id int, @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-10-28 13:27 · modificado 2022-10-28 13:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE DouroAula_ThumbsUpDown
	@UpDown bit,
	@aula_id int,
	@e_id int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if exists(select * from douro_aula_entidade where aulae_aula_id = @aula_id and aulae_e_id = @e_id)
	begin
		update douro_aula_entidade set AULAE_INTERESSE = case when @UpDown = 1 then 1 else -1 end where aulae_aula_id = @aula_id and aulae_e_id = @e_id
	end
	else
	begin
		insert into douro_aula_entidade (AULAE_AULA_ID, AULAE_E_ID, AULAE_INTERESSE, AULAE_DATA) values (@aula_id, @e_id, case when @UpDown = 1 then 1 else -1 end, getdate())
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Email_BarcosFechados`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-04-13 10:37 · modificado 2020-04-15 14:12* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Email_BarcosFechados]
AS
BEGIN

	declare @t table(linha nvarchar(max))
	declare @txt  nvarchar(max), 
	@corlinha bit

	set @txt = '<table border="1"><tr style="background-color:gray"><th width="15%"><span style="color:white">OF</span></th><th width="65%"><span style="color:white">Modelo</span></th><th width="20%"><span style="color:white">Laminagem</span></th></tr>'

	insert into @t (linha)
	select 
		'<tr style="background-color:FFC"><td>' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)) + '</td><td>' + p_nome + '</td><td>' + cast(cast(lam.fim as date) as nvarchar(max)) + '</td></tr>'
	from 
		of_fp 
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join produto on OF_P_ID = p_id
		inner join (select offp_of_id id, offp_datafim fim from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 and OFFP_DATAFIM is not null) as lam on OF_ID = lam.id
	where 
		OFFP_FP_ID = 8
		and cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(DATEADD(day,-1,getdate()) as date)
	order by lam.fim

	if exists(select * from @t)
	begin
		while exists (select top 1 linha from @t)
		begin
			if @corlinha = 0
			begin
				set @corlinha = 1
				set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 Replace(linha,'style="background-color:FFC','style="background-color:white') from @t)
			end
			else
			begin
				set @corlinha = 0
				set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 linha from @t)
			end
			
			delete @t where linha = (select top 1 linha from @t)
		end

		EXEC	[dbo].[SendMail]
				@De = N'nelo.production.div@gmail.com',
				@Para = N'rutedanielanascimento@outlook.com',
				--@CC = N'andre.santos@nelo.eu',
				@BCC = N'nunandre@gmail.com',
				@Assunto = N'Barcos acabados no dia anterior',
				@Texto = @txt,
				@HTML = 1
	end

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Email_Moldes]
AS
BEGIN

	from ordemfabrico inner join

	where of_id between 70000 and 89999 and 
	offp_fp_id = 14 and convert(nchar(10), getdate(), 101) = convert(nchar(10), offp_datainicio, 101)

	if exists(select * from @t)

				set @corlinha = 1
				set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 Replace(linha,'style="background-color:FFC','style="background-color:white') from @t)
			end
			else
			begin
				set @corlinha = 0
				set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 linha from @t)
			end
			
			delete @t where linha = (select top 1 linha from @t)
		end

		EXEC	[dbo].[SendMail]
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Email_Movimentação_Moldes]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @HTML_table nvarchar(max) = (select dbo.Query_to_HTMLtable('select OF_ID as [OF], OF_NOME as Nome, p_nome as Modelo from dbo.Moldes_movimentacao'))
	declare @msg nvarchar(500)

	declare curcapa cursor for
	select '<tr style="background-color:FFC"><td>' + convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) + '</td><td>' + of_nome + '</td><td>' + p_nome + '</td>' from dbo.moldes_movimentacao order by p_nome

	open curcapa

	declare @linha nvarchar(max)

	fetch next from curcapa into @linha while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		set @HTML_table += @linha

	fetch next from curcapa into @linha
	end
	close curcapa
	deallocate curcapa

	EXEC	[dbo].[SendMail]
				@De = N'nelo.production.div@gmail.com',
				@Para = N'eduardojppinto@hotmail.com; marto.fontes@gmail.com',

				@Assunto = 'Movimentação de moldes para o 1º piso',

				@HTML = 1,

END
```

#### `dbo.Email_OFsSemTransp_TransporteExistente`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-12-21 09:25* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Email_OFsSemTransp_TransporteExistente]
AS
BEGIN

	declare @t table(id int, linha nvarchar(max))
	declare @txt  nvarchar(max), @corlinha bit

	set @txt = '<table border="1"><tr style="background-color:gray"><th width="30%"><span style="color:white">Cliente</span></th><th width="10%"><span style="color:white">OF Id</span></th><th width="10%"><span style="color:white">OF Data</span></th><th width="15%"><span style="color:white">Modelo</span></th><th width="30%"><span style="color:white">Referencia</span></th><th width="30%"><span style="color:white">Tr. data</span></th><th width="30%"><span style="color:white">Tr. tipo</span></th></tr>'

	insert into @t (id, linha)
	select 
		of_id, '<tr style="background-color:FFC"><td>' + e_nome + '</td><td>' + convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) + '</td><td>' + convert(varchar(10),of_data,101) + '</td><td>' + p_nome + '</td><td>' + of_referencia + '</td><td>' + convert(varchar(10),trs.tr_data,101) + '</td><td>' + trs.trtp_nome + '</td>'
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		outer apply (select * from transp_of where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID and TROF_ENVIADO = 1) z
		inner join (select distinct of_e_id_enc, tr_data, trtp_nome from ordemfabrico inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id where tr_data >= getdate()) as trs on e_id = trs.of_e_id_enc
	where 
		of_tr_id is null 
		and fp_sequencia < dbo.fase_sequencia_entregue() 
		and e_nelo = 0
		and z.TROF_TR_ID is null
		and of_id < 10000000
	order by 
		e_nome, p_nome

	if exists(select * from @t)
	begin
		while exists (select top 1 linha from @t)
		begin
			if @corlinha = 0
			begin
				set @corlinha = 1
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Email_PA_Estufa]

	insert into @t (linha)
	select

	from

		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on offp_of_id = OF_ID
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join entidade on OF_E_ID_ENC = e_id
	where
		offp_fp_id = 5
		and datediff(HH,offp_datafim,getdate()) = 2
	union
	select
		'<tr style="background-color:FFC"><td>' + e_nome + '</td><td>' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)) + '</td><td>' + p_nome + '</td><td>Tirar da estufa</td></tr>'

		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on offp_of_id = OF_ID
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join entidade on OF_E_ID_ENC = e_id
		inner join (select offp_of_id as id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 22 and OFFP_DATAINICIO is null) as lSeco on OF_ID = lSeco.id
	where
		offp_fp_id = 5
		and datediff(HH,offp_datafim,getdate()) = 8

	if exists(select * from @t)
	begin
		while exists (select top 1 linha from @t)
		begin
			if @corlinha = 0
			begin
				set @corlinha = 1
				set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 Replace(linha,'style="background-color:FFC','style="background-color:white') from @t)
			end
			else
			begin
				set @corlinha = 0
				set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 linha from @t)
			end
			
			delete @t where linha = (select top 1 linha from @t)
		end

				@Para = N'alexcosta.nelo@gmail.com',
				@CC = N'andre.santos@nelo.eu',

				@HTML = 1
	end

END
```

```sql
		+ p_nome + '</td><td>' 
		+ fp_nome + '</td><td>' 
		+ ARM_NOME + '</td>'
		--+ '<td><form action="http://192.168.0.15:3138/fechaOF/' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)) + '/' + cast(OFFP_ID as nvarchar(max)) + '/9"' + '  method="post"><input type="submit" value="Bom"><form/></td><td>'
		--+ '<a href="http://192.168.0.15:3138/fechaOF/' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)) + '/' + cast(OFFP_ID as nvarchar(max)) + '/49"' + ' target="_blank">Médio<a/></td><td>'

	from
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID

		and OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA < dateadd(D,-7,getdate())

	if exists(select * from @t)
	begin
		while exists (select top 1 linha from @t)
		begin
			if @corlinha = 0
			begin
				set @corlinha = 1
				set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 Replace(linha,'style="background-color:FFC','style="background-color:white') from @t)

				@CC = N'luis.miguel@nelo.eu',
				@BCC = N'nunandre@gmail.com',

				@Texto = @txt,

	end

END
```
