#### `dbo.Fornecedores_ListaCompras`(@e_id int, @ano int, @mes int, @anof int, @mesf int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-06-26 16:53* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Fornecedores_ListaCompras]

@e_id int,
@ano int,
@mes int,
@anof int = @ano,
@mesf int = @mes

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @dI date, @dF date
	set @dI = cast(convert(nvarchar(max),@ano) + '/' + convert(nvarchar(max),@mes) + '/01' as date)
	set @dF = dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,1,cast(convert(nvarchar(max),@anof) + '/' + convert(nvarchar(max),@mesf) + '/01' as date)))

	select
		mov_id, p_id, p_nome, mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_id_pedido, e_nome as responsavel, mov_tpmov_id, mov_observacoes, pf_codigo, round(mov_quantidade,4) as mov_quantidade, mov_precounitario, mov_desconto, 
		round(mov_quantidade,3) * mov_precounitario as tot, pcont_nome as TipoContab, uni_nome Unidade
	from
		movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_entidade on p_id = pf_p_id and mov_e_id = PF_E_ID inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		left join entidade on mov_e_id_responsavel = e_id inner join UNIDADE on p_uni_id = uni_id
	where
		mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_e_id = @e_id and 
		(cast(mov_data as date) between @dI and @dF or
		cast(mov_datasaida as date) between @dI and @dF)
	order by
		mov_data
END
```

#### `dbo.Fornecedores_ListaPedidos`(@e_id int, @mov_satisfeito bit, @e_id_responsavel int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2020-12-15 15:22* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Fornecedores_ListaPedidos]

@e_id int = null,
@mov_satisfeito bit = 0,
@e_id_responsavel int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if @e_id is not null
	select
		m.mov_id, e.e_nome, m.mov_data, /*m1.mov_data*/null as mov_data_ent, m.mov_p_id, p_nome, m.mov_observacoes, u.uni_nome, round(m.mov_quantidade,2) as mov_quantidade,
		round(coalesce(sum(m1.mov_quantidade),0),2) as mov_qtd_ent, m.mov_precounitario, /*m1.mov_id*/null as mov_id_ent, m.mov_satisfeito, pf_codigo, m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome as frn_uni, pf_conversao, pf_descricao,
		e1.e_nome as responsavel, m.mov_data_aprovado, e1.E_ID as id_RespPedido
	from
		movimento as m 
		inner join produto on m.mov_p_id = p_id 
		left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id 
		inner join unidade as u on p_uni_id = u.uni_id 
		inner join entidade as e on m.mov_e_id = e.e_id 
		inner join produto_entidade on p_id = pf_p_id and pf_e_id = @e_id 
		inner join unidade as u1 on pf_uni_id = u1.uni_id
		left join entidade as e1 on m.mov_e_id_responsavel = e1.e_id 
	where
		m.mov_tpmov_id = 9 
		and m.mov_e_id = @e_id 
		and m.mov_satisfeito = @mov_satisfeito
	group by
		m.mov_id, e.e_nome, m.mov_data, m.mov_p_id, p_nome, m.mov_observacoes, u.uni_nome, m.mov_quantidade, m.mov_satisfeito, pf_codigo, m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome, pf_conversao, pf_descricao,
		e1.e_nome, m.mov_data_aprovado, m.mov_precounitario, e1.E_ID
	order by
		mov_data desc
else if @e_id_responsavel is null
	select
		m.mov_id, e.e_id, e.e_nome, m.mov_data, cast(dateadd(day,e.e_prazoentrega,m.MOV_DATA_APROVADO) as date) as previsao, /*m1.mov_data*/null as mov_data_ent, p_nome, m.mov_observacoes, u.uni_nome, 
		round(m.mov_quantidade,2) as mov_quantidade, round(coalesce(sum(m1.mov_quantidade),0),2) as mov_qtd_ent, m.mov_precounitario, /*m1.mov_id*/null as mov_id_ent, m.mov_satisfeito, pf_codigo, m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome as frn_uni, pf_conversao, e.e_contacto, e.e_email,
		e1.e_nome as responsavel, m.mov_data_aprovado
	from
		movimento as m 
		inner join produto on m.mov_p_id = p_id 
		left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id 
		inner join unidade as u on p_uni_id = u.uni_id 
		inner join entidade as e on m.mov_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join produto_entidade on p_id = pf_p_id and pf_e_id = e_id 
		inner join unidade as u1 on pf_uni_id = u1.uni_id
		left join entidade as e1 on m.mov_e_id_responsavel = e1.e_id 
	where
		m.mov_tpmov_id = 9 
		and m.mov_satisfeito = @mov_satisfeito
	group by
		m.mov_id, e.e_id, e.e_nome, m.mov_data, dateadd(day,e.e_prazoentrega,m.MOV_DATA_APROVADO), p_nome, m.mov_observacoes, u.uni_nome, m.mov_quantidade, m.mov_satisfeito, pf_codigo, m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome, pf_conversao, e.e_contacto, e.e_email,
		e1.e_nome, m.mov_data_aprovado, m.mov_precounitario
	order by
		mov_data desc, e_nome, p_nome
else
	select
		m.mov_id, e.e_id, e.e_nome, m.mov_data, cast(dateadd(day,e.e_prazoentrega,m.MOV_DATA_APROVADO) as date) as previsao, /*m1.mov_data*/null as mov_data_ent, m.mov_p_id, p_nome, m.mov_observacoes, u.uni_nome, 
		round(m.mov_quantidade,2) as mov_quantidade, round(coalesce(sum(m1.mov_quantidade),0),2) as mov_qtd_ent, m.mov_precounitario, /*m1.mov_id*/null as mov_id_ent, m.mov_satisfeito, pf_codigo, m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome as frn_uni, pf_conversao, e.e_contacto, e.e_email,
		e1.e_nome as responsavel, m.mov_data_aprovado
	from
		movimento as m 
		inner join produto on m.mov_p_id = p_id 
		left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id 
		inner join unidade as u on p_uni_id = u.uni_id 
		inner join entidade as e on m.mov_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join produto_entidade on p_id = pf_p_id and pf_e_id = e_id 
		inner join unidade as u1 on pf_uni_id = u1.uni_id
		left join entidade as e1 on m.mov_e_id_responsavel = e1.e_id 
	where
		m.mov_tpmov_id = 9 
		and m.mov_satisfeito = @mov_satisfeito 
		and (m.mov_e_id_responsavel = @e_id_responsavel or m.mov_e_id_responsavel is null)
	group by
		m.mov_id, e.e_id, e.e_nome, m.mov_data, dateadd(day,e.e_prazoentrega,m.MOV_DATA_APROVADO), m.mov_p_id, p_nome, m.mov_observacoes, u.uni_nome, m.mov_quantidade, m.mov_satisfeito, pf_codigo, m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome, pf_conversao, e.e_contacto, e.e_email,
		e1.e_nome, m.mov_data_aprovado, m.mov_precounitario
	order by
		mov_data desc, e_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Funcionario_EPIS`(@e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Funcionario_EPIS]
	
	@e_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    with cte (id) as
	(
		select tp_id from produto_tipo where tp_tp_id = 130
		union all
		select tp_id from cte inner join produto_tipo on id = tp_tp_id
	)

	--select id, tp_id, tp_nome from cte inner join produto_tipo on id = tp_id;

	select mov_data as Data, tp_nome as Tipo, p_nome as Produto, mov_quantidade as Qtd, mov_observacoes as Obs
	from cte inner join produto_tipo on id = tp_id inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id inner join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id
	where mov_e_id = @e_id
	order by mov_data desc
END
```

#### `dbo.getAdminDashBoardByFase`(@idFase int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[getAdminDashBoardByFase] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@idFase int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @dt smalldatetime = getdate() 
set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

select fp_id, fp_nome, count(distinct of_id) as barcos,
	(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then 'W' 
	else 'P' end) as estado, fp_sequencia
from ordemfabrico inner join --(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, min(offp_ordem) as ord from of_fp group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as f on of_id = f.ofid and of_fp_id = f.fpid inner join 
	of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id /*and offp_ordem = f.ord*/ inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id and of_fp_id = fp_id
	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
where fp_id = @idFase AND of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) --and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > cast(@dt as date) or offp_datafim is null)
group by fp_id, fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then 'W' else 'P' end)
union
select fp_id, fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos, 'C' as estado, fp_sequencia
from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
where fp_id = @idFase AND of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38))/*and of_e_id_enc <> 19747*/ and 
	cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date)
group by fp_id, fp_sequencia, fp_nome--,'C'
END
```

#### `dbo.getBarcosPriorityListByFase`(@faseId int, @moldeMatriz bit, @pecas bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-12-10 13:06* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`, `molde`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[getBarcosPriorityListByFase]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@faseId int,
	@moldeMatriz bit = 0,
	@pecas bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dt smalldatetime = getdate()
	set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

	declare @semanaInc int = (case when datepart("dw",getdate()) > 4 then 2 else 1 end)
	declare @dt_2Semanas date = dateadd(week,@semanaInc,dateadd(day,6-datepart("dw",getdate()),getdate()))

	if @faseId not in (18,51) and @moldeMatriz = 0
		select
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC) as ord, 
			fpp.fp_id as FaseId, 
			fpp.fp_nome as FaseNome, 
			of_id BarcoId, 
			OF_OBSERVACOES Observacoes, 
			e.E_NOME Cliente,
			P_NOME + (case when tpcam_nome is not null then ' (' + tpcam_nome + ')' else '' end) BarcoNome, 
			of_p_id_cdeck DeckId, 
			of_p_id_ccasco CascoId, 
			OFFP_DATAINICIO FaseDataInicio, 
			OFFP_DATAFIM FaseDataFinal, 
			'' Deck, 
			'' Casco, 
			eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador1, 
			eq1.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador2,
			(case when cast(tr_data as date) <= @dt_2Semanas  then 1 else 0 end) weeks, 
			(case when tr_data is null then dateadd(year,10,getdate()) else tr_data end) tr_data, 
			case when z.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else OFFP_RETURN end Retorno, 
			offp_id FaseID,
			case when of_id > 10000000 then 2 else 1 end sequencia,
			dbo.of_Pedido_Estado(of_id) PedidoEstado,
			case when z1.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end cqMont,
			isnull(OFFP_VALOR_FACT, 0) Valor
		from
			of_fp fp
			left join produto_camada_tipo on fp.offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			inner join ordemfabrico on fp.offp_of_id = of_id
			inner join fases_producao fpp on offp_fp_id = fpp.fp_id
			inner join fases_producao fpp1 on of_fp_id = fpp1.fp_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on tr_id = of_tr_id 
			left join ENTIDADE e on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID 
			left join offp_eq as eq on offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join offp_eq as eq1 on offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 0
			outer apply (select 
							top 1 fp1.OFFP_ID id, fp1.OFFP_FP_ID fpId, fp1.OFFP_DATAFIM fim, fp1.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA dtPrev, case when fp1.OFFP_TPCAM_ID = fp.OFFP_TPCAM_ID OR (fp1.OFFP_TPCAM_ID is null and fp.OFFP_TPCAM_ID is null) then 2 when fp1.OFFP_TPCAM_ID <> fp.OFFP_TPCAM_ID then 0 else 1 end igual 
						from 
							OF_FP fp1 
						where 
							fp1.OFFP_OF_ID = fp.OFFP_OF_ID
							and fp1.OFFP_ORDEM < fp.OFFP_ORDEM
						order by igual desc, fp1.OFFP_ORDEM desc) a
			outer apply (select distinct ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK from OF_CHECKLIST ch where ch.OFCH_OF_ID = OF_ID and ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK = OF_FP_ID and ch.OFCH_ESTADO is not null) z
			outer apply (select distinct ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK from OF_CHECKLIST ch where ch.OFCH_OF_ID = OF_ID and ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK = 74 and ch.OFCH_ESTADO is not null) z1
		where
			fp.OFFP_FP_ID = @faseId
			and (fim is not null or id is null)
			and fp.OFFP_DATAFIM is null
			and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 --OF_ID < 10000000
			and OF_ID > case when @pecas = 1 then 10000000 else 0 end
			and fpp1.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
		order by 
			sequencia, ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC;
	else if @moldeMatriz = 0
		select 
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC) as ord,
			fp_id as FaseId, 
			fp_nome as FaseNome, 
			of_id as BarcoId, 
			OF_OBSERVACOES as Observacoes, 
			e.E_NOME as Cliente, 
			p.P_NOME + (case when tpcam_nome is not null then ' (' + tpcam_nome + ')' else '' end) as BarcoNome, 
			of_p_id_cdeck as DeckId, 
			of_p_id_ccasco as CascoId, 
			OFFP_DATAINICIO as FaseDataInicio, 
			OFFP_DATAFIM as FaseDataFinal, 
			'' as Deck, 
			'' as Casco, 
			eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador1, 
			eq1.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador2,
			(case when cast(tr_data as date) <= @dt_2Semanas  then 1 else 0 end) as weeks, 
			(case when tr_data is null then dateadd(year,10,getdate()) else tr_data end) as tr_data, 
			OFFP_RETURN as Retorno, 
			offp_id as FaseID,
			cast(0.0 as float) Valor
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_datafim is null 
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
			left join offp_eq as eq on offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 
			inner join produto p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
			left join ENTIDADE e on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID 
			LEFT JOIN TRANSPORTE ON TR_ID = OF_TR_ID 
			left join offp_eq as eq1 on offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 0
			left join (select offp_of_id as idOF, cast(max(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dtPrev from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 group by offp_of_id) as ff on of_id = ff.idOF
		where 
			of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
			and case when @pecas = 0 then of_id else 10000000 end < case when @pecas = 0 then 10000000 else of_id end
			and ff.dtPrev <= (case when datepart(hour, getdate()) > 12 and datepart(dw,@dt) < 6 then dbo.get_ProximoDiaDeTrabalho(getdate()) 
								when datepart(hour, getdate()) > 12 and datepart(dw,@dt) = 6 then dbo.get_ProximoDiaDeTrabalho(getdate())
								when datepart(dw,@dt) = 7 then dateadd(day,2,@dt)
								else @dt end)
			and fp_id = @faseId
			and of_fp_id in (11,32,51,18)
		GROUP BY 
			TR_DATA, ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA, fp_id, fp_nome, of_id, OF_OBSERVACOES, 
			e.E_NOME, p.P_NOME + (case when tpcam_nome is not null then ' (' + tpcam_nome + ')' else '' end), of_p_id_cdeck, of_p_id_ccasco, OFFP_DATAINICIO, OFFP_DATAFIM, eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID, 
			eq1.OFFPEQ_E_ID, cast(tr_data as date), OFFP_RETURN, offp_id
		order by 
			ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC;
	else
		select 
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC) as ord,
			fp_id as FaseId, 
			fp_nome as FaseNome, 
			of_id as BarcoId, 
			OF_OBSERVACOES as Observacoes, 
			e.E_NOME as Cliente, 
			p.P_NOME + (case when tpcam_nome is not null then ' (' + tpcam_nome + ')' else '' end) as BarcoNome, 
			of_p_id_cdeck as DeckId, 
			of_p_id_ccasco as CascoId, 
			OFFP_DATAINICIO as FaseDataInicio, 
			OFFP_DATAFIM as FaseDataFinal, 
			'' as Deck, 
			'' as Casco, 
			eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador1, 
			eq1.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador2,
			(case when cast(tr_data as date) <= @dt_2Semanas  then 1 else 0 end) as weeks, 
			(case when tr_data is null then dateadd(year,10,getdate()) else tr_data end) as tr_data, 
			OFFP_RETURN as Retorno, 
			offp_id as FaseID,
			of_p_id ProdutoId,
			1 PedidoEstado,
			cast(0 as bit) cqMont,
			cast(0 as float) Valor
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and OF_FP_ID = OFFP_FP_ID --and offp_datafim is null 
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
			left join offp_eq as eq on offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 
			inner join produto p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
			left join ENTIDADE e on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID 
			LEFT JOIN TRANSPORTE ON TR_ID = OF_TR_ID 
			left join offp_eq as eq1 on offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 0
			left join (select offp_of_id as idOF, cast(max(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dtPrev from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 group by offp_of_id) as ff on of_id = ff.idOF
		where 
			of_id between 70000 and 89999 
			--and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37)) 
			and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > cast(@dt as date) 
				or offp_datafim is null) 
			and offp_fp_id = @faseId 
			and p_id not in (21886, 21887)
		GROUP BY 
			TR_DATA, ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA, fp_id, fp_nome, of_id, OF_OBSERVACOES, 
			e.E_NOME, p.P_NOME + (case when tpcam_nome is not null then ' (' + tpcam_nome + ')' else '' end), of_p_id_cdeck, of_p_id_ccasco, OFFP_DATAINICIO, OFFP_DATAFIM, eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID, 
			eq1.OFFPEQ_E_ID, cast(tr_data as date), OFFP_RETURN, offp_id,
			of_p_id
		order by 
			ISNULL(TR_DATA, dateadd(year,10,getdate())), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC;	
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[getDashBoard]
AS
BEGIN

	-- interfering with SELECT statements.

	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) --and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > cast(@dt as date) or offp_datafim is null)
group by fp_id, fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then 'W' else 'P' end)
union
select fp_id, fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos, 'C' as estado, fp_sequencia
from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id

	cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date)
group by fp_id, fp_sequencia, fp_nome--,'C'
order by FP_SEQUENCIA
END
```

#### `dbo.getUserAssociatedOF`(@userId int, @faseId int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-10-01 13:51* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[getUserAssociatedOF]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@userId int, 
	@faseId int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dt smalldatetime = getdate() 
	set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

	select 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ISNULL(TR_DATA, '2059-12-31 00:00:00'), 
		OF_SEQUENCIA, 
		OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC) as ord, 
		fp_id as FaseId, 
		fp_nome as FaseNome, 
		of_id as BarcoId, 
		e.E_NOME as Cliente, 
		p.P_NOME as BarcoNome, 
		of_p_id_cdeck as DeckId, 
		of_p_id_ccasco as CascoId, 
		OFFP_DATAFIM as FaseDataFinal, 
		p2.P_NOME as Deck, 
		p3.P_NOME as Casco
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id 
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id and of_fp_id = fp_id
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		inner join produto p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		left join produto p2 on of_p_id_cdeck = p2.P_ID 
		left join produto p3 on of_p_id_ccasco = p3.P_ID 
		left join ENTIDADE e on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID 
		LEFT JOIN TRANSPORTE ON TR_ID = OF_TR_ID
	where 
		of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
		and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) --and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
		and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > cast(@dt as date) 
			or offp_datafim is null) 
		and offpeq_e_id = @userId 
		and fp_id = @faseId
	GROUP BY 
		ISNULL(TR_DATA, '2059-12-31 00:00:00'), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA, fp_id, fp_nome, of_id, e.E_NOME, p.P_NOME, of_p_id_cdeck, of_p_id_ccasco, OFFP_DATAINICIO, OFFP_DATAFIM, p2.P_NOME, p3.P_NOME
	order by 
		ISNULL(TR_DATA, '2059-12-31 00:00:00'), OF_SEQUENCIA, OF_PARAPINTARFORA DESC;
END
```

#### `dbo.getUserAssociatedWork`(@externalUserId int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-09-26 16:57* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[getUserAssociatedWork] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@externalUserId int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @dt smalldatetime = getdate() 
set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

select fp_id, fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos
from ordemfabrico inner join --(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, min(offp_ordem) as ord from of_fp group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as f on of_id = f.ofid and of_fp_id = f.fpid inner join 
	of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id /*and offp_ordem = f.ord*/ inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id and of_fp_id = fp_id
	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id /*and offpeq_chefe = 1*/ inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and of_id < 10000000 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) --and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > cast(@dt as date) or offp_datafim is null) and offpeq_e_id = @externalUserId
group by fp_id, fp_nome
order by fp_id
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Add]

@movent_met_id int, 
@movent_e_id int, 
@movent_data_i smalldatetime, 
@movent_data_f smalldatetime, 
@movent_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@movent_of_id int = null,
@movent_vai_phc bit = 0,
@movent_e_e_id int = null,
@movent_valor_hora float = null,
@movent_fp_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	--SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @movent_valor_hora is null or @movent_valor_hora = 0
		set @movent_valor_hora = coalesce((select e_custohora from entidade where e_id = @movent_e_id),0)
		
    insert into ent_mov (movent_met_id, movent_e_id, movent_data_i, movent_data_f, movent_observacoes,movent_valor_hora, movent_of_id, movent_vai_phc, movent_e_e_id, movent_fp_id)
	values (@movent_met_id, @movent_e_id, @movent_data_i, @movent_data_f, @movent_observacoes,@movent_valor_hora, @movent_of_id, @movent_vai_phc, @movent_e_e_id, @movent_fp_id)

	select id = @@identity
END
```

#### `dbo.Horas_Lista`(@data date, @ano int, @mes int, @filtro int, @movent_e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2020-05-18 08:46*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Lista]

@data date = null,
@ano int = null,
@mes int = null,
@filtro int,
@movent_e_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@filtro = 1)
		select 
			movent_id, movent_met_id, movent_e_id, e_nome, movent_data_I, movent_data_F, 
			(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horas, 
			movent_observacoes, movent_valor_hora, movent_vai_phc
		from 
			dbo.ent_mov inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_id = e_id
		where
			movent_met_id = 1 and
			year(movent_data_I) = @ano and
			month(movent_data_I) = @mes
		order by 
			movent_data_I, e_nome
	else if (@filtro = 2)
		select 
			movent_id, movent_met_id, movent_e_id, e_nome, movent_data_I, movent_data_F,  
			(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horas, 
			movent_observacoes, movent_valor_hora, movent_vai_phc
		from 
			dbo.ent_mov inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_id = e_id
		where
			movent_met_id = 1 and
			cast(movent_data_I as date) = @data
		order by 
			movent_data_I, e_nome
	else if (@filtro = 3) -- ajuda extra
		select 
			movent_id, movent_met_id, movent_e_e_id, movent_fp_id, e_nome, cast(movent_data_I as date) as data, 
			(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horas, 
			movent_observacoes
		from 
			dbo.ent_mov inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_e_id = e_id
		where
			movent_met_id = 13 and
			movent_e_id = @movent_e_id
		order by 
			movent_data_I desc, e_nome
	else if (@filtro = 4) -- horas perdidas
		select 
			movent_id, movent_met_id, movent_e_e_id, movent_fp_id, e_nome, cast(movent_data_I as date) as data, 
			(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)*-1 as horas, 
			movent_observacoes
		from 
			dbo.ent_mov inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_id = e_id
		where
			movent_met_id = 12 and
			movent_e_id = @movent_e_id
		order by 
			movent_data_I desc, e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Horas_Pag_Add`(@movent_met_id int, @movent_e_id int, @movent_data_pag smalldatetime, @movent_valor_hora float, @movent_valor_pago float, @movent_data_i smalldatetime, @movent_data_f smalldatetime, @movent_observacoes nvarchar(max), @movent_cc float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Pag_Add]

@movent_met_id int, 
@movent_e_id int, 
@movent_data_pag smalldatetime = null, 
@movent_valor_hora float = 0,  
@movent_valor_pago float = 0, 
@movent_data_i smalldatetime, 
@movent_data_f smalldatetime, 
@movent_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@movent_cc float = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    insert into ent_mov (movent_met_id, movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, movent_valor_hora, movent_valor_pago, movent_observacoes, movent_data_i, movent_data_f, movent_cc)
	values (@movent_met_id, @movent_e_id, @movent_data_pag, @movent_valor_hora, @movent_valor_pago, @movent_observacoes, @movent_data_i, @movent_data_f, @movent_cc)

	select id = @@identity

	update ent_mov set movent_processado = 1, movent_data_pag = @movent_data_pag where movent_processado = 0 and movent_data_i < dateadd(dd,1,@movent_data_f) and movent_e_id = @movent_e_id and movent_met_id <> 11
END
```

#### `dbo.Horas_Pag_Lista_CC`(@inicio smalldatetime, @fim smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-03-06 16:55* · 🔎 `custo`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Pag_Lista_CC]

@inicio as smalldatetime = null,
@fim as smalldatetime = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	set @fim = dateadd(dd,1,@fim)

	if @inicio >= '2018/01/01' /* e_isencao_horario...., movent_vai_phc marca as q n são para pagar, lançamento das horas distribuidas.... magia! */
	begin
		select 
			0 as processar, 
			horas.movent_e_id, 
			e_isencao_horario, 
			e_nome, 
			round(
					(
						(
							coalesce(horas.total_HE,0) 
							- coalesce(horas.dsc,0)
						) 
						* (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)
					) 
					- isnull(hPHC.horasPHC * e_custohora * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end),0) 
					- (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(horas.total_Flt,0) 
					- isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC * e_custohora,0) else 0 end),2
				) as entre_datas, 
			coalesce(round(cc.total,2),0) as cc, 
			isnull(hPHC.horasPHC,0) as horasPHC, 
			isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC,0) as fltDescPHC
		from
			(select movent_e_id, 
					sum((case when movent_met_id = 1 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
							then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
							when movent_met_id = 1 then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 else 0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total_HE, 
					sum((case when movent_met_id = 4 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
							then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
							when movent_met_id = 4 then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 else 0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total_Flt, 
					(case when e_isencao_horario = 1 then 24 * E_CUSTOHORA else 0 end) as dsc
				from ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id 
				where movent_met_id in (1,4) and movent_data_i < @fim and movent_processado = 0 and movent_vai_phc = 0 /* movent_vai_phc marca as q n são para pagar */
				group by movent_e_id, E_CUSTOHORA, e_isencao_horario) as horas
			left join
			(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id --or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
			left join
			(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
			inner join entidade on horas.movent_e_id = e_id --or faltas.movent_e_id = e_id
			left join (select pe.ncont, sum(hs.horas) as horasPHC, sum(case when cast(factor as float) = 1 then horas else 0 end) as fltDescPHC 
						from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs as hs on pe.no = hs.no where ntipo = 1 and data between @inicio and @fim group by pe.ncont) as hPHC on e_contribuinte = hPHC.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
		union 
		select 0 as processar, e_id as movent_e_id, e_isencao_horario, e_nome, 
			e_custohora * 2 * -24 as entre_datas, 
			coalesce(round(cc.total,2),0) as cc, 0 as horasPHC, 0 as fltDescPHC
		from entidade left join (select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		where e_isencao_horario = 1 and e_activo = 1 and e_id not in (select distinct movent_e_id from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (1,4) and movent_data_i < @fim and movent_processado = 0) 
		order by e_nome
	end
	else if @inicio >= '2017/11/01'
	begin
		select 0 as processar, horas.movent_e_id, e_nome, 
		round(((coalesce(horas.total_HE,0) - coalesce(horas.dsc,0)) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(horas.total_Flt,0) else 0 end),2) as entre_datas, 
		coalesce(round(cc.total,2),0) as cc
		from
		(select movent_e_id, 
				sum((case when movent_met_id = 1 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						when movent_met_id = 1 then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 else 0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total_HE, 
				sum((case when movent_met_id = 4 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						when movent_met_id = 4 then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 else 0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total_Flt, 
				(case when movent_e_id in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484,20526,20365,20645,20917) then 24 * em.movent_valor_hora else 0 end) as dsc
			from ent_mov as em 
			where movent_met_id in (1,4) and movent_data_i < @fim and movent_processado = 0 
			group by movent_e_id, em.movent_valor_hora) as horas
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id --or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		inner join entidade on horas.movent_e_id = e_id --or faltas.movent_e_id = e_id
		union 
		select 0 as processar, e_id as movent_e_id, e_nome, 
			e_custohora * 2 * -24 as entre_datas, 
			coalesce(round(cc.total,2),0) as cc
		from entidade left join (select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		where e_id in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484,20526,20365,20645,20917) and e_activo = 1 and e_id not in (select distinct movent_e_id from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (1,4) and movent_data_i < @fim and movent_processado = 0) 
		order by e_nome
	end
	else if @inicio >= '2017/03/01'
	begin
		select 0 as processar, horas.movent_e_id, e_nome, 
		round(((coalesce(horas.total_HE,0) - coalesce(horas.dsc,0)) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(horas.total_Flt,0) else 0 end),2) as entre_datas, 
		coalesce(round(cc.total,2),0) as cc
		from
		(select movent_e_id, 
				sum((case when movent_met_id = 1 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						when movent_met_id = 1 then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 else 0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total_HE, 
				sum((case when movent_met_id = 4 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						when movent_met_id = 4 then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 else 0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total_Flt, 
				(case when movent_e_id in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484,20526,20365,20620,20645) then 24 * em.movent_valor_hora else 0 end) as dsc
			from ent_mov as em 
			where movent_met_id in (1,4) and movent_data_i < @fim and movent_processado = 0 
			group by movent_e_id, em.movent_valor_hora) as horas
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id --or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		inner join entidade on horas.movent_e_id = e_id --or faltas.movent_e_id = e_id
		union
```

#### `dbo.Horas_Pag_Lista_Pags`(@inicio smalldatetime, @fim smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-03-06 15:24* · 🔎 `custo`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Pag_Lista_Pags]

@inicio as smalldatetime = null,
@fim as smalldatetime = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	set @fim = dateadd(dd,1,@fim)

	if @inicio >= '2018/01/01' /* e_isencao_horario...., movent_vai_phc marca as q n são para pagar, lançamento das horas distribuidas.... magia! */
	begin
		select 
			em.movent_id, em.movent_e_id, e_nome,
			(case when round(((coalesce(horas.total,0) - coalesce(horas.dsc,0)) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - isnull(hPHC.horasPHC * e_custohora * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end),0) - 
												(case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(faltas.total,0) - isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC * e_custohora,0) else 0 end),2) < 0 and e_isencao_horario = 0 then 0 else
			round(((coalesce(horas.total,0) - coalesce(horas.dsc,0)) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - isnull(hPHC.horasPHC * e_custohora * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end),0) - 
												(case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(faltas.total,0) - isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC * e_custohora,0) else 0 end),2) end) as entre_datas, 
			movent_cc as cc, em.movent_valor_pago, em.movent_data_pag, em.movent_observacoes,
			0 as n500, 0 as n200, 0 as n100, 0 as n50, 0 as n20, 0 as n10, 0 as n5
		from 
			ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id left join
			(select em1.movent_e_id, em1.movent_data_pag,
				sum((case when datepart(hh,em1.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em1.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em1.movent_data_I, em1.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, em1.movent_data_I, em1.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em1.movent_valor_hora) as total, (case when e_isencao_horario = 1 then 24 * em1.movent_valor_hora else 0 end) as dsc
				from ent_mov as em1 inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where em1.movent_met_id = 1 and em1.movent_processado = 1 and movent_vai_phc = 0 /* movent_vai_phc marca as q n são para pagar */ 
				group by em1.movent_e_id, em1.movent_data_pag, em1.movent_valor_hora, e_isencao_horario) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id and em.movent_data_pag = horas.movent_data_pag
			left join
			(select em2.movent_e_id, em2.movent_data_pag,
					sum((case when datepart(hh,em2.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em2.movent_data_F) > 13 
							then datediff(n, em2.movent_data_I, em2.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
							else datediff(n, em2.movent_data_I, em2.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em2.movent_valor_hora) as total
					from ent_mov as em2 where em2.movent_met_id = 4 and em2.movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id, em2.movent_data_pag) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id and em.movent_data_pag = faltas.movent_data_pag
			left join (select pe.ncont, sum(hs.horas) as horasPHC, sum(case when cast(factor as float) = 1 then horas else 0 end) as fltDescPHC 
							from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs as hs on pe.no = hs.no where ntipo = 1 and data between @inicio and @fim group by pe.ncont) as hPHC on e_contribuinte = hPHC.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
		where 
			em.movent_met_id = 11 
			and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim)
		order by e_nome
	end

						then datediff(n, em2.movent_data_I, em2.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, em2.movent_data_I, em2.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em2.movent_valor_hora) as total
				from ent_mov as em2 where em2.movent_met_id = 4 and em2.movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id, em2.movent_data_pag) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id and em.movent_data_pag = faltas.movent_data_pag
		where em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim)
		order by e_nome
	end
	else
	begin
		select em.movent_id, em.movent_e_id, e_nome,
		(case when round(((coalesce(horas.total,0) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(faltas.total,0) else 0 end)),2) < 0 then 0 else
		round(((coalesce(horas.total,0) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(faltas.total,0) else 0 end)),2) end) as entre_datas, 
		movent_cc as cc, em.movent_valor_pago, em.movent_data_pag, em.movent_observacoes,
		0 as n500, 0 as n200, 0 as n100, 0 as n50, 0 as n20, 0 as n10, 0 as n5
		from ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id left join
		(select em1.movent_e_id, em1.movent_data_pag,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,em1.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em1.movent_data_F) > 13 
					then datediff(n, em1.movent_data_I, em1.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
					else datediff(n, em1.movent_data_I, em1.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em1.movent_valor_hora) as total
			from ent_mov as em1 where em1.movent_met_id = 1 and em1.movent_processado = 1 group by em1.movent_e_id, em1.movent_data_pag) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id and em.movent_data_pag = horas.movent_data_pag
		left join
		(select em2.movent_e_id, em2.movent_data_pag,
				sum((case when datepart(hh,em2.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em2.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em2.movent_data_I, em2.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, em2.movent_data_I, em2.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em2.movent_valor_hora) as total
				from ent_mov as em2 where em2.movent_met_id = 4 and em2.movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id, em2.movent_data_pag) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id and em.movent_data_pag = faltas.movent_data_pag
		where em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim)
		order by e_nome
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Horas_Pag_Upd`(@movent_id int, @movent_met_id int, @movent_e_id int, @movent_data_pag smalldatetime, @movent_valor_hora float, @movent_valor_pago float, @movent_data_i smalldatetime, @movent_data_f smalldatetime, @movent_observacoes nvarchar(max), @movent_cc float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Pag_Upd]

@movent_id int,
@movent_met_id int, 
@movent_e_id int, 
@movent_data_pag smalldatetime = null, 
@movent_valor_hora float = 0,  
@movent_valor_pago float = 0, 
@movent_data_i smalldatetime, 
@movent_data_f smalldatetime, 
@movent_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@movent_cc float = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    update ent_mov 
	set movent_met_id = @movent_met_id, 
		movent_e_id = @movent_e_id, 
		movent_data_pag = @movent_data_pag, 
		movent_valor_hora = @movent_valor_hora,
		movent_valor_pago = @movent_valor_pago,
		movent_observacoes = @movent_observacoes,
		movent_data_i = @movent_data_i,
		movent_data_f = @movent_data_f,
		movent_cc = @movent_cc
	where 
		movent_id = @movent_id

	update ent_mov set movent_processado = 1, movent_data_pag = @movent_data_pag where movent_processado = 0 and movent_data_i < @movent_data_f and movent_e_id = @movent_e_id and movent_met_id <> 11
END
```

#### `dbo.Horas_Perdidas_Lista`(@data smalldatetime, @ano int, @semana int, @filtro int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Perdidas_Lista]

@data smalldatetime = null,
@ano int = null,
@semana int = null,
@filtro int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@filtro = 1)
		select 
			movent_id, movent_met_id, movent_e_id, movent_data_I, movent_data_F, 
			datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 as horas, 
			movent_observacoes, 
(case when datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 < 10 then '0' else '' end) + convert(nvarchar(max), floor(datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0)) + ':' + (case when 
convert(int,((datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0)-floor(datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0))*60) < 10 then '0' else '' end) + convert(nvarchar(max), 
convert(int,((datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0)-floor(datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0))*60)) as tp_min
		from 
			dbo.ent_mov inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_id = e_id
		where
			movent_met_id = 12 and
			year(movent_data_I) = @ano and
			datepart(ww,movent_data_I) = @semana
		order by 
			movent_data_I, e_nome
	else if (@filtro = 2)
		select 
			movent_id, movent_met_id, movent_e_id, movent_data_I, movent_data_F,  
			(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horas, 
			movent_observacoes
		from 
			dbo.ent_mov inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_id = e_id
		where
			movent_met_id = 12 and
			movent_data_I = @data
		order by 
			movent_data_I, e_nome
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Horas_Upd]

		movent_e_e_id = @movent_e_e_id,
		movent_fp_id = @movent_fp_id
	where
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_Avaliacao`(@id_id int, @id_idcl_id_grau int, @id_idcl_id_tipo int, @id_idcl_id_relev int, @id_idcl_id_priori int, @id_idcl_id_facil int, @e_id int, @id_idest_id int, @idev_aprov_obs nvarchar(max), @id_aval_1 int, @id_aval_2 int, @id_aval_3 int, @id_aval_4 int, @id_aval_5 int, @id_aval_6 int, @id_aval_7 int, @id_aval_tp int, @id_aval_rf int, @id_aval_rh int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-05-03 13:39*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Avaliacao]

@id_id int,
@id_idcl_id_grau int = 0,
@id_idcl_id_tipo int = 0,
@id_idcl_id_relev int = 0,
@id_idcl_id_priori int = 0,
@id_idcl_id_facil int = 0,
@e_id int,
@id_idest_id int = 6,
@idev_aprov_obs nvarchar(max) = '',
@id_aval_1 int = 0, 
@id_aval_2 int = 0, 
@id_aval_3 int = 0, 
@id_aval_4 int = 0, 
@id_aval_5 int = 0, 
@id_aval_6 int = 0, 
@id_aval_7 int = 0, 
@id_aval_tp int = 0, 
@id_aval_rf int = 0, 
@id_aval_rh int = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dt smalldatetime
	set @dt = (select getdate())

    update ideia set 
		id_idcl_id_grau = @id_idcl_id_grau, 
		id_idcl_id_tipo = @id_idcl_id_tipo, 
		id_idcl_id_relev = @id_idcl_id_relev, 
		id_idcl_id_priori = @id_idcl_id_priori, 
		id_idcl_id_facil = @id_idcl_id_facil, 
		id_idest_id = @id_idest_id,
		id_aval_1 = @id_aval_1,
		id_aval_2 = @id_aval_2,
		id_aval_3 = @id_aval_3,
		id_aval_4 = @id_aval_4,
		id_aval_5 = @id_aval_5,
		id_aval_6 = @id_aval_6,
		id_aval_7 = @id_aval_7,
		id_aval_tp = @id_aval_tp,
		id_aval_rf = @id_aval_rf,
		id_aval_rh = @id_aval_rh,
		ID_FEEDBACK = isnull(ID_FEEDBACK, @idev_aprov_obs)
	where 
		id_id = @id_id

	declare @idev_id int, @id int

	if (@id_idest_id = 6)
	begin
		exec @id = ideia_evo @idev_id_id = @id_id, @idev_idest_id = 6, @idev_data_i = @dt

		select id = @id

		set @idev_id = (select idev_id from ideia_evol where idev_id_id = @id_id and idev_idest_id = 6 and idev_data_f is null)

		if not exists (select * from ideia_colab where idcol_e_id = @e_id and idcol_id_id = @id_id  and (idcol_idev_id = @idev_id or idcol_idev_id is null) and idcol_tpcol_id = 1)
			insert into ideia_colab (idcol_e_id, idcol_id_id, idcol_idev_id, idcol_tpcol_id) values (@e_id, @id_id, @idev_id, 1)
		else
			update ideia_colab set idcol_data = (select getdate()) where idcol_e_id = @e_id and idcol_id_id = @id_id  and idcol_idev_id = @idev_id and idcol_tpcol_id = 1
	end
/***********************************************************************************************/
	if (@id_idest_id <> 6)
	begin

		exec @id = ideia_evo @idev_id_id = @id_id, @idev_idest_id = @id_idest_id, @idev_data_i = @dt, @idev_aprov_obs = @idev_aprov_obs

		select id = @id

		set @idev_id = (select idev_id from ideia_evol where idev_id_id = @id_id and idev_idest_id = @id_idest_id and idev_data_f is null)

		if not exists (select * from ideia_colab where idcol_e_id = @e_id and idcol_id_id = @id_id  and (idcol_idev_id = @idev_id or idcol_idev_id is null) and idcol_tpcol_id = 2)
			insert into ideia_colab (idcol_e_id, idcol_id_id, idcol_idev_id, idcol_tpcol_id) values (@e_id, @id_id, @idev_id, 2)
		else
			update ideia_colab set idcol_data = (select getdate()) where idcol_e_id = @e_id and idcol_id_id = @id_id  and idcol_idev_id = @idev_id and idcol_tpcol_id = 2
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_Delete`(@id_id int)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Delete]

@id_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    delete ideia_tarefa from ideia_tarefa inner join ideia_evol on idtar_idev_id = idev_id where idev_id_id = @id_id

	delete ideia_colab from ideia_colab inner join ideia_evol on idcol_idev_id = idev_id where idev_id_id = @id_id

	delete ideia_colab where idcol_id_id = @id_id

	delete ideia_evol where idev_id_id = @id_id

	delete ideia_doc where iddoc_id_id = @id_id

	delete ideia where id_id = @id_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_Docs`(@iddoc_id int, @iddoc_nome nvarchar(max), @iddoc_descricao nvarchar(max), @iddoc_Caminho nvarchar(max), @iddoc_e_id int, @iddoc_id_id int, @tarefa int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-03-10 16:20*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Docs]

@iddoc_id int = null,
@iddoc_nome nvarchar(max) = null, 
@iddoc_descricao nvarchar(max),
@iddoc_Caminho nvarchar(max) = null,
@iddoc_e_id int,
@iddoc_id_id int,
@tarefa int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@tarefa = 1) --Nova
		insert into ideia_doc (iddoc_nome, iddoc_descricao, iddoc_caminho, iddoc_e_id, iddoc_id_id) 
		values (@iddoc_nome, @iddoc_descricao, @iddoc_caminho, @iddoc_e_id, @iddoc_id_id)
	else if (@tarefa = 2) --Actualiza
		update ideia_doc set iddoc_nome = isnull(@iddoc_nome,iddoc_nome), iddoc_descricao = @iddoc_descricao, iddoc_caminho = isnull(@iddoc_caminho, iddoc_caminho) where iddoc_id = @iddoc_id
	else if (@tarefa = 3) --Elimina
		delete from ideia_doc where iddoc_id = @iddoc_id

END
```

#### `dbo.ideia_evo`(@idev_id int, @idev_id_id int, @idev_idest_id int, @idev_data_i smalldatetime, @idev_data_f smalldatetime, @idev_data_aprov smalldatetime, @idev_aprov_obs nvarchar(max), @idev_score int, @output int OUTPUT)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[ideia_evo]

@idev_id int = null, 
@idev_id_id int = null, 
@idev_idest_id int = null, 
@idev_data_i smalldatetime = null, 
@idev_data_f smalldatetime = null, 
@idev_data_aprov smalldatetime = null,
@idev_aprov_obs nvarchar(max) = null, 
@idev_score int = 0,
@output int  = null out

as
begin
	set nocount on;
	declare @id int, @id_pai int, @id_primeiro_estado int

	set @id_primeiro_estado = (select idest_id from ideia_estado where idest_idest_id = @idev_idest_id and idest_sequencia = 1)

	set @id = (select idev_id from ideia_evol where idev_id_id = @idev_id_id and idev_idest_id = @idev_idest_id and idev_data_f is null)

    if (@id is null)
	begin

		set @id_pai = (select idev_idev_id from ideia_evol where idev_id_id = @idev_id_id and idev_data_f is null)

		update ideia_evol set idev_data_f = getdate() where idev_id_id = @idev_id_id and idev_data_f is null

		insert into ideia_evol (idev_id_id, idev_idest_id, idev_data_i, idev_data_f, idev_aprov_obs, idev_idev_id) 
			values (@idev_id_id, @idev_idest_id, @idev_data_i, (case when @id_primeiro_estado is null then null else @idev_data_i end), @idev_aprov_obs, @id_pai)

		set @id = @@identity

		if (@id_primeiro_estado is not null)
		begin
			update ideia set id_idest_id = @id_primeiro_estado where id_id = @idev_id_id

			insert into ideia_evol (idev_id_id, idev_idest_id, idev_data_i, idev_idev_id) values (@idev_id_id, @id_primeiro_estado, @idev_data_i, @id)
		end

		return @id

	end
	else 
	begin
		update ideia_evol set idev_data_aprov = @idev_data_aprov, idev_score = @idev_score, idev_aprov_obs = @idev_aprov_obs 
			where idev_id_id = @idev_id_id and idev_idest_id = @idev_idest_id and idev_data_f is null

		set @id = (select coalesce(idev_idev_id, idev_id) from ideia_evol where idev_id_id = @idev_id_id and idev_idest_id = @idev_idest_id and idev_data_f is null)

		return @id
	end
end
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_GetClassificacaoCheck`(@idcl_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2023-02-08 15:52 · modificado 2023-02-08 16:09*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE Ideia_GetClassificacaoCheck
	@idcl_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		idcl_id,
		coalesce(seg.idclchk_periodicidade, ter.idclchk_periodicidade, quar.idclchk_periodicidade, quin.idclchk_periodicidade, sex.idclchk_periodicidade, 0) periodicidade,
		isnull(seg.idclchk_idcl_id, 0) segunda,
		isnull(ter.idclchk_idcl_id, 0) terca,
		isnull(quar.idclchk_idcl_id, 0) quarta,
		isnull(quin.idclchk_idcl_id, 0) quinta,
		isnull(sex.idclchk_idcl_id, 0) sexta
	from
		IDEIA_CLASSIFICACAO
		left join (select idclchk_idcl_id, idclchk_periodicidade from ideia_classific_check where idclchk_idcl_id = @idcl_id and idclchk_diasemana = 2) seg on IDCL_ID = seg.idclchk_idcl_id
		left join (select idclchk_idcl_id, idclchk_periodicidade from ideia_classific_check where idclchk_idcl_id = @idcl_id and idclchk_diasemana = 3) ter on IDCL_ID = ter.idclchk_idcl_id
		left join (select idclchk_idcl_id, idclchk_periodicidade from ideia_classific_check where idclchk_idcl_id = @idcl_id and idclchk_diasemana = 4) quar on IDCL_ID = quar.idclchk_idcl_id
		left join (select idclchk_idcl_id, idclchk_periodicidade from ideia_classific_check where idclchk_idcl_id = @idcl_id and idclchk_diasemana = 5) quin on IDCL_ID = quin.idclchk_idcl_id
		left join (select idclchk_idcl_id, idclchk_periodicidade from ideia_classific_check where idclchk_idcl_id = @idcl_id and idclchk_diasemana = 6) sex on IDCL_ID = sex.idclchk_idcl_id
    where
		idcl_id = @idcl_id

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Lista]

@id_e_id int,
@tipo_util int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@tipo_util in (1,4))
		select id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado as Fase, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, sub.idev_data_i as id_data, count(iddoc_id) as docs, e_nome, id_feedback as Feedback
		from ideia inner join entidade on id_e_id = e_id left join 
				ideia_doc on id_id = iddoc_id_id and iddoc_iddoc_id is null inner join ideia_estado as ie on id_idest_id = ie.idest_id 
				inner join ideia_estado as ie1 on ie.idest_idest_id = ie1.idest_id
				left join (select idev_id_id, idev_data_i from ideia_evol where idev_idest_id = 5) as sub on id_id = sub.idev_id_id
		where id_idest_id in (5,6)
		group by id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, sub.idev_data_i, e_nome, id_feedback
		union
		select id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado as Fase, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, sub.idev_data_i as id_data, count(iddoc_id) as docs, e_nome, id_feedback as Feedback
		from ideia inner join entidade on id_e_id = e_id left join 
				ideia_doc on id_id = iddoc_id_id and iddoc_iddoc_id is null inner join ideia_estado as ie on id_idest_id = ie.idest_id  
				inner join ideia_estado as ie1 on ie.idest_idest_id = ie1.idest_id
				left join (select idev_id_id, idev_data_i from ideia_evol where idev_idest_id = 5) as sub on id_id = sub.idev_id_id
		where id_idest_id = 11 and id_e_id = @id_e_id 
		group by id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, sub.idev_data_i, e_nome, id_feedback
		order by sub.idev_data_i desc
	else
		select id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado as Fase, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, sub.idev_data_i as id_data, count(iddoc_id) as docs, e_nome, id_feedback as Feedback
		from ideia inner join entidade on id_e_id = e_id left join 
				ideia_doc on id_id = iddoc_id_id and iddoc_iddoc_id is null inner join ideia_estado as ie on id_idest_id = ie.idest_id 
				inner join ideia_estado as ie1 on ie.idest_idest_id = ie1.idest_id
				left join (select idev_id_id, idev_data_i from ideia_evol where idev_idest_id = 5) as sub on id_id = sub.idev_id_id
		where /*id_idest_id in (5,6,11) and*/ id_e_id = @id_e_id  
		group by id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, sub.idev_data_i, e_nome, id_feedback order by sub.idev_data_i desc

END
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_Projecto`(@id_id int, @id_descricao nvarchar(max), @id_sugestao nvarchar(max), @id_fonte nvarchar(max), @id_e_id int, @utilizador nvarchar(max), @id_idest_id int, @id_tem_idi bit, @id_feedback nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Projecto]

@id_id int = null,
@id_descricao nvarchar(max),
@id_sugestao nvarchar(max),
@id_fonte nvarchar(max),
@id_e_id int,
@utilizador nvarchar(max),
@id_idest_id int,
@id_tem_idi bit = 0,
@id_feedback nvarchar(max) = ''

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @id int, @dt smalldatetime

	declare @id_idest_id_ant int
	set @id_idest_id_ant = (select id_idest_id from ideia where id_id = @id_id)

	update ideia set id_descricao = @id_descricao, id_sugestao = @id_sugestao, id_fonte = @id_fonte, id_idest_id = @id_idest_id, 
		id_tem_idi = @id_tem_idi, id_feedback = @id_feedback where id_id = @id_id

	set @dt = getdate()

	exec @id = ideia_evo @idev_id_id = @id_id, @idev_idest_id = @id_idest_id, @idev_data_i = @dt

	select id = @id

END
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_Projecto_Lista`(@e_id int, @idest_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Projecto_Lista]

@e_id int = null,
@idest_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@e_id is null and @idest_id is null)
    select id_tem_idi, id_id, id_idest_id,  ie1.idest_estado as estado, ie.idest_estado as SubEstado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, count(iddoc_id) as docs, e.e_nome,
			coalesce(respAnalise.e_nome, respAprov.e_nome) as resp_analise, coalesce(respAnalise.idcol_data, respAprov.idcol_data) as data_analise, respAprov.e_nome as resp_aprov,
			cl1.idcl_classific as grau, cl2.idcl_classific as tipo, cl3.idcl_classific as relev, cl4.idcl_classific as priori, cl5.idcl_classific as facil
	from ideia inner join entidade as e on id_e_id = e.e_id left join ideia_doc on id_id = iddoc_id_id and iddoc_iddoc_id is null 
		inner join ideia_estado as ie on id_idest_id =  ie.idest_id inner join ideia_estado as ie1 on ie.idest_idest_id = ie1.idest_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl1 on id_idcl_id_grau = cl1.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl2 on id_idcl_id_tipo = cl2.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl3 on id_idcl_id_relev = cl3.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl4 on id_idcl_id_priori = cl4.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl5 on id_idcl_id_facil = cl5.idcl_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, idcol_data, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 1) as respAnalise on id_id = respAnalise.idcol_id_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, idcol_data, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 2) as respAprov on id_id = respAprov.idcol_id_id
	--where  ie.idest_idest_id in (2,3,21,26)
	where  ie.idest_idest_id not in (1,4)
	group by id_tem_idi, id_id, id_idest_id,  ie1.idest_estado, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, e.e_nome, respAnalise.e_nome, respAnalise.idcol_data, 
			respAprov.idcol_data, respAprov.e_nome, cl1.idcl_classific, cl2.idcl_classific, cl3.idcl_classific, cl4.idcl_classific, cl5.idcl_classific
	order by id_data desc
else if (@e_id is not null)
	select tar.tot as Tarefas, coalesce(tarC.tot,0) as TarComp, id_tem_idi, id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado as estado, ie.idest_estado as SubEstado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, count(iddoc_id) as docs, e.e_nome,
			 coalesce(respAnalise.e_nome, respAprov.e_nome) as resp_analise, coalesce(respAnalise.idcol_data, respAprov.idcol_data) as data_analise, respAprov.e_nome as resp_aprov,
			cl1.idcl_classific as grau, cl2.idcl_classific as tipo, cl3.idcl_classific as relev, cl4.idcl_classific as priori, cl5.idcl_classific as facil
	from ideia inner join entidade as e on id_e_id = e.e_id left join ideia_doc on id_id = iddoc_id_id and iddoc_iddoc_id is null
		inner join ideia_estado as ie on id_idest_id = ie.idest_id inner join ideia_estado as ie1 on ie.idest_idest_id = ie1.idest_id inner join ideia_evol on id_id = idev_id_id and id_idest_id = idev_idest_id 
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl1 on id_idcl_id_grau = cl1.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl2 on id_idcl_id_tipo = cl2.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl3 on id_idcl_id_relev = cl3.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl4 on id_idcl_id_priori = cl4.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl5 on id_idcl_id_facil = cl5.idcl_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, idcol_data, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 1) as respAnalise on id_id = respAnalise.idcol_id_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, idcol_data, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 2) as respAprov on id_id = respAprov.idcol_id_id
		inner join (select idtar_idev_id as id, count(*) as tot from ideia_tarefa where idtar_e_id = @e_id group by idtar_idev_id) as tar on idev_idev_id = tar.id
		left join (select idtar_idev_id as id, count(*) as tot from ideia_tarefa where idtar_e_id = @e_id and idtar_data_f is not null group by idtar_idev_id) as tarC on idev_idev_id = tarC.id
	where /*ie.idest_idest_id in (2,3,21,26) and*/  ie.idest_idest_id not in (1,4) and idev_data_f is null
	group by id_tem_idi, id_id, id_idest_id, ie1.idest_estado, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, e.e_nome, respAnalise.e_nome, respAnalise.idcol_data, respAprov.idcol_data, 
			respAprov.e_nome, cl1.idcl_classific, cl2.idcl_classific, cl3.idcl_classific, cl4.idcl_classific, cl5.idcl_classific, tar.tot, tarC.tot
	order by id_data desc
else
    select id_tem_idi, id_id, id_idest_id,  ie.idest_estado as estado, ie1.idest_estado as SubEstado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, count(iddoc_id) as docs, e.e_nome,
			coalesce(respAnalise.e_nome, respAprov.e_nome) as resp_analise, coalesce(respAnalise.idcol_data, respAprov.idcol_data) as data_analise, respAprov.e_nome as resp_aprov,
			cl1.idcl_classific as grau, cl2.idcl_classific as tipo, cl3.idcl_classific as relev, cl4.idcl_classific as priori, cl5.idcl_classific as facil
	from ideia inner join entidade as e on id_e_id = e.e_id left join ideia_doc on id_id = iddoc_id_id and iddoc_iddoc_id is null 
		inner join ideia_estado as ie on id_idest_id =  ie.idest_id left join ideia_estado as ie1 on ie.idest_idest_id = ie1.idest_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl1 on id_idcl_id_grau = cl1.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl2 on id_idcl_id_tipo = cl2.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl3 on id_idcl_id_relev = cl3.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl4 on id_idcl_id_priori = cl4.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl5 on id_idcl_id_facil = cl5.idcl_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, idcol_data, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 1) as respAnalise on id_id = respAnalise.idcol_id_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, idcol_data, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 2) as respAprov on id_id = respAprov.idcol_id_id
	where  id_idest_id in (4,10)
	group by id_tem_idi, id_id, id_idest_id,  ie1.idest_estado, ie.idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, e.e_nome, respAnalise.e_nome, respAnalise.idcol_data, 
			respAprov.idcol_data, respAprov.e_nome, cl1.idcl_classific, cl2.idcl_classific, cl3.idcl_classific, cl4.idcl_classific, cl5.idcl_classific
	order by id_data desc

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Reuniao_mng]

@idr_id int = null, 
@idr_nome nvarchar(max) = '', 
@idr_descr nvarchar(max) = '',
@idr_data smalldatetime = NULL,
@idr_id_id int = null,
@tarefa int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dt smalldatetime
	set @dt = (select GETDATE())

    if (@tarefa = 0) --insert
		insert into ideia_reuniao (idr_nome,idr_descr,idr_data,idr_id_id)
		values (@idr_nome,@idr_descr,@idr_data,@idr_id_id)
	else if (@tarefa = 1) --update
		update ideia_reuniao set idr_nome = @idr_nome,idr_descr = @idr_descr,idr_data = @idr_data
		where idr_id = @idr_id
	else if (@tarefa = 2) --delete
		update ideia_reuniao set idr_eliminado = @dt
		where idr_id = @idr_id

END
```

```sql
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @id int, @dt smalldatetime

	if (@id_id is null or @id_id = -1)
	begin
		insert into ideia (id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_e_id, id_idest_id, id_comunicacao, id_idcl_id_grau, id_observacoes, id_licoes, id_prop_intelect, id_resultado_pi, id_data_inicio, id_data_fim, id_e_id_coordenador, id_objectivos_esperados, id_orcamento, id_entidades_externas, id_tipologia)
		values (@id_descricao, @id_sugestao, @id_fonte, @id_e_id, @id_idest_id, @id_comunicacao, @id_idcl_id_grau, @id_observacoes, @id_licoes, @id_prop_intelect, @id_resultado_pi, @id_data_inicio, @id_data_fim, @id_e_id_coordenador, @id_objectivos_esperados, @id_orcamento, @id_entidades_externas, @id_tipologia)

		set @id = @@identity

		set @dt = getdate()

		exec ideia_evo @idev_id_id = @id, @idev_idest_id = @id_idest_id, @idev_data_i = @dt

		select id = @id
	end
	else
	begin
		declare @id_idest_id_ant int
		set @id_idest_id_ant = (select id_idest_id from ideia where id_id = @id_id)

		update ideia 
		set 
			id_descricao = @id_descricao, id_sugestao = @id_sugestao, id_fonte = @id_fonte, id_idest_id = @id_idest_id, id_comunicacao = @id_comunicacao, id_idcl_id_grau = @id_idcl_id_grau 
			, id_observacoes = @id_observacoes, id_licoes = @id_licoes, id_prop_intelect = @id_prop_intelect, id_resultado_pi = @id_resultado_pi,
			id_data_inicio = @id_data_inicio, id_data_fim = @id_data_fim, id_e_id_coordenador = @id_e_id_coordenador, id_objectivos_esperados = @id_objectivos_esperados, id_orcamento = @id_orcamento, id_entidades_externas = @id_entidades_externas, id_tipologia = @id_tipologia
		where id_id = @id_id
		
		set @dt = getdate()

		exec ideia_evo @idev_id_id = @id_id, @idev_idest_id = @id_idest_id, @idev_data_i = @dt

		select id = @id_id
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_Tarefas`(@idtar_id int, @idtar_idev_id int, @idtar_e_id int, @idtar_descricao nvarchar(max), @idtar_obs nvarchar(max), @idtar_data_p_i smalldatetime, @idtar_data_p_f smalldatetime, @idtar_data_i smalldatetime, @idtar_data_f smalldatetime, @idtar_data_prevista smalldatetime, @idtar_idtar_id int, @tarefa int, @idtar_resultados_p nvarchar(max), @idtar_resultados nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-01-31 09:36*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Tarefas]

@idtar_id int = null, 
@idtar_idev_id int = null, 
@idtar_e_id int = null, 
@idtar_descricao nvarchar(max) = null, 
@idtar_obs nvarchar(max) = null, 
@idtar_data_p_i smalldatetime = null, 
@idtar_data_p_f smalldatetime = null, 
@idtar_data_i smalldatetime = null, 
@idtar_data_f smalldatetime = null, 
@idtar_data_prevista smalldatetime = null, 
@idtar_idtar_id int = null,
@tarefa int,
@idtar_resultados_p nvarchar(max) = null,
@idtar_resultados nvarchar(max) = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@tarefa = 0) --insert
		insert into ideia_tarefa (idtar_idev_id, idtar_e_id, idtar_descricao, idtar_obs, idtar_data_p_i, idtar_data_p_f, idtar_data_i, idtar_data_f, idtar_data_prevista, idtar_idtar_id, idtar_resultados_p, idtar_resultados)
		values (@idtar_idev_id, @idtar_e_id, @idtar_descricao, @idtar_obs, @idtar_data_p_i, @idtar_data_p_f, @idtar_data_i, @idtar_data_f, @idtar_data_prevista, @idtar_idtar_id, @idtar_resultados_p, @idtar_resultados)
	else if (@tarefa = 1) --update
		update ideia_tarefa set idtar_idev_id = @idtar_idev_id, idtar_e_id = @idtar_e_id, idtar_descricao = @idtar_descricao, idtar_obs = @idtar_obs,
			idtar_data_p_i = @idtar_data_p_i, idtar_data_p_f = @idtar_data_p_f, idtar_data_i = @idtar_data_i, idtar_data_f = @idtar_data_f, idtar_data_prevista = @idtar_data_prevista, idtar_idtar_id = @idtar_idtar_id,
			idtar_resultados_p = @idtar_resultados_p, idtar_resultados = @idtar_resultados
		where idtar_id = @idtar_id
	else if (@tarefa = 2) --delete
		delete from ideia_tarefa where idtar_id = @idtar_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Ideia_Triagem_Lista`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ideia_Triagem_Lista]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select id_id, id_idest_id, idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, count(iddoc_id) as docs, e.e_nome,
			 respAnalise.e_nome as resp_analise, respAnalise.idcol_data as data_analise, respAprov.e_nome as resp_aprov,
			cl1.idcl_classific as grau, cl2.idcl_classific as tipo, cl3.idcl_classific as relev, cl4.idcl_classific as priori, cl5.idcl_classific as facil
	from ideia inner join entidade as e on id_e_id = e.e_id left join ideia_doc on id_id = iddoc_id_id and iddoc_iddoc_id is null 
		inner join ideia_estado on id_idest_id = idest_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl1 on id_idcl_id_grau = cl1.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl2 on id_idcl_id_tipo = cl2.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl3 on id_idcl_id_relev = cl3.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl4 on id_idcl_id_priori = cl4.idcl_id
		left join (select idcl_id, idcl_classific from ideia_classificacao) as cl5 on id_idcl_id_facil = cl5.idcl_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, idcol_data, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 1) as respAnalise on id_id = respAnalise.idcol_id_id
		left join (select idcol_id_id, e_nome from ideia_colab inner join entidade on idcol_e_id = e_id where idcol_tpcol_id = 2) as respAprov on id_id = respAprov.idcol_id_id
	where id_idest_id in (5,6) or idest_idest_id in (5,6)
	group by id_id, id_idest_id, idest_estado, id_descricao, id_sugestao, id_fonte, id_data, e.e_nome, respAnalise.e_nome, respAnalise.idcol_data, respAprov.e_nome, cl1.idcl_classific, cl2.idcl_classific, cl3.idcl_classific, cl4.idcl_classific, cl5.idcl_classific
	order by id_data desc

END
```

#### `dbo.imprime_OF_Const`(@of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[imprime_OF_Const]

@of_id int

as
begin
	set nocount on;

    declare @const int
	set @const = (select p_id from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_of_id = @of_id and p_tp_id = 84)

	if (@const is not null)
		select 
			convert(nvarchar(max),p_nome) + ' = ' + '_________' + ' ' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_medida)
		from 
			produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		where 
			comp_p_id = @const and tp_fp_id = 1
		order by tp_nome, p_nome
end
```

```sql
		where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 1) as lam on of_id = lam.id left join 
	(select offp_of_id as id, e_nome as lamin, offp_observacoes as obs from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id 
		where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 18) as pin on of_id = pin.id left join
	(select offp_of_id as id, e_nome as lamin, offp_observacoes as obs from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id 
		where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 4) as col on of_id = col.id left join
	(select offp_of_id as id, e_nome as lamin, offp_observacoes as obs from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id 
		where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 8) as acab on of_id = acab.id 
	--inner join
	--produto as p2 on OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = p2.P_ID inner join
	--produto as p3 on OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = p3.P_ID inner join
	--produto as p4 on OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = p4.P_ID inner join
	--produto as p5 on OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = p5.P_ID inner join
	--produto as p6 on OF_P_ID_QUINAS = p6.P_ID inner join
	--produto as p7 on OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR = p7.P_ID inner join
	--produto as p8 on OF_P_ID_GOLA = p8.P_ID
where 
	of_id = @of_id
order by 
	p.p_id desc
```

#### `dbo.imprime_OF_EtiquetaTransporte`(@of_id int, @tr_id int, @e_nome nvarchar(max), @notas nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-04-28 14:05* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[imprime_OF_EtiquetaTransporte]

@of_id int,
@tr_id int = null,
@e_nome nvarchar(max) = null,
@notas nvarchar(max) = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @tr_id is null
		select 
			(case when len(of_nome) > 0 then convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) + '/' + of_nome else convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) end) as of_id, 
			tp_nome, 
			p_nome, 
			e.e_nome, 
			of_referencia, 
			tr_descricao + coalesce(' (' + e1.e_nome + ')', '') as tr_descricao,
			tr_id, isnull(paises_nome, '') as pais, e1.E_NOME as transportadora, TR_MORADA
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id inner join 
			entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join 
			transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id left join 
			entidade as e1 on tr_e_id = e1.e_id
			left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id
		where 
			of_id = @of_id
	else
		select 
			0 as of_id, 
			'Box' tp_nome, 
			'Box' p_nome, 
			@e_nome e_nome, 
			@notas of_referencia, 
			tr_descricao + coalesce(' (' + e1.e_nome + ')', '') as tr_descricao,
			tr_id, isnull(paises_nome, '') as pais, e1.E_NOME as transportadora, TR_MORADA
		from
			transporte
			left join entidade as e1 on tr_e_id = e1.e_id
			left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id
		where 
			tr_id = @tr_id
END
```

#### `dbo.imprime_OF_Garantia`(@of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-02-19 15:52* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[imprime_OF_Garantia]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select distinct
		of_id, 
		p_nome, 
		(case when Charindex('(', dk.deck,0) > 0 then substring(dk.deck, Charindex('(', dk.deck,0)+1, Charindex(')', dk.deck,0) - Charindex('(', dk.deck,0) - 1) else dk.deck end) as of_cordeck, 
		(case when Charindex('(', cc.casco,0) > 0 then substring(cc.casco, Charindex('(', cc.casco,0)+1, Charindex(')', cc.casco,0) - Charindex('(', cc.casco,0) - 1) else cc.casco end) as of_corcasco,
		isnull(offp_peso,0) offp_peso, 
		tr_id, 
		tr_descricao, 
		paises_nome, 
		of_referencia, 
		isnull(of_datafim, getdate()) dt,
		isnull(laminagem.dataLaminagem, getdate()) dataLaminagem
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join 
		produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		left join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 8
		left join (select offp_of_id ofId, offp_data_prevista dataLaminagem from of_fp where OFFP_FP_ID in (1,67)) laminagem on OF_ID = laminagem.ofId
		left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id
		left join (select mov_of_id as id, p_nome as deck from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_atrib_id = 1) as dk on of_id = dk.id
		left join (select mov_of_id as id, p_nome as casco from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_atrib_id = 2) as cc on of_id = cc.id
	where 
		of_id = @of_id
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[imprime_OF_Livro]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

select 
	of_id, 
	p_nome, 
	offp_peso, 
	(select substring(p_nome, Charindex('(', p_nome,0)+1, Charindex(')', p_nome,0) - Charindex('(', p_nome,0) - 1) from produto where of_p_id_cdeck = p_id) as cordeck, 
	(select substring(p_nome, Charindex('(', p_nome,0)+1, Charindex(')', p_nome,0) - Charindex('(', p_nome,0) - 1) from produto where of_p_id_ccasco = p_id) as corcasco 
from 
	ordemfabrico inner join 
	produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join 
	of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
where 
	offp_fp_id = 8 and 
	of_id = @of_id

END
```
