```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ListarOFsAttach_Lista]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		of_id as OrdFab, 
		p.p_nome as Modelo, 
		'' as Cores,--dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as Deck,p2.p_nome as Casco,
		e_nome as Cliente,
		of_referencia as Referencia,
		fp_nome as Estado,
		of_transporte as Transporte,
		of_datatransporte as DataTr,
		count(atch_id) as Anexos,
		of_observacoes as Observacoes
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join
		produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join
		entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join 
		fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id inner join
		of_attach on of_id = atch_of_id
	where
		ATCH_TIPO in (1,4)
	group by 
		of_id, p.p_nome, 
		--dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0), 
		e_nome, of_referencia, fp_nome, of_transporte, of_datatransporte, of_observacoes
		
END
```

#### `dbo.ListarTransportes_Fabrica`(@of_datatransporte smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ListarTransportes_Fabrica]

@of_datatransporte smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		(case when of_fp_id = 10 then 1 else 0 end) as embalado,
		(case when of_fp_id = 12 then 1 else 0 end) as entregue,
		trof_tr_id,
		trof_leva_pecas,
		e.e_nome as cliente,
		of_id,
		(case when isnumeric(of_nome) = 1 then convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) + '/' + of_nome else convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) end) as of_id_ext,
		p.p_nome,
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as cdeck, p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		tr_descricao,
		coalesce(e1.e_nome, e2.e_nome) as acabador,
		of_referencia,
		fp_nome,
		p3.p_nome as embalagem
	from
		ordemfabrico 
		left join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		left join of_fp as fp on of_id = fp.offp_of_id and fp.offp_fp_id = 33 and fp.offp_return = 0 
		left join offp_eq as eq on fp.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade as e1 on eq.offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
		left join of_fp as fp1 on of_id = fp1.offp_of_id and fp1.offp_fp_id = 22 and fp1.offp_return = 0 
		left join offp_eq as eq1 on fp1.offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade as e2 on eq1.offpeq_e_id = e2.e_id 
		left join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id and mov_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 81) 
		left join produto as p3 on mov_p_id = p3.p_id and p3.p_tp_id = 81 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id 
		inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id
	where 
		tr_data = @of_datatransporte
END
```

#### `dbo.LivroDePonto`(@dF smalldatetime, @dII smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 11:58*

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[LivroDePonto]

@dF smalldatetime, 
@dII smalldatetime

as
begin
	set nocount on;

	declare @dI smalldatetime
	--, @dF smalldatetime, @dI smalldatetime
	--set @dII = '2012/04/09'
	--set @dF = '2012/04/11'

	declare @t table (id nvarchar(max), nome nvarchar(max), dtE smalldatetime, dtS smalldatetime, h float, obs nvarchar(max))

	declare cur_LivroPonto cursor for
	select convert(nvarchar(max),pestamp), convert(nvarchar(max),nome), convert(nvarchar(max),ncont), convert(smalldatetime,dataadm) from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe where status = 1 /*and ncont in ('142757136','144125129')*/ order by nome

	open cur_LivroPonto
	declare @id nvarchar(max), @nome nvarchar(max), @ncont nvarchar(max), @dt smalldatetime

	fetch next from cur_LivroPonto into @id, @nome, @ncont, @dt while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
		set @dI = @dII 

		while (@dI <= @dF)
		begin

			if ((select datepart(dw, @dI)) in (2,3,4,5,6) and @dI >= @dt)
			begin

				if exists(select * from ferias where data = @dI and tipo = 'Férias')
				begin
					insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
						(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), 4, 'Férias')

					insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
						(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), 4, 'Férias')
				end
				else if exists(select * from ferias where data = @dI and tipo = 'Feriado')
				begin
					set @dI  = @dI
--					insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
--						(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), 4, 'Feriado')
--
--					insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
--						(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), 4, 'Feriado')
				end
				else if exists(select * from entidade inner join ent_mov on e_id = movent_e_id where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9) and e_contribuinte = @ncont and convert(smalldatetime,convert(nchar(11), movent_data_i)) = @dI)
				begin
					declare @dif float, @tp nvarchar(max), @i smalldatetime, @f smalldatetime
					select @dif = datediff(mi, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0, @tp = 'Falta - ' + met_nome, @i = movent_data_i,@f = movent_data_f  from entidade inner join ent_mov on e_id = movent_e_id inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9) and e_contribuinte = @ncont and convert(smalldatetime,convert(nchar(11), movent_data_i)) = @dI

					if (@dif = 9) -- Dia todo
					begin
						insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
							(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), 4, @tp)

						insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
							(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), 4, @tp)
					end
					else
					begin
						if (@i = dateadd(hh, 8, @dI) and @f = dateadd(hh, 12, @dI)) -- manhã toda
						begin
							insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), 4, @tp)

							insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), 4, '')
						end
						else if (@i = dateadd(hh, 13, @dI) and @f = dateadd(hh, 17, @dI)) -- Tarde toda
						begin
							insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), 4, '')

							insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), 4, @tp)
						end
						else if (@i between dateadd(hh, 8, @dI) and dateadd(hh, 12, @dI) and @f between dateadd(hh, 8, @dI) and dateadd(hh, 12, @dI)) -- Manhã parcial
						begin
							if (datediff(mi,dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), @i) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), @i, @dif, '')

							if (datediff(mi, @i, @f) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, @i, @f, @dif, @tp)

							if (datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 12, @dI)) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(	@id, @nome, @f, dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 12, @dI))/60, '')

							insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), 4, '')
						end
						else if (@i between dateadd(hh, 13, @dI) and dateadd(hh, 17, @dI) and @f between dateadd(hh, 13, @dI) and dateadd(hh, 17, @dI)) -- Tarde parcial
						begin
							insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), 4, '')

							if (datediff(mi,dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), @i) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), @i, @dif, '')

							if (datediff(mi, @i, @f) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, @i, @f, @dif, @tp)

							if (datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 17, @dI)) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(	@id, @nome, @f, dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 17, @dI))/60, '')
						end
						else if (@i between dateadd(hh, 8, @dI) and dateadd(hh, 12, @dI) and @f between dateadd(hh, 13, @dI) and dateadd(hh, 17, @dI)) -- Manhã e Tarde parcial
						begin
							if (datediff(mi,dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), @i) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), @i, @dif, '')

							if (datediff(mi, @i, @f) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, @i, @f, @dif, @tp)

							if (datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 12, @dI)) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(	@id, @nome, @f, dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 12, @dI))/60, '')
							if (datediff(mi,dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), @i) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), @i, @dif, '')

							if (datediff(mi, @i, @f) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
									(@id, @nome, @i, @f, @dif, @tp)

							if (datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 17, @dI)) > 0)
								insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
								(	@id, @nome, @f, dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), datediff(mi, @f, dateadd(hh, 17, @dI))/60, '')
						end
					end				
				end
				else
				begin
					insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
						(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 8, @dI), dateadd(hh, 12, @dI), 4, '')

					insert into @t (id, nome, dtE, dtS, h, obs) values 
						(@id, @nome, dateadd(hh, 13, @dI), dateadd(hh, 17, @dI), 4, '')
				end
			end	

			set @dI  = (select dateadd(dd, 1, @dI))
		end

	fetch next from cur_LivroPonto into @id, @nome, @ncont, @dt
	end
	close cur_LivroPonto
	deallocate cur_LivroPonto

	select * from @t order by nome, dtE

end
```

#### `dbo.LojaOnline_Encomendas`(@operacao int, @encomenda varchar(50))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-01-13 13:55* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[LojaOnline_Encomendas] 

	@operacao int,
	@encomenda varchar(50) = null
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @operacao = 1 
	begin
		-- Insere novas encomendas!!!
		insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_p_id, mov_quantidade, mov_precounitario,mov_precovenda,mov_desconto,mov_observacoes, mov_numutil, mov_tpmov_id, mov_server, mov_qtd_bal, 
								mov_deck_part,mov_shop_order_id, mov_shop_order_item_id, mov_shop_updated_at, mov_shop_shipping, mov_e_id, mov_shop_entity_id, MOV_ARM_ID)
		(select --created_at, p_id
			created_at, p_id, (case when status = 'complete' then qty_shipped else qty_ordered end) as qty_Final, 
						isnull((case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(/*cast(case when CHARINDEX('-',sku,0) > 1 then ltrim(rtrim((SUBSTRING(sku,CHARINDEX('-',sku,0)+1,len(sku)-(CHARINDEX(sku,'-',0)+1))))) else sku end as int)*/mov_p_id,null) else p_precocusto end),0),
						price/1.23, 0, 
						coalesce(customer_firstname,'') 
							+ ' ' + coalesce(customer_lastname,'') 
							+ case when len(cast(comment as nvarchar(max))) > 1 then '; Order Notes: ' + cast(comment as nvarchar(max)) else '' end  
							+ ' | Order nº: ' + increment_id 
							+  ' | OPÇÕES: ' + case when len(nomePai) > 2 then ' (Origem: ' + nomePai + ') ' else '' end
							+ case when len(opt.opcoes) > 2 or len(opt1.opcoes) > 2 then opt.opcoes + '; ' + opt1.opcoes else '' end as obs,
						0, 4, 'OnlineShop', 0, '', increment_id, item_id, created_at_item, isnull(shipping_description,'') + ' (pago: ' + isnull(method,'') + ')', 20544, customer_id, P_ARM_ID
		from
			OPENQUERY(SHOP,
						'SELECT		
								ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status, ord.shipping_description, ord.shipping_method, ord.customer_id, 
								ord.customer_firstname, ord.customer_lastname, ord.store_name, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, 
								ordItem.item_id, ordItem.created_at as created_at_item, ordItem.updated_at as updated_at_item, 
								ordItem.order_id, ordItem.product_type, ordItem.sku, ordItem.name, ordItem.qty_ordered, ordItem.qty_shipped, 
								ordItem.qty_invoiced, ordItem.price, ordItem.product_options, c.comment, ordItemPai.name as nomePai, payment.method
							FROM 
								sales_order as ord 
								inner join sales_order_item ordItem on ord.entity_id = ordItem.order_id
								left join sales_order_payment payment on ord.entity_id = payment.parent_id
								left join sales_order_item ordItemPai on ordItem.parent_item_id = ordItemPai.item_id
								left join sales_order_status_history c on ord.entity_id = c.parent_id and entity_name = ''order'' and is_visible_on_front = 1
							where 
								ord.status not in (''complete'',''canceled'', ''closed'') 
								and ord.created_at > date_add(now(), INTERVAL -30 DAY)
								and ord.created_at >= ''2023-10-18''
								and ordItem.product_type in (''simple'', ''virtual'', ''grouped'') and ordItem.sku not like ''Boat%''') zz
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((SELECT [label] + ': ' + [value] + '; ' FROM OPENJSON(zz.product_options, '$.options') WITH (label nvarchar(max), value  nvarchar(max)) FOR XML path('')),'') as NVARCHAR(MAX)) opcoes) opt
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((
								select distinct
									xx.title +': ' + isnull(xxVal.title ,zz.[value]) + '; '
								from
									(SELECT *  
									FROM OPENJSON(substring(replace(cast(zz.product_options as nvarchar(max)),'{"info_buyRequest":',''),0,len(replace(cast(zz.product_options as nvarchar(max)),'{"info_buyRequest":',''))))  
										WITH (
										uenc NVARCHAR(MAX),
										options NVARCHAR(MAX) AS JSON
										) b
									cross APPLY OPENJSON(b.options)) zz
									inner join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_id, title from catalog_product_option_title') xx on cast(zz.[key] as nvarchar(max)) = cast(xx.option_id as nvarchar(max)) and value <> ''
									left join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_type_id, title from catalog_product_option_type_title') xxVal on case when ISNUMERIC(zz.[value]) = 1 then cast(cast(zz.[value] as float) as int) else 0 end = xxVal.option_type_id
								FOR XML path('')),'') as NVARCHAR(MAX)) opcoes) opt1
				left join movimento on item_id = mov_shop_order_item_id 
					and cast(mov_p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
				inner join produto on 
					cast(p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
			where 
				((status <> 'pending'
				and increment_id like '6%') 
				or increment_id like '1%')
				and mov_shop_order_item_id is null)

		/*****************************************************************************************************************************/
		-- Actualiza encomendas!!!

		update movimento set mov_quantidade = (case when status = 'complete' then qty_shipped else qty_ordered end)
		--select *
		from OPENQUERY(SHOP,
			'SELECT		
				ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status, ord.shipping_description, ord.shipping_method, ord.customer_id, ord.customer_firstname, ord.customer_lastname, ord.store_name, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, 
				ordItem.item_id, ordItem.created_at as created_at_item, ordItem.updated_at as updated_at_item, ordItem.order_id, ordItem.product_type, ordItem.sku, ordItem.name, ordItem.qty_ordered, ordItem.qty_shipped, ordItem.qty_invoiced, ordItem.price
			FROM 
				sales_order as ord inner join sales_order_item ordItem on ord.entity_id = ordItem.order_id
			where 
				ord.status not in (''complete'',''canceled'', ''closed'') and ord.created_at > ''2019/06/01'' and product_type in (''simple'', ''virtual'') and ordItem.sku not like ''Boat%''') 
			inner join movimento on item_id = mov_shop_order_item_id and increment_id = MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID
				and cast(mov_p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
			inner join produto on  
				cast(p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
		where mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_quantidade <> (case when status = 'complete' then qty_shipped else qty_ordered end)

		/*****************************************************************************************************************************/
		-- Elimina encomendas "canceled" e "closed"!!!
		delete m 
		--select mov_id, mov_data, p_id, p_nome, arm_id, arm_nome, mov_tpmov_id, mov_shop_order_id, mov_shop_order_item_id, mov_observacoes, movss.movs
		from OPENQUERY(SHOP, 
			'SELECT		
				ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status, ord.shipping_description, ord.shipping_method, ord.customer_id, ord.customer_firstname, ord.customer_lastname, ord.store_name, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, 
				ordItem.item_id, ordItem.created_at as created_at_item, ordItem.updated_at as updated_at_item, ordItem.order_id, ordItem.product_type, ordItem.sku, ordItem.name, ordItem.qty_ordered, ordItem.qty_shipped, ordItem.qty_invoiced, ordItem.price
			FROM 
				sales_order as ord inner join sales_order_item ordItem on ord.entity_id = ordItem.order_id
			where 
				ord.status in (''canceled'', ''closed'', ''complete'') and ord.created_at > ''2019/06/01'' and product_type in (''simple'', ''virtual'')') 
			inner join movimento m on item_id = mov_shop_order_item_id and increment_id = MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID
			--inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id
			outer apply (select count(mov_id) movs from movimento where mov_mov_id = m.mov_id) movss
			where MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and movss.movs = 0

		/* Actualiza encomendas parcialmente satisfeitas */
		update m set m.mov_satisfeito = 1
		--select mov_id, mov_data, p_id, p_nome, arm_id, arm_nome, mov_tpmov_id, mov_shop_order_id, mov_shop_order_item_id, mov_observacoes, movss.movs
		from OPENQUERY(SHOP, 
			'SELECT		
				ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status, ord.shipping_description, ord.shipping_method, ord.customer_id, ord.customer_firstname, ord.customer_lastname, ord.store_name, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, 
				ordItem.item_id, ordItem.created_at as created_at_item, ordItem.updated_at as updated_at_item, ordItem.order_id, ordItem.product_type, ordItem.sku, ordItem.name, ordItem.qty_ordered, ordItem.qty_shipped, ordItem.qty_invoiced, ordItem.price
			FROM 
				sales_order as ord inner join sales_order_item ordItem on ord.entity_id = ordItem.order_id
			where 
				ord.status in (''canceled'', ''closed'', ''complete'') and ord.created_at > ''2019/06/01'' and product_type in (''simple'', ''virtual'') and ordItem.sku not like ''Boat%''') 
			inner join movimento m on item_id = mov_shop_order_item_id and increment_id = MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID
			inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id
			outer apply (select count(mov_id) movs from movimento where mov_mov_id = m.mov_id) movss
			where MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and mov_tpmov_id = 12 --and movss.movs > 0

		/* Fecha encomendas Complete */
		update p set ped_aprovado = 1
		from
			OPENQUERY(SHOP,
						'SELECT		
								ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status
							FROM 
								sales_order as ord 
							where 
								ord.status = ''complete''') zz
			inner join PEDIDOS p on zz.increment_id = PED_SHOP_ORDER_ID
		where
			PED_APROVADO = 0
	end
	else if @operacao = 2 -- Insere encomenda especifica
		insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_p_id, mov_quantidade, mov_precounitario,mov_precovenda,mov_desconto,mov_observacoes, mov_numutil, mov_tpmov_id, mov_server, mov_qtd_bal, 
								mov_deck_part,mov_shop_order_id, mov_shop_order_item_id, mov_shop_updated_at, MOV_ARM_ID, mov_shop_entity_id)
		(select distinct
				created_at, 
				p_id, 
				(case when status = 'complete' then qty_ordered /*qty_shipped*/ else qty_ordered end) as qty_Final, 
				isnull((case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(mov_p_id,null) else p_precocusto end),0),
				price/1.23, 0,
						coalesce(customer_firstname,'') 
							+ ' ' + coalesce(customer_lastname,'') 
							+ case when len(cast(comment as nvarchar(max))) > 1 then '; Order Notes: ' + cast(comment as nvarchar(max)) else '' end  
							+ ' | Order nº: ' + increment_id 
							+  ' | OPÇÕES: ' + case when len(nomePai) > 2 then ' (Origem: ' + nomePai + ') ' else '' end
							+ case when len(opt.opcoes) > 2 or len(opt1.opcoes) > 2 then opt.opcoes + '; ' + opt1.opcoes else '' end as obs,
						0, 4, 'OnlineShop', 0, '', increment_id, item_id, created_at_item, P_ARM_ID, customer_id
			from
				OPENQUERY(SHOP,
						'SELECT		
								ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status, ord.shipping_description, ord.shipping_method, ord.customer_id, 
								ord.customer_firstname, ord.customer_lastname, ord.store_name, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, 
								ordItem.item_id, ordItem.created_at as created_at_item, ordItem.updated_at as updated_at_item, 
								ordItem.order_id, ordItem.product_type, ordItem.sku, ordItem.name, ordItem.qty_ordered, ordItem.qty_shipped, 
								ordItem.qty_invoiced, ordItem.price, ordItem.product_options, c.comment, ordItemPai.name as nomePai
							FROM 
								sales_order as ord 
								inner join sales_order_item ordItem on ord.entity_id = ordItem.order_id
								left join sales_order_item ordItemPai on ordItem.parent_item_id = ordItemPai.item_id and ord.entity_id = ordItemPai.order_id
								left join sales_order_status_history c on ord.entity_id = c.parent_id and entity_name = ''order'' and is_visible_on_front = 1
							where 
								ordItem.product_type in (''simple'', ''virtual'', ''grouped'') and ordItem.sku not like ''Boat%''') zz
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((SELECT [label] + ': ' + [value] + '; ' FROM OPENJSON(zz.product_options, '$.options') WITH (label nvarchar(max), value  nvarchar(max)) FOR XML path('')),'') as NVARCHAR(MAX)) opcoes) opt
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((
								select distinct
									xx.title +': ' + isnull(xxVal.title ,zz.[value]) + '; '
								from
									(SELECT *  
									FROM OPENJSON(substring(replace(cast(zz.product_options as nvarchar(max)),'{"info_buyRequest":',''),0,len(replace(cast(zz.product_options as nvarchar(max)),'{"info_buyRequest":',''))))  
										WITH (
										uenc NVARCHAR(MAX),
										options NVARCHAR(MAX) AS JSON
										) b
									cross APPLY OPENJSON(b.options)) zz
									inner join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_id, title from catalog_product_option_title') xx on zz.[key] = xx.option_id and value <> ''
									left join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_type_id, title from catalog_product_option_type_title') xxVal on case when ISNUMERIC(zz.[value]) = 1 then cast(zz.[value] as int) else 0 end = xxVal.option_type_id
								FOR XML path('')),'') as NVARCHAR(MAX)) opcoes) opt1
				left join movimento on item_id = mov_shop_order_item_id 
					and cast(mov_p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
				inner join produto on 
					cast(p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
				where 
					increment_id = @encomenda 
					and mov_shop_order_item_id is null)
END
```

#### `dbo.LojaOnline_Encomendas_v2`(@operacao int, @encomenda varchar(50))

```sql
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((SELECT [label] + ': ' + [value] + '; ' FROM OPENJSON(zz.product_options, '$.options') WITH (label nvarchar(max), value  nvarchar(max)) FOR XML path('')),'') as NVARCHAR(MAX)) opcoes) opt
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((

										WITH (

										options NVARCHAR(MAX) AS JSON
										) b
									cross APPLY OPENJSON(b.options)) zz
									inner join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_id, title from catalog_product_option_title') xx on zz.[key] = xx.option_id and value <> ''
									left join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_type_id, title from catalog_product_option_type_title') xxVal on case when ISNUMERIC(zz.[value]) = 1 then cast(zz.[value] as int) else 0 end = xxVal.option_type_id

			FROM 
				sales_order as ord inner join sales_order_item ordItem on ord.entity_id = ordItem.order_id
			where

			inner join movimento m on item_id = mov_shop_order_item_id and increment_id = MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID
			--inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id
			outer apply (select count(mov_id) movs from movimento where mov_mov_id = m.mov_id) movss
			where MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and movss.movs = 0

		--select mov_id, mov_data, p_id, p_nome, arm_id, arm_nome, mov_tpmov_id, mov_shop_order_id, mov_shop_order_item_id, mov_observacoes, movss.movs
		from OPENQUERY(SHOP, 
			'SELECT		
				ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status, ord.shipping_description, ord.shipping_method, ord.customer_id, ord.customer_firstname, ord.customer_lastname, ord.store_name, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, 
				ordItem.item_id, ordItem.created_at as created_at_item, ordItem.updated_at as updated_at_item, ordItem.order_id, ordItem.product_type, ordItem.sku, ordItem.name, ordItem.qty_ordered, ordItem.qty_shipped, ordItem.qty_invoiced, ordItem.price

							FROM

							where 
								ord.status = ''complete''') zz
			inner join PEDIDOS p on zz.increment_id = PED_SHOP_ORDER_ID

			PED_APROVADO = 0
	end
	else if @operacao = 2 -- Insere encomenda especifica

								mov_deck_part,mov_shop_order_id, mov_shop_order_item_id, mov_shop_updated_at, MOV_ARM_ID, mov_shop_entity_id)
		(select distinct
				created_at, p_id, (case when status = 'complete' then qty_ordered /*qty_shipped*/ else qty_ordered end) as qty_Final, isnull((case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(/*cast(case when CHARINDEX('-',sku,0) > 1 then ltrim(rtrim((SUBSTRING(sku,CHARINDEX('-',sku,0)+1,len(sku)-(CHARINDEX(sku,'-',0)+1))))) else sku end as int)*/mov_p_id,null) else p_precocusto end),0),
				price/1.23, 0,
						coalesce(customer_firstname,'') 
							+ ' ' + coalesce(customer_lastname,'') 
							+ case when len(cast(comment as nvarchar(max))) > 1 then '; Order Notes: ' + cast(comment as nvarchar(max)) else '' end  
							+ ' | Order nº: ' + increment_id 
							+  ' | OPÇÕES: ' + case when len(nomePai) > 2 then ' (Origem: ' + nomePai + ') ' else '' end
							+ case when len(opt.opcoes) > 2 or len(opt1.opcoes) > 2 then opt.opcoes + '; ' + opt1.opcoes else '' end as obs,
						0, 4, 'OnlineShop', 0, '', increment_id, item_id, created_at_item, P_ARM_ID, customer_id
			from
				OPENQUERY(SHOP,
						'SELECT		
								ord.entity_id, ord.increment_id, ord.status, ord.shipping_description, ord.shipping_method, ord.customer_id, 
								ord.customer_firstname, ord.customer_lastname, ord.store_name, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, 
								ordItem.item_id, ordItem.created_at as created_at_item, ordItem.updated_at as updated_at_item, 
								ordItem.order_id, ordItem.product_type, ordItem.sku, ordItem.name, ordItem.qty_ordered, ordItem.qty_shipped, 
								ordItem.qty_invoiced, ordItem.price, ordItem.product_options, c.comment, ordItemPai.name as nomePai
							FROM 
								sales_order as ord 
								inner join sales_order_item ordItem on ord.entity_id = ordItem.order_id
								left join sales_order_item ordItemPai on ordItem.parent_item_id = ordItemPai.item_id and ord.entity_id = ordItemPai.order_id
								left join sales_order_status_history c on ord.entity_id = c.parent_id and entity_name = ''order'' and is_visible_on_front = 1
							where 
								ordItem.product_type in (''simple'', ''virtual'', ''grouped'', ''configurable'', ''bundle'') and ordItem.parent_item_id is null and ordItem.sku not like ''Boat%''') zz
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((SELECT [label] + ': ' + [value] + '; ' FROM OPENJSON(zz.product_options, '$.options') WITH (label nvarchar(max), value  nvarchar(max)) FOR XML path('')),'') as NVARCHAR(MAX)) opcoes) opt
				outer apply (select cast(isnull((
								select distinct
									xx.title +': ' + isnull(xxVal.title ,zz.[value]) + '; '
								from
									(SELECT *  
									FROM OPENJSON(substring(replace(cast(zz.product_options as nvarchar(max)),'{"info_buyRequest":',''),0,len(replace(cast(zz.product_options as nvarchar(max)),'{"info_buyRequest":',''))))  
										WITH (
										uenc NVARCHAR(MAX),
										options NVARCHAR(MAX) AS JSON
										) b
									cross APPLY OPENJSON(b.options)) zz
									inner join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_id, title from catalog_product_option_title') xx on zz.[key] = xx.option_id and value <> ''
									left join OPENQUERY(SHOP,'select option_type_id, title from catalog_product_option_type_title') xxVal on case when ISNUMERIC(zz.[value]) = 1 then cast(zz.[value] as int) else 0 end = xxVal.option_type_id
								FOR XML path('')),'') as NVARCHAR(MAX)) opcoes) opt1
				left join movimento on item_id = mov_shop_order_item_id 
					and cast(mov_p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
				inner join produto on 
					cast(p_id as varchar(50)) in (select a.Number from fn_SplitInt(sku,'-') a)
				where 
					increment_id = @encomenda and mov_shop_order_item_id is null)
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Medidas_mng]

@med_id int,
@med_np_id int,
@med_m_id int,
@med_tam_id int,
@med_obs nvarchar(max),
@med_medida float,
@med_observacoes nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@med_id is null)
	begin
		insert into medidas (med_np_id, med_m_id, med_tam_id, med_obs, med_medida, med_observacoes) values
							(@med_np_id, @med_m_id, @med_tam_id, @med_obs, @med_medida, @med_observacoes)
	end
	else if (@med_id is not null)
	begin
		update medidas set med_np_id = @med_np_id, med_m_id = @med_m_id, med_tam_id = @med_tam_id, med_obs = @med_obs, med_medida = @med_medida, med_observacoes = @med_observacoes where med_id = @med_id
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.MO_Acerta`(@p_id int, @p_precocusto_inicial float, @p_precocusto float, @factor float, @contaGeral bit, @contaOFs bit, @aPartirDe date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-10-14 11:13* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `custo`, `preco`, `preço`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MO_Acerta] 

	@p_id int,
	@p_precocusto_inicial float,
	@p_precocusto float,
	@factor float = 1, /*Qd @contaGeral = 1 é o factor a multiplicar pela qtd actual, qd @contaOFs = 1 é a qtd q substitui a actual*/
	@contaGeral bit,
	@contaOFs bit,
	@aPartirDe date

AS
BEGIN
	/* Actualiza standards de mao de obra (p_tp_id = 90)*/
	EXEC('disable trigger actualizaofsemcursoinsert on produto_componente');

	update produto_componente set comp_quantidade = round((case when @contaGeral = 1 then comp_quantidade * @factor else @factor end),3)
	from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
	where 
		comp_p_p_id = @p_id 
		--and p_tp_id not in (158,166,173,185,174,187,190,209,219) 
		and TP_NOME not like 'Parcerias/%'
		and tp_tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
		and (case when @p_id = 20794 then comp_p_id else 1 end) not in (27413,20379)
		
	EXEC('enable trigger actualizaofsemcursoinsert on produto_componente');
	

	/* Acerta movimento e respectivos sub movimentos */
	declare @tb table (movid int, parceria bit, visto bit)

	insert into @tb (movid, parceria, visto) 
	(select 
			mov_id, 
			case when TP_NOME not like 'Parcerias/%' then 1 else 0 end,
			0 
		from movimento left join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		where 
			(mov_tpmov_id in (2,4) 
				or (mov_tpmov_id = 11 
					and cast(isnull(of_datafim,mov_data) as date) >= @aPartirDe)) 
			and mov_p_id = @p_id
			and (case when @p_id = 20794 then of_p_id else 1 end) not in (27413,20379) 
			--and p_tp_id not in (158,166,173,185,174,187,190,209,219) 
			--and TP_NOME not like 'Parcerias/%' 
			and tp_tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1)))

	while exists(select * from @tb where visto in (0,3))
	begin
		update @tb set visto = 1 where visto = 3

		insert into @tb (movid, parceria,visto) 
		(select mov_id, parceria, 3 from @tb inner join movimento on movid = mov_mov_id /*inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_tpmov_id = 4 or (mov_tpmov_id = 11 and cast(mov_data as date) >= @aPartirDe)*/)

		update @tb set visto = 1 where visto = 0
	end

	update movimento set mov_quantidade = round((case when parceria = 1 then mov_quantidade when @contaGeral = 1 then mov_quantidade * @factor else @factor end),3), mov_precounitario = @p_precocusto from movimento inner join @tb on mov_id = movid

	--GGF
	update movimento set mov_quantidade = round((case when parceria = 1 then mov_quantidade when @contaGeral = 1 then mov_quantidade * @factor else @factor end),3), mov_precounitario = @p_precocusto from movimento inner join @tb on mov_mov_id = movid and mov_p_id = 22394

	/* Acerta preço da Mão de Obra */
	if @p_precocusto <> @p_precocusto_inicial
	begin
		declare @dt smalldatetime = @aPartirDe
		exec dbo.Inventario_Add_Movimento @dt,@dt,@p_id,1,@p_precocusto,0,1,'Novo valor',20980 /*Fornecedor "MAR-Kayaks"*/,0,1,null,null,0,0

		update produto set p_precocusto = @p_precocusto where p_id = @p_id
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Modelos_Add_Kayak`(@p_nome nvarchar(max), @p_m_id int, @p_np_id int, @p_tam_id int, @p_const_id int, @p_descricao nvarchar(max), @p_tp_id int, @p_coeficiente float, @p_precocusto float, @p_precovenda float, @p_pesolam float, @p_pesoacab float, @p_mplaminagem float, @p_modlaminagem float, @p_mpacabamento float, @p_modacabamento float, @p_desenvolvimento bit, @p_qtd_resina float, @p_l_id int, @p_tp_id_disciplina int, @p_pl_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `disciplina`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Modelos_Add_Kayak]

@p_nome nvarchar(max),
@p_m_id int,
@p_np_id int,
@p_tam_id int,
@p_const_id int,
@p_descricao nvarchar(max),
@p_tp_id INT,
@p_coeficiente float,
@p_precocusto float,
@p_precovenda float,
@p_pesolam float,
@p_pesoacab float,
@p_mplaminagem float,
@p_modlaminagem float,
@p_mpacabamento float,
@p_modacabamento float,
@p_desenvolvimento bit = 0,
@p_qtd_resina float = 0,
@p_l_id int = null,
@p_tp_id_disciplina int = null,
@p_pl_id int = null

as
begin transaction

declare @id int

if exists (select p_id from produto where p_nome=@P_NOME)
	raiserror('Ja existe um Modelo com esse nome!!!',16,1)
else
begin
	
	
	insert into produto 
		(p_nome, p_m_id, p_np_id, p_tam_id, p_descricao, p_precocusto, p_precovenda, p_tp_id, p_coeficiente, p_pesolam, 	
		p_pesoacab, p_mplaminagem, p_modlaminagem, p_mpacabamento, p_modacabamento, p_desenvolvimento, p_qtd_resina, p_l_id, p_tp_id_disciplina, p_pl_id) 
	VALUES
		(@p_nome, @p_m_id, @p_np_id, @p_tam_id, @p_descricao, @p_precocusto, @p_precovenda, @p_tp_id, @p_coeficiente, @p_pesolam, 	
		@p_pesoacab, @p_mplaminagem, @p_modlaminagem, @p_mpacabamento, @p_modacabamento, @p_desenvolvimento, @p_qtd_resina, @p_l_id, @p_tp_id_disciplina, @p_pl_id) 

	set @id = @@identity

	insert into produto_componente
			(comp_p_id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id)
		values
			(@id, @p_const_id, 1, 1)
	
end

select id = @id

commit transaction

if @@error<>0
rollback transaction
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Modelos_Copy_Paste]

@id_copy int,
@id_paste int

as
begin
	set nocount on;

	declare @t table (comp_id int, comp_p_id int, comp_p_p_id int, comp_quantidade float, comp_tpcomp_id int, comp_atrib_id int, comp_fp_id int)

    insert into @t (comp_id, comp_p_id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id, comp_atrib_id, comp_fp_id)
	(select comp_id, @id_paste, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id, comp_atrib_id, comp_fp_id from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id where comp_p_id = @id_copy and p_tp_id <> 84)

	declare @comp_id int, @comp_p_id int, @comp_p_p_id int, @comp_quantidade float, @comp_tpcomp_id int, @comp_atrib_id int, @comp_fp_id int

	while exists(select * from @t)
	begin
		select top 1 @comp_id = comp_id, @comp_p_id = comp_p_id, @comp_p_p_id = comp_p_p_id, @comp_quantidade = comp_quantidade, @comp_tpcomp_id = comp_tpcomp_id, @comp_atrib_id = comp_atrib_id, @comp_fp_id = comp_fp_id from @t

		exec Inventario_Add_Associado_ou_Componente @comp_p_id, @comp_p_p_id, @comp_quantidade, @comp_tpcomp_id, 0, @comp_atrib_id, @comp_fp_id

		delete from @t where comp_id = @comp_id
	end
end
```

#### `dbo.Modelos_Lista_Associados`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-01-21 11:29* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Modelos_Lista_Associados]

@p_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @t table(comp_atrib_id int, tp_nome nvarchar(max), comp_p_p_id int, p_nome nvarchar(max), Unidade nvarchar(max), comp_quantidade float,
		p_precocusto float, comp_valor_extra float, comp_tpcomp_id int, comp_fp_id int, comp_id int, p_co2 float, p_co2_data_alterado date, p_co2_observacoes nvarchar(max), p_pesolam float, P_FABRICOINTERNO bit, pai nvarchar(max), visto bit default 0)

	insert into @t
	select 
		comp_atrib_id, tp_nome, comp_p_p_id, p_nome, uni_nome as Unidade, comp_quantidade,
		case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end as p_precocusto, 
		comp_valor_extra, comp_tpcomp_id, comp_fp_id, comp_id, 
		(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else P_CO2 end) p_co2, p_co2_data_alterado, p_co2_observacoes, p_pesolam, P_FABRICOINTERNO, cast(comp_id as nvarchar(max)), 0
	from
		produto_componente 
		inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
	where
		comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1 and p_tp_id <> 84

	while exists(select * from @t where visto = 0)
	begin
	
		declare @pId_pai int, @compId_pai int, @qtd_pai float, @pai nvarchar(max)

		select top 1 @pId_pai = comp_p_p_id, @compId_pai = comp_id, @pai = pai, @qtd_pai = comp_quantidade from @t where visto = 0

		update @t set visto = 1 where comp_id = @compId_pai

		insert into @t
		select 
			comp_atrib_id, tp_nome, comp_p_p_id, '      - ' + p_nome, uni_nome as Unidade, @qtd_pai * comp_quantidade,
			case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end as p_precocusto, 
			comp_valor_extra, comp_tpcomp_id, comp_fp_id, comp_id, 
			(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else P_CO2 end) p_co2, p_co2_data_alterado, p_co2_observacoes, p_pesolam, P_FABRICOINTERNO, @pai + '_' + cast(comp_id as nvarchar(max)), 0
		from
			produto_componente 
			inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
			left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
		where
			comp_p_id = @pId_pai and comp_tpcomp_id = 1 and p_tp_id <> 84

	end

	select * from @t order by pai
END
```

#### `dbo.Modelos_Lista_Detalhe`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-05-06 16:12* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `disciplina`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Modelos_Lista_Detalhe]

@p_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select top 1
		p.p_id, 
		p.p_nome, 
		p.p_tp_id, 
		p.p_np_id, 
		p.p_m_id, 
		p.p_tam_id, 
		p1.p_id as p_id_const, 
		coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(p.p_id, null),0) as p_precocusto, 
		p.p_precovenda, 
		p.p_coeficiente, 
		p.p_pesolam, 
		p.p_pesoacab, 
		p.p_mplaminagem, 
		p.p_modlaminagem, 
		p.p_mpacabamento, 
		p.p_modacabamento, 
		p.p_descricao, 
		p.p_desenvolvimento, 
		p.p_fabricointerno, 
		p.p_qtd_resina,
		p.p_l_id, 
		p.p_tp_id_disciplina, 
		p.p_pl_id, 
		coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X_Inflacionado(p.p_id, null),0) as p_precocustoActual
	from
		produto as p left join produto_componente on comp_p_id = p.p_id left join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id and p1.p_tp_id = 84
	where
		p.p_id = @p_id
	order by p_id_const desc
END
```

#### `dbo.Modelos_Lista_OFs`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-05-27 11:37* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Modelos_Lista_OFs]

@p_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

   select 
		convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) + '/' + coalesce(of_nome,'') as OrdFab, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p.p_nome as CDeck, p1.p_nome as CCasco,
		isnull(sum(offp.PesoLam),0) as PesoLam,
		isnull(sum(offp1.PesoAcab),0) as PesoAcab,
		e_nome as Cliente,
		fp_nome as Estado,
		of_referencia as Referencia,
		of_fact as Factura,
		of_transportedoc as NotasFact,
		y.descr as UltTransporte
	from
		ordemfabrico 
		left join (select offp_of_id, sum(offp_peso) PesoLam from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 6 and offp_datafim is not null group by offp_of_id) offp on of_id = offp.offp_of_id
		left join (select offp_of_id, sum(offp_peso) PesoAcab from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 8 and offp_datafim is not null group by offp_of_id) offp1 on of_id = offp1.offp_of_id
		left join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
		outer apply
			(select top 1 tr_id, cast(cast(tr_data as date) as nvarchar(10)) + ': ' + tr_descricao as descr from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id where trof_of_id = of_id order by tr_data desc) as y
	where
		of_p_id = @p_id
	group by
		of_id,
		of_nome,
		e_nome,
		fp_nome,
		of_referencia,
		of_fact,
		of_transportedoc,
		y.descr
END
```

#### `dbo.Modelos_TrocaOFs`(@of_origem int, @of_destino int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2023-05-24 12:01 · modificado 2024-12-06 13:57* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Modelos_TrocaOFs] 

	@of_origem int, 
	@of_destino int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--update of_of_tipouso set OFOFTU_OF_ID = case when OFOFTU_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end where OFOFTU_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem)
	--update of_checklist set OFCH_OF_ID = case when OFCH_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end where OFCH_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem)
	--update of_fp set OFFP_OF_ID = case when OFFP_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end where OFFP_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem)
	declare @movs table(id int);
	
	with cte (idd, ofId) as
	(
		select mov_id, case when MOV_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end from MOVIMENTO where MOV_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem) and (MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null or MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1)
		union all
		select mov_id, case when MOV_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end from cte inner join movimento on idd = MOV_MOV_ID
	)
	update movimento set MOV_OF_ID = ofId from movimento inner join cte on MOV_ID = idd

	update OF_ATTACH set ATCH_OF_ID = case when ATCH_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end where ATCH_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem)
	--update OF_ENTIDADE set OFE_OF_ID = case when OFE_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end where OFE_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem)

	update transp_of set TROF_OF_ID = case when TROF_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end where TROF_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem)

	update pedidos set PED_OF_ID = case when PED_OF_ID = @of_destino then @of_origem else @of_destino end, ped_notas = case when PED_OF_ID = @of_destino then 'Pedido da Of: ' + cast(@of_origem as nvarchar(max)) else 'Pedido da Of: ' + cast(@of_destino as nvarchar(max)) end where PED_OF_ID in (@of_destino, @of_origem)

	declare @ofEId int, @ofReferencia nvarchar(max), @ofObservacoes nvarchar(max), @ofObservacoesTransporte nvarchar(max), @ofTrId int, @ofFactura nvarchar(max), @ofPreco float, @OF_EM_ID int, @OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO int,
		@ofEId_Dest int, @ofReferencia_Dest nvarchar(max), @ofObservacoes_Dest nvarchar(max), @ofObservacoesTransporte_Dest nvarchar(max), @ofTrId_Dest int, @ofFactura_Dest nvarchar(max), @ofPreco_Dest float, @OF_EM_ID_Dest int, @OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO_Dest int

	select @ofEId = OF_E_ID_ENC, @ofReferencia = OF_REFERENCIA, @ofObservacoes = OF_OBSERVACOES, @ofObservacoesTransporte = OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, @ofTrId = OF_TR_ID, @ofFactura = OF_FACT,@ofPreco = OF_PRECOVENDA, @OF_EM_ID = OF_EM_ID, @OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO = OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_ID = @of_origem
	select @ofEId_Dest = OF_E_ID_ENC, @ofReferencia_Dest = OF_REFERENCIA, @ofObservacoes_Dest = OF_OBSERVACOES, @ofObservacoesTransporte_Dest = OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, @ofTrId_Dest = OF_TR_ID, @ofFactura_Dest = OF_FACT,@ofPreco_Dest = OF_PRECOVENDA, @OF_EM_ID_Dest = OF_EM_ID, @OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO_Dest = OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_ID = @of_destino

	update ORDEMFABRICO 
		set OF_E_ID_ENC = @ofEId, OF_REFERENCIA = @ofReferencia, OF_OBSERVACOES = @ofObservacoes, OF_TRANSPORTEDOC = @ofObservacoesTransporte, OF_TR_ID = @ofTrId, OF_FACT = @ofFactura, OF_PRECOVENDA = @ofPreco, OF_EM_ID = @OF_EM_ID, OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO = @OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO 
		where OF_ID = @of_destino

	update ORDEMFABRICO 
		set OF_E_ID_ENC = @ofEId_Dest, OF_REFERENCIA = @ofReferencia_Dest, OF_OBSERVACOES = @ofObservacoes_Dest, OF_TRANSPORTEDOC = @ofObservacoesTransporte_Dest, OF_TR_ID = @ofTrId_Dest, OF_FACT = @ofFactura_Dest, OF_PRECOVENDA = @ofPreco_Dest, 
			OF_EM_ID = @OF_EM_ID_Dest, OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO = @OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO_Dest 
		where OF_ID = @of_origem
END
```

#### `dbo.Modelos_Upd_Kayak`(@p_id int, @p_nome nvarchar(max), @p_m_id int, @p_np_id int, @p_tam_id int, @p_const_id int, @p_descricao nvarchar(max), @p_tp_id int, @p_coeficiente float, @p_precocusto float, @p_precovenda float, @p_pesolam float, @p_pesoacab float, @p_mplaminagem float, @p_modlaminagem float, @p_mpacabamento float, @p_modacabamento float, @p_desenvolvimento bit, @p_fabricointerno bit, @p_qtd_resina float, @p_l_id int, @p_tp_id_disciplina int, @p_pl_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-11-08 15:35* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `disciplina`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Modelos_Upd_Kayak]

@p_id int,
@p_nome nvarchar(max),
@p_m_id int,
@p_np_id int,
@p_tam_id int,
@p_const_id int,
@p_descricao nvarchar(max),
@p_tp_id INT,
@p_coeficiente float,
@p_precocusto float,
@p_precovenda float,
@p_pesolam float,
@p_pesoacab float,
@p_mplaminagem float,
@p_modlaminagem float,
@p_mpacabamento float,
@p_modacabamento float,
@p_desenvolvimento bit = 0,
@p_fabricointerno bit = 0,
@p_qtd_resina float = 0,
@p_l_id int = null,
@p_tp_id_disciplina int = null,
@p_pl_id int = null

as
begin transaction

	select @p_precocusto = dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(@p_id,null)

	update produto 
		set
			p_nome = @p_nome, 
			p_m_id = @p_m_id, 
			p_np_id = @p_np_id, 
			p_tam_id = @p_tam_id, 
			p_descricao = @p_descricao, 
			p_precocusto = @p_precocusto, 
			p_precovenda = @p_precovenda, 
			p_tp_id = @p_tp_id, 
			p_coeficiente = @p_coeficiente, 
			p_pesolam = @p_pesolam, 	
			p_pesoacab = @p_pesoacab, 
			p_mplaminagem = @p_mplaminagem, 
			p_modlaminagem = @p_modlaminagem, 
			p_mpacabamento = @p_mpacabamento, 
			p_modacabamento = @p_modacabamento,
			p_desenvolvimento = @p_desenvolvimento,
			p_fabricointerno = @p_fabricointerno,
			p_qtd_resina = @p_qtd_resina,
			p_l_id = isnull(@p_l_id,p_l_id),
			p_tp_id_disciplina = isnull(@p_tp_id_disciplina,p_tp_id_disciplina),
			p_pl_id = isnull(@p_pl_id,p_pl_id),
			p_pesolam_upd = case when p_pesolam <> @p_pesolam then getdate() else p_pesolam_upd end,
			p_pesoacab_upd = case when p_pesoacab <> @p_pesoacab then getdate() else p_pesoacab_upd end, 
			P_PRECO_TEMP = @p_precocusto
		where
			p_id = @p_id

	declare @p_const_id_ant int
	set @p_const_id_ant = (
					select comp_p_p_id 
						from produto_componente inner join 
							 produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join
							 produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
						where comp_p_id = @p_id and p_tp_id = 84)


	if (@p_const_id <> @p_const_id_ant)
	begin
		update produto_componente
			set
				comp_p_p_id = @p_const_id
			where
				comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_p_p_id = @p_const_id_ant	
	end
	else if (@p_const_id_ant is null and @p_const_id is not null)
	begin
		insert into produto_componente
			(comp_p_id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id)
		values
			(@p_id, @p_const_id, 1, 1)			
	end

commit transaction

if @@error<>0
rollback transaction
```

#### `dbo.Moldes_Add`(@p_nome nvarchar(max), @p_m_id int, @p_np_id int, @p_tam_id int, @p_const_id int, @p_descricao nvarchar(max), @p_tp_id int, @p_coeficiente float, @p_precocusto float, @p_precovenda float, @p_pesolam float, @p_pesoacab float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `reparaç`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Moldes_Add]

@p_nome nvarchar(max),
@p_m_id int = null,
@p_np_id int = null,
@p_tam_id int = null,
@p_const_id int = null,
@p_descricao nvarchar(max),
@p_tp_id INT,
@p_coeficiente float,
@p_precocusto float,
@p_precovenda float,
@p_pesolam float,
@p_pesoacab float

as
begin transaction

declare @id int

if exists (select p_id from produto where p_nome = @P_NOME and p_tp_id = @p_tp_id and p_activo = 1)
	raiserror('Ja existe um Modelo com esse nome!!!',16,1)
else
begin
	
	
	insert into produto 
		(p_nome, p_m_id, p_np_id, p_tam_id, p_descricao, p_precocusto, p_precovenda, p_tp_id, p_coeficiente, p_pesolam, p_pesoacab) 
	VALUES
		(@p_nome, @p_m_id, @p_np_id, @p_tam_id, @p_descricao, @p_precocusto, @p_precovenda, @p_tp_id, @p_coeficiente, @p_pesolam, @p_pesoacab) 

	set @id = @@identity

	if (@p_const_id is not null)
		insert into produto_componente
				(comp_p_id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id)
			values
				(@id, @p_const_id, 1, 1)
	
	end

	if @p_tp_id = 82 /*Molde*/
	begin	
		insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_sequencia, prodf_automatica, prodf_fabrico, prodf_criador) 
		(
		select @id, 11, 1, 1, 0, 'Auto' /*n laminado*/
		union select @id, 21, 2, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*preparação*/
		union select @id, 1, 3, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*laminagem*/
		union select @id, 2, 4, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*Cura*/
		union select @id, 8, 5, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*Montagem*/
		union select @id, 15, 6, 0, 0, 'Auto' /*uso*/)
	end
	else
	begin	
		insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_sequencia, prodf_automatica, prodf_fabrico, prodf_criador) 
		(
		select @id, 11, 1, 1, 0, 'Auto' /*n laminado*/
		union select @id, 20, 2, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*CNC*/
		union select @id, 21, 3, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*preparação*/
		union select @id, 1, 4, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*laminagem*/
		union select @id, 2, 5, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*Cura*/
		union select @id, 8, 6, 0, 1, 'Auto' /*Montagem*/
		union select @id, 15, 7, 0, 0, 'Auto' /*uso*/)
	end

	select id = @id

commit transaction

if @@error<>0
rollback transaction
```

#### `dbo.moldes_mng`(@mldu_id int, @mld_id int, @mldu_e_id int, @tarefa int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[moldes_mng]

@mldu_id int = null,
@mld_id int,
@mldu_e_id int,
@tarefa int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @utiliz int, @num_util int
	select @utiliz = mld_utiliz, @num_util = mldtp_numutil from moldes inner join moldes_tipo on mld_mldtp_id = mldtp_id where mld_id = @mld_id

	if (@tarefa = 1)
	begin
		insert into moldes_mov (mldu_mld_id, mldu_e_id) values (@mld_id, @mldu_e_id)

		if (@utiliz = @num_util - 1)
		begin
			update moldes set mld_utiliz = 0 where mld_id = @mld_id
		end 
		else if (@utiliz < @num_util - 1)
			update moldes set mld_utiliz = mld_utiliz + 1 where mld_id = @mld_id
	end
	else
	begin
		delete from moldes_mov where mldu_id = @mldu_id
		update moldes set mld_utiliz = (case when mld_utiliz > 0 then mld_utiliz - 1 else 3 end) where mld_id = @mld_id
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Moldes_Upd`(@p_id int, @p_nome nvarchar(max), @p_m_id int, @p_np_id int, @p_tam_id int, @p_const_id int, @p_descricao nvarchar(max), @p_tp_id int, @p_coeficiente float, @p_precocusto float, @p_precovenda float, @p_pesolam float, @p_pesoacab float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Moldes_Upd]

@p_id int,
@p_nome nvarchar(max),
@p_m_id int = null,
@p_np_id int = null,
@p_tam_id int = null,
@p_const_id int = null,
@p_descricao nvarchar(max),
@p_tp_id INT,
@p_coeficiente float,
@p_precocusto float,
@p_precovenda float,
@p_pesolam float,
@p_pesoacab float

as
begin transaction

	update produto 
		set
			p_nome = @p_nome, 
			p_m_id = @p_m_id, 
			p_np_id = @p_np_id, 
			p_tam_id = @p_tam_id, 
			p_descricao = @p_descricao, 
			p_precocusto = @p_precocusto, 
			p_precovenda = @p_precovenda, 
			p_tp_id = @p_tp_id, 
			p_coeficiente = @p_coeficiente, 
			p_pesolam = @p_pesolam, 	
			p_pesoacab = @p_pesoacab
		where
			p_id = @p_id

	declare @p_const_id_ant int
	set @p_const_id_ant = (
					select comp_p_p_id 
						from produto_componente inner join 
							 produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join
							 produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
						where comp_p_id = @p_id and p_tp_id = 84)


	if (@p_const_id <> @p_const_id_ant)
	begin
		update produto_componente
			set
				comp_p_p_id = @p_const_id
			where
				comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_p_p_id = @p_const_id_ant	
	end
	else if (@p_const_id_ant is null and @p_const_id is not null)
	begin
		insert into produto_componente
			(comp_p_id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade, comp_tpcomp_id)
		values
			(@p_id, @p_const_id, 1, 1)			
	end

commit transaction

if @@error<>0
rollback transaction
```

#### `dbo.Moldes_Utilizacoes`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-11-12 13:21* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `molde`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Moldes_Utilizacoes]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select
		year(offp_data_prevista) as ano,
		datepart(week,offp_data_prevista) as semana,
		datepart(weekday,offp_data_prevista) as diaSemana,
		cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as offp_data_prevista,
		offp_turn_id,
		o.of_id,
		p_nome,
		o1.of_id as of_id_mld,
		o1.of_nome, 
		o1.of_numutil as utilRep,
		(case 
			when offp_turn_id = 1 then cast(dateadd(day, (case when datepart(weekday,offp_data_prevista) = 2 then -2 else -1 end), offp_data_prevista) as smalldatetime) + '14:00:00' 
			when offp_turn_id = 2 then cast(offp_data_prevista as smalldatetime) + '08:00:00'
			when offp_turn_id = 3 then cast(offp_data_prevista as smalldatetime) + '14:00:00'
		end) as ocupado_a, x.ultFeito, rep.ultRep
	from 
		of_fp 
		inner join ordemfabrico o on offp_of_id = o.of_id 
		inner join produto on o.of_p_id = p_id
		inner join ordemfabrico o1 on offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id
		outer apply (select MAX(offp_datafim) as ultFeito from OF_FP where OFFP_OF_ID_MLD = o1.OF_ID and OFFP_FP_ID = 1) as x
		outer apply (select MAX(offp_datafim) as ultRep from OF_FP where OFFP_OF_ID = o1.OF_ID and OFFP_FP_ID = 14) as rep
	where 
		o.of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and o.of_id < 10000000
		and cast(offp_data_prevista as date) >= cast(getdate() as date)
		and (o1.of_numutil >= 8 or DATEDIFF(day, x.ultFeito, GETDATE()) >= 30 or DATEDIFF(day, rep.ultRep, GETDATE()) >= 30)
	order by 
		cast(offp_data_prevista as date),
		utilRep desc
END
```
