#### `dbo.Movimento_Lista_ClasseAssoc`(@tp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-03-20 13:06* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Movimento_Lista_ClasseAssoc]

@tp_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

 --   select 
	--	tp_id, tp_nome
	--from 
	--	produto_tipo 
	--where 
	--	tp_tp_id = @tp_id
	--order by
	--	tp_nome

	declare @t table(tp_id int, tp_nome nvarchar(max), tp_tp_id int, visto bit default 0)

	insert into @t(tp_id, tp_nome, tp_tp_id)
	select 
			tp_id, tp_nome, tp_tp_id
		from
			produto_tipo
		where 
			tp_tp_id = @tp_id

	declare @tp_id_01 int, @tp_nome nvarchar(max), @tp_tp_id int

	while exists(select * from @t where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 @tp_id_01 = tp_id, @tp_nome = tp_nome, @tp_tp_id = tp_tp_id from @t where visto = 0

		update @t set visto = 1 where tp_id = @tp_id_01

		insert into @t (tp_id, tp_nome, tp_tp_id)
		select 
			tp_id, case when @tp_tp_id is null then tp_nome else @tp_nome + '\' + tp_nome end, case when @tp_tp_id is null then tp_tp_id else @tp_tp_id end
		from
			produto_tipo
		where 
			TP_TP_ID = @tp_id_01
	end


	select tp_id, tp_nome from @t order by tp_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.MovimentoFase_Sai`(@of_id int, @of_eof_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-01-13 16:36* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[MovimentoFase_Sai]

@of_id int,
@of_eof_id int

as

set nocount on;

declare @of_arm_id int, @counter INT
set @of_arm_id = (select of_arm_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

declare @dtActual smalldatetime = getdate()

CREATE TABLE #tt (movid int, movmovid int, lvl int)

if (@of_eof_id not in (select fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1))
begin
	declare @movsExcluidos table (movId int)
	insert into @movsExcluidos (movId) select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 4 and (MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null or MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1)

	while exists(select mov_id from movimento inner join @movsExcluidos on MOV_MOV_ID = movId where mov_id not in (select movId from @movsExcluidos))
	begin
		insert into @movsExcluidos (movId) select mov_id from movimento inner join @movsExcluidos on MOV_MOV_ID = movId where mov_id not in (select movId from @movsExcluidos)
	end

	SET @Counter = 0

	insert into #tt (movid, movmovid, lvl)
	select 
		mov_id, mov_mov_id, @counter 
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join ATRIBUTO on MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
	where 
		mov_of_id = @of_id 
		and mov_tpmov_id = 4 
		and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0 
		and (MOV_ATRIB_ID is null or ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT not in ('Acessórios', 'Acessorios Extra'))
		and mov_id not in (select movId from @movsExcluidos)

	WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0
	BEGIN

	SET @counter = @counter + 1

	insert into #tt (movid, movmovid, lvl)
	select	
		mov_id, mov_mov_id, @counter 
	from 
		#tt 
		inner join movimento on movid = mov_mov_id 
	where 
		lvl = @counter - 1

	end

	update movimento 
	set mov_data = getdate(), mov_tpmov_id = (case when p_saidas_auto = 1 and @of_id < 10000000 then 2 else 11 end), 
		mov_arm_id = p_arm_id, 
		MOV_OBSERVACOES += ' ** MovimentoFase_Sai, fase:' + cast(@of_eof_id as nvarchar(max)) + ' **'
	from 
		#tt 
		inner join movimento on movid=mov_id 
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id

	if (@of_eof_id = 72)
		update movimento set mov_tpmov_id = 11 where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_tpmov_id = 4

end
else if (@of_eof_id in (select fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and FP_ID <> 8))
begin
	declare @sequencia int
	set @sequencia = (select fp_sequencia from fases_producao where fp_id = @of_eof_id);

	SET @Counter = 0

	insert into #tt (movid, movmovid, lvl)
	select
		mov_id, mov_mov_id, @counter 
	from
		of_fp
		inner join movimento on OFFP_OF_ID = MOV_OF_ID
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
		left join ATRIBUTO on MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
	where
		OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id
		and OFFP_FP_ID = @of_eof_id
		and offp_datainicio is not null
		and (offp_datafim is null or DATEDIFF(n, offp_datafim, @dtActual) < 10)
		and mov_fp_id = @of_eof_id
		and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 4
		and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0
		and (MOV_ATRIB_ID is null	
				or ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT not in ('Acessórios', 'Acessorios Extra'))
	--select 
	--	mov_id, mov_mov_id, @counter 
	--from 
	--	movimento 
	--	inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
	--	inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
	--	inner join fases_producao fp on tp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
	--	inner join ORDEMFABRICO on mov_of_id = of_id
	--	left join ATRIBUTO on MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
	--	left join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE on COMP_P_ID = OF_P_ID and COMP_P_P_ID = MOV_P_ID
	--	left join PRODUTO_FASE on PRODF_P_ID = OF_P_ID and PRODF_FP_ID = COMP_FP_ID
	--	left join fases_producao fpp on prodf_fp_id = fpp.fp_id
	--where 
	--	mov_of_id = @of_id 
	--	and mov_tpmov_id = 4 
	--	and isnull(fpp.fp_sequencia,fp.fp_sequencia) <= @sequencia
	--	and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0
	--	and (MOV_ATRIB_ID is null	
	--		or ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT not in ('Acessórios', 'Acessorios Extra'))

	WHILE @@ROWCOUNT > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @counter = @counter + 1

		insert into #tt (movid, movmovid, lvl)
		select 
			mov_id, mov_mov_id, @counter 
		from 
			#tt 
			inner join movimento on movid = mov_mov_id 
		where 
			lvl = @counter - 1
	end
	
	update movimento 
	set mov_data = getdate(), mov_tpmov_id = (case when p_saidas_auto = 1 and @of_id < 10000000 then 2 else 11 end), 
		mov_precounitario = (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end), 
		mov_arm_id = p_arm_id, MOV_OBSERVACOES += ' ** MovimentoFase_Sai, fase:' + cast(@of_eof_id as nvarchar(max)) + ' **'
	from 
		#tt 
		inner join movimento on movid = mov_id 
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id

	drop table #tt
end
```

#### `dbo.MySQL_Register_Your_Boat`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `peso`, `expedi`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[MySQL_Register_Your_Boat]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	/*Insere registos que ainda não existem numa tabela temporaria*/
	declare @reg table(entry_id int, e_nome nvarchar(max), e_email nvarchar(max), e_cidade nvarchar(max), e_pais nvarchar(max), e_codigopostal nvarchar(max),
					   e_datanascimento smalldatetime, e_genero nvarchar(50), of_id int, e_p_id_banco int, e_banco_pos int, e_p_id_fp int, e_fp_pos int,
					   e_p_id_strap int, e_club nvarchar(max), e_pesocorporal float, e_numtreinos int, e_competicao bit, e_touring bit, e_sprint bit,
					   e_expeditions bit, e_marathon bit, e_observacoes nvarchar(max))

	insert into @reg (entry_id, e_nome, e_email, e_cidade, e_pais, e_codigopostal, e_datanascimento, e_genero, of_id, e_p_id_banco, e_banco_pos, e_p_id_fp, e_fp_pos,
					   e_p_id_strap, e_club, e_pesocorporal, e_numtreinos, e_competicao, e_touring, e_sprint, e_expeditions, e_marathon, e_observacoes)
	SELECT 
		convert(int,entry_id), convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_1), convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_4), convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_5), convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_7), convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_6), 
		
		(case when isdate(convert(nvarchar(max),form_field_2)) = 1 then convert(nvarchar(max),form_field_2) else null end),

		(case when convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_3) = 'Male' then 'Masculino' else 'Feminino' end), 
		(case when isnumeric(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_9)) = 1 then convert(int,convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_9)) else 0 end), 
		(case when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_10))) = 'Nelo' then 21483 when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_10))) = 'USA' then 20982 when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_10))) = 'Wood' then 20253 when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_10))) = 'Ultra Low' then 21484 end), 
		convert(int,convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_11)), 
		(case when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_12))) = 'Big' then 20256 else 20247 end), 
		convert(int,convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_13)), 
		(case when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_14))) = 'Carbon' then 20249 when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_14))) = 'Neoprene' then 20248 else 20257 end), 
		convert(nvarchar(max),form_field_15), 
		(case when isnumeric(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_16)) = 0 then 0 
				when isnumeric(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_16)) = 1 and convert(float, replace(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_16),',','.')) > 120 then convert(float, replace(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_16),',','.')) * 0.4536 
				else convert(float, replace(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_16),',','.')) end), 
		(case when isnumeric(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_17)) = 0 then 0 else convert(float, convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_17)) end), 
		(case when ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_18))) = 'yes' then 1 else 0 end), 
		(case when Charindex(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_19), 'touring', 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as e_touring, 
		(case when Charindex(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_19), 'sprint', 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as e_sprint, 
		(case when Charindex(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_19), 'expeditions', 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as e_expeditions, 
		(case when Charindex(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_19), 'marathon', 0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as e_marathon, 
		form_field_20
	FROM 
		OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
		'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_main;',
		'select entry_id, form_field_1, form_field_4, form_field_5, form_field_7, form_field_6, form_field_2, form_field_3, form_field_9, form_field_10, form_field_11, form_field_12, form_field_13, form_field_14, form_field_15, form_field_16, form_field_17, form_field_18, form_field_19, form_field_20 from exp_freeform_form_entries_9 where form_field_9 regexp ''[0-9]''')
		inner join ordemfabrico on ltrim(rtrim(convert(nvarchar(max), form_field_9))) = convert(nvarchar(max), of_id)
	WHERE 
		entry_id > coalesce((select max(registo) from import where descricao = 'Register your boat'),0)


	/*Cria registos de entidades não existentes*/
	insert into entidade (e_nome, e_email, e_cidade, e_pais, e_codigopostal, e_datanascimento, e_genero, e_ent_id, e_p_id_banco, e_banco_pos, e_p_id_fp, e_fp_pos,
					   e_p_id_strap, e_clube, e_pesocorporal, e_numtreinos, e_competicao, e_touring, e_sprint, e_expeditions, e_marathon, e_observacoes)
	select e_nome, e_email, e_cidade, e_pais, e_codigopostal, e_datanascimento, e_genero, 17, e_p_id_banco, e_banco_pos, e_p_id_fp, e_fp_pos,
					   e_p_id_strap, e_club, e_pesocorporal, e_numtreinos, e_competicao, e_touring, e_sprint, e_expeditions, e_marathon, e_observacoes
	from @reg where e_nome not in (select e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id = 17)


	/*Actualiza barcos*/
	update o set o.of_e_id = e.e_id from ordemfabrico as o inner join @reg as r on o.of_id = r.of_id inner join entidade as e on r.e_nome = e.e_nome where o.of_e_id is null

	/*Actualiza ultimo registo de Register Your Boat na BD*/
	declare @max int
	set @max = (select max(entry_id) from @reg)

	if (@max is not null) update import set registo = @max where descricao = 'Register your boat'


END
```

#### `dbo.NaoPagos_Lista`(@id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[NaoPagos_Lista]

@id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@id > -1)
	select 
		of_id as OrdFab, 
		p.p_nome as Modelo, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, 
		of_oftu_id,
		e_nome as Cliente, fp_id, 
		of_pago, 
		of_datapagamento, 
		of_referencia as Referencia,
		(select top 1 convert(nvarchar(max),tr_data,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(tr_descricao,'') 
			from transporte left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
			where trof_of_id = of_id and trof_enviado = 1 order by tr_data desc) as UltTR, of_tr_id
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where 
		of_pago = 0 
		and fp_id in (12,13,14) 
		and of_oftu_id = @id 
	order by 
		e_nome, fp_id desc, p.p_nome
else
	select 
		of_id as OrdFab, 
		p.p_nome as Modelo, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores,  
		of_oftu_id,
		e_nome as Cliente, 
		fp_id, 
		of_pago, 
		of_datapagamento, 
		of_referencia as Referencia,
		(select top 1 convert(nvarchar(max),tr_data,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(tr_descricao,'') 
			from transporte left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
			where trof_of_id = of_id and trof_enviado = 1 order by tr_data desc) as UltTR, of_tr_id
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where 
		of_pago = 0 
		and fp_id in (12,13,14) 
		and of_oftu_id is null 
	order by 
		e_nome, fp_id desc, p.p_nome


END
```

#### `dbo.OF_Pesos125`(@of_id int, @p500 int, @p250 int, @p100 int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-01-30 16:43* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `v_of`, `peso`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OF_Pesos125]

	@of_id int,
	@p500 int = 0,
	@p250 int = 0,
	@p100 int = 0
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @mov_500 int, @mov_250 int, @mov_100 int
	--Pesos 500
	set @mov_500 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 26037)
	if (@mov_500 is not null and @p500 > 0)
		exec produtosassociados_upd 26037, @p500, @of_id, @mov_500
	else if (@mov_500 is null and @p500 > 0)
		exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 26037, @p500, @of_id, 101
	else if (@mov_500 is not null and @p500 = 0)
		exec produtosassociados_del 26037, @of_id, @mov_500

	--Pesos 250
	set @mov_250 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 26036)
	if (@mov_250 is not null and @p250 > 0)
		exec produtosassociados_upd 26036, @p250, @of_id, @mov_250
	else if (@mov_250 is null and @p250 > 0)
		exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 26036, @p250, @of_id, 101
	else if (@mov_250 is not null and @p250 = 0)
		exec produtosassociados_del 26036, @of_id, @mov_250

	--Pesos 100
	set @mov_100 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 29532)
	if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 > 0)
		exec produtosassociados_upd 29532, @p100, @of_id, @mov_100 -- Psos de 100g = 20423
	else if (@mov_100 is null and @p100 > 0)
		exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 29532, @p100, @of_id, 101
	else if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 = 0)
		exec produtosassociados_del 29532, @of_id, @mov_100
END
```

#### `dbo.OF_Pesquisa`(@pesq nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OF_Pesquisa]
	
@pesq nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		of_id, p.p_nome as modelo, 
		e_nome as cliente, of_referencia, fp_nome, coalesce(desm.offp_peso,0) as desm, coalesce(acab.offp_peso,0) as acab, count(atch.atch_image) as images, of_observacoes, of_tr_data_ult, of_tr_desc_ult, of_datainicio, of_datafim, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id inner join 
		produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		left join (select atch_of_id, atch_image from of_attach) as atch on of_id = atch.atch_of_id left join of_fp as desm on of_id = desm.offp_of_id and desm.offp_fp_id = 6
		left join of_fp as acab on of_id = acab.offp_of_id and acab.offp_fp_id = 8
	where 
		(e_nome like '%' + @pesq + '%' or of_referencia like '%' + @pesq + '%' or of_observacoes like '%' + @pesq + '%' or convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) like '%' + @pesq + '%'or p.p_nome like '%' + @pesq + '%') and OF_ID < 10000000
	group by 
		of_id, p.p_nome, dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0), e_nome, of_referencia, fp_nome, of_observacoes, of_tr_data_ult, of_tr_desc_ult, of_datainicio, of_datafim, desm.offp_peso, acab.offp_peso
	order by 
		isnull(of_tr_data_ult, getdate()) desc, p.p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.OFsEmpregado_Detalhe`(@of int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `peso`, `molde`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[OFsEmpregado_Detalhe]

@of int

as

if exists(select of_id from ordemfabrico where of_id=@of)
begin
select 
of_id, tp_nome, p.p_id, p.p_nome, 
dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as of_p_id_cdeck, '' as of_p_id_ccasco, --p1.p_nome as of_p_id_cdeck, p2.p_nome as of_p_id_ccasco, 
'auto' as of_autocolantes, e_nome, 
(select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id=p_id where mov_of_id=of_id and p_tp_id=84) as const_nome, 
(select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id=p_id where mov_of_id=of_id and p_tp_id=14) as Leme, 
(select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id=p_id where mov_of_id=of_id and p_tp_id=11) as FincaPes,
(select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id=p_id where mov_of_id=of_id and p_tp_id=62) as FincaPesTras,
(select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id=p_id where mov_of_id=of_id and p_tp_id=12) as Strap,
(select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id=p_id where mov_of_id=of_id and p_tp_id=10) as Banco, 
(case when exists (select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id=p_id where mov_of_id=of_id and p_tp_id=74) then 'true' else 'false' end) as of_capa,
of_observacoes, tr_data, of_of_id_mld,
pintura.offp_id as Pintura_Id, pintura.offp_datainicio as PinturaInicio, pintura.offp_datafim as PinturaFim, pintura.ch as Pintor, pintura.ass as PinturaAssistente, 
pintura.offp_problemas as PinturaProblemas, pintura.offp_observacoes as PinturaObservacoes, 
laminagem.offp_id as Laminagem_Id, laminagem.offp_datainicio as LamInicio, laminagem.offp_datafim as LamFim, laminagem.ch as Laminador, laminagem.ass as LamAssistente, 
laminagem.offp_problemas as LamProblemas, laminagem.offp_observacoes as LamObservacoes, 
estufa.offp_datainicio as EstInicio, estufa.offp_datafim as EstFim, estufa.offp_problemas as EstProblemas, estufa.offp_observacoes as EstObservacoes, 
colagem.offp_id as Col_Id, colagem.offp_datainicio as ColInicio, colagem.offp_datafim as ColFim, colagem.ch as Colador, colagem.ass as ColAssistente, 
colagem.offp_problemas as ColProblemas, colagem.offp_observacoes as ColObservacoes, 
desmolde.offp_id as Des_Id, desmolde.offp_datainicio as DesInicio, desmolde.offp_datafim as DesFim, desmolde.ch as Desmoldador, desmolde.ass as DesAssistente, 
desmolde.offp_problemas as DesProblemas, desmolde.offp_peso as DesPeso, desmolde.offp_observacoes as DesObservacoes, 
parque.offp_id as Pq_Id, parque.offp_datainicio as PqDesInicio, parque.offp_datafim as PqDesFim, parque.ch as PqDesmoldador, parque.ass as PqDesAssistente, 
parque.offp_problemas as PqDesProblemas, parque.offp_observacoes as PqDesObservacoes, 
acabamento.offp_id as Acab_Id, acabamento.offp_datainicio as AcabInicio, acabamento.offp_datafim as AcabFim, acabamento.ch as Acabador, 
acabamento.ass as AcabAssistente, acabamento.offp_problemas as AcabProblemas, acabamento.offp_peso as AcabPeso,acabamento.offp_observacoes as AcabObservacoes,
(case when p.p_qtd_resina > 0 then p.p_qtd_resina else coalesce((select m.mov_quantidade from movimento as m inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto on m1.mov_p_id = p_id where m.mov_p_id in (21399,20448,27484) and m.mov_of_id = of_id and p_tp_id = 84), 0) end) as qtdResina
from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id=p.p_id inner join produto_tipo on p.p_tp_id=tp_id 
	--left join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id
left join entidade on of_e_id_enc=e_id left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
left join
(select offp_of_id, offp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, o.offpeq_e_id as ch, o1.offpeq_e_id as ass, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes
from of_fp left join offp_eq as o on offp_id = o.offpeq_offp_id and o.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join offp_eq as o1 on offp_id = o1.offpeq_offp_id and o1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
where offp_fp_id = 18) as pintura on of_id = pintura.offp_of_id
left join
(select offp_of_id, offp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, o.offpeq_e_id as ch, o1.offpeq_e_id as ass, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes
from of_fp left join offp_eq as o on offp_id = o.offpeq_offp_id and o.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join offp_eq as o1 on offp_id = o1.offpeq_offp_id and o1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
where offp_fp_id = 1) as laminagem on of_id = laminagem.offp_of_id
left join
(select offp_of_id, offp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, o.offpeq_e_id as ch, o1.offpeq_e_id as ass, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes
from of_fp left join offp_eq as o on offp_id = o.offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join offp_eq as o1 on offp_id = o1.offpeq_offp_id and o1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
where offp_fp_id = 2) as estufa on of_id = estufa.offp_of_id
left join
(select offp_of_id, offp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, o.offpeq_e_id as ch, o1.offpeq_e_id as ass, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes
from of_fp left join offp_eq as o on offp_id = o.offpeq_offp_id and o.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join offp_eq as o1 on offp_id = o1.offpeq_offp_id and o1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
where offp_fp_id = 4) as colagem on of_id = colagem.offp_of_id
left join
(select offp_of_id, offp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, o.offpeq_e_id as ch, o1.offpeq_e_id as ass, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes, offp_peso
from of_fp left join offp_eq as o on offp_id = o.offpeq_offp_id and o.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join offp_eq as o1 on offp_id = o1.offpeq_offp_id and o1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
where offp_fp_id = 6) as desmolde on of_id = desmolde.offp_of_id
left join
(select offp_of_id, offp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, o.offpeq_e_id as ch, o1.offpeq_e_id as ass, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes
from of_fp left join offp_eq as o on offp_id = o.offpeq_offp_id and o.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join offp_eq as o1 on offp_id = o1.offpeq_offp_id and o1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
where offp_fp_id = 22) as parque on of_id = parque.offp_of_id
left join
(select offp_of_id, offp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, o.offpeq_e_id as ch, o1.offpeq_e_id as ass, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes, offp_peso
from of_fp left join offp_eq as o on offp_id = o.offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join offp_eq as o1 on offp_id = o1.offpeq_offp_id and o1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
where offp_fp_id = 8) as acabamento on of_id = acabamento.offp_of_id
where of_id=@of
end
else
begin
	raiserror('A Ordem de Fabrico que introduziu não Existe!!!',16,1)
end
```

#### `dbo.OFsEmpregado_Lista`(@EMP_ID int, @EMP_TIPO int)

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OFsEmpregado_Lista]

@EMP_ID int,
@EMP_TIPO int

AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION

if @EMP_TIPO=5
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (11,1,2) and offp_fp_id=1 and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=7
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (7,8) and offp_fp_id=8 and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=26
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	/*inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id*/ INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (6,22,40,42) and offp_fp_id=22 /*and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID */and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=6
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (5,6) and offp_fp_id=6 and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=9
begin

	select 
	(case when (select offp_datainicio from of_fp where offp_of_id=of_id and offp_fp_id=4) is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar,
	(case when (select offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_of_id=of_id and offp_fp_id=3) is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Sair, 
	of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id
	INNER JOIN FASES_PRODUCAO ON OF_FP_ID=FP_ID 
	where of_fp_id in (2,3,4) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by of_id

end


COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OFsEmpregado_ListaMoldes]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @np int, @m int, @tam int
	select @np = p_np_id, @m = p_m_id, @tam = p_tam_id from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id

	select 
		of_id, of_nome, of_peso_deck, of_peso_casco, of_numutil 
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
	where 
		p_tp_id = 82 
		and p_np_id = @np 
		and p_m_id = @m 
		and p_tam_id = @tam
	union select null as of_id, ' ', 0, 0, 0 as of_nome order by of_id
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OFsEmpregado_Pega]

@OF_ID int,
@EMP_TIPO int,
@PEGAR bit

AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION

if @EMP_TIPO=5
begin
	if @PEGAR='true'
	begin
		if exists(select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @OF_ID and offp_fp_id = 18 and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datafim is null))
			update of_fp 
				set offp_datainicio = coalesce(offp_datainicio, getdate()), offp_datafim = coalesce(offp_datafim, getdate()) 
				where offp_of_id = @OF_ID and offp_fp_id = 18

		update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=11 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=1 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=1 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
	else
	begin

		update of_fp set offp_datafim=null
		where offp_fp_id=11 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=null
		where offp_fp_id=1 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=11 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
end
else if @EMP_TIPO=7
begin
	if @PEGAR='true'
	begin

		update of_fp set offp_datafim=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=7 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=8 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=8 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
	else
	begin

		update of_fp set offp_datafim=null
		where offp_fp_id=7 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=null
		where offp_fp_id=8 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=7 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
end
else if @EMP_TIPO=26
begin
	if @PEGAR='true'
	begin

		update of_fp set offp_datafim=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=6 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=22 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=22 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
	else
	begin

		update of_fp set offp_datafim=null
		where offp_fp_id=6 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=null
		where offp_fp_id=22 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=6 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
end
else if @EMP_TIPO=8
begin
	if @PEGAR='true'
	begin

		update of_fp set offp_datafim=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=5 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=6 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=6 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
	else
	begin

		update of_fp set offp_datafim=null
		where offp_fp_id=5 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=null
		where offp_fp_id=6 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=5 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
end
else if @EMP_TIPO=9
begin
	if @PEGAR='true'
	begin
		if ((select offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_of_id=@OF_ID and offp_fp_id=2) is null)
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datafim=getdate()
			where offp_fp_id=2 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID
		end

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=getdate()
		where offp_fp_id=4 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=4 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
	else
	begin
		if ((select offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_of_id=@OF_ID and offp_fp_id=2) is not null)
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datafim=null
			where offp_fp_id=2 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID
		end

		update of_fp set offp_datainicio=null
		where offp_fp_id=4 and offp_of_id=@OF_ID

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id=2 where of_id=@OF_ID
	end
end


declare @of_fp_id int
set @of_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @OF_ID)

exec MovimentoFase_Sai @OF_ID, @of_fp_id

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.OFsEmpregado_Upd`(@OF_ID int, @OF_PINTURAINICIO datetime, @OF_PINTURAFIM datetime, @OF_PINTURAPROBLEMAS nvarchar(max), @OF_PINTURAOBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_PINTURAPINTOR int, @OF_PINTURAASSISTENTE int, @OF_LAMINICIO datetime, @OF_LAMFIM datetime, @OF_LAMPROBLEMAS nvarchar(max), @OF_LAMOBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_LAMLAMINADOR int, @OF_LAMASSISTENTE int, @OF_LAMPESO float, @OF_ESTINICIO datetime, @OF_ESTFIM datetime, @OF_ESTPROBLEMAS nvarchar(max), @OF_ESTOBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_COLINICIO datetime, @OF_COLFIM datetime, @OF_COLCOLADOR int, @OF_COLASSISTENTE int, @OF_COLPROBLEMAS nvarchar(max), @OF_COLOBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_DESINICIO datetime, @OF_DESFIM datetime, @OF_DESDESMOLDADOR int, @OF_DESASSISTENTE int, @OF_DESPROBLEMAS nvarchar(max), @OF_DESOBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_PQDESINICIO datetime, @OF_PQDESFIM datetime, @OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR int, @OF_PQDESASSISTENTE int, @OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS nvarchar(max), @OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_ACABINICIO datetime, @OF_ACABFIM datetime, @OF_ACABPROBLEMAS nvarchar(max), @OF_ACABOBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_ACABACABADOR int, @OF_ACABASSISTENTE int, @OF_ACABPESO float, @OF_MLD_ID int, @QTD_RESINA float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `v_of`, `producao`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OFsEmpregado_Upd]

@OF_ID INT,
@OF_PINTURAINICIO DATETIME,
@OF_PINTURAFIM DATETIME,
@OF_PINTURAPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_PINTURAOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_PINTURAPINTOR INT,
@OF_PINTURAASSISTENTE INT,
@OF_LAMINICIO DATETIME,
@OF_LAMFIM DATETIME,
@OF_LAMPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_LAMOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_LAMLAMINADOR INT,
@OF_LAMASSISTENTE INT,
@OF_LAMPESO FLOAT,
@OF_ESTINICIO DATETIME,
@OF_ESTFIM DATETIME,
@OF_ESTPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ESTOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_COLINICIO DATETIME,
@OF_COLFIM DATETIME,
@OF_COLCOLADOR INT,
@OF_COLASSISTENTE INT,
@OF_COLPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_COLOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_DESINICIO DATETIME,
@OF_DESFIM DATETIME,
@OF_DESDESMOLDADOR INT,
@OF_DESASSISTENTE INT,
@OF_DESPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_DESOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_PQDESINICIO DATETIME,
@OF_PQDESFIM DATETIME,
@OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR INT,
@OF_PQDESASSISTENTE INT,
@OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ACABINICIO DATETIME,
@OF_ACABFIM DATETIME,
@OF_ACABPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ACABOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ACABACABADOR INT,
@OF_ACABASSISTENTE INT,
@OF_ACABPESO FLOAT,
@OF_MLD_ID INT,
@QTD_RESINA FLOAT

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /*Actualiza fases de Producao*/
if ((select of_supervisao from ordemfabrico where of_id = @OF_ID) = 1 and (select i = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@OF_ID)) = 8)
		raiserror('Peça a um Superior para visturiar esta Ordem de Fabrico!!!',16,1)
else
begin
	declare @p_deck_ant float, @p_deck_dp float, @p_casco_ant float, @p_casco_dp float

	select @p_deck_ant = offp_peso_deck_ant, @p_deck_dp = offp_peso_deck_dp, @p_casco_ant = offp_peso_casco_ant, @p_casco_dp = offp_peso_casco_dp from of_fp where offp_of_id = @OF_ID and offp_fp_id = 18

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 18, @OF_PINTURAINICIO, @OF_PINTURAFIM, 0, @OF_PINTURAPROBLEMAS, @OF_PINTURAPINTOR, @OF_PINTURAASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PINTURAOBSERVACOES, @p_deck_ant, @p_deck_dp, @p_casco_ant, @p_casco_dp

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 1, @OF_LAMINICIO, @OF_LAMFIM, 0, @OF_LAMPROBLEMAS, @OF_LAMLAMINADOR, @OF_LAMASSISTENTE, null, @OF_LAMOBSERVACOES

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 2, @OF_ESTINICIO, @OF_ESTFIM, 0, @OF_ESTPROBLEMAS, null, null, null, @OF_ESTOBSERVACOES

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 4, @OF_COLINICIO, @OF_COLFIM, 0, @OF_COLPROBLEMAS, @OF_COLCOLADOR, @OF_COLASSISTENTE, null, @OF_COLOBSERVACOES

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 6, @OF_DESINICIO, @OF_DESFIM, @OF_LAMPESO, @OF_DESPROBLEMAS, @OF_DESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_DESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_DESOBSERVACOES

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 22, @OF_PQDESINICIO, @OF_PQDESFIM, 0, @OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS, @OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_PQDESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 8, @OF_ACABINICIO, @OF_ACABFIM, @OF_ACABPESO, @OF_ACABPROBLEMAS, @OF_ACABACABADOR, @OF_ACABASSISTENTE, null, @OF_ACABOBSERVACOES

declare @of_fp_id int
set @of_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@OF_ID)

	update ordemfabrico set of_of_id_mld = @OF_MLD_ID, of_fp_id = @of_fp_id where of_id = @OF_ID

if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 9 and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datainicio <> @OF_ACABFIM or (offp_datainicio is not null and @OF_ACABFIM is null)) and offp_datafim is null)
	update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @OF_ACABFIM where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 9 and offp_datainicio is null and offp_datafim is null
else if ((dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@OF_ID) = 9) and not exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 9 and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datainicio = @OF_ACABFIM) and offp_datafim is null))
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, 9, @OF_ACABFIM)


declare @resina int
set @resina = (select m.mov_p_id from movimento as m inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto on m1.mov_p_id = p_id where m.mov_p_id in (21399,20448,27484) and m.mov_of_id = @OF_ID and p_tp_id = 84)

if (@resina is not null and @QTD_RESINA > 0)
	exec ProdutosAssociados_Upd @resina, @QTD_RESINA, @OF_ID
else if (@QTD_RESINA > 0)
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @resina, @QTD_RESINA, @OF_ID, 57
else if (@QTD_RESINA = 0)
	exec ProdutosAssociados_Del @resina, @OF_ID

end

exec MovimentoFase_Sai @OF_ID, @of_fp_id

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Acessorio_Extra`(@mov_id int, @mov_of_id int, @mov_p_id int, @mov_quantidade float, @mov_e_id int, @del float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `v_of`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Acessorio_Extra]

@mov_id int = null,
@mov_of_id int,
@mov_p_id int,
@mov_quantidade float,
@mov_e_id int,
@del float

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if @mov_id is not null and @del = 0
	begin
		insert into movimento 
		(mov_data, mov_quantidade, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, mov_desconto, mov_observacoes, mov_of_id, mov_e_id, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_acerto, mov_acessorio_adicional, mov_defeituoso)
		values (getdate(),@mov_quantidade, 0, 0, 0, 'Acessório extra da OF: ' + cast(@mov_of_id as nvarchar(max)), @mov_of_id, @mov_e_id, @mov_p_id, 4, 0, 1, 0)
	end
	else if @del = 0
		update movimento set mov_p_id = @mov_p_id, mov_quantidade = @mov_quantidade where mov_id = @mov_id
	else
		delete from movimento where mov_id = @mov_id

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_AcessoriosBaixaEmFase`(@mov_id int, @e_id_Resp int, @of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-01-22 11:02* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_AcessoriosBaixaEmFase]

@mov_id int = null,
@e_id_Resp int, 
@of_id int = null -- do accessório

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dt as datetime
	select @dt = getdate()

	if @mov_id is not null
		update 
			movimento 
		set 
			mov_qtd_bal = (case when mov_qtd_bal < mov_quantidade then mov_qtd_bal + 1 else mov_quantidade end),
			mov_tpmov_id = (case 
								when p_saidas_auto = 1 and mov_quantidade = mov_qtd_bal + 1 then 2
								when p_saidas_auto = 0 and mov_quantidade = mov_qtd_bal + 1 then 11
								--when (p_gera_of = 1 and p_saidas_auto = 1 and isnull(x.nOFs,0) = mov_quantidade) or (p_gera_of = 0 and p_saidas_auto = 1) then 2
								--when (p_gera_of = 1 and p_saidas_auto = 0 and isnull(x.nOFs,0) = mov_quantidade) or (p_gera_of = 0 and p_saidas_auto = 0) then 11
								--when p_saidas_auto = 1 then 2
								--when p_saidas_auto = 0 then 11
								else mov_tpmov_id
							end),
			mov_data = @dt
		from 
			movimento 
			inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
			--left join (select of_mov_id, count(of_id) as nOFs from ordemfabrico group by of_mov_id) x on mov_id = of_mov_id
		where 
			mov_id = @mov_id


    if @of_id is not null
	begin
		declare @e_id int, @offp_id int
		select top 1 @e_id = of_e_id_enc, @offp_id = offp_id from movimento inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id left join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 12 and offp_datainicio is null where mov_id = @mov_id

		update of_fp set offp_datafim = @dt where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null

		if @offp_id is not null
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @dt where offp_id = @offp_id
			exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @e_id_Resp, 1, 12, @offp_id
		end
		else
		begin
			exec OrdemFabrico_AddFase @of_id = @of_id, @fp_id = 12, @offp_datainicio = @dt

			select @offp_id = offp_id from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 12 and offp_datafim is null and offp_datainicio is not null

			if @offp_id is not null 
				exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @e_id_Resp, 1, 12, @offp_id
		end
		update ordemfabrico set of_mov_id = @mov_id, of_e_id_enc = @e_id, of_fp_id = 12 where of_id = @of_id
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Add`(@OF_EOF_ID int, @OF_DATA datetime, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO datetime, @OF_E_ID int, @OF_E_ID_ENC int, @OF_P_ID int, @OF_P_ID_CONST int, @OF_P_ID_CDECK int, @OF_P_ID_CCASCO int, @OF_OF_ID_MLD int, @OF_OBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_MORADAENTREGA nvarchar(max), @OF_REFERENCIA nvarchar(max), @OF_TELEFONE nvarchar(max), @OF_EMAIL nvarchar(max), @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC nvarchar(max), @OF_ENC_ID int, @OF_PRECOCUSTO float, @OF_PRECOVENDA float, @OF_DESCONTO float, @OF_VALORPAGO float, @OF_PAGO bit, @QTD_BANCO int, @QTD_FINCAPES int, @QTD_FINCAPESTRAS int, @QTD_LEME int, @QTD_STRAP int, @OF_LEME int, @OF_FINCAPES int, @OF_FINCAPESTRAS int, @OF_STRAP int, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES nvarchar(max), @OF_BANCO int, @OF_CAPA int, @OF_MATTPINTURA int, @QTD_MATTPINTURA int, @OF_PN int, @QTD_PN int, @OF_TAMPA5 int, @QTD_TAMPA5 int, @OF_EMBALAGEM int, @OF_OFTU_ID int, @OF_SUPERVISAO bit, @OF_DATAINICIO smalldatetime, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit, @OF_TURN_ID int, @OF_TR_ID int, @OF_CRIADOR nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR int, @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR int, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR int, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR int, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS int, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR int, @OF_P_ID_GOLA int, @OF_ACABCONTROLO bit, @OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS bit, @of_transp bit, @of_paraalterar bit, @of_id_copy int, @of_nome nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-04-22 13:36* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Add]

@OF_EOF_ID INT,
@OF_DATA DATETIME,
@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO DATETIME,
@OF_E_ID INT,
@OF_E_ID_ENC INT,
@OF_P_ID INT,
@OF_P_ID_CONST INT,
@OF_P_ID_CDECK INT,
@OF_P_ID_CCASCO INT,
@OF_OF_ID_MLD INT,
@OF_OBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_MORADAENTREGA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_REFERENCIA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TELEFONE NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_EMAIL NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ENC_ID INT,
@OF_PRECOCUSTO FLOAT,
@OF_PRECOVENDA FLOAT,
@OF_DESCONTO FLOAT,
@OF_VALORPAGO FLOAT,
@OF_PAGO BIT,
----------------------------------------------------------------------------@OF_CL_ID_ENC INT,
--ACESSORIOS--
@QTD_BANCO INT,
@QTD_FINCAPES INT,
@QTD_FINCAPESTRAS INT,
@QTD_LEME INT,
@QTD_STRAP INT,
@OF_LEME INT,
@OF_FINCAPES INT,
@OF_FINCAPESTRAS INT,
@OF_STRAP INT,
@OF_AUTOCOLANTES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_BANCO INT,
@OF_CAPA INT,
@OF_MATTPINTURA INT = NULL,
@QTD_MATTPINTURA INT = NULL,
@OF_PN INT = NULL,
@QTD_PN INT = NULL,
@OF_TAMPA5 INT = NULL,
@QTD_TAMPA5 INT = NULL,
/****************************************************/
@OF_EMBALAGEM INT,
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_SUPERVISAO bit,
@OF_DATAINICIO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit,
@OF_TURN_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_TR_ID INT = NULL,
--------USER----------
@OF_CRIADOR NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR INT = 20598,
@OF_P_ID_GOLA INT = 20598,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO BIT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS BIT = 0,
@of_transp bit = 0,
@of_paraalterar bit = 0,
@of_id_copy int = 0,
@of_nome NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''

AS
BEGIN TRANSACTION
set nocount on;

	declare @of_id int, @intervalo_inicio int, @intervalo_fim int

	select @intervalo_inicio = intervalo_inicio, @intervalo_fim = intervalo_fim 
		from intervalo inner join produto_tipo on intervalo_tp_id = tp_id
			 inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id
		where p_id = @OF_P_ID

	set @of_id = coalesce(((select max(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_id between @intervalo_inicio and @intervalo_fim) + 1),@intervalo_inicio)

	declare @of_coeficiente float
	set @of_coeficiente=(select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID)

	declare @supervisaoPintura bit
	if (@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = 20598 OR @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_QUINAS = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_CCASCO = 20598) set @supervisaoPintura = 1
	else set @supervisaoPintura = 0

	set @OF_EOF_ID = (select top 1 prodf_fp_id from produto_fase where prodf_p_id = @of_p_id order by prodf_sequencia)

	--set @OF_ID = 18965

	insert into ordemfabrico
		(OF_ID, OF_DATA, OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, OF_OBSERVACOES, OF_PRECOCUSTO, 
		OF_PRECOVENDA, OF_MORADAENTREGA, OF_REFERENCIA, OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, OF_AUTOCOLANTE, 
		OF_DESCONTO, OF_VALORPAGO, OF_COEFICIENTE, OF_PAGO, OF_SUPERVISAO,OF_OFTU_ID, OF_ENC_ID, 
		OF_P_ID, OF_E_ID, OF_E_ID_ENC, OF_FP_ID, OF_OF_ID_MLD, OF_P_ID_CDECK, OF_P_ID_CCASCO, 
		OF_DATAINICIO, OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, OF_TURN_ID, OF_TELEFONE, OF_EMAIL, OF_CRIADOR,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, OF_P_ID_QUINAS, OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, OF_P_ID_GOLA, OF_TRANSP, OF_SUPERVISAOPINTURA, OF_P_ID_HIST, of_paraalterar, of_nome)
	values
		(@OF_ID, @OF_DATA, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, @OF_OBSERVACOES, @OF_PRECOCUSTO,
		@OF_PRECOVENDA, @OF_MORADAENTREGA, @OF_REFERENCIA, @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES,
		@OF_DESCONTO, @OF_VALORPAGO, @OF_COEFICIENTE, @OF_PAGO, @OF_SUPERVISAO, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_ENC_ID,
		@OF_P_ID, @OF_E_ID, @OF_E_ID_ENC, @OF_EOF_ID, @OF_OF_ID_MLD, @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @OF_P_ID_CCASCO, 
		@OF_DATAINICIO, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, @OF_TURN_ID, @OF_TELEFONE, @OF_EMAIL, @OF_CRIADOR,
		@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, @OF_P_ID_GOLA, @of_transp, @supervisaoPintura, convert(nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID) + '(' + @OF_CRIADOR + '); ', @of_paraalterar, @of_nome)


	select id = @OF_ID


/*Cria Registos das Fases de Producao*/
	--insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) (select @OF_ID, fp_id from fases_producao where fp_id in (11,18,1,2,3,4,5,6,22,7,8,9,10,12))
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, OFFP_COEFICIENTE, offp_tpcam_id, offp_planeamento, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X) (select @OF_ID, prodf_fp_id, prodf_sequencia, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_tpcam_id, fp_planeamento, prodf_coeficiente_x from produto_fase inner join fases_producao on prodf_fp_id = fp_id where prodf_p_id = @of_p_id)

/*Cria registo do tipo de Uso*/
	if (@OF_OFTU_ID is not null)
	begin
		declare @OF_DATATRANSPORTE smalldatetime
		set @OF_DATATRANSPORTE = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

		insert into of_of_tipouso (ofoftu_of_id, ofoftu_oftu_id, ofoftu_dataentrada) values (@OF_ID, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_DATATRANSPORTE)
	end

/*Adiciona Acessorios, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_BANCO, @QTD_BANCO, @OF_ID, 10

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPES, @QTD_FINCAPES, @OF_ID, 11

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPESTRAS, @QTD_FINCAPESTRAS, @OF_ID, 62

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_LEME, @QTD_LEME, @OF_ID, 14

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_STRAP, @QTD_STRAP, @OF_ID, 12

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_CAPA, 1, @OF_ID, 74

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_EMBALAGEM, 1, @OF_ID, 81

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84
	
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_MATTPINTURA, @QTD_MATTPINTURA, @OF_ID, 134

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_PN, @QTD_PN, @OF_ID, 65

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_TAMPA5, @QTD_TAMPA5, @OF_ID, 135



declare @qtd_deck float, @qtd_casco float, @topo_fr float, @topo_tr float, @lateral_fr float, @lateral_tr float, @quinas float
select @qtd_deck = coalesce(p_qtddeck,0), @qtd_casco = coalesce(p_qtdcasco,0), 
	@topo_fr = p_perc_topo_fr, @topo_tr = p_perc_topo_tr, @lateral_fr = p_perc_lateral_fr, @lateral_tr = p_perc_lateral_tr, @quinas = p_perc_quinas
from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID

if (@OF_P_ID_CDECK = @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
begin
	set @qtd_deck = @qtd_deck + @qtd_casco
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null
end
else if (@OF_P_ID_CDECK <> @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
begin
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CCASCO, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, null
end

	set @topo_fr = @qtd_deck * @topo_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @topo_fr, @OF_ID, null, 'Topo_fr'

	set @topo_tr = @qtd_deck * @topo_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @topo_tr, @OF_ID, null, 'Topo_tr'

	set @lateral_fr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @lateral_fr, @OF_ID, null, 'Lateral_fr'

	set @lateral_tr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @lateral_tr, @OF_ID, null, 'Lateral_tr'

	set @quinas = @qtd_deck * @quinas
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @quinas, @OF_ID, null, 'Quinas'

--/*Adiciona os Standards, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID, null

--/*Adiciona os Produtos Acossiados à construção e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	--exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID_CONST, 84

/*Actualiza fases de Producao*/
declare @d as smalldatetime
set @d = getdate()

	if @OF_EOF_ID = 32
	begin
		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 32, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL

		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, NULL, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL
	end
	else exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 18, @OF_PINTURAINICIO, @OF_PINTURAFIM, 0, @OF_PINTURAPROBLEMAS, @OF_PINTURAPINTOR, @OF_PINTURAASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PINTURAOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 1, @OF_LAMINICIO, @OF_LAMFIM, 0, @OF_LAMPROBLEMAS, @OF_LAMLAMINADOR, @OF_LAMASSISTENTE, null, @OF_LAMOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 2, @OF_ESTINICIO, @OF_ESTFIM, 0, @OF_ESTPROBLEMAS, null, null, null, @OF_ESTOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 5, @OF_COLINICIO, @OF_COLFIM, 0, @OF_COLPROBLEMAS, @OF_COLCOLADOR, @OF_COLASSISTENTE, null, @OF_COLOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 6, @OF_DESINICIO, @OF_DESFIM, @OF_LAMPESO, @OF_DESPROBLEMAS, @OF_DESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_DESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_DESOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 22, @OF_PQDESINICIO, @OF_PQDESFIM, 0, @OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS, @OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_PQDESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 8, @OF_ACABINICIO, @OF_ACABFIM, @OF_ACABPESO, @OF_ACABPROBLEMAS, @OF_ACABACABADOR, @OF_ACABASSISTENTE, null, @OF_ACABOBSERVACOES


	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	
	if @of_id_copy > 0
	begin
		declare @tb table (atch_nome nvarchar(max), atch_of_id int, atch_image nvarchar(max))

		insert into @tb (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) select atch_nome, atch_of_id, Replace(atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy), convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID)) from of_attach where atch_of_id = @of_id_copy
		
		declare @files int = (select count(*) from @tb)
		declare @atch_nome nvarchar(max), @atch_image nvarchar(max), @comando varchar(1000)

		while @files > 0
		begin
			select top 1 @atch_nome = atch_nome, @atch_image = atch_image from @tb

			insert into of_attach (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) values (@atch_nome, @OF_ID, @atch_image)

			set @comando = 'copy /y ' + Replace(@atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID), convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy)) + ' ' + @atch_image

			exec master..xp_cmdshell @comando

			delete top (1) from @tb

			set @comando = ''
			set @files = @files - 1
		end
	end

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.Ordemfabrico_Add_Chgecklist_Fase`(@of_id int, @fp_id_chk int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-01-30 17:03 · modificado 2020-01-31 13:43* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `molde`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE Ordemfabrico_Add_Chgecklist_Fase
	@of_id int,
	@fp_id_chk int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @lista int, @offp_id int
	select top 1 @lista = P_PL_ID, @offp_id = offp_id from produto inner join ORDEMFABRICO on p_id = OF_P_ID inner join of_fp on of_id = OFFP_OF_ID where of_id = @of_id and OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_id_chk

    insert into of_checklist (OFCH_DESCR, OFCH_VISTO, OFCH_RESOLVIDO, OFCH_OF_ID, OFCH_SEQUENCIA,OFCH_FP_ID,OFCH_FP_ID_CHK, ofch_culpa_chefe, ofch_offp_id, ofch_molde_reparar)
	(select pli_descr, 0, 0, @of_id, pli_sequencia, pli_fp_id, pli_fp_id_chk, pli_culpa_chefe, @offp_id, pli_molde_reparar
		from 
			produto_lista 
			inner join produto_lista_items on pl_id = pli_pl_id
		where pli_pl_id = @lista and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = @fp_id_chk)
END
```

```sql
--@OF_COLINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_COLFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_COLCOLADOR INT,
--@OF_COLASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_COLPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_COLOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_DESINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_DESFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_DESDESMOLDADOR INT,
--@OF_DESASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_DESPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_DESOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_PQDESINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_PQDESFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR INT,
--@OF_PQDESASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_ACABINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_ACABFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_ACABPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_ACABOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_ACABACABADOR INT,
--@OF_ACABASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_ACABPESO FLOAT,
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_SUPERVISAO bit,
@OF_DATAINICIO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit,
@OF_TURN_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_TR_ID INT = NULL,
--------USER----------
@OF_CRIADOR NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR INT = 20598,
@OF_P_ID_GOLA INT = 20598,

--@OFFP_PINTURATEMP FLOAT = 0,
--@OFFP_PINTURAHUMID FLOAT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO BIT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS BIT = 0,
@of_transp bit = 0,
@of_paraalterar bit = 0,
@of_id_copy int = 0

AS
BEGIN TRANSACTION
set nocount on;

	declare @of_id int, @intervalo_inicio int, @intervalo_fim int

	select @intervalo_inicio = intervalo_inicio, @intervalo_fim = intervalo_fim 
		from intervalo inner join produto_tipo on intervalo_tp_id = tp_id
			 inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id
		where p_id = @OF_P_ID

	set @of_id = coalesce(((select max(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_id between @intervalo_inicio and @intervalo_fim) + 1),@intervalo_inicio)

	declare @of_coeficiente float
	set @of_coeficiente=(select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID)

	declare @supervisaoPintura bit
	if (@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = 20598 OR @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_QUINAS = 20598 OR  @OF_P_ID_CCASCO = 20598) set @supervisaoPintura = 1
	else set @supervisaoPintura = 0

	insert into ordemfabrico
		(OF_ID, OF_DATA, OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, OF_OBSERVACOES, OF_PRECOCUSTO, 
		OF_PRECOVENDA, OF_MORADAENTREGA, OF_REFERENCIA, OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, OF_AUTOCOLANTE, 
		OF_DESCONTO, OF_VALORPAGO, OF_COEFICIENTE, OF_PAGO, OF_SUPERVISAO,OF_OFTU_ID, OF_ENC_ID, 
		OF_P_ID, OF_E_ID, OF_E_ID_ENC, OF_FP_ID, OF_OF_ID_MLD, OF_P_ID_CDECK, OF_P_ID_CCASCO, 
		OF_DATAINICIO, OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, OF_TURN_ID, OF_TELEFONE, OF_EMAIL, OF_CRIADOR,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, OF_P_ID_QUINAS, OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, OF_P_ID_GOLA, OF_TRANSP, OF_SUPERVISAOPINTURA, OF_P_ID_HIST, of_paraalterar)
	values
		(@OF_ID, @OF_DATA, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, @OF_OBSERVACOES, @OF_PRECOCUSTO,
		@OF_PRECOVENDA, @OF_MORADAENTREGA, @OF_REFERENCIA, @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES,
		@OF_DESCONTO, @OF_VALORPAGO, @OF_COEFICIENTE, @OF_PAGO, @OF_SUPERVISAO, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_ENC_ID,
		@OF_P_ID, @OF_E_ID, @OF_E_ID_ENC, @OF_EOF_ID, @OF_OF_ID_MLD, @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @OF_P_ID_CCASCO, 
		@OF_DATAINICIO, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, @OF_TURN_ID, @OF_TELEFONE, @OF_EMAIL, @OF_CRIADOR,
		@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, @OF_P_ID_GOLA, @of_transp, @supervisaoPintura, convert(nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID) + '(' + @OF_CRIADOR + '); ', @of_paraalterar)


	select id = @OF_ID


/*Cria Registos das Fases de Producao*/
	--insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) (select @OF_ID, fp_id from fases_producao where fp_id in (11,18,1,2,3,4,5,6,22,7,8,9,10,12))
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) (select @OF_ID, prodf_fp_id, prodf_sequencia from produto_fase where prodf_p_id = @of_p_id)

/*Cria registo do tipo de Uso*/
	if (@OF_OFTU_ID is not null)
	begin
		declare @OF_DATATRANSPORTE smalldatetime
		set @OF_DATATRANSPORTE = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

		insert into of_of_tipouso (ofoftu_of_id, ofoftu_oftu_id, ofoftu_dataentrada) values (@OF_ID, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_DATATRANSPORTE)
	end

/*Adiciona Acessorios, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_BANCO, @QTD_BANCO, @OF_ID, 10

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPES, @QTD_FINCAPES, @OF_ID, 11

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPESTRAS, @QTD_FINCAPESTRAS, @OF_ID, 62

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_LEME, @QTD_LEME, @OF_ID, 14

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_STRAP, @QTD_STRAP, @OF_ID, 12

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_CAPA, 1, @OF_ID, 74

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_EMBALAGEM, 1, @OF_ID, 81

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84
	
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_MATTPINTURA, @QTD_MATTPINTURA, @OF_ID, 134

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_PN, @QTD_PN, @OF_ID, 65

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_TAMPA5, @QTD_TAMPA5, @OF_ID, 135



declare @qtd_deck float, @qtd_casco float, @topo_fr float, @topo_tr float, @lateral_fr float, @lateral_tr float, @quinas float
select @qtd_deck = coalesce(p_qtddeck,0), @qtd_casco = coalesce(p_qtdcasco,0), 
	@topo_fr = p_perc_topo_fr, @topo_tr = p_perc_topo_tr, @lateral_fr = p_perc_lateral_fr, @lateral_tr = p_perc_lateral_tr, @quinas = p_perc_quinas
from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID

if (@OF_P_ID_CDECK = @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
begin
	set @qtd_deck = @qtd_deck + @qtd_casco
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null
end
else if (@OF_P_ID_CDECK <> @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
begin
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CCASCO, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, null
end

	set @topo_fr = @qtd_deck * @topo_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @topo_fr, @OF_ID, null, 'Topo_fr'

	set @topo_tr = @qtd_deck * @topo_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @topo_tr, @OF_ID, null, 'Topo_tr'

	set @lateral_fr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @lateral_fr, @OF_ID, null, 'Lateral_fr'

	set @lateral_tr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @lateral_tr, @OF_ID, null, 'Lateral_tr'

	set @quinas = @qtd_deck * @quinas
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @quinas, @OF_ID, null, 'Quinas'

--/*Adiciona os Standards, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID, null

--/*Adiciona os Produtos Acossiados à construção e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	--exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID_CONST, 84

/*Actualiza fases de Producao*/
declare @d as smalldatetime
set @d = getdate()
	if @OF_EOF_ID = 32
	begin
		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 32, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, ''

		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, NULL, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, ''
	end
	else exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, ''

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 18, @OF_PINTURAINICIO, @OF_PINTURAFIM, 0, @OF_PINTURAPROBLEMAS, @OF_PINTURAPINTOR, @OF_PINTURAASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PINTURAOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 1, @OF_LAMINICIO, @OF_LAMFIM, 0, @OF_LAMPROBLEMAS, @OF_LAMLAMINADOR, @OF_LAMASSISTENTE, null, @OF_LAMOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 2, @OF_ESTINICIO, @OF_ESTFIM, 0, @OF_ESTPROBLEMAS, null, null, null, @OF_ESTOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 5, @OF_COLINICIO, @OF_COLFIM, 0, @OF_COLPROBLEMAS, @OF_COLCOLADOR, @OF_COLASSISTENTE, null, @OF_COLOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 6, @OF_DESINICIO, @OF_DESFIM, @OF_LAMPESO, @OF_DESPROBLEMAS, @OF_DESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_DESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_DESOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 22, @OF_PQDESINICIO, @OF_PQDESFIM, 0, @OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS, @OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_PQDESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 8, @OF_ACABINICIO, @OF_ACABFIM, @OF_ACABPESO, @OF_ACABPROBLEMAS, @OF_ACABACABADOR, @OF_ACABASSISTENTE, null, @OF_ACABOBSERVACOES


	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	
	if @of_id_copy > 0
	begin
		declare @tb table (atch_nome nvarchar(max), atch_of_id int, atch_image nvarchar(max))

		insert into @tb (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) select atch_nome, atch_of_id, Replace(atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy), convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID)) from of_attach where atch_of_id = @of_id_copy
		
		declare @files int = (select count(*) from @tb)
		declare @atch_nome nvarchar(max), @atch_image nvarchar(max), @comando varchar(1000)

		while @files > 0
		begin
			select top 1 @atch_nome = atch_nome, @atch_image = atch_image from @tb

			insert into of_attach (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) values (@atch_nome, @OF_ID, @atch_image)

			set @comando = 'copy /y ' + Replace(@atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID), convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy)) + ' ' + @atch_image

			exec master..xp_cmdshell @comando

			delete top (1) from @tb

			set @comando = ''
			set @files = @files - 1
		end
	end

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Add_V2`(@OF_EOF_ID int, @OF_DATA datetime, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO datetime, @OF_E_ID int, @OF_E_ID_ENC int, @OF_P_ID int, @OF_P_ID_CONST int, @OF_OF_ID_MLD int, @OF_OBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_MORADAENTREGA nvarchar(max), @OF_REFERENCIA nvarchar(max), @OF_TELEFONE nvarchar(max), @OF_EMAIL nvarchar(max), @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC nvarchar(max), @OF_ENC_ID int, @OF_PRECOCUSTO float, @OF_PRECOVENDA float, @OF_DESCONTO float, @OF_VALORPAGO float, @OF_PAGO bit, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES nvarchar(max), @OF_EMBALAGEM int, @OF_OFTU_ID int, @OF_SUPERVISAO bit, @OF_DATAINICIO smalldatetime, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit, @OF_TURN_ID int, @OF_TR_ID int, @OF_CRIADOR nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR int, @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR int, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR int, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR int, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS int, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR int, @OF_P_ID_GOLA int, @OF_ACABCONTROLO bit, @OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS bit, @of_transp bit, @of_paraalterar bit, @of_id_copy int, @of_nome nvarchar(max), @of_of_id_mae int, @of_dataentrega smalldatetime, @id int OUTPUT)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-01-28 13:41* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Add_V2]

@OF_EOF_ID INT,
@OF_DATA DATETIME,
@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO DATETIME,
@OF_E_ID INT,
@OF_E_ID_ENC INT,
@OF_P_ID INT,
@OF_P_ID_CONST INT,
--@OF_P_ID_CDECK INT,
--@OF_P_ID_CCASCO INT,
@OF_OF_ID_MLD INT,
@OF_OBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_MORADAENTREGA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_REFERENCIA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TELEFONE NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_EMAIL NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ENC_ID INT,
@OF_PRECOCUSTO FLOAT,
@OF_PRECOVENDA FLOAT,
@OF_DESCONTO FLOAT,
@OF_VALORPAGO FLOAT,
@OF_PAGO BIT,
----------------------------------------------------------------------------@OF_CL_ID_ENC INT,
@OF_AUTOCOLANTES NVARCHAR(MAX),
/****************************************************/
@OF_EMBALAGEM INT,
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_SUPERVISAO bit,
@OF_DATAINICIO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit,
@OF_TURN_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_TR_ID INT = NULL,
--------USER----------
@OF_CRIADOR NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR INT = 20598,
@OF_P_ID_GOLA INT = 20598,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO BIT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS BIT = 0,
@of_transp bit = 0,
@of_paraalterar bit = 0,
@of_id_copy int = 0,
@of_nome NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@of_of_id_mae int = null,
@of_dataentrega smalldatetime = null,
@id int = null output

AS
BEGIN TRANSACTION
set nocount on;

	declare @of_id int, @intervalo_inicio int, @intervalo_fim int

	select @intervalo_inicio = intervalo_inicio, @intervalo_fim = intervalo_fim 
		from intervalo inner join produto_tipo on intervalo_tp_id = tp_id
			 inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id
		where p_id = @OF_P_ID

	if @intervalo_inicio is not null
		set @of_id = coalesce(((select max(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_id between @intervalo_inicio and @intervalo_fim) + 1),@intervalo_inicio)
	else
		set @of_id = isnull((select max(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_id between 10000000 and 19999999)+1, 10000000)

	declare @of_coeficiente float
	set @of_coeficiente=(select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID)

	declare @supervisaoPintura bit = 0

	set @OF_EOF_ID = (select 
						top 1 prodf_fp_id 
					from 
						produto_fase 
					where 
						prodf_p_id = @of_p_id
						and prodf_data_eliminado is null 
						and prodf_prodf_id is null
					order by prodf_sequencia)

	--select @of_id = 137411

	insert into ordemfabrico
		(OF_ID, OF_DATA, OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, OF_OBSERVACOES, OF_PRECOCUSTO, 
		OF_PRECOVENDA, OF_MORADAENTREGA, OF_REFERENCIA, OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, OF_AUTOCOLANTE, 
		OF_DESCONTO, OF_VALORPAGO, OF_COEFICIENTE, OF_PAGO, OF_SUPERVISAO,OF_OFTU_ID, OF_ENC_ID, 
		OF_P_ID, OF_E_ID, OF_E_ID_ENC, OF_FP_ID, OF_OF_ID_MLD, 
		OF_DATAINICIO, OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, OF_TURN_ID, OF_TELEFONE, OF_EMAIL, OF_CRIADOR,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, OF_P_ID_QUINAS, OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, OF_P_ID_GOLA, OF_TRANSP, OF_SUPERVISAOPINTURA, OF_P_ID_HIST, of_paraalterar, of_nome, of_versao_nova, of_of_id_mae, of_dataentrega)
	values
		(@OF_ID, @OF_DATA, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, @OF_OBSERVACOES, @OF_PRECOCUSTO,
		@OF_PRECOVENDA, @OF_MORADAENTREGA, @OF_REFERENCIA, @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES,
		@OF_DESCONTO, @OF_VALORPAGO, @OF_COEFICIENTE, @OF_PAGO, @OF_SUPERVISAO, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_ENC_ID,
		@OF_P_ID, @OF_E_ID, @OF_E_ID_ENC, @OF_EOF_ID, @OF_OF_ID_MLD, 
		@OF_DATAINICIO, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, @OF_TURN_ID, @OF_TELEFONE, @OF_EMAIL, @OF_CRIADOR,
		@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, @OF_P_ID_GOLA, @of_transp, 
		@supervisaoPintura, convert(nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID) + '(' + @OF_CRIADOR + '); ', @of_paraalterar, @of_nome, 1, @of_of_id_mae, @of_dataentrega)


	select id = @OF_ID
	set @id = @of_id

/*Cria Registos das Fases de Producao*/
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, OFFP_COEFICIENTE, offp_tpcam_id, offp_planeamento, offp_coeficiente_x) 
	(select @OF_ID, prodf_fp_id, prodf_sequencia, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_tpcam_id, fp_planeamento, PRODF_COEFICIENTE_X 
	from produto_fase inner join fases_producao on prodf_fp_id = fp_id where prodf_p_id = @of_p_id and prodf_data_eliminado is null and prodf_prodf_id is null)
	--exec OrdemFabrico_AddFases_Inicio @of_p_id, @of_id

/*Cria registo do tipo de Uso*/
	if (@OF_OFTU_ID is not null)
	begin
		declare @OF_DATATRANSPORTE smalldatetime
		set @OF_DATATRANSPORTE = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

		insert into of_of_tipouso (ofoftu_of_id, ofoftu_oftu_id, ofoftu_dataentrada) values (@OF_ID, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_DATATRANSPORTE)
	end

/*Adiciona Acessorios, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_EMBALAGEM, 1, @OF_ID, 81

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84

--/*Adiciona os Standards, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards_completo @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID, null


/*Actualiza fases de Producao*/
declare @d as smalldatetime
set @d = getdate()

	if @OF_EOF_ID = 32
	begin
		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 32, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL

		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, NULL, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL
	end
	else exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL


	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	
	if @of_id_copy > 0
	begin
		declare @tb table (atch_nome nvarchar(max), atch_of_id int, atch_image nvarchar(max))

		insert into @tb (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) select atch_nome, atch_of_id, Replace(atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy), convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID)) from of_attach where atch_of_id = @of_id_copy
		
		declare @files int = (select count(*) from @tb)
		declare @atch_nome nvarchar(max), @atch_image nvarchar(max), @comando varchar(1000)

		while @files > 0
		begin
			select top 1 @atch_nome = atch_nome, @atch_image = atch_image from @tb

			insert into of_attach (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) values (@atch_nome, @OF_ID, @atch_image)

			set @comando = 'copy /y "' + Replace(@atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID), convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy)) + '" "' + @atch_image + '"'

			exec master..xp_cmdshell @comando

			delete top (1) from @tb

			set @comando = ''
			set @files = @files - 1
		end
	end

	exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaOFs_Associados @of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, @OF_DATA, @OF_E_ID_ENC

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION

return @OF_ID
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Add_V2_Com_OF_ID`(@of_id int, @OF_EOF_ID int, @OF_DATA datetime, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO datetime, @OF_E_ID int, @OF_E_ID_ENC int, @OF_P_ID int, @OF_P_ID_CONST int, @OF_OF_ID_MLD int, @OF_OBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_MORADAENTREGA nvarchar(max), @OF_REFERENCIA nvarchar(max), @OF_TELEFONE nvarchar(max), @OF_EMAIL nvarchar(max), @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC nvarchar(max), @OF_ENC_ID int, @OF_PRECOCUSTO float, @OF_PRECOVENDA float, @OF_DESCONTO float, @OF_VALORPAGO float, @OF_PAGO bit, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES nvarchar(max), @OF_EMBALAGEM int, @OF_OFTU_ID int, @OF_SUPERVISAO bit, @OF_DATAINICIO smalldatetime, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit, @OF_TURN_ID int, @OF_TR_ID int, @OF_CRIADOR nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR int, @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR int, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR int, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR int, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS int, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR int, @OF_P_ID_GOLA int, @OF_ACABCONTROLO bit, @OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS bit, @of_transp bit, @of_paraalterar bit, @of_id_copy int, @of_nome nvarchar(max), @of_of_id_mae int, @of_dataentrega smalldatetime, @id int OUTPUT)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-09-08 11:24 · modificado 2022-09-08 11:24* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Add_V2_Com_OF_ID]

@of_id int,
@OF_EOF_ID INT,
@OF_DATA DATETIME,
@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO DATETIME,
@OF_E_ID INT,
@OF_E_ID_ENC INT,
@OF_P_ID INT,
@OF_P_ID_CONST INT,
--@OF_P_ID_CDECK INT,
--@OF_P_ID_CCASCO INT,
@OF_OF_ID_MLD INT,
@OF_OBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_MORADAENTREGA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_REFERENCIA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TELEFONE NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_EMAIL NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ENC_ID INT,
@OF_PRECOCUSTO FLOAT,
@OF_PRECOVENDA FLOAT,
@OF_DESCONTO FLOAT,
@OF_VALORPAGO FLOAT,
@OF_PAGO BIT,
----------------------------------------------------------------------------@OF_CL_ID_ENC INT,
@OF_AUTOCOLANTES NVARCHAR(MAX),
/****************************************************/
@OF_EMBALAGEM INT,
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_SUPERVISAO bit,
@OF_DATAINICIO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit,
@OF_TURN_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_TR_ID INT = NULL,
--------USER----------
@OF_CRIADOR NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR INT = 20598,
@OF_P_ID_GOLA INT = 20598,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO BIT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS BIT = 0,
@of_transp bit = 0,
@of_paraalterar bit = 0,
@of_id_copy int = 0,
@of_nome NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@of_of_id_mae int = null,
@of_dataentrega smalldatetime = null,
@id int = null output

AS
BEGIN TRANSACTION
set nocount on;

	declare @of_coeficiente float
	set @of_coeficiente=(select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID)

	declare @supervisaoPintura bit = 0

	set @OF_EOF_ID = (select 
						top 1 prodf_fp_id 
					from 
						produto_fase 
					where 
						prodf_p_id = @of_p_id
						and prodf_data_eliminado is null 
						and prodf_prodf_id is null
					order by prodf_sequencia)

	insert into ordemfabrico
		(OF_ID, OF_DATA, OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, OF_OBSERVACOES, OF_PRECOCUSTO, 
		OF_PRECOVENDA, OF_MORADAENTREGA, OF_REFERENCIA, OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, OF_AUTOCOLANTE, 
		OF_DESCONTO, OF_VALORPAGO, OF_COEFICIENTE, OF_PAGO, OF_SUPERVISAO,OF_OFTU_ID, OF_ENC_ID, 
		OF_P_ID, OF_E_ID, OF_E_ID_ENC, OF_FP_ID, OF_OF_ID_MLD, 
		OF_DATAINICIO, OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, OF_TURN_ID, OF_TELEFONE, OF_EMAIL, OF_CRIADOR,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, OF_P_ID_QUINAS, OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, OF_P_ID_GOLA, OF_TRANSP, OF_SUPERVISAOPINTURA, OF_P_ID_HIST, of_paraalterar, of_nome, of_versao_nova, of_of_id_mae, of_dataentrega)
	values
		(@OF_ID, @OF_DATA, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, @OF_OBSERVACOES, @OF_PRECOCUSTO,
		@OF_PRECOVENDA, @OF_MORADAENTREGA, @OF_REFERENCIA, @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES,
		@OF_DESCONTO, @OF_VALORPAGO, @OF_COEFICIENTE, @OF_PAGO, @OF_SUPERVISAO, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_ENC_ID,
		@OF_P_ID, @OF_E_ID, @OF_E_ID_ENC, @OF_EOF_ID, @OF_OF_ID_MLD, 
		@OF_DATAINICIO, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM, @OF_TURN_ID, @OF_TELEFONE, @OF_EMAIL, @OF_CRIADOR,
		@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR, @OF_P_ID_GOLA, @of_transp, 
		@supervisaoPintura, convert(nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID) + '(' + @OF_CRIADOR + '); ', @of_paraalterar, @of_nome, 1, @of_of_id_mae, @of_dataentrega)


	select id = @OF_ID
	set @id = @of_id

/*Cria Registos das Fases de Producao*/
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, OFFP_COEFICIENTE, offp_tpcam_id, offp_planeamento, offp_coeficiente_x) 
	(select @OF_ID, prodf_fp_id, prodf_sequencia, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_tpcam_id, fp_planeamento, PRODF_COEFICIENTE_X 
	from produto_fase inner join fases_producao on prodf_fp_id = fp_id where prodf_p_id = @of_p_id and prodf_data_eliminado is null and prodf_prodf_id is null)
	--exec OrdemFabrico_AddFases_Inicio @of_p_id, @of_id

/*Cria registo do tipo de Uso*/
	if (@OF_OFTU_ID is not null)
	begin
		declare @OF_DATATRANSPORTE smalldatetime
		set @OF_DATATRANSPORTE = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

		insert into of_of_tipouso (ofoftu_of_id, ofoftu_oftu_id, ofoftu_dataentrada) values (@OF_ID, @OF_OFTU_ID, @OF_DATATRANSPORTE)
	end

/*Adiciona Acessorios, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_EMBALAGEM, 1, @OF_ID, 81

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84

--/*Adiciona os Standards, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards_completo @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID, null


/*Actualiza fases de Producao*/
declare @d as smalldatetime
set @d = getdate()

	if @OF_EOF_ID = 32
	begin
		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 32, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL

		exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, NULL, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL
	end
	else exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL, NULL


	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	
	if @of_id_copy > 0
	begin
		declare @tb table (atch_nome nvarchar(max), atch_of_id int, atch_image nvarchar(max))

		insert into @tb (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) select atch_nome, atch_of_id, Replace(atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy), convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID)) from of_attach where atch_of_id = @of_id_copy
		
		declare @files int = (select count(*) from @tb)
		declare @atch_nome nvarchar(max), @atch_image nvarchar(max), @comando varchar(1000)

		while @files > 0
		begin
			select top 1 @atch_nome = atch_nome, @atch_image = atch_image from @tb

			insert into of_attach (atch_nome, atch_of_id, atch_image) values (@atch_nome, @OF_ID, @atch_image)

			set @comando = 'copy /y "' + Replace(@atch_image, convert(nvarchar(max),@OF_ID), convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id_copy)) + '" "' + @atch_image + '"'

			exec master..xp_cmdshell @comando

			delete top (1) from @tb

			set @comando = ''
			set @files = @files - 1
		end
	end

	exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaOFs_Associados @of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, @OF_DATA, @OF_E_ID_ENC

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Add_Web`(@of_e_id_enc int, @of_p_id int, @of_referencia nvarchar(max), @of_observacoes nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-06-23 11:42 · modificado 2024-09-27 14:56* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`, `preco`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Add_Web] 

	@of_e_id_enc int, 
	@of_p_id int, 
	@of_referencia nvarchar(max) = '', 
	@of_observacoes nvarchar(max) = ''

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @of_id int, @intervalo_inicio int, @intervalo_fim int, @of_fp_id int, @of_p_id_const int
```
