```sql
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
		left join offp_eq as ch on offp_id = ch.offpeq_offp_id and ch.offpeq_chefe = 1
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		left join dbo.produto_tipos_de_camada() on offp_tpcam_id = id 
	where 
		offp_of_id = @of_id
	order by 
		offp_ordem

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Lista_Moldes`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2026-03-18 11:29 · modificado 2026-03-18 11:29* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `v_of`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Lista_Moldes]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		of_id, 
		(case when of_fp_id = 13 then '(PR) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 14 and offpgrav_id is not null then '(PARADO!!!) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 14 then '(R) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 15 then of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 16 then '(PA) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 17 then '(A) ' + of_nome end) as of_nome, 
		p_np_id, 
		p_m_id, 
		p_tam_id ,
		isnull(of_peso_deck,0) as of_peso_deck,
		isnull(of_peso_casco,0) as of_peso_casco
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_id, offpgrav_id  from of_fp left join offp_gravidades on offp_id = fpgrav_offp_id left join offp_gravidade on fpgrav_offpgrav_id = offpgrav_id where of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id and offpgrav_parar = 1 and offp_datafim is null) x
	where 
		p_tp_id = 82 and of_fp_id in (13,14,15,16,17)
	union
	select null as of_id, ' ' as of_nome, null as p_np_id, null as p_m_id, null as p_tam_id, 0, 0 order by of_id
	
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Lista_Reparados_em`(@arm_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Lista_Reparados_em]

@arm_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select of_id as [OF], p.p_nome as Modelo, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as Deck, p2.p_nome as Casco, 
		e.e_nome as Cliente, 
		of_referencia as Ref, offp_datafim as [Data Rep], offp_problemas as Problema, offp_observacoes as [Observações], e1.e_nome as Reparador
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		--inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id
		--inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id 
		inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
	where offp_arm_id = @arm_id and offp_fp_id = 14 and offp_datafim is not null
	order by Cliente, Modelo, of_id

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Lista_Transportes`(@of_id int)

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Lista_Transportes]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select tr_id as Id, tr_data as Data, tr_descricao as [Descrição], paises_nome as [País]
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_ListaAcessorios_Extra] 
	
	@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		mov_id, tp_nome, p_nome, mov_quantidade, mov_precovenda, mov_observacoes, p_id, tp_id,
		cast((case when isnull(mov_tpmov_id,4) = 4 then 0 else 1 end) as bit) as mov_tpmov_id
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_ListaAcessorios_Std_Atribuidos`(@of_id int, @p_id int, @novo bit, @inclExtras bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-10-27 13:24* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `preco`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_ListaAcessorios_Std_Atribuidos]
	@of_id int = null,
	@p_id int,
	@novo bit = 0,
	@inclExtras bit = 0
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if @novo = 0 and @inclExtras = 0
	select distinct
		atrib_familia_pt, 
		atrib_id, 
		atrib_nome_pt, 
		m.mov_p_id as p_id, 
		coalesce(m.mov_precovenda,0) as ext, 
		coalesce(m.mov_quantidade,0) as comp_quantidade, m.mov_id, 
		(case when m.mov_p_id is null then null else cast(atrib_id as nvarchar(max)) + '_' + cast(m.mov_p_id as nvarchar(max)) end) as id,
		ATRIB_ORDEM, 
		atrib_familia_en, 
		atrib_nome_en,
		cast((case when isnull(m.mov_tpmov_id,4) = 4 then 0 else 1 end) as bit) as mov_tpmov_id,
		cast(m1.MOV_P_ID as nvarchar(max)) + ' - ' + ps.p_nome as substituir
	from
		(select distinct atrib_familia_pt, atrib_id, atrib_nome_pt, ATRIB_ORDEM, atrib_familia_en, atrib_nome_en, COMP_ELIMINADO
			from produto as p inner join lista on p.p_l_id = l_id inner join produto_componente as pc on l_id = pc.comp_l_id inner join produto as p1 on pc.comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id inner join atributo on comp_atrib_id = atrib_id 
			where p.p_id = @p_id) as atrs
		left join movimento m on atrs.atrib_id = m.mov_atrib_id and m.mov_of_id = @of_id
		left join movimento m1 on m.MOV_ID = m1.MOV_MOV_ID and m1.MOV_TPMOV_ID = 13
		left join produto ps on m1.mov_p_id = ps.p_id
	where atrs.COMP_ELIMINADO is null or (m.mov_of_id = @of_id and atrs.atrib_id = m.mov_atrib_id)
	order by 
		atrib_familia_pt, 
		atrib_nome_pt
else if @novo = 1
	select 
		atrib_familia_pt, 
		atrib_id, 
		atrib_nome_pt, 
		p1.p_id, 
		0 as ext, 
		comp_quantidade, 
		null, 
		(case when p1.p_id is null then null else cast(atrib_id as nvarchar(max)) + '_' + cast(p1.p_id as nvarchar(max)) end) as id, 
		atrib_familia_en, 
		atrib_nome_en,
		CAST(0 as bit) as mov_tpmov_id,
		null as substituir
	from 
		produto as p 
		inner join produto_componente as pc on p.p_id = pc.comp_p_id 
		inner join produto as p1 on pc.comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id 
		inner join atributo on comp_atrib_id = atrib_id 
	where 
		p.p_id = @p_id 
		and comp_tpcomp_id <> 3
	order by atrib_familia_pt, atrib_nome_pt
else if @novo = 0 and @inclExtras = 1
	select 
		atrib_familia_pt, 
		atrib_id, 
		atrib_nome_pt, 
		mov_p_id as p_id, 
		coalesce(mov_precovenda,0) as ext, 
		coalesce(mov_quantidade,0) as comp_quantidade, 
		mov_id,
		COALESCE(P_NOME_EN, P_NOME) as P_NOME, 
		(case when mov_p_id is null then null else cast(atrib_id as nvarchar(max)) + '_' + cast(mov_p_id as nvarchar(max)) end) as id,
		ATRIB_ORDEM, 
		atrib_familia_en, 
		atrib_nome_en,
		cast((case when isnull(mov_tpmov_id,4) = 4 then 0 else 1 end) as bit) as mov_tpmov_id
	from
		(select distinct atrib_familia_pt, atrib_id, atrib_nome_pt, ATRIB_ORDEM, atrib_familia_en, atrib_nome_en 
			from produto as p inner join lista on p.p_l_id = l_id inner join produto_componente as pc on l_id = pc.comp_l_id inner join produto as p1 on pc.comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id inner join atributo on comp_atrib_id = atrib_id 
			where p.p_id = @p_id) as atrs
		left join movimento on atrs.atrib_id = mov_atrib_id and mov_of_id = @of_id
		left join PRODUTO as p1 on MOV_P_ID = p1.P_ID
	union
	select 
		'Extras' as atrib_familia_pt, 
		null as atrib_id, 
		'Extras' as atrib_nome_pt, 
		p_id, 
		mov_precovenda as ext, 
		mov_quantidade as comp_quantidade, 
		mov_id,
		COALESCE(P_NOME_EN, P_NOME) as P_NOME, 
		cast(mov_id as nvarchar(max)) as id, 
		1 as  ATRIB_ORDEM, 
		'Extras' as atrib_familia_en, 
		'Extras' as atrib_nome_en,
		cast((case when isnull(mov_tpmov_id,4) = 4 then 0 else 1 end) as bit) as mov_tpmov_id
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
	where 
		mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_acessorio_adicional = 1 
	order by 
		atrib_familia_pt, atrib_nome_pt
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_ListaDetalhe`(@of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-11-13 13:33* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_ListaDetalhe]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @NewLineChar AS CHAR(2) = CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)

	select 
		coalesce(o.of_fp_id, -1) as of_fp_id, 
		o.of_data, 
		coalesce(o.of_e_id, -1) as of_e_id,
		coalesce(o.of_e_id_enc, -1) as of_e_id_enc,
		coalesce(o.of_enc_id,-1) as of_enc_id, 
		coalesce(p.p_tp_id, -1) as p_tp_id, 
		coalesce(o.of_p_id, -1) as of_p_id,
		of_autocolante,
		o.of_observacoes,
		o.of_referencia, 
		o.of_precovenda,
		o.of_precocusto, 
		o.of_desconto, 
		o.of_valorpago, 
		o.of_datapagamento,
		o.of_pago, 
		o.of_transportedoc, 
		o.of_transporte, 
		o.of_datatransporte, 
		coalesce(of_oftu_id, -1) as of_oftu_id, 
		o.of_supervisao,
		coalesce(laminagem.offp_of_id_mld, -1) as of_of_id_mld,
		coalesce(q.mov_p_id,0) as resina_p_id,
		coalesce(q.mov_id,0) as resina_mov_id,
		coalesce(q.mov_quantidade,0) as resina,
		of_datainicio,
		of_supervisaolaminagem, 
		laminagem.offp_turn_id as of_turn_id, 
		of_telefone, 
		of_email, 
		of_tr_id,
		(select 
				top 1 convert(nvarchar(max),tr_data,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(tr_descricao,'')
			from 
				transporte 
				left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id 
				inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id
			where 
				trof_of_id = of_id 
				and trof_enviado = 1 
			order by	
				tr_data desc) as UltTR,
		of_p_id_topo_fr, 
		of_p_id_topo_tr, 
		of_p_id_lateral_fr, 
		of_p_id_lateral_tr, 
		of_p_id_quinas, 
		of_p_id_quinas_tr, 
		of_p_id_gola, 
		of_arm_id, 
		of_arm_id_lam, 
		of_transp,
		coalesce(p100.qtd,0) as p1, 
		coalesce(p375.qtd,0) as p375, 
		coalesce(p500.qtd,0) as p500, 
		of_desconta_peso, 
		p.P_PESOLAM, 
		p.P_PESOACAB, 
		p.P_URL_IMG_PROD,
		of_parapintarfora, 
		of_revisto, 
		of_paraalterar, 
		of_nome, 
		of_acerto_resina, 
		of_linhaacab, 
		const.construcao,
		of_supervisaopintura,
		'Contacto: ' + @NewLineChar + isnull(em.EM_CONTACTO,'') + @NewLineChar + @NewLineChar + 'Morada: ' + @NewLineChar + isnull(em.EM_MORADA,'') + @NewLineChar + @NewLineChar + 'Tlf: ' + isnull(em.EM_TELEFONE,'') as moradaEnvio,
		'Contacto: ' + @NewLineChar + isnull(em1.EM_CONTACTO,'') + @NewLineChar + @NewLineChar + 'Morada: ' + @NewLineChar + isnull(em1.EM_MORADA,'') + @NewLineChar + @NewLineChar + 'Tlf: ' + isnull(em1.EM_TELEFONE,'') as moradaFact,
		dbo.of_Pedido_Estado(o.OF_ID) as pedidoMaterial, OF_PROMO_CODE, OF_FACT, p.P_PRECOVENDA,
		OF_FALTA_AUTOCOLANTE_NOME, OF_FALTA_PROTECCAO_PAGAIA, OF_FALTA_GARRAFA, OF_FALTA_PARAFUSOS, OF_FALTA_PESOS, OF_FALTA_TRACTION_PADS, OF_FALTA_FINCA_PES, OF_FALTA_BANCO, OF_FALTA_LEME, OF_FALTA_CAPA, OF_FALTA_TOALHA,
		of_ral_main, of_ral_sec, of_dureza_deck, of_dureza_casco, of_dureza_proa, of_sensor_id_vacuo
	from 
		ordemfabrico as o 
		inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id 
		left join encomenda as enc on o.of_enc_id = enc.enc_id 
		left join (select 
				m1.mov_id, m1.mov_p_id, m1.mov_quantidade, m1.mov_of_id, comp_quantidade, m1.mov_qtd_bal
			from 
				movimento as m 
				inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id 
				inner join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id 
				inner join produto as p3 on m.mov_p_id = p3.p_id 
				inner join produto_componente on p3.p_id = comp_p_id --and comp_p_p_id = p1.P_ID --in (21399,20448,27484)
				inner join produto as p2 on comp_p_p_id = p2.p_id 
			where 
				p3.p_tp_id = 84 
				and p1.P_TP_ID = 288 
				and p2.P_TP_ID = 288) as q on OF_ID = q.MOV_OF_ID
		left join (select 
							mov_of_id, 
							sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd 
						from 
							movimento 
						where 
							mov_p_id = 22676 
						group by 
							mov_of_id) as p100 on of_id = p100.mov_of_id 
		left join (select 
							mov_of_id, 
							sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd 
						from 
							movimento 
						where 
							mov_p_id = 26036 
						group by 
							mov_of_id) as p375 on of_id = p375.mov_of_id 
		left join (select 
							mov_of_id, 
							sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd 
						from 
							movimento 
						where 
							mov_p_id = 26037 
						group by 
							mov_of_id) as p500 on of_id = p500.mov_of_id
		left join (select 
							mov_of_id, 
							mov_p_id as construcao 
						from 
							movimento 
							inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
						where 
							p_tp_id = 84 
							and mov_of_id is not null) as const on o.of_id = const.mov_of_id
		left join (select	
							offp_of_id, 
							offp_of_id_mld,
							offp_turn_id							
						from	
							of_fp
						where 
							offp_fp_id = 1) as laminagem on o.of_id = laminagem.offp_of_id
		left join ENTIDADE_MORADA as em on OF_EM_ID = em.EM_ID
		left join ENTIDADE_MORADA as em1 on OF_EM_ID_FACTURACAO = em1.EM_ID
	where o.of_id = @of_id

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_ListaDetalhe_Fases`(@of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_ListaDetalhe_Fases]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT OFFP.OFFP_ID, OFFP.OFFP_OF_ID, OFFP.OFFP_FP_ID, OFFP.OFFP_PROBLEMAS, OFFP.OFFP_OBSERVACOES, OFFP.OFFP_DATAINICIO, OFFP.OFFP_DATAFIM, 
			OFFP.OFFP_PESO, coalesce(OFFPEQ.OFFPEQ_E_ID, -1) as OFFPEQ_E_ID, coalesce(OFFPEQ1.OFFPEQ_E_ID, -1) as OFFPEQ_E_ID_A, 
			OFFP_PESO_DECK_ANT, OFFP_PESO_DECK_DP, OFFP_PESO_CASCO_ANT, OFFP_PESO_CASCO_DP, OFFP_OFFPCL_ID, OFFP_CONTROLO, OFFP_TEMPERATURA, OFFP_HUMIDADE, OFFP_CONTROLO_CRIS, OFFP_HORAS_REP
	FROM OF_FP AS OFFP LEFT JOIN OFFP_EQ AS OFFPEQ ON OFFP.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID AND OFFPEQ.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
					LEFT JOIN OFFP_EQ AS OFFPEQ1 ON OFFP.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ1.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID AND OFFPEQ1.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 0 WHERE OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id
END
```

```sql
@of_id int
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Pausa`(@offp_id int, @of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-05-15 09:21 · modificado 2020-05-18 10:38* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE OrdemFabrico_Pausa 
	@offp_id int,
	@of_id int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dtInicio smalldatetime, @dtFim smalldatetime, @offpeq_e_id_chefe int, @fp_id int
	select offp_datafim from of_fp 
	
	select @offpeq_e_id_chefe = offpeq_e_id, @fp_id = offp_fp_id, @dtInicio = OFFP_DATAINICIO, @dtFim = OFFP_DATAFIM from of_fp left join OFFP_EQ on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 where OFFP_ID = @offp_id

    if @dtInicio is not null
	begin
		update o 
			set OFFP_ORDEM += 1 
		from 
			of_fp o1 
			inner join of_fp o on o1.OFFP_OF_ID = o.OFFP_OF_ID 
		where 
			o1.offp_id = @offp_id 
			and o.OFFP_ORDEM > o1.OFFP_ORDEM; 

		update of_fp set offp_datafim = isnull(offp_datafim, getdate()) where OFFP_ID = @offp_id
	
		insert into of_fp 
			(offp_fp_id, offp_of_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes, offp_peso_deck_ant, offp_peso_deck_dp, offp_peso_casco_ant, offp_peso_casco_dp, 
			offp_offpcl_id, offp_horas_rep, offp_temperatura, offp_humidade, offp_controlo, offp_controlo_cris, offp_ordem, offp_planeamento) 
			(select 
				offp_fp_id, offp_of_id, null, null, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, null, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, OFFP_ORDEM + 1, OFFP_PLANEAMENTO 
			from 
				of_fp 
			where 
				OFFP_ID = @offp_id) 
			
		declare @id int = @@identity 
	
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id_chefe, 1, @fp_id, @id
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Pendentes`(@of_id int, @leme int, @qleme int, @fpes int, @qfpes int, @fpestr int, @qfpestr int, @strap int, @qstrap int, @banco int, @qbanco int, @capa int, @qcapa int, @of_observacoes nvarchar(max), @of_transportedoc nvarchar(max), @of_transp bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Pendentes]

@of_id int,
@leme int = null,
@qleme int = 1,
@fpes int = null,
@qfpes int = 1,
@fpestr int = null,
@qfpestr int = 1,
@strap int = null,
@qstrap int = 1,
@banco int = null,
@qbanco int = 1,
@capa int = null,
@qcapa int = 1,
@of_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@of_transportedoc nvarchar(max) = '',
@of_transp bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @banco, @qbanco, @of_id, 10

	exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @fpes, @qfpes, @of_id, 11

	exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @fpestr, @qfpestr, @of_id, 62

	exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @leme, @qleme, @of_id, 14

	exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @strap, @qstrap, @of_id, 12

	exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @capa, @qcapa, @of_id, 74

	update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 32
	update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 11

	update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 11, of_observacoes = @of_observacoes, of_transportedoc = @of_transportedoc, of_transp = @of_transp where of_id = @of_id

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_PintarFora`(@of_id int, @pintarFora bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_PintarFora]

	@of_id int,
	@pintarFora bit

AS
BEGIN
	--SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @offp_ordemPolimento int
			
	if @pintarFora = 1
	begin
		if not exists(select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 35 and offp_datainicio is null) -- Acabamento 3
		begin
			--select @offp_ordemPolimento = max(offp_ordem) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 42 group by offp_of_id
			
			--if @offp_ordemPolimento is null
			--begin
			--	select @offp_ordemPolimento = max(offp_ordem) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 8 group by offp_of_id

			--	update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @offp_ordemPolimento

			--	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, offp_return) values (@of_id, 42, @offp_ordemPolimento, 0)
			--end

			--update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 2 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @offp_ordemPolimento

			--insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, offp_return) values (@of_id, 35, @offp_ordemPolimento, 0)
			--insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, offp_return) values (@of_id, 40, @offp_ordemPolimento+1, 1)

			--update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id) where of_id = @of_id
			exec OrdemFabrico_LinhaAcabamento @of_id, 3
		end
	end
	else if @pintarFora = 0
	begin
		if exists(select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 35 and offp_datainicio is null)
		begin
			select @offp_ordemPolimento = max(offp_ordem) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 42 group by offp_of_id

			delete from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 40 and offp_ordem = @offp_ordemPolimento - 1
			delete from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 35 and offp_ordem = @offp_ordemPolimento - 2

			update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem - 2 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @offp_ordemPolimento

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id) where of_id = @of_id
		end
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Add`(@offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offpeq_e_id int, @offp_of_id int, @offp_arm_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-01-28 13:39* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `reparac`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Add]

@offp_problemas nvarchar(max),
@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null,
@offpeq_e_id int = null,
@offp_of_id int,
@offp_arm_id int = 1

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() 
		from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id 
		where of_id = @offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null
	
	declare @pos int
	select @pos = max(offp_ordem) + 1 from of_fp where offp_of_id = @offp_of_id

	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes,offp_arm_id, offp_ordem) 
			   values (@offp_of_id, 14, @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_problemas, @offp_observacoes,@offp_arm_id, @pos)
	
	declare @offp_id int
	set @offp_id = @@identity

	select @pos += 1
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes,offp_arm_id, offp_ordem) 
			   values (@offp_of_id, 9, @offp_datafim, null, '', '',@offp_arm_id, @pos)

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @offp_of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 1, 14, @offp_id

	update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@offp_of_id) where of_id = @offp_of_id

	--if (@offp_datafim is null)
	--	update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 14 where of_id = @offp_of_id
	--else if (@offp_datafim is not null and @offp_arm_id <> 1)
	--begin
	--	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@offp_of_id, 12, getdate())

	--	update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 12, of_numutil = 0 where of_id = @offp_of_id
	--end

	select id = @offp_id

END


--************************************************************************************
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Add_v2`(@of_id int, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offp_peso float, @Rep bit, @RepV bit, @Pecas bit, @dataPrevistaEntrega smalldatetime, @email nvarchar(max), @offpValor float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2024-01-19 14:06 · modificado 2024-02-07 15:04* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`, `reparac`, `peso`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Add_v2] 

	@of_id int, 
	@offp_problemas nvarchar(max) = '',
	@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null, 
	@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null, 
	@offp_peso float = 0, 
	@Rep bit, 
	@RepV bit, 
	@Pecas bit, 
	@dataPrevistaEntrega smalldatetime = null,
	@email nvarchar(max) = '',
	@offpValor float = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @ord int, @coef float, @nord int

	set @nord = case when @Rep = 1 then 1 else 0 end + case when @RepV = 1 then 1 else 0 end + case when @Pecas = 1 then 1 else 0 end

	select 
		@ord = min(offp_ordem), @coef = 1
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		left join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_datafim is null
	where 
		of_id = @of_id 
	group by 
		of_coeficiente

	update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + @nord where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @ord

	update of_fp set OFFP_DATAFIM = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and OFFP_DATAINICIO is not null and OFFP_DATAFIM is null

	declare @IdRep int

	if (@Rep = 1)
	begin
		insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_observacoes, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_ordem, offp_coeficiente, offp_tpcam_id, OFFP_PLANEAMENTO, OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA, offp_email, offp_valor_fact)
				(select @of_id, 77, @offp_problemas, @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_peso, isnull(@ord,0), @coef, null, FP_PLANEAMENTO, @dataPrevistaEntrega, @email, isnull(@offpValor,0) from FASES_PRODUCAO where FP_ID = 77)

		set @IdRep = @@IDENTITY

	end
	else if (@RepV = 1)
	begin
		insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_observacoes, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_ordem, offp_coeficiente, offp_tpcam_id, OFFP_PLANEAMENTO, OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA, offp_email, offp_valor_fact)
				(select @of_id, 76, @offp_problemas, @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_peso, isnull(@ord,0), @coef, null, FP_PLANEAMENTO, @dataPrevistaEntrega, @email, isnull(@offpValor,0) from FASES_PRODUCAO where FP_ID = 76)

		set @IdRep = @@IDENTITY
	end
						
	if (@Pecas = 1)
		insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_observacoes, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_ordem, offp_coeficiente, offp_tpcam_id, OFFP_PLANEAMENTO, OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN, OFFP_RETURN)
				(select @of_id, 53, '', @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_peso, isnull(@ord + 1,0), @coef, null, FP_PLANEAMENTO, @IdRep, 1 from FASES_PRODUCAO where FP_ID = 53)

	update ORDEMFABRICO set OF_FP_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id) where of_id = @of_id

	select id = @IdRep
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Del`(@offp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `reparac`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Del]

@offp_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @offp_of_id int, @offp_datafim smalldatetime
	select @offp_of_id = offp_of_id, @offp_datafim = offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @offp_of_id, null, 1, 14, @offp_id

    delete of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id

	if (@offp_datafim is null)
	begin
		if (select p_tp_id from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @offp_of_id) in (82,83)
		begin
			set @offp_id = (select max(offp_id) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 15)

			update of_fp set offp_datafim = null where offp_id = @offp_id

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 15 where of_id = @offp_of_id
		end
		else
		begin
			set @offp_id = (select max(offp_id) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 9)

			update of_fp set offp_datafim = null where offp_id = @offp_id

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 9 where of_id = @offp_of_id
		end
	end
END

select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = 14225 order by offp_id
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Update_v2`(@of_id int, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offp_peso float, @Rep bit, @RepV bit, @Pecas bit, @dataPrevistaEntrega smalldatetime, @email nvarchar(max), @repId int, @offpValor float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2024-01-22 15:04 · modificado 2024-02-06 13:43* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`, `reparac`, `peso`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Reparacao_Update_v2] 

	@of_id int, 
	@offp_problemas nvarchar(max) = '',
	@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null, 
	@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null, 
	@offp_peso float = 0, 
	@Rep bit, 
	@RepV bit, 
	@Pecas bit, 
	@dataPrevistaEntrega smalldatetime = null,
	@email nvarchar(max) = '',
	@repId int,
	@offpValor float = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	update OF_FP set OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id, OFFP_OBSERVACOES = @offp_problemas, OFFP_DATAINICIO = @offp_datainicio, OFFP_DATAFIM = @offp_datafim, OFFP_FP_ID = case when @Rep = 1 then 77 else 76 end, OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA = @dataPrevistaEntrega, offp_email = @email, offp_valor_fact = isnull(@offpValor,0) where OFFP_ID = @repId

	declare @idColagem int
	select @idColagem = offp_id from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 53 and OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = @repId

	if (@Pecas = 0 and @idColagem is not null)
	begin
		exec Ordemfabrico_Del_Fase @idColagem
	end
	else if (@Pecas = 1 and @idColagem is null)
	begin
		declare @ord int
		select @ord = offp_ordem from OF_FP where OFFP_ID = @repId

		update of_fp set OFFP_ORDEM += 1 where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and OFFP_ORDEM > @ord

		insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_observacoes, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_ordem, offp_coeficiente, offp_tpcam_id, OFFP_PLANEAMENTO, OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN, OFFP_RETURN)
				(select @of_id, 53, '', null, null, 0, @ord + 1, 0.5, null, FP_PLANEAMENTO, @repId, 1 from FASES_PRODUCAO where FP_ID = 53)
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_ReparacaoMoldes_Add`(@offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offpeq_e_id int, @offp_of_id int, @fp_id int, @gravs nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-12-16 13:56* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `v_of`, `reparac`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_ReparacaoMoldes_Add]

@offp_problemas nvarchar(max),
@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null,
@offpeq_e_id int = null,
@offp_of_id int,
@fp_id int,
@gravs nvarchar(max) = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @of_fp_id int
	select @of_fp_id = of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @offp_of_id

	if @of_fp_id <> @fp_id
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = isnull(offp_datainicio, getdate()), offp_datafim = getdate() 
			from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id 
			where of_id = @offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes) 
				   values (@offp_of_id, @fp_id, @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_problemas, @offp_observacoes)

		declare @offp_id int
		set @offp_id = @@identity

		if(@gravs is not null)
			insert into offp_gravidades (fpgrav_offp_id, fpgrav_offpgrav_id) (select @offp_id, Number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt] (@gravs,'_'))

		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @offp_of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 1, @fp_id, @offp_id

		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = @fp_id where of_id = @offp_of_id						
	end
	else
	begin
		declare @offp_id1 int
		select top 1 @offp_id1 = offp_id from of_fp where offp_of_id = @offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		update of_fp set OFFP_PROBLEMAS += @offp_problemas where offp_id = @offp_id1
	end
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd]

@OF_ID INT,
@OF_EOF_ID INT,
@OF_DATA DATETIME,
@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO DATETIME,
@OF_E_ID INT,
@OF_E_ID_ENC INT,
@OF_P_ID INT,
@OF_P_ID_CONST INT,
@OF_P_ID_CDECK INT,
@OF_P_ID_CCASCO INT,
@OF_OF_ID_MLD INT,
@OF_OBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_MORADAENTREGA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_REFERENCIA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TELEFONE NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_EMAIL NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ENC_ID INT,
@OF_PRECOCUSTO FLOAT,
@OF_PRECOVENDA FLOAT,
@OF_DESCONTO FLOAT,
@OF_VALORPAGO FLOAT,
@OF_PAGO BIT,
----------------------------------------------------------------------------@OF_CL_ID_ENC INT,
--ACESSORIOS--
@QTD_BANCO INT,
@QTD_FINCAPES INT,
@QTD_FINCAPESTRAS INT,
@QTD_LEME INT,
@QTD_STRAP INT,
@OF_LEME INT,
@OF_FINCAPES INT,
@OF_FINCAPESTRAS INT,
@OF_STRAP INT,
@OF_AUTOCOLANTES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_BANCO INT,
@OF_CAPA INT,
@OF_MATTPINTURA INT = NULL,
@QTD_MATTPINTURA INT = NULL,
@OF_PN INT = NULL,
@QTD_PN INT = NULL,
@OF_TAMPA5 INT = NULL,
@QTD_TAMPA5 INT = NULL,
/****************************************************/
@OF_EMBALAGEM INT,
/****************************************************/
--ACESSORIOS--
--@OF_PINTURAINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_PINTURAFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_PINTURAPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_PINTURAOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_PINTURAPINTOR INT,
--@OF_PINTURAASSISTENTE INT,
--@OFFP_PESO_DECK_ANT FLOAT = 0,
--@OFFP_PESO_DECK_DP FLOAT = 0,
--@OFFP_PESO_CASCO_ANT FLOAT = 0,
--@OFFP_PESO_CASCO_DP FLOAT = 0,
--@OF_LAMINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_LAMFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_LAMPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_LAMOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_LAMLAMINADOR INT,
--@OF_LAMASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_LAMPESO FLOAT,
--@OF_ESTINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_ESTFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_ESTPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_ESTOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_COLINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_COLFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_COLCOLADOR INT,
--@OF_COLASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_COLPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_COLOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_DESINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_DESFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_DESDESMOLDADOR INT,
--@OF_DESASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_DESPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_DESOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_PQDESINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_PQDESFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR INT,
--@OF_PQDESASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_ACABINICIO DATETIME,
--@OF_ACABFIM DATETIME,
--@OF_ACABPROBLEMAS NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_ACABOBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
--@OF_ACABACABADOR INT,
--@OF_ACABASSISTENTE INT,
--@OF_ACABPESO FLOAT,
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_SUPERVISAO bit,
@QTD_RESINA FLOAT,
@OF_DATAINICIO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit,
@OF_TURN_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_TR_ID INT = NULL,
--------USER----------
@OF_ACTUALIZADOR NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR INT,
@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS INT,
@OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR INT = 20598,
@OF_P_ID_GOLA INT = 20598,
@OF_ARM_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_ARM_ID_LAM INT = NULL,
@OFFP_OFFPCL_ID INT = NULL,

--@OFFP_PINTURATEMP FLOAT = 0,
--@OFFP_PINTURAHUMID FLOAT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO BIT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS BIT = 0,
@of_transp bit = 0,
@offp_horas_rep float = 0,

@p100 int = 0,
@p375 int = 0,
@p500 int = 0,

@of_desconta_peso bit = 0,
@of_parapintarfora bit = 0,
@of_revisto bit = 0,
@of_paraalterar bit = 0,
@of_nome NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@of_acerto_resina float = null,

@of_linhaacab int = null

AS
BEGIN TRANSACTION
set nocount on;

	declare @of_p_id_ant int,
			@of_p_id_cdeck_ant int,
			@of_p_id_ccasco_ant int,
			@of_p_id_topo_fr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_topo_tr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_quinas_ant int

	select @of_p_id_ant = of_p_id, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant = of_p_id_cdeck, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant = of_p_id_ccasco, 
			@of_p_id_topo_fr_ant = of_p_id_topo_fr, @of_p_id_topo_tr_ant = of_p_id_topo_tr, @of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant = of_p_id_lateral_fr, 
			@of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant = of_p_id_lateral_tr, @of_p_id_quinas_ant = of_p_id_quinas
	from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id

	declare @of_coeficiente float
	set @of_coeficiente=(select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID)

/*Adiciona Acessorios, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_BANCO, @QTD_BANCO, @OF_ID, 10

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPES, @QTD_FINCAPES, @OF_ID, 11

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPESTRAS, @QTD_FINCAPESTRAS, @OF_ID, 62

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_LEME, @QTD_LEME, @OF_ID, 14

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_STRAP, @QTD_STRAP, @OF_ID, 12

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_CAPA, 1, @OF_ID, 74

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_EMBALAGEM, 1, @OF_ID, 81
	
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_MATTPINTURA, @QTD_MATTPINTURA, @OF_ID, 134

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_PN, @QTD_PN, @OF_ID, 65

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_TAMPA5, @QTD_TAMPA5, @OF_ID, 135

declare @resina int, @const_ant int
select @resina = m.mov_p_id, @const_ant = m1.mov_p_id from movimento as m inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto on m1.mov_p_id = p_id where m.mov_p_id in (21399,20448,27484) and m.mov_of_id = @OF_ID and p_tp_id = 84

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84

declare @qtd_deck float, @qtd_casco float, @topo_fr float, @topo_tr float, @lateral_fr float, @lateral_tr float, @quinas float
select @qtd_deck = coalesce(p_qtddeck,0), @qtd_casco = coalesce(p_qtdcasco,0), 
	@topo_fr = p_perc_topo_fr, @topo_tr = p_perc_topo_tr, @lateral_fr = p_perc_lateral_fr, @lateral_tr = p_perc_lateral_tr, @quinas = p_perc_quinas
from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID

if (@of_p_id_cdeck_ant <> @of_p_id_cdeck or @of_p_id_ccasco_ant <> @of_p_id_ccasco)
begin
	if (((@of_p_id_cdeck_ant <> @of_p_id_ccasco_ant) or (@of_p_id_cdeck_ant = @of_p_id_ccasco_ant)) and @OF_P_ID_CDECK = @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
	begin
		exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant
		exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant

		set @qtd_deck = @qtd_deck + @qtd_casco
		exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null
	end
	else if (((@of_p_id_cdeck_ant <> @of_p_id_ccasco_ant) or (@of_p_id_cdeck_ant = @of_p_id_ccasco_ant)) and @OF_P_ID_CDECK <> @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
	begin
		exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant
		exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant

		exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null
		exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CCASCO, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, null
	end
end

if (@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR <> @of_p_id_topo_fr_ant)
begin
	set @topo_fr = @qtd_deck * @topo_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @topo_fr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_topo_fr_ant, 'Topo_fr'
end

if (@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR <> @of_p_id_topo_tr_ant)
begin
	set @topo_tr = @qtd_deck * @topo_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @topo_tr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_topo_tr_ant, 'Topo_tr'
end

if (@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR <> @of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant)
begin
	set @lateral_fr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @lateral_fr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant, 'Lateral_fr'
end
	set @lateral_tr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @lateral_tr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant, 'Lateral_tr'

if (@OF_P_ID_QUINAS <> @of_p_id_quinas_ant)
begin
	set @quinas = @qtd_deck * @quinas
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @quinas, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_quinas_ant, 'Quinas'
end

/*Adiciona os Standards, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID, @of_p_id_ant

/*Adiciona os Produtos Acossiados à construção e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	--exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84

if (@resina is not null and @OF_P_ID_CONST = @const_ant)
	exec ProdutosAssociados_Upd @resina, @QTD_RESINA, @OF_ID


/*Actualiza fases de Producao*/

declare @of_fp_id int
set @of_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	if (@of_fp_id <> @OF_EOF_ID) and (@OF_EOF_ID not in (select fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1))
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID and offp_datafim is null)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID
		else
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, getdate())
	end

	set @OF_EOF_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id)

	declare @OF_DATATRANSPORTE smalldatetime
		set @OF_DATATRANSPORTE = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

	exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte @of_id, @OF_DATATRANSPORTE

	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	if @of_linhaacab is not null
		exec dbo.OrdemFabrico_LinhaAcabamento @of_id, @of_linhaacab

	update ordemfabrico
	set
		OF_DATA=@OF_DATA, 
		OF_DATAPAGAMENTO=@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, 
		OF_OBSERVACOES=@OF_OBSERVACOES, 
		OF_PRECOCUSTO=@OF_PRECOCUSTO, 
		OF_PRECOVENDA=@OF_PRECOVENDA, 
		OF_MORADAENTREGA=@OF_MORADAENTREGA, 
		OF_REFERENCIA=@OF_REFERENCIA, 
		OF_TRANSPORTEDOC=@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, 
		OF_AUTOCOLANTE=@OF_AUTOCOLANTES, 
		OF_DESCONTO=@OF_DESCONTO, 
		OF_VALORPAGO=@OF_VALORPAGO, 
		OF_COEFICIENTE=@OF_COEFICIENTE, 
		OF_PAGO=@OF_PAGO, 
		OF_SUPERVISAO=@OF_SUPERVISAO,
		OF_OFTU_ID=@OF_OFTU_ID, 
		OF_ENC_ID=@OF_ENC_ID, 
		OF_P_ID=@OF_P_ID, 
		OF_E_ID=@OF_E_ID, 
		OF_E_ID_ENC=@OF_E_ID_ENC, 
		OF_FP_ID= @OF_EOF_ID,
		OF_OF_ID_MLD=@OF_OF_ID_MLD, 
		OF_P_ID_CDECK=@OF_P_ID_CDECK, 
		OF_P_ID_CCASCO=@OF_P_ID_CCASCO,
		OF_DATAINICIO = @OF_DATAINICIO,
		OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM = @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM,
		OF_TURN_ID = @OF_TURN_ID,
		OF_TELEFONE = @OF_TELEFONE,
		OF_EMAIL = @OF_EMAIL,
		OF_ACTUALIZADOR = @OF_ACTUALIZADOR,
		OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO = @OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR,
		OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR,
		OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR,
		OF_P_ID_QUINAS = @OF_P_ID_QUINAS,
		OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR = @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR,
		OF_P_ID_GOLA = @OF_P_ID_GOLA,
		OF_ARM_ID = @OF_ARM_ID,
		OF_ARM_ID_LAM = @OF_ARM_ID_LAM,
		of_transp = @of_transp,
		of_desconta_peso = @of_desconta_peso,
		of_p_id_hist = (case when @of_p_id_ant = @OF_P_ID then of_p_id_hist else of_p_id_hist + convert(nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID) + '(' + @OF_ACTUALIZADOR + '); ' end),
		of_parapintarfora = @of_parapintarfora,
		of_revisto = @of_revisto,
		of_paraalterar = @of_paraalterar,
		of_nome = @of_nome,
		of_acerto_resina = coalesce(@of_acerto_resina,of_acerto_resina),
		of_linhaacab = coalesce(@of_linhaacab,of_linhaacab)
		where
		of_id = @OF_ID

	select of_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID

	--Pesos 100
	declare @mov_100 int
	set @mov_100 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 22676)
	if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 > 0)
		exec produtosassociados_upd 22676, @p100, @of_id, @mov_100 -- Psos de 100g = 20423
	else if (@mov_100 is null and @p100 > 0)
		exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 22676, @p100, @of_id, 101
	else if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 = 0)
		exec produtosassociados_del 22676, @of_id, @mov_100

	--Pesos 375
	set @mov_100 = null
	set @mov_100 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 26036)
	if (@mov_100 is not null and @p375 > 0)
		exec produtosassociados_upd 26036, @p375, @of_id, @mov_100 -- Psos de 100g = 20423
	else if (@mov_100 is null and @p375 > 0)
		exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 26036, @p375, @of_id, 101
	else if (@mov_100 is not null and @p375 = 0)
		exec produtosassociados_del 26036, @of_id, @mov_100

	--Pesos 500
	set @mov_100 = null
	set @mov_100 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 26037)
	if (@mov_100 is not null and @p500 > 0)
		exec produtosassociados_upd 26037, @p500, @of_id, @mov_100 -- Psos de 100g = 20423
	else if (@mov_100 is null and @p500 > 0)
		exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 26037, @p500, @of_id, 101
	else if (@mov_100 is not null and @p500 = 0)
		exec produtosassociados_del 26037, @of_id, @mov_100


	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @OF_ID, @OF_EOF_ID


COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_DisposicaoFabrica`(@of_id int, @of_referencia nvarchar(max), @of_sequencia int, @laminador int, @colador int, @desmoldador int, @acabador int, @lixador int, @pintoracabamento int, @of_parapintarfora bit, @mov_p_id int, @of_eof_id int, @of_observacoes nvarchar(max), @of_supervisao bit, @of_supervisaolaminagem bit, @of_tr_id int, @of_arm_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_DisposicaoFabrica]

@of_id int,
@of_referencia nvarchar(max),
@of_sequencia int,
@laminador int,
@colador int = null,
@desmoldador int,
@acabador int,
@lixador int = null,
@pintoracabamento int = null,
@of_parapintarfora bit = 0,
@mov_p_id int,
@of_eof_id int,
@of_observacoes nvarchar(max),
@of_supervisao bit,
@of_supervisaolaminagem bit,
@of_tr_id int = null,
@of_arm_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@of_tr_id is not null)
	begin
		declare @of_datatransporte smalldatetime
		set @of_datatransporte = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

		exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte @of_id, @of_datatransporte
	end

	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	declare @of_fp_id int
	set @of_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	if (@OF_EOF_ID in (select fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1))
		set @OF_EOF_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@OF_ID)
	else if (@of_fp_id <> @OF_EOF_ID)
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID and offp_datainicio is null)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID
		else
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, getdate())
	end


    update 
		ordemfabrico 
	set 
		of_referencia = @of_referencia,
		of_sequencia = @of_sequencia,
		of_fp_id = @of_eof_id,
		of_observacoes = @of_observacoes,
		of_supervisao = @of_supervisao,
		of_supervisaolaminagem = @of_supervisaolaminagem,
		of_arm_id = @of_arm_id,
		of_parapintarfora = @of_parapintarfora
	where
		of_id = @of_id

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @laminador, 1, 1

	--exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @colador, 1, 4

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @desmoldador, 1, 6

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @acabador, 1, 33 -- Novo Acabamento
	
	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @lixador, 1, 22

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @pintoracabamento, 1, 5

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @mov_p_id, 1, @of_id, 81

	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @of_eof_id

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase`(@of_id int, @offpeq_e_id int, @offpeq_chefe bit, @offp_fp_id int, @offp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase] 

@of_id int,
@offpeq_e_id int,
@offpeq_chefe bit,
@offp_fp_id int,
@offp_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	    
	declare @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant int, @offpeq_e int, @pos int, @qtd_Fases int

	if (@offp_id is null)
		set @offp_id = (select top 1 offp_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id and offp_of_id = @of_id order by offp_ordem desc)--select top 1 offp_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is null order by offp_ordem

	if (@offp_id is null)
	begin
		if (@offp_fp_id = 33 and @offpeq_e_id is not null) -- Novo "Acabamento" vai para a maior posição entre a colagem e o pq acab + 1
		begin
			-- Retira fases "Pintura Acabamento" e "Lixagem"
			select @pos = min(offp_ordem), @qtd_Fases = count(offp_id) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (5,22) /*Pint. Acab,Lixagem*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			delete offp_eq from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (5,22) /*Pint. Acab,Lixagem*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			delete from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (5,22) /*Pint. Acab,Lixagem*/ and offp_datainicio is null

			if ((select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id) in (5,22))
				update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 33 where of_id = @of_id
			
			if @qtd_Fases > 1
				update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem -1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @pos

			--Insere nova fase de acabamento
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, @offp_fp_id, @pos)
			set @offp_id = @@identity
		end
		else if (@offp_fp_id in (5,22) and @offpeq_e_id is not null) -- Pint. Acab,Lixagem
		begin
			-- Retira fases "Pintura Acabamento" e "Lixagem"
			select @pos = min(offp_ordem), @qtd_Fases = count(offp_id) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 /*Novo "Acabamento"*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			delete offp_eq from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 /*Novo "Acabamento"*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			delete from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 /*Novo "Acabamento"*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			
			if ((select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id) = 33)
				update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 5 where of_id = @of_id

			if @qtd_Fases > 1
				update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 2 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @pos

			--Insere novas fases de Pint. acabamento e Lixagem
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, @offp_fp_id, (case when @offp_fp_id = 5 then @pos else @pos + 1 end))
			set @offp_id = @@identity
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, (case when @offp_fp_id = 5 then 22 else 5 end), (case when @offp_fp_id = 5 then @pos else @pos + 1 end))
		end
	end

	set @offpeq_e = (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id 
									 where offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = (case when @offpeq_chefe = 1 then 0 else 1 end))

	set @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant = (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id 
									 where offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe)

	if @offpeq_e = @offpeq_e_id
	begin
		if @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant is not null
			delete offp_eq where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe

		update offp_eq set offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id 
									 where offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = (case when @offpeq_chefe = 1 then 0 else 1 end)
	end
	else if (@offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant is null and (@offpeq_e_id is not null or @offpeq_e_id <> -1))
	begin

		insert into offp_eq (offpeq_offp_id, offpeq_e_id, offpeq_chefe) values (@offp_id, @offpeq_e_id, @offpeq_chefe)

	end
	else if ((@offpeq_e_id is null or @offpeq_e_id = -1) and @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant is not null)
	begin
 
		delete offp_eq where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe

	end
	else if (@offpeq_e_id <> @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant and (@offpeq_e_id <> @offpeq_e or @offpeq_e is null))
	begin

		update offp_eq set offpeq_e_id = @offpeq_e_id where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe

	end
	else if (@offpeq_e_id <> @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant and @offpeq_e_id = @offpeq_e)
	begin

		delete offp_eq where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe
		update offp_eq set offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe where  offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = (case when @offpeq_chefe = 1 then 0 else 1 end)

	end

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase_Teste`(@of_id int, @offpeq_e_id int, @offpeq_chefe bit, @offp_fp_id int, @offp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase_Teste] 

@of_id int,
@offpeq_e_id int,
@offpeq_chefe bit,
@offp_fp_id int,
@offp_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	declare @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant int, @offpeq_e int, @pos int 

	if (@offp_id is null)
		set @offp_id = (select offp_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id and offp_of_id = @of_id)

	if (@offp_id is null)
	begin
		if (@offp_fp_id = 33 and @offpeq_e_id is not null) -- Novo "Acabamento" vai para a maior posição entre a colagem e o pq acab + 1
		begin
			-- Retira fases "Pintura Acabamento" e "Lixagem"
			set @pos = (select min(offp_ordem) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (5,22) and offp_datainicio is null)
			delete offp_eq from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (5,22) /*Pint. Acab,Lixagem*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			delete from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (5,22) /*Pint. Acab,Lixagem*/ and offp_datainicio is null

			if ((select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id) in (5,22))
				update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 33 where of_id = @of_id

			update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem -1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @pos

			--Insere nova fase de acabamento
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, @offp_fp_id, @pos)
			set @offp_id = @@identity
		end
		else if (@offp_fp_id in (5,22) and @offpeq_e_id is not null) -- Pint. Acab,Lixagem
		begin
			-- Retira fases "Pintura Acabamento" e "Lixagem"
			set @pos = (select min(offp_ordem) from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 /*Novo "Acabamento"*/ and offp_datainicio is null)
			delete offp_eq from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 /*Novo "Acabamento"*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			delete from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 /*Novo "Acabamento"*/ and offp_datainicio is null
			
			if ((select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id) = 33)
				update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 5 where of_id = @of_id

			update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 2 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @pos

			--Insere novas fases de Pint. acabamento e Lixagem
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, @offp_fp_id, (case when @offp_fp_id = 5 then @pos else @pos + 1 end))
			set @offp_id = @@identity
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, (case when @offp_fp_id = 5 then 22 else 5 end), (case when @offp_fp_id = 5 then @pos else @pos + 1 end))
		end
	end

	set @offpeq_e = (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id 
									 where offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = (case when @offpeq_chefe = 1 then 0 else 1 end))

	set @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant = (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id 
									 where offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe)

	if (@offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant is null and (@offpeq_e_id is not null or @offpeq_e_id <> -1))
	begin

		insert into offp_eq (offpeq_offp_id, offpeq_e_id, offpeq_chefe) values (@offp_id, @offpeq_e_id, @offpeq_chefe)

	end
	else if ((@offpeq_e_id is null or @offpeq_e_id = -1) and @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant is not null)
	begin
 
		delete offp_eq where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe

	end
	else if (@offpeq_e_id <> @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant and (@offpeq_e_id <> @offpeq_e or @offpeq_e is null))
	begin

		update offp_eq set offpeq_e_id = @offpeq_e_id where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe

	end
	else if (@offpeq_e_id <> @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant and @offpeq_e_id = @offpeq_e)
	begin

		delete offp_eq where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe
		update offp_eq set offpeq_chefe = @offpeq_chefe where  offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = (case when @offpeq_chefe = 1 then 0 else 1 end)

	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Ordemfabrico_Upd_Fase`(@offp_id int, @offp_fp_id int, @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @chefe int, @ajudante int, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_peso_deck_ant float, @offp_peso_deck_dp float, @offp_peso_casco_ant float, @offp_peso_casco_dp float, @offp_peso float, @offp_ordem int, @of_id int, @offp_return bit, @offp_coeficiente float, @offp_tpcam_id int, @offp_of_id_mld int, @offp_data_prevista smalldatetime, @offp_coeficiente_x float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-03-05 10:17* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ordemfabrico_Upd_Fase]
	
	@offp_id int,
	@offp_fp_id int,
	@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null, 
	@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null, 
	@chefe int = null, 
	@ajudante int = null, 
	@offp_problemas nvarchar(max) = '', 
	@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
	@offp_peso_deck_ant float = 0, 
	@offp_peso_deck_dp float = 0, 
	@offp_peso_casco_ant float = 0, 
	@offp_peso_casco_dp float = 0, 
	@offp_peso float = 0, 
	@offp_ordem int = 0,
	@of_id int,
	@offp_return bit = null,
	@offp_coeficiente float = null,
	@offp_tpcam_id int = null,
	@offp_of_id_mld int = -2,
	@offp_data_prevista smalldatetime = '1900/01/01',
	@offp_coeficiente_x float = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @df_anterior smalldatetime
	if @offp_fp_id = 6
		set @df_anterior = (select offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id)

    update of_fp set 
		offp_datainicio = @offp_datainicio,
		offp_datafim = @offp_datafim,
		offp_problemas = @offp_problemas,
		offp_observacoes = @offp_observacoes,
		offp_peso_deck_ant = @offp_peso_deck_ant,
		offp_peso_deck_dp = @offp_peso_deck_dp,
		offp_peso_casco_ant = @offp_peso_casco_ant,
		offp_peso_casco_dp = @offp_peso_casco_dp,
		offp_peso = @offp_peso,
		offp_ordem = @offp_ordem,
		offp_return = coalesce(@offp_return,offp_return),
		offp_coeficiente = isnull(@offp_coeficiente, offp_coeficiente),
		offp_tpcam_id = isnull(@offp_tpcam_id, offp_tpcam_id),
		offp_of_id_mld = (case when @offp_of_id_mld = -2 then offp_of_id_mld else @offp_of_id_mld end),
		offp_data_prevista = (case when @offp_data_prevista = '1900/01/01' then offp_data_prevista else @offp_data_prevista end),
		offp_coeficiente_x = isnull(@offp_coeficiente_x,offp_coeficiente_x)
	where offp_id = @offp_id
	
	/*Chefe*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @chefe, 1, @offp_fp_id, @offp_id

	/*Assistente*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @ajudante, 0, @offp_fp_id, @offp_id

	if (@offp_fp_id = 8)-- and @offp_datafim is not null)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_datafim = @offp_datafim where of_id = @of_id
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_ValorFases @of_id
		
		declare @prodNome nvarchar(max), @pesosMovId int, @pesos int, @porcasMovId int, @porcas int, @dtHoje smalldatetime
		select 
			@prodNome = p_nome,
			@pesosMovId = MOV_ID,
			@pesos = case 
						when p_nome like 'K1 %' then ceiling((11.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'K2 %' then ceiling((17.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'K4 %' then ceiling((29.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'C1 %' then ceiling((13.4 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'C2 %' then ceiling((18.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						else 0
					end,
			@dtHoje = getdate()
		from 
			ORDEMFABRICO 
			inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID 
			left join movimento on of_id = MOV_OF_ID and MOV_P_ID = 48568 and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0
		where	
			OF_ID = @of_id

		select 
			@porcasMovId = MOV_ID,
			@porcas = (@pesos - @pesos % 2) / 2
		from 
			ORDEMFABRICO 
			inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID 
			left join movimento on of_id = MOV_OF_ID and MOV_P_ID = 23333 and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0
		where	
			OF_ID = @of_id

		if (@offp_peso > 0 and (@prodNome like '% SCS' or @prodNome like '% FC'))
		begin
			declare @packPesos int
			select top 1 @packPesos = mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 26037
			if (@packPesos is not null)
				exec Inventario_Del_Movimento @packPesos

			if @pesosMovId is null and @pesos > 0
				insert into movimento 
					(mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_lote, mov_e_id, mov_desconto, mov_arm_id, mov_pl_id, mov_acerto, mov_defeituoso, mov_e_id_responsavel, mov_tr_id, mov_of_id, mov_mov_id)
				values
					(@dtHoje, null, 48568, 2, 0, 0, @pesos, 'Acerto de peso da OF: ' + cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', null, 0, 9, null, 0, 0, null, null, @of_id, null)
			else if @pesos > 0
				update movimento set MOV_QUANTIDADE = @pesos where MOV_ID = @pesosMovId
			else
				delete movimento where MOV_ID = @pesosMovId

			if @porcasMovId is null and @porcas > 0
				insert into movimento 
					(mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_lote, mov_e_id, mov_desconto, mov_arm_id, mov_pl_id, mov_acerto, mov_defeituoso, mov_e_id_responsavel, mov_tr_id, mov_of_id, mov_mov_id)
				values
					(@dtHoje, null, 23333, 2, 0, 0, @porcas, 'Acerto de peso da OF: ' + cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', null, 0, 9, null, 0, 0, null, null, @of_id, null)
			else if @porcas > 0
				update movimento set MOV_QUANTIDADE = @porcas where MOV_ID = @porcasMovId
			else 
				delete movimento where MOV_ID = @porcasMovId
		end

	end

	if @offp_fp_id = 6 and (@offp_of_id_mld = -2 or @offp_of_id_mld is null)
		select top 1 @offp_of_id_mld = offp_of_id_mld from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 1 order by offp_datafim desc
	
	if @offp_fp_id = 6 and @df_anterior is null and @offp_datafim is not null
		update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil + 1 where of_id = @offp_of_id_mld
	else if @offp_fp_id = 6 and @offp_datafim is null and @df_anterior is not null
		update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil - 1 where of_id = @offp_of_id_mld

END
```

#### `dbo.Ordemfabrico_Upd_Fase_V2`(@offp_id int, @offp_fp_id int, @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @chefe int, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_peso_deck_ant float, @offp_peso_deck_dp float, @offp_peso_casco_ant float, @offp_peso_casco_dp float, @offp_peso float, @offp_ordem int, @of_id int, @offp_return bit, @offp_coeficiente float, @offp_tpcam_id int, @offp_of_id_mld int, @offp_data_prevista smalldatetime, @offp_coeficiente_x float, @of_acerto_resina float, @of_desconta_peso bit, @offp_valor_control_1 float, @offp_valor_control_2 float, @offp_valor_control_3 float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2023-09-29 10:15 · modificado 2026-04-28 11:09* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Ordemfabrico_Upd_Fase_V2]
	
	@offp_id int,
	@offp_fp_id int,
	@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null, 
	@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null, 
	@chefe int = null, 
	@offp_problemas nvarchar(max) = '', 
	@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = null,
	@offp_peso_deck_ant float = 0, 
	@offp_peso_deck_dp float = 0, 
	@offp_peso_casco_ant float = 0, 
	@offp_peso_casco_dp float = 0, 
	@offp_peso float = 0, 
	@offp_ordem int = null,
	@of_id int,
	@offp_return bit = null,
	@offp_coeficiente float = null,
	@offp_tpcam_id int = null,
	@offp_of_id_mld int = -2,
	@offp_data_prevista smalldatetime = '1900/01/01',
	@offp_coeficiente_x float = null,
	@of_acerto_resina float = null,
	@of_desconta_peso bit = null,

	@offp_valor_control_1 float = 0,
	@offp_valor_control_2 float = 0,
	@offp_valor_control_3 float = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @df_anterior smalldatetime
	if @offp_fp_id = 6
		set @df_anterior = (select offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id)
		
    update of_fp set 
		offp_datainicio = @offp_datainicio,
		offp_datafim = @offp_datafim,
		offp_problemas = @offp_problemas,
		offp_observacoes = isnull(@offp_observacoes,offp_observacoes),
		offp_peso_deck_ant = @offp_peso_deck_ant,
		offp_peso_deck_dp = @offp_peso_deck_dp,
		offp_peso_casco_ant = @offp_peso_casco_ant,
		offp_peso_casco_dp = @offp_peso_casco_dp,
		offp_peso = @offp_peso,
		offp_ordem = isnull(@offp_ordem, offp_ordem),
		offp_return = coalesce(@offp_return,offp_return),
		offp_coeficiente = isnull(@offp_coeficiente, offp_coeficiente),
		offp_tpcam_id = isnull(@offp_tpcam_id, offp_tpcam_id),
		offp_of_id_mld = (case when @offp_of_id_mld = -2 then offp_of_id_mld else @offp_of_id_mld end),
		offp_data_prevista = (case when @offp_data_prevista = '1900/01/01' then offp_data_prevista else @offp_data_prevista end),
		offp_coeficiente_x = isnull(@offp_coeficiente_x,offp_coeficiente_x),
		offp_valor_control_1 = @offp_valor_control_1,
		offp_valor_control_2 = @offp_valor_control_2,
		offp_valor_control_3 = @offp_valor_control_3
	where 
		offp_id = @offp_id
	
	/*Chefe*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @chefe, 1, @offp_fp_id, @offp_id

	/*Assistente*/ 
		--exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @ajudante, 0, @offp_fp_id, @offp_id

	if ((@of_acerto_resina is not null or @of_desconta_peso is not null) and @offp_fp_id in (1,67))
		update ordemfabrico set of_acerto_resina = coalesce(@of_acerto_resina,of_acerto_resina), of_desconta_peso = coalesce(@of_desconta_peso,of_desconta_peso) where of_id = @of_id

	if (@offp_fp_id = 8)-- and @offp_datafim is not null)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_datafim = @offp_datafim where of_id = @of_id
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_ValorFases @of_id
		
		declare @prodNome nvarchar(max), @pesosMovId int, @pesos int, @dtHoje smalldatetime
		select 
			@prodNome = p_nome,
			@pesosMovId = MOV_ID,
			@pesos = case 
						when p_nome like 'K1 %' then ceiling((11.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'K2 %' then ceiling((17.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'K4 %' then ceiling((29.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'C1 %' then ceiling((13.4 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						when p_nome like 'C2 %' then ceiling((18.9 - @offp_peso)/0.125) 
						else 0
					end,
			@dtHoje = getdate()
		from 
			ORDEMFABRICO 
			inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID 
			left join movimento on of_id = MOV_OF_ID and MOV_P_ID = 48568 and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0
		where	
			OF_ID = @of_id

		if (@offp_peso > 0 and (@prodNome like '% SCS' or @prodNome like '% FC'))
		begin
			declare @packPesos int
			select top 1 @packPesos = mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 26037
			if (@packPesos is not null)
				exec Inventario_Del_Movimento @packPesos
			
			if @pesosMovId is null
			begin
				insert into movimento 
					(mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_lote, mov_e_id, mov_desconto, mov_arm_id, mov_pl_id, mov_acerto, mov_defeituoso, mov_e_id_responsavel, mov_tr_id, mov_of_id, mov_mov_id)
				values
					(@dtHoje, null, 48568, 2, 0, 0, @pesos, 'Acerto de peso da OF: ' + cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', null, 0, 7, null, 0, 0, null, null, @of_id, null)

				insert into movimento 
					(mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_lote, mov_e_id, mov_desconto, mov_arm_id, mov_pl_id, mov_acerto, mov_defeituoso, mov_e_id_responsavel, mov_tr_id, mov_of_id, mov_mov_id)
				values
					(@dtHoje, null, 21080, 2, 0, 0, FLOOR(@pesos/2), 'Acerto de peso da OF: ' + cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', null, 0, 7, null, 0, 0, null, null, @of_id, null)

				insert into movimento 
					(mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_lote, mov_e_id, mov_desconto, mov_arm_id, mov_pl_id, mov_acerto, mov_defeituoso, mov_e_id_responsavel, mov_tr_id, mov_of_id, mov_mov_id)
				values
					(@dtHoje, null, 23333, 2, 0, 0, FLOOR(@pesos/2), 'Acerto de peso da OF: ' + cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', null, 0, 7, null, 0, 0, null, null, @of_id, null)
			end
			else
				update movimento set MOV_QUANTIDADE = @pesos where MOV_ID = @pesosMovId

		end

	end

	if @offp_fp_id = 6 and (@offp_of_id_mld = -2 or @offp_of_id_mld is null)
		select top 1 @offp_of_id_mld = offp_of_id_mld from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 1 order by offp_datafim desc
	
	if @offp_fp_id = 6 and @df_anterior is null and @offp_datafim is not null
		update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil + 1 where of_id = @offp_of_id_mld
	else if @offp_fp_id = 6 and @offp_datafim is null and @df_anterior is not null
		update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil - 1 where of_id = @offp_of_id_mld

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_NaoPagos`(@OF_ID int, @OF_EOF_ID int, @OF_REFERENCIA nvarchar(max), @OF_OFTU_ID int, @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC nvarchar(max), @OF_PAGO bit, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO smalldatetime, @OF_TR_ID int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_NaoPagos]

@OF_ID int,
@OF_EOF_ID INT,
@OF_REFERENCIA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_PAGO BIT,
@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO SMALLDATETIME,
@OF_TR_ID INT = NULL


AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION

exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

Update ORDEMFABRICO 
set
OF_FP_ID=@OF_EOF_ID,
OF_REFERENCIA=@OF_REFERENCIA,
OF_OFTU_ID=@OF_OFTU_ID,
OF_TRANSPORTEDOC=@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC,
OF_PAGO=@OF_PAGO,
OF_DATAPAGAMENTO=@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO
where
OF_ID=@OF_ID

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_PlanoLaminagem`(@of_id int, @of_datainicio smalldatetime, @of_turn_id int, @offpeq_e_id int, @of_of_id_mld int, @of_arm_id_lam int, @offp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-05-06 13:20* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_PlanoLaminagem]

@of_id int,
@of_datainicio smalldatetime,
@of_turn_id int,
@offpeq_e_id int,
@of_of_id_mld int,
@of_arm_id_lam int,
@offp_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	update 
		of_fp
	set 
		offp_data_prevista = @of_datainicio,
		offp_turn_id = @of_turn_id,
		offp_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld
	where 
		offp_id = @offp_id

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 1, 1, @offp_id

	declare @e_id_ajud int
	select @e_id_ajud = E_E_ID from ENTIDADE where E_ID = @offpeq_e_id

	if @e_id_ajud is not null
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @e_id_ajud, 0, 1, @offp_id

	-- Actualiza os pesos antes do molde pelos definidos no proprio molde
	declare @of_peso_casco float, @of_peso_deck float
	select @of_peso_casco = of_peso_casco, @of_peso_deck = of_peso_deck from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_of_id_mld

	update
		of_fp 
	set 
		offp_peso_casco_ant = (case when offp_peso_casco_ant = 0 then isnull(@of_peso_casco,0) else offp_peso_casco_ant end),
		offp_peso_deck_ant = (case when offp_peso_deck_ant = 0 then isnull(@of_peso_deck,0) else offp_peso_deck_ant end),
		offp_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld
	where 
		offp_of_id = @of_id
		and offp_datafim is null
		and offp_fp_id in (18,6)

	if exists(select offp_id from of_fp inner join ORDEMFABRICO on offp_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id and p_nome like '% FC' and offp_fp_id = 1 and OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA is null)
		update 
			oo 
		set 
			offp_data_prevista = case when @of_datainicio is not null then dateadd(day,case when datepart(dw,@of_datainicio) < 6 then 1 else 3 end, @of_datainicio) else @of_datainicio end,
			offp_turn_id = @of_turn_id,
			offp_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld
		from 
			of_fp oo 
			inner join ORDEMFABRICO on offp_of_id = of_id 
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		where 
			of_id = @of_id 
			and p_nome like '% FC' 
			and offp_fp_id = 1 
			and OFFP_DATAFIM is null

	--verifica se o molde está no piso 0 select * from ordemfabrico as o inner join ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id where o.of_id = @of_id and o1.of_arm_id = 1
	--if not exists (select * from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_of_id_mld and of_arm_id = 14) and @of_datainicio >= getdate() and @of_turn_id > 0 and @of_of_id_mld > 0
	--begin
	--	declare @ass nvarchar(max) = (select 'O molde ' + of_nome + ' atribuido à OF:' + convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id) + ' para fazer a ' + convert(nvarchar(10),@of_datainicio,103)  + ' não está no Piso 0!' from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_of_id_mld)
		
	--	EXEC [dbo].[SendMail] 
	--		@De = N'moldes@gmail.com', 
	--		@Para = N'eduardojppinto@hotmail.com', 
	--		@BCC = N'nunandre@gmail.com', 
	--		@Assunto = @ass, 
	--		@Texto = 'Molde fora!',
	--		@HTML = 1
	--end

	if exists(select of_id from ordemfabrico inner join turno on of_turn_id = turn_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id inner join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id	where of_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld and of_datainicio between dateadd(dd, -1, @of_datainicio) and dateadd(dd, 1, @of_datainicio) and offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id <> @of_id)
		raiserror('O molde que escolheu ja está atribuido a OF(s) por isso não deve estar disponivel nessa data...!', 16, 1)
	
END
```

```sql
			of_referencia = @of_referencia,
			of_oftu_id = @of_oftu_id,
			of_transportedoc = @of_transportedoc,
			of_arm_id = coalesce(@of_arm_id, of_arm_id), 
			of_sequencia = coalesce(@of_sequencia, of_sequencia), 
			of_sequencia_upd = (case when @of_sequencia <> of_sequencia then getdate() else of_sequencia_upd end)

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @of_embalagem, 1, @of_id, 81

	--if @pintoracabamento <> @pintoracabamento_Ant or (@pintoracabamento is null and @pintoracabamento_Ant is not null) or (@pintoracabamento is not null and @pintoracabamento_Ant is null)

	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @of_eof_id
```
