#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_Resum_Const`(@of_id int, @of_fp_id int, @offpeq_e_id int, @of_pago int, @of_datapagamento smalldatetime, @of_referencia nvarchar(max), @of_oftu_id int, @of_transportedoc nvarchar(max), @const_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_Resum_Const]

@of_id int,
@of_fp_id int,
@offpeq_e_id int,
@of_pago int,
@of_datapagamento smalldatetime,
@of_referencia nvarchar(max),
@of_oftu_id int,
@of_transportedoc nvarchar(max),
@const_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    update ordemfabrico
		set
			of_fp_id = @of_fp_id,
			of_pago = @of_pago,
			of_datapagamento = @of_datapagamento,
			of_referencia = @of_referencia,
			of_oftu_id = @of_oftu_id,
			of_transportedoc = @of_transportedoc
	where
		of_id = @of_id


	declare @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant int, @offp_id int

	set @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant = (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id 
									 where offp_fp_id = 8 and offp_of_id = @of_id and offpeq_chefe = 1)

	set @offp_id = (select offp_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 8 and offp_of_id = @of_id)

	if (@offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant is null and (@offpeq_e_id is not null or @offpeq_e_id <> -1))
	begin

		insert into offp_eq (offpeq_offp_id, offpeq_e_id, offpeq_chefe) values (@offp_id, @offpeq_e_id, 1)

	end
	else if ((@offpeq_e_id is null or @offpeq_e_id = -1) and @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant is not null)
	begin

		delete offp_eq where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1

	end
	else if (@offpeq_e_id <> @offpeq_e_id_chefe_ant)
	begin

		update offp_eq set offpeq_e_id = @offpeq_e_id where offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_offp_id = @offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1

	end

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @const_id, 1, @OF_ID, 84

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_Resum_Ent`(@of_id int, @of_eof_id int, @offpeq_e_id int, @of_pago int, @of_datapagamento datetime, @of_referencia nvarchar(max), @of_oftu_id int, @of_transportedoc nvarchar(max), @of_fact nvarchar(max), @of_embalagem int, @of_tr_id int, @of_arm_id int, @of_precovenda float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_Resum_Ent]

@of_id int,
@of_eof_id int,
@offpeq_e_id int,
@of_pago int,
@of_datapagamento datetime,
@of_referencia nvarchar(max),
@of_oftu_id int,
@of_transportedoc nvarchar(max),
@of_fact nvarchar(max) = null,
@of_embalagem int = -1,
@of_tr_id int = null,
@of_arm_id int = null,
@of_precovenda float = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@of_tr_id is not null)
begin
	declare @of_datatransporte smalldatetime
	set @of_datatransporte = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

	exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte @of_id, @of_datatransporte
end

	exec Transportes_Add_OF @of_id, @of_tr_id

declare @of_fp_id int
set @of_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	if (@OF_EOF_ID in (11,18,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8))
		set @OF_EOF_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@OF_ID)
	else if (@of_fp_id <> @OF_EOF_ID)
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID and offp_datainicio is null)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID
		else
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, getdate())
	end



    update ordemfabrico
		set
			of_fp_id = @of_eof_id,
			of_pago = @of_pago,
			of_datapagamento = @of_datapagamento,
			of_referencia = @of_referencia,
			of_oftu_id = @of_oftu_id,
			of_transportedoc = @of_transportedoc,
			of_arm_id = coalesce(@of_arm_id, of_arm_id),
			of_fact = coalesce(@of_fact, of_fact),
			of_precovenda = coalesce(@of_precovenda,of_precovenda)
	where
		of_id = @of_id

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @of_embalagem, 1, @of_id, 81

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 1, 8
	
	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @of_eof_id

END
```

@of_referencia nvarchar(max),
@of_oftu_id int,
@of_transportedoc nvarchar(max),
@of_embalagem int = -1,
@of_tr_id int = null,
@of_arm_id int = null,
@lixador int = null,
@pintoracabamento int = null,
@colador int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@of_tr_id is not null)
begin
	declare @of_datatransporte smalldatetime
	set @of_datatransporte = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

	exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte @of_id, @of_datatransporte
end

	exec Transportes_Add_OF @of_id, @of_tr_id

	declare @of_fp_id int
	set @of_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	if (@OF_EOF_ID in (select fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1))
		set @OF_EOF_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@OF_ID)
	else if (@of_fp_id <> @OF_EOF_ID)
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID and offp_datainicio is null)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID
		else
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, getdate())
	end



    update ordemfabrico
		set
			of_fp_id = @of_eof_id,
			of_pago = @of_pago,
			of_datapagamento = @of_datapagamento,
			of_referencia = @of_referencia,
			of_oftu_id = @of_oftu_id,
			of_transportedoc = @of_transportedoc,
			of_arm_id = coalesce(@of_arm_id, of_arm_id)
	where
		of_id = @of_id

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @of_embalagem, 1, @of_id, 81

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase_Teste @of_id, @colador, 1, 4
	
	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase_Teste @of_id, @lixador, 1, 22

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase_Teste @of_id, @pintoracabamento, 1, 5

	exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase_Teste @of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 1, 33
	
	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @of_eof_id

END
```

--------USER----------
@OF_ACTUALIZADOR NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,

@of_desconta_peso bit = 0,
@of_parapintarfora bit = 0,
@of_revisto bit = 0,
@of_paraalterar bit = 0

AS
BEGIN TRANSACTION
set nocount on;

	declare @of_p_id_ant int,
			@of_p_id_cdeck_ant int,
			@of_p_id_ccasco_ant int,
			@of_p_id_topo_fr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_topo_tr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_quinas_ant int

	select @of_p_id_ant = of_p_id, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant = of_p_id_cdeck, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant = of_p_id_ccasco, 
			@of_p_id_topo_fr_ant = of_p_id_topo_fr, @of_p_id_topo_tr_ant = of_p_id_topo_tr, @of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant = of_p_id_lateral_fr, 
			@of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant = of_p_id_lateral_tr, @of_p_id_quinas_ant = of_p_id_quinas
	from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id

	declare @of_coeficiente float
	set @of_coeficiente=(select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID)

/*Adiciona Acessorios, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_BANCO, @QTD_BANCO, @OF_ID, 10

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPES, @QTD_FINCAPES, @OF_ID, 11

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_FINCAPESTRAS, @QTD_FINCAPESTRAS, @OF_ID, 62

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_LEME, @QTD_LEME, @OF_ID, 14

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_STRAP, @QTD_STRAP, @OF_ID, 12

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_CAPA, 1, @OF_ID, 74

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_EMBALAGEM, 1, @OF_ID, 81
	
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_MATTPINTURA, @QTD_MATTPINTURA, @OF_ID, 134

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_PN, @QTD_PN, @OF_ID, 65

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_TAMPA5, @QTD_TAMPA5, @OF_ID, 135

declare @resina int, @const_ant int
select @resina = m.mov_p_id, @const_ant = m1.mov_p_id from movimento as m inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto on m1.mov_p_id = p_id where m.mov_p_id in (21399,20448,27484) and m.mov_of_id = @OF_ID and p_tp_id = 84

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84

declare @qtd_deck float, @qtd_casco float, @topo_fr float, @topo_tr float, @lateral_fr float, @lateral_tr float, @quinas float
select @qtd_deck = coalesce(p_qtddeck,0), @qtd_casco = coalesce(p_qtdcasco,0), 
	@topo_fr = p_perc_topo_fr, @topo_tr = p_perc_topo_tr, @lateral_fr = p_perc_lateral_fr, @lateral_tr = p_perc_lateral_tr, @quinas = p_perc_quinas
from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID

if (((@of_p_id_cdeck_ant <> @of_p_id_ccasco_ant) or (@of_p_id_cdeck_ant = @of_p_id_ccasco_ant)) and @OF_P_ID_CDECK = @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
begin
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant

	set @qtd_deck = @qtd_deck + @qtd_casco
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null
end
else if (((@of_p_id_cdeck_ant <> @of_p_id_ccasco_ant) or (@of_p_id_cdeck_ant = @of_p_id_ccasco_ant)) and @OF_P_ID_CDECK <> @OF_P_ID_CCASCO)
begin
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores NULL, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, null
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CCASCO, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, null
end

	set @topo_fr = @qtd_deck * @topo_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR, @topo_fr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_topo_fr_ant, 'Topo_fr'

	set @topo_tr = @qtd_deck * @topo_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR, @topo_tr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_topo_tr_ant, 'Topo_tr'

	set @lateral_fr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_fr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR, @lateral_fr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant, 'Lateral_fr'

	set @lateral_tr = @qtd_deck * @lateral_tr
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR, @lateral_tr, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant, 'Lateral_tr'

	set @quinas = @qtd_deck * @quinas
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_QUINAS, @quinas, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_quinas_ant, 'Quinas'

/*Adiciona os Standards, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID, @of_p_id_ant

/*Adiciona os Produtos Acossiados à construção e verifica Componentes excluindo os adicionados em cima*/
	--exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84

if (@resina is not null and @OF_P_ID_CONST = @const_ant)
	exec ProdutosAssociados_Upd @resina, @QTD_RESINA, @OF_ID
--else if (@QTD_RESINA > 0)
--	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @resina, @QTD_RESINA, @OF_ID, 57
--else if (@QTD_RESINA = 0)
--	exec ProdutosAssociados_Del @resina, @OF_ID

/*Actualiza fases de Producao*/

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 18, @OF_PINTURAINICIO, @OF_PINTURAFIM, 0, @OF_PINTURAPROBLEMAS, @OF_PINTURAPINTOR, @OF_PINTURAASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PINTURAOBSERVACOES, @OFFP_PESO_DECK_ANT, @OFFP_PESO_DECK_DP, @OFFP_PESO_CASCO_ANT, @OFFP_PESO_CASCO_DP, null, 0, @OFFP_PINTURATEMP, @OFFP_PINTURAHUMID, 0

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 1, @OF_LAMINICIO, @OF_LAMFIM, 0, @OF_LAMPROBLEMAS, @OF_LAMLAMINADOR, @OF_LAMASSISTENTE, null, @OF_LAMOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 2, @OF_ESTINICIO, @OF_ESTFIM, 0, @OF_ESTPROBLEMAS, null, null, null, @OF_ESTOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 5, @OF_COLINICIO, @OF_COLFIM, 0, @OF_COLPROBLEMAS, @OF_COLCOLADOR, @OF_COLASSISTENTE, null, @OF_COLOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 6, @OF_DESINICIO, @OF_DESFIM, @OF_LAMPESO, @OF_DESPROBLEMAS, @OF_DESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_DESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_DESOBSERVACOES, 0, 0, 0, 0, @OFFP_OFFPCL_ID

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 22, @OF_PQDESINICIO, @OF_PQDESFIM, 0, @OF_PQDESPROBLEMAS, @OF_PQDESDESMOLDADOR, @OF_PQDESASSISTENTE, null, @OF_PQDESOBSERVACOES

	--exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 8, @OF_ACABINICIO, @OF_ACABFIM, @OF_ACABPESO, @OF_ACABPROBLEMAS, @OF_ACABACABADOR, @OF_ACABASSISTENTE, null, @OF_ACABOBSERVACOES, 0, 0, 0, 0, null, @offp_horas_rep, 0, 0, @OF_ACABCONTROLO, @OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS

declare @of_fp_id int
set @of_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	if (@of_fp_id <> @OF_EOF_ID) and (@OF_EOF_ID not in (select fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1))
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID and offp_datafim is null)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID
		else
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, getdate())
	end

	set @OF_EOF_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF_Teste(@of_id)

	declare @OF_DATATRANSPORTE smalldatetime
		set @OF_DATATRANSPORTE = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

	exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte @of_id, @OF_DATATRANSPORTE

	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	update ordemfabrico
	set
		OF_DATA=@OF_DATA, 
		OF_DATAPAGAMENTO=@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, 
		OF_OBSERVACOES=@OF_OBSERVACOES, 
		OF_PRECOCUSTO=@OF_PRECOCUSTO, 
		OF_PRECOVENDA=@OF_PRECOVENDA, 
		OF_MORADAENTREGA=@OF_MORADAENTREGA, 
		OF_REFERENCIA=@OF_REFERENCIA, 
		OF_TRANSPORTEDOC=@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, 
		OF_AUTOCOLANTE=@OF_AUTOCOLANTES, 
		OF_DESCONTO=@OF_DESCONTO, 
		OF_VALORPAGO=@OF_VALORPAGO, 
		OF_COEFICIENTE=@OF_COEFICIENTE, 
		OF_PAGO=@OF_PAGO, 
		OF_SUPERVISAO=@OF_SUPERVISAO,
		OF_OFTU_ID=@OF_OFTU_ID, 
		OF_ENC_ID=@OF_ENC_ID, 
		OF_P_ID=@OF_P_ID, 
		OF_E_ID=@OF_E_ID, 
		OF_E_ID_ENC=@OF_E_ID_ENC, 
		OF_FP_ID= @OF_EOF_ID,
		OF_OF_ID_MLD=@OF_OF_ID_MLD, 
		OF_P_ID_CDECK=@OF_P_ID_CDECK, 
		OF_P_ID_CCASCO=@OF_P_ID_CCASCO,
		OF_DATAINICIO = @OF_DATAINICIO,
		OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM = @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM,
		OF_TURN_ID = @OF_TURN_ID,
		OF_TELEFONE = @OF_TELEFONE,
		OF_EMAIL = @OF_EMAIL,
		OF_ACTUALIZADOR = @OF_ACTUALIZADOR,
		OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO = @OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = @OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR,
		OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = @OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR,
		OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR,
		OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR,
		OF_P_ID_QUINAS = @OF_P_ID_QUINAS,
		OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR = @OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR,
		OF_P_ID_GOLA = @OF_P_ID_GOLA,
		OF_ARM_ID = @OF_ARM_ID,
		OF_ARM_ID_LAM = @OF_ARM_ID_LAM,
		of_transp = @of_transp,
		of_desconta_peso = @of_desconta_peso,
		of_p_id_hist = (case when @of_p_id_ant = @OF_P_ID then of_p_id_hist else of_p_id_hist + convert(nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID) + '(' + @OF_ACTUALIZADOR + '); ' end),
		of_parapintarfora = @of_parapintarfora,
		of_revisto = @of_revisto,
		of_paraalterar = @of_paraalterar
		where
		of_id = @OF_ID

	select of_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID

	--Pesos 100
	declare @mov_100 int
	set @mov_100 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 22676)
	if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 > 0)
		exec produtosassociados_upd 22676, @p100, @of_id, @mov_100 -- Psos de 100g = 20423
	else if (@mov_100 is null and @p100 > 0)
		exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 22676, @p100, @of_id, 101
	else if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 = 0)
		exec produtosassociados_del 22676, @of_id, @mov_100


	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @OF_ID, @OF_EOF_ID


COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_V2`(@OF_ID int, @OF_EOF_ID int, @OF_DATA datetime, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO datetime, @OF_E_ID int, @OF_E_ID_ENC int, @OF_P_ID int, @OF_P_ID_CONST int, @OF_OF_ID_MLD int, @OF_OBSERVACOES nvarchar(max), @OF_MORADAENTREGA nvarchar(max), @OF_REFERENCIA nvarchar(max), @OF_TELEFONE nvarchar(max), @OF_EMAIL nvarchar(max), @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC nvarchar(max), @OF_ENC_ID int, @OF_PRECOCUSTO float, @OF_PRECOVENDA float, @OF_DESCONTO float, @OF_VALORPAGO float, @OF_PAGO bit, @OF_AUTOCOLANTES nvarchar(max), @OF_EMBALAGEM int, @OF_OFTU_ID int, @OF_SUPERVISAO bit, @RESINA_P_ID int, @RESINA_MOV_ID int, @QTD_RESINA float, @OF_DATAINICIO smalldatetime, @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit, @OF_TURN_ID int, @OF_TR_ID int, @OF_ACTUALIZADOR nvarchar(max), @OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO smalldatetime, @OF_ARM_ID int, @OF_ARM_ID_LAM int, @OFFP_OFFPCL_ID int, @OF_ACABCONTROLO bit, @OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS bit, @of_transp bit, @offp_horas_rep float, @p100 int, @p375 int, @p500 int, @of_desconta_peso bit, @of_parapintarfora bit, @of_revisto bit, @of_paraalterar bit, @of_nome nvarchar(max), @of_acerto_resina float, @of_supervisaopintura bit, @e_id_responsavel int, @of_promo_code nvarchar(max), @of_fact nvarchar(max), @OF_FALTA_AUTOCOLANTE_NOME bit, @OF_FALTA_PROTECCAO_PAGAIA bit, @OF_FALTA_GARRAFA bit, @OF_FALTA_PARAFUSOS bit, @OF_FALTA_PESOS bit, @OF_FALTA_TRACTION_PADS bit, @OF_FALTA_FINCA_PES bit, @OF_FALTA_BANCO bit, @OF_FALTA_LEME bit, @OF_FALTA_CAPA bit, @OF_FALTA_TOALHA bit, @of_ral_main nvarchar(max), @of_ral_sec nvarchar(max), @OF_DUREZA_DECK int, @OF_DUREZA_CASCO int, @OF_DUREZA_PROA int, @of_sensor_id_vacuo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-11-13 13:51* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_V2]

@OF_ID INT,
@OF_EOF_ID INT,
@OF_DATA DATETIME,
@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO DATETIME,
@OF_E_ID INT,
@OF_E_ID_ENC INT,
@OF_P_ID INT,
@OF_P_ID_CONST INT,
@OF_OF_ID_MLD INT,
@OF_OBSERVACOES NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_MORADAENTREGA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_REFERENCIA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TELEFONE NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_EMAIL NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_TRANSPORTEDOC NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_ENC_ID INT,
@OF_PRECOCUSTO FLOAT,
@OF_PRECOVENDA FLOAT,
@OF_DESCONTO FLOAT,
@OF_VALORPAGO FLOAT,
@OF_PAGO BIT,
--ACESSORIOS--
@OF_AUTOCOLANTES NVARCHAR(MAX),
/****************************************************/
@OF_EMBALAGEM INT,
/****************************************************/
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_SUPERVISAO bit,
@RESINA_P_ID int = null,
@RESINA_MOV_ID int = null,
@QTD_RESINA FLOAT,
@OF_DATAINICIO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM bit,
@OF_TURN_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_TR_ID INT = NULL,
--------USER----------
@OF_ACTUALIZADOR NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL,
@OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@OF_ARM_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_ARM_ID_LAM INT = NULL,
@OFFP_OFFPCL_ID INT = NULL,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO BIT = 0,
@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS BIT = 0,
@of_transp bit = 0,
@offp_horas_rep float = 0,

@p100 int = 0,
@p375 int = 0,
@p500 int = 0,

@of_desconta_peso bit = 0,
@of_parapintarfora bit = 0,
@of_revisto bit = 0,
@of_paraalterar bit = 0,
@of_nome NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
@of_acerto_resina float = null,
@of_supervisaopintura bit = null,

@e_id_responsavel int = null,
@of_promo_code NVARCHAR(MAX) = null,

@of_fact NVARCHAR(MAX) = null,

@OF_FALTA_AUTOCOLANTE_NOME bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_PROTECCAO_PAGAIA bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_GARRAFA bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_PARAFUSOS bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_PESOS bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_TRACTION_PADS bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_FINCA_PES bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_BANCO bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_LEME bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_CAPA bit = 0, 
@OF_FALTA_TOALHA bit = 0,

@of_ral_main NVARCHAR(MAX) = null,  
@of_ral_sec NVARCHAR(MAX) = null,

@OF_DUREZA_DECK int = null,
@OF_DUREZA_CASCO int = null,
@OF_DUREZA_PROA int = null,
@of_sensor_id_vacuo int = -1

AS
BEGIN TRANSACTION
set nocount on;

	declare @of_p_id_ant int,
			@of_p_id_cdeck_ant int,
			@of_p_id_ccasco_ant int,
			@of_p_id_topo_fr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_topo_tr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant int,
			@of_p_id_quinas_ant int,
			@of_e_id_enc_actual int,
			@of_fp_id int

	select @of_p_id_ant = of_p_id, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant = of_p_id_cdeck, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant = of_p_id_ccasco, 
			@of_p_id_topo_fr_ant = of_p_id_topo_fr, @of_p_id_topo_tr_ant = of_p_id_topo_tr, @of_p_id_lateral_fr_ant = of_p_id_lateral_fr, 
			@of_p_id_lateral_tr_ant = of_p_id_lateral_tr, @of_p_id_quinas_ant = of_p_id_quinas, @of_e_id_enc_actual = of_e_id_enc, @of_fp_id = of_fp_id
	from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id

	declare @of_coeficiente float
	set @of_coeficiente=(select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID)

	declare @resina int, @const_ant int
	select @resina = isnull(@RESINA_P_ID,m.mov_p_id), @const_ant = m1.mov_p_id from movimento as m inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto as p on m1.mov_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on m.mov_p_id = p1.p_id where m.mov_of_id = @OF_ID and p.p_tp_id = 84 and p1.p_tp_id = 288

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @OF_P_ID_CONST, 1, @OF_ID, 84

	/*Adiciona os Standards, Produtos Acossiados e verifica Componentes excluindo os acessorios principais*/
		exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards @OF_ID, @OF_P_ID, @of_p_id_ant

	if (@resina is not null and @OF_P_ID_CONST = @const_ant)
		exec ProdutosAssociados_Upd @resina, @QTD_RESINA, @OF_ID, @RESINA_MOV_ID
	
	if (@of_fp_id <> @OF_EOF_ID) and (@OF_EOF_ID not in (select fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1))
	begin
		update 
			of_fp 
		set 
			offp_datafim = (case when fp_automatica = 1 then getdate() else null end)
		from 
			of_fp 
			inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
		where 
			offp_of_id = @of_id 
			and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id 
			and offp_datafim is null

		if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID and offp_datafim is null)
			update 
				of_fp 
			set 
				offp_datainicio = getdate() 
			where 
				offp_of_id = @of_id 
				and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID
		else
		begin
			declare @ord int
			select @ord = max(offp_ordem) + 1 from of_fp where offp_datafim is not null and offp_of_id = @OF_ID

			update of_fp set OFFP_ORDEM += 1 where offp_of_id = @OF_ID and OFFP_ORDEM >= @ord

			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio, OFFP_ORDEM) (select @of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, (case when fp_automatica = 1 then getdate() else null end), @ord from fases_producao where fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID)
		end
	end

	set @OF_EOF_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id)

	declare @OF_DATATRANSPORTE smalldatetime
		set @OF_DATATRANSPORTE = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @of_tr_id)

	exec OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte @of_id, @OF_DATATRANSPORTE

	exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @OF_TR_ID

	update 
		ordemfabrico
	set
		OF_DATA = @OF_DATA, 
		OF_DATAPAGAMENTO = @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO, 
		OF_OBSERVACOES = @OF_OBSERVACOES, 
		OF_PRECOCUSTO = @OF_PRECOCUSTO, 
		OF_PRECOVENDA = @OF_PRECOVENDA, 
		OF_MORADAENTREGA = @OF_MORADAENTREGA, 
		OF_REFERENCIA = @OF_REFERENCIA, 
		OF_TRANSPORTEDOC = @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC, 
		OF_AUTOCOLANTE = @OF_AUTOCOLANTES, 
		OF_DESCONTO = @OF_DESCONTO, 
		OF_VALORPAGO = @OF_VALORPAGO, 
		OF_COEFICIENTE = @OF_COEFICIENTE, 
		OF_PAGO = @OF_PAGO, 
		OF_SUPERVISAO = @OF_SUPERVISAO,
		OF_OFTU_ID = @OF_OFTU_ID, 
		OF_ENC_ID = @OF_ENC_ID, 
		OF_P_ID = @OF_P_ID, 
		OF_E_ID = @OF_E_ID, 
		OF_E_ID_ENC = @OF_E_ID_ENC, 
		OF_FP_ID = @OF_EOF_ID,
		OF_OF_ID_MLD = @OF_OF_ID_MLD, 
		OF_DATAINICIO = @OF_DATAINICIO,
		OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM = @OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM,
		OF_TURN_ID = @OF_TURN_ID,
		OF_TELEFONE = @OF_TELEFONE,
		OF_EMAIL = @OF_EMAIL,
		OF_ACTUALIZADOR = @OF_ACTUALIZADOR,
		OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO = @OF_DATAACTUALIZACAO,
		OF_ARM_ID = @OF_ARM_ID,
		OF_ARM_ID_LAM = @OF_ARM_ID_LAM,
		of_transp = @of_transp,
		of_desconta_peso = @of_desconta_peso,
		of_p_id_hist = (case when @of_p_id_ant = @OF_P_ID then of_p_id_hist else of_p_id_hist + convert(nvarchar(max), @OF_P_ID) + '(' + @OF_ACTUALIZADOR + '); ' end),
		of_parapintarfora = @of_parapintarfora,
		of_revisto = @of_revisto,
		of_paraalterar = @of_paraalterar,
		of_nome = @of_nome,
		of_acerto_resina = coalesce(@of_acerto_resina,of_acerto_resina),
		of_supervisaopintura = isnull(@of_supervisaopintura, of_supervisaopintura),
		of_promo_code = isnull(@of_promo_code,of_promo_code),
		OF_DATA_PROMO_DEALER = case when OF_DATA_PROMO_DEALER is null and @of_promo_code is not null then getdate() else OF_DATA_PROMO_DEALER end,
		of_fact = ISNULL(@of_fact,of_fact),
		OF_FALTA_AUTOCOLANTE_NOME = @OF_FALTA_AUTOCOLANTE_NOME, 
		OF_FALTA_PROTECCAO_PAGAIA = @OF_FALTA_PROTECCAO_PAGAIA, 
		OF_FALTA_GARRAFA = @OF_FALTA_GARRAFA, 
		OF_FALTA_PARAFUSOS = @OF_FALTA_PARAFUSOS, 
		OF_FALTA_PESOS = @OF_FALTA_PESOS, 
		OF_FALTA_TRACTION_PADS = @OF_FALTA_TRACTION_PADS, 
		OF_FALTA_FINCA_PES = @OF_FALTA_FINCA_PES, 
		OF_FALTA_BANCO = @OF_FALTA_BANCO, 
		OF_FALTA_LEME = @OF_FALTA_LEME, 
		OF_FALTA_CAPA = @OF_FALTA_CAPA, 
		OF_FALTA_TOALHA = @OF_FALTA_TOALHA,
		of_ral_main = isnull(@of_ral_main, of_ral_main), of_ral_sec = isnull(@of_ral_sec, of_ral_sec),
		OF_DUREZA_DECK = isnull(@OF_DUREZA_DECK, OF_DUREZA_DECK),
		OF_DUREZA_CASCO = isnull(@OF_DUREZA_CASCO, OF_DUREZA_CASCO),
		OF_DUREZA_PROA = isnull(@OF_DUREZA_PROA, OF_DUREZA_PROA),
		of_sensor_id_vacuo = case when @of_sensor_id_vacuo = -1 then of_sensor_id_vacuo else @of_sensor_id_vacuo end
	where
		of_id = @OF_ID

	select of_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID

	--exec OF_Pesos125 @of_id, @p500, @p375, @p100

	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @OF_ID, @OF_EOF_ID

	if @of_e_id_enc_actual <> @OF_E_ID_ENC --and exists (select offp_id from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = @OF_ID and offp_fp_id = 12 and OFFP_DATAINICIO < getdate())
		insert into 
			OF_ENTIDADE ([OFE_OF_ID], [OFE_OF_PRECOVENDA], [OFE_E_ID_ANTERIOR], [OFE_E_ID_RESPONSAVEL])
		values 
			(@OF_ID, @OF_PRECOVENDA, @of_e_id_enc_actual, isnull(@e_id_responsavel,19747))		


COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_Upd_ValorFases`(@of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2021-12-07 14:07 · modificado 2024-05-22 11:39* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`, `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Upd_ValorFases]
	@of_id int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	update ofFp set
		OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = isnull(round(case 
										when OF_ID >= 10000000 and OF_P_ID in (33672, 22665, 22809, 22613, 21021, 28866, 33671)
											then 3.5
										when OF_ID >= 10000000
											then 0.35/FP_HORA_COEF
										when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and a.novoCoef is not null
											then a.novoCoef--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and P_NOME like 'Melges%'
											then isnull(auxMelg.valor,0)--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and TP_NOME like 'Touring%'
											then coalesce(auxTur.valor,auxOutros.valor,0)--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and P_NOME like 'TR %'
											then coalesce(auxTr.valor, auxOutros.valor,0)--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and P_NOME like 'ED %' or P_NOME like 'WT %'
											then coalesce(auxCost.valor,auxOutros.valor,0)--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and (P_NOME like '%SCS%' or P_NOME like '%.7%' or P_NOME like '% FC%') and (auxOutrosSCS.valor is not null or auxOutros.valor is not null)
											then isnull(auxOutrosSCS.valor,auxOutros.valor)--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and x.offpId <> OFFP_ID 
											then 0
										when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID is null and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 
											then 0.15/FP_HORA_COEF--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID is null and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 
											then 0.25/FP_HORA_COEF--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID is null and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42) 
											then 0.20/FP_HORA_COEF--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID is null and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40) 
											then 0.50/FP_HORA_COEF--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID is null and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35) 
											then 0.75/FP_HORA_COEF--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
										when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 and (a.novoCoef is null or a.novoCoef = 0)
											then 0.75/FP_HORA_COEF
										else isnull(auxOutros.valor,0)--/isnull(nFs.n,1)
									end, 2) * case when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and OFFP_FP_ID = 35 and pa.Idd is not null then 0.5 else 1 end, 0)
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
		left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
		left join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
		left join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
		left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
		outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
						where a.OFFP_RETURN = 1 and a.OFFP_OF_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OF_ID and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID 
		left join aux_ValoresProd a on a.fpId = OFFP_FP_ID and a.pId = OF_P_ID and case when OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then a.seq else 1 end = case when OFFP_FP_ID = 3 and OFFP_ORDEM = 9 then OFFP_ORDEM else 1 end
		left join (select * from aux_ValoresProducao aux where aux.tipo like '%outros%' and aux.palavras is null and Retorno = 0) auxOutros on OFFP_FP_ID = auxOutros.faseId and NP_NOME in (select ab.Number from dbo.fn_SplitStr(auxOutros.pocos,',') ab)
		left join (select * from aux_ValoresProducao aux where aux.tipo like '%outros%' and aux.palavras like '%SCS%' and Retorno = 0) auxOutrosSCS on OFFP_FP_ID = auxOutrosSCS.faseId and NP_NOME in (select ab.Number from dbo.fn_SplitStr(auxOutrosSCS.pocos,',') ab)
		left join (select * from aux_ValoresProducao aux where aux.tipo like '%Row%' and aux.palavras is null and Retorno = 0) auxRow on OFFP_FP_ID = auxRow.faseId and NP_NOME in (select ab.Number from dbo.fn_SplitStr(auxRow.pocos,',') ab)
		left join (select * from aux_ValoresProducao aux where aux.tipo like '%Cost%' and aux.palavras is null and Retorno = 0) auxCost on OFFP_FP_ID = auxCost.faseId and NP_NOME in (select ab.Number from dbo.fn_SplitStr(auxCost.pocos,',') ab)
		left join (select * from aux_ValoresProducao aux where aux.tipo like '%Tur%' and aux.palavras is null and Retorno = 0) auxTur on OFFP_FP_ID = auxTur.faseId and NP_NOME in (select ab.Number from dbo.fn_SplitStr(auxTur.pocos,',') ab)
		left join (select * from aux_ValoresProducao aux where aux.tipo like '%Tr%' and aux.tipo not like '%outros%' and aux.palavras is null and Retorno = 0) auxTr on OFFP_FP_ID = auxTr.faseId and NP_NOME in (select ab.Number from dbo.fn_SplitStr(auxTr.pocos,',') ab)
		left join (select * from aux_ValoresProducao aux where aux.tipo like '%Melg%' and aux.palavras is null and Retorno = 0) auxMelg on OFFP_FP_ID = auxMelg.faseId 
		left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
	where
		FP_PRODUCAO = 1
		and OF_ID = @of_id
		and OFFP_FP_ID in (select distinct ax.faseId from aux_ValoresProducao ax)
		and (OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0 or OFFP_RETURN = 1)
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase`(@of_id int, @fp_id int, @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offp_peso float, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offpeq_e_id_chefe int, @offpeq_e_id int, @offp_id int, @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_peso_deck_ant float, @offp_peso_deck_dp float, @offp_peso_casco_ant float, @offp_peso_casco_dp float, @offp_offpcl_id int, @offp_horas_rep float, @offp_pinturatemp float, @offp_pinturahumid float, @of_acabcontrolo bit, @of_acabcontrolo_cris bit, @of_acerto_resina float, @of_desconta_peso bit, @offp_tpcam_id int, @fp_id_destino int, @offp_id_culpa int, @offp_culpa_obs nvarchar(max), @offp_valor_control_1 float, @offp_valor_control_2 float, @offp_valor_control_3 float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-10-28 13:42* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase]

@of_id int,
@fp_id int,
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = getdate,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null,
@offp_peso float = null,
@offp_problemas nvarchar(max) = '',
@offpeq_e_id_chefe int = null,
@offpeq_e_id int = null,
@offp_id int = null,
@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = null,
@offp_peso_deck_ant float = null,
@offp_peso_deck_dp float = null,
@offp_peso_casco_ant float = null,
@offp_peso_casco_dp float = null,
@offp_offpcl_id int = null,
@offp_horas_rep float = 0,

@offp_pinturatemp float = 0,
@offp_pinturahumid float = 0,
@of_acabcontrolo bit = 0,
@of_acabcontrolo_cris bit = 0,
@of_acerto_resina float = null,
@of_desconta_peso bit = null,
@offp_tpcam_id int = null,
@fp_id_destino int = null,
@offp_id_culpa int = null,
@offp_culpa_obs nvarchar(max) = null,

@offp_valor_control_1 float = 0,
@offp_valor_control_2 float = 0,
@offp_valor_control_3 float = 0


AS
BEGIN
	--SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@offp_id is null)
		set @offp_id = (select top 1 offp_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @fp_id and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is null order by offp_ordem)

	if (@offp_horas_rep = 0)
		set @offp_horas_rep = coalesce((select offp_horas_rep from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id),0)

	declare @fp_id_act int, @offp_id_act int, @sequencia_act int, @auto bit, @producao bit, @fim smalldatetime, @p_id int, @armazem int, @tipoMov int
	set @fp_id_act = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))

	select top 1 
		@offp_id_act = offp_id, 
		@sequencia_act = offp_ordem, 
		@auto = FP_AUTOMATICA, 
		@producao = FP_PRODUCAO, 
		@fim = offp_datafim,
		@p_id = of_p_id,
		@armazem = p_arm_id,
		@tipoMov = case when P_SAIDAS_AUTO = 1 then 1 else 7 end
	from 
		of_fp 
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
	where 
		offp_of_id = @of_id 
		and offp_fp_id = @fp_id_act 
		and offp_datafim is null 
	order by offp_ordem

	if @sequencia_act is null
		select @sequencia_act = MAX(offp_ordem) from OF_FP where offp_of_id = @of_id
	
	declare @df_anterior smalldatetime
	if @fp_id = 6
		set @df_anterior = (select offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id)

	declare @fpOrdem int
	select @fpOrdem = min(offp_ordem) from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_id and OFFP_DATAFIM is null

	-- Fecha fases anteriores nas OFs das Peças!!
	if (@of_id > 10000000 and exists(select * from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and OFFP_DATAFIM is null and OFFP_ORDEM < @fpOrdem))
		update of_fp set OFFP_DATAINICIO = @offp_datainicio, OFFP_DATAFIM = @offp_datainicio where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and OFFP_DATAFIM is null and OFFP_ORDEM < @fpOrdem

	-- Actualiza fase actual (anterior ao update)
	if @fp_id = 11
	begin
		update of_fp 
		set 
			offp_datainicio = coalesce(@offp_datainicio, getdate()), offp_datafim = @offp_datafim, 
			offp_peso = coalesce(@offp_peso, offp_peso), offp_problemas = @offp_problemas, offp_observacoes = @offp_observacoes, 
			offp_peso_deck_ant = isnull(@offp_peso_deck_ant,offp_peso_deck_ant), --(case when @offp_peso_deck_ant = 0 then offp_peso_deck_ant else @offp_peso_deck_ant end), 
			offp_peso_deck_dp = isnull(@offp_peso_deck_dp,offp_peso_deck_dp), --(case when @offp_peso_deck_dp = 0 then offp_peso_deck_dp else @offp_peso_deck_dp end), 
			offp_peso_casco_ant = isnull(@offp_peso_casco_ant,offp_peso_casco_ant), --(case when @offp_peso_casco_ant = 0 then offp_peso_casco_ant else @offp_peso_casco_ant end), 
			offp_peso_casco_dp = isnull(@offp_peso_casco_dp,offp_peso_casco_dp), --(case when @offp_peso_casco_dp = 0 then offp_peso_casco_dp else @offp_peso_casco_dp end)
			offp_offpcl_id = @offp_offpcl_id,
			offp_horas_rep = @offp_horas_rep, offp_temperatura = @offp_pinturatemp, offp_humidade = @offp_pinturahumid,
			offp_controlo = @of_acabcontrolo, offp_controlo_cris = @of_acabcontrolo_cris, offp_tpcam_id = isnull(@offp_tpcam_id, offp_tpcam_id),
			offp_valor_control_1 = @offp_valor_control_1,
			offp_valor_control_2 = @offp_valor_control_2,
			offp_valor_control_3 = @offp_valor_control_3
		where 
			offp_id = @offp_id
	end
	else
	begin
		if (@auto = 1 and @fim is null) -- and @fp_id_act <> @fp_id
				update of_fp set offp_datafim = coalesce(@offp_datainicio,getdate()) where offp_id = @offp_id_act

		if (@offp_id is not null)
			update of_fp 
			set 
				offp_datainicio = @offp_datainicio, offp_datafim = @offp_datafim, 
				offp_peso = coalesce(@offp_peso, offp_peso), offp_problemas = @offp_problemas, offp_observacoes = @offp_observacoes, 
				offp_peso_deck_ant = isnull(@offp_peso_deck_ant,offp_peso_deck_ant), --(case when @offp_peso_deck_ant = 0 then offp_peso_deck_ant else @offp_peso_deck_ant end), 
				offp_peso_deck_dp = isnull(@offp_peso_deck_dp,offp_peso_deck_dp), --(case when @offp_peso_deck_dp = 0 then offp_peso_deck_dp else @offp_peso_deck_dp end), 
				offp_peso_casco_ant = isnull(@offp_peso_casco_ant,offp_peso_casco_ant), --(case when @offp_peso_casco_ant = 0 then offp_peso_casco_ant else @offp_peso_casco_ant end), 
				offp_peso_casco_dp = isnull(@offp_peso_casco_dp,offp_peso_casco_dp), --(case when @offp_peso_casco_dp = 0 then offp_peso_casco_dp else @offp_peso_casco_dp end)
				offp_offpcl_id = @offp_offpcl_id,
				offp_horas_rep = @offp_horas_rep, offp_temperatura = @offp_pinturatemp, offp_humidade = @offp_pinturahumid,
				offp_controlo = @of_acabcontrolo, offp_controlo_cris = @of_acabcontrolo_cris, offp_tpcam_id = isnull(@offp_tpcam_id, offp_tpcam_id),
				offp_valor_control_1 = @offp_valor_control_1,
				offp_valor_control_2 = @offp_valor_control_2,
				offp_valor_control_3 = @offp_valor_control_3
			where 
				offp_id = @offp_id
		else
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem > @sequencia_act
		
			insert into of_fp (offp_fp_id, offp_of_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes, offp_peso_deck_ant, offp_peso_deck_dp, offp_peso_casco_ant, offp_peso_casco_dp, offp_offpcl_id, offp_horas_rep, 
								offp_temperatura, offp_humidade, offp_controlo, offp_controlo_cris, offp_ordem, offp_planeamento) 
							(select @fp_id, @of_id, @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, isnull(@offp_peso,0), @offp_problemas, @offp_observacoes, isnull(@offp_peso_deck_ant,0), isnull(@offp_peso_deck_dp,0), isnull(@offp_peso_casco_ant,0), isnull(@offp_peso_casco_dp,0), @offp_offpcl_id, @offp_horas_rep, 
								@offp_pinturatemp, @offp_pinturahumid, @of_acabcontrolo, @of_acabcontrolo_cris, @sequencia_act + 1, fp_planeamento from fases_producao where fp_id = @fp_id)
		end

		-- Actualiza fase seguinte (dp do update)
		if @offp_datafim is not null
		begin
			set @fp_id_act = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))
			select top 1 @offp_id_act = offp_id, @sequencia_act = offp_ordem, @auto = fp_automatica, @producao = fp_producao, @fim = offp_datafim from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id_act and offp_datafim is null order by offp_ordem
	
			if (@auto = 1)
				update of_fp set offp_datainicio = coalesce(@offp_datafim,getdate()) where offp_id = @offp_id_act 
		end
	end
			
	if ((len(@offp_problemas) > 0 and @fp_id between 1 and 7) or @offp_offpcl_id is not null)
		update ordemfabrico set of_supervisao = 1, of_acerto_resina = coalesce(@of_acerto_resina, of_acerto_resina,0) where of_id = @of_id
	else if @fp_id in (8,9)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico 
		set 
			of_datafim = (case when @fp_id = 8 then @offp_datafim else @offp_datainicio end), --(case when (@fp_id = 8 and @offp_datafim is not null) or (@fp_id = 9 and @offp_datainicio is not null) then coalesce(of_datafim,getdate()) else of_datafim end), 
			of_acerto_resina = coalesce(@of_acerto_resina, of_acerto_resina,0) 
		where 
			of_id = @of_id

		if (@fp_id = 8) 
			exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_ValorFases @of_id
	end
	else if @of_acerto_resina is not null or @of_desconta_peso is not null
		update ordemfabrico set of_acerto_resina = coalesce(@of_acerto_resina,of_acerto_resina), of_desconta_peso = coalesce(@of_desconta_peso,of_desconta_peso) where of_id = @of_id



	/*Chefe*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id_chefe, 1, @fp_id, @offp_id

	/*Assistente*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 0, @fp_id, @offp_id

	if @fp_id = 6
	begin
		declare @offp_of_id_mld int
		select top 1 @offp_of_id_mld = offp_of_id_mld from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 1 order by offp_datafim desc

		if @df_anterior is null and @offp_datafim is not null
		begin
			update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil + 1 where of_id = @offp_of_id_mld
		end
		else if @offp_datafim is null and @df_anterior is not null
		begin
			update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil - 1 where of_id = @offp_of_id_mld
		end
	end

	if @fp_id_destino is not null
	begin
		if @fp_id_destino <> 50
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem > @sequencia_act
			
			declare @offp_id_destino int 
			select top 1 @offp_id_destino = offp_id from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_id_destino and offp_datafim is null

			if @offp_id_destino is null
				insert into of_fp (offp_fp_id, offp_of_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes, offp_peso_deck_ant, offp_peso_deck_dp, offp_peso_casco_ant, offp_peso_casco_dp, offp_offpcl_id, offp_horas_rep, 
								offp_temperatura, offp_humidade, offp_controlo, offp_controlo_cris, offp_ordem, offp_planeamento) 
							(select @fp_id_destino, @of_id, getdate(), null, 0, '', '', 0, 0, 0, 0, @offp_offpcl_id, 0, 
								0, 0, 0, 0, @sequencia_act + 1, fp_planeamento from fases_producao where fp_id = @fp_id)
			else
				update of_fp set offp_datainicio = isnull(offp_datainicio,getdate()) where offp_id = @offp_id_destino
		end

		declare @precocusto float 
		select @precocusto = isnull(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(@p_id, null),0)

		if @fp_id_destino = 9 --Armazem
		begin
			exec Entradas_Fornecedores_Add 
						@mov_data = @offp_datafim
						, @mov_datasaida = null
						, @mov_p_id = @p_id
						, @mov_quantidade = 1
						, @mov_precounitario = @precocusto
						, @mov_observacoes = 'Entrada de finalização de OF'
						, @mov_e_id = null
						, @mov_desconto = 0
						, @mov_tpmov_id = @tipoMov
						, @mov_arm_id = @armazem
						, @mov_e_id_responsavel = @offpeq_e_id_chefe
						, @of_id = @of_id
		end
		else if @fp_id_destino = 49 --2ª escolha
		begin
			update OF_FP set OFFP_RETURN = 1, OFFP_PROBLEMAS = @offp_culpa_obs where OFFP_ID = @offp_id_culpa
		end
		else if @fp_id_destino = 50 --Lixo
		begin
			declare @fpId int 
			select top 1 @fpId = offp_fp_id from OF_FP where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id order by OFFP_ORDEM

			exec OrdemFabrico_AddFase @of_id = @of_id, @fp_id = @fpId, @offp_return = 1, @offp_offp_id_return = @offp_id_culpa, @coefTempo = 1, @offp_problemas = @offp_culpa_obs
		end
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase_Teste`(@of_id int, @fp_id int, @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offp_peso float, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offpeq_e_id_chefe int, @offpeq_e_id int, @offp_id int, @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_peso_deck_ant float, @offp_peso_deck_dp float, @offp_peso_casco_ant float, @offp_peso_casco_dp float, @offp_offpcl_id int, @offp_horas_rep float, @offp_pinturatemp float, @offp_pinturahumid float, @of_acabcontrolo bit, @of_acabcontrolo_cris bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase_Teste]

@of_id int,
@fp_id int,
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime,
@offp_peso float = 0.0,
@offp_problemas nvarchar(max) = '',
@offpeq_e_id_chefe int = null,
@offpeq_e_id int = null,
@offp_id int = null,
@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = null,
@offp_peso_deck_ant float = 0,
@offp_peso_deck_dp float = 0,
@offp_peso_casco_ant float = 0,
@offp_peso_casco_dp float = 0,
@offp_offpcl_id int = null,
@offp_horas_rep float = 0,

@offp_pinturatemp float = 0,
@offp_pinturahumid float = 0,
@of_acabcontrolo bit = 0,
@of_acabcontrolo_cris bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@offp_id is null) -- qd tem mais q uma fase da mm?!?!!?!?!?
		set @offp_id = (select top 1 offp_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @fp_id and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is null order by offp_ordem)

	if (@offp_horas_rep = 0)
		set @offp_horas_rep = (select offp_horas_rep from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id)

	declare @fp_id_act int, @offp_id_act int, @sequencia_act int, @auto bit, @producao bit, @fim smalldatetime
	set @fp_id_act = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))
	select @offp_id_act = offp_id, @sequencia_act = offp_ordem, @auto = fp_automatica, @producao = fp_producao, @fim = offp_datafim from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id_act
	
	-- Actualiza fase actual (anterior ao update)
	if (@auto = 1 and @fim is null)
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = coalesce(@offp_datainicio,getdate()) where offp_id = @offp_id_act

	if (@offp_id is not null)
		update of_fp 
		set 
			offp_datainicio = @offp_datainicio, offp_datafim = @offp_datafim, 
			offp_peso = coalesce(@offp_peso, 0), offp_problemas = @offp_problemas, offp_observacoes = @offp_observacoes, 
			offp_peso_deck_ant = @offp_peso_deck_ant, --(case when @offp_peso_deck_ant = 0 then offp_peso_deck_ant else @offp_peso_deck_ant end), 
			offp_peso_deck_dp = @offp_peso_deck_dp, --(case when @offp_peso_deck_dp = 0 then offp_peso_deck_dp else @offp_peso_deck_dp end), 
			offp_peso_casco_ant = @offp_peso_casco_ant, --(case when @offp_peso_casco_ant = 0 then offp_peso_casco_ant else @offp_peso_casco_ant end), 
			offp_peso_casco_dp = @offp_peso_casco_dp, --(case when @offp_peso_casco_dp = 0 then offp_peso_casco_dp else @offp_peso_casco_dp end)
			offp_offpcl_id = @offp_offpcl_id,
			offp_horas_rep = @offp_horas_rep, offp_temperatura = @offp_pinturatemp, offp_humidade = @offp_pinturahumid,
			offp_controlo = @of_acabcontrolo, offp_controlo_cris = @of_acabcontrolo_cris
		where 
			offp_id = @offp_id
	else
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem > @sequencia_act
		
		insert into of_fp (offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_peso, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes, offp_peso_deck_ant, offp_peso_deck_dp, offp_peso_casco_ant, offp_peso_casco_dp, offp_offpcl_id, offp_horas_rep, 
							offp_temperatura, offp_humidade, offp_controlo, offp_controlo_cris, offp_ordem) values
						(@offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_peso, @offp_problemas, @offp_observacoes, @offp_peso_deck_ant, @offp_peso_deck_dp, @offp_peso_casco_ant, @offp_peso_casco_dp, @offp_offpcl_id, @offp_horas_rep, 
							@offp_pinturatemp, @offp_pinturahumid, @of_acabcontrolo, @of_acabcontrolo_cris, @sequencia_act + 1)
	end

	-- Actualiza fase seguinte (dp do update)
	if @offp_datafim is not null
	begin
		set @fp_id_act = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))
		select @offp_id_act = offp_id, @sequencia_act = offp_ordem, @auto = fp_automatica, @producao = fp_producao, @fim = offp_datafim from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id_act

		if @auto = 1
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = coalesce(@offp_datainicio,getdate()) where offp_id = @offp_id_act 
	end

	if ((len(@offp_problemas) > 0 and @fp_id between 1 and 7) or @offp_offpcl_id is not null)
		update ordemfabrico set of_supervisao = 1 where of_id = @of_id

	/*Chefe*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id_chefe, 1, @fp_id, @offp_id

	/*Assistente*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 0, @fp_id, @offp_id


END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase_V01`(@of_id int, @fp_id int, @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @offp_peso float, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offpeq_e_id_chefe int, @offpeq_e_id int, @offp_id int, @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @offp_peso_deck_ant float, @offp_peso_deck_dp float, @offp_peso_casco_ant float, @offp_peso_casco_dp float, @offp_offpcl_id int, @offp_horas_rep float, @offp_pinturatemp float, @offp_pinturahumid float, @of_acabcontrolo bit, @of_acabcontrolo_cris bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase_V01]

@of_id int,
@fp_id int,
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime,
@offp_peso float,
@offp_problemas nvarchar(max),
@offpeq_e_id_chefe int,
@offpeq_e_id int,
@offp_id int = null,
@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = null,
@offp_peso_deck_ant float = 0,
@offp_peso_deck_dp float = 0,
@offp_peso_casco_ant float = 0,
@offp_peso_casco_dp float = 0,
@offp_offpcl_id int = null,
@offp_horas_rep float = 0,

@offp_pinturatemp float = 0,
@offp_pinturahumid float = 0,
@of_acabcontrolo bit = 0,
@of_acabcontrolo_cris bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@offp_id is null)
		set @offp_id = (select offp_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @fp_id and offp_of_id = @of_id)

	if (@offp_horas_rep = 0)
		set @offp_horas_rep = (select offp_horas_rep from of_fp where offp_id = @offp_id)

--	if (@offp_offpcl_id is null)
--		set @offp_offpcl_id = (select offp_offpcl_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @fp_id and offp_of_id = @of_id)

    update of_fp 
	set 
		offp_datainicio = @offp_datainicio, offp_datafim = @offp_datafim, 
		offp_peso = coalesce(@offp_peso, 0), offp_problemas = @offp_problemas, offp_observacoes = @offp_observacoes, 
		offp_peso_deck_ant = @offp_peso_deck_ant, --(case when @offp_peso_deck_ant = 0 then offp_peso_deck_ant else @offp_peso_deck_ant end), 
		offp_peso_deck_dp = @offp_peso_deck_dp, --(case when @offp_peso_deck_dp = 0 then offp_peso_deck_dp else @offp_peso_deck_dp end), 
		offp_peso_casco_ant = @offp_peso_casco_ant, --(case when @offp_peso_casco_ant = 0 then offp_peso_casco_ant else @offp_peso_casco_ant end), 
		offp_peso_casco_dp = @offp_peso_casco_dp, --(case when @offp_peso_casco_dp = 0 then offp_peso_casco_dp else @offp_peso_casco_dp end)
		offp_offpcl_id = @offp_offpcl_id,
		offp_horas_rep = @offp_horas_rep, offp_temperatura = @offp_pinturatemp, offp_humidade = @offp_pinturahumid,
		offp_controlo = @of_acabcontrolo, offp_controlo_cris = @of_acabcontrolo_cris
	where 
		offp_id = @offp_id

	if ((len(@offp_problemas) > 0 and @fp_id between 1 and 7) or @offp_offpcl_id is not null)
		update ordemfabrico set of_supervisao = 1 where of_id = @of_id


	if (@fp_id = 18) --Pintura
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = @offp_datainicio where offp_fp_id = 11 and offp_of_id = @of_id
	else if (@fp_id = 1) -- Laminagem
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_fp_id = 2 and offp_of_id = @of_id
	else if (@fp_id = 2) -- Estufa
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_fp_id = 6 and offp_of_id = @of_id
	else if (@fp_id = 6) -- Desmolde/Desmolde
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_fp_id = 3 and offp_of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@fp_id = 3) -- Pq./Corte
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = @offp_datainicio where offp_fp_id = 6 and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is null
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_fp_id = 7 and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datainicio is null
	end
	--else if (@fp_id = 4) -- Colagem
	--begin
	--	update of_fp set offp_datafim = @offp_datainicio where offp_fp_id in (3,5) and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is null -- "Parque/Corte" ou "Parque Molde/Pintura Acabamento"

	--	if exists(select * from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is not null)
	--		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_fp_id = 7 and offp_of_id = @of_id
	--end
	--else if (@fp_id = 5) -- Parque Molde/Pintura Acabamento
	--begin
	--	update of_fp set offp_datafim = @offp_datainicio where offp_fp_id in (3,4) and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is null -- "Parque/Corte" ou "Parque Molde/Pintura Acabamento"

	--	if exists(select * from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 4 and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is not null)
	--		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_fp_id = 7 and offp_of_id = @of_id
	--end
	--else if (@fp_id = 22) -- Parque Desmolde/Lixagem
	--begin
	--	update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_fp_id = 7 and offp_of_id = @of_id
	--end
	else if (@fp_id = 8 or @fp_id = 22) -- Acabamento/Lixagem
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = @offp_datainicio where offp_fp_id = 7 and offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_datafim is null

		declare @id int

		if exists(select * from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 9 and offp_of_id = @of_id)
		begin
			set @id = (select min(offp_id) from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 9 and offp_of_id = @of_id)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_id = @id
		end
		else if exists(select * from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 15 and offp_of_id = @of_id)
		begin
			set @id = (select min(offp_id) from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 15 and offp_of_id = @of_id)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_id = @id
		end
	end


	/*Chefe*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id_chefe, 1, @fp_id, @offp_id

	/*Assistente*/ 
		exec OrdemFabrico_Upd_EmpregadoFase @of_id, @offpeq_e_id, 0, @fp_id, @offp_id


END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_UpdStandards`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-11-29 13:40* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `v_of`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_UpdStandards]

@p_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare cur_OFsEmCurso cursor for
	select distinct of_id from ordemfabrico inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id where of_p_id = @p_id and fp_sequencia < dbo.fase_Sequencia_Armazem() and FP_PRODUCAO = 1

	OPEN cur_OFsEmCurso
	DECLARE @of_id int

	fetch next from cur_OFsEmCurso into @of_id while @@fetch_status=0
	begin

			--with movimentos (movid) as
			--(
			--	select mov_id from produto inner join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_id inner join movimento on comp_p_p_id = mov_p_id 
			--													where p_id = @p_id and mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id not in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id in (10,11,12,14,62,74,81,84,134,135,65))
			--	union all
			--	select mov_id from movimentos inner join movimento on movid=mov_mov_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
			--)

			create table #tt (movid int, lvl int)

			declare @counter int
			set @counter = 0 

			insert into #tt (movid, lvl) (select mov_id, @counter from produto_componente inner join movimento on comp_p_p_id = mov_p_id 
										where comp_p_id = @p_id and mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_atrib_id is null) --and mov_p_id not in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id in (10,11,12,14,62,74,81,84,134,135,65)))

			while @@ROWCOUNT > 0
			begin
				SET @counter = @counter + 1

				insert into #tt (movid, lvl) (select mov_id, @counter from #tt inner join movimento on movid=mov_mov_id where lvl = @counter - 1)
			end

			delete movimento from movimento inner join #tt on mov_id = movid

			exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards @of_id, @p_id, null
		
			drop table #tt

	fetch next from cur_OFsEmCurso into @of_id

	end

	close cur_OFsEmCurso
	deallocate cur_OFsEmCurso

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte`(@of_id int, @data_ins smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_VerificaDataTransporte]

@of_id int,
@data_ins smalldatetime = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


declare @data_ant smalldatetime

select @data_ant = tr_data from ordemfabrico inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id where of_id = @of_id

if (@data_ant <> @data_ins) or (@data_ant is null and @data_ins is not null) or (@data_ant is not null and @data_ins is null)
begin
	if (datepart(ww,@data_ant) = datepart(ww,getdate()) and year(@data_ant) = year(getdate())) and (datepart(ww,@data_ins) <> datepart(ww,getdate()) or @data_ins is null)
	begin
		-- Saiu
		if exists(select alarm_id from alarm where alarm_of_id = @of_id and alarm_descricao like '*' + convert(char(10),@data_ant, 105) + '*' and alarm_talarm_id = 1 and datediff(n, alarm_data, getdate()) <= 60) 
		begin
			delete from alarm where alarm_of_id = @of_id and alarm_descricao like '*' + convert(char(10),@data_ant, 105) + '*' and alarm_talarm_id = 1 and datediff(n, alarm_data, getdate()) <= 60
		end
		else
		begin
			insert into alarm (ALARM_DESCRICAO, ALARM_DISPENSADO, ALARM_DATA, ALARM_OF_ID, ALARM_TALARM_ID)
			values ('*' + convert(char(10),@data_ant, 105) + '*', 0, getdate(), @of_id, 2)
		end
	end
	else if (datepart(ww,@data_ins) = datepart(ww,getdate()) and year(@data_ins) = year(getdate())) and (datepart(ww,@data_ant) <> datepart(ww,getdate()) or @data_ant is null)
	begin
		-- Entrou
		insert into alarm (ALARM_DESCRICAO, ALARM_DISPENSADO, ALARM_DATA, ALARM_OF_ID, ALARM_TALARM_ID)
		values ('*' + convert(char(10),@data_ins, 105) + '*', 0, getdate(), @of_id, 1)
	end
end

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabrico_VerificaOFs_Associados`(@of_id int, @OF_EOF_ID int, @OF_DATA smalldatetime, @OF_E_ID_ENC int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-04-14 14:38* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `custo`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_VerificaOFs_Associados]
 
	@of_id int,
	@OF_EOF_ID int,
	@OF_DATA smalldatetime,
	@OF_E_ID_ENC int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	/*** 16/01/2023 Nuno A.: comentei tudo para parar de gerar OFs, passa-se a gerar só no planeamento ***/
	/*** 14/04/2025 Nuno A.: descomentei tudo para gerar OFs dos barcos Dragão (petticrows) ***/

	if (select of_p_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id) = 41876
	begin
	if exists (select mov_id from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_of_id = @of_id and p_gera_of = 1)
		begin
			declare @ttt table(mov_id int, mov_p_id int, p_id_c int, cust float, vend float, qtd int, visto bit default 0)
			insert into @ttt (mov_id, mov_p_id, p_id_c, cust, vend, qtd) 
						(select 
							mov_id, 
							mov_p_id,
							p_p_id,
							case when p_fabricointerno = 1
								then dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id,null)
								else p_precocusto 
							end,
							p_precovenda ,
							mov_quantidade
						from 
							movimento 
							inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
						where 
							mov_of_id = @of_id 
							and p_gera_of = 1)

			declare @movid int, @p_id int, @p_id_cons int, @of_id_pai nvarchar(max), @custo float, @venda float, @qtd int, @xxx int

			set @of_id_pai = 'Gerada a partir da OF:  ' + cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max))

			while exists(select * from @ttt where visto = 0)
			begin
				select top 1
					@movid = mov_id, 
					@p_id = mov_p_id, 
					@p_id_cons= p_id_c, 
					@custo = cust, 
					@venda = vend,
					@qtd = qtd
				from @ttt
				where
					visto = 0
				while @qtd > 0
				begin
					EXEC @xxx = [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Add_V2]
						@OF_EOF_ID = @OF_EOF_ID,
						@OF_DATA = @OF_DATA,
						@OF_E_ID_ENC = @OF_E_ID_ENC,
						@OF_P_ID = @p_id,
						@OF_P_ID_CONST = @p_id_cons,
						@OF_OBSERVACOES = @of_id_pai,
						@OF_MORADAENTREGA = N'',
						@OF_REFERENCIA = @of_id_pai,
						@OF_PRECOCUSTO = @custo, 
						@OF_PRECOVENDA = @venda,
						@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO = NULL, @OF_E_ID = NULL,@OF_OF_ID_MLD = NULL,	@OF_TELEFONE = NULL, @OF_EMAIL = NULL, @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC = NULL, @OF_ENC_ID = NULL,
						@OF_DESCONTO = 0,@OF_VALORPAGO = 0,@OF_PAGO = 0,@OF_AUTOCOLANTES = N'',	@OF_EMBALAGEM = NULL,@OF_OFTU_ID = NULL,@OF_SUPERVISAO = 0,	@OF_DATAINICIO = NULL,
						@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM = 0,@OF_TURN_ID = NULL,	@OF_TR_ID = NULL,@OF_CRIADOR = N'',@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = NULL,@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = NULL,
						@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = NULL,	@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = NULL,	@OF_P_ID_QUINAS = NULL,	@OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR = NULL,	@OF_P_ID_GOLA = NULL,	@OF_ACABCONTROLO = 0,
						@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS = 0,	@of_transp = 0,	@of_paraalterar = 0,@of_id_copy = NULL,	@of_nome = NULL, @of_of_id_mae = @of_id

					set @qtd = @qtd - 1 
				end
				update @ttt set visto = 1 where mov_id = @movid
			end
		end
	end		
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabricoMoldes_Add`(@of_p_id int, @const_id int, @of_p_id_cdeck int, @of_p_id_ccasco int, @of_observacoes nvarchar(max), @of_data smalldatetime, @of_eof_id int, @of_of_id_mld int, @of_nome nvarchar(max), @of_molde_acessorio bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabricoMoldes_Add]

@of_p_id int,
@const_id int,
@of_p_id_cdeck int = null,
@of_p_id_ccasco int = null,
@of_observacoes nvarchar(max),
@of_data smalldatetime,
@of_eof_id int,
@of_of_id_mld int = null,
@of_nome nvarchar(max),
@of_molde_acessorio bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if not exists (select * from ordemfabrico where of_nome = @of_nome)
begin
	
	declare @of_id int, @intervalo_inicio int, @intervalo_fim int

	select @intervalo_inicio = intervalo_inicio, @intervalo_fim = intervalo_fim 
		from intervalo inner join produto_tipo on intervalo_tp_id = tp_id
			 inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id
		where p_id = @OF_P_ID

	set @of_id = coalesce(((select max(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_id between @intervalo_inicio and @intervalo_fim) + 1), @intervalo_inicio)

    insert into ordemfabrico (of_id, of_nome, of_p_id, of_p_id_cdeck, of_p_id_ccasco, of_observacoes, of_data, of_fp_id, of_of_id_mld, of_molde_acessorio, of_e_id_enc)
		values (@of_id, @of_nome, @of_p_id, @of_p_id_cdeck, @of_p_id_ccasco, @of_observacoes, @of_data, @of_eof_id, @of_of_id_mld, @of_molde_acessorio, 19747)

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @const_id, 1, @of_id, 84

	select id = @of_id


/*Cria Registos das Fases de Producao*/
if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id = @of_p_id) = 82)
begin
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, offp_planeamento) (select @of_id, fp_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY fp_sequencia ASC), (case when fp_id = 1 then 1 else 0 end) from fases_producao where fp_id in (11,21,1,2,7,8,15))
end
else
	insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem, offp_planeamento) (select @of_id, fp_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY fp_sequencia ASC), (case when fp_id = 1 then 1 else 0 end) from fases_producao where fp_id in (11,21,20,1,2,7,8,15))

/*Actualiza fases de Producao*/
declare @d as smalldatetime
set @d = getdate()
	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @OF_ID, 11, @d, NULL, 0, '', NULL, NULL
end
else
	raiserror('Já existe uma OF com esse Nome..!', 16, 1)

END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabricoMoldes_Lista_Detalhe`(@of_id int)

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabricoMoldes_Lista_Detalhe]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN

    select

		o.of_fp_id,
		o.of_nome,

		o.of_p_id_ccasco,
		o.of_observacoes,
		o.of_of_id_mld,
		(case when o1.of_id is null then convert(bit, 0) else convert(bit, 1) end) as Ocup,
		o.of_molde_acessorio,
		o.of_peso_deck,
		o.of_peso_casco
	from
		ordemfabrico as o left join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_id = o1.of_of_id_mld and convert(varchar(10), o1.of_datainicio, 105) = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 105) left join
		movimento on o.of_id = mov_of_id and mov_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 84) inner join
		produto as p1 on o.of_p_id = p1.p_id
	where
		o.of_id = @of_id
	order by mov_p_id desc
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabricoMoldes_Lista_DetalheFases`(@of_id int)
