```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabricoMoldes_Lista_DetalheFases]

@of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		offp_id, 
		offp_datainicio, 
		offp_datafim, 
		eq.offpeq_e_id as offpeq_e_id_chefe,
		eq1.offpeq_e_id as offpeq_e_id,
		offp_problemas, 
		offp_peso,
		offp_fp_id
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id left join
		offp_eq as eq on offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
		offp_eq as eq1 on offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 0
	where
		of_id = @of_id
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabricoMoldes_Lista_Matrizes`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabricoMoldes_Lista_Matrizes]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		of_id, (case when of_fp_id = 13 then '(PR) ' + of_nome
					 when of_fp_id = 14 then '(R) ' + of_nome
					 when of_fp_id = 15 then of_nome
					 when of_fp_id = 16 then '(PA) ' + of_nome
					 when of_fp_id = 17 then '(A) ' + of_nome end) as of_nome, p_np_id, p_m_id, p_tam_id 
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
	where 
		p_tp_id = 83 and of_fp_id in (13,14,15,16,17)
	union
	select null as of_id, ' ' as of_nome, null as p_np_id, null as p_m_id, null as p_tam_id order by of_id
END
```

#### `dbo.OrdemFabricoMoldes_Upd`(@of_id nvarchar(max), @of_p_id int, @const_id int, @of_p_id_cdeck int, @of_p_id_ccasco int, @of_observacoes nvarchar(max), @of_data smalldatetime, @of_eof_id int, @of_of_id_mld int, @of_nome nvarchar(max), @of_molde_acessorio bit, @of_peso_casco float, @of_peso_deck float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[OrdemFabricoMoldes_Upd]

@of_id nvarchar(max),
@of_p_id int,
@const_id int,
@of_p_id_cdeck int = null,
@of_p_id_ccasco int = null,
@of_observacoes nvarchar(max),
@of_data smalldatetime,
@of_eof_id int,
@of_of_id_mld int = null,
@of_nome nvarchar(max),
@of_molde_acessorio bit = 0,
@of_peso_casco float = null,
@of_peso_deck float = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if not exists(select * from ordemfabrico where of_id <> @of_id and of_nome = @of_nome and of_id between 70000 and 89999)
begin

declare @of_fp_id int
set @of_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	if (@OF_EOF_ID in (11,20,21,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,33,8))
		set @OF_EOF_ID = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@OF_ID)
	else if (@of_fp_id <> @OF_EOF_ID)
	begin
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @of_fp_id and offp_datafim is null

		if exists (select * from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID and offp_datainicio is null)
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @OF_EOF_ID
		else
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, @OF_EOF_ID, getdate())
	end

	declare @of_p_id_ant int,
			@of_p_id_cdeck_ant int,
			@of_p_id_ccasco_ant int

	select @of_p_id_ant = of_p_id, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant = of_p_id_cdeck, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant = of_p_id_ccasco from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id

	update ordemfabrico
	set
		of_nome = @of_nome,
		of_p_id = @of_p_id, 
		of_p_id_cdeck = @of_p_id_cdeck, 
		of_p_id_ccasco = @of_p_id_ccasco, 
		of_observacoes = @of_observacoes, 
		of_data = @of_data, 
		of_fp_id = @of_eof_id,
		of_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld,
		of_molde_acessorio = @of_molde_acessorio,
		of_peso_casco = isnull(@of_peso_casco,of_peso_casco),
		of_peso_deck = isnull(@of_peso_deck, of_peso_deck)
	where
		of_id = @of_id

	--Actualiza pesos do "molde antes" nas OFs com este molde atribuido e q n têm a Pintura concluida
	update 
		offp1
	set 
		offp1.offp_peso_deck_ant = isnull(@of_peso_deck,offp.offp_peso_deck_ant),
		offp1.offp_peso_casco_ant = isnull(@of_peso_casco,offp.offp_peso_casco_ant)
	from
		of_fp offp
		inner join of_fp offp1 on offp.offp_of_id = offp1.offp_of_id and offp1.offp_fp_id = 18
	where
		offp.offp_of_id_mld = @of_id
		and offp1.offp_datafim is null

	select fp = @of_eof_id

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddStandards @of_id, @of_p_id, @of_p_id_ant

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @const_id, 1, @of_id, 84

	declare @qtd_deck float, 
			@qtd_casco float
	select @qtd_deck = coalesce(p_qtddeck,0), @qtd_casco = coalesce(p_qtdcasco,0) from produto where p_id = @OF_P_ID

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CDECK, @qtd_deck, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_cdeck_ant

	exec OrdemFabrico_AddCores @OF_P_ID_CCASCO, @qtd_casco, @OF_ID, @of_p_id_ccasco_ant

	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @of_eof_id

end
else
	raiserror('Já existe uma OF com esse Nome..!',16,1)

END
```

#### `dbo.Pecas_Producao`(@data_inicio date, @data_fim date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-01-13 14:05 · modificado 2020-01-13 14:05* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		NR
-- Create date: 
-- Description:	Peças produzidas entre datas
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE Pecas_Producao 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@data_inicio date = NULL, 
	@data_fim date = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT        dbo.PRODUTO_TIPO.TP_NOME, dbo.PRODUTO.P_NOME, SUM(CASE WHEN of_fp_id = 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Por_Fazer, SUM(CASE WHEN of_fp_id = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Corte, 
                         SUM(CASE WHEN of_fp_id = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Armazem, SUM(CASE WHEN of_fp_id = 49 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Armazem_2_Escolha, SUM(CASE WHEN of_fp_id = 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Lixo, count(of_id) as Previsto
	FROM            dbo.ORDEMFABRICO INNER JOIN
							 dbo.PRODUTO ON dbo.PRODUTO.P_ID = dbo.ORDEMFABRICO.OF_P_ID INNER JOIN
							 dbo.LISTA_PRODUTO ON dbo.PRODUTO.P_ID = dbo.LISTA_PRODUTO.LP_P_ID AND dbo.LISTA_PRODUTO.LP_L_ID = 32 INNER JOIN
							 dbo.FASES_PRODUCAO ON dbo.ORDEMFABRICO.OF_FP_ID = dbo.FASES_PRODUCAO.FP_ID INNER JOIN
							 dbo.PRODUTO_TIPO ON dbo.PRODUTO.P_TP_ID = dbo.PRODUTO_TIPO.TP_ID INNER JOIN
							 OF_FP ON OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID AND OFFP_FP_ID = 36
	WHERE        (dbo.ORDEMFABRICO.OF_FP_ID IN (3, 9, 49, 36, 50))
		AND (OFFP_DATAFIM BETWEEN @data_inicio AND @data_fim OR offp_datafim IS NULL OR OFFP_DATAFIM = '') AND OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA BETWEEN @data_inicio AND @data_fim
	GROUP BY dbo.PRODUTO_TIPO.TP_NOME, dbo.PRODUTO.P_NOME
END
```

#### `dbo.Pedido_Del`(@fornecedorId int, @pedidoId int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2024-06-21 11:00 · modificado 2024-06-21 13:13*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Pedido_Del]
	@fornecedorId int, 
	@pedidoId int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    update movimento set mov_mov_id = null
	from
		movimento 
	where
		MOV_ID_PEDIDO = @pedidoId
		and MOV_E_ID = @fornecedorId
		and mov_tpmov_id = 1

	delete
	from
		movimento 
	where
		MOV_ID_PEDIDO = @pedidoId
		and MOV_E_ID = @fornecedorId
		and mov_tpmov_id = 9		
		
	delete
	from 
		pedidos
	where
		PED_ID = @pedidoId
		and ped_e_id = @fornecedorId
END
```

#### `dbo.Pedidos_TrocaProduto`(@movId int, @produtoId int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2024-09-09 15:26 · modificado 2024-09-09 15:55*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE Pedidos_TrocaProduto
	@movId int, 
	@produtoId int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @movQtd float, @pedidoId int = 0, @entidadeId int = 0

	select
		@pedidoId = MOV_ID_PEDIDO,
		@entidadeId = MOV_E_ID,
		@movQtd = MOV_QUANTIDADE
	from
		MOVIMENTO
	where
		MOV_ID = @movId

	exec Inventario_Del_Movimento @movId

	insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_p_id, mov_quantidade, mov_tpmov_id, mov_id_pedido, mov_e_id)
	select
		getdate(),
		@produtoId,
		@movQtd,
		12,
		@pedidoId,
		@entidadeId
	union
	select
		getdate(),
		COMP_P_P_ID,
		@movQtd * comp_quantidade,
		12,
		@pedidoId,
		@entidadeId
	from
		produto_componente 
	where
		comp_p_id = @produtoId
	and comp_tpcomp_id = 1
END
```

#### `dbo.Performance_Func_Agrup_v2`(@eid int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-01-10 11:27 · modificado 2021-04-22 14:30* · 🔎 `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Performance_Func_Agrup_v2]

	@eid int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @di date = dateadd(DAY,(datepart(DAY,getdate())-1)*-1,getdate()), 
			@df date = getdate(), 
			@hi nvarchar(max) = ' 08:00', 
			@hf nvarchar(max) = ' ' + cast(datepart(hour,getdate()) as nvarchar(max)) + ':00'

	declare @xx TABLE 
	(
		e_id int,
		e_nome nvarchar(max),
		barcos int,
		rtns int,
		culpado int,
		ret_Provocados int,
		totHoras int,
		absentismo float,
		ganho_Produtivo float,
		percent_Retornos float,
		produtividade float,
		premio float,
		ord int
	)

    declare @t table(barcos float, extPint float, extDesm float, coefs float, 
				rtns int, culpado float, tot float, totRet_New int, e_nome nvarchar(max), 
				e_id int, fp_id int, fp nvarchar(max), fp_sequencia int, faltas float, 
				h_Ext float, h_trb float, aj_ext float, h_Perdidas float, equipa int, 
				fp_hora_coef float, hProdTotal float, total_OFs int, total_Retornos int, total_RetornosCulpado int, 
				e_fp_id int, ret_Provocados float, tempo_a_descontar float, ferias float, temp float, 
				faseFunc nvarchar(max), seqFunc int, barcosComErros int, baixas float)

	insert into @t (barcos, extPint, extDesm, coefs, rtns, culpado, tot, totRet_New, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp, fp_sequencia, faltas, h_Ext, h_trb, aj_ext, h_Perdidas, equipa, fp_hora_coef, hProdTotal, total_OFs, 
					total_Retornos, total_RetornosCulpado, e_fp_id, ret_Provocados, tempo_a_descontar, ferias, temp, faseFunc, seqFunc, barcosComErros, baixas)
	exec Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Agrup_Geral 2019, 54, @dI, @dF, @hi, @hf, @eid

	insert into @xx (e_id,e_nome,barcos,rtns,culpado,ret_Provocados,totHoras,absentismo,ganho_Produtivo,percent_Retornos,produtividade,premio, ord)
	select 
		x.e_id,
		x.e_nome,
		x.barcos,
		x.rtns,
		x.culpado,
		x.ret_Provocados,
		x.totHoras,
		x.absentismo,
		round(x.ganho_Produtivo,1) as ganho_Produtivo,
		round(x.percent_Retornos,2) as percent_Retornos,
		round(x.produtividade,2) as produtividade,
		round(case
			when x.absentismo >= 0.25
				or x.ganho_Produtivo <= -16 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0)
				or x.percent_Retornos > 0.2
			then 0
			when x.ganho_Produtivo >= -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.1
			then 100
			when x.ganho_Produtivo < -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.1
			then 100 + ((8 + x.ganho_Produtivo) * 12.5)
			when x.ganho_Produtivo >= -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos > 0.1 and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.2
			then 75
			when x.ganho_Produtivo < -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos > 0.1 and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.2
			then (100 + ((8 + x.ganho_Produtivo) * 12.5)) * 0.75
		end, 1) as premio,
		2
	from
		(select 
			e_id, e_nome, sum(barcos) as barcos, sum(rtns) as rtns, sum(culpado) as culpado, sum(ret_Provocados) as ret_Provocados,
			h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext as totHoras,
			faltas / h_trb as absentismo,
			sum(case when fp_id = 40 
					then temp
					else fp_hora_coef * tot
				end - tempo_a_descontar) - (h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext) as ganho_Produtivo,
			sum(case when fp_id = 40 
					then temp
					else fp_hora_coef * tot
				end - tempo_a_descontar) / (h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext) as produtividade,
			(sum(culpado) + sum(ret_Provocados)) / sum(barcos) as percent_Retornos
		from
			@t
		group by
			e_id, e_nome, h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext, faltas / h_trb) as x
	
	/**************************************************************/
	delete @t
	/*************************************************************/

	set @di = dateadd(month,-1, @di)
	set @df = dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,1, @di))

	insert into @t (barcos, extPint, extDesm, coefs, rtns, culpado, tot, totRet_New, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp, fp_sequencia, faltas, h_Ext, h_trb, aj_ext, h_Perdidas, equipa, fp_hora_coef, hProdTotal, total_OFs, 
					total_Retornos, total_RetornosCulpado, e_fp_id, ret_Provocados, tempo_a_descontar, ferias, temp, faseFunc, seqFunc, barcosComErros, baixas)
	exec Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Agrup_Geral 2019, 54, @dI, @dF, ' 08:00', ' 17:00', @eid

	insert into @xx (e_id,e_nome,barcos,rtns,culpado,ret_Provocados,totHoras,absentismo,ganho_Produtivo,percent_Retornos,produtividade,premio, ord)
	select 
		x.e_id,
		x.e_nome,
		x.barcos,
		x.rtns,
		x.culpado,
		x.ret_Provocados,
		x.totHoras,
		x.absentismo,
		round(x.ganho_Produtivo,1) as ganho_Produtivo,
		round(x.percent_Retornos,2) as percent_Retornos,
		round(x.produtividade,2) as produtividade,
		round(case
			when x.absentismo >= 0.25
				or x.ganho_Produtivo <= -16 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0)
				or x.percent_Retornos > 0.2
			then 0
			when x.ganho_Produtivo >= -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.1
			then 100
			when x.ganho_Produtivo < -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.1
			then 100 + ((8 + x.ganho_Produtivo) * 12.5)
			when x.ganho_Produtivo >= -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos > 0.1 and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.2
			then 75
			when x.ganho_Produtivo < -8 * CEILING(datediff(day, @dI, @dF)/30.0) and x.percent_Retornos > 0.1 and x.percent_Retornos <= 0.2
			then (100 + ((8 + x.ganho_Produtivo) * 12.5)) * 0.75
		end, 1) as premio,
		1
	from
		(select 
			e_id, e_nome, sum(barcos) as barcos, sum(rtns) as rtns, sum(culpado) as culpado, sum(ret_Provocados) as ret_Provocados,
			h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext as totHoras,
			faltas / h_trb as absentismo,
			sum(case when fp_id = 40 
					then temp
					else fp_hora_coef * tot
				end - tempo_a_descontar) - (h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext) as ganho_Produtivo,
			sum(case when fp_id = 40 
					then temp
					else fp_hora_coef * tot
				end - tempo_a_descontar) / (h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext) as produtividade,
			(sum(culpado) + sum(ret_Provocados)) / sum(barcos) as percent_Retornos
		from
			@t
		group by
			e_id, e_nome, h_trb + h_Ext - faltas - baixas - ferias + h_Perdidas + aj_ext, faltas / h_trb) as x

	select * from @xx
END
```

#### `dbo.Performance_Func_Agrup_v3`(@eid int, @dI date, @dF date, @group bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2021-04-08 11:12 · modificado 2026-06-03 10:57* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `retorno`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Performance_Func_Agrup_v3]

	@eid int = null,
	@dI date = null,
	@dF date = null,
	@group bit = 1

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @dI is null or @dF is null 
		select @dI = dateadd(DAY,(datepart(DAY,getdate())-1)*-1,getdate()), @dF = dateadd(DAY, case when datepart(hour,getdate()) > 18 or getdate() < '2026/06/02 18:00'  then 0 else -1 end, getdate())

	declare @dIt smalldatetime, @dFt smalldatetime
	set @dIt = dateadd(hour,8,cast(@dI as smalldatetime))
	set @dFt = dateadd(hour,17,cast(@dF as smalldatetime))

	/*Calcular Prémio*/
	declare @h_trb float = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(@dIt, @dFt)
	declare @h_trb_ant float = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(dateadd(month,-1, @dIt), dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt))

	declare @facturadoLoja float = 0
	if @dI < '2026/06/01'
		select 
			@facturadoLoja = cast(a.total as float) 
		from 
			OPENQUERY(SHOP,'SELECT year(created_at) ano, month(created_at) mes, cast(sum(total_invoiced) as float) total FROM `paddle-m2-db`.sales_order where state = ''complete'' group by year(created_at), month(created_at);') a
		where
			a.ano = year(@dI)
			and a.mes = month(@dI)
	else
		select 
			@facturadoLoja = cast(a.total as float) 
		from 
			OPENQUERY(SHOP,'SELECT year(si.created_at) ano, month(si.created_at) mes, cast(sum(si.subtotal) as float) total FROM `paddle-m2-db`.sales_invoice si inner join `paddle-m2-db`.sales_order so on si.order_id = so.entity_id where so.state = ''complete'' group by year(si.created_at), month(si.created_at);') a
		where
			a.ano = year(@dI)
			and a.mes = month(@dI)


	declare @barcosPreparados int
	select	
		@barcosPreparados = count(distinct of_id)
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
		--inner join (select distinct m.mov_of_id ofId from movimento m inner join movimento m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto on m1.mov_p_id = p_id where p_tp_id = 84 and m.mov_satisfeito = 1) mov on of_id = ofId
	where
		OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA between @dI and @dF
		and OFFP_DATAFIM between @dI and @dF
		and offp_of_id < 10000000


	declare @barcosComMascara int
	select 
		@barcosComMascara = count(of_id)
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
	where
		(OF_PFORA_CLASS > 1
		or OF_PARAPINTARFORA = 1)
		and offp_fp_id = 65
		and OFFP_DATAFIM between @dI and @dF


	declare @ganhoInjeccao float
	select
		@ganhoInjeccao = sum(mov_quantidade * case when p_id = 52411 then 0.81
				when p_id = 51018 then 9.34
				when p_id = 53719 then 1.55
				when p_id = 53772 then 1.96
				when p_id = 22672 then 3.32 end)
	from
		movimento
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
	where 
		cast(mov_data as date) between @dI and @dF
		and mov_tpmov_id in (1)
		and p_id in (52411,51018,53719,53772,22672)
		and MOV_ACERTO = 0

	declare @qtdCNC float
	if (@dF < '2026/03/01')
		select 
			@qtdCNC = sum(mov_quantidade)
		from
			movimento 
		where 
			mov_data between @dI and @dF
			and mov_tpmov_id in (2)
			and mov_p_id = 21147
	else
		select 
			@qtdCNC = sum(mov_quantidade)
		from
			movimento 
			inner join ORDEMFABRICO on mov_of_id = of_id
			inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on of_fp_id = fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		where 
			OFFP_DATAFIM between @dI and @dF
			and mov_tpmov_id in (2,11)
			and mov_p_id = 21147
			and mov_of_id is not null
			and offp_fp_id = 20

	declare @corteCostura float
	select
		@corteCostura = sum(p_precovenda)
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join produto m on of_p_id = m.p_id
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
	where
		offp_fp_id = 48
		and OFFP_DATAFIM between @dI and @dF

	declare @serralharia float
	select 
		@serralharia = sum(mov_quantidade * (p_precovenda - coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0)))
		--@dI Mes, p_id, p_nome, coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) pCusto, p_precovenda pVenda, comp_quantidade qtdSerralhariaPeca, sum(mov_quantidade) nPecas
	from
		movimento 
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
		inner join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_id
	where
		comp_p_p_id = 21637
		and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		and cast(mov_data as date) between @dI and @dF
		and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1
		and p_precovenda > 0



	if @group = 1 and GETDATE() < '2022/12/01'
		select
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			count(a.of_id) barcos,
			sum(a.Gravidade_1) ErrosGrau_1,
			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
				case 
					when a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or a.Gravidade_2 > 0
						then 0
					else
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),1) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb absentismo,
			2 ord,
			@dI de,
			@df ate,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then 0
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID IdRetornoCulpa from OF_FP where offp_return = 1 and OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = ofFp.offp_id) x1
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
								inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
								INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on PLI_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, PLI_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between @dI and @dF
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_FP_ID = erros.PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and case when @eid is null then 1 else eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID end = isnull(@eid,1)
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between @dI and @dF
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
						)
					)
				--and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,65,51)) a --in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@dI as date), cast(@dF as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		union
		select
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			count(a.of_id) barcos,
			sum(a.Gravidade_1) ErrosGrau_1,
			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
				case 
					when a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or a.Gravidade_2 > 0
						then 0
					else
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),1) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb_ant absentismo,
			1 ord,
			dateadd(month,-1, @dI) de,
			dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF) ate,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_RETURN = 1 and a.OFFP_OF_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OF_ID and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
								inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
								INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on PLI_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, PLI_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,1, @di))
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and case when @eid is null then 1 else eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID end = isnull(@eid,1)
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF)
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM as date) between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF)
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF)
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
						)
					)
				--and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,65)) a -- in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)) a
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(dateadd(month,-1, @dI) as date), cast(dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF) as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		order by 
			E_ID,
			ord
	else if @group = 0 and @dI < '2022/11/01'
		select
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			a.of_id barcos,
			sum(a.Gravidade_1) ErrosGrau_1,
			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
				case 
					when a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or a.Gravidade_2 > 0
						then 0
					else
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),2) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb absentismo,
			2 ord,
			@dI de,
			@df ate,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			P_NOME,
			a.e_taxa_irs,
			a.OFFP_RETURN
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_RETURN = 1 and a.OFFP_OF_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OF_ID and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
								inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
								INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on PLI_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, PLI_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between @dI and @dF
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_FP_ID = erros.PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and case when @eid is null then 1 else eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID end = isnull(@eid,1)
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between @dI and @dF
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							--and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OFFP_FP_ID <> 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
						)
					)
				and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,65)) a --in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@dI as date), cast(@dF as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			a.of_id,
			a.OFFP_RETURN,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			P_NOME,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		order by 
			E_ID,
			ord
	else if @group = 1 and GETDATE() >= '2022/12/01'
		select
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			count(a.of_id) barcos,
			sum(a.Gravidade_1) ErrosGrau_1,
			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
				case 
					when a.of_id < 10000000 and (a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.of_datafim < '2025/10/01')) -- or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.fp_id not in (1,67) and a.of_datafim >= '2025/10/01'))
						then 0
					when a.of_id >= 10000000 and a.Gravidade_3 > 0
						then 0
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and (p_nome not like '% FC' or a.fp_id not in (1,67))
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end / 2
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end / 2
					when p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end
					else
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os erros de gravidade 1 a não descontar nada ** (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end */
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),1) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb absentismo,
			2 ord,
			@dI de,
			@df ate,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs,
			@facturadoLoja facturadoLoja,
			@barcosPreparados barcosPreparados,
			@barcosComMascara barcosComMascara,
			@ganhoInjeccao ganhoInjeccao,
			@qtdCNC qtdCNC,
			@corteCostura corteCostura,
			@serralharia serralharia
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome + isnull(' / ' + pe.nome  collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS,'') e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				eq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 1 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then 0
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os retornos não graves a não descontar nada ** when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 0 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X / 2 **/
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID IdRetornoCulpa, OFFP_RETORNO_GRAVE Grave from OF_FP where offp_return = 1 and OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = ofFp.offp_id) x1
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, OFFP_FP_ID PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
								--inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID and ofch_offp_id_culpa = offp_id -- AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, OFFP_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between @dI and @dF
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_FP_ID = erros.PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and case when @eid is null then 1 else eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID end = isnull(@eid,1)
				and e_activo = 1
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between @dI and @dF
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and (OF_ID > 10000000 or OF_ID between 70000 and 89999)
							--and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OFFP_FP_ID <> 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
							and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50,12)
						)
					)
				--and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,54,65,6,51,46,71,74,66,51,8,6)) a --in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@dI as date), cast(@dF as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		union

			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
```
