```sql
						then 0
					when a.of_id >= 10000000 and a.Gravidade_3 > 0
						then 0
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and (p_nome not like '% FC' or a.fp_id not in (1,67))
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end / 2
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end / 2
					when p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end
					else
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os erros de gravidade 1 a não descontar nada ** (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end */
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),1) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb_ant absentismo,
			1 ord,
			dateadd(month,-1, @dI) de,
			dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF) ate,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs,
			@facturadoLoja facturadoLoja,
			@barcosPreparados barcosPreparados,
			@barcosComMascara barcosComMascara,
			@ganhoInjeccao ganhoInjeccao,
			@qtdCNC qtdCNC,
			@corteCostura corteCostura,
			@serralharia serralharia
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome + isnull(' / ' + pe.nome collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS,'') e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				eq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 1 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then 0
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os retornos não graves a não descontar nada ** when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 0 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X / 2 **/
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID IdRetornoCulpa, OFFP_RETORNO_GRAVE Grave from OF_FP where offp_return = 1 and OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = ofFp.offp_id) x1
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, OFFP_FP_ID PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
								--inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID and ofch_offp_id_culpa = offp_id -- AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, OFFP_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,1, @di))
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and case when @eid is null then 1 else eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID end = isnull(@eid,1)
				and e_activo = 1
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF)
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM as date) between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF)
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and (OF_ID > 10000000 or OF_ID between 70000 and 89999)
							--and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between dateadd(month,-1, @dI) and dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF)
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OFFP_FP_ID <> 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
							and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50,12)
						)
					)
				--and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,54,65,6,51,46,71,74,66,51,8,6)) a -- in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)) a
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(dateadd(month,-1, @dI) as date), cast(dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF) as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		union
		select
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			count(a.of_id) barcos,
			sum(a.Gravidade_1) ErrosGrau_1,
			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
				case 
					when a.of_id < 10000000 and (a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.of_datafim < '2025/10/01')) -- or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.fp_id not in (1,67) and a.of_datafim >= '2025/10/01'))
						then 0
					when a.of_id >= 10000000 and a.Gravidade_3 > 0
						then 0
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and (p_nome not like '% FC' or a.fp_id not in (1,67))
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end / 2
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end / 2
					when p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end
					else
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os erros de gravidade 1 a não descontar nada ** (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end */
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),1) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb_ant absentismo,
			0 ord,
			dateadd(month,-2, @dI) de,
			dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,-1, @dI)) ate,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs,
			@facturadoLoja facturadoLoja,
			@barcosPreparados barcosPreparados,
			@barcosComMascara barcosComMascara,
			@ganhoInjeccao ganhoInjeccao,
			@qtdCNC qtdCNC,
			@corteCostura corteCostura,
			@serralharia serralharia
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome + isnull(' / ' + pe.nome collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS,'') e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				eq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 1 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then 0
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os retornos não graves a não descontar nada ** when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 0 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X / 2 **/
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID IdRetornoCulpa, OFFP_RETORNO_GRAVE Grave from OF_FP where offp_return = 1 and OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = ofFp.offp_id) x1
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, OFFP_FP_ID PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
								--inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID and ofch_offp_id_culpa = offp_id -- AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, OFFP_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between dateadd(month,-2, @dI) and dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,-1, @dI))
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and case when @eid is null then 1 else eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID end = isnull(@eid,1)
				and e_activo = 1
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between dateadd(month,-2, @dI) and dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,-1, @dI))
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM as date) between dateadd(month,-2, @dI) and dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,-1, @dI))
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and (OF_ID > 10000000 or OF_ID between 70000 and 89999)
							--and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between dateadd(month,-2, @dI) and dateadd(day,-1,dateadd(month,-1, @dI))
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OFFP_FP_ID <> 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
							and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50,12)
						)
					)
				--and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,54,65,6,51,46,71,74,66,51,8,6)) a -- in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)) a
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(dateadd(month,-1, @dI) as date), cast(dateadd(day,day(@dF)*-1,@dF) as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		order by 
			E_ID,
			ord
	else if @group = 0 and @dI >= '2022/11/01'
		select
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			a.of_id barcos,
			sum(a.Gravidade_1) ErrosGrau_1,
			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
				case 
					when a.of_id < 10000000 and (a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.of_datafim < '2025/10/01')) -- or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.fp_id not in (1,67) and a.of_datafim >= '2025/10/01'))
						then 0
					when a.of_id >= 10000000 and a.Gravidade_3 > 0
						then 0
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and (p_nome not like '% FC' or a.fp_id not in (1,67))
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end / 2
					when a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end / 2
					when p_nome like '% FC' and a.fp_id in (1,67)
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 then 2 else 4 end
					else
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os erros de gravidade 1 a não descontar nada ** (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end */
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),2) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb absentismo,
			2 ord,
			@dI de,
			@df ate,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			P_NOME,
			a.e_taxa_irs,
			a.OFFP_RETURN,
			@facturadoLoja facturadoLoja,
			@barcosPreparados barcosPreparados,
			@barcosComMascara barcosComMascara,
			@ganhoInjeccao ganhoInjeccao,
			@qtdCNC qtdCNC,
			@corteCostura corteCostura,
			@serralharia serralharia
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome + isnull(' / ' + pe.nome collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS,'') e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				eq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 1 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then 0
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os retornos não graves a não descontar nada ** when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 0 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X / 2 **/
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID IdRetornoCulpa, OFFP_RETORNO_GRAVE Grave from OF_FP where offp_return = 1 and OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = ofFp.offp_id) x1
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, OFFP_FP_ID PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
								--inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
								--INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID and ofch_offp_id_culpa = offp_id -- AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, OFFP_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between @dI and @dF
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_FP_ID = erros.PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and case when @eid is null then 1 else eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID end = isnull(@eid,1)
				and e_activo = 1
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between @dI and @dF
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and (OF_ID > 10000000 or OF_ID between 70000 and 89999)
							--and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OFFP_FP_ID <> 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
							and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50,12)
						)
					)
				--and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,54,65,6,51,46,71,74,66,51,8,6)) a --in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@dI as date), cast(@dF as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			a.of_id,
			a.OFFP_RETURN,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			P_NOME,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		order by 
			E_ID,
			ord
END
```

#### `dbo.Performance_Individual`(@e_id int, @dt_I smalldatetime, @dt_F smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Performance_Individual] 
	
@e_id int,
@dt_I smalldatetime,
@dt_F smalldatetime


AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @e_e_id int
	set @e_e_id = coalesce((select e_e_id from entidade where e_id = @e_id),0)

	set @dt_I = dateadd(week,-6,@dt_F)

	select year(offp_datafim) as Ano, datepart("WW", offp_datafim) as Semana, count(offp_of_id) as Barcos, sum(of_coeficiente) as coefs, 
		fp_nome as fp, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0) as faltas, coalesce(x.h_ext,0) as h_Ext, diasTrb.hTrb as h_Trb, coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
		(diasTrb.hTrb+coalesce(x.h_ext,0)+coalesce(aj_ext,0)-coalesce(f.faltas,0))/sum(of_coeficiente) as coefH
	from of_fp inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id and e_chefe = 1 inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i) as ano, datepart("WW", movent_data_i) as semana, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @dt_I and @dt_F and movent_data_i <= getdate() group by movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i), datepart("WW", movent_data_i)) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id and year(offp_datafim) = f.ano and datepart("WW", offp_datafim) = f.semana
		left join (select movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i) as ano, datepart("WW", movent_data_i) as semana, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @dt_I and @dt_F and movent_data_i <= getdate() group by movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i), datepart("WW", movent_data_i)) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id and year(offp_datafim) = x.ano and datepart("WW", offp_datafim) = x.semana
		left join (select movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i) as ano, datepart("WW", movent_data_i) as semana, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @dt_I and @dt_F and movent_data_i <= getdate() group by movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i), datepart("WW", movent_data_i)) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id
		left join (select @e_id as id, year(dtrb_data) as ano, datepart("WW", dtrb_data) as semana, count(*) * 8 + ((case when @dt_F >= convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101) and datepart(hh,getdate()) >= 13 and datepart("WW", dtrb_data) = datepart("WW", getdate()) then datepart(hh,getdate()) -1 when @dt_F >= convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101) and datepart(hh,getdate()) < 13 and datepart("WW", dtrb_data) = datepart("WW", getdate()) then datepart(hh,getdate()) else 8 end) -8) as hTrb 
			from dias_trabalho 
			where dtrb_data between @dt_I and @dt_F and dtrb_data < convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101)
			group by year(dtrb_data), datepart("WW", dtrb_data)) as diasTrb on e_id = diasTrb.id and year(offp_datafim) = diasTrb.ano and datepart("WW", offp_datafim) = diasTrb.semana
	where offp_fp_id in (18,5,22,8,3,4,6,33) and offp_datafim between @dt_I and @dt_F and (e_id = @e_id or e_id = @e_e_id)
	group by year(offp_datafim), datepart("WW", offp_datafim), 
		fp_nome, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0), coalesce(x.h_ext,0), coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), diasTrb.hTrb
	union
	select diasTrb.ano as Ano, diasTrb.semana as Semana, 0 as Barcos, 0 as coefs, 
		fp_nome as fp,
		'Ajudante: ' + e_nome as e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, sum(coalesce(f.faltas,0)) as faltas, sum(coalesce(x.h_ext,0)) as h_Ext, diasTrb.hTrb as h_Trb, coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 0 as coefH
	from (select @e_e_id as id, year(dtrb_data) as ano, datepart("WW", dtrb_data) as semana, count(*) * 8 + ((case when @dt_F >= convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101) and datepart(hh,getdate()) >= 13 and datepart("WW", dtrb_data) = datepart("WW", getdate()) then datepart(hh,getdate()) -1 when @dt_F >= convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101) and datepart(hh,getdate()) < 13 and datepart("WW", dtrb_data) = datepart("WW", getdate()) then datepart(hh,getdate()) else 8 end) -8) as hTrb 
		from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between @dt_I and @dt_F and dtrb_data < convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101) group by year(dtrb_data), datepart("WW", dtrb_data)) as diasTrb
		inner join entidade on diasTrb.id = e_id inner join entidade_tipo on ent_id = e_ent_id and e_activo = 1 and e_chefe = 0 inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i) as ano, datepart("WW", movent_data_i) as semana, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @dt_I and @dt_F and movent_data_i <= getdate() group by movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i), datepart("WW", movent_data_i)) as f on e_id = f.movent_e_id and diasTrb.ano = f.ano and diasTrb.semana = f.semana
		left join (select movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i) as ano, datepart("WW", movent_data_i) as semana, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @dt_I and @dt_F and movent_data_i <= getdate() group by movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i), datepart("WW", movent_data_i)) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id and diasTrb.ano = x.ano and diasTrb.semana = x.semana
		left join (select movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i) as ano, datepart("WW", movent_data_i) as semana, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @dt_I and @dt_F and movent_data_i <= getdate() group by movent_e_id, year(movent_data_i), datepart("WW", movent_data_i)) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id and diasTrb.ano = aj.ano and diasTrb.semana = aj.semana
	where e_fp_id in (18,5,22,8,3,4,6,33) and (e_id = @e_id or e_id = @e_e_id)
	group by fp_nome, fp_id, fp_sequencia, e_nome, e_id, coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), diasTrb.hTrb, diasTrb.ano, diasTrb.semana
	order by Ano, Semana, fp, barcos desc, e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_Delete_FaltasMes`(@ano int, @mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2026-05-28 10:33 · modificado 2026-05-28 10:33*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE PHC_Delete_FaltasMes
	@ano int, @mes int
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    --select * from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs where ntipo = 2 and year(data) = @ano and month(data) = @mes
	delete from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs where ntipo = 2 and year(data) = @ano and month(data) = @mes

	update [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov set movent_phc = 0
	--select *
	from
		[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e.e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ty as ty on em.movent_met_id = ty.codigo
	where year(em.movent_data_i) = @ano and month(em.movent_data_i) = @mes and emt.met_met_id = 2 and movent_phc = 1

END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_Factura_Add`(@cliente int, @fno int OUTPUT)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PHC_Factura_Add]

@cliente int,
@fno int output

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

set @fno = (select max(fno) from ft) + 1

INSERT INTO dbo.ft 
(ftstamp,pais,nmdoc,fno,no,nome,morada,local,codpost,ncont,bino,bidata,bilocal,telefone,zona,vendedor,fdata,ftano,
pdata,carga,descar,saida,ivatx1,ivatx2,ivatx3,fin,ndoc,moeda,fref,estab,cdata,
tipodoc,chora,cambiofixo,memissao,edescc,chdata,ousrinis,ousrdata,ousrhora,usrinis,
usrdata,usrhora) 
select 
	'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21),																										--ststamp
	cl.pais,																																		--pais
	'Factura',																																		--nmdoc
	@fno,																																			--fno
	cl.no,																																			--no
	cl.nome,																																		--nome
	cl.morada,																																		--morada
	cl.local,																																		--local
	cl.codpost,																																		--codpost
	cl.ncont,																																		--ncont
	cl.bino,																																		--bino
	cl.bidata,																																		--bidata
	cl.bilocal,																																		--bilocal
	cl.telefone,																																	--telefone
	cl.zona,																																		--zona
	0,																																				--vendedor
	convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1),																													--fdata
	year(getdate()),																																--ftano
	convert(nchar(10),dateadd(mm,1,getdate()),1),																									--pdata
	'Nossas instalações',																															--carga
	'Morada do cliente',																															--descar
	convert(varchar(2),datepart(HH,getdate())) + ':' + convert(varchar(2),datepart(n,getdate())),													--saida
	5.00,																																			--ivatx1
	20.00,																																			--ivatx2
	12.00,																																			--ivatx3
	0.0,																																			--fin
	1,																																				--ndoc
	'PTE ou EURO',																																	--moeda
	cl.fref,																																		--fref
	0,																																				--estab
	convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1),																													--cdata
	1,																																				--tipodoc
	convert(varchar(2),datepart(HH,getdate())) + convert(varchar(2),datepart(n,getdate())),															--chora
	0,																																				--cambiofixo
	'EURO',																																			--memissao
	0,																																				--edescc
	convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1),																													--chdata
	'ADM',																																			--ousrinis
	convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1),																													--ousrdata
	convert(varchar(2),datepart(HH,getdate())) + ':' + convert(varchar(2),datepart(n,getdate())),													--ousrhora
	'ADM',																																			--usrinis
	convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1),																													--usrdata
	convert(varchar(2),datepart(HH,getdate())) + ':' + convert(varchar(2),datepart(n,getdate())) + ':' + convert(varchar(2),datepart(s,getdate()))	--usrhora 
from cl as cl where cl.no = @cliente

select id = @fno

END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_Factura_Linhas`(@fno int, @cliente int, @pid int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PHC_Factura_Linhas]

@fno int, /*nº da factura*/
@cliente int,
@pid int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @preco int, @tabiva int, @fref varchar(20), @iva float, @ftstamp char(25)
	select @preco = cl.preco, @tabiva = cl.tabiva, @fref = cl.fref, @ftstamp = ft.ftstamp
		from [PHC].dbo.cl as cl inner join [PHC].dbo.ft as ft on cl.no = ft.no where cl.no = @cliente and ft.fno = @fno

	select @iva = convert(float,ltrim(rtrim(replace(valor,',','.')))) from [PHC].dbo.para1 where descricao like 'ativa%' + convert(varchar, @tabiva)

	INSERT INTO [PHC].dbo.fi 
	(fistamp, nmdoc, fno, ref, design, qtt, tiliquido, etiliquido, unidade, unidad2, iva, ivaincl, codigo, tabiva, ndoc, armazem, fnoft, ndocft, 
	ftanoft, facturada, rdata, nsujpp, ecomissao, cpoc, composto, compostoori, lordem, fmarcada, usr1, usr2, usr3, usr4, usr5, usr6, ftstamp, stipo, 
	fifref, tipodoc, familia, peso, pbruto, pv, pvmoeda, epv, tmoeda, slvu, eslvu, sltt, esltt, tliquido, pvori, epvori, 
	ousrinis, ousrdata, ousrhora, usrinis, usrdata, usrhora)
	select 
		'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21) /*fistamp*/, 'Factura' /*nmdoc*/, @fno /*fno*/, st.ref /*ref*/, st.design /*design*/, 1 /*qtt*/, 
		st.pvultimo /*tiliquido*/, 
		(case when @preco = 1 then st.epv1 when @preco = 2 then st.epv2 when @preco = 3 then st.epv3 when @preco = 4 then st.epv4 when @preco = 5 then st.epv5 end) /*etiliquido*/, 
		st.unidade /*unidade*/, st.uni2 /*unidad2*/, @iva /*iva*/, 	0 /*ivaincl*/, st.codigo /*codigo*/, @tabiva /*tabiva*/, 
		1 /*ndoc*/, 1 /*armazem*/, 0 /*fnoft*/, 0 /*ndocft*/, 0 /*ftanoft*/, 0 /*facturada*/, convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1) /*rdata*/,
		st.nsujpp /*nsujpp*/, st.ecomissao /*ecomissao*/, st.cpoc /*cpoc*/, 0 /*composto*/, 0 /*compostoori*/, 1 /*lordem*/, 0 /*fmarcada*/, 
		st.usr1 /*usr1*/, st.usr2 /*usr2*/, st.usr3 /*usr3*/, st.usr4 /*usr4*/, st.usr5 /*usr5*/, st.usr6 /*usr6*/, @ftstamp /*ftstamp*/, 1 /*stipo*/,
		@fref /*fifref*/, 1 /*tipodoc*/, st.familia /*familia*/, st.peso /*peso*/, st.pbruto /*pbruto*/, st.pvultimo /*pv*/, 0 /*pvmoeda*/, 
		(case when @preco = 1 then st.epv1 when @preco = 2 then st.epv2 when @preco = 3 then st.epv3 when @preco = 4 then st.epv4 when @preco = 5 then st.epv5 end) /*epv*/,
		0 /*tmoeda*/, st.pvultimo /*slvu*/, 
		(case when @preco = 1 then st.epv1 when @preco = 2 then st.epv2 when @preco = 3 then st.epv3 when @preco = 4 then st.epv4 when @preco = 5 then st.epv5 end) /*eslvu*/, st.pvultimo /*sltt*/, st.epv1 /*esltt*/, st.epv1 * (1+(convert(float,ltrim(rtrim(replace(p.valor,',','.'))))/100))/*tliquido*/, 
		st.pvultimo /*pvori*/, 
		(case when @preco = 1 then st.epv1 when @preco = 2 then st.epv2 when @preco = 3 then st.epv3 when @preco = 4 then st.epv4 when @preco = 5 then st.epv5 end) /*epvori*/, 
		'ADM' /*ousrinis*/, convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1) /*ousrdata*/, 
		convert(varchar(2),datepart(HH,getdate())) + ':' + convert(varchar(2),datepart(n,getdate())) /*ousrhora*/, 'ADM' /*usrinis*/, 
		convert(nchar(10),getdate(),1) /*usrdata*/,
		convert(varchar(2),datepart(HH,getdate())) + ':' + convert(varchar(2),datepart(n,getdate())) + ':' + convert(varchar(2),datepart(s,getdate())) /*usrhora */
	from
		[PHC].dbo.st
	where
		st.u_idprod = @pid

END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_FacturasClientes_Linhas`(@fno nvarchar(max), @nmdoc nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2025-11-11 11:30 · modificado 2025-11-11 14:45*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE PHC_FacturasClientes_Linhas
	@fno nvarchar(max), 
	@nmdoc nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		fi.ref, fi.design, fi.qtt, fi.etiliquido, fi.iva, abs(fi.etiliquido) - fi.esltt as ValorIVA, ft.nome as cliente, ft.fdata, fi.lordem
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi 
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.ftstamp = ft.ftstamp
	where 
		fi.fno = @fno and fi.nmdoc = @nmdoc
	 --order by 
		--fi.lordem
END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_Insere_FaltasDoMes`(@ano int, @mes int, @preview bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 11:58*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PHC_Insere_FaltasDoMes] 
	@ano int,
	@mes int,
	@preview bit
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if not exists (select distinct e_nome, e_contribuinte
	from
		[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
	where year(em.movent_data_i) = @ano and month(em.movent_data_i) = @mes and emt.met_met_id = 2 and movent_phc = 0 and len(e_contribuinte) < 5 /*and e_activo = 1*/)
	begin
		if @preview = 0
		begin
			insert into [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs (hsstamp,nome,data,no,ntipo,desconta,just,refe,horasfalta,fdia,ocorrencia,tyfalta,tydescricao,/*nfmes,fmes,fano,*/pctdia,decreferias,processada,horas,bsfalta,OBS,ntipo1)
			select 
				'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21) as st,																		-- hsstamp
				pe.nome as nome,																									-- nome
				convert(datetime,convert(varchar(10), movent_data_i,1)) as data,													-- data
				pe.no as [no], --Nº do empregado a encontrar pelo nº contrib														-- no
				2 as ntipo,																											-- ntipo
				ty.desconta as desconta,																							-- desconta
				ty.just as just,																									-- just	
				(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 
																	and movent_met_id not in (5,10) then 1 else 0 end) as refe,		-- Refe
				(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horasfalta,										-- horasfalta
				2 as fdia,																											-- fdia
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY convert(varchar(10), movent_data_i, 105) DESC) + 897 as ocorrencia,						-- ocorrencia
				movent_met_id as tyfalta,																							-- tyfalta
				ty.descricao as tydescricao,																						-- tydescricao
				((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) / 8)*100 as pctdia,								-- pctdia
				1 as decreferias,																									-- decreferias
				0 as processada,																									-- processada
				1 as horas,																											-- horas
				13 as bsfalta,																										-- bsfalta
				movent_observacoes,																									-- OBS
				'Faltas' as ntipo1																									-- ntipo1
			from
				[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
				inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e.e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ty as ty on em.movent_met_id = ty.codigo
			where year(em.movent_data_i) = @ano and month(em.movent_data_i) = @mes and emt.met_met_id = 2 and movent_phc = 0-- and e.e_activo = 1


			update [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov set movent_phc = 1 
			from
				[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
				inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e.e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ty as ty on em.movent_met_id = ty.codigo
			where year(em.movent_data_i) = @ano and month(em.movent_data_i) = @mes and emt.met_met_id = 2 and movent_phc = 0
		end
		else
			select 
				'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21) as st,																		-- hsstamp
				pe.nome as nome,																									-- nome
				convert(datetime,convert(varchar(10), movent_data_i,1)) as data,													-- data
				pe.no as [no], --Nº do empregado a encontrar pelo nº contrib														-- no
				2 as ntipo,																											-- ntipo
				ty.desconta as desconta,																							-- desconta
				ty.just as just,																									-- just	
				(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 
																	and movent_met_id not in (5,10) then 1 else 0 end) as refe,		-- Refe
				(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horasfalta,										-- horasfalta
				2 as fdia,																											-- fdia
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY convert(varchar(10), movent_data_i, 105) DESC) + 897 as ocorrencia,						-- ocorrencia
				movent_met_id as tyfalta,																							-- tyfalta
				ty.descricao as tydescricao,																						-- tydescricao
				((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) / 8)*100 as pctdia,								-- pctdia
				1 as decreferias,																									-- decreferias
				0 as processada,																									-- processada
				1 as horas,																											-- horas
				13 as bsfalta,																										-- bsfalta
				movent_observacoes,																									-- OBS
				'Faltas' as ntipo1																									-- ntipo1
			from
				[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
				inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e.e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ty as ty on em.movent_met_id = ty.codigo
			where year(em.movent_data_i) = @ano and month(em.movent_data_i) = @mes and emt.met_met_id = 2 and movent_phc = 0
	end
	else
		select distinct e_nome, e_contribuinte
		from
			[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
			inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
		where year(em.movent_data_i) = @ano and month(em.movent_data_i) = @mes and emt.met_met_id = 2 and movent_phc = 0 and len(e_contribuinte) < 5 --and e_activo = 1
		--select msg = 'Existem funcionários sem contribuinte associado!!'
END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_Insere_HExtra`(@di date, @df date, @preview bit, @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-05-28 16:42*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PHC_Insere_HExtra]
	@di date,
	@df date,
	@preview bit,
	@e_id int = null
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    /* HORAS EXTRA */
	/* Verifica contribuintes */
	if not exists (select distinct e_nome, e_contribuinte
	from
		[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
	where year(em.movent_data_i) = year(getdate()) and month(em.movent_data_i) = month(getdate())-1 and emt.met_met_id = 1 and movent_phc = 0 and len(e_contribuinte) < 5 and e.e_activo = 1
		and case when @e_id is null then 1 else em.movent_e_id end = case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end)
	begin
		/* Magia */
		/* Diluir */
		declare @incr int, @feitasdia float, @idfeitas int
		declare @horas table (movid int, eid int, datai smalldatetime, dataf smalldatetime, h float, obs nvarchar(max))
		declare @horas_1 table (movid int, eid int, datai smalldatetime, dataf smalldatetime, h float, obs nvarchar(max))

		/* Distribui horas dos funcionários sem isenção de horario pelos dias da semana */
		declare curofs_const cursor for
		select 
				movent_e_id,
				(case when sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 end)) < 24
					then sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 end))
					else 24 end)
			from 
				ent_mov inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id
			where 
				movent_met_id = 1 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between @di and @df and e_isencao_horario = 0 and MOVENT_VAI_PHC = 0 and movent_phc = 0 and e_activo = 1
				and case when @e_id is null then 1 else movent_e_id end = case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end
			group by movent_e_id, e_nome
			having (case when sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 end)) < 24
					then sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 end))
					else 24 end) > 0			
		open curofs_const
		declare @id int, @diluir float

		fetch next from curofs_const into @id, @diluir while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin
			set @incr = 0
			while @diluir > 0 and dateadd(day, @incr, @di) <= @df
			begin
				set @idfeitas = null
				set @feitasdia = 0.0

				select @idfeitas = movent_id, @feitasdia = (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 end) 
				from ent_mov 
				where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_e_id = @id and cast(movent_data_i as date) = cast(dateadd(day, @incr, @di) as date) and MOVENT_VAI_PHC = 0

				if datepart(dw, dateadd(day, @incr, @di)) not in (1,7) /*and isnull(@feitasdia,0) = 0*/ and exists (select * from dias_trabalho where cast(dtrb_data as date) = cast(dateadd(day, @incr, @di) as date)) and not exists (select movent_e_id, sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 end)) from ent_mov inner join ENT_MOV_TIPO on MOVENT_MET_ID = MET_ID where movent_e_id = @id and met_met_id = 2 and cast(movent_data_i as date) = cast(dateadd(day, @incr, @di) as date) group by movent_e_id having sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_i, movent_data_f)/60.0 end)) > 2.0)
				begin
					set @feitasdia = (case when @diluir > 2.0 then 2.0 else @diluir end)
					insert into @horas (eid, datai, dataf, obs) values (@id, dateadd(hour,17,cast(cast(dateadd(day, @incr, @di) as date) as smalldatetime)), dateadd(mi,(17.0+@feitasdia)*60.0,cast(cast(dateadd(day, @incr, @di) as date) as smalldatetime)),'')
					set @diluir = @diluir - @feitasdia
				end
				set @incr = @incr + 1
			end

		fetch next from curofs_const into @id, @diluir
		end
		close curofs_const
		deallocate curofs_const


		insert into @horas_1 (h,eid, datai, dataf) (select h,eid, datai, dataf from @horas)

		declare curOFs_Const cursor for
		select movent_e_id, movent_data_i, movent_data_f, movent_observacoes
		from ent_mov inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id inner join dias_trabalho on cast(movent_data_i as date) = cast(dtrb_data as date)
		where  movent_met_id = 1 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between @di and @df and e_isencao_horario = 0 and
			movent_e_id not in (select distinct eid from @horas_1) and datepart(dw, movent_data_i) not in (1,7) and MOVENT_VAI_PHC = 0 and movent_phc = 0
			and case when @e_id is null then 1 else movent_e_id end = case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end

		open curOFs_Const
		declare @movent_e_id int, @movent_data_i smalldatetime, @movent_data_f smalldatetime, @movent_observacoes nvarchar(max)

		fetch next from curOFs_Const into @movent_e_id, @movent_data_i, @movent_data_f, @movent_observacoes while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin

			if  isnull((select sum((case when datepart(hh,datai) < 12 and datepart(hh,dataf) >= 13 then datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 end)) from @horas where eid = @movent_e_id),0) + 
					(case when datepart(hh,@movent_data_i) < 12 and datepart(hh,@movent_data_f) >= 13 then datediff(n, @movent_data_i, @movent_data_f)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, @movent_data_i, @movent_data_f)/60.0 end) < 24
			begin
				insert into @horas (h,eid, datai, dataf, obs) values (1,@movent_e_id, @movent_data_i, @movent_data_f, @movent_observacoes)
			end

		fetch next from curOFs_Const into @movent_e_id, @movent_data_i, @movent_data_f, @movent_observacoes
		end
		close curOFs_Const
		deallocate curOFs_Const

		/*******************************************************************************************/
		if @preview = 0
		begin
			insert into [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs (hsstamp,nome,data,no,ntipo, tipohora, horas, factor,desconta,just,refe,fdia,ocorrencia,tyfalta,tydescricao,/*nfmes,fmes,fano,*/pctdia,decreferias,processada,bsfalta,OBS,ntipo1,usadtpr)
			select 
				'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21) as st,																		-- hsstamp
				pe.nome as nome,																									-- nome
				convert(datetime,convert(varchar(10), datai,1)) as data,													-- data
				pe.no as [no], --Nº do empregado a encontrar pelo nº contrib														-- no
				1 as ntipo,																											-- ntipo
				'Hora extra a dobrar' as tipohora,                                                                                  -- tipo hora
				cast((case when datepart(hh,datai) < 12 and datepart(hh,dataf) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 end) as float) as horas,							     			-- horas
				2 as factor,                                                                                                        -- Factor
				0 as desconta,																		             					-- desconta
				0 as just,														         											-- just	
				0 as refe,	                                                                                                     	-- Refe
				2 as fdia,																											-- fdia
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY convert(varchar(10), datai, 105) DESC) + 897 as ocorrencia,						-- ocorrencia
				1 as tyfalta,																							-- tyfalta
				'' as tydescricao,																						-- tydescricao
				((case when datepart(hh,datai) < 12 and datepart(hh,dataf) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 end) / 8)*100 as pctdia,								-- pctdia
				1 as decreferias,																									-- decreferias
				0 as processada,																									-- processada
				13 as bsfalta,																										-- bsfalta
				obs,																									-- OBS
				'Horas extraordinárias' as ntipo1,																					-- ntipo1
				1 as usadtpr                                                                                                        -- usadtpr
			from
				@horas as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.eid = e.e_id
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e.e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS

			/* Com efeito */
			update [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov 
				set movent_phc = 1 
			--select * 
			from
				[MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.movent_e_id = e.e_id
				inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.ent_mov_tipo as emt on em.movent_met_id = emt.met_id
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e.e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
			where cast(em.movent_data_i as date) between @di and @df and emt.met_id = 1 and movent_phc = 0 and movent_vai_phc = 0
				and case when @e_id is null then 1 else movent_e_id end = case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end
		end
		else
			select 
				'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21) as st,																		-- hsstamp
				pe.nome as nome,																									-- nome
				convert(datetime,convert(varchar(10), datai,1)) as data,													-- data
				pe.no as [no], --Nº do empregado a encontrar pelo nº contrib														-- no
				1 as ntipo,																											-- ntipo
				'Hora extra a dobrar' as tipohora,                                                                                  -- tipo hora
				cast((case when datepart(hh,datai) < 12 and datepart(hh,dataf) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 end) as float) as horas,							     			-- horas
				2 as factor,                                                                                                        -- Factor
				0 as desconta,																		             					-- desconta
				0 as just,														         											-- just	
				0 as refe,	                                                                                                     	-- Refe
				2 as fdia,																											-- fdia
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY convert(varchar(10), datai, 105) DESC) + 897 as ocorrencia,						-- ocorrencia
				1 as tyfalta,																							-- tyfalta
				'' as tydescricao,																						-- tydescricao
				((case when datepart(hh,datai) < 12 and datepart(hh,dataf) >= 13 
						then datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, datai, dataf)/60.0 end) / 8)*100 as pctdia,								-- pctdia
				1 as decreferias,																									-- decreferias
				0 as processada,																									-- processada
				13 as bsfalta,																										-- bsfalta
				obs,																									-- OBS
				'Horas extraordinárias' as ntipo1,																					-- ntipo1
				1 as usadtpr                                                                                                        -- usadtpr
			from
				@horas as em inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.entidade as e on em.eid = e.e_id
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe on e.e_contribuinte = pe.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_InsereProdutos`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-03-14 10:39* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PHC_InsereProdutos]

AS
BEGIN
	/******************** Insere Barcos ********************/

	-- 1)
	insert into [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st (ststamp, ref, design, familia, unidade, cpoc, u_idprod, tabiva, epv1, epv2, peso)
		select 
			'NA' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21),
			case when p_tp_id = 6 then convert(varchar(18),substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id)) else convert(varchar(18),p_id) end,
			p_nome, 
			convert(varchar(18),tp_nome), 
			(case when uni_nome is null then 'Unid' else uni_nome end), 
			1, 
			p_id, 
			2, 
			p_precovenda, 
			0, 
			p_pesoacab 
		from 
			produto 
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
		where  
			p_id not in (select u_idprod from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st) 
			and convert(char(18),p_id) not in (select ref from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st) 
			and p_tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1) where tptp_id is not null)-- produto_tipo where tp_tp_id = 1)-- and tp_id <> 55)
			and p_activo = 1 
			and not p_nome like 'BM %' 
			and substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + 
				reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS not in (select ref from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st)
		order by 
			tp_nome,p_nome

	-- 2) Actualiza codigos para pesquisa:
	insert into [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.stobs (stobsstamp, ref, ousrdata, ousrinis, usrdata)
		select 'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21), ref, getdate(), 'NA', getdate() from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st where ref not in (select distinct ref from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.stobs)


	/******************** Insere produtos Loja ********************/

	insert into [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st (ststamp, ref, design, familia, unidade, cpoc, u_idprod, tabiva, epv1, iva1incl, epv2, iva2incl, peso)
		select cast('ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21) as char(25)),
			convert(char(18),p_id),
			cast(p_nome as char(60)), 
			convert(varchar(18),tp_nome), 
			cast((case when uni_nome is null then 'Unid' else uni_nome end) as varchar(4)), 
			1, 
			cast(p_id as numeric(8,0)), 
			2, 
			round(p_precovenda*1.23,1), 
			1, 
			p_precovenda, 
			0, 
			p_pesoacab 
		from 
			produto 
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
		where 
			p_id not in (select u_idprod from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st) and convert(char(18),p_id) not in (select ref from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st) and 
			p_loja = 1
			and p_activo = 1
			--and p_tp_id = 107
		order by 
			tp_nome,p_nome
	
	
	--Actualiza codigos para pesquisa:
	insert into [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.stobs (stobsstamp, ref, ousrdata, ousrinis, usrdata)
		select 'ADM' + left(replace(newid(),'-',''),21), ref, getdate(), 'NA', getdate() from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st where ref not in (select distinct ref from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.stobs)
END
```

#### `dbo.PHC_Movimentos_Fornecedores`(@I date, @F date, @tds bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2025-09-04 11:06 · modificado 2026-04-14 16:02*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PHC_Movimentos_Fornecedores] 
	@I date, 
	@F date, 
	@tds bit
AS
BEGIN

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @dI date = @I, @dF date = @F, @todos bit = @tds

    select 
		case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end ClienteFornecedor,
		d.dostamp DocumentoId, m.adoc Documento, 
		isnull(f.fno, 0) FacturaNumero, cast(f.fdata as date) FacturaData, m.descricao Entidade, cast(case when year(d.u_datadoc) > 1900 then d.u_datadoc else m.data end as date) dataLancamento,
		cast(d.u_datadoc as date) DataDO, cast(d.u_datavenc as date) DataVencimento, cast(d.u_pago as float) Pago, cast(d.u_partepag as float) PartePaga, 
		case when sum(cast(m.edeb as float)) > 0 then isnull(sum(cast(m.edeb as float)),0) else isnull(sum(cast(m.ecre as float)),0) end Total,  -- cast(d.edebfin as float) Total,
		isnull(sum(cast(m.edeb as float)),0) edeb, isnull(sum(cast(m.ecre as float)),0) ecre, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) as float) CC, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) + isnull(fr.cc, 0) as float) EC,
		cast(case when fr.cc is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Forn, m.docnome, d.u_pago, d.u_pagar, d.u_datapag, year(d.u_datapag) AnoPag, month(d.u_datapag) MesPag, 
		datepart(WEEK,d.u_datapag) SemanaPag, u_priority, cast(case when m.conta like '22111%' then 1 else 0 end as bit) nacional
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.do d
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml m on d.dostamp = m.dostamp
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '21%' group by descricao) cl on m.descricao = cl.descr
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '22%' group by descricao) fr on m.descricao = fr.descr
		left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft f on m.adoc = cast(f.fno as nvarchar(max)) and m.conta like '21%' and (f.nmdoc = 'Factura' or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') and f.anulado = 0
	where
		m.conta like '22%' 
		and (((m.data between @dI and @dF or d.u_datadoc between @dI and @dF)
		and d.u_pago = @tds)
		--and case when @tds = 1 then 1 else d.u_pago end = case when @tds = 1 then 1 else @todos end)
		or (d.u_pagar = 1 and d.u_pago = 0)
		or (year(d.u_datapag) = year(getdate()) and month(d.u_datapag) = month(getdate())))
	group by
		case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end,
		d.dostamp, m.adoc, f.fno, f.fdata, m.descricao, m.data, d.u_datadoc, d.u_datavenc, d.u_pago, d.u_partepag, d.edebfin, cl.cc, fr.cc, m.docnome, d.u_pago, d.u_pagar, d.u_datapag, u_priority
		, cast(case when m.conta like '22111%' then 1 else 0 end as bit)

END
```

```sql
	where

		d.u_pago, d.u_partepag, d.edebfin, cl.cc, fr.cc, m.docnome, d.u_pago, d.u_pagar, d.u_datapag
END
```

```sql
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.do d
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml m on d.dostamp = m.dostamp
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '21%' group by descricao) cl on m.descricao = cl.descr
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '22%' group by descricao) fr on m.descricao = fr.descr
		left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft f on m.adoc = cast(f.fno as nvarchar(max)) and m.conta like '21%' and (f.nmdoc = 'Factura' or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') and f.anulado = 0
	where
		m.data between @dI and @dF
		and m.conta like '21%'
		and d.u_pago = @todos	
	group by
		case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end,
		d.dostamp, m.adoc, f.fno, f.fdata, m.descricao, m.data, d.u_datadoc, d.u_datavenc, d.u_pago, d.u_partepag, d.edebfin, cl.cc, fr.cc, m.docnome, d.u_pago, 
		d.u_pagar
	union all
	select
		'Clientes' ClienteFornecedor, f.ftstamp DocumentoId, cast(f.fno as nvarchar(max)) Documento, f.fno FacturaNumero, f.fdata FacturaData, f.nome Entidade, f.fdata dataLancamento, f.fdata DataDO,
		f.fdata DataVencimento, cast(0 as bit) Pago, 0 PartePaga, f.ettiliq Total, f.ettiliq edeb, 0 ecrer, 0 CC, 0 EC, cast(0 as bit) Forn, f.nmdoc docnome, f.u_pago u_pago, u_pagar --,*
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft as f 
	where
		f.anulado = 0
		and f.fdata between @dI and @dF -->= dateadd(month, -4, getdate())
		and f.nmdoc = 'Factura Proforma'
		and f.facturada = 0
		and f.u_pago = 0

END
```
