#### `dbo.Planeamento_Del`(@pl_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Planeamento_Del]

@pl_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @qtd_feita_ant float, @pl_prodf_id int, @pl_p_id int

	select @qtd_feita_ant = pl_qtd_feita, @pl_prodf_id = pl_prodf_id, @pl_p_id = pl_p_id from plano where pl_id = @pl_id

	update produto_fase set prodf_stock = prodf_stock - @qtd_feita_ant where prodf_id = @pl_prodf_id

	declare @prodf_id_ant int, @prodf_sequencia int

	set @prodf_sequencia = (select prodf_sequencia from produto_fase where prodf_id = @pl_prodf_id)

	if @prodf_sequencia > 1
	begin
		set @prodf_id_ant = (select prodf_id from produto_fase where prodf_p_id = @pl_p_id and prodf_sequencia = @prodf_sequencia - 1 and prodf_prodf_id is null and prodf_data_eliminado is null)

		update produto_fase set prodf_stock = prodf_stock + @qtd_feita_ant where prodf_id = @prodf_id_ant
	end

	declare @mov_id int 
	set @mov_id = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_pl_id = @pl_id)

	if (@mov_id is not null)
		exec Inventario_Del_Movimento @mov_id

    delete 
		plano 
	where 
		pl_id = @pl_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Planeamento_Lista_Necessidades`(@lista int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `reparac`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Planeamento_Lista_Necessidades]

@lista int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

select tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, 
		p_stock, p_stockmin, p_necessidades, p_stock - p_stockmin - p_necessidades as repor,  
		convert(bit, 0) as sel, coalesce(round(avg(sai.tot),0),0) as media, -1 as pl_prodf_id, coalesce(temp.t,0) as tp,
(case when coalesce(temp.t,0) < 10 then '0' else '' end) + convert(nvarchar(max), floor(coalesce(temp.t,0))) + ':' + (case when convert(int,(coalesce(temp.t,0)-floor(coalesce(temp.t,0)))*60) < 10 then '0' else '' end) + convert(nvarchar(max), convert(int,(coalesce(temp.t,0)-floor(coalesce(temp.t,0)))*60)) as tp_min
from lista_produto inner join produto on lp_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id left join
(select mov_p_id, year(mov_data) as ano, month(mov_data) as mes, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot
			from movimento where mov_data > dateadd(yy, -1, getdate()) and mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id, year(mov_data), month(mov_data)) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id left join
(select prodf_p_id, sum(prodf_tempo) as t from produto_fase where prodf_data_eliminado is null group by prodf_p_id) as temp on p_id = temp.prodf_p_id
where lp_l_id = @lista
group by tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_tempo_preparacao, p_tempo_solda, p_tempo_montagem, p_stock, p_stockmin, p_necessidades, p_stock - p_stockmin - p_necessidades,temp.t
order by tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Planeamento_Lista_Semana`(@ano int, @semana int, @pl_l_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-06 15:04* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Planeamento_Lista_Semana]

@ano int,
@semana int,
@pl_l_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		tp_nome, pl_id, p_id, p_nome, prodf_stock, pl_qtd, pl_tempo, coalesce(mov.tot,0) pl_qtd_feita, pl_e_id, e_nome, pl_prodf_id, fp_nome,
		(case when (pl_qtd * pl_tempo)/60 < 10 then '0' else '' end) + convert(nvarchar(max), floor((pl_qtd * pl_tempo)/60)) + ':' + 
			(case when convert(int,(((pl_qtd * pl_tempo)/60)-floor((pl_qtd * pl_tempo)/60))*60) < 10 then '0' else '' end) + 
					convert(nvarchar(max), convert(int,(((pl_qtd * pl_tempo)/60)-floor((pl_qtd * pl_tempo)/60))*60)) as tp_min
	from 
		plano 
		inner join produto on pl_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join produto_fase on pL_prodf_id = prodf_id 
		left join fases_producao on prodf_fp_id = fp_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id as id, mov_prodf_id as fid, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where year(mov_data) = @ano and datepart(ww,mov_data) = @semana and mov_tpmov_id in (1,7) group by mov_p_id, mov_prodf_id) as mov on pl_p_id = mov.id and pl_prodf_id = mov.fid
		left join entidade on pl_e_id = e_id
	where 
		pl_ano = @ano 
		and pl_semana = @semana 
		and pl_l_id = @pl_l_id
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome, prodf_sequencia

END
```

#### `dbo.Planeamento_Previsão`(@diasBarco int, @barcosTurno int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-12-09 11:05* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `molde`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Planeamento_Previsão]

@diasBarco int, 
@barcosTurno int

AS
BEGIN
	/*declare @diasBarco int, @barcosTurno int */
	declare @barcosTurno_ins int, @turno int, @dt_Lam smalldatetime, @mld int, @dt_mld smalldatetime, @mld_id int, @of int, @nomeMod nvarchar(max), @standBy int

	set @standBy = 0
	/*set @diasBarco = 7*/
	/*set @barcosTurno = 7*/

	set @dt_Lam = dateadd(day,1,convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101))

	declare @barcos table(id int, modelo nvarchar(max), np int, m int, tam int, dt_trans smalldatetime, dt_lam smalldatetime, trn int, mld_id int, lam int, diasAberta int, chk bit)
	declare @moldes table(data smalldatetime, trn int, id int, np int, m int, tam int)
	declare @barcosStandBy table(id int)

	set @mld = 1
	set @dt_mld = dateadd(day,1,convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101))
	while @mld < 150
	begin
		insert into @moldes(data, trn, id, np, m, tam) 
		select dateadd(day,@mld,@dt_mld), 1, of_id, p_np_id, p_m_id, p_tam_id from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id between 70000 and 79999 and of_fp_id in (13,14,15) and p_np_id is not null and p_m_id is not null and p_tam_id is not null
	
		insert into @moldes(data, trn, id, np, m, tam) 
		select dateadd(day,@mld,@dt_mld), 2, of_id, p_np_id, p_m_id, p_tam_id from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id between 70000 and 79999 and of_fp_id in (13,14,15) and p_np_id is not null and p_m_id is not null and p_tam_id is not null

		set @mld = @mld + 1
	end

	insert into @barcos (id, modelo, np, m, tam, dt_trans, dt_lam, trn, mld_id, diasAberta, chk)
	select distinct o.of_id, p_nome, p.p_np_id, p.p_m_id, p.p_tam_id, tr_data, x.OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA, of_turn_id, of_of_id_mld, datediff(day,of_data,getdate()), 0 
	from 
		ordemfabrico as o 
		outer apply (select top 1 * from of_fp inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID where offp_of_id = of_id and fp_producao = 1 order by OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA) x
		inner join transporte on o.of_tr_id = tr_id inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join (select of_id, p_np_id, p_m_id, p_tam_id from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
			where of_id between 70000 and 79999 and of_fp_id in (13,14,15) and p_np_id is not null and p_m_id is not null and p_tam_id is not null) as mld on p.p_np_id = mld.p_np_id and p.p_m_id = mld.p_m_id and p.p_tam_id = mld.p_tam_id
	where tr_data is not null and o.of_fp_id in (11,32) and o.of_e_id_enc <> 19747 /*Cliente Fábrica*/ group by o.of_id, p_nome, p.p_np_id, p.p_m_id, p.p_tam_id, tr_data, x.OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA, of_turn_id, of_of_id_mld,of_data --order by tr_data, of_data
	union all 
	select distinct o.of_id, p_nome, p.p_np_id, p.p_m_id, p.p_tam_id, dateadd(year,10,getdate()) as tr_data, x.OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA, of_turn_id, of_of_id_mld, datediff(day,of_data,getdate()), 0 
	from 
		ordemfabrico as o 
		outer apply (select top 1 * from of_fp inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID where offp_of_id = of_id and fp_producao = 1 order by OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA) x
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join (select 
						of_id, p_np_id, p_m_id, p_tam_id 
					from 
						ordemfabrico 
						inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
					where 
						of_id between 70000 and 79999 
						and of_fp_id in (13,14,15) 
						and p_np_id is not null 
						and p_m_id is not null 
						and p_tam_id is not null) as mld on p.p_np_id = mld.p_np_id and p.p_m_id = mld.p_m_id and p.p_tam_id = mld.p_tam_id
	where 
		o.of_fp_id in (11,32) 
		and o.of_tr_id is null 
		and o.of_e_id_enc <> 19747 /*Cliente Fábrica*/ 
	group by 
		o.of_id, p_nome, p.p_np_id, p.p_m_id, p.p_tam_id,of_data, x.OFFP_DATA_ENTREGA, of_turn_id, of_of_id_mld --order by tr_data, of_data

	while  @dt_Lam > '1900-1-1'
	begin
		set @turno = 1

		if datepart(weekday, @dt_Lam) = 7
			set @dt_Lam = dateadd(day,2,@dt_Lam)
		else if datepart(weekday, @dt_Lam) = 1
			set @dt_Lam = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)

		while @turno < 3
		begin
			set @barcosTurno_ins = 1

			while @barcosTurno_ins <= @barcosTurno
			begin
				set @mld_id = 0
				set @of = 0

				if @standBy = 0
				begin
					if exists(select top 1 * from @barcos where dt_lam = @dt_Lam and trn = @turno and mld_id is not null and chk = 0)
						select top 1 
							@mld_id = b.mld_id, 
							@of = b.id, 
							@nomeMod = b.modelo 
						from 
							@barcos as b 
						where 
							b.dt_lam = @dt_Lam 
							and b.trn = @turno 
							and b.mld_id is not null 
							and b.chk = 0
					else
						select top 1 
							@mld_id = m.id, 
							@of = b.id, 
							@nomeMod = b.modelo + ' (L)' 
						from 
							@barcos as b 
							inner join @moldes as m on b.np = m.np and b.m = m.m and b.tam = m.tam 
						where 
							m.data = @dt_Lam 
							and m.trn = @turno 
							and (b.dt_lam is null 
								or b.trn is null 
								or b.mld_id is null) 
							and b.chk = 0 
						order by 
							b.dt_trans, 
							b.diasAberta desc
				
					print 'nome: 1'
				end
				else if @standBy = 1
				begin
					select top 1 @mld_id = m.id, @of = b.id, @nomeMod = b.modelo from @barcos as b inner join @moldes as m on b.np = m.np and b.m = m.m and b.tam = m.tam where m.data = @dt_Lam and m.trn = @turno and (b.dt_lam is null or b.trn is null or b.mld_id is null) and b.chk = 0 and b.id not in (select id from @barcosStandBy) order by b.dt_trans, b.diasAberta desc
					print 'nome: 2'
				end

				if @mld_id > 0 and @of > 0 and @nomeMod not like 'K4 %' and @nomeMod not like 'Ocean %'
				begin
					update @barcos set modelo = @nomeMod, dt_lam = @dt_Lam, trn = @turno, mld_id = @mld_id, lam = @barcosTurno_ins, chk = 1 where id = @of
					if @turno = 2
					begin
						delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and ((trn = 2 and data = @dt_Lam) or (trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)))
						--delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)
					end
					else if @turno = 1
					begin
						delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and ((trn in (1,2) and data = @dt_Lam) or (trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)))
						--delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)
					end
					set @standBy = 0
					set @barcosTurno_ins = @barcosTurno_ins + 1
				end
				else if @mld_id > 0 and @of > 0 and @nomeMod like 'K4 %' and @barcosTurno - @barcosTurno_ins >=1
				begin
					update @barcos set modelo = @nomeMod, dt_lam = @dt_Lam, trn = @turno, mld_id = @mld_id, lam = @barcosTurno_ins, chk = 1 where id = @of

					if @turno = 2
					begin
						delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and ((trn = 2 and data = @dt_Lam) or (trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)))
						--delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)
					end
					else if @turno = 1
					begin
						delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and ((trn in (1,2) and data = @dt_Lam) or (trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)))
						--delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)
					end
					set @standBy = 0
					delete from @barcosStandBy where id = @of
					set @barcosTurno_ins = @barcosTurno_ins + 2
				end
				else if @mld_id > 0 and @of > 0 and @nomeMod like 'Ocean %'
				begin
					update @barcos set modelo = @nomeMod, dt_lam = @dt_Lam, trn = @turno, mld_id = @mld_id, lam = @barcosTurno_ins, chk = 1 where id = @of
					if @turno = 2
					begin
						delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and ((trn = 2 and data = @dt_Lam) or (trn in (1,2) and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)) or (trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,2,@dt_Lam)))
						--delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)
					end
					else if @turno = 1
					begin
						delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and ((trn in (1,2) and data = @dt_Lam) or (trn in (1,2) and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)) or (trn = 1 and data = dateadd(day,2,@dt_Lam)))
						--delete from @moldes where id = @mld_id and trn in (1,2) and data = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)
					end
					set @standBy = 0
					delete from @barcosStandBy where id = @of
					set @barcosTurno_ins = @barcosTurno_ins + 1
				end
				else if @mld_id > 0 and @of > 0 and @nomeMod like 'K4 %' and @barcosTurno - @barcosTurno_ins < 1
				begin
					if not exists (select id from @barcosStandBy where id = @of)
						insert into @barcosStandBy(id) values (@of)
					set @standBy = 1
				end
				else set @barcosTurno_ins = @barcosTurno_ins + 1
				--	delete from @barcos where id = @of

					--print @of
					--print @dt_Lam
			end

			set @turno = @turno + 1
		end

		if exists (select * from @barcos where dt_lam is null)
		begin
			if datepart(weekday, @dt_Lam) < 6
				set @dt_Lam = dateadd(day,1,@dt_Lam)
			else if datepart(weekday, @dt_Lam) >= 6
				set @dt_Lam = dateadd(day,3,@dt_Lam)
		end
		else
			set @dt_Lam = '1900-1-1'

	end

	delete from Z_PrevisaoPlano

	insert into Z_PrevisaoPlano ([OF], Modelo, Cliente, Referencia, Dia, Laminador, Turno, Molde, Dt_Trans, Dt_Lam, Dif, Cliente_id)
	select 
		id, 
		(case when dt_trans < dateadd(year,9,getdate()) then modelo else modelo + ' (Tr)' end) as modelo, e_nome, of_referencia, datepart(weekday,dt_lam) as dia, lam, 
		trn, 
		mld_id, 
		(case when dt_trans < dateadd(year,9,getdate()) then dt_trans else dateadd(day, 6-datepart(weekday,dateadd(day,@diasBarco,dt_Lam)),dateadd(day,@diasBarco,dt_Lam)) end) as dt_trans, 
		isnull(dt_lam, getdate()),
		datediff(day,dt_lam, (case when dt_trans < dateadd(year,9,getdate()) then dt_trans else dateadd(day, 6-datepart(weekday,dateadd(day,@diasBarco,dt_Lam)),dateadd(day,@diasBarco,dt_Lam)) end)) as dif, 
		e_id
	from 
		@barcos 
		inner join ordemfabrico on id = of_id 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
	where 
		chk = 1
	order by 
		dt_lam, trn, lam

	update ordemfabrico 
		set of_tr_data_prevista = (case when charindex('(Tr)',Modelo) > 0 then Dt_Trans else null end), 
			of_plano_data_prevista = (case when charindex('(L)',Modelo) > 0 then Dt_Lam else null end),
			of_plano_turno_previsto = (case when charindex('(L)',Modelo) > 0 then Turno else null end)
	from Z_PrevisaoPlano inner join ordemfabrico on [of] = of_id where charindex('(Tr)',Modelo) > 0 or charindex('(L)',Modelo) > 0

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlaneamentoF_NaoLaminados] 

@doDia bit = 0,
@deAmanha bit = 0,
@ofId int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if @doDia = 0 and @deAmanha = 0 and @ofId is null
    select 
		offp_id,
		cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio, turn_nome, o.of_id, p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as modelo, 
		e1.e_nome as func, p.p_id, dbo.of_Cores(o.of_id,0) as deck/*, p2.p_nome as casco*/, e.e_nome as cliente, o1.of_nome, 
		o.of_referencia, o.of_parapintarfora, o.of_paraalterar, o.of_observacoes, o.of_supervisaolaminagem, 
		offp_observacoes, 
		cast(e1.e_id as nvarchar(max)) + ISNULL('_' + cast(e1.e_e_id as nvarchar(max)), '') as func_id, 
		o.of_desconta_peso, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_problemas, o.of_acerto_resina, offp_fp_id,
		isnull(const.construcaoId, 0) construcaoId
	from 
		ordemfabrico as o 
		inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		inner join of_fp on o.of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id in (1,67) and offp_datafim is null
		left join offp_eq eq on offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
		left join turno on offp_turn_id = turn_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico as o1 on offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id 
		left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
		left join (select mov_of_id ofId, mov_id construcaoId from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where p_tp_id = 84 and mov_of_id is not null) const on o.of_id = const.ofId
	where 
		cast(offp_data_prevista as date) >= dateadd(day,-1,getdate()) and o.of_e_id_enc <> 25518
		and o.of_id < 10000000
	order by 
		cast(offp_data_prevista as date), turn_sequencia, p.p_nome
else if @doDia = 0 and @deAmanha = 0 and @ofId is not null
    select 
		offp_id,
		cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio, turn_nome, o.of_id, p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as modelo, 
		e1.e_nome as func, p.p_id, dbo.of_Cores(o.of_id,0) as deck/*, p2.p_nome as casco*/, e.e_nome as cliente, isnull(o1.of_nome,'') of_nome, 
		o.of_referencia, o.of_parapintarfora, o.of_paraalterar, o.of_observacoes, o.of_supervisaolaminagem, 
		offp_observacoes, 
		cast(e1.e_id as nvarchar(max)) + ISNULL('_' + cast(e1.e_e_id as nvarchar(max)), '') as func_id, 
		o.of_desconta_peso, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_problemas, o.of_acerto_resina, offp_fp_id,
		isnull(const.construcaoId, 0) construcaoId
	from 
		ordemfabrico as o 
		inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		inner join of_fp on o.of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id in (1,67)
		left join offp_eq eq on offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
		left join turno on offp_turn_id = turn_id 
		left join ordemfabrico as o1 on offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id 
		left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id

	where

		e1.e_nome as func, p.p_id, dbo.of_Cores(o.of_id,0) as deck/*, p2.p_nome as casco*/, e.e_nome as cliente, o1.of_nome, 
		o.of_referencia, o.of_parapintarfora, o.of_paraalterar, o.of_observacoes, o.of_supervisaolaminagem, 
		offp_observacoes, 
		cast(e1.e_id as nvarchar(max)) + ISNULL('_' + cast(e1.e_e_id as nvarchar(max)), '') as func_id, 
		o.of_desconta_peso, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_problemas, o.of_acerto_resina, offp_fp_id,
		isnull(const.construcaoId, 0) construcaoId
	from 
		ordemfabrico as o 
		inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		inner join of_fp on o.of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id in (1,67) and offp_datafim is null 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1

	where

		o.of_referencia, o.of_parapintarfora, o.of_paraalterar, o.of_observacoes, o.of_supervisaolaminagem,

		cast(e1.e_id as nvarchar(max)) + ISNULL('_' + cast(e1.e_e_id as nvarchar(max)), '') as func_id, 
		o.of_desconta_peso, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_problemas, o.of_acerto_resina, offp_fp_id,
		isnull(const.construcaoId, 0) construcaoId
	from

		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
		left join turno on offp_turn_id = turn_id
```

#### `dbo.PlaneamentoF_UltimosFeitos`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlaneamentoF_UltimosFeitos]

@p_id integer 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

 --   select top 15 of_datainicio, e1.e_nome, of_id, datediff(day,of_datainicio,getdate()) as dias, e1.e_id
	--from ordemfabrico inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 1 
	--	inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
	--where of_p_id = @p_id and of_datainicio < getdate() order by dias

	select top 10 cast(max(o.offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt, e1.e_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),o1.offp_peso) + ' (' + convert(nvarchar(max),o1.offp_peso - p_pesolam) + ')' as offp_peso, e1.e_id
	from ordemfabrico 
		inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		inner join of_fp as o on of_id = o.offp_of_id and o.offp_fp_id = 1 and o.offp_datafim is not null
		inner join offp_eq on o.offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		inner join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join of_fp as o1 on of_id = o1.offp_of_id and o1.offp_fp_id = 6 
	where of_p_id = @p_id and cast(o.offp_data_prevista as date) < getdate() 
	group by e1.e_nome, e1.e_id, p_pesolam, o1.offp_peso
	order by cast(max(o.offp_data_prevista) as date) desc
END
```

#### `dbo.PlaneamentoF_UltimosFeitos_Funcionario`(@p_id int, @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlaneamentoF_UltimosFeitos_Funcionario]

@p_id integer,
@e_id integer 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

 --   select top 15 of_datainicio, e1.e_nome, of_id, datediff(day,of_datainicio,getdate()) as dias, e1.e_id
	--from ordemfabrico inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 1 
	--	inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
	--where of_p_id = @p_id and of_datainicio < getdate() order by dias

	select top 10 cast(fp.offp_data_prevista as date) as dt, of_id, of_referencia, p_pesolam, convert(nvarchar(max),fp1.offp_peso) + ' (' + convert(nvarchar(max),fp1.offp_peso - p_pesolam) + ')' as offp_peso, fp.offp_observacoes
	from ordemfabrico 
		inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		inner join of_fp as fp on of_id = fp.offp_of_id and fp.offp_fp_id = 1 and fp.offp_datafim is not null
		inner join offp_eq on fp.offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		inner join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join of_fp as fp1 on of_id = fp1.offp_of_id and fp1.offp_fp_id = 6
	where of_p_id = @p_id and cast(fp.offp_data_prevista as date) < getdate() and e1.e_id = @e_id --group by e1.e_nome, e1.e_id
	order by cast(fp.offp_data_prevista as date) desc
END
```

#### `dbo.PlaneamentoPecas_Entrada`(@p_id int, @fp_id int, @data date, @qtd int, @movId int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2023-01-17 11:12 · modificado 2024-11-07 09:22* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlaneamentoPecas_Entrada] 
	@p_id int,
	@fp_id int,
	@data date,
	@qtd int,
	@movId int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if(@movId is not null or @movId > 0)
	begin
		declare @armId int, @saidasAuto int, @tipoMov int
		select @armId = p_arm_id, @saidasAuto = p_saidas_auto from produto where p_id = @p_id

		set @tipoMov = case when @fp_id = 78 or @saidasAuto = 0 then 16 else 1 end

		exec Inventario_Add_Movimento @data, null, @p_id, @tipoMov, 0, 0, @qtd, 'Planemamento de peças: Entrada', 20597, 0, @armId, null, null, 0, 0, 20597, null, null, @movId
	end
	else
	begin

		declare @Ofs table (OffpId int, ofId int, chefe int, OffpIdProx int, fpOrdem int, visto bit default 0)
		declare @offp_id int, @of_id int, @e_id int, @offp_id_prox int, @fpDestino int, @fpSequencia int
	
		insert into @Ofs (OffpId, ofId, chefe, OffpIdProx, fpOrdem)
		select top (@qtd) 
			f.offp_id, f.offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, fProx.offp_id, f.OFFP_ORDEM
		from 
			OF_FP f
			inner join ORDEMFABRICO on OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID 
			left join OFFP_EQ on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 
			outer apply (select top 1 offp_id from OF_FP where OFFP_OF_ID = f.OFFP_OF_ID and f.OFFP_ORDEM < OFFP_ORDEM order by OFFP_ORDEM) fProx 
		where 
			OF_P_ID = @p_id 
			and f.OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_id 
			and cast(f.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA as date) = @data 
			and f.OFFP_DATAFIM is null

		while exists (select * from @Ofs where visto = 0)
		begin
			select top 1 @offp_id = OffpId, @of_id = ofId, @e_id = chefe, @offp_id_prox = OffpIdProx, @fpSequencia = fpOrdem from @Ofs where visto = 0

			set @fpDestino = case when @offp_id_prox is null then 9 else null end

			exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @of_id = @of_id, @fp_id = @fp_id, @offp_datainicio = @data, @offp_datafim = @data, @offpeq_e_id_chefe = @e_id, @offp_observacoes = 'Fechada pelo planeamento de peças', @offp_id = @offp_id, @offp_peso = 0, @fp_id_destino = @fpDestino

			set @fpDestino = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id)

			update ORDEMFABRICO set OF_FP_ID = @fpDestino where OF_ID = @of_id

			if @fpDestino is not null
				exec MovimentoFase_Sai @OF_ID, @fpDestino
		
			update @Ofs set visto = 1 where OffpId = @offp_id
		end
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.PlaneamentoPecas_Qtd`(@p_id int, @qtd int, @funcionario int, @data date, @fase int, @dataEntrega date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-01-21 14:52* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `custo`, `preco`, `preço`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlaneamentoPecas_Qtd]
	@p_id int,
	@qtd int,
	@funcionario int = null,
	@data date,
	@fase int,
	@dataEntrega date = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @geraOf bit
	select @geraOf = p_gera_of from produto where p_id = @p_id

	if @geraOf = 0
	begin
		exec Inventario_Add_Movimento @data, null, @p_id, 15, 0, 0, @qtd, 'Planemamento de peças', 20597, 0, 7, null, null, 0, 0, 20597, null, null, null
	end
	else
	begin
		declare @ofs_Criar int, @precoCusto float, @precoVenda float, @fpId int, @hoje date = getdate(), @of_id int, @offp_id int, @constId int, @p_tp_id int

		/* Qtd de OFs a criar*/
		select 
			@ofs_Criar = @qtd - isnull(count(offp_id),0) 
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
		where 
			offp_fp_id = @fase 
			and offp_data_prevista is null 
			and offp_datainicio is null
			and of_p_id = @p_id
			and of_referencia <> 'OF gerada por falta de codigo de barras na peça'
			and OF_ID not in (select distinct OFFP_OF_ID from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = @fase and offp_data_prevista is not null)

		/* Preços e fase inicial do produto*/
		select 
			@p_tp_id = p_tp_id,
			@precoCusto = p.p_precocusto, 
			@precoVenda = p.p_precovenda,
			@fpId = f.prodf_fp_id ,
			@constId = c.constId
		from 
			produto p 
			cross apply (select top 1
							prodf_fp_id
						from 
							produto_fase
						where
							prodf_p_id = p.p_id 
							and prodf_data_eliminado is null 
							and prodf_prodf_id is null
						order by 
							prodf_sequencia) as f
			outer apply (select p_id constId from PRODUTO_COMPONENTE inner join produto p1 on COMP_P_P_ID = p1.P_ID where COMP_P_ID = p.P_ID and p1.P_TP_ID = 84) c
		where 
			p.p_id = @p_id


		declare @tOFs table (offpId int, ofId int)

		insert into @tOFs(offpId, ofId)
		(
			select top (@qtd)
				offp_id as id, OF_ID
			from 
				ordemfabrico 
				inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
			where
				offp_fp_id = @fase 
				and offp_data_prevista is null 
				and offp_datainicio is null
				and of_p_id = @p_id
				and of_referencia <> 'OF gerada por falta de codigo de barras na peça'
				and OF_ID not in (select distinct OFFP_OF_ID from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = @fase and offp_data_prevista is not null)
		)

		/* Actualiza OFs existentes */
		set @qtd = (case when @ofs_Criar < 0 then @qtd else @qtd - @ofs_Criar end)
		if @qtd > 0
		begin
			update
				of_fp 
			set 
				offp_data_prevista = @data, offp_of_id_mld = 70176
			from
				of_fp 
				inner join @tOFs on OFFP_ID = offpId

			if @dataEntrega is not null 
				update ORDEMFABRICO set OF_DATAENTREGA = @dataEntrega from ORDEMFABRICO inner join @tOFs on OF_ID = ofId

			if @funcionario is not null
				insert into offp_eq (offpeq_offp_id, offpeq_e_id, offpeq_chefe)
				(select top 1 offpId, @funcionario, case when offpeq_e_id is null then 1 else 0 end from @tOFs left join offp_eq on offpId = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1)
		end

		/* Cria OFs em falta */
		while @ofs_Criar > 0
		begin		
			declare @e_id int = case when @p_tp_id = 383 then 31663 /*NELO Rotomoldagem*/ else 19747 /*Fábrica*/ end

			/* Se TR Vortex Basic (id: 28016) */
			declare @ofNome nvarchar(max) = ''
			if @p_id = 28016
				set @ofNome = dbo.of_HIN_VortexN10()
			else if @p_id = 45873
				set @ofNome = dbo.of_HIN_VortexN10_Green()

			EXEC [dbo].[OrdemFabrico_Add_V2]
				@OF_EOF_ID = @fpId,
				@OF_DATA = @hoje,
				@OF_E_ID_ENC = @e_id,
				@OF_P_ID = @p_id,
				@OF_P_ID_CONST = @constId,
				@OF_OBSERVACOES = N'',
				@OF_MORADAENTREGA = N'',
				@OF_REFERENCIA = N'OF gerada no planeamento de peças',
				@OF_PRECOCUSTO = @precoCusto, 
				@OF_PRECOVENDA = @precoVenda,
				@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO = NULL, @OF_E_ID = NULL,@OF_OF_ID_MLD = NULL,	
				@OF_TELEFONE = NULL, @OF_EMAIL = NULL, @OF_TRANSPORTEDOC = NULL, @OF_ENC_ID = NULL,
				@OF_DESCONTO = 0,@OF_VALORPAGO = 0,@OF_PAGO = 0,@OF_AUTOCOLANTES = N'',	
				@OF_EMBALAGEM = NULL,@OF_OFTU_ID = NULL,@OF_SUPERVISAO = 0,	@OF_DATAINICIO = NULL,
				@OF_SUPERVISAOLAMINAGEM = 0,@OF_TURN_ID = NULL,	@OF_TR_ID = NULL,@OF_CRIADOR = N'',
				@OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = NULL,@OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = NULL, @OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = NULL,	
				@OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = NULL,	@OF_P_ID_QUINAS = NULL,	@OF_P_ID_QUINAS_TR = NULL,	@OF_P_ID_GOLA = NULL,	@OF_ACABCONTROLO = 0,
				@OF_ACABCONTROLO_CRIS = 0,	@of_transp = 0,	@of_paraalterar = 0,@of_id_copy = NULL,	@of_nome = @ofNome, @of_of_id_mae = null, @of_dataentrega = @dataEntrega

			select @of_id = max(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_p_id = @p_id and cast(OF_DATA as date) >= cast(getdate() as date)

			select top 1 @offp_id = offp_id from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @fase order by offp_ordem

			update 
				of_fp 
			set 
				offp_data_prevista = @data, offp_of_id_mld = 70176 
			where
				OFFP_ID = @offp_id
		
			if @funcionario is not null
				insert into offp_eq (offpeq_offp_id, offpeq_e_id, offpeq_chefe)
				values (@offp_id, @funcionario, 1)

			set @ofs_Criar = @ofs_Criar - 1
		end
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.PlaneamentoPecas_v2_Lista`(@data date, @lista bit, @dias int, @funcionarios int, @percent float, @json nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-10-30 10:02 · modificado 2025-06-06 15:18* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlaneamentoPecas_v2_Lista] 
	@data date, 
	@lista bit, 
	@dias int = 5, 
	@funcionarios int = 3,
	@percent float = 0.8,
	@json nvarchar(max) = ''
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @hoje date = getdate()

	declare @dt table(id int, ano int, mes int, dia int, qtd float)

	declare @dt_final table(pId int, mdo float, qtdPossivel int, numCiclos int, pecasCiclo int, visto bit default 0)

	if (@lista = 1)
	begin

		insert into @dt (id, ano, mes, dia, qtd) 
		(select 
			m.mov_p_id, 
			year(m.mov_data) as ano, 
			month(m.mov_data) as mes, 
			datepart(week,m.mov_data) as dia, 
			(case when coalesce(d.tot,0) = 0 then 0 else coalesce(d.tot,0)/sum(m.mov_quantidade) end) as qtd
		from 
			movimento as m 
			left join (select 
							mov_p_id, year(mov_data) as ano, month(mov_data) as mes, datepart(week,mov_data) as dia, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot 
						from 
							movimento 
						where 
							mov_defeituoso = 1 
							and mov_tpmov_id = 2 
						group by 
							mov_p_id, year(mov_data), month(mov_data), datepart(week,mov_data)) as d on m.mov_p_id = d.mov_p_id and year(m.mov_data) = d.ano and month(m.mov_data) = d.mes and datepart(week,m.mov_data) = d.dia
		where 
			m.mov_tpmov_id = 1 
			and m.mov_acerto = 0 
			and m.mov_data > '2016/07/22'
		group by m.mov_p_id, year(m.mov_data), month(m.mov_data), datepart(week,m.mov_data), d.tot)

		
		select distinct
				tp_nome as Tipo, 
				p_id as Id, 
				p_nome as Produto, 
				isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) as Nec, 
				isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) as Stock, 
				p_stockmin as StMin, 
				uni_nome as Uni,
				dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) as PecasCiclo, 
				dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) as CiclosDia, 
				round(COMP_QUANTIDADE,3) as mdoUni,
				case 
					when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
						then 0
					when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
						then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
					else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
				end as FazerNec,
				dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias as CapacSem,
				case
					when case 
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								then 0
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
								then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
							else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
						end <
						dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
					then case 
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								then 0
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
								then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
							else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
						end
					else dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
				end as CapacNec, 
				case
					when case 
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								then 0
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
								then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
							else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
						end > 0
					then p_stockmin
					when (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0)) - case 
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								then 0
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
								then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
							else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
						end > p_stockmin
					then 0
					else P_STOCKMIN - ((isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0)) - case 
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								then 0
							when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
								then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
							else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
						end)
				end as FazerStMin,
				case 
					when (dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias) - case
									when case 
											when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
												then 0
											when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
												then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
											else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
										end <
										dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
									then case 
											when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
												then 0
											when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
												then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
											else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
										end
									else dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
									end >= 0
					then (dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias) - case
						when case 
								when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
									then 0
								when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
									then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
							end <
							dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
						then case 
								when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
									then 0
								when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
									then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
							end
						else dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
						end
					else 0
					end as CapacStMin,
				0 as adicional
			from 
				produto
				left join produto_componente on P_ID = COMP_P_ID
				inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
				left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
							where tr_data between @hoje and @data and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12,13,14) group by mov_p_id) as ofs on p_id = ofs.mov_p_id 
				left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join transporte on mov_tr_id = tr_id 
							where tr_data between @hoje and @data and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_shop_order_id is not null group by mov_p_id) as shopTr on p_id = shopTr.mov_p_id 
				left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tr_id is null and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_shop_order_id is not null group by mov_p_id) as shop on p_id = shop.mov_p_id 
				left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
				left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
				left join (select p.mov_p_id, sum(p.mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento as p where p.mov_tpmov_id = 9 and p.MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 group by p.mov_p_id) as ped on p_id = ped.mov_p_id 
				left join (select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on p_id = dt.id 
				left join (select max(at_id) as id, at_p_id as at_pid from produto_attach group by at_p_id) as img on p_id = img.at_pid left join produto_attach on img.id = at_id
				left join (select id, sum(q) as qtd from 
								(select 
									COMP_P_P_ID as id, 
									case when (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end) < 0 then 0
										else (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end)
									end as q 
								from 
									PRODUTO_COMPONENTE 
									inner join MOVIMENTO on COMP_P_ID = MOV_P_ID 
									inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
									inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
									left join (select p_id as pId, SUM(Stock) as stock from [dbo].[produto_stocks_por_armazem] group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_ID = st.pId
								where 
									COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 2 
									and tr_data between @hoje and @data 
									and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12,13,14)
								group by 
									COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, st.stock) as x
							group by id) as xxx on p_id = xxx.id 
				left join ENTIDADE on P_E_ID_RESP = E_ID
				left join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
			where 
				(P_ARM_ID = 8
				or COMP_P_P_ID = 20745) 
				and P_ACTIVO = 1
				and (P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
					or (P_DESCONTINUADO = 1 and isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) > 0))
				and TP_TP_ID not in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
				and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
			order by
				TP_NOME, P_NOME
	end
	else
	begin
		if (len(@json)>10)
			insert into @dt_final (pId, mdo, qtdPossivel, numCiclos, pecasCiclo)
			SELECT Id, mdoUni, CapacNec + adicional, CiclosDia, PecasCiclo FROM OpenJson(@json)
			with(
				Id int '$.Id',
				mdoUni float '$.mdoUni',
				CapacNec float '$.CapacNec',
				PecasCiclo float '$.PecasCiclo',
				CiclosDia float '$.CiclosDia',
				adicional int '$.adicional'
			)
		else
		insert into @dt_final (pId, mdo, qtdPossivel, numCiclos, pecasCiclo)
			select distinct
						p_id, 
						COMP_QUANTIDADE,
						case
							when case 
									when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
										then 0
									when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
										then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
									else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
								end <
								dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
							then case 
									when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
										then 0
									when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
										then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
									else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
								end
							else dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) * dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) * @dias
						end as possiveisFazer,
						dbo.maximo(P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,1) as P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA,			
						dbo.maximo(P_PECAS_CICLO,1) as P_PECAS_CICLO
					from 
						produto
						left join produto_componente on P_ID = COMP_P_ID
						inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
						left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data between @hoje and @data and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12,13,14) /*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/ group by mov_p_id) as ofs on p_id = ofs.mov_p_id 
						left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join transporte on mov_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data between @hoje and @data and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_shop_order_id is not null /*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/ group by mov_p_id) as shopTr on p_id = shopTr.mov_p_id 
						left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tr_id is null and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_shop_order_id is not null group by mov_p_id) as shop on p_id = shop.mov_p_id 
						left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
						left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
						left join (select p.mov_p_id, sum(p.mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento as p where p.mov_tpmov_id = 9 and p.MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 group by p.mov_p_id) as ped on p_id = ped.mov_p_id 
						left join (select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on p_id = dt.id 
						left join (select max(at_id) as id, at_p_id as at_pid from produto_attach group by at_p_id) as img on p_id = img.at_pid left join produto_attach on img.id = at_id
						left join (select id, sum(q) as qtd from 
										(select 
											COMP_P_P_ID as id, 
											case when (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end) < 0 then 0
												else (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end)
											end as q 
										from 
											PRODUTO_COMPONENTE 
											inner join MOVIMENTO on COMP_P_ID = MOV_P_ID 
											inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
											inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
											left join (select p_id as pId, SUM(Stock) as stock from [dbo].[produto_stocks_por_armazem] group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_ID = st.pId
										where 
											COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 2 
											and tr_data between @hoje and @data 
											and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12,13,14)
										group by 
											COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, st.stock) as x
									group by id) as xxx on p_id = xxx.id 
						left join ENTIDADE on P_E_ID_RESP = E_ID
						left join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
					where 
						(P_ARM_ID = 8
						or COMP_P_P_ID = 20745) 
						and P_ACTIVO = 1
						and (P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
							or (P_DESCONTINUADO = 1 and isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) > 0))
						and TP_TP_ID not in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
						and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
						and case 
								when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) > isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
									then 0
								when isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) < 0
									then isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0)
								else isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) + isnull(xxx.qtd, 0) - (isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0))
							end > 0

		declare @pId int, @mdo float, @qtdPossivel int, @numCiclos int, @pecasCiclo int, @diaSem int, @capacidadeDispDia float, @qtdInserir int

		declare @plano table(diaSemana int, pId int, qtd int, mdo float) 

		while exists(select * from @dt_final where visto = 0)
		begin
			select top 1 @pId = pId, @mdo = mdo, @qtdPossivel = qtdPossivel, @numCiclos = numCiclos, @pecasCiclo = pecasCiclo from @dt_final where visto = 0 order by qtdPossivel * mdo desc

			set @diaSem = 2

			while (@qtdPossivel > 0 and @diaSem <= @dias + 1)
			begin

				set @capacidadeDispDia = (@funcionarios * 8 * @percent) - isnull((select sum(mdo) from @plano where diaSemana = @diaSem),0)
				if (@qtdPossivel <= @numCiclos * @pecasCiclo and @qtdPossivel * @mdo <= @capacidadeDispDia)
				begin
					set @qtdInserir = @qtdPossivel
				end
				else 
					set @qtdInserir = case when @capacidadeDispDia >= (cast(@numCiclos * @pecasCiclo as float) * @mdo) --floor(@capacidadeDispDia / (cast(@pecasCiclo as float) * @mdo)) > @numCiclos * @pecasCiclo 
											then @numCiclos * @pecasCiclo
											else floor(@capacidadeDispDia / (cast(@numCiclos * @pecasCiclo as float) * @mdo)) * @pecasCiclo
									end
			
				if (@qtdInserir > 0)
				begin
					insert into @plano (diaSemana, pId, qtd, mdo) values (@diaSem, @pId, @qtdInserir, @qtdInserir * @mdo)
					update @dt_final set qtdPossivel -= @qtdInserir where pId = @pId
					set @qtdPossivel -= @qtdInserir
				end
			
				set @diaSem += 1
			end
			update @dt_final set visto = 1 where pId = @pId
		end

		select 
			pl.diaSemana, p.P_NOME as Produto, pl.qtd, round(pl.mdo,3) as mdo, pl.pId as Id, a.fp_id 
		from 
			@plano pl 
			inner join produto p on pl.pId = p.P_ID 
			outer apply (select top 1 fp_id from PRODUTO_FASE s inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on prodf_fp_id = fp_id where PRODF_P_ID = p.P_ID and FP_PLANEAMENTO = 1 and PRODF_DATA_ELIMINADO is null order by PRODF_SEQUENCIA) a
		order by 
			diaSemana, P_NOME
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Plano_Planeia`(@of_id int, @turno int, @data date, @offp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2021-06-01 14:13 · modificado 2022-06-15 09:33* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Plano_Planeia]
	
	@of_id int,
	@turno int,
	@data date,
	@offp_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @of_id_mld int
	
	select top 1
		@of_id_mld = oMld.of_id --, oMld.of_nome, oMld.OF_FP_ID
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO o
		inner join produto p on o.OF_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join produto pMld on p.P_NP_ID = pMld.P_NP_ID and p.P_M_ID = pMld.P_M_ID and p.P_TAM_ID = pMld.P_TAM_ID
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO oMld on pMld.P_ID = oMld.OF_P_ID
	where
		o.OF_ID = @of_id
		and pMld.P_TP_ID = 82
		and oMld.OF_FP_ID in (15,13,14)

	if (@offp_id is null)
		update of_fp set OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA = @data, OFFP_TURN_ID = @turno, OFFP_OF_ID_MLD = @of_id_mld where offp_fp_id = 1 and OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id
	else
		update of_fp set OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA = @data, OFFP_TURN_ID = @turno, OFFP_OF_ID_MLD = @of_id_mld where OFFP_ID = @offp_id


END
```

#### `dbo.PlanoLaminagem_Lista_Laminadores`(@tipo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlanoLaminagem_Lista_Laminadores]

@tipo int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@tipo = 1)
	begin
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (5,16,11) and e_activo = 1
		union
		select null as e_id, ' ' as e_nome order by e_nome
	end
	else if (@tipo = 2)
	begin
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where (e_ent_id in (5,16,11) or e_id = 20372) and e_activo = 1
		union
		select null as e_id, ' ' as e_nome order by e_nome
	end
	else if (@tipo = 3)
	begin
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where (e_ent_id in (28) or e_id = 20372) and e_activo = 1
		union
		select null as e_id, ' ' as e_nome order by e_nome
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.PlanoLaminagem_Lista_Moldes`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-02-11 08:55* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `v_of`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlanoLaminagem_Lista_Moldes]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		of_id, 
		(case when of_fp_id = 13 then '(PR) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 14 and offpgrav_id is not null then '(PARADO!!!) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 14 then '(R) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 15 then of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 16 then '(PA) ' + of_nome
			when of_fp_id = 17 then '(A) ' + of_nome end) as of_nome, 
		p_np_id, 
		p_m_id, 
		p_tam_id ,
		isnull(of_peso_deck,0) as of_peso_deck,
		isnull(of_peso_casco,0) as of_peso_casco
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_id, offpgrav_id  from of_fp left join offp_gravidades on offp_id = fpgrav_offp_id left join offp_gravidade on fpgrav_offpgrav_id = offpgrav_id where of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id and offpgrav_parar = 1 and offp_datafim is null) x
	where 
		p_tp_id = 82 and of_fp_id in (13,14,15,16/*,17*/)
	union
	select null as of_id, ' ' as of_nome, null as p_np_id, null as p_m_id, null as p_tam_id, 0, 0 order by of_id
	
END
```

#### `dbo.PlanoLaminagem_Lista_NaoLaminados`(@tipo int, @fp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-09-30 09:28* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlanoLaminagem_Lista_NaoLaminados]

@tipo int,
@fp_id int = 1

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@tipo = 1)
	begin
		select
			offp_id,
			cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio,
			offp_turn_id as of_turn_id,
			offpeq_e_id,
			offp_of_id_mld as of_of_id_mld,
			datediff(day,of_data, getdate()) as dias,
			of_id,
			case when of_of_id_mae between 892000 and 892200 then 'Dragon Boat (' + cast(isnull(laminagem.qtd,0) as nvarchar(max)) + 'h): ' else '' end + case when of_p_id = 41876 then 'Dragon Boat' else p.p_nome end + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as p_nome,
			of_referencia,
			e_nome,
			dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores,
			isnull(tr_data, maeT.maeTr) tr_data,
			p.p_np_id,
			p.p_m_id,
			p.p_tam_id,
			of_supervisaopintura,
			of_fp_id,
			of_observacoes,
			of_parapintarfora,
			of_paraalterar,
			dbo.GrauDificuldade(of_id) as grau,
			of_tr_data_prevista,
			of_plano_data_prevista,
			of_plano_turno_previsto
		from
			ordemfabrico 
			left join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
			inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
			left join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id 
			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id 
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			left join (select of_id id, tr_data maeTr from ORDEMFABRICO inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id where of_tr_id is not null) maeT on of_of_id_mae = maeT.id
			left join (select mov_of_id, sum(mov_quantidade) qtd from movimento where mov_of_id is not null and mov_p_id = 20794 group by mov_of_id) laminagem on of_id = laminagem.MOV_OF_ID
		where
			p.p_tp_id not in (7,9,112,245) 
			and p.p_fabricointerno = 1 
			and offp_planeamento = 1 
			and offp_datainicio is null 
			and (of_id < 10000000 or of_p_id in (52165, 30491, 34278, 36694, 53730) or of_of_id_mae between 892000 and 892200)
			and (case when @fp_id in (1,67) then @fp_id else OF_FP_ID end) = ISNULL(@fp_id, 1)
			and of_e_id_enc <> 25518
		order by
			of_datainicio, p.p_nome
	end	
	else if (@tipo = 2)
	begin
		select
			offp_id,
			cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio,
			offp_turn_id as of_turn_id,
			offpeq_e_id,
			offp_of_id_mld as of_of_id_mld,
			datediff(day,of_data, getdate()) as dias,
			of_id,
			case when of_of_id_mae between 892000 and 892200 then 'Dragon Boat (' + cast(isnull(laminagem.qtd,0) as nvarchar(max)) + 'h): ' else '' end + case when of_p_id = 41876 then 'Dragon Boat' else p.p_nome end + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as p_nome,
			of_referencia,
			e_nome,
			dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, 
			isnull(tr_data, maeT.maeTr) tr_data,
			p.p_np_id,
			p.p_m_id,
			p.p_tam_id,
			of_supervisaopintura,
			of_fp_id,
			of_observacoes,
			of_parapintarfora,
			of_paraalterar,
			dbo.GrauDificuldade(of_id) as grau,
			of_tr_data_prevista,
			of_plano_data_prevista,
			of_plano_turno_previsto
		from
			ordemfabrico left join
			entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join 
			produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join 
			of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id left join 
			offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			left join (select of_id id, tr_data maeTr from ORDEMFABRICO inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id where of_tr_id is not null) maeT on of_of_id_mae = maeT.id
			left join (select mov_of_id, sum(mov_quantidade) qtd from movimento where mov_of_id is not null and mov_p_id = 20794 group by mov_of_id) laminagem on of_id = laminagem.MOV_OF_ID
		where
			/*of_fp_id in (11,32) and*/ 
			p.p_tp_id in (7,9,112,245) 
			and p.p_fabricointerno = 1 
			and offp_planeamento = 1 
			and offp_datainicio is null 
			and (of_id < 10000000 or of_p_id = 52165 or of_of_id_mae between 892000 and 892200)
			and (case when @fp_id = 1 then 1 else OF_FP_ID end) = ISNULL(@fp_id, 1)
			and of_e_id_enc <> 25518
		order by
			of_datainicio, p.p_nome
	end
	else if (@tipo = 3)
	begin
		select
			offp_id,
			cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio,
			offp_turn_id as of_turn_id,
			offpeq_e_id,
			offp_of_id_mld as of_of_id_mld,
			datediff(day,of_data, getdate()) as dias,
			of_id,
			p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as p_nome,
			of_referencia,
			e_nome,
			dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, 
			tr_data,
			p.p_np_id,
			p.p_m_id,
			p.p_tam_id,
			of_supervisaopintura,
			of_fp_id,
			of_observacoes,
			of_parapintarfora,
			of_paraalterar,
			dbo.GrauDificuldade(of_id) as grau,
			of_tr_data_prevista,
			of_plano_data_prevista,
			of_plano_turno_previsto
		from
			ordemfabrico left join
			entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join 
			produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join 
			of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 36 left join 
			offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		where
			p.p_fabricointerno = 1 
			and p_gera_of = 1 
			/*and offp_planeamento = 1*/ 
			and offp_datainicio is null and of_id < 10000000 and of_supervisaopintura = 0
			and of_e_id_enc <> 25518
		order by
			of_datainicio, p.p_nome
	end	

END
```

#### `dbo.PlanoLaminagem_Lista_Semana`(@ano int, @semana int, @tipo int, @of_arm_id_lam int, @fp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-10-02 11:38* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlanoLaminagem_Lista_Semana]

@ano int,
@semana int,
@tipo int,
@of_arm_id_lam int,
@fp_id int = 1

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if (@tipo = 1)
begin
	select
		case when o.of_of_id_mae between 892000 and 892200 then 'Dragon Boat (' + cast(isnull(laminagem.qtd,0) as nvarchar(max)) + 'h): ' else '' end + case when o.of_p_id = 41876 then 'Dragon Boat' else p_nome end + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as p_nome,
		o.of_id,
		e1.e_nome as laminador,
		o1.of_nome,
		e.e_nome,
		offp_turn_id as of_turn_id,
		datepart(dw,offp_data_prevista) as dia,
		o.of_supervisaolaminagem, 
		dbo.GrauDificuldade(o.of_id) as grau,
		(case when OFFP_DATAFIM is not null then 2 when offp_datainicio is not null and OFFP_DATAFIM is null then 1 else 0 end) as estado
		, case when e.e_nelo = 1 then 0 else o.of_precovenda end of_precovenda
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto on o.of_p_id = p_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join
		of_fp on o.of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id left join 
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id inner join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id
		left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id 
		left join (select mov_of_id, sum(mov_quantidade) qtd from movimento where mov_of_id is not null and mov_p_id = 20794 group by mov_of_id) laminagem on o.of_id = laminagem.MOV_OF_ID
	where

		offp_of_id_mld is not null 
		--p_tp_id not in (7,9,112) and

		o.of_supervisaolaminagem, dbo.GrauDificuldade(o.of_id) as grau,
		(case when OFFP_DATAFIM is not null then 2 when offp_datainicio is not null and OFFP_DATAFIM is null then 1 else 0 end) as estado
		, 0 of_precovenda
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto on o.of_p_id = p_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join
		of_fp on o.of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id left join 
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join

		left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id

	where

		(o.of_id between 70000 and 89999 or of_p_id = 52165) and

		o.of_arm_id_lam = @of_arm_id_lam
		and (case when @fp_id in (1,67) then @fp_id else o.OF_FP_ID end) = ISNULL(@fp_id, 1)
	order by

		offp_turn_id,
		e1.e_nome
end
else if (@tipo = 2)

	where

		and (case when @fp_id = 1 then 1 else o.OF_FP_ID end) = ISNULL(@fp_id, 1)
	union
	select

		o.of_id,

	from
```

#### `dbo.PlanoLaminagem_NecessidadesMP`(@ano int, @semana int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2026-04-15 10:59 · modificado 2026-04-24 14:59* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlanoLaminagem_NecessidadesMP]

@ano int,
@semana int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @t table(mov_id int, tp_id int, tp_nome nvarchar(max), P_ID int, P_NOME nvarchar(max), stock float, qtdN float, p_tem_stock bit, OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA date, visto bit)

	insert into @t
	select
		mP.mov_id, tp_id, tp_nome, pP.P_ID, pP.P_NOME, 0 stock, mP.mov_quantidade, pP.p_tem_stock, OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA, 0
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join PRODUTO pM on of_p_id = pM.p_id
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
		inner join movimento mC on of_id = mC.mov_of_id 
		inner join produto pC on mC.mov_p_id = pC.P_ID
		inner join movimento mP on mC.mov_id = mP.MOV_MOV_ID
		inner join produto pP on mP.mov_p_id = pP.P_ID
		inner join produto_tipo on pP.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		--cross apply (select round(sum(case when MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 then mov_quantidade else mov_quantidade * -1 end),0) stock from movimento where mov_p_id = pP.p_id and MOV_TPMOV_ID in (1,2)) st
	where
		year(OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA) = @ano and datepart(WEEK,OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA) = @semana
		--and cast(OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA  as date) >= cast(getdate() as date)
		and pC.p_tp_id = 84
	--group by
	--	tp_id, tp_nome, pP.P_ID, pP.P_NOME, st.stock, pP.p_tem_stock
	
	while exists(select mov_id from @t where visto = 0)
	begin
	
		declare @mov_id int
		select top 1 @mov_id = mov_id from @t where visto = 0

		update @t set visto = 1 where mov_id = @mov_id

		insert into @t
		select
			mP.mov_id, tp.tp_id, tp.tp_nome, pP.P_ID, pP.P_NOME, 0 stock, mP.mov_quantidade, pP.p_tem_stock, OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA, 0
		from
			@t x
			inner join movimento mP on x.mov_id = mP.mov_mov_id
			inner join produto pP on mP.mov_p_id = pP.P_ID
			inner join produto_tipo tp on pP.P_TP_ID = tp.TP_ID
			--cross apply (select round(sum(case when MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 then mov_quantidade else mov_quantidade * -1 end),0) stock from movimento where mov_p_id = pP.p_id and MOV_TPMOV_ID in (1,2)) st
		where
			mP.mov_mov_id = @mov_id
		--group by
		--	tp_id, tp_nome, pP.P_ID, pP.P_NOME, st.stock, pP.p_tem_stock
		
	end

	select
		x.tp_id TipoId, x.tp_nome Tipo, x.P_ID ProdutoId, x.P_NOME Produto, round(st.stock - case when x.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA < cast(getdate() as date) then 0 else isnull(cA.qtdNd,0) end,1) Stock, round(sum(x.qtdN),1) qtdN, x.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA, datepart(WEEKDAY,x.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA) diaSemana
	from
		@t x
		cross apply (select round(sum(case when MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 then mov_quantidade else mov_quantidade * -1 end),0) stock from movimento where mov_p_id = x.p_id and MOV_TPMOV_ID in (1,2)) st
		outer apply (select round(sum(x1.qtdN),1) qtdNd from @t x1 where x1.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA < x.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA and x.P_ID = x1.P_ID) cA
	where
		x.p_tem_stock = 1
		and x.tp_id in (57, 410, 412, 413)
	group by
		x.tp_id, x.tp_nome, x.P_ID, x.P_NOME, st.stock, x.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA, cA.qtdNd
	order by 
		tp_nome, P_NOME

END
```

#### `dbo.PlanoLaminagem_RacioMoldesModelos`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-12-03 12:04* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PlanoLaminagem_RacioMoldesModelos]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	declare @table table (Modelo nvarchar(max), OFs float, Moldes float)

	insert into @table (Modelo, OFs, Moldes)
	(select 
		np_nome + ' ' + m_nome + ' ' + (case when tam_nome = 'UNICO' then '' else tam_nome end) as Modelo, count(of_id) as OFs
	,(select count(of_id) from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where p_np_id = np_id and p_m_id = m_id and p_tam_id = tam_id and of_id between 70000 and 79999 and of_fp_id in (13,14,15)) as Moldes
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join 
		produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
		produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
		produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id inner join 
		produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id
	where 
		of_fp_id in (11,32) and of_datainicio is null and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
	group by 
		np_id, m_id, tam_id, np_nome + ' ' + m_nome + ' ' + (case when tam_nome = 'UNICO' then '' else tam_nome end))


	select Modelo, OFs, Moldes, (case when Moldes = 0 then 0 else round(OFs/Moldes,2) end) as Racio from @table order by racio desc

END
```

#### `dbo.Pontos_Lista_HE`(@ano int, @mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Pontos_Lista_HE]

@ano int, 
@mes int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select distinct
		chefe.e_nome, 
		20 as dias,
		gajos.total as gajos,
		20 * 8 * gajos.total as mes,
		coalesce(horas.total,0) - coalesce(faltas.total,0) as total,
		20 * 8 * gajos.total + coalesce(horas.total,0) - coalesce(faltas.total,0) as tot,
		round(rep.reps,2) as reps,
		round(coalesce(aj.ajudas,0.00),2) as ajudas
	from
		entidade_pontos inner join 
		equipa as eq on ep_eq_id = eq.eq_id inner join 
		(select e_id, e_nome, eeq_eq_id from entidade_equipa inner join entidade on eeq_e_id = e_id 
			where eeq_chefe = 1 and ((year(eeq_data_entrada) = @ano and month(eeq_data_entrada) <= @mes) or year(eeq_data_entrada) < @ano)
				and (eeq_data_saida is null or 
					((year(eeq_data_saida) = @ano and month(eeq_data_saida) > @mes) or year(eeq_data_saida) > @ano))) as chefe on eq.eq_id = chefe.eeq_eq_id
	left join
	(select eeq_eq_id, 
		sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as total
			from entidade_equipa inner join ent_mov on eeq_e_id = movent_e_id
				where ((year(eeq_data_entrada) = @ano and month(eeq_data_entrada) <= @mes) or year(eeq_data_entrada) < @ano)
					and (eeq_data_saida is null or ((year(eeq_data_saida) = @ano and month(eeq_data_saida) > @mes) or year(eeq_data_saida) > @ano)) and
						year(movent_data_I) = @ano and month(movent_data_I) = @mes and movent_met_id = 1 group by eeq_eq_id) as horas on eq.eq_id = horas.eeq_eq_id
	left join
	(select eeq_eq_id, 
		sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as total
			from entidade_equipa inner join ent_mov on eeq_e_id = movent_e_id inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id
				where ((year(eeq_data_entrada) = @ano and month(eeq_data_entrada) <= @mes) or year(eeq_data_entrada) < @ano)
					and (eeq_data_saida is null or ((year(eeq_data_saida) = @ano and month(eeq_data_saida) > @mes) or year(eeq_data_saida) > @ano)) and
						year(movent_data_I) = @ano and month(movent_data_I) = @mes and met_met_id = 2 group by eeq_eq_id) as faltas on eq.eq_id = faltas.eeq_eq_id
	left join
	(select eeq_eq_id, 
		count(*) as total
			from entidade_equipa
				where ((year(eeq_data_entrada) = @ano and month(eeq_data_entrada) <= @mes) or year(eeq_data_entrada) < @ano)
					and (eeq_data_saida is null or ((year(eeq_data_saida) = @ano and month(eeq_data_saida) > @mes) or year(eeq_data_saida) > @ano)) 
						group by eeq_eq_id) as gajos on eq.eq_id = gajos.eeq_eq_id
	left join
	(select offpeq_e_id, sum(offp_horas_rep) as reps 
		from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 8 and offpeq_chefe = 1 and year(offp_datafim) = @ano and month(offp_datafim) = @mes group by offpeq_e_id) as rep on chefe.e_id = rep.offpeq_e_id
	left join 
	(select offpeq_e_id as iddd, sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as ajudas
		from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id inner join ent_mov on offp_of_id = movent_of_id where offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_fp_id = 8 and movent_met_id = 13 and year(offp_datafim) = @ano and month(offp_datafim) = @mes 
			group by offpeq_e_id) as aj on chefe.e_id = aj.iddd
END
```

#### `dbo.Pontos_Lista_Mes`(@ano int, @mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `reparac`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Pontos_Lista_Mes]

@ano int, 
@mes int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		ep_id,
		ep_diasmes,
		chefe.e_nome,
		ep_horas,
		ep_reparacoes,
		ep_horas - ep_reparacoes as Total,
		coef.coefs,
		(case when coef.coefs = 0 then 0 else (ep_horas - ep_reparacoes)/coef.coefs end) as HoraBarco,
		(case when ep_diasmes = 0 then 0 else ((coef.coefs * 5) - (ep_horas - ep_reparacoes)) / ep_diasmes * 60 end) as MinDia,
		(case when ep_diasmes = 0 then 0 else (((coef.coefs * 5) - (ep_horas - ep_reparacoes)) / ep_diasmes * 60 * ep_diasmes) / 60 end) as HorasGanhas,
		coalesce(pontos_pontos, 0) as pontos, 
		ep_desconto, 
		coalesce(pontos_pontos, 0) - ep_desconto as Total1, 
		ep_obs,
		coalesce((select sum(p.pontos_pontos - ep.ep_desconto) 
			from entidade_pontos as ep inner join pontos as p on ep.ep_pontos_id = p.pontos_id 
				where ep.ep_ano = @ano and ep.ep_mes <= @mes and ep.ep_eq_id = eq.eq_id),0) as Acumulado,
		coalesce((select sum(p.pontos_pontos - ep.ep_desconto) 
			from entidade_pontos as ep inner join pontos as p on ep.ep_pontos_id = p.pontos_id 
				where ep.ep_ano = @ano and ep.ep_mes < @mes and ep.ep_eq_id = eq.eq_id),0) as Acumulado1
	from 
		entidade_pontos inner join 
		equipa as eq on ep_eq_id = eq.eq_id inner join 
		(select e_nome, eeq_eq_id from entidade_equipa inner join entidade on eeq_e_id = e_id 
			where eeq_chefe = 1 and ((year(eeq_data_entrada) = @ano and month(eeq_data_entrada) <= @mes) or year(eeq_data_entrada) < @ano)
				and (eeq_data_saida is null or 
					((year(eeq_data_saida) = @ano and month(eeq_data_saida) > @mes) or year(eeq_data_saida) > @ano))) as chefe on eq.eq_id = chefe.eeq_eq_id inner join
		(select eeq_eq_id, sum(of_coeficiente) as coefs from entidade_equipa inner join offp_eq on eeq_e_id = offpeq_e_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join
			of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id
				where ((year(eeq_data_entrada) = @ano and month(eeq_data_entrada) <= @mes) or year(eeq_data_entrada) < @ano)
					and (eeq_data_saida is null or ((year(eeq_data_saida) = @ano and month(eeq_data_saida) > @mes) or year(eeq_data_saida) > @ano)) and offp_fp_id = 8 and
						year(of_datafim) = @ano and month(of_datafim) = @mes group by eeq_eq_id) as coef on eq.eq_id = coef.eeq_eq_id left join
		pontos on ep_pontos_id = pontos_id
	where 
		ep_ano = @ano and
		ep_mes = @mes
	order by 
		chefe.e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Pontos_Upd`(@ep_id int, @ep_ano int, @ep_mes int, @ep_diasmes int, @ep_horas float, @ep_reparacoes float, @pontos int, @ep_desconto int, @ep_obs nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `reparac`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Pontos_Upd]

@ep_id int,
@ep_ano int,
@ep_mes int,
@ep_diasmes int,
@ep_horas float,
@ep_reparacoes float,
@pontos int,
@ep_desconto int,
@ep_obs nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	set @pontos = (select pontos_id from pontos where pontos_pontos = @pontos)

    update entidade_pontos 
	set 
		ep_ano = @ep_ano, ep_mes = @ep_mes, ep_diasmes = @ep_diasmes, 
		ep_horas = @ep_horas, ep_reparacoes = @ep_reparacoes, ep_pontos_id = @pontos, ep_desconto = @ep_desconto, ep_obs = @ep_obs
	where
		ep_id = @ep_id

	declare @ep_e_id int
	set @ep_e_id = (select ep_e_id from entidade_pontos where ep_id = @ep_id)

	exec pontos_verifica_premios @ep_e_id, @ep_ano

END
```

#### `dbo.pontos_verifica_premios`(@ep_e_id int, @ep_ano int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[pontos_verifica_premios]

@ep_e_id int,
@ep_ano int

as
begin
	set nocount on;

	if (month(getdate()) > 3)
	begin

		declare @mes int, @soma int, @pontos int, @ep_id int, @eeq_id int

		set @eeq_id = (select eeq_eq_id from entidade_equipa where eeq_e_id = @ep_e_id and eeq_data_saida is null)

		set @mes = 4

		set @soma = (select sum(pontos_pontos - ep_desconto) from entidade_pontos inner join pontos on ep_pontos_id = pontos_id where ep_ano = @ep_ano and ep_mes < @mes and ep_eq_id = @eeq_id)

		while (@mes <= 12)
		begin
			select @ep_id = ep_id, @pontos = coalesce(pontos_pontos,0) - ep_desconto from entidade_pontos inner join pontos on ep_pontos_id = pontos_id where ep_ano = @ep_ano and ep_mes = @mes and ep_eq_id = @eeq_id

			if (@soma + @pontos >= 50)
			begin
				set @soma = @soma + @pontos - 50

				update entidade_pontos set ep_premio = 1, ep_resto = @soma where ep_id = @ep_id

				set @mes = @mes + 1
				set @ep_id = NULL
				set @pontos = 0
			end
			else
			begin
				if (@ep_id is not null)
					update entidade_pontos set ep_premio = 0, ep_resto = 0 where ep_id = @ep_id

				set @soma = @soma + @pontos
				set @mes = @mes + 1
				set @ep_id = NULL
				set @pontos = 0
			end
		end

	end

end
```

#### `dbo.Produto_fase_receita`(@prodf_id int, @prodf_p_id int, @prodf_fp_id int, @prodf_descricao nvarchar(max), @prodf_tempo float, @prodf_sequencia int, @prodf_criador nvarchar(max), @prodf_actualizador nvarchar(max), @prodf_dataactualizacao smalldatetime, @prodf_prodf_id int, @tarefa int, @prodf_coeficiente float, @prodf_coeficiente_x float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-12-15 09:08* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Produto_fase_receita]

@prodf_id int = null,
@prodf_p_id int = null,
@prodf_fp_id int = null, 
@prodf_descricao nvarchar(max),
@prodf_tempo float = 0,
@prodf_sequencia int,
@prodf_criador nvarchar(max),
@prodf_actualizador nvarchar(max) = null,
@prodf_dataactualizacao smalldatetime = null,
@prodf_prodf_id int = null,
@tarefa int, /* 0 para apagar; 1 para inserir; 2 para actualizar */
@prodf_coeficiente float = 0,
@prodf_coeficiente_x float = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@tarefa = 0) /*apagar*/
	begin
		if @prodf_id is not null
			update produto_fase set prodf_data_eliminado = getdate() where prodf_id = @prodf_id
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 1) /*inserir*/
	begin
		if @prodf_prodf_id is null
		begin
			set @prodf_sequencia = coalesce((select max(prodf_sequencia) + 1 from produto_fase where prodf_prodf_id is null and prodf_p_id = @prodf_p_id and prodf_data_eliminado is null),1)
		end
		else if @prodf_prodf_id is not null
		begin
			set @prodf_sequencia = coalesce((select max(prodf_sequencia) + 1 from produto_fase where prodf_prodf_id = @prodf_prodf_id and prodf_data_eliminado is null),1)
		end
	
		insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia, prodf_criador, prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao, prodf_prodf_id, prodf_tempo, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_coeficiente_x)
		values (@prodf_p_id, @prodf_fp_id, @prodf_descricao, @prodf_sequencia, @prodf_criador, @prodf_actualizador, @prodf_dataactualizacao, @prodf_prodf_id, @prodf_tempo, @prodf_coeficiente, @prodf_coeficiente_x)
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 2) /*actualizar*/
	begin
		update produto_fase set prodf_descricao = @prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia = @prodf_sequencia, 
								prodf_actualizador = @prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao = @prodf_dataactualizacao, prodf_tempo = @prodf_tempo,
								prodf_coeficiente = @prodf_coeficiente, prodf_coeficiente_x = @prodf_coeficiente_x
		where prodf_id = @prodf_id
		
		if (@prodf_p_id is not null and @prodf_fp_id is not null and @prodf_prodf_id is null)
			update 
				OF_FP 
			set 
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = @prodf_coeficiente_x
			from
				ORDEMFABRICO 
				inner join OF_FP on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
			where 
				OF_P_ID = @prodf_p_id
				and OFFP_FP_ID = @prodf_fp_id
				and OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X <> @prodf_coeficiente_x
				and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
				--and (OFFP_DATAFIM >= dateadd(month, -2, getdate())
				--	or OFFP_DATAFIM is null)
	end
END
```
