```sql
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Produto_Fases_Add] 

	@operacao int = 1,
	@prodf_p_id int,
	@prodf_fp_id int = null,
	@prodf_criador nvarchar(max),
	@prodf_automatica bit,
	@prodf_fabrico bit,
	@prodf_sequencia int,
	@prodf_id_anterior int = null,
	@prodf_id_prox int = null,
	@prodf_tpcam_id int = null,
	@prodf_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @id int

	if @operacao = 1 -- Novo
	begin
		
		update produto_fase set prodf_sequencia += 1 where PRODF_P_ID = @prodf_p_id and prodf_sequencia >= @prodf_sequencia

		insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_criador, prodf_automatica, prodf_fabrico, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_tpcam_id, prodf_sequencia) 
		(select @prodf_p_id, @prodf_fp_id, @prodf_criador, @prodf_automatica, @prodf_fabrico, fp_hora_coef, @prodf_tpcam_id, @prodf_sequencia from fases_producao where fp_id = @prodf_fp_id)

		set @id = @@identity

		if @prodf_id_anterior is not null and @prodf_id_prox is not null
			delete from produto_fase_link where prodfl_prodf_id_prox = @prodf_id_prox and prodfl_prodf_id_ant = @prodf_id_anterior

		if @prodf_id_anterior is not null
			insert into produto_fase_link(prodfl_prodf_id_prox, prodfl_prodf_id_ant) values (@id,@prodf_id_anterior)

		if @prodf_id_prox is not null
			insert into produto_fase_link(prodfl_prodf_id_prox, prodfl_prodf_id_ant) values (@prodf_id_prox,@id)

	end
	--else if @operacao = 2 -- Update
	--begin

	--	insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_criador, prodf_automatica, prodf_fabrico, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_tpcam_id) 
	--	(select @prodf_p_id, @prodf_fp_id, @prodf_criador, @prodf_automatica, @prodf_fabrico, fp_hora_coef, @prodf_tpcam_id from fases_producao where fp_id = @prodf_fp_id)

	--	set @id = @@identity

	--	if @prodf_id_anterior is not null and @prodf_id_prox is not null
	--		delete from produto_fase_link where prodfl_prodf_id_prox = @prodf_id_prox and prodfl_prodf_id_ant = @prodf_id_anterior

	--	if @prodf_id_anterior is not null
	--		insert into produto_fase_link(prodfl_prodf_id_prox, prodfl_prodf_id_ant) values (@id,@prodf_id_anterior)

	--	if @prodf_id_prox is not null
	--		insert into produto_fase_link(prodfl_prodf_id_prox, prodfl_prodf_id_ant) values (@prodf_id_prox,@id)

	--end
	else if @operacao = 3 -- Delete
	begin

		delete from produto_fase_link where prodfl_prodf_id_ant = @prodf_id or prodfl_prodf_id_prox = @prodf_id

		delete from produto_fase where prodf_id = @prodf_id
		
		if @prodf_id_prox is not null and @prodf_id_anterior is not null
			insert into produto_fase_link(prodfl_prodf_id_prox, prodfl_prodf_id_ant) values (@prodf_id_prox, @prodf_id_anterior)

	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Produto_Fases_Copy_Paste`(@p_id_copy int, @p_id_paste int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Produto_Fases_Copy_Paste]

@p_id_copy int,
@p_id_paste int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @t table (prodf_id int, prodf_prodf_id int);

    with cte (prodf_id, prodf_prodf_id) as
	(
		select prodf_id, prodf_prodf_id from produto_fase inner join fases_producao on prodf_fp_id = fp_id where prodf_p_id = @p_id_copy
		union all
		select pf.prodf_id, pf.prodf_prodf_id from cte as c inner join produto_fase as pf on c.prodf_id = pf.prodf_prodf_id
	)

	insert into @t (prodf_id, prodf_prodf_id) (select * from cte)

	declare @id int, @id_c int, @id_1 int, @prodf_id_1 int, @prodf_prodf_id_1 int

	while exists (select * from @t where prodf_prodf_id is null)
	begin

		set @id_c = (select top 1 prodf_id from @t where prodf_prodf_id is null)
		
		insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia, prodf_data, prodf_criador, prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao, prodf_prodf_id, prodf_data_eliminado)
		(select @p_id_paste, prodf_fp_id, prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia, prodf_data, prodf_criador, prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao, prodf_prodf_id, prodf_data_eliminado from produto_fase where prodf_id = @id_c)

		set @id = @@identity
		
		while exists (select * from @t where prodf_prodf_id = @id_c)
		begin

			select top 1 @prodf_id_1 = prodf_id, @prodf_prodf_id_1 = prodf_prodf_id from @t where prodf_prodf_id = @id_c

			insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia, prodf_data, prodf_criador, prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao, prodf_prodf_id, prodf_data_eliminado)
			(select @p_id_paste, prodf_fp_id, prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia, prodf_data, prodf_criador, prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao, @id, prodf_data_eliminado from produto_fase where prodf_id = @prodf_id_1 and prodf_prodf_id = @prodf_prodf_id_1)

			set @id_1 = @@identity

			insert into produto_fase (prodf_p_id, prodf_fp_id, prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia, prodf_data, prodf_criador, prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao, prodf_prodf_id, prodf_data_eliminado)
			(select @p_id_paste, prodf_fp_id, prodf_descricao, prodf_sequencia, prodf_data, prodf_criador, prodf_actualizador, prodf_dataactualizacao, @id_1, prodf_data_eliminado from produto_fase where prodf_prodf_id = @prodf_id_1) 

			delete from @t where prodf_id = @prodf_id_1 and prodf_prodf_id = @prodf_prodf_id_1
		end

		delete from @t where prodf_id = @id_c or prodf_prodf_id = @id_c
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Produto_Fases_Passos`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-01-26 16:36* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Produto_Fases_Passos]

@p_id int 

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    with cte (prodf_id, prodf_data, fp_nome, prodf_descricao, prodf_tempo, prodf_sequencia, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_prodf_id, prodf_data_eliminado, prodf_coeficiente_x, fp_hora_coef) as
	(
		select prodf_id, prodf_data, convert(nvarchar(max),fp_nome), prodf_descricao, prodf_tempo, prodf_sequencia, prodf_coeficiente, prodf_prodf_id, prodf_data_eliminado, prodf_coeficiente_x * fp_hora_coef, fp_hora_coef from produto_fase inner join fases_producao on prodf_fp_id = fp_id where prodf_p_id = @p_id
		union all
		select pf.prodf_id, pf.prodf_data, convert(nvarchar(max),''), pf.prodf_descricao, pf.prodf_tempo, pf.prodf_sequencia, pf.prodf_coeficiente, pf.prodf_prodf_id, pf.prodf_data_eliminado, pf.prodf_coeficiente_x * fp.fp_hora_coef, fp.fp_hora_coef from cte as c inner join produto_fase as pf on c.prodf_id = pf.prodf_prodf_id inner join fases_producao fp on pf.prodf_fp_id = fp.fp_id
	)

	select * from cte
END
```

#### `dbo.Produto_Image`(@at_id int, @at_nome nvarchar(100), @at_image nvarchar(max), @at_descricao nvarchar(max), @at_p_id int, @at_att_id int, @at_eobs_id int, @tarefa int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Produto_Image]

@at_id int,
@at_nome nvarchar(50),
@at_image nvarchar(max),
@at_descricao nvarchar(max) = '',
@at_p_id int = null,
@at_att_id int = 1,
@at_eobs_id int = null,
@tarefa int

as

BEGIN TRANSACTION


	if (@tarefa = 0) /*apagar*/
	begin
		delete from produto_attach where at_id = @at_id
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 1)/*inserir*/
	begin
		insert into produto_attach (at_nome, at_image, at_descricao, at_p_id, at_att_id, at_eobs_id) values (@at_nome, @at_image, @at_descricao, @at_p_id, @at_att_id, @at_eobs_id)
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 2)/*actualizar*/
	begin
		update produto_attach set at_nome = @at_nome, at_image = @at_image, at_descricao = @at_descricao, at_p_id = @at_p_id, at_att_id = @at_att_id where at_id = @at_id or at_eobs_id = @at_eobs_id
	end

COMMIT TRANSACTION

select id=@@identity

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

```sql
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Produto_Set_EAN] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@p_id int = 0
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @pre varchar(12);
	DECLARE @ean decimal(13, 0);

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	--SELECT @pre = CONCAT('56004042', format(cast(max(right(left(p_ean, 12), 4)) as int)+1 , '000#'))  FROM produto WHERE p_ean is not null;
	SELECT @pre = CONCAT('56004042', format(dbo.getNextEAN(), '000#'))

	--SET @pre = '560040420000' + '803';
	--SELECT @ean = CONCAT(@pre, dbo.udf_get_check_digit_ucc_ean13(CAST @pre as bigint))
	--print @pre;
	--print dbo.udf_get_check_digit_ucc_ean13(@pre);

	UPDATE produto SET P_EAN = CONCAT(@pre, dbo.udf_get_check_digit_ucc_ean13(@pre)) WHERE p_id = @p_id;

	select CONCAT(@pre, dbo.udf_get_check_digit_ucc_ean13(@pre));

END
```

#### `dbo.ProdutoLista_Upd_OFs`(@pl_id int, @corrigir bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-04-30 14:58* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`, `producao`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ProdutoLista_Upd_OFs] 

@pl_id int,
@corrigir bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @corrigir = 1
		delete OF_CHECKLIST
		from 
			produto
			inner join ORDEMFABRICO on p_id = OF_P_ID
			inner join PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS on P_PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID
			inner join of_fp on of_id = OFFP_OF_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFFP_FP_ID
			--inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on offp_fp_id = FP_ID
			inner join OF_CHECKLIST on offp_id = OFCH_OFFP_ID --and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR
			left join (select distinct OFCH_OFFP_ID as id from of_checklist where ofch_estado > 0 or OFCH_RESOLVIDO = 1 or ofch_visto = 1) as x on offp_id = x.id
		where
			OF_DATAFIM is null
			--and OFFP_FP_ID <> 8
			and x.id is null
			and P_PL_ID = @pl_id


	insert into of_checklist (OFCH_DESCR, OFCH_VISTO, OFCH_RESOLVIDO, OFCH_OF_ID, OFCH_SEQUENCIA,OFCH_FP_ID,OFCH_FP_ID_CHK, ofch_culpa_chefe, ofch_offp_id, ofch_molde_reparar, ofch_offp_id_culpa)
	select 
		pli_descr, 0, 0, of_id, 
		pli_sequencia - case when matt.ofId is not null and pli_fp_id_chk = 74 then 100 else 0 end, 
		PLI_FP_ID, 
		case when matt.ofId is not null and pli_fp_id_chk = 74 then 8 else pli_fp_id_chk end, 
		pli_culpa_chefe, offp_id, pli_molde_reparar, z.id
	from 
		produto
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on p_id = OF_P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS on P_PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID
		left join (select distinct mov_of_id ofId from movimento where MOV_P_ID = 41578 and MOV_ATRIB_ID = 103) matt on of_id = matt.ofId
		inner join of_fp on of_id = OFFP_OF_ID and case when matt.ofId is not null and pli_fp_id_chk = 74 then 8 else pli_fp_id_chk end = OFFP_FP_ID
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_id id from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID and OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID order by OFFP_ORDEM ) z
		left join OF_CHECKLIST on offp_id = OFCH_OFFP_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR
		left join (select distinct OFCH_OFFP_ID as id from of_checklist where ofch_estado > 0 or OFCH_RESOLVIDO = 1 or ofch_visto = 1) as x on offp_id = x.id
	where
		OF_DATAFIM is null
		and OFCH_ID is null
		and x.id is null
		and P_PL_ID = @pl_id


	--select 
	--	pli_descr, 0, 0, of_id, pli_sequencia, PLI_FP_ID, case when matt.ofId is not null and pli_fp_id_chk = 74 then 8 else pli_fp_id_chk end, pli_culpa_chefe, offp_id, pli_molde_reparar, z.id
	--from 
	--	produto
	--	inner join ORDEMFABRICO on p_id = OF_P_ID
	--	inner join PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS on P_PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID
	--	left join (select distinct mov_of_id ofId from movimento where MOV_P_ID = 41578 and MOV_ATRIB_ID = 103) matt on of_id = matt.ofId
	--	inner join of_fp on of_id = OFFP_OF_ID and case when matt.ofId is not null and pli_fp_id_chk = 74 then 8 else pli_fp_id_chk end = OFFP_FP_ID
	--	outer apply (select top 1 offp_id id from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID and OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID order by OFFP_ORDEM ) z
	--	left join OF_CHECKLIST on offp_id = OFCH_OFFP_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR
	--where
	--	OF_DATAFIM is null
	--	and offp_id not in (select distinct OFCH_OFFP_ID as id from of_checklist where ofch_estado > 0 or OFCH_RESOLVIDO = 1 or ofch_visto = 1)
	--	and OFCH_ID is null
	--	and P_PL_ID = 1015

END
```

#### `dbo.ProdutoModelo_Add`(@m_nome nvarchar(max), @m_descricao nvarchar(max))

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ProdutoModelo_Add]

@m_nome nvarchar(max),
@m_descricao nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if not exists(select * from produto_modelo where m_nome = @m_nome)
		insert into produto_modelo (m_nome, m_descricao) values (@m_nome, @m_descricao)
	else
		raiserror('Já existe um modelo com esse nome na BD..!', 16, 1)
END
```

```sql
END
```

```sql
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		comp_id, comp_atrib_id, comp_fp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, comp_quantidade, comp_valor_extra, comp_eliminado, atrib_nome_pt, comp_gestor_marca
	from 
		produto_componente 
		inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join atributo on comp_atrib_id = atrib_id
	where 
		comp_l_id = @l_id 
		and comp_tpcomp_id = 3 
	order by 
		atrib_nome_pt, tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.ProdutosAssociados_Add`(@p_id int, @qtd float, @of_id int, @tpmov_id int, @mov_deck_part nvarchar(max), @mov_id int, @atrib_id int, @mov_precovenda float, @mov_acessorio_adicional bit, @fp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-04-22 09:09* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[ProdutosAssociados_Add]

@p_id int,
@qtd float,
@of_id int,
@tpmov_id int,
@mov_deck_part nvarchar(max) = '',
@mov_id int = null, 
@atrib_id int = null,
@mov_precovenda float = 0,
@mov_acessorio_adicional bit = 0,
@fp_id int = null

as

	declare @mov_p_id int,
			@mov_quantidade float,
			@id_pai int,
			@identity int,	
			@mov_deck nvarchar(max),
			@mov_mov_id int,
			@p_preco float,
			@mov_atrib_id int,
			@construcao bit = 0, 
			@resina float = 0,
			@arm_id int,
			@stock bit,
			@movid_pai int

--if @mov_acessorio_adicional = 0
--begin

	-- Vê se é uma construção, por causa da qtd resina
	if exists(select p_id from produto where p_id = @p_id and p_tp_id = 84)
	begin

		set @construcao = 1
		select @resina = p_qtd_resina from produto inner join ordemfabrico on p_id = of_p_id where of_id = @of_id

	end

	create table #associados
	(
		id int,
		qtd float,
		pai int,
		mov_id int,
		mov_deck_part nvarchar(max),
		mov_atrib_id int,
		mov_precovenda float,
		mov_acessorio_adicional bit default 0,
		visto bit default 0
	)

	insert into #associados (id, qtd, pai, mov_id, mov_deck_part, mov_atrib_id, mov_precovenda, mov_acessorio_adicional) 
					values (@p_id, @qtd, NULL, @mov_id, @mov_deck_part, @atrib_id, @mov_precovenda, @mov_acessorio_adicional);

	with associados (id, qtd, pai, mov_atrib_id) as
	(
		select 
			p_id, (case when @construcao = 1 and p_id in (21399,27484) and @resina > 0 then @resina else @qtd * comp_quantidade end), convert(int,@p_id), comp_atrib_id
		from 
			produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id=p_id 
		where 
			comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1
		union all
		select 
			p_id, qtd * comp_quantidade, id, comp_atrib_id
		from 
			associados inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id=p_id 
		where 
			comp_tpcomp_id = 1
	)

	insert into #associados (id, qtd, pai, mov_atrib_id) (select * from associados)

	while exists (select * from #associados where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 
			@mov_p_id = id, 
			@mov_quantidade = qtd, 
			@id_pai = pai, 
			@mov_deck = coalesce(mov_deck_part,''), 
			@mov_mov_id = mov_id, 
			@mov_atrib_id = mov_atrib_id, 
			@mov_precovenda = mov_precovenda, 
			@mov_acessorio_adicional = mov_acessorio_adicional 
		from 
			#associados
		where 
			visto = 0

		set @movid_pai = (select coalesce((select top 1 mov_id from #associados where id=@id_pai), @mov_mov_id))

		declare @of_datafim date 
		select @of_datafim = of_datafim from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_ID = @of_id

		select 
			@p_preco = (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end),
			@tpmov_id = (case when @tpmov_id = 4 or @of_datafim is null then 4 when p_saidas_auto = 1 then 2 else 11 end),
			@arm_id = P_ARM_ID,
			@stock = P_TEM_STOCK
		from 
			produto 
		where 
			p_id = @mov_p_id

		insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_of_id, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_mov_id, mov_deck_part, mov_precounitario, mov_atrib_id, mov_precovenda, mov_acessorio_adicional, MOV_ARM_ID, mov_fp_id)
			values 
		(getdate(), @mov_quantidade, 'OF: ' + convert(nvarchar(max), @of_id), @of_id, @mov_p_id, @tpmov_id, @movid_pai, @mov_deck, coalesce(@p_preco,0), @mov_atrib_id, coalesce(@mov_precovenda,0), @mov_acessorio_adicional, @arm_id, @fp_id)

		set @identity = @@identity

		--if (@tpmov_id = 2 and @stock = 0)
		--	exec ProdutosComponentes_Entrada @mov_p_id, @mov_quantidade, @identity

		if @id_pai is not null
			update #associados set mov_id = @identity, visto = 1 where id = @mov_p_id and qtd = @mov_quantidade and pai = @id_pai
		else			
			update #associados set mov_id = @identity, visto = 1 where id = @mov_p_id

	end

	drop table #associados
--end
--else
--begin
--	select 
--		@p_preco = (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end),
--		@tpmov_id = (case when @tpmov_id = 4 or @of_datafim is null then 4 when p_saidas_auto = 1 then 2 else 11 end),
--		@arm_id = P_ARM_ID
--	from 
--		produto 
--	where 
--		p_id = @mov_p_id

--	insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_of_id, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_mov_id, mov_deck_part, mov_precounitario, mov_atrib_id, mov_precovenda, mov_acessorio_adicional, MOV_ARM_ID)
--		values 
--	(getdate(), @qtd, 'OF: ' + convert(nvarchar(max), @of_id), @of_id, @p_id, @tpmov_id, null, '', isnull(@p_preco,0), @mov_atrib_id, coalesce(@mov_precovenda,0), @mov_acessorio_adicional, @arm_id)
--end


if @p_id = 20598 and @atrib_id not in (24,25) -- Pintura(Mix)
	update ordemfabrico set of_supervisaopintura = 1 where of_id = @of_id and of_fp_id in (18,11) and of_supervisaopintura = 0
```

#### `dbo.ProdutosComponentes_Add`(@p_id int, @qtd float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[ProdutosComponentes_Add]

@p_id int,
@qtd float

as

declare @ruptura float
set @ruptura = (select p_stock - p_necessidades - p_stockmin - @qtd from produto where p_id = @p_id)

if (@ruptura < 0)
begin

	set @ruptura = (case when (@ruptura * -1) >= @qtd then @qtd else @qtd + @ruptura end);

	with componentes (id, qtd, pai, rupt) as
	(
		select p_id, @ruptura * comp_quantidade, convert(int,@p_id), (p_stock - p_necessidades - p_stockmin)-(@ruptura * comp_quantidade)
			from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id=p_id where comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
		union all
		select p_id, (case when ((rupt - (qtd * comp_quantidade)) * -1) >= (qtd * comp_quantidade) then (qtd * comp_quantidade)
							 else (qtd * comp_quantidade) + (rupt) end), 
			   id, ((p_stock - p_necessidades - p_stockmin) - (qtd * comp_quantidade))
		from componentes inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id=p_id 
		where rupt < 0 and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
	)

	update produto set p_necessidades = p_necessidades + qtd from componentes inner join produto on id = p_id

end
```

```sql
create procedure [dbo].[ProdutosComponentes_Del]

@p_id int,
@qtd float

as

declare @ruptura float
set @ruptura = (select p_stock - p_necessidades - p_stockmin - @qtd from produto where p_id = @p_id)

if (@ruptura < 0)
begin

	set @ruptura = (case when (@ruptura * -1) >= @qtd then @qtd else @qtd + @ruptura end);

	with componentes (id, qtd, pai, rupt) as
	(
		select p_id, @ruptura * comp_quantidade, convert(int,@p_id), (p_stock - p_necessidades - p_stockmin)-(@ruptura * comp_quantidade)
			from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id=p_id where comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
		union all
		select p_id, (case when ((rupt - (qtd * comp_quantidade)) * -1) >= (qtd * comp_quantidade) then (qtd * comp_quantidade)
							 else (qtd * comp_quantidade) + (rupt) end), 
			   id, ((p_stock - p_necessidades - p_stockmin) - (qtd * comp_quantidade))
		from componentes inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id=p_id 
		where rupt < 0 and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
	)

	update produto set p_necessidades = (case when (p_necessidades - qtd) < 0 then 0 else (p_necessidades - qtd) end) from componentes inner join produto on id = p_id

end
```

#### `dbo.ProdutosComponentes_Entrada`(@p_id int, @qtd float, @id_pai int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2020-07-24 12:00* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[ProdutosComponentes_Entrada]

@p_id int,
@qtd float,
@id_pai int

as
	declare @p_nome nvarchar(max), @p_loja bit, @p_tem_stock bit
	select @p_nome = p_nome, @p_loja = P_LOJA, @p_tem_stock = P_TEM_STOCK from produto where p_id = @p_id

	if exists(select * from movimento where mov_mov_id = @id_pai)
	begin
		update movimento set mov_quantidade = @qtd * comp_quantidade, mov_observacoes = 'Entrada de ' + convert(nvarchar(max),@qtd) + ' ' + @p_nome, mov_arm_id = p_arm_id
		from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id 
			where comp_p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 and mov_mov_id = @id_pai
	end
	else
	begin
	insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_quantidade, mov_observacoes, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_mov_id, mov_precounitario, mov_arm_id)
	select 
		getdate(), 
		@qtd * comp_quantidade, 
		'Entrada de ' + convert(nvarchar(max),@qtd) + ' ' + @p_nome, 
		p_id, 
		(case when p_saidas_auto = 1 or (@p_loja = 1 and @p_tem_stock = 0) then 2 else 11 end), 
		@id_pai, 
		(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end),
		p_arm_id
	from 
		produto_componente 
		inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id 
	where 
		comp_p_id = @p_id 
		and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
end
```

```sql
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[PSD_getPremade] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT * FROM
	OPENQUERY(MY_SQL, 'SELECT DISTINCT p.entity_id, p.sku, preco.value as preco, nome.value as nome, CONCAT(''https://www.paddlesportsdesign.com/pub/media/catalog/product'', image.value) as imagem
	FROM nelopt_magento.catalog_product_entity p INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_website w ON w.product_id = p.entity_id INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_decimal preco ON preco.entity_id = p.entity_id AND preco.attribute_id = 75  INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_int activo ON p.entity_id = activo.entity_id AND activo.attribute_id = 96 AND activo.store_id = 4 INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_varchar nome ON p.entity_id = nome.entity_id AND nome.attribute_id = 71 AND nome.store_id = 4 INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_varchar image ON p.entity_id = image.entity_id AND image.attribute_id = 85 
	WHERE attribute_set_id = 12 AND website_id = 1  AND activo.value = 1')

END
```

```sql
		catalog_product_website w ON w.product_id = p.entity_id INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_decimal preco ON preco.entity_id = p.entity_id AND preco.attribute_id = 75  INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_int activo ON p.entity_id = activo.entity_id AND activo.attribute_id = 96 AND activo.store_id = 4 INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_varchar nome ON p.entity_id = nome.entity_id AND nome.attribute_id = 71 AND nome.store_id = 4 INNER JOIN
		catalog_product_entity_varchar image ON p.entity_id = image.entity_id AND image.attribute_id = 85 
	WHERE attribute_set_id = 12 AND website_id = 1  AND activo.value = 1') INNER JOIN 
PRODUTO ON P_REF_UNIV = CAST(entity_id as nvarchar) LEFT JOIN
PRODUTO_ATTACH ON AT_P_ID = P_ID
WHERE AT_ID IS NULL


-- INSERIR NAS OPCOES
DECLARE @ent_id INTEGER,
	@tipo varchar(255),
	@scs integer,
	@pid integer


DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR
SELECT psd.tipo, psd.scs, p_id FROM
	OPENQUERY(MY_SQL, 'SELECT p.entity_id, t.value as tipo, s.value as scs
FROM nelopt_magento.catalog_product_entity p INNER JOIN 
	nelopt_magento.catalog_product_entity_varchar t ON t.entity_id = p.entity_id AND t.attribute_id = 188 INNER JOIN 
	nelopt_magento.catalog_product_entity_int s ON s.entity_id = p.entity_id AND s.attribute_id = 189') psd INNER JOIN
	produto ON p_ref_univ = cast(entity_id as nvarchar) 

OPEN cur;

FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @tipo, @scs, @pid;
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO PRODUTO_COMPONENTE (COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, COMP_TPCOMP_ID, COMP_FP_ID, COMP_ATRIB_ID, COMP_L_ID, COMP_VALOR_EXTRA)
	SELECT @pid as comp_p_p_id, 1 as comp_quantidade, 3 as COMP_TPCOMP_ID, 18 as comp_fp_id, 75 as comp_atrib_id, lista as comp_l_id, 1 as comp_valor_extra 
	FROM STRING_SPLIT(@tipo, ',') t LEFT JOIN
		PRODUTO_COMPONENTE pc ON COMP_P_P_ID = @pid  INNER JOIN
	OPENQUERY(MY_SQL, 'SELECT option_id, value as lista FROM nelopt_magento.eav_attribute_option_value WHERE store_id = 4') att ON att.option_id = value 
	WHERE COMP_ID IS NULL ;
	
	FETCH NEXT FROM cur INTO @tipo, @scs, @pid;
END;

CLOSE cur;
DEALLOCATE cur;

END
```

#### `dbo.Rental_Provas_AddReceiveBoat`(@of_id int, @bookingId int, @userId int, @data smalldatetime, @tipo int, @ofr_booking_name nvarchar(max), @ofr_booking_nteam nvarchar(max), @ofr_booking_valor float)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2021-12-21 10:21 · modificado 2022-04-14 13:49* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Rental_Provas_AddReceiveBoat]
	@of_id int,
	@bookingId int,
	@userId int,
	@data smalldatetime,
	@tipo int,
	@ofr_booking_name nvarchar(max) = '',
	@ofr_booking_nteam nvarchar(max) = '',
	@ofr_booking_valor float = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
				
    if (@tipo = 0) -- atribuir ao booking
	begin
		declare @tr_id int = null
		select @tr_id = transport from openquery([RENTAL],'select e.id as eventId, b.id as bookingId, e.transport from events as e inner join events_booking as b on e.id = b.event_id') where bookingId = @bookingId

		exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @of_id, @tr_id

		insert into of_rental_provas ([ofr_of_id], [ofr_booking_id], [ofr_data_entrega], [ofr_data_recebido], [ofr_e_id_entrega], [ofr_e_id_recebido], [ofr_booking_name], [ofr_booking_nteam], [ofr_booking_valor], [ofr_e_id_atribui])
		values (@of_id, @bookingId, null, null, null, null, @ofr_booking_name, @ofr_booking_nteam, @ofr_booking_valor, @userId)
	end
	else if (@tipo = 1) -- entregar barco
	begin
		update of_rental_provas set ofr_data_entrega = @data, ofr_e_id_entrega = @userId where ofr_of_id = @of_id and ofr_booking_id = @bookingId
		--insert into of_rental_provas ([ofr_of_id], [ofr_booking_id], [ofr_data_entrega], [ofr_data_recebido], [ofr_e_id_entrega], [ofr_e_id_recebido], [ofr_booking_name], [ofr_booking_nteam], [ofr_booking_valor])
		--values (@of_id, @bookingId, @data, null, @userId, null, @ofr_booking_name, @ofr_booking_nteam, @ofr_booking_valor)
	end
	else if (@tipo = 2) -- recebimento barco
	begin
		update of_rental_provas set ofr_data_recebido = @data, ofr_e_id_recebido = @userId where ofr_of_id = @of_id and ofr_booking_id = @bookingId
	end
	else if (@tipo = 3) -- remover barco
	begin
		delete from of_rental_provas where ofr_of_id = @of_id and ofr_booking_id = @bookingId

		exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @of_id, null
	end

	select of_id, p_nome + '<br />(' + e_nome + ')' p_nome, of_referencia from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id where of_id = @of_id
END
```

#### `dbo.Rental_Provas_Transporte`(@tr_id int, @provaId int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-03-18 13:49 · modificado 2022-03-18 13:57* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE Rental_Provas_Transporte
	@tr_id int,
	@provaId int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @tb table(eventId int, bookingId int, tr_id_ant int)

	insert into @tb (eventId, bookingId, tr_id_ant)
	select eventId, bookingId, transport from openquery([RENTAL],'select e.id as eventId, b.id as bookingId, e.transport from events as e inner join events_booking as b on e.id = b.event_id')

	declare @tr_id_ant int
	select @tr_id_ant = tr_id_ant from @tb where eventId = @provaId

	if (@tr_id_ant <> @tr_id or (@tr_id_ant is null and @tr_id is not null))
	begin
		if (@tr_id_ant is not null)
		begin
			delete TRANSP_OF from TRANSP_OF inner join OF_RENTAL_PROVAS on TROF_OF_ID = OFR_OF_ID inner join @tb on OFR_BOOKING_ID = bookingId where eventId = @provaId and TROF_TR_ID = @tr_id_ant
		end

		insert into TRANSP_OF (TROF_OF_ID, TROF_TR_ID)
		select 
			oo.OFR_OF_ID,
			@tr_id
		from 
			OF_RENTAL_PROVAS oo 
			inner join @tb x on oo.OFR_BOOKING_ID = x.bookingId
		where
			x.eventId = @provaId
			and oo.OFR_OF_ID not in (select trof_of_id from TRANSP_OF where TROF_TR_ID = @tr_id)

		update o
			set o.of_tr_id = tr_id
		from
			ORDEMFABRICO o
			inner join OF_RENTAL_PROVAS oo on o.OF_ID = oo.OFR_OF_ID
			inner join @tb x on oo.OFR_BOOKING_ID = x.bookingId
			cross apply (select top 1 tr_id from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = o.OF_ID and TROF_ENVIADO = 0 order by TR_DATA) t
	end
	else if (@tr_id_ant is not null and @tr_id is null)
	begin
		delete TRANSP_OF from TRANSP_OF inner join OF_RENTAL_PROVAS on TROF_OF_ID = OFR_OF_ID inner join @tb on OFR_BOOKING_ID = bookingId where eventId = @provaId and TROF_TR_ID = @tr_id_ant
				
		update o
			set o.of_tr_id = tr_id
		from
			ORDEMFABRICO o
			inner join OF_RENTAL_PROVAS oo on o.OF_ID = oo.OFR_OF_ID
			inner join @tb x on oo.OFR_BOOKING_ID = x.bookingId
			outer apply (select top 1 tr_id from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = o.OF_ID and TROF_ENVIADO = 0 order by TR_DATA) t
	end
END
```

```sql
	if @pintura = 1 and @pinturaId is null

	else if @pintura = 1 and @pinturaId is not null

	else if @pintura = 0 and @pinturaId is not null

	if @verniz = 1 and @vernizId is null
		insert into REP_OF_FP (ROFFP_REP_ID, ROFFP_OF_ID, ROFFP_FP_ID, ROFFP_SEQUENCIA) values (@repId, @ordemFab, 73, 2)
	else if @verniz = 1 and @vernizId is not null

	else if @verniz = 0 and @vernizId is not null

	if @cura = 1 and @curaId is null

	else if @cura = 1 and @curaId is not null

	if @lixagem = 1 and @lixagemId is null

	else if @lixagem = 1 and @lixagemId is not null
		update REP_OF_FP set ROFFP_OF_ID = @ordemFab where ROFFP_ID = @lixagemId
	else if @lixagem = 0 and @lixagemId is not null
		delete from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_ID = @lixagemId
	
	if @polimento = 1 and @polimentoId is null
		insert into REP_OF_FP (ROFFP_REP_ID, ROFFP_OF_ID, ROFFP_FP_ID, ROFFP_SEQUENCIA) values (@repId, @ordemFab, 42, 5)
	else if @polimento = 1 and @polimentoId is not null
		update REP_OF_FP set ROFFP_OF_ID = @ordemFab where ROFFP_ID = @polimentoId
	else if @polimento = 0 and @polimentoId is not null

	if @montagem = 1 and @montagemId is null
```

#### `dbo.ReparacoesProvas_Upd_Fase`(@roffp_id int, @roffp_e_id int, @aberto int, @roffp_observacoes nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2023-04-18 14:50 · modificado 2023-04-21 09:33* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `reparac`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ReparacoesProvas_Upd_Fase]
	@roffp_id int,
	@roffp_e_id int,
	@aberto int,
	@roffp_observacoes nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    update
		rep_of_fp
	set 
		roffp_data_i = case when @aberto = 0 then getdate() else roffp_data_i end,
		roffp_data_f = case when @aberto = 1 then getdate() else null end,
		roffp_e_id = @roffp_e_id,
		roffp_observacoes = @roffp_observacoes
	where
		roffp_id = @roffp_id


	declare @roffp_rep_id int, @roffp_of_id  nvarchar(max), @email nvarchar(max)
	select @roffp_rep_id = roffp_rep_id, @roffp_of_id = 'Your boat ' + cast(roffp_of_id as  nvarchar(max)) + ' is ready!', @email = rep_contacto from rep_of_fp inner join reparacoes_provas on roffp_rep_id = rep_id where roffp_id = @roffp_id

	if not exists(select roffp_id from rep_of_fp where roffp_rep_id = @roffp_rep_id and roffp_data_f is null) and len(@email) > 5
		EXEC SendMail 'nelo@nelo.eu', @email, null, null, @roffp_of_id, 'Hi, you can collect your boat at our repair service.', 0, null, null, null
END
```

#### `dbo.Reparados_Lista`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reparados_Lista]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		distinct(of_id) as OrdFab, 
		p.p_nome as Modelo, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as Deck, p2.p_nome as Casco,
		e_nome as Cliente,
		of_referencia as Referencia,
		fp_nome as Estado,
		of_transporte as Transporte,
		of_datatransporte as DataTr
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join
		produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
		produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
		entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join 
		fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id inner join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
	where 
		offp_fp_id = 14
		
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Acab_vs_Lam`(@tipo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_Acab_vs_Lam]

@tipo int

as

if (@tipo = -1)
	select (case when month(offp_datafim) > 9 then year(offp_datafim)+1 else year(offp_datafim) end) as Ano, 
		month(offp_datafim) as Mes, datepart(ww, offp_datafim) as Semana, fp_nome as Fase, count(offp_of_id) as Num, 
		(case when datepart(ww, offp_datafim) >= 40 then 1 else 2 end) as sequencia
	from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
	where offp_datafim >= convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(max),year(getdate())-2) + '-09-30') and fp_id in (1,8)
	group by year(offp_datafim), month(offp_datafim), datepart(ww, offp_datafim), fp_nome
	order by Ano, Mes, Fase
else
	select (case when month(offp_datafim) > 9 then year(offp_datafim)+1 else year(offp_datafim) end) as Ano, 
		month(offp_datafim) as Mes, datepart(ww, offp_datafim) as Semana, fp_nome as Fase, count(offp_of_id) as Num, 
		(case when datepart(ww, offp_datafim) >= 40 then 1 else 2 end) as sequencia
	from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
	where offp_datafim >= convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(max),year(getdate())-2) + '-09-30') and fp_id in (1,8) and p_tp_id = @tipo
	group by year(offp_datafim), month(offp_datafim), datepart(ww, offp_datafim), fp_nome
	order by Ano, Mes, Fase
```

#### `dbo.Report_Acabador`(@emp int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Acabador]

@emp int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @tipo int
	set @tipo = (select e_ent_id from entidade where e_id = @emp)

	if @tipo = 7
    select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		dbo.of_cores(o.of_id, 0) as cdeck,
		'' as ccasco,
		e.e_nome,
		o.of_observacoes,
		e1.e_nome as emp,
		o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		--produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
		--produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join 
		fases_producao on o.of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		o.of_fp_id = 33 and (o.of_sequencia <> 99 or o.of_sequencia is null) and e1.e_id = @emp
	order by 
		o.of_fp_id, o.of_id
	else if @tipo = 34
	select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		dbo.of_cores(o.of_id, 0) as cdeck,
		'' as ccasco,
		e.e_nome,
		o.of_observacoes,
		e1.e_nome as emp,
		o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		--produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
		--produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 5 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join 
		fases_producao on o.of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		o.of_fp_id in (7,5) and (o.of_sequencia <> 99 or o.of_sequencia is null) and e1.e_id = @emp and offp_datafim is null
	order by 
		o.of_fp_id, o.of_id
	else if @tipo = 35
	select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		dbo.of_cores(o.of_id, 0) as cdeck,
		'' as ccasco,
		e.e_nome,
		o.of_observacoes,
		e1.e_nome as emp,
		o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		--produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
		--produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 22 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join 
		fases_producao on o.of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		o.of_fp_id = 22 and (o.of_sequencia <> 99 or o.of_sequencia is null) and e1.e_id = @emp and offp_datafim is null
	order by 
		o.of_fp_id, o.of_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Acertos`(@inicio smalldatetime, @fim smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Acertos]

@inicio smalldatetime,
@fim smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, sum(m.mov_quantidade) as Total, count(m.mov_id) as Movs,
		(select max(mov_data) from movimento as m2 where m2.mov_tpmov_id = 2 and m2.mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data < @inicio and 
	(m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acerto%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acert%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acerrto%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acero%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Aerto%')) as dt_ant,
		(select sum(mov_quantidade) from movimento as m1 where m1.mov_p_id = p_id and m1.mov_tpmov_id = 2 and m1.mov_data between 
	(select max(mov_data) from movimento as m2 where m2.mov_tpmov_id = 2 and m2.mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data < @inicio and 
	(m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acerto%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acert%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acerrto%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Acero%' or m2.mov_observacoes like 'Aerto%'))
	and @fim and 
		m1.mov_observacoes not like 'Acerto%' and m1.mov_observacoes not like 'Acert%' and m1.mov_observacoes not like 'Acerrto%' and m1.mov_observacoes not like 'Acero%' and m1.mov_observacoes not like 'Aerto%' and m1.mov_observacoes not like 'Correcção%') as entre,
	(case when datepart(dw,mov_data) in (2,3) then 'Semanal' else 'Mensal' end) as periodicidade
	from 
		movimento as m inner join produto on m.mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
	where
		(m.mov_observacoes like 'Acerto%' or m.mov_observacoes like 'Acert%' or m.mov_observacoes like 'Acerrto%' or m.mov_observacoes like 'Acero%' or m.mov_observacoes like 'Aerto%')
		and m.mov_tpmov_id = 2 and m.mov_data between @inicio and @fim
	group by 
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, (case when datepart(dw,mov_data) in (2,3) then 'Semanal' else 'Mensal' end)
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Assiduidade`(@e_id int, @inicio date, @fim date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Assiduidade]

@e_id int,
@inicio date,
@fim date


AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		movent_id, 
		movent_met_id, 
		met_nome, 
		met_met_id, 
		movent_e_id, 
		e_nome, 
		movent_data_I, 
		movent_data_F, 
		(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horas, 
		movent_observacoes
	from 
		dbo.ent_mov 
		inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_id = e_id 
		inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id
	where
		movent_met_id <> 11 and
		movent_e_id = @e_id and 
		cast(movent_data_I as date) between @inicio and @fim
	union
	select 
		1 as movent_id,
		999 as movent_met_id,
		'Picagem' as met_nome,
		null as met_met_id,
		@e_id as movent_e_id,
		'' as e_nome,
		picos as movent_data_I,
		dateadd(n,1,picos) as movent_data_f,
		0 as horas, 
		'' as movent_observacoes
	from [dbo].[funcionario_PicagensEntreDatas](@inicio, @fim,@e_id)
	order by 
		movent_data_I, met_met_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Assiduidade_Sub`(@e_id int, @inicio date, @fim date, @movent_met_id nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Assiduidade_Sub]

@e_id int,
@inicio date,
@fim date,
@movent_met_id nvarchar(max)


AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	select 
		movent_id, movent_met_id, met_nome, met_met_id, movent_e_id, e_nome, movent_data_I, movent_data_F, 
		(case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end) as horas, 
		movent_observacoes
	from 
		dbo.ent_mov inner join dbo.entidade on movent_e_id = e_id inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id
	where
		movent_met_id in (select Number from dbo.fn_SplitInt(@movent_met_id,',')) and
		movent_e_id = @e_id and 
		cast(movent_data_I as date) between @inicio and @fim
	order by 
		movent_data_I, met_met_id

END
```

#### `dbo.report_CheckList`(@dt_I date, @dt_F date, @fase nvarchar(max), @emp nvarchar(max), @tipo nvarchar(max), @modelo bit, @filtrarModelos bit, @pl_fp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[report_CheckList]
 
	@dt_I date, 
	@dt_F date,
	@fase nvarchar(max) = '',
	@emp nvarchar(max) = '',
	@tipo nvarchar(max) = '',
	@modelo bit = 0,
	@filtrarModelos bit = 0,
	@pl_fp_id int = 8

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @fase = '' and @emp = '' and @tipo = ''
	begin
		if @filtrarModelos = 0
			select 
				coalesce(nok.ofch_of_id,ok.ofch_of_id) as ofch_of_id,
				coalesce(nok.fp_nome,ok.fp_nome) as fp_nome,
				(case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_nome,ok.e_nome) else substring(p_nome,0,charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + ' ' + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0,charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) end) as e_nome,
				(case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_id,ok.e_id) else p_id end) as e_id,
				(case when nok.ofch_of_id is null then 'Ok' else 'Não Ok' end), avg(of_coeficiente) as coef
			from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id left join
				(select distinct ofch_of_id, fp_nome, e_nome, e_id, (case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado in (2,3,4,5) then 'Não Ok' else 'Não revisto' end) as i
				from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
				where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado = 1 and ofch_fp_id_chk = @pl_fp_id) as Ok on of_id = ok.ofch_of_id and fp.fp_nome = ok.fp_nome left join
				(select distinct ofch_of_id, fp_nome, e_nome, e_id, (case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado in (2,3,4,5) then 'Não Ok' else 'Não revisto' end) as i
				from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
				where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado in (2,3,4,5) and ofch_fp_id_chk = @pl_fp_id) as nOk on of_id = nok.ofch_of_id and fp.fp_nome = nok.fp_nome inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado in (1,2,3,4,5) and ofch_fp_id_chk = @pl_fp_id
			group by coalesce(nok.ofch_of_id,ok.ofch_of_id), coalesce(nok.fp_nome,ok.fp_nome), (case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_nome,ok.e_nome) else substring(p_nome,0,charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + ' ' + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0,charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) end),
				(case when nok.ofch_of_id is null then 'Ok' else 'Não Ok' end), (case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_id,ok.e_id) else p_id end)
			order by ofch_of_id, fp_nome
		else
			select 
				coalesce(nok.ofch_of_id,ok.ofch_of_id) as ofch_of_id,
				coalesce(nok.fp_nome,ok.fp_nome) as fp_nome,
				(case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_nome,ok.e_nome) else substring(p_nome,0,charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + ' ' + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0,charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) end) as e_nome,
				(case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_id,ok.e_id) else p_id end) as e_id,
				(case when nok.ofch_of_id is null then 'Ok' else 'Não Ok' end), avg(of_coeficiente) as coef
			from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id left join
				(select distinct ofch_of_id, fp_nome, e_nome, e_id, (case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado in (2,3,4,5) then 'Não Ok' else 'Não revisto' end) as i
				from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
				where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado =1 and ofch_fp_id_chk = @pl_fp_id) as Ok on of_id = ok.ofch_of_id and fp.fp_nome = ok.fp_nome left join
				(select distinct ofch_of_id, fp_nome, e_nome, e_id, (case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado in (2,3,4,5) then 'Não Ok' else 'Não revisto' end) as i
				from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
				where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado  in (2,3,4,5) and ofch_fp_id_chk = @pl_fp_id) as nOk on of_id = nok.ofch_of_id and fp.fp_nome = nok.fp_nome inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado in (1,2,3,4,5) and (p_nome like 'k% Cinco %' or p_nome like 'C% 6.%' or p_nome like 'Ocean Ski 5%') and ofch_fp_id_chk = @pl_fp_id
			group by coalesce(nok.ofch_of_id,ok.ofch_of_id), coalesce(nok.fp_nome,ok.fp_nome), (case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_nome,ok.e_nome) else substring(p_nome,0,charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + ' ' + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0,charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) end),
				(case when nok.ofch_of_id is null then 'Ok' else 'Não Ok' end), (case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_id,ok.e_id) else p_id end)
			order by ofch_of_id, fp_nome
	end
	else if @fase <> '' and @emp = '' and @tipo = ''
	begin
		if @filtrarModelos = 0
			select 
				coalesce(nok.ofch_of_id,ok.ofch_of_id) as ofch_of_id,

				(case when @modelo = 0 then coalesce(nok.e_id,ok.e_id) else p_id end) as e_id,
```

#### `dbo.report_CheckList_Detalhe`(@dt_I date, @dt_F date, @fase nvarchar(max), @emp nvarchar(max), @tipo nvarchar(max), @filtrarModelos bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[report_CheckList_Detalhe]
 
	@dt_I date, 
	@dt_F date,
	@fase nvarchar(max) = '',
	@emp nvarchar(max) = '',
	@tipo nvarchar(max) = '',
	@filtrarModelos bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if len(@emp) > 1
	begin
		if @filtrarModelos = 0
			select distinct ofch_of_id as ofch_of_id, p_nome, fp_nome, e_nome, ofch_descr, 
				--(case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado = 2 then 'Corrigido' when ofch_estado = 3 then 'Mau' when ofch_estado = 4 then 'Ultrapassado' when ofch_estado = 5 then 'Reparado' else 'Não revisto' end)
				(case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado in (2,3,4,5) then 'Não Ok' else 'Não revisto' end) as tipo
			from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado in (1,2,3,4,5) and (case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' else 'Não Ok' end) = @tipo and fp_nome = @fase and e_nome = @emp
			order by ofch_of_id, fp_nome
		else
			select distinct ofch_of_id as ofch_of_id, p_nome, fp_nome, e_nome, ofch_descr, 
				--(case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado = 2 then 'Corrigido' when ofch_estado = 3 then 'Mau' when ofch_estado = 4 then 'Ultrapassado' when ofch_estado = 5 then 'Reparado' else 'Não revisto' end)
				(case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' when ofch_estado in (2,3,4,5) then 'Não Ok' else 'Não revisto' end) as tipo
			from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			where cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F and ofch_estado in (1,2,3,4,5) and (case when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' else 'Não Ok' end) = @tipo and fp_nome = @fase and e_nome = @emp
				and (p_nome like 'k% Cinco %' or p_nome like 'C% 6.%' or p_nome like 'Ocean Ski 5%')
			order by ofch_of_id, fp_nome
	end
	else -- if len(@emp) > 1
	begin
		if @filtrarModelos = 0
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[report_CheckList_Detalhe_Evol]

	@tipo nvarchar(max) = ''

			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join
			(select e_nome as nome, datepart(week,of_datafim) as s, year(of_datafim) as a, count(ofch_of_id) as tot
				from OF_CHECKLIST inner join ordemfabrico on ofch_of_id = of_id inner join fp_fp on ofch_fp_id = fpfp_fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and fpfp_fp_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
```

#### `dbo.Report_ChecklistMatriz_Detalhe`(@dt_I date, @dt_F date, @fp_id int, @ofch_descr nvarchar(max), @ofch_estado nvarchar(max), @fase int, @ofch_gravidade int, @familias nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `disciplina`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ChecklistMatriz_Detalhe]

	@dt_I date, 
	@dt_F date,
	@fp_id int = null,
	@ofch_descr nvarchar(max) = null,
	@ofch_estado nvarchar(max) = null,
	@fase int = 8,
	@ofch_gravidade int = null,
	@familias nvarchar(max) = '149'

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if @ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5)
	select e.e_nome as cliente, of_id, p_nome, of_datafim, fp_nome, e1.e_nome as resp, offp_observacoes, offp_problemas
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join of_checklist on of_id = ofch_of_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		left join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and  offp_fp_id = ofch_fp_id and offp_return = 0
		--inner join fp_fp on offp_fp_id = fpfp_fp_fp_id 
		left join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = (case when @fp_id = 51 then 0 else 1 end)
		left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
	where 
		cast((case when @fase = 8 then of_datafim else ofch_data_actualizacao end) as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F 
		and ofch_fp_id = @fp_id 
		and ofch_descr = @ofch_descr 
		and ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5) 	
		and ofch_gravidade = @ofch_gravidade
		and ofch_fp_id_chk = @fase
		and p_tp_id_disciplina in (select Number from dbo.fn_SplitInt(@familias,','))
else
	select e.e_nome as cliente, of_id, p_nome, of_datafim, fp_nome, e1.e_nome as resp, offp_observacoes, offp_problemas
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join of_checklist on of_id = ofch_of_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id 
		left join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and  offp_fp_id = ofch_fp_id and offp_return = 0
		--inner join fp_fp on offp_fp_id = fpfp_fp_fp_id 
		left join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = (case when @fp_id = 51 then 0 else 1 end)
		left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
	where 
		cast((case when @fase = 8 then of_datafim else ofch_data_actualizacao end) as date) between @dt_I and @dt_F 
		and ofch_fp_id = @fp_id 
		and ofch_descr = @ofch_descr 
		and ofch_estado = @ofch_estado
		and ofch_gravidade = @ofch_gravidade
		and ofch_fp_id_chk = @fase
		and p_tp_id_disciplina in (select Number from dbo.fn_SplitInt(@familias,','))

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_CoeficienteAcabamentos`(@inicio int, @fim int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_CoeficienteAcabamentos]

@inicio int,
@fim int

as 

begin transaction

select 
	count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, e_nome, datepart(mm, offp_datafim) as Mes, 
	datepart(yy, offp_datafim) as Ano 
from 
	ordemfabrico inner join 
	produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
	of_fp on offp_of_id = of_id inner join 
	fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id inner join 
	offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id inner join 
	entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
	inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id=tp_id
where 
	of_fp_id not in (11,18,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8) and 
	offp_fp_id = 8 and 
	datepart(yy, offp_datafim) between @inicio and @fim and offpeq_chefe = 1
group by 
	datepart(mm, offp_datafim), datepart(yy, offp_datafim), e_nome
order by 
	Ano, Mes

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_Colador`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Colador]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		p1.p_nome as cdeck,
		p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		e.e_nome,
		o.of_observacoes,
		e1.e_nome as emp,
		o1.of_nome
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
		produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 4 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join
		turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
	where
		o.of_fp_id in (2,3,4) and (o.of_sequencia <> 99 or o.of_sequencia is null)
	order by 
		o.of_fp_id, o.of_id
		
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Consumos`(@tipo int, @ano int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Consumos]

@tipo int,
@ano int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@tipo = 1)
		select 
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, p_precocusto, sum(mov_quantidade) * p_precocusto as Total 
		from 
			movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		where 
			mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = @ano and tp_id not in (81,84,90) 
		group by 
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, p_precocusto 
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome
	else if (@tipo = 2)
	begin
		declare @data_I datetime, @data_F datetime

		set @data_I = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(4), @ano - 1) + '/10/01')
		set @data_F = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(4), @ano) + '/09/30')

		select 
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, p_precocusto, sum(mov_quantidade) * p_precocusto as Total 
		from 
			movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		where 
			mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data between @data_I and @data_F and tp_id not in (81,84,90) 
		group by 
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, p_precocusto 
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Consumos3meses`(@tipo int, @top int, @orderby int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Consumos3meses]

@tipo int,
@top int,
@orderby int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@tipo = 1)
	if (@orderby = 3)
		select
			top (@top) p_id, p_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as piv, 
				sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as Total1,
			coalesce((select sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) from movimento where mov_p_id = p_id and
				mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(dateadd(mm,-2,getdate())) and month(mov_data) = month(dateadd(mm,-2,getdate()))),0) as Total2,
			coalesce((select sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) from movimento where mov_p_id = p_id and
				mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate())) and month(mov_data) = month(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate()))),0) as Total3,
```

#### `dbo.Report_Consumos500`(@dI smalldatetime, @dF smalldatetime, @acimaDe float, @pcont_id int, @tpmov_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-06 15:41* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Consumos500]
	
	@dI smalldatetime, 
	@dF smalldatetime,
	@acimaDe float,
	@pcont_id int = null,
	@tpmov_id int = 2

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @precos table(rowN int, id int, valor float, ano int)

	insert into @precos (rowN,id,valor, ano) (select row_number() over(partition by mov_p_id order by mov_data desc), mov_p_id, mov_precounitario,1
												from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
												where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and p_activo = 1 /*and p_fabricointerno = 0*/ and mov_data <= @dF and ((p_fabricointerno = 0 and mov_datasaida is not null) or p_fabricointerno = 1)
												union
												select row_number() over(partition by mov_p_id order by mov_data desc), mov_p_id, mov_precounitario,-1
												from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
												where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and p_activo = 1 /*and p_fabricointerno = 0*/ and mov_data <= dateadd(year,-1,@dF)  and ((p_fabricointerno = 0 and mov_datasaida is not null) or p_fabricointerno = 1))
	if @pcont_id is null
	begin
		

		select 
			pcont_nome, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_fabricointerno, c.qtd as Qtd2011, round(pr.valor,2) as Preco2011, c.tot as Tot2011, round(c.tot/(datediff(mm,@dI, @dF)+1),2) as Media2011, ac_mais.qtd as QtsAcertosPos2011, ac_mais.tot as ValorAcertosPos2011, ac_menos.qtd as QtsAcertosNeg2011, ac_menos.tot as ValorAcertosNeg2011,
			a.qtd as Qtd2010, round(pr1.valor,2) as Preco2010, a.tot as Tot2010, round(a.tot/(datediff(mm,@dI, @dF)+1),2) as Media2010, ac_mais1.qtd as QtsAcertosPos2010, ac_mais1.tot as ValorAcertosPos2010, ac_menos1.qtd as QtsAcertosNeg2010, ac_menos1.tot as ValorAcertosNeg2010, obs.observacoes
		from 
			produto_tipo inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id inner join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario /*dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)*/) as tot from movimento where mov_data between @dI and @dF and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_observacoes not like 'Movimento do Armazem%' group by mov_p_id) as c on p_id = c.mov_p_id inner join 
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario /*dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)*/) as tot from movimento where mov_data between dateadd(yy,-1,@dI) and dateadd(yy,-1,@dF) and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_observacoes not like 'Movimento do Armazem%' group by mov_p_id) as a on p_id = a.mov_p_id left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario /*dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)*/) as tot from movimento where mov_data between @dI and @dF and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade >= 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_mais on p_id = ac_mais.mov_p_id left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario /*dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)*/) as tot from movimento where mov_data between @dI and @dF and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade < 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_menos on p_id = ac_menos.mov_p_id left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario /*dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)*/) as tot from movimento where mov_data between dateadd(yy,-1,@dI) and dateadd(yy,-1,@dF) and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade >= 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_mais1 on p_id = ac_mais1.mov_p_id left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario /*dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)*/) as tot from movimento where mov_data between dateadd(yy,-1,@dI) and dateadd(yy,-1,@dF) and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade < 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_menos1 on p_id = ac_menos1.mov_p_id
			left join @precos as pr on p_id = pr.id and pr.rowN = 1 and pr.ano = 1 
			left join @precos as pr1 on p_id = pr1.id and pr1.rowN = 1 and pr1.ano = -1 left join
			(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 6 group by mov_p_id) as obs_last on p_id = obs_last.id left join
			(select mov_p_id as id, mov_data as dt, cast(cast(mov_data as date) as nvarchar(max))  + ': ' + mov_observacoes as observacoes from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 6) as obs on obs_last.id = obs.id and obs_last.dt = obs.dt
		where 
			p_activo = 1 and round(c.tot/(datediff(mm,@dI, @dF)+1),2) > @acimaDe and p_fabricointerno = 0 and tp_tp_id <> 85 and c.qtd > 0 and a.qtd > 0 and p_tem_stock = 1
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome
	end

	--declare @precos table(rowN int, id int, valor float, ano int)
	else
	begin
		select 
			pcont_nome, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_fabricointerno, c.qtd as Qtd2011, round(coalesce(pr.valor,p_precocusto,0),2) as Preco2011, c.tot as Tot2011, round(c.tot/(datediff(mm,@dI, @dF)+1),2) as Media2011, isnull(ac_mais.qtd,0) as QtsAcertosPos2011, isnull(ac_mais.tot,0) as ValorAcertosPos2011, isnull(ac_menos.qtd,0) as QtsAcertosNeg2011, isnull(ac_menos.tot,0) as ValorAcertosNeg2011,
			a.qtd as Qtd2010, round(pr1.valor,2) as Preco2010, a.tot as Tot2010, round(a.tot/(datediff(mm,@dI, @dF)+1),2) as Media2010, isnull(ac_mais1.qtd,0) as QtsAcertosPos2010, isnull(ac_mais1.tot,0) as ValorAcertosPos2010, isnull(ac_menos1.qtd,0) as QtsAcertosNeg2010, isnull(ac_menos1.tot,0) as ValorAcertosNeg2010, obs.observacoes
		from 
			produto_tipo inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id 
			left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot from movimento 
				where mov_data between @dI and @dF and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_observacoes not like 'Movimento do Armazem%' group by mov_p_id) as c on p_id = c.mov_p_id
			left join 
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot from movimento 
				where mov_data between dateadd(yy,-1,@dI) and dateadd(yy,-1,@dF) and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_observacoes not like 'Movimento do Armazem%' group by mov_p_id) as a on p_id = a.mov_p_id 
			left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot from movimento 
				where mov_data between @dI and @dF and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade >= 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_mais on p_id = ac_mais.mov_p_id 
			left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot from movimento 
				where mov_data between @dI and @dF and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade < 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_menos on p_id = ac_menos.mov_p_id 
			left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot from movimento 
				where mov_data between dateadd(yy,-1,@dI) and dateadd(yy,-1,@dF) and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade >= 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_mais1 on p_id = ac_mais1.mov_p_id 
			left join
			(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot from movimento 
				where mov_data between dateadd(yy,-1,@dI) and dateadd(yy,-1,@dF) and mov_tpmov_id = @tpmov_id and mov_quantidade < 0 and (mov_acerto = 1 or mov_observacoes like '%acert%') group by mov_p_id) as ac_menos1 on p_id = ac_menos1.mov_p_id
			left join @precos as pr on p_id = pr.id and pr.rowN = 1 and pr.ano = 1 
			left join @precos as pr1 on p_id = pr1.id and pr1.rowN = 1 and pr1.ano = -1 left join
			(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 6 group by mov_p_id) as obs_last on p_id = obs_last.id left join
			(select mov_p_id as id, mov_data as dt, cast(cast(mov_data as date) as nvarchar(max)) + ': ' + mov_observacoes as observacoes from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 6) as obs on obs_last.id = obs.id and obs_last.dt = obs.dt
		where 
			p_activo = 1 and round(c.tot/(datediff(mm,@dI, @dF)+1),2) > @acimaDe and p_pcont_id = @pcont_id /*and tp_tp_id <> 85 and c.qtd > 0 and a.qtd > 0 and p_tem_stock = 1*/
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ConsumosCont`(@tipo int, @ano int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ConsumosCont]

@tipo int,
@ano int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@tipo = 1)
		select 
			pcont_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * p_precocusto) as Total 
		from 
			movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		where 
			mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = @ano and p_tp_id not in (81,84,90) 
		group by 
			pcont_nome 
		order by 
			pcont_nome
	else if (@tipo = 2)
	begin
		declare @data_I datetime, @data_F datetime

		set @data_I = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(4), @ano - 1) + '/10/01')
		set @data_F = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(4), @ano) + '/09/30')

		select 
			pcont_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * p_precocusto) as Total 
		from 
			movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		where 
			mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data between @data_I and @data_F and p_tp_id not in (81,84,90) 
		group by 
			pcont_nome
		order by 
			pcont_nome
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ConsumosTop10`(@tipo int, @ano int, @top int)
