```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ConsumosTop10]

@tipo int,
@ano int,
@top int = 10

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@tipo = 1)
		select 
			top (@top) tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, p_precocusto, sum(mov_quantidade) * p_precocusto as Total 
		from 
			movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		where 
			mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = @ano and tp_id not in (81,84,90,91) 
		group by 
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, p_precocusto 
		order by 
			Total desc
	else if (@tipo = 2)
	begin
		declare @data_I datetime, @data_F datetime

		set @data_I = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(4), @ano - 1) + '/10/01')
		set @data_F = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(4), @ano) + '/09/30')

		select 
			top (@top) tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, p_precocusto, sum(mov_quantidade) * p_precocusto as Total 
		from 
			movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		where 
			mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data between @data_I and @data_F and tp_id not in (81,84,90,91) 
		group by 
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, p_precocusto 
		order by 
			Total desc
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ContaCorrente`(@CL_ID int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_ContaCorrente]

@CL_ID int

as

begin transaction

SELECT 
	E_NOME, 
	OF_DATATRANSPORTE, 
	OF_ID, 
	P_NOME, 
	OF_REFERENCIA, 
	OF_PRECOVENDA, 
	(OF_PRECOVENDA*(1-(OF_DESCONTO /100))) AS APAGAR, 
	OF_PAGO, 
	OF_DATAPAGAMENTO,
	(select 
		sum(OF_PRECOVENDA*(1-(OF_DESCONTO /100))) 
	from 
		ordemfabrico
	where 
		OF_PAGO='false' and OF_E_ID_ENC = @CL_ID and of_fp_id in (12,13,14)) as totApagar,
	oftu_nome as Teste_Stock
FROM 
	ENTIDADE INNER JOIN ORDEMFABRICO ON E_ID=OF_E_ID_ENC left JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID 
	left join of_tipouso on of_oftu_id=oftu_id
WHERE 
	E_ID = @CL_ID and 
	of_fp_id in (12,13,14) and 
	(of_oftu_id is null or 
		of_oftu_id=1 or of_oftu_id=2)
order by 
	OF_PAGO, OF_DATATRANSPORTE desc

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_Desmoldador`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Desmoldador]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		p1.p_nome as cdeck,
		p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		e.e_nome,
		o.of_observacoes,
		e1.e_nome as emp,
		o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
		produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 4 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join
		turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join 
		fases_producao on o.of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		o.of_fp_id in (4,5) and (o.of_sequencia <> 99 or o.of_sequencia is null)
	order by 
		o.of_fp_id, o.of_id
		
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_EmEspera_Evol`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2023-09-13 11:14 · modificado 2023-09-13 11:14* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE Report_EmEspera_Evol
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @dt date = getdate();

	declare @dtts table(ano int, mes int, fpId int, fpNome nvarchar(max), seq int, barcos int);
	declare @meses int = 52, @dtInt date = dateadd(day, 6 - datepart(dw,@dt), @dt);

	while (@meses >= 0)
	begin
		set @dtInt = DATEADD(day, -7, @dtInt)

		insert into @dtts (ano, mes, fpId, fpNome, seq, barcos)
		select distinct
			year(@dtInt), datepart(WEEK,@dtInt),
			FP_ID, FP_NOME, FP_SEQUENCIA, of_id ns
		from 
			ORDEMFABRICO
			inner join OF_FP offp on OF_ID = offp.OFFP_OF_ID and (offp.OFFP_DATAINICIO is null or offp.OFFP_DATAINICIO > @dtInt)
			cross apply (select top 1 offp_id id, OFFP_DATAFIM dtFim from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID and OFFP_ORDEM = offp.OFFP_ORDEM - 1 and OFFP_DATAFIM <= @dtInt order by OFFP_ORDEM) x
			inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
		where
			FP_PRODUCAO = 1
			and fp_id not in (13,14,11,32)
			and OF_DATA < @dtInt
			and of_id < 10000000
			and of_e_id_enc <> 19747

		set @meses -= 1
	end

	select ano, mes, fpId, fpNome, seq, count(barcos) barcos from @dtts group by ano, mes, fpId, fpNome, seq

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_FornecedoresTop`(@tipo int, @ano int, @top int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_FornecedoresTop]

@tipo int,
@ano int,
@top int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if (@tipo = 1)
	select top (@top) e_id, e_nome, e_prazopagamento, e_fazentrega, e_prazoentrega, e_transportepago, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario),
	(select sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) from movimento where mov_e_id = e_id and year(mov_data) = @ano -1 and mov_data <= dateadd(yy,-1, getdate())) as Ano_Ant
	from entidade inner join movimento on e_id = mov_e_id and mov_tpmov_id = 1 where e_activo = 1 and e_ent_id = 18 and year(mov_data) = @ano 
	group by e_id, e_nome, e_prazopagamento, e_fazentrega, e_prazoentrega, e_transportepago order by sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) desc
else if (@tipo = 2)
begin
	declare @dt_I datetime, @dt_F datetime
	set @dt_I = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(max), @ano - 1) + '-10-01')
	set @dt_F = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(max), @ano) + '-09-30')
	

	select top (@top) e_id, e_nome, e_prazopagamento, e_fazentrega, e_prazoentrega, e_transportepago, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario),
	(select sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) from movimento where mov_e_id = e_id and mov_data between dateadd(yy,-1, @dt_I) and dateadd(yy,-1, @dt_F)) as Ano_Ant
	from entidade inner join movimento on e_id = mov_e_id and mov_tpmov_id = 1 where e_activo = 1 and e_ent_id = 18 and mov_data between @dt_I and @dt_F
	group by e_id, e_nome, e_prazopagamento, e_fazentrega, e_prazoentrega, e_transportepago order by sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) desc
end
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_FornecedoresTop_Consumos`(@dt_i smalldatetime, @dt_f smalldatetime, @val float, @top int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `preco`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_FornecedoresTop_Consumos] 

	@dt_i smalldatetime, @dt_f smalldatetime, @val float, @top int

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @consumos table(p_id int, qtd float, valor float)
	declare @entradas table(mov_id int)
	declare @fornecedores table(e_id int, valor float)


	/* Consumos acima de @val entre @dt_i e @dt_f */

	insert into @consumos (p_id, qtd, valor)
	(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot
	from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
	where mov_data between @dt_i and @dt_f and mov_tpmov_id = 2 and p_fabricointerno = 0
	group by mov_p_id
	having sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) > @val)


	/* Esvazia entradas */

	declare cur_Entradas cursor for
	select p_id, qtd, valor from @consumos order by valor desc

	open cur_Entradas
	declare @id int, @qtd float, @valor float, @mov_id int, @forn_id int, @qtd_ent float, @preco_ent float

	fetch next from cur_Entradas into @id, @qtd, @valor while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		while @qtd > 0
		begin
			select top 1 @mov_id = mov_id, @forn_id = mov_e_id, @qtd_ent = mov_quantidade, @preco_ent = mov_precounitario 
				from movimento 
					where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = @id and mov_data < @dt_f and mov_id not in (select mov_id from @entradas) order by mov_data desc

			if @mov_id is null
				set @qtd = 0
			else
			begin
				insert into @entradas (mov_id) values (@mov_id)

				if exists (select e_id from @fornecedores where e_id = @forn_id)
					update @fornecedores set valor = valor + ((case when @qtd < @qtd_ent then @qtd else @qtd_ent end)*@preco_ent) where e_id = @forn_id
				else
					insert into @fornecedores(e_id, valor) values (@forn_id, (case when @qtd < @qtd_ent then @qtd else @qtd_ent end)*@preco_ent)

				set @qtd = (case when @qtd > @qtd_ent then @qtd - @qtd_ent else 0 end)
			end
		end

		set @mov_id = null
		set @forn_id = null
		set @qtd_ent = 0
		set @preco_ent = 0

	fetch next from cur_Entradas into @id, @qtd, @valor
	end
	close cur_Entradas
	deallocate cur_Entradas

	declare @total float
	set @total = (select sum(valor) from @fornecedores)

	select top (@top) e.e_id, e.e_nome, e_prazopagamento, e_fazentrega, e_prazoentrega, e_transportepago, f.valor, f.valor/@total as peso from @fornecedores as f inner join entidade as e on f.e_id = e.e_id order by f.valor desc
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_FornecedoresTop_Consumos_Detalhe`(@dt_i smalldatetime, @dt_f smalldatetime, @val float, @e_id int)

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_FornecedoresTop_Consumos_Detalhe]

	@dt_i smalldatetime, @dt_f smalldatetime, @val float, @e_id int

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @consumos table(p_id int, qtd float, valor float)
	declare @entradas table(mov_id int)
	declare @fornecedores table(e_id int, p_id int, qtd float, valor float)


	/* Consumos acima de @val entre @dt_i e @dt_f */

	insert into @consumos (p_id, qtd, valor)
	(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot
	from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
	where mov_data between @dt_i and @dt_f and mov_tpmov_id = 2 and p_fabricointerno = 0 --and mov_p_id in (select pf_p_id from produto_entidade where pf_e_id = @e_id)
	group by mov_p_id
	having sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) > @val)


	/* Esvazia entradas */

	declare cur_Entradas cursor for
	select p_id, qtd, valor from @consumos order by valor desc

	open cur_Entradas
	declare @id int, @qtd float, @valor float, @mov_id int, @forn_id int, @qtd_ent float, @preco_ent float

	fetch next from cur_Entradas into @id, @qtd, @valor while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		while @qtd > 0
		begin
			select top 1 @mov_id = mov_id, @forn_id = mov_e_id, @qtd_ent = mov_quantidade, @preco_ent = mov_precounitario 
				from movimento 
					where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = @id and mov_data < @dt_f and mov_id not in (select mov_id from @entradas) order by mov_data desc

			if @mov_id is null
				set @qtd = 0
			else if @forn_id = @e_id
			begin
				insert into @entradas (mov_id) values (@mov_id)

				insert into @fornecedores(e_id, p_id, qtd, valor) values (@forn_id, @id, (case when @qtd < @qtd_ent then @qtd else @qtd_ent end), (case when @qtd < @qtd_ent then @qtd else @qtd_ent end)*@preco_ent)

				set @qtd = (case when @qtd > @qtd_ent then @qtd - @qtd_ent else 0 end)
			end
			else
			begin
				insert into @entradas (mov_id) values (@mov_id)

				set @qtd = (case when @qtd > @qtd_ent then @qtd - @qtd_ent else 0 end)
			end
		end

		set @mov_id = null
		set @forn_id = null
		set @qtd_ent = 0
		set @preco_ent = 0

	fetch next from cur_Entradas into @id, @qtd, @valor
	end
	close cur_Entradas
	deallocate cur_Entradas

	declare @total float
	set @total = (select sum(valor) from @fornecedores)

	select e.e_id, e.e_nome, p.p_nome, sum(f.qtd) as qtd, sum(f.valor ) as valor
		from @fornecedores as f inner join entidade as e on f.e_id = e.e_id inner join produto as p on f.p_id = p.p_id 
			group by e.e_id, e.e_nome, p.p_nome
				order by valor desc
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_FornecedoresTop_Detalhe`(@e_id int, @tipo int, @ano int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_FornecedoresTop_Detalhe]

@e_id int,
@tipo int,
@ano int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if (@tipo = 1)
	select p_id, p_nome, p_precocusto, count(mov_id) as compras, sum(mov_precounitario * mov_quantidade) as valor from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
	where year(mov_data) = @ano and mov_e_id = @e_id and mov_tpmov_id = 1
	group by p_id, p_nome, p_precocusto
	order by valor desc
else if (@tipo = 2)
begin
	declare @dt_I datetime, @dt_F datetime
	set @dt_I = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(max), @ano - 1) + '-10-01')
	set @dt_F = convert(datetime, convert(nvarchar(max), @ano) + '-09-30')
	
	select p_id, p_nome, p_precocusto, count(mov_id) as compras, sum(mov_precounitario * mov_quantidade) as valor from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
	where mov_data between @dt_I and @dt_F and mov_e_id = @e_id and mov_tpmov_id = 1
	group by p_id, p_nome, p_precocusto
	order by valor desc
end
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Horas_Faltas`(@ano int, @mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Horas_Faltas]

@ano int,
@mes int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select e_nome, met_nome,
	sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) * (case when movent_met_id = 4 then -1 else 1 end) as horas
	from entidade inner join ent_mov on e_id = movent_e_id inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id 
	where year(movent_data_I) = @ano and month(movent_data_I) = @mes and movent_met_id in (1,4)
	group by e_nome, movent_met_id, met_nome
	order by e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Horas_Mes`(@inicio smalldatetime, @fim smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Horas_Mes]

@inicio as smalldatetime = null,
@fim as smalldatetime = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	set @fim = dateadd(dd,1,@fim)

	select em.movent_id, em.movent_e_id, e_nome,
	round(coalesce(faltas.total,0),2) as faltas, round(horas.h,2) as Horas, 

	(case when round((((coalesce(horas.total,0) - coalesce(horas.dsc,0)) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(faltas.total,0) else 0 end)),2) < 0 and e_id not in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484,20526) then 0 else
		round((((coalesce(horas.total,0)- coalesce(horas.dsc,0)) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)) - (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then coalesce(faltas.total,0) else 0 end)),2) end) as entre_datas, 
	
	round(cc.total,2) as cc, movent_valor_pago, movent_data_pag, movent_observacoes
	from ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id inner join
	(select movent_e_id, 
		sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
				then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
				else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total,
		sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
				then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
				else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as h, (case when movent_e_id in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484,20526) then 24 * em.movent_valor_hora else 0 end) as dsc
		from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim group by movent_e_id, movent_valor_hora) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id
	left join
	(select movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
					then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
					else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total
			from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 4 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim group by movent_e_id) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id
	left join
	(select movent_e_id,
			sum((case when movent_met_id = 1 and datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 
						then ((datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1) * movent_valor_hora) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)
					when movent_met_id = 1
						then ((datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0) * movent_valor_hora) * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end)
					when movent_met_id = 4 and datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim
						then -1 * (datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1) * (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then movent_valor_hora else 0 end)
					when movent_met_id = 4 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim
						then -1 * (datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0) * (case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then movent_valor_hora else 0 end) 
					when movent_met_id = 11
						then -1 * movent_valor_pago
					else 0
					end)) as total
			from ent_mov inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where movent_met_id in (1,4,11) and movent_data_i <= @fim group by movent_e_id) as cc on horas.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id
	where em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim
	order by e_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Horas_Mes_Teste`(@inicio smalldatetime, @fim smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 12:01* · 🔎 `custo`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Horas_Mes_Teste]

@inicio as smalldatetime = null,
@fim as smalldatetime = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	set @fim = dateadd(dd,1,@fim)
	
	if @inicio >= '2018/02/01'
	begin
		select 
			e_nome, e_custohora, e_horas_a_dobrar, e_isencao_horario, cast(isnull(horas.nHoras,0) - isnull(hPHC.horasPHC,0) - isnull(horas.nDsc,0) as float) as nHoras, 
			coalesce((case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then (horas.total - horas.dsc) * 2 else horas.total - horas.dsc end),0) - isnull(hPHC.horasPHC * e_custohora * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end),0) as h, 
			coalesce((case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then faltas.total else 0 end),0) - isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC * e_custohora,0) as f, coalesce(cc.total,0) as cc_ant, movent_valor_pago, isnull(hPHC.horasPHC,0) as horasPHC, isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC,0) as fltDescPHC, movent_cc
		from 
			ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id 
			inner join (select movent_e_id, 
							sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
									then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
									else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as nHoras,
							sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
									then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
									else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total, 
									(case when e_isencao_horario = 1 then 24 * E_CUSTOHORA else 0 end) as dsc, (case when e_isencao_horario = 1 then 24 else 0 end) as nDsc
						from 
							ent_mov as em 
							inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id 
						where 
							movent_met_id = 1 
							and (cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@inicio as date) and cast(@fim as date) or cast(MOVENT_DATA_PAG as date) between cast(@inicio as date) and cast(@fim as date))
							and movent_processado = 1 
							and movent_vai_phc = 0 
						group by 
							movent_e_id, E_CUSTOHORA, e_isencao_horario) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id
			left join (select movent_e_id,
							sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
									then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
									else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total
						from 
							ent_mov as em 
						where 
							movent_met_id = 4 
							and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@inicio as date) and cast(@fim as date) 
							and movent_processado = 1 
						group by 
							movent_e_id) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id
			left join
			(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 and movent_data_f < @inicio group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
			left join
			(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
			left join (select pe.ncont, sum(hs.horas) as horasPHC, sum(case when cast(factor as float) = 1 then horas else 0 end) as fltDescPHC 
							from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs as hs on pe.no = hs.no where ntipo = 1 and data between @inicio and @fim group by pe.ncont) as hPHC on e_contribuinte = hPHC.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
		where 
			em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim) and movent_valor_pago > 0
		order by 
			e_nome
	end
	else if @inicio >= '2016/05/01'
	begin
		select e_nome, e_custohora, e_horas_a_dobrar, e_isencao_horario, 0 as nHoras,
		coalesce((case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then (horas.total - horas.dsc) * 2 else horas.total - horas.dsc end),0) - isnull(hPHC.horasPHC * e_custohora * (case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then 2 else 1 end),0) as h, 
		coalesce((case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then faltas.total else 0 end),0) - isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC * e_custohora,0) as f, coalesce(cc.total,0) as cc_ant, movent_valor_pago, isnull(hPHC.horasPHC,0) as horasPHC, isnull(hPHC.fltDescPHC,0) as fltDescPHC, movent_cc
		from ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id inner join
		(select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
					then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
					else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total, (case when movent_e_id in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484,20526) then 24 * em.movent_valor_hora else 0 end) as dsc
			from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id, em.movent_valor_hora) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id,
				sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total
				from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 4 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 and movent_data_f < @inicio group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		left join (select pe.ncont, sum(hs.horas) as horasPHC, sum(case when cast(factor as float) = 1 then horas else 0 end) as fltDescPHC 
						from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pe as pe left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.hs as hs on pe.no = hs.no where ntipo = 1 and data between @inicio and @fim group by pe.ncont) as hPHC on e_contribuinte = hPHC.ncont collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
		where em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim) and movent_valor_pago > 0
		order by e_nome
	end
	else if @inicio >= '2016/05/01'
	begin
		select e_nome, e_custohora, e_horas_a_dobrar, e_isencao_horario, 0 as nHoras,
		coalesce((case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then (horas.total - horas.dsc) * 2 else horas.total - horas.dsc end),0) as h, 
		coalesce((case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then faltas.total else 0 end),0) as f, coalesce(cc.total,0) as cc_ant, movent_valor_pago
		from ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id inner join
		(select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
					then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
					else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total, (case when movent_e_id in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484,20526) then 24 * em.movent_valor_hora else 0 end) as dsc
			from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id, em.movent_valor_hora) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id,
				sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total
				from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 4 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 and movent_data_f < @inicio group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		where em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim) and movent_valor_pago > 0
		order by e_nome
	end
	else if @inicio >= '2015/02/01'
	begin
		select e_nome, e_custohora, e_horas_a_dobrar, e_isencao_horario, 0 as nHoras,
		coalesce((case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then (horas.total - horas.dsc) * 2 else horas.total - horas.dsc end),0) as h, 
		coalesce((case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then faltas.total else 0 end),0) as f, coalesce(cc.total,0) as cc_ant, movent_valor_pago
		from ent_mov as em inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id inner join
		(select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
					then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
					else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total, (case when movent_e_id in (20363,20366,20700,20525,20362,20708,20388,20484) then 24 * em.movent_valor_hora else 0 end) as dsc
			from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id, em.movent_valor_hora) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id,
				sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total
				from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 4 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 and movent_data_f < @inicio group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
		left join
		(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		where em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim) and movent_valor_pago > 0
		order by e_nome
	end
	else
	begin
		select 
			e_nome, e_custohora, e_horas_a_dobrar, e_isencao_horario, 0 as nHoras,
			coalesce((case when e_horas_a_dobrar = 1 then horas.total * 2 else horas.total end),0) as h, 
			coalesce((case when e_falta_desc_horas = 1 then faltas.total else 0 end),0) as f, coalesce(cc.total,0) as cc_ant, movent_valor_pago
		from 
			ent_mov as em 
			inner join entidade on em.movent_e_id = e_id inner join
			(select movent_e_id, 
				sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
						then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
						else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total
				from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id) as horas on em.movent_e_id = horas.movent_e_id
			left join
			(select movent_e_id,
					sum((case when datepart(hh,em.movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,em.movent_data_F) > 13 
							then datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 
							else datediff(n, em.movent_data_I, em.movent_data_F)/60.0 end) * em.movent_valor_hora) as total
					from ent_mov as em where movent_met_id = 4 and movent_data_i between @inicio and @fim and movent_processado = 1 group by movent_e_id) as faltas on horas.movent_e_id = faltas.movent_e_id
			left join
			(select movent_e_id, max(movent_data_pag) as dt from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11 and movent_data_f < @inicio group by movent_e_id) as cc_ant on horas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id or faltas.movent_e_id = cc_ant.movent_e_id
			left join
			(select movent_e_id, movent_data_pag, round(movent_cc,2) as total from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 11) as cc on cc_ant.movent_e_id = cc.movent_e_id and cc_ant.dt = cc.movent_data_pag
		where em.movent_met_id = 11 and em.movent_data_i between @inicio and dateadd(hh,-1,@fim) and movent_valor_pago > 0
		order by e_nome
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_HorasAjudante`(@i smalldatetime, @f smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_HorasAjudante]

@i smalldatetime,
@f smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

IF @i < '2015/03/01'
BEGIN
	SELECT OFFPEQ_E_ID, e_nome,
		sum((case when pa.peso - p_pesolam > -0.250 and pa.peso - p_pesolam < 0.250 and of_desconta_peso = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as pesoBom, 
		sum((case when (-0.500 < pa.peso - p_pesolam and pa.peso - p_pesolam < -0.250 and of_desconta_peso = 0) or (0.250 < pa.peso - p_pesolam and pa.peso - p_pesolam < 0.500 and of_desconta_peso = 0) then 1 else 0 end)) as pesoNGrave, 
		sum((case when (pa.peso - p_pesolam <= -0.500 and of_desconta_peso = 0) or (pa.peso - p_pesolam >= 0.500 and of_desconta_peso = 0) then 1 else 0 end)) as pesoGrave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_muito_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_normal,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_nao_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_muito_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_muito_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_normal,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_nao_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_muito_grave,
		coalesce(Inj.tot,0) as Injustificadas, coalesce(JustPag.tot,0) as JustifPaga, coalesce(Just.tot,0) as Justif, coalesce(BaixaSS.tot,0) as BaixaSegSoc, coalesce(BaixaSeguro.tot,0) as BaixaSegur, 
		coalesce(BaixaSeguroP.tot,0) as BaixaSeguroParc, coalesce(Ferias.tot,0) as Ferias, coeficientes.coef, coalesce(coeficientes_cl.coef,0) as coef_cl
	FROM ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join OF_FP on of_id = offp_of_id left join
		of_fp laminagem ON laminagem.offp_of_id = of_fp.offp_of_id AND laminagem.offp_fp_id = 1  INNER JOIN
		offp_eq eq1 on laminagem.offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 1 INNER JOIN
		entidade ON e_id = OFFPEQ_E_ID left join 
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 4 and movent_data_i between @i and @f group by movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end)) as Inj on e_id = Inj.movent_e_id left join 
	
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 5 and movent_data_i between @i and @f group by movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end)) as JustPag on e_id = JustPag.movent_e_id left join 
	
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 6 and movent_data_i between @i and @f group by movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end)) as Just on e_id = Just.movent_e_id left join 
	
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 7 and movent_data_i between @i and @f group by movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end)) as BaixaSS on e_id = BaixaSS.movent_e_id left join 
	
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 8 and movent_data_i between @i and @f group by movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end)) as BaixaSeguro on e_id = BaixaSeguro.movent_e_id left join 
	
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 9 and movent_data_i between @i and @f group by movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end)) as BaixaSeguroP on e_id = BaixaSeguroP.movent_e_id left join 
	
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 10 and movent_data_i between @i and @f group by movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20344 when movent_e_id = 21548 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20758 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end)) as Ferias on e_id = Ferias.movent_e_id left join
	
		(select offpeq_e_id as id, sum(p_coeficiente) as coef from produto inner join ordemfabrico on p_id = of_p_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_datainicio between @i and @f group by offpeq_e_id) as coeficientes on e_id = coeficientes.id left join
		(select offpeq_e_id as id, sum(p_coeficiente) as coef from produto inner join ordemfabrico on p_id = of_p_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_datainicio between @i and @f and
		(OF_P_ID_CDECK = 20577 or OF_P_ID_CCASCO = 20577 or OF_P_ID_TOPO_FR = 20577 or OF_P_ID_TOPO_TR = 20577 or OF_P_ID_LATERAL_FR = 20577 or OF_P_ID_LATERAL_TR = 20577 or OF_P_ID_QUINAS = 20577 or OF_TRANSP = 1) group by offpeq_e_id) as coeficientes_cl on e_id = coeficientes_cl.id left join
		(select offp_of_id as id, offp_peso as peso from of_fp where offp_peso > 0 and offp_fp_id = 6) as pA on of_id = pA.id
	WHERE of_datainicio between @i and @f
		AND OF_FP.OFFP_FP_ID = 7 and OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAM_INOCENTE = 0 and OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_PINT_INOCENTE = 0
	GROUP BY OFFPEQ_E_ID, E_NOME, coalesce(Inj.tot,0), coalesce(JustPag.tot,0), coalesce(Just.tot,0), coalesce(BaixaSS.tot,0), coalesce(BaixaSeguro.tot,0), coalesce(BaixaSeguroP.tot,0), coalesce(Ferias.tot,0), coeficientes.coef, coeficientes_cl.coef
END
ELSE IF (@i >= '2015/03/01' and @i < '2015/06/01')
BEGIN
	SELECT OFFPEQ_E_ID, e_nome,
		sum((case when pa.peso - p_pesolam > -0.250 and pa.peso - p_pesolam < 0.250 and of_desconta_peso = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as pesoBom, 
		sum((case when (-0.500 < pa.peso - p_pesolam and pa.peso - p_pesolam < -0.250 and of_desconta_peso = 0) or (0.250 < pa.peso - p_pesolam and pa.peso - p_pesolam < 0.500 and of_desconta_peso = 0) then 1 else 0 end)) as pesoNGrave, 
		sum((case when (pa.peso - p_pesolam <= -0.500 and of_desconta_peso = 0) or (pa.peso - p_pesolam >= 0.500 and of_desconta_peso = 0) then 1 else 0 end)) as pesoGrave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_muito_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_normal,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_nao_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_LAMINAGEM = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as laminagem_muito_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_muito_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_bom,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_normal,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_nao_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_grave,
		SUM(CASE WHEN OF_FP.OFFP_PROBS_INTERIOR = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as interior_muito_grave,
		coalesce(Inj.tot,0) as Injustificadas, coalesce(JustPag.tot,0) as JustifPaga, coalesce(Just.tot,0) as Justif, coalesce(BaixaSS.tot,0) as BaixaSegSoc, coalesce(BaixaSeguro.tot,0) as BaixaSegur, 
		coalesce(BaixaSeguroP.tot,0) as BaixaSeguroParc, coalesce(Ferias.tot,0) as Ferias, coeficientes.coef, coalesce(coeficientes_cl.coef,0) as coef_cl
	FROM ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join OF_FP on of_id = offp_of_id left join
		of_fp laminagem ON laminagem.offp_of_id = of_fp.offp_of_id AND laminagem.offp_fp_id = 1  INNER JOIN
		offp_eq eq1 on laminagem.offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 1 INNER JOIN
		entidade ON e_id = OFFPEQ_E_ID left join 
		(select movent_met_id, (case when movent_e_id = 20345 then 20360 when movent_e_id = 21524 then 20343 when movent_e_id = 21522 then 20346 when movent_e_id = 21521 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 20917 then 20386 when movent_e_id = 20657 then 20372 when movent_e_id = 21564 then 20535 else movent_e_id end) as movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
```

#### `dbo.Report_Innux`(@tipo int, @dIn date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:46 · modificado 2020-07-31 13:39* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Innux] 
	@tipo int,
	@dIn date
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if @tipo = 1 /*Atrasos dia*/
		SELECT 
			m.[IDFuncionario], f.[Numero] as NumeroFuncionario,f.[Nome] as NomeFuncionario, f.[IDPlanoTrabalho],m.[Data], m.[Data] + m.[Hora] AS x, 
			datediff(n, (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time) end), m.[Hora]) as minutos,
			round(datediff(n, (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time) end), m.[Hora])/60.0,2) as horas,
			(case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then 'Atrasado (horas)' else 'Saiu cedo (horas)' end) as tipo, fp_nome, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas--, cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time) as iiii, cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time) as fff
		FROM 	 
			[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Terminais] as t on m.[IDTerminal] = t.[IDTerminal]
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] inner join entidade on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[PlanosTrabalhoHorarios] as pl on f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] = pl.[IDPlanoTrabalho] and pl.Dia = datepart(dw,m.[Hora]) - 1
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Horarios] as hh on pl.[IDHorario] = hh.[IDHorario]
		where 
			(
				cast(m.[Hora] as time) between dateadd(n,5,cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)) /*'08:05:00'*/ and dateadd(n,90,cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)) /*'09:30:00' */
				or cast(m.[Hora] as time) between dateadd(n,-30,cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time)) /*'16:30:00'*/ and dateadd(n,-1,cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time)) /*'16:59:59'*/
			)
			and cast(m.[Data] as date) = @dIn and f.[Numero] is not null
		order by NomeFuncionario, x
	else if @tipo = 2 /*Faltas de presença dia anterior*/		
		SELECT 
			0 as IDFuncionario, e_id as NumeroFuncionario, e_nome as NomeFuncionario, 0 as IDPlanoTrabalho, null as Data, null as x, null as minutos, null as horas, '' as tipo, fp_nome, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
		FROM 	
			entidade 
			inner join entidade_tipo on e_ent_id = ent_id 
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
		where e_activo = 1 and ent_ent_id = 19 and e_id not in (select distinct f.[Numero] from [Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] where cast(Data as date) = @dIn and f.[Numero] is not null)
			and f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] in (3,4)
		order by e_nome 
	else if @tipo = 3 /*Falta de Entradas/saidas*/		
		SELECT 
			m.[IDFuncionario], f.[Numero] as NumeroFuncionario,f.[Nome] as NomeFuncionario, count(m.[IDFuncionario]) as ent, fp_nome, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
		FROM 	 
			[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m --inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Terminais] as t on m.[IDTerminal] = t.[IDTerminal]
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] inner join entidade on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
		where 
			cast(m.[Data] as date) = dateadd(day,-1,@dIn) and f.[Numero] is not null
		group by m.[IDFuncionario], f.[Numero],f.[Nome], fp_nome, faltas
		having count(m.[IDFuncionario]) = 1
		order by NomeFuncionario 
	else if @tipo = 4 /*Faltas de presença dia anterior*/		
		SELECT 
			0 as IDFuncionario, e_id as NumeroFuncionario, e_nome as NomeFuncionario, 0 as IDPlanoTrabalho, null as Data, null as x, null as minutos, null as horas, '' as tipo, fp_nome, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
		FROM 	
			entidade inner join entidade_tipo on e_ent_id = ent_id inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
		where e_activo = 1 and ent_ent_id = 19 and e_id not in (select distinct f.[Numero] from [Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] where cast(Data as date) = dateadd(day,-1,@dIn) and f.[Numero] is not null)
			and f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] in (3,4)
		order by e_nome 
	else if @tipo = 5 /*Atrasos mensal*/		
		SELECT 
			m.[IDFuncionario], f.[Numero] as NumeroFuncionario,f.[Nome] as NomeFuncionario, f.[IDPlanoTrabalho],m.[Data], m.[Data] + m.[Hora] AS x, 
			datediff(n, (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time) end), m.[Hora]) as minutos,
			round(datediff(n, (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time) end), m.[Hora])/60.0,2) as horas,
			(case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then 'Atrasado (horas)' else 'Saiu cedo (horas)' end) as tipo, fp_nome, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
		FROM 	 
			[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m 
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Terminais] as t on m.[IDTerminal] = t.[IDTerminal]
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] 
			inner join entidade on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[PlanosTrabalhoHorarios] as pl on f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] = pl.[IDPlanoTrabalho] and pl.Dia = datepart(dw,m.[Hora]) - 1
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Horarios] as hh on pl.[IDHorario] = hh.[IDHorario]
		where
			(
				cast(m.[Hora] as time) between dateadd(n,5,cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)) /*'08:05:00'*/ and dateadd(n,90,cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)) /*'09:30:00' */
				or cast(m.[Hora] as time) between dateadd(n,-30,cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time)) /*'16:30:00'*/ and dateadd(n,-1,cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time)) /*'16:59:59'*/
			)
			and year(m.[Data]) = year(@dIn) and month(m.[Data]) = month(@dIn) and f.[Numero] is not null and datepart(dw,m.[Data]) not in (1,7)
		order by NomeFuncionario, x
	else if @tipo = 6
		SELECT 
			f.[Numero] as Id,f.[Nome] as Funcionario,
			(case when m.[Data] + (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) end) > m.[Data] + m.[Hora] then m.[Data] + m.[Hora]
				else m.[Data] + (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) end) end) as Inicio, 
			(case when m.[Data] + (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim])end) < m.[Data] + m.[Hora] then m.[Data] + m.[Hora]
				else m.[Data] + (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) end) end) AS Ponto, 
			datediff(n, (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) end), m.[Hora]) as minutos,
			round(datediff(n, (case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
						when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) > 12 then isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) end), m.[Hora])/60.0,2) as horas,
			(case when datepart(hh,m.[Hora]) < 12 then 'Atrasado (horas)' else 'Saiu cedo (horas)' end) as tipo, isnull(mvs.horas,0) as faltas, cast(0 as bit) as Marcar, fp_nome, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
		FROM 	 
			[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Terminais] as t on m.[IDTerminal] = t.[IDTerminal]
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] inner join entidade on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join (select movent_e_id, cast(movent_data_i as date) as dt, sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end))/60.0 as horas from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and year(movent_data_i) = year(@dIn) and month(movent_data_i) = month(@dIn) group by movent_e_id, cast(movent_data_i as date)) as mvs on e_id = movent_e_id and cast(mvs.dt as date) = cast(m.[Data] as date)
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[PlanosTrabalhoHorarios] as pl on f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] = pl.[IDPlanoTrabalho] and pl.Dia = datepart(dw,m.[Hora]) - 1
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Horarios] as hh on pl.[IDHorario] = hh.[IDHorario]
		where
			(
				cast(m.[Hora] as time) between dateadd(n,5,cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)) /*'08:05:00'*/ and dateadd(n,90,cast(hh.[PrimeiraParteIni] as time)) /*'09:30:00' */
				or cast(m.[Hora] as time) between dateadd(n,-30,cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time)) /*'16:30:00'*/ and dateadd(n,-1,cast(isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]) as time)) /*'16:59:59'*/
			)
			and year(m.[Data]) = year(@dIn) and month(m.[Data]) = month(@dIn) and f.[Numero] is not null and datepart(dw,m.[Data]) not in (1,7)
		order by Funcionario, Ponto
	else if @tipo = 7 /* Dia anterior Geral (atrasos, saidas cedo e faltas */
		select
			m.[IDFuncionario], f.[Numero] as NumeroFuncionario,f.[Nome] as NomeFuncionario, f.[IDPlanoTrabalho],
			m.[Data], 
			min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) as x, 
			datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) as minutos,
			cast(datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]))/60.0 as decimal(12,2)) as horas,
			(case when datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) > 5
							and datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))  > 5
								then '1) Atrasado + Saiu cedo'
					when datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) > 5 
						then '1) Atrasado'
					when datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))  > 5
						then '1) Saiu cedo' end) as tipo,
			fp_nome,
			max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) as saida, 
			datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim])) as minutos_s,
			cast(datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))/60.0 as decimal(12,2)) as horas_S, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
		FROM 	 
			[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] 
			inner join entidade on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[PlanosTrabalhoHorarios] as pl on f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] = pl.[IDPlanoTrabalho] and pl.Dia = datepart(dw,m.[Hora]) - 1
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Horarios] as hh on pl.[IDHorario] = hh.[IDHorario]
		where
			cast(m.[Data] as date) = @dIn and f.[Numero] is not null
		group by
			m.[IDFuncionario], m.[Data], f.[IDPlanoTrabalho], f.[Numero], f.[Nome], f.[IDPlanoTrabalho], fp_nome, faltas, hh.[SegundaParteFim], hh.[PrimeiraParteFim], hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
		having 
			max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) <> min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) and
			(datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) > 5
			or datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))  > 5)
		union 
		select 
			null as IDFuncionario, e_id as NumeroFuncionario, e_nome as NomeFuncionario, 0, @dIn as Data, cast(@dIn as datetime) + '00:00:00' as x, 0, 0, '2) Faltou' as tipo, fp_nome, cast(@dIn as datetime) + '00:00:00' as saida, 0, 0, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
		from entidade
			left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
				inner join entidade_tipo on e_ent_id = ent_id
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@dIn, dateadd(day,1,@dIn), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
		where e_activo = 1 and ent_ent_id = 19
			and e_id not in (select 
								distinct [Numero] 
							from 
								[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] 
							where 
								cast(m.[Data] as date) = @dIn and f.[Numero] is not null)
		order by 
			tipo, NomeFuncionario
		
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Innux_DiaAntGeral`(@dIn date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-25 13:11 · modificado 2019-06-25 13:11* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Innux_DiaAntGeral] 
	@dIn date
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @d date = dateadd(day,-1,@dIn)


    select
		m.[IDFuncionario], f.[Numero] as NumeroFuncionario,f.[Nome] as NomeFuncionario, f.[IDPlanoTrabalho],
		m.[Data], 
		min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) as x, 
		datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) as minutos,
		cast(datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]))/60.0 as decimal(12,2)) as horas,
		(case when datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) > 5
						and datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))  > 5
							then '1) Atrasado + Saiu cedo'
				when datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) > 5 
					then '1) Atrasado'
				when datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))  > 5
					then '1) Saiu cedo' end) as tipo,
		fp_nome,
		max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) as saida, 
		datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim])) as minutos_s,
		cast(datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))/60.0 as decimal(12,2)) as horas_S, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
	FROM 	 
		[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m
		inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] 
		inner join entidade on e_id = f.[Numero]
		left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@d, dateadd(day,1,@d), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
		inner join [Innux].[dbo].[PlanosTrabalhoHorarios] as pl on f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] = pl.[IDPlanoTrabalho] and pl.Dia = datepart(dw,m.[Hora]) - 1
		inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Horarios] as hh on pl.[IDHorario] = hh.[IDHorario]
	where
		cast(m.[Data] as date) = @d and f.[Numero] is not null
	group by
		m.[IDFuncionario], m.[Data], f.[IDPlanoTrabalho], f.[Numero], f.[Nome], f.[IDPlanoTrabalho], fp_nome, faltas, hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim], hh.[PrimeiraParteIni]
	having 
		max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) <> min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]) and
		(datediff(n,m.[Data] + hh.[PrimeiraParteIni], min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])) > 5
		or datediff(n, max(m.[Data] + m.[Hora]),m.[Data] + isnull(hh.[SegundaParteFim],hh.[PrimeiraParteFim]))  > 5)
	union 
	select 
		null as IDFuncionario, e_id as NumeroFuncionario, e_nome as NomeFuncionario, 0, @d as Data, null as x, 0, 0, '2) Faltou' as tipo, fp_nome, null as saida, 0, 0, isnull(faltas,0) as faltas
	from entidade
		left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
			inner join entidade_tipo on e_ent_id = ent_id
			inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on e_id = f.[Numero]
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@d, dateadd(day,1,@d), null) group by movent_eId) as flt on flt.movent_eId = e_id
	where e_activo = 1 and ent_ent_id = 19 and f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] in (3,4)
		and e_id not in (select 
							distinct [Numero] 
						from 
							[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] 
						where 
							cast(m.[Data] as date) = @d and f.[Numero] is not null)
	order by 
		tipo, NomeFuncionario
		
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Inventario_`(@data smalldatetime, @upd_preco bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-01-05 14:34* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Inventario_]
	
	@data smalldatetime,
	@upd_preco bit

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	    
	if @upd_preco = 1
	begin
		--declare @precos table (p_id int, preco float)

		declare @ofs table (tp_nome nvarchar(max), p_ nvarchar(max), p_nome nvarchar(max), ofs int, estado nvarchar(max), preco float, Horas float, e_nome nvarchar(max), of_id int, of_datainicio smalldatetime, of_datafim smalldatetime, 
			fp_nome nvarchar(max), offp_datainicio smalldatetime, offp_datafim smalldatetime, arm_nome nvarchar(max), offpcl_desc nvarchar(max), p_id int)
		
		insert into @ofs(tp_nome, p_, p_nome, ofs, estado, preco, Horas, e_nome, of_id, of_datainicio, of_datafim, fp_nome, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, arm_nome, offpcl_desc, p_id)
		select 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) as p_id, 
			p_nome, 1, case when e_nelo = 1 then 'Produtos intermédios nosso' else 'Produtos intermédios clientes' end as estado, 
			isnull(pr.preco * 1.3, 0), 
			round(coalesce(h.t,0),2) as Horas, e_nome, of_id, i.dt as of_datainicio, of_datafim, 'Produtos intermédios' as fp_nome, null as offp_datainicio, null as offp_datafim, arm_nome, c.offpcl_desc as gravidade, p_id
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join (select offp_of_id as id, min(offp_datainicio) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 group by offp_of_id) as i on of_id = i.id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select comp_p_id, sum(comp_quantidade) as t from produto_componente where comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90 and p_id <> 20796) group by comp_p_id) as h on p_id = h.comp_p_id
			inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
			inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
			inner join armazem on of_arm_id = arm_id
			left join (select offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, offpcl_desc, offpcl_sequencia from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id left join offp_cl on offp_offpcl_id = offpcl_id where offp_fp_id = 6) as c on of_id = c.offp_of_id
			inner join (select distinct P_ID as pId, dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X_Desmolde(p_id,null) as preco 
							from 
								ordemfabrico 
								inner join (select offp_of_id as id, min(offp_datainicio) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 group by offp_of_id) as i on of_id = i.id
								inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
								inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
							where 
								(of_datafim > @data 
									or of_datafim is null
								) 
								and i.dt < @data 
								--and tp_tp_id = 1 
								and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
								and (of_oftu_id <> 2 
										or of_oftu_id is null
									)
								and of_id < 10000000) as pr on OF_P_ID = pr.pId
		where 
			(of_datafim > @data 
				or of_datafim is null
			) 
			and i.dt < @data 
			--and tp_tp_id = 1 
			and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
			and (of_oftu_id <> 2 
					or of_oftu_id is null
				)
			and of_id < 10000000
		union
		select 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) as p_, 
			p.p_nome, 1, (case when e_nelo = 1 then 'Produtos acabados nosso' else 'Produtos acabados clientes' end) as estado, 
			case when OF_PRECOCUSTO_DT > 0 then OF_PRECOCUSTO_DT else dbo.PrecoCusto_OF(of_id,3) end, 
			round(coalesce(h.t,0),2) as Horas, e_nome, of_id, i.dt as of_datainicio, of_datafim, fp_nome, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, arm_nome, c.offpcl_desc as gravidade, p_id
		from
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join (select offp_of_id as id, min(offp_datainicio) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 group by offp_of_id) as i on of_id = i.id
			inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select offp_of_id as ofid, min(offp_ordem) as ord, min(offp_datainicio) as dtt from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (9,10,12,13,14) and (@data between offp_datainicio and offp_datafim or (@data >= offp_datainicio and offp_datafim is null)) group by offp_of_id) as offs on of_id = offs.ofid
			left join (select comp_p_id, sum(comp_quantidade) as t from produto_componente where comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90) group by comp_p_id) as h on p.p_id = h.comp_p_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_ordem = offs.ord and offp_datainicio = offs.dtt 
			inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
			inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
			inner join armazem on of_arm_id = arm_id
			left join (select offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, offpcl_desc, offpcl_sequencia from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id left join offp_cl on offp_offpcl_id = offpcl_id where offp_fp_id = 6) as c on of_id = c.offp_of_id
			left join (select offp_of_id, min(offp_datainicio) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 12 group by offp_of_id) as entr on of_id = entr.offp_of_id
		where 
			((offp_fp_id in (9,10,13,14) 
				and (@data between offp_datainicio and offp_datafim 
					or (offp_datainicio <= @data and offp_datafim is null)
				)
			) 
			or (of_fp_id = 9 
				and offp_fp_id = 9 
				and offp_datainicio is null 
				and offp_datafim is null and of_datafim < @data
			) 
			or (offp_fp_id = 8 
				and of_datafim <= @data 
				and (entr.dt is null or entr.dt > @data)
			)
			or (offp_fp_id = 12 
				and year(offp_datainicio) = year(@data)
				and (len(of_fact) = 0 or of_fact is null) -- manhosice
			)
			or (offp_fp_id = 12 and e_nelo = 1 
				and year(offp_datainicio) = year(@data) -- manhosice
			)) 
			and of_id not in (select distinct offp_of_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (17,16))
			and of_id < 10000000
			and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
		order by 
			estado, tp_nome, p_nome


		select o.tp_nome, o.p_, o.p_nome, o.ofs, o.estado, o.preco, o.Horas, o.e_nome, o.of_id, o.of_datainicio, o.of_datafim, o.fp_nome, o.offp_datainicio, o.offp_datafim, o.arm_nome, o.offpcl_desc as gravidade, p.p_preco_temp, p.p_id from @ofs as o inner join produto as p on o.p_id = p.p_id /*as o inner join @precos as p on o.p_id = p.p_id*/
	end
	else
		select 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) as p_id, 
			p_nome, count(of_id), 'Produtos intermédios' as estado, 0 as preco, round(coalesce(h.t,0),2) as Horas, e_nome, of_id, i.dt as of_datainicio, of_datafim, 'Produtos intermédios' as fp_nome, null as offp_datainicio, null as offp_datafim, 
			arm_nome, c.offpcl_desc as gravidade
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join (select offp_of_id as id, min(offp_datainicio) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 group by offp_of_id) as i on of_id = i.id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select comp_p_id, sum(comp_quantidade) as t from produto_componente where comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90 and p_id <> 20796) group by comp_p_id) as h on p_id = h.comp_p_id
			inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
			inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
			inner join armazem on of_arm_id = arm_id
			left join (select offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, offpcl_desc, offpcl_sequencia from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id left join offp_cl on offp_offpcl_id = offpcl_id where offp_fp_id = 6) as c on of_id = c.offp_of_id
		where 
			(of_datafim > @data 
				or of_datafim is null
			) 
			and i.dt < @data 
			--and tp_tp_id = 1 
			and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
			and (of_oftu_id <> 2 
					or of_oftu_id is null
				)
			and of_id < 10000000
		group by 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id), 
			p_nome, h.t, e_nome, of_id, i.dt, of_datafim, arm_nome, c.offpcl_desc
		union
		select 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) as p_id, 
			p.p_nome, count(of_id), (case when offp_fp_id = 12 then 'Produtos acabados' else 'Produtos acabados' end) as estado, 0 as preco, round(coalesce(h.t,0),2) as Horas, e_nome, of_id, i.dt as of_datainicio, of_datafim, fp_nome, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, arm_nome, c.offpcl_desc as gravidade
		from
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join (select offp_of_id as id, min(offp_datainicio) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 1 group by offp_of_id) as i on of_id = i.id
			inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select offp_of_id as ofid, min(offp_ordem) as ord, min(offp_datainicio) as dtt from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (9,10,12,13,14) and (@data between offp_datainicio and offp_datafim or (@data >= offp_datainicio and offp_datafim is null)) group by offp_of_id) as offs on of_id = offs.ofid
			left join (select comp_p_id, sum(comp_quantidade) as t from produto_componente where comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90) group by comp_p_id) as h on p.p_id = h.comp_p_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_ordem = offs.ord and offp_datainicio = offs.dtt 
			inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
			inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
			inner join armazem on of_arm_id = arm_id
			left join (select offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, offpcl_desc, offpcl_sequencia from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id left join offp_cl on offp_offpcl_id = offpcl_id where offp_fp_id = 6) as c on of_id = c.offp_of_id
			left join (select offp_of_id, min(offp_datainicio) as dt from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 12 group by offp_of_id) as entr on of_id = entr.offp_of_id
		where 
			((offp_fp_id in (9,10,13,14) 
				and (@data between offp_datainicio and offp_datafim 
					or (offp_datainicio <= @data 
						and offp_datafim is null
					)
				)
			) 
			or (of_fp_id = 9 
				and offp_fp_id = 9 
				and offp_datainicio is null 
				and offp_datafim is null 
				and of_datafim < @data
			) 
			or (offp_fp_id = 8 
				and of_datafim <= @data 
				and (entr.dt is null 
					or entr.dt > @data
				)
			)
			or (offp_fp_id = 12 
				and year(offp_datainicio) = year(@data)
				and (len(of_fact) = 0 or of_fact is null) -- manhosice
			)
			or (offp_fp_id = 12 and e_nelo = 1 
				and year(offp_datainicio) = year(@data) -- manhosice
			))
			and of_id not in (select distinct offp_of_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (17,16))
			and of_id < 10000000
			and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
		group by 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id), 
			p_nome, h.t, e_nome, of_id, i.dt, of_datafim, fp_nome, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, arm_nome, c.offpcl_desc, offp_fp_id
		order by

END
```
