#### `dbo.Report_Inventario_Externos`(@data smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-06 15:55* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Inventario_Externos]
	
	@data smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, 
		(select top 1 mov_precounitario from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data <= @data and mov_precounitario > 0.0 order by mov_data desc) as p_precocusto, 
		coalesce(entradas,0) /*- coalesce(saidas,0)*/ as st,
		coalesce((select top 1 e_nome from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data <= @data  order by mov_data desc),'') as Forn, pcont_nome, e_qt.n_ent, e_qt.qt_ent, ult_Ent.dt, s_qt.n_sai, s_qt.qt_sai, ult_Sai.dt1,
		coalesce(e.arm_nome, '') as arm_nome
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id 
		left join (select distinct comp_p_p_id from produto_componente) as cp on p_id = cp.comp_p_p_id inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id inner join (select distinct mov_p_id from movimento where year(mov_data) >= year(getdate()) - 2 and mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on p_id = m.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then 1 else -1 end)) as entradas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as e on p_id = e.mov_p_id
		--left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade) as saidas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as s on p_id = s.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_ent, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_ent from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as e_qt on p_id = e_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_sai, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_sai from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as s_qt on p_id = s_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Ent on p_id = ult_Ent.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt1 from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Sai on p_id = ult_Sai.mov_p_id
	where
		p_pcont_id in (1,2) and p_fabricointerno = 0 and p_activo = 1 and p_tem_stock = 1 and p_descontinuado = 0 and p_tp_id <> 125 --and coalesce(entradas,0) - coalesce(saidas,0) > 0.0
	union
	select 
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, 
		(select top 1 mov_precounitario from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data <= @data and mov_precounitario > 0.0 order by mov_data desc) as p_precocusto, 
		coalesce(entradas,0) /*- coalesce(saidas,0)*/ as st,
		coalesce((select top 1 e_nome from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data <= @data order by mov_data desc),'') as Forn, pcont_nome, e_qt.n_ent, e_qt.qt_ent, ult_Ent.dt, s_qt.n_sai, s_qt.qt_sai, ult_Sai.dt1,
		coalesce(e.arm_nome, '') as arm_nome
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id 
		inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id 
		left join (select distinct mov_p_id from movimento where year(mov_data) >= year(getdate()) - 2 and mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on p_id = m.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then 1 else -1 end)) as entradas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as e on p_id = e.mov_p_id
		--left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade) as saidas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as s on p_id = s.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_ent, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_ent from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as e_qt on p_id = e_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_sai, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_sai from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as s_qt on p_id = s_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Ent on p_id = ult_Ent.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt1 from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Sai on p_id = ult_Sai.mov_p_id
	where
		p_pcont_id in (5,8) and p_fabricointerno = 0 and p_activo = 1 and p_tem_stock = 1 and p_descontinuado = 0 and p_tp_id <> 125 --and coalesce(entradas,0) - coalesce(saidas,0) > 0.0
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

```sql

		coalesce(e.arm_nome, '') as arm_nome
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id 
		left join (select distinct comp_p_p_id from produto_componente) as cp on p_id = cp.comp_p_p_id 
		inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id inner join (select distinct mov_p_id from movimento where year(mov_data) >= year(getdate()) - 2 and mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on p_id = m.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then 1 else -1 end)) as entradas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as e on p_id = e.mov_p_id
		--left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade) as saidas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as s on p_id = s.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_ent, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_ent from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as e_qt on p_id = e_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_sai, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_sai from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as s_qt on p_id = s_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Ent on p_id = ult_Ent.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt1 from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Sai on p_id = ult_Sai.mov_p_id
	where
		p_pcont_id in (1,2) and p_activo = 1 and p_tem_stock = 1 and p_descontinuado = 0 and p_tp_id <> 125 --and coalesce(entradas,0) - coalesce(saidas,0) > 0.0
	union
	select 
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, 
		case when p_fabricointerno = 1 and p_pcont_id = 9 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, @data) * 1.3,0) 
			when p_fabricointerno = 1 and p_pcont_id <> 9 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, @data),0) 
			else (select top 1 mov_precounitario from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data <= @data and mov_precounitario > 0.0 order by mov_data desc) end as p_precocusto, 
		coalesce(entradas,0) /*- coalesce(saidas,0)*/ as st,
		coalesce((select top 1 e_nome from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = p_id and mov_data <= @data order by mov_data desc),'') as Forn, pcont_nome, e_qt.n_ent, e_qt.qt_ent, ult_Ent.dt, s_qt.n_sai, s_qt.qt_sai, ult_Sai.dt1,
		coalesce(e.arm_nome, '') as arm_nome
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id 
		inner join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id 
		left join (select distinct mov_p_id from movimento where year(mov_data) >= year(getdate()) - 2 and mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on p_id = m.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then 1 else -1 end)) as entradas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as e on p_id = e.mov_p_id
		--left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade) as saidas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as s on p_id = s.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_ent, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_ent from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as e_qt on p_id = e_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_sai, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_sai from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as s_qt on p_id = s_qt.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Ent on p_id = ult_Ent.mov_p_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt1 from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Sai on p_id = ult_Sai.mov_p_id
	where
		p_pcont_id in (5,8,6,9) and p_activo = 1 and p_tem_stock = 1 and p_descontinuado = 0 and p_tp_id <> 125 --and coalesce(entradas,0) - coalesce(saidas,0) > 0.0
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Inventario_Internos`(@data smalldatetime, @upd_preco bit)

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Inventario_Internos]
	
	@data smalldatetime,
	@upd_preco bit

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    
	if @upd_preco = 1
		select 
			tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, @data),0) as p_precocusto, coalesce(e.entradas,0) /*- coalesce(s.saidas, 0)*/ as stock, coalesce(e.arm_nome, '') as arm_nome--, round(coalesce(sum(comp_quantidade),0),2) as Horas
			, s_qt.n_sai, s_qt.qt_sai, ult_Sai.dt1, e_qt.n_ent, e_qt.qt_ent, ult_Ent.dt, PCONT_NOME
		from 
			produto_tipo inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id 
			inner join PRODUTO_CONTABILIDADE_TIPO on P_PCONT_ID = PCONT_ID
			inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then 1 else -1 end)) as entradas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as e on p_id = e.mov_p_id
			--left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade) as saidas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as s on p_id = s.mov_p_id
			--left join armazem on e.mov_arm_id = arm_id and s.mov_arm_id = arm_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_sai, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_sai from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as s_qt on p_id = s_qt.mov_p_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt1 from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Sai on p_id = ult_Sai.mov_p_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_ent, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_ent from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as e_qt on p_id = e_qt.mov_p_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Ent on p_id = ult_Ent.mov_p_id
			left join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_id and comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90)
		where
			p_pcont_id in (1,2,5,6,8,9) and coalesce(e.entradas,0) /*- coalesce(s.saidas, 0)*/ > 0.0 and p_fabricointerno = 1 and coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, @data),0) > 0 and p_tem_stock = 1 and p_activo = 1 and p_descontinuado = 0
		group by tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, @data),0), coalesce(e.entradas,0) /*- coalesce(s.saidas, 0)*/, coalesce(e.arm_nome, '')
			, s_qt.n_sai, s_qt.qt_sai, ult_Sai.dt1, e_qt.n_ent, e_qt.qt_ent, ult_Ent.dt, PCONT_NOME
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome
	else
		select 
			tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, 0 as p_precocusto, coalesce(e.entradas,0) /*- coalesce(s.saidas, 0)*/ as stock, coalesce(e.arm_nome, '') as arm_nome--, round(coalesce(sum(comp_quantidade),0),2) as Horas
			, s_qt.n_sai, s_qt.qt_sai, ult_Sai.dt1, e_qt.n_ent, e_qt.qt_ent, ult_Ent.dt, PCONT_NOME
		from 
			produto_tipo inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id
			inner join PRODUTO_CONTABILIDADE_TIPO on P_PCONT_ID = PCONT_ID 
			inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then 1 else -1 end)) as entradas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as e on p_id = e.mov_p_id
			--left join (select mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome, sum(mov_quantidade) as saidas from movimento inner join armazem on mov_arm_id = arm_id where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data < @data group by mov_p_id, mov_arm_id, arm_nome) as s on p_id = s.mov_p_id
			--left join armazem on e.mov_arm_id = arm_id and s.mov_arm_id = arm_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_sai, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_sai from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as s_qt on p_id = s_qt.mov_p_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt1 from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Sai on p_id = ult_Sai.mov_p_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, count(mov_id) as n_ent, sum(mov_quantidade) as qt_ent from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and year(mov_data) = year(@data) group by mov_p_id) as e_qt on p_id = e_qt.mov_p_id
			left join (select mov_p_id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ult_Ent on p_id = ult_Ent.mov_p_id
			left join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_id and comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90)
		where
			p_pcont_id in (1,2,5,6,8,9) and coalesce(e.entradas,0) /*- coalesce(s.saidas, 0)*/ > 0.0 and p_fabricointerno = 1 and coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, @data),0) > 0 and p_tem_stock = 1 and p_activo = 1 and p_descontinuado = 0
		group by tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, @data),0), coalesce(e.entradas,0) /*- coalesce(s.saidas, 0)*/, coalesce(e.arm_nome, '')
			, s_qt.n_sai, s_qt.qt_sai, ult_Sai.dt1, e_qt.n_ent, e_qt.qt_ent, ult_Ent.dt, PCONT_NOME
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome


END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Inventario_TesteStock`(@data smalldatetime, @upd_preco bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-06 15:57* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Inventario_TesteStock]

	@data smalldatetime,
	@upd_preco bit

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	    
	if @upd_preco = 1
	begin
		select 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) as p_id, 
			p.p_nome, of_id, e_nome, /*price*/ dbo.PrecoCusto_OF(of_id,3) as p_preco_temp, round(coalesce(h.t,0),2) as Horas, of_datafim
		from
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select comp_p_id, sum(comp_quantidade) as t from produto_componente where comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90) group by comp_p_id) as h on p.p_id = h.comp_p_id
			inner join of_of_tipouso on of_id = ofoftu_of_id
			inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		where 
			ofoftu_oftu_id = 2 and (ofoftu_datasaida >= @data or ofoftu_datasaida is null)
		order by 
			e_nome, tp_nome, p.p_nome
	end
	else
		select 
			tp_nome, substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) as p_id, 
			p.p_nome, of_id, e_nome, 0 as p_preco_temp, round(coalesce(h.t,0),2) as Horas, of_datafim
		from
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select comp_p_id, sum(comp_quantidade) as t from produto_componente where comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 90) group by comp_p_id) as h on p.p_id = h.comp_p_id
			inner join of_of_tipouso on of_id = ofoftu_of_id
			inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		where 
			ofoftu_oftu_id = 2 and (ofoftu_datasaida >= @data or ofoftu_datasaida is null)
		order by 
			e_nome, tp_nome, p.p_nome


END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Mensal_Pesos`(@mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Mensal_Pesos]

@mes int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select of_id, p_nome, (case when fp_id = 6 then p_pesolam else p_pesoacab end) ideal, offp_peso, (case when offp_fp_id = 6 then lam.nome else e_nome end) as e_nome, fp_nome
	from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id inner join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id inner join
	(select offp_of_id, e_nome as nome from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id inner join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id where offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_fp_id = 1) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
	where offp_fp_id in (6,8) and year(offp_datafim) = year(dateadd(mm,-1,getdate())) and month(offp_datafim) = @mes and 
		offp_problemas <> '' and offpeq_chefe = 1
	order by fp_sequencia, e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Mensal_Problemas`(@mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Mensal_Problemas]


@mes int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select of_id, p_nome, offpcl_desc, fp.offp_problemas, (case when fp_id = 6 then x.e_nome else e.e_nome end) as e_nome, fp_nome,
		(case when fp_id = 6 then x.offp_datainicio else fp.offp_datainicio end) as Data
	from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp as fp on of_id = fp.offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id inner join entidade as e on offpeq_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join offp_cl on offp_offpcl_id = offpcl_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id left join
		(select offp_of_id, offp_datainicio, e_nome from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id inner join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id 
		where year(offp_datafim) = year(getdate()) and month(offp_datafim) = @mes and offpeq_chefe = 1 and offp_fp_id = 1) as x on of_id = x.offp_of_id
	where year(fp.offp_datafim) = year(getdate()) and month(fp.offp_datafim) = @mes and fp.offp_problemas <> '' and offpeq_chefe = 1
	order by fp_sequencia, e.e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Mensal_Producao`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_Mensal_Producao]
as

select year(of_datafim) as Ano, month(of_datafim) as Mes, count(of_id) as Num, 'Todos' as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where year(of_datafim) between year(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate()))-1 and year(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate())) 
	  and month(of_datafim) between month(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate())) and month(getdate()) and tp_tp_id = 1
group by year(of_datafim), month(of_datafim)
union
select year(of_datafim) as Ano, month(of_datafim) as Mes, count(of_id) as Num, tp_nome as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where year(of_datafim) between year(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate()))-1 and year(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate())) 
	  and month(of_datafim) between month(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate())) and month(getdate()) and tp_tp_id = 1
group by year(of_datafim), month(of_datafim), tp_nome
order by Tipo, Mes, Ano
```

#### `dbo.Report_Mensal_Producao_Anual`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_Mensal_Producao_Anual]
as

declare @t table (Ano int, Num int, Coef float, Tipo varchar(max))

insert into @t (Ano, Num, Coef, Tipo)
select year(of_datafim) as Ano, count(of_id) as Num, sum(of_coeficiente) as coef, tp_nome as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate()) - 1 and tp_tp_id = 1
group by year(of_datafim), tp_nome
union
select year(of_datafim) as Ano, count(of_id) as Num, sum(of_coeficiente) as coef, 'Todos' as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate()) - 1 and tp_tp_id = 1
group by year(of_datafim)


select a.Tipo, a.Num as Num1, a.Coef as Coef1, b.Num as Num2, b.Coef as Coef2, c.Num as Num3, c.Coef as Coef3
from @t as a inner join @t as b on a.Tipo = b.Tipo and a.Ano = b.Ano + 1
	 inner join @t as c on a.Tipo = c.Tipo and a.Ano = c.Ano + 2
```

#### `dbo.Report_Mensal_Producao_HomologoAnual`()

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_Mensal_Producao_HomologoAnual]
as

declare @t table (Ano int, Num int, Coef float, Tipo varchar(max))

insert into @t (Ano, Num, Coef, Tipo)
select year(of_datafim) as Ano, count(of_id) as Num, sum(of_coeficiente) as coef, tp_nome as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-2 and year(getdate())
	  and ((month(of_datafim) = month(getdate()) and day(of_datafim) <= day(getdate())) or month(of_datafim) < month(getdate())) and of_id < 10000000 
	  and tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
group by year(of_datafim), tp_nome
union
select year(of_datafim) as Ano, count(of_id) as Num, sum(of_coeficiente) as coef, 'Todos' as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-2 and year(getdate())
	  and ((month(of_datafim) = month(getdate()) and day(of_datafim) <= day(getdate())) or month(of_datafim) < month(getdate())) and of_id < 10000000 
	  and tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
group by year(of_datafim)


select a.Tipo, a.Num as Num1, a.Coef as Coef1, b.Num as Num2, b.Coef as Coef2, c.Num as Num3, c.Coef as Coef3
from @t as a inner join @t as b on a.Tipo = b.Tipo and a.Ano = b.Ano + 1
	 inner join @t as c on a.Tipo = c.Tipo and a.Ano = c.Ano + 2
```

#### `dbo.Report_Mensal_Producao_HomologoEpoca`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-03-24 10:18* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_Mensal_Producao_HomologoEpoca]
as

declare @inicio datetime
declare @fim datetime

set @inicio = (case when month(getdate()) > 9 then convert(datetime, convert(varchar(max), year(getdate())) + '/10/01') 
				else convert(datetime, convert(varchar(max), year(getdate()) - 1) + '/10/01') end)

set @fim = getdate()

declare @t table (Ano int, Num int, Coef float, Tipo varchar(max))

insert into @t (Ano, Num, Coef, Tipo)
select (case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim) + 1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano, count(of_id) as Num, sum(of_coeficiente) as coef, tp_nome as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where (of_datafim between @inicio and @fim or of_datafim between dateadd(yy,-1,@inicio) and dateadd(yy,-1,@fim) or of_datafim between dateadd(yy,-2,@inicio) and dateadd(yy,-2,@fim)) and of_id < 10000000
group by (case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim) + 1 else year(of_datafim) end), tp_nome
union
select (case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim) + 1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano, count(of_id) as Num, sum(of_coeficiente) as coef, 'Todos' as Tipo
from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where (of_datafim between @inicio and @fim or of_datafim between dateadd(yy,-1,@inicio) and dateadd(yy,-1,@fim) or of_datafim between dateadd(yy,-2,@inicio) and dateadd(yy,-2,@fim)) and of_id < 10000000
group by (case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim) + 1 else year(of_datafim) end)


select a.Tipo, a.Num as Num1, a.Coef as Coef1, b.Num as Num2, b.Coef as Coef2, c.Num as Num3, c.Coef as Coef3
from @t as a inner join @t as b on a.Tipo = b.Tipo and a.Ano = b.Ano + 1
	 inner join @t as c on a.Tipo = c.Tipo and a.Ano = c.Ano + 2
```

#### `dbo.Report_Moldes_Movimentacao`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `molde`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Moldes_Movimentacao] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select of_id, of_nome, p_nome, isnull(avg(med),0) as medSemana
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id left join
	(select distinct p_nome as nome, p_np_id as np_id, p_m_id as m_id, p_tam_id as tam_id
	from ORDEMFABRICO inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
	where tr_data between dateadd(day, 6 - datepart(dw, getdate()), getdate()) and dateadd(ww, 2, dateadd(day, 6 - datepart(dw, getdate()), getdate()))) as a on p_np_id = np_id and p_m_id = m_id and p_tam_id = tam_id left join
	(select datepart(ww,of_datainicio) as semana, of_of_id_mld as mld_id, count(of_of_id_mld) as med from ordemfabrico where of_datainicio >= dateadd(yy, -1, getdate()) group by datepart(ww,of_datainicio), of_of_id_mld) as m on of_id = mld_id
	where p_tp_id = 82 and nome is null and of_arm_id = 14 and of_arm_fixo = 0
	group by of_id, of_nome, p_nome
	order by p_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_MovimentosContabilisticos`(@dt_i smalldatetime, @dt_f smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 12:00* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_MovimentosContabilisticos]

@dt_i smalldatetime,
@dt_f smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		ml.descricao, ml2.ncont as ncont, (case when mov.e_contribuinte is null then 0 else 1 end) as matchFound,
		sum(ml.ecre - ml.edeb) as deb, --sum(ml1.ecre) as cred
		coalesce(mov.tot,0)
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml as ml left join (select distinct conta, ncont from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.pc where ncont <> '') as ml2 on ml.conta = ml2.conta left join
		(select e_contribuinte, sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as tot from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
			where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_datasaida between @dt_i and @dt_f group by e_contribuinte) as mov on mov.e_contribuinte = ltrim(rtrim(coalesce(ml2.ncont, ml.descricao))) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
	where
		ml.dino = 2 and ml.conta like '2211%' and ml.data between @dt_i and @dt_f
	group by 
		ml.descricao, ml2.ncont, (case when mov.e_contribuinte is null then 0 else 1 end), coalesce(mov.tot,0)--,
	having 
		sum(ml.ecre) > 0.0 or sum(ml.edeb) > 0.0
	order by 
		ml.descricao

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Necessidades`(@tp_id int, @internas bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-11 11:22* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Necessidades]

@tp_id int,
@internas bit

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if (@tp_id = 2)
begin
    select 
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0) as p_stock, p_stockmin, coalesce(zx.qtd,0) as p_necessidades
	from
		produto 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
		--left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento left join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = of_id and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747 where mov_tpmov_id = 4 group by mov_p_id) as nec on p_id = nec.mov_p_id
		outer apply (select sum(quantidade) qtd from dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista(p_id)) zx
	where 
		(tp_id = @tp_id or tp_tp_id = @tp_id) and p_fabricointerno = @internas and p_activo = 1 and p_tp_id not in (73,81)
	union
	select
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0) as p_stock, p_stockmin, sum(mov_quantidade)
	from
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id 
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
		--left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento left join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = of_id and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747 where mov_tpmov_id = 4 group by mov_p_id) as nec on p_id = nec.mov_p_id
	where
		p_tp_id = 73 and p_activo = 1 and of_fp_id in (7) and p_fabricointerno = @internas
	group by
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, p_stock, p_stockmin, coalesce(ent.tot,0), coalesce(sai.tot,0)
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome
end
else
	select 
		tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_medida, coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0) as p_stock, p_stockmin, coalesce(zx.qtd,0) as p_necessidades
	from
		produto 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
		--left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento left join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = of_id and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747 where mov_tpmov_id = 4 group by mov_p_id) as nec on p_id = nec.mov_p_id
		outer apply (select sum(quantidade) qtd from dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista(p_id)) zx
	where 
		(tp_id = @tp_id or tp_tp_id = @tp_id) and p_fabricointerno = @internas and p_activo = 1
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Necessidades_Data`(@data smalldatetime, @l_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-11-15 15:30* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Necessidades_Data]

	@data smalldatetime,
	@l_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @dt table(id int, ano int, mes int, dia int, qtd float)

	insert into @dt (id, ano, mes, dia, qtd) 
	(select 
		m.mov_p_id, year(m.mov_data) as ano, month(m.mov_data) as mes, datepart(week,m.mov_data) as dia, (case when coalesce(d.tot,0) = 0 then 0 else coalesce(d.tot,0)/sum(m.mov_quantidade) end) as qtd
	from 
		movimento as m 
		left join (select 
						mov_p_id, year(mov_data) as ano, month(mov_data) as mes, datepart(week,mov_data) as dia, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot 
					from 
						movimento 
					where 
						mov_defeituoso = 1 
						and mov_tpmov_id = 2 
					group by 
						mov_p_id, year(mov_data), month(mov_data), datepart(week,mov_data)) as d on m.mov_p_id = d.mov_p_id and year(m.mov_data) = d.ano and month(m.mov_data) = d.mes and datepart(week,m.mov_data) = d.dia
	where 
		m.mov_tpmov_id = 1 
		and m.mov_acerto = 0 
		and m.mov_data > '2016/07/22'
	group by 
		m.mov_p_id, year(m.mov_data), month(m.mov_data), datepart(week,m.mov_data), d.tot)

	--select 
	--	tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, sum(m1.mov_quantidade) as tot, coalesce(ent.qtd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtd,0) as stock, coalesce(dt.qtd,0) as defs, p_stockmin, p_qtd_montagem
	--from 
	--	ordemfabrico inner join movimento as m1 on of_id = m1.mov_of_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id inner join lista_produto on p_id = lp_p_id
	--	inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on m1.mov_p_id = ent.mov_p_id left join
	--	(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on m1.mov_p_id = sai.mov_p_id left join
	--	(select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on m1.mov_p_id = dt.id 
	--where 
	--	/*(p_tp_id in (10,11,12,14,62,63,67,103,73,64) or p_id in (21676,20848,20971)) and*/ of_fp_id not in (9,10,12) and tr_data <= @data and lp_l_id = @l_id
	--group by 
	--	tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, ent.qtd, sai.qtd, coalesce(dt.qtd,0), p_stockmin, p_qtd_montagem
	--order by 
	--	tp_nome, p_nome


	select 
		tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as tot, isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) as stock, isnull(dt.qtd,0) as defs, p_stockmin, p_qtd_montagem, 
		replace((case when p_imagem is null or p_imagem = '' then at_image else p_imagem end), '\\server\Documents\imagens_BD\Produtos\', 'http://agents.nelo.eu/imagens_bd/produtos/') as p_imagem, p_stock_linha,
		isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as shopTr, isnull(shop.qtd,0) as shop
	from 
		lista_produto 
		inner join produto on lp_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data <= @data and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12,13,14) group by mov_p_id) as ofs on p_id = ofs.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join transporte on mov_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data <= @data and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_shop_order_id is not null group by mov_p_id) as shopTr on p_id = shopTr.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento left join transporte on mov_tr_id = tr_id where tr_id is null and mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_shop_order_id is not null group by mov_p_id) as shop on p_id = shop.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
		left join (select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on p_id = dt.id 
		left join (select max(at_id) as id, at_p_id as at_pid from produto_attach group by at_p_id) as img on p_id = img.at_pid left join produto_attach on img.id = at_id
	where 
		lp_l_id = @l_id 
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Necessidades_Data_Componentes`(@data smalldatetime, @tp_id int, @l_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Necessidades_Data_Componentes]
	
	@data smalldatetime,
	@tp_id int,
	@l_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @dt table(id int, ano int, mes int, dia int, qtd float)

	insert into @dt (id, ano, mes, dia, qtd) (select m.mov_p_id, year(m.mov_data) as ano, month(m.mov_data) as mes, datepart(week,m.mov_data) as dia, (case when coalesce(d.tot,0) = 0 then 0 else coalesce(d.tot,0)/sum(m.mov_quantidade) end) as qtd
	from movimento as m left join 
	(select mov_p_id, year(mov_data) as ano, month(mov_data) as mes, datepart(week,mov_data) as dia, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento 
			where mov_defeituoso = 1 and mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id, year(mov_data), month(mov_data), datepart(week,mov_data)) as d on m.mov_p_id = d.mov_p_id and year(m.mov_data) = d.ano and month(m.mov_data) = d.mes and datepart(week,m.mov_data) = d.dia
	where m.mov_tpmov_id = 1 and m.mov_acerto = 0 and m.mov_data > dateadd(month,-1,getdate())--'2016/07/22'
	group by m.mov_p_id, year(m.mov_data), month(m.mov_data), datepart(week,m.mov_data), d.tot)


	select 
		pt1.tp_nome, p1.p_id, p1.p_nome, (case when ofs.qtd > 0 and ((ofs.qtd - (ent1.qtd - sai1.qtd)) * comp_quantidade) + p.p_stockmin >= p.p_qtd_montagem then ((ofs.qtd - (ent1.qtd - sai1.qtd)) * comp_quantidade) + p.p_stockmin when ofs.qtd > 0 and ((ofs.qtd - (ent1.qtd - sai1.qtd)) * comp_quantidade) + p.p_stockmin > 0 then p.p_qtd_montagem when ofs.qtd is null and p.p_stockmin - (ent1.qtd - sai1.qtd) >= p.p_qtd_montagem then p.p_stockmin - (ent1.qtd - sai1.qtd) when p.p_stockmin - (ent1.qtd - sai1.qtd) > 0 and p.p_stockmin - (ent1.qtd - sai1.qtd) < p.p_qtd_montagem then p.p_qtd_montagem else 0 end) as tot, coalesce(ent.qtd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtd,0) as stock, round(coalesce(dt.qtd,0),2) as defs, p1.p_pecas_ciclo, p1.p_ciclo_2px
	from 
		lista_produto inner join produto as p on lp_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto_tipo as pt on p.p_tp_id = pt.tp_id left join 
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data <= @data and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12) group by mov_p_id) as ofs on p_id = ofs.mov_p_id left join  
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent1 on p.p_id = ent1.mov_p_id left join
		produto_componente on p.p_id = comp_p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 left join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id and p1.p_tem_stock = 1 left join produto_tipo as pt1 on p1.p_tp_id = pt1.tp_id left join
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p1.p_id = ent.mov_p_id left join
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p1.p_id = sai.mov_p_id left join
		(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai1 on p.p_id = sai1.mov_p_id left join
		(select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on p.p_id = dt.id
		--ordemfabrico inner join movimento as m1 on of_id = m1.mov_of_id inner join produto as p on m1.mov_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto_tipo as pt on p.p_tp_id = pt.tp_id inner join lista_produto on p.p_id = lp_p_id
		--inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent1 on m1.mov_p_id = ent1.mov_p_id left join
		--(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai1 on m1.mov_p_id = sai1.mov_p_id inner join 
		--produto_componente on p.p_id = comp_p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id and p1.p_tem_stock = 1 inner join produto_tipo as pt1 on p1.p_tp_id = pt1.tp_id left join 
		--(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p1.p_id = ent.mov_p_id left join
		--(select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p1.p_id = sai.mov_p_id left join
		--(select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on p1.p_id = dt.id
	where 
		p.p_tp_id = @tp_id and lp_l_id = @l_id -- and tr_data <= @data and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12)
	--group by 
	--	pt1.tp_nome, p1.p_id, p1.p_nome, ent.qtd, sai.qtd, coalesce(dt.qtd,0), comp_quantidade, ent1.qtd, sai1.qtd, p1.p_pecas_ciclo, p1.p_ciclo_2px
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Necessidades_Data_v2`(@data date, @tipo int, @hoje date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-07-25 11:17 · modificado 2021-10-26 16:47* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Necessidades_Data_v2]

	@data date,
	@tipo int = null, -- 1) Pintura, arm:11 | 2) Laminagem, arm:8 e MO: 20745;20794 | 3) Serralharia, arm:13 e MO:21637 | 4) Montagem, arm:9;10
	@hoje date = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--declare @hoje date = getdate()
	set @hoje = isnull(@hoje,getdate())

    declare @dt table(id int, ano int, mes int, dia int, qtd float)

	insert into @dt (id, ano, mes, dia, qtd) 
	(select 
		m.mov_p_id, 
		year(m.mov_data) as ano, 
		month(m.mov_data) as mes, 
		datepart(week,m.mov_data) as dia, 
		(case when coalesce(d.tot,0) = 0 then 0 else coalesce(d.tot,0)/sum(m.mov_quantidade) end) as qtd
	from 
		movimento as m 
		left join (select 
					mov_p_id, year(mov_data) as ano, month(mov_data) as mes, datepart(week,mov_data) as dia, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot 
				from 
					movimento 
				where 
					mov_defeituoso = 1 
					and mov_tpmov_id = 2 
				group by 
					mov_p_id, year(mov_data), month(mov_data), datepart(week,mov_data)) as d on m.mov_p_id = d.mov_p_id and year(m.mov_data) = d.ano and month(m.mov_data) = d.mes and datepart(week,m.mov_data) = d.dia
	where 
		m.mov_tpmov_id = 1 
		and m.mov_acerto = 0 
		and m.mov_data > '2016/07/22'
	group by m.mov_p_id, year(m.mov_data), month(m.mov_data), datepart(week,m.mov_data), d.tot)

	if @tipo = 1 -- Pintura
		select 
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, 
			isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as tot, 
			isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) as stock, 
			isnull(dt.qtd,0) as defs, 
			p_stockmin, p_qtd_montagem, 
			replace((case when p_imagem is null or p_imagem = '' then at_image else p_imagem end), '\\server\Documents\imagens_BD\Produtos\', 'http://agents.nelo.eu/imagens_bd/produtos/') as p_imagem, p_stock_linha,
			isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as shopTr, isnull(shop.qtd,0) as shop, P_FABRICOINTERNO, E_NOME as responsavelPedidos, isnull(ped.qtd,0) as pedido, xxx.qtd, UNI_NOME,

								case when (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end) < 0 then 0
									else (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end)
								end as q 
							from 
								PRODUTO_COMPONENTE 
								inner join MOVIMENTO on COMP_P_ID = MOV_P_ID 
								inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
								inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
								left join (select p_id as pId, SUM(Stock) as stock from [dbo].[produto_stocks_por_armazem] group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_ID = st.pId
							where 
								COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 2 
								and tr_data between (case when @data > @hoje then @hoje else @data end) and @data 
								and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 4
								--and of_fp_id not in (8,9,10,12,13,14)
								--and OF_ID in (select offp_of_id from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 46 and OFFP_DATAFIM is null)
								/*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/
							group by 
								COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, st.stock) as x
						group by id) as xxx on p_id = xxx.id 
			left join ENTIDADE on P_E_ID_RESP = E_ID
			left join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
		where 
			(P_ARM_ID = 13 
				or COMP_P_P_ID = 21637)
			and P_ACTIVO = 1
			and (P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
				or (P_DESCONTINUADO = 1 and isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) > 0))
			and TP_TP_ID not in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
			--and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome
	else if @tipo = 4 -- Montagem
		select distinct
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as tot, isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) as stock, isnull(dt.qtd,0) as defs, p_stockmin, p_qtd_montagem, 
			replace((case when p_imagem is null or p_imagem = '' then at_image else p_imagem end), '\\server\Documents\imagens_BD\Produtos\', 'http://agents.nelo.eu/imagens_bd/produtos/') as p_imagem, p_stock_linha,
			isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as shopTr, isnull(shop.qtd,0) as shop, P_FABRICOINTERNO, E_NOME as responsavelPedidos, isnull(ped.qtd,0) as pedido, xxx.qtd, UNI_NOME,
			case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then dbo.produto_OFsEmCurso(p_id) else '' end as emCurso, case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then dbo.produto_OFsEmCurso_inteiro(p_id) else 0 end as emProducao, ofs.pedSatisf
			, case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then dbo.produto_OFsEmArmazem_inteiro(p_id) else 0 end as emArmazem
		from 
			produto
			left join produto_componente on P_ID = COMP_P_ID
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select 
							mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, isnull(pedidos.qtd,0) as pedSatisf 
						from 
							movimento 
							inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
							inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
							left join (select 
											mov_p_id as pId, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd 
										from 
											pedidos 
											inner join movimento on ped_id = mov_id_pedido and ped_e_id = mov_e_id 
											inner join ordemfabrico on ped_of_id = of_id
											inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
										where 
											mov_tpmov_id = 2 
											and tr_data between @hoje and @data
											and of_fp_id not in (8,9,10,12,13,14)
										group by	
											mov_p_id) as pedidos on mov_p_id = pedidos.pId
						where 
							tr_data between @hoje and @data 
							and of_fp_id not in (8,9,10,12,13,14) 
						group by 
							mov_p_id, pedidos.qtd) as ofs on p_id = ofs.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join transporte on mov_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data between (case when @data > @hoje then @hoje else @data end) and @data and mov_tpmov_id in (4,12) and len(mov_shop_order_id) > 7 and mov_satisfeito = 0 /*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/ group by mov_p_id) as shopTr on p_id = shopTr.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tr_id is null and mov_tpmov_id in (4,12) and len(mov_shop_order_id) > 7 and mov_satisfeito = 0 group by mov_p_id) as shop on p_id = shop.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
			left join (select p.mov_p_id, sum(p.mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento as p where p.mov_tpmov_id = 9 and p.MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 group by p.mov_p_id) as ped on p_id = ped.mov_p_id 
			left join (select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on p_id = dt.id 
			left join (select max(at_id) as id, at_p_id as at_pid from produto_attach group by at_p_id) as img on p_id = img.at_pid left join produto_attach on img.id = at_id
			left join (select id, sum(q) as qtd from 
							(select 
								COMP_P_P_ID as id, 
								case when (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end) < 0 then 0
									else (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end)
								end as q 
							from 
								PRODUTO_COMPONENTE 
								inner join MOVIMENTO on COMP_P_ID = MOV_P_ID 
								inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
								inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
								left join (select p_id as pId, SUM(Stock) as stock from [dbo].[produto_stocks_por_armazem] group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_ID = st.pId
							where 
								COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 2 
								and tr_data between (case when @data > @hoje then @hoje else @data end) and @data 
								and of_fp_id not in (8,9,10,12,13,14)
								/*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/
							group by 
								COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, st.stock) as x
						group by id) as xxx on p_id = xxx.id 
			left join ENTIDADE on P_E_ID_RESP = E_ID
			left join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
		where 
			(P_ARM_ID in (9,10)
			or COMP_P_P_ID = 21639)
			and P_ACTIVO = 1
			and (P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
				or (P_DESCONTINUADO = 1 and isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) > 0))
			and TP_TP_ID not in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
			--and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		order by 
			tp_nome, p_nome
	else if @tipo = 6 -- CorteCostura
		select distinct
			tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as tot, isnull(ent.qtd,0) - isnull(sai.qtd,0) as stock, isnull(dt.qtd,0) as defs, p_stockmin, p_qtd_montagem, 
			replace((case when p_imagem is null or p_imagem = '' then at_image else p_imagem end), '\\server\Documents\imagens_BD\Produtos\', 'http://agents.nelo.eu/imagens_bd/produtos/') as p_imagem, p_stock_linha,
			isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) as shopTr, isnull(shop.qtd,0) as shop, P_FABRICOINTERNO, E_NOME as responsavelPedidos, isnull(ped.qtd,0) as pedido, xxx.qtd, UNI_NOME,
			case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then dbo.produto_OFsEmCurso(p_id) else '' end as emCurso, case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then dbo.produto_OFsEmCurso_inteiro(p_id) else 0 end as emProducao, ofs.pedSatisf
			, case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then dbo.produto_OFsEmArmazem_inteiro(p_id) else 0 end as emArmazem
		from 
			produto
			left join produto_componente on P_ID = COMP_P_ID
			inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
			left join (select 
							mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd, isnull(pedidos.qtd,0) as pedSatisf 
						from 
							movimento 
							inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
							inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
							left join (select 
											mov_p_id as pId, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd 
										from 
											pedidos 
											inner join movimento on ped_id = mov_id_pedido and ped_e_id = mov_e_id 
											inner join ordemfabrico on ped_of_id = of_id
											inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
										where 
											mov_tpmov_id = 2 
											and tr_data between @hoje and @data
											--and of_fp_id not in (8,9,10,12,13,14)
											and OF_ID in (select offp_of_id from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 46 and OFFP_DATAFIM is null)
										group by	
											mov_p_id) as pedidos on mov_p_id = pedidos.pId
						where 
							tr_data between @hoje and @data 
							--and of_fp_id not in (8,9,10,12,13,14) 
							and OF_ID in (select offp_of_id from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 46 and OFFP_DATAFIM is null)
						group by 
							mov_p_id, pedidos.qtd) as ofs on p_id = ofs.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento inner join transporte on mov_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data between @hoje and @data and mov_tpmov_id in (4,12) and len(mov_shop_order_id) > 7 and mov_satisfeito = 0 /*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/ group by mov_p_id) as shopTr on p_id = shopTr.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tr_id is null and mov_tpmov_id in (4,12) and len(mov_shop_order_id) > 7 and mov_satisfeito = 0 group by mov_p_id) as shop on p_id = shop.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id 
			left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id 
			left join (select p.mov_p_id, sum(p.mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento as p where p.mov_tpmov_id = 9 and p.MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 group by p.mov_p_id) as ped on p_id = ped.mov_p_id 
			left join (select id, avg(qtd) as qtd from @dt group by id) as dt on p_id = dt.id 
			left join (select max(at_id) as id, at_p_id as at_pid from produto_attach group by at_p_id) as img on p_id = img.at_pid left join produto_attach on img.id = at_id
			left join (select id, sum(q) as qtd from 
							(select 
								COMP_P_P_ID as id, 
								case when (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end) < 0 then 0
									else (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end)
								end as q 
							from 
								PRODUTO_COMPONENTE 
								inner join MOVIMENTO on COMP_P_ID = MOV_P_ID 
								inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
								inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
								left join (select p_id as pId, SUM(Stock) as stock from [dbo].[produto_stocks_por_armazem] group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_ID = st.pId
							where 
								COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 2 
								and tr_data between @hoje and @data 
								--and of_fp_id not in (8,9,10,12,13,14)
								and OF_ID in (select offp_of_id from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 46 and OFFP_DATAFIM is null)
								/*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/
							group by 
								COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, st.stock) as x
						group by id) as xxx on p_id = xxx.id 
			left join ENTIDADE on P_E_ID_RESP = E_ID
			left join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
		where 
			(P_ARM_ID = 18
			or COMP_P_P_ID = 28659)

				or (P_DESCONTINUADO = 1 and isnull(ofs.qtd,0) + isnull(shopTr.qtd,0) > 0))
			and TP_TP_ID not in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
			and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		order by

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PercentagemAcessorios`(@ano int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_PercentagemAcessorios]

@ano int

as 

begin transaction

select 
	tp_nome,
	p_id, 
	p_nome, 
	sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd,
	(select sum(mov_quantidade) from ordemfabrico inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
							where datepart(yy,of_datafim) = @ano and p_tp_id = tp_id and of_fp_id not in (11,18,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8)) as total
from 
	ordemfabrico inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
where 
	datepart(yy,of_datafim) = @ano and tp_id in (10,11,12,14,62) and of_fp_id not in (11,18,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8)
group by 
	tp_id,
	tp_nome,
	p_id, 
	p_nome
order by 
	tp_nome,
	p_nome
	

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_Performance_Sub_New`(@di1 date, @df1 date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-27 10:05 · modificado 2019-06-27 10:05* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Performance_Sub_New] 
	@di1 date, 
	@df1 date
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @i date = @di1, @f date = @df1

    declare @h_trb int = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(cast(@i as smalldatetime) + cast('08:00:00' as smalldatetime), cast(@f as smalldatetime) + cast('17:00:00' as smalldatetime))

	select 
		fp_nome,
		e_id,
		e_nome + (case when E_FP_ID <> FP_ID then ' (*)' else '' end) as e_nome,
		offp_fp_id,
		e_fp_id,
		/*count(distinct offp_of_id)*/ SUM(case when fp_Func.OFFP_RETURN = 1 then 0 else 1 end) as ofs,
		sum((case when offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as N_Ret,
		sum((case when offp_return = 1 then 1 else 0 end)) as Ret,
		sum((case when offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 1 else 0 end)) as Ret_Culpado,
		sum(isnull(retProv.ids,0)) as Ret_Provocados,
		sum(
			case 
				when fp_Func.offp_return = 0 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)
				when fp_Func.offp_return = 1 and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id then 0
				when fp_Func.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fp_Func.offp_datainicio, fp_Func.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome)*(0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)))
			end
		) as temp,
		sum(isnull(retProv.tempo,0)) as tempo_a_descontar,
		(case when e_fp_id = fp_Func.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0) else 0.0 end) as faltas, 
		(case when e_fp_id = fp_Func.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0) else 0.0 end) as h_Ext, 
		(case when e_fp_id = fp_Func.offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
		(case when e_fp_id = fp_Func.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) else 0.0 end) as h_Perd, 
		coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0) as aj_ext,
		hTeo.hProdTotal,
		fp_sequencia,
		(case when e_fp_id = fp_Func.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.ferias,0) else 0.0 end) as ferias,
		fp_id
	from 
		of_fp as fp_Func
		left join offp_eq as eq on fp_Func.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id-- and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join entidade on eq.offpeq_e_id = e_id
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fp_Func.offp_offp_id_return = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id and eqResp.offpeq_chefe = eq.offpeq_chefe
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fp_Func.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		outer apply (select 
						count(offp_id) as ids,
						offp_offp_id_return as id_Pai,
						offp_fp_id as fase_Id,
						sum(dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.offp_datainicio, f.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p.p_nome)*0.5)) as tempo
					from 
						of_fp as f
						left join offp_eq as e on f.offp_id = e.offpeq_offp_id and e.offpeq_chefe = 1
						left join offp_eq as e1 on f.offp_id = e1.offpeq_offp_id and e1.offpeq_chefe = 0
						inner join ordemfabrico as o on f.offp_of_id = o.of_id
						inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id
					where
						fp_Func.offp_id = f.offp_offp_id_return 
						and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e.offpeq_e_id ,0)
						and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e1.offpeq_e_id ,0)
						and f.offp_fp_id = fp_Func.offp_fp_id
					group by 
						offp_offp_id_return, offp_fp_id) as retProv
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		left join (select 
						movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, SUM(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas 
					from 
						dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@i as date), cast(@f as date),null) 
					group by 
						movent_eId) as eMovs on e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_V2(cast(@i as date), cast(@f as date)) as hTeo on e_id = hTeo.eid
		inner join fases_producao on fp_Func.OFFP_FP_ID = fp_id --e_fp_id = fp_id
	where 
		cast(fp_Func.offp_datafim as date) between @i and @f
		--and e_fp_id = fp_Func.offp_fp_id
		and fp_Func.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38))
	group by
		fp_nome,
		e_id,
		e_nome,
		offp_fp_id,
		e_fp_id,
		eMovs.faltas,
		eMovs.hExtra,
		eMovs.hAjuda,
		eMovs.hPerdidas,
		hTeo.hProdTotal,
		fp_sequencia,
		eMovs.ferias,
		fp_id
	order by 
		fp_sequencia,
		e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Pesos_DiaDia`(@data smalldatetime, @dataf smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-01-17 13:38* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `v_of`, `producao`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Pesos_DiaDia]

@data smalldatetime,
@dataf smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		offp_datafim, of_id as [OF], 
		p.p_id, 
		p.p_nome as Modelo,
		(select p_nome from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_of_id = of_id and p_tp_id = 84) as Const,
		p.p_pesolam, 
		desm.peso, 
		coalesce(pa.peso,0) as peso_pa, 
		coalesce(lix.peso,lm.pesoAc) as peso_lix, 
		p.p_pesoacab as Ideal, 
		coalesce(offp_peso, 0) as Peso, 
		coalesce(offp_peso, 0) - p.p_pesoacab as dif_Peso, 
		lm.lam_id as lam_id, 
		coalesce(pa.pintA,'') as pintAc, 
		coalesce(lm.lam,'') + '/' + coalesce(lx.lam,'') as Laminador, 
		'', 
		lami.lam as lamin,
		(case when p.p_pesoacab - coalesce(offp_peso, 0) > 0.25 then 'Peso Reduzido' when p.p_pesoacab - coalesce(offp_peso, 0) < -0.25 then 'Peso Excedido' else 'Peso Ok' end) as descr, 
		of_desconta_peso, 
		of_observacoes, 
		p.p_dif_ideal_pa_d, 
		p.p_dif_ideal_pa_lx, 
		p.p_dif_ideal_lx_acab, 
		pa.coefPA, 
		lm.coefAc, 
		lx.coefLx,
		case when IdConstrucao is null then 0 else 1 end ConstrucaoAlterada
	from
		ordemfabrico o
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
		left join movimento as m on of_id = m.mov_of_id and m.mov_p_id in (21399,20448,27484) 
		left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id 
		left join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id and p1.p_tp_id = 84
		left join produto_componente as c on p.p_id = c.comp_p_id and c.comp_p_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 84)
		left join produto_componente as c1 on c.comp_p_p_id = c1.comp_p_id and c1.comp_p_p_id  in (21399,20448,27484) 
		
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id as id, e_id as pa_id, e_nome as pintA, offp_peso as peso, 
			((case when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + offp_coeficiente) as coefPA
			from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
			where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_return = 0 and offp_of_id = o.OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as pa-- on of_id = pa.id 
		
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id as id, e_id as lam_id, e_nome as lam, offp_peso as pesoAc, 
			((case when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + offp_coeficiente) as coefAc
			from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
			where offp_fp_id = 33 and offp_return = 0 and offp_of_id = o.OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as lm --on of_id = lm.id 
		
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id as id, e_id as lam_id, e_nome as lam, 
			((case when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + offp_coeficiente) as coefLx
			from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
			where offp_fp_id = 22 and offp_return = 0 and offp_of_id = o.OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as lx --on of_id = lx.id 
		
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id as id, e_id as lam_id, e_nome as lam
			from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
			where offp_fp_id = 1 and offp_return = 0 and offp_of_id = o.OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as lami --on of_id = lami.id 
		
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id, offp_peso as peso from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 6 and offp_peso > 0 and offp_return = 0 and offp_of_id = o.OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as desm --on of_id = desm.offp_of_id 
		
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id, offp_peso as peso from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 22 and offp_peso > 0 and offp_return = 0 and offp_of_id = o.OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as lix --on of_id = lix.offp_of_id
		outer apply (select top 1 j.IdConstrucao from dbo.of_AlteracoesConstrucao(o.of_id) j) z
	where 
		cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@data as date) and cast(@dataf as date) 
		and offp_fp_id = 8 
		and offp_return = 0
		and of_id < 10000000 and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
	order by Laminador

 --   select 
	--	offp_datafim, of_id as [OF], p.p_id, p.p_nome as Modelo,

	--	p.p_dif_ideal_pa_d, p.p_dif_ideal_pa_lx, p.p_dif_ideal_lx_acab, pa.coefPA, lm.coefAc, lx.coefLx
```

#### `dbo.Report_PesosMedios`(@modelo nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-01-17 11:46* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_PesosMedios]

@modelo nvarchar(max)

as

begin transaction

	select 
		p_id, p_nome, tp_nome,
		p_pesolam,
		lam.pesoLam as avgLam,
		p_pesoacab,
		acab.pesoAcab as avgAcab
	from 
		produto 
		inner join ordemfabrico on p_id = of_p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id=tp_id 
		inner join (select of_p_id, round(avg(offp_peso),2) as pesoLam from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id where offp_fp_id=6 and offp_peso<>0 group by of_p_id) as lam on lam.of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join (select of_p_id, round(avg(offp_peso),2) as pesoAcab from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id where offp_fp_id=8 and offp_peso<>0 group by of_p_id) as acab on acab.of_p_id = p_id
	where 
		/*tp_id = 1 
		or tp_tp_id = 1 
		and*/ p_nome like '%' + @modelo + '%' 
		and P_TP_ID in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1))
	group by 
		p_id, p_nome, tp_nome, p_pesolam, lam.pesoLam, p_pesoacab, acab.pesoAcab 
	order by 
		p_nome

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_PesosMedios_Detalhe`(@modelo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_PesosMedios_Detalhe]

@modelo int

as

begin transaction

select of_id, of_datainicio, p_nome, tp_nome,offp.offp_peso as p_pesolam,offp_A.offp_peso as p_pesoacab
from produto inner join ordemfabrico on p_id = of_p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id=tp_id inner join of_fp as offp on of_id = offp.offp_of_id and offp.offp_fp_id = 6 and offp.offp_peso<>0
	 inner join of_fp as offp_A on of_id = offp_A.offp_of_id and offp_A.offp_fp_id = 8 and offp_A.offp_peso<>0
where tp_id = 1 or tp_tp_id = 1 and p_id = @modelo order by p_nome

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.report_PHC_Facturacao_Clientes`(@preco_upd bit, @filtrar bit, @dI smalldatetime, @dF smalldatetime, @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 11:47* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[report_PHC_Facturacao_Clientes] 
	
	@preco_upd bit = 0,
	@filtrar bit,
	@dI smalldatetime,
	@dF smalldatetime,
	@e_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @preco_upd = 1
	begin
		declare @t table (id int, preco float)

		if @filtrar = 1
		begin
		insert into @t (id, preco) (select distinct p_id, [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(p_id, fdata) 
			from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.produto on ref = substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.ftstamp = ft.ftstamp
			where fi.nmdoc in ('Factura', 'Nota de crédito') and ft.no = @e_id and ft.fdata between @dI and @dF and ft.anulado = 0)

		select ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata as ousrdata, fi.ref, fi.design, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then fi.qtt * -1 else fi.qtt end)) as qtt, t.preco as p_precocusto, fi.esltt/sum(fi.qtt) as esltt, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then -1 else 1 end)) * fi.esltt as total 
		from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.produto on ref = substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
			inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.ftstamp = ft.ftstamp inner join @t as t on p_id = id
		where fi.nmdoc in ('Factura', 'Nota de crédito') and ft.no = @e_id and ft.fdata between @dI and @dF and ft.anulado = 0
		group by ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata, fi.ref, fi.design, fi.esltt, t.preco
		end
		else
		begin
		insert into @t (id, preco) (select distinct p_id, [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(p_id, fdata) 
			from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.produto on ref = substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
				inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.ftstamp = ft.ftstamp
			where fi.nmdoc in ('Factura', 'Nota de crédito') and ft.fdata between @dI and @dF and ft.anulado = 0)

		select ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata as ousrdata, fi.ref, fi.design, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then fi.qtt * -1 else fi.qtt end)) as qtt, t.preco as p_precocusto, fi.esltt/sum(fi.qtt) as esltt, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then -1 else 1 end)) * fi.esltt as total 
		from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.produto on ref = substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
			inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.ftstamp = ft.ftstamp inner join @t as t on p_id = id
		where fi.nmdoc in ('Factura', 'Nota de crédito') and ft.fdata between @dI and @dF and ft.anulado = 0
		group by ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata, fi.ref, fi.design, fi.esltt, t.preco
		end
	end
	else
	begin
		if @filtrar = 1
		begin
		select ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata as ousrdata, fi.ref, fi.design, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then fi.qtt * -1 else fi.qtt end)) as qtt, p_preco_temp as p_precocusto, fi.esltt/sum(fi.qtt) as esltt, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then -1 else 1 end)) * fi.esltt as total 
		from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.produto on ref = substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
			inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.ftstamp = ft.ftstamp
		where fi.nmdoc in ('Factura', 'Nota de crédito') and ft.no = @e_id and ft.fdata between @dI and @dF and ft.anulado = 0
		group by ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata, fi.ref, fi.design, fi.esltt, p_preco_temp
		end
		else
		begin
		select ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata as ousrdata, fi.ref, fi.design, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then fi.qtt * -1 else fi.qtt end)) as qtt, p_preco_temp as p_precocusto, fi.esltt/sum(fi.qtt) as esltt, sum((case when fi.nmdoc = 'Nota de crédito' then -1 else 1 end)) * fi.esltt as total 
		from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].dbo.produto on ref = substring(p_nome,0, Charindex(' ', p_nome,0)) + reverse(substring(reverse(p_nome),0, Charindex(' ', reverse(p_nome),0))) + '-' + convert(nvarchar(max),p_id) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS
			inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.ftstamp = ft.ftstamp
		where fi.nmdoc in ('Factura', 'Nota de crédito') and ft.fdata between @dI and @dF and ft.anulado = 0
		group by ft.nome, fi.nmdoc, fi.fno, ft.fdata, fi.ref, fi.design, fi.esltt, p_preco_temp
		end
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Pintor`()

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Pintor]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (datepart(hh, getdate()) >= 12 and datepart(hh, getdate()) <= 17)
    select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		p1.p_nome as cdeck,
		p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		o.of_observacoes,
		convert(varchar(10), o.of_datainicio, 105) as of_datainicio,
		turn_nome,
		e_nome,
		o1.of_nome,
		(select p3.p_nome from produto as p3 inner join movimento on p3.p_id = mov_p_id where p3.p_tp_id = 10 and mov_of_id = o.of_id) as banco,
		o.of_arm_id
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id inner join
		produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join
		produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id inner join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 18 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join
		turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id
	where
		(convert(varchar(10), o.of_datainicio, 105) = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 105) and
		o.of_turn_id = 3) or 
		(convert(varchar(10), o.of_datainicio, 105) = convert(varchar(10), dateadd(dd, 1, getdate()), 105) and
		o.of_turn_id in (1,2))
	order by
		o.of_datainicio,
		o.of_turn_id
else if (datepart(hh, getdate()) < 12)
    select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		p1.p_nome as cdeck,
		p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		o.of_observacoes,
		convert(varchar(10), o.of_datainicio, 105) as of_datainicio,
		turn_nome,
		e_nome,
		o1.of_nome,
		(select p3.p_nome from produto as p3 inner join movimento on p3.p_id = mov_p_id where p3.p_tp_id = 10 and mov_of_id = o.of_id) as banco,
		o.of_arm_id
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id inner join
		produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join
		produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id inner join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 18 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join
		turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id
	where
		(convert(varchar(10), o.of_datainicio, 105) = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 105) and
		o.of_turn_id in (2,3)) or 
		(convert(varchar(10), o.of_datainicio, 105) = convert(varchar(10), dateadd(dd, 1, getdate()), 105) and
		o.of_turn_id = 1)
	order by
		o.of_datainicio,
		o.of_turn_id
else if (datepart(hh, getdate()) > 17)
	select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		p1.p_nome as cdeck,
		p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		o.of_observacoes,
		convert(varchar(10), o.of_datainicio, 105) as of_datainicio,
		turn_nome,
		e_nome,
		o1.of_nome,
		(select p3.p_nome from produto as p3 inner join movimento on p3.p_id = mov_p_id where p3.p_tp_id = 10 and mov_of_id = o.of_id) as banco,
		o.of_arm_id
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id inner join
		produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join
		produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id inner join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 18 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id inner join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join
		turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id
	where

	order by

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Pintor_Data`(@dt date, @pecas bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-10-18 09:39* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Pintor_Data]

@dt date,
@pecas bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	if @pecas = 0
		select 
			o.of_id,
			p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ' Cliente: ' + cl.E_NOME as p_nome,
			p.P_ID as ProdutoId,
			p.P_QTDDECK as QtdIdealGelDeck,
```
