```sql
			p.P_QTDCASCO as QtdIdealGelCasco,		
			dbo.of_Cores(o.of_id,0) as cores,
			o.of_observacoes,
			cast(fp1.offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio,
			turn_nome,
			ent.e_nome,
			a1.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador1id,
			a2.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador2id,
			o1.of_nome,
			fp1.offp_of_id_mld as MoldeId,
			(select top 1 p3.p_nome from produto as p3 inner join movimento on p3.p_id = mov_p_id where p3.p_tp_id = 10 and mov_of_id = o.of_id and mov_atrib_id = 9) as banco,
			o.of_arm_id, o.of_p_id_cdeck, o.of_p_id_ccasco, o.of_p_id_gola, o.of_p_id_lateral_fr, o.of_p_id_lateral_tr, o.of_p_id_quinas, o.of_p_id_quinas_tr, o.of_p_id_topo_fr, o.of_p_id_topo_tr,
			p.p_qtddeck + p.p_qtdcasco as qtdGel,
			p.P_QTDDECK_REAL as QtdIdealGelDeckReal,
			p.P_QTDCASCO_REAL as QtdIdealGelCascoReal,
			dbo.of_Fibras(o.of_id) as Fibras,
			o.of_turn_id,
			P_QTDDECK_REAL_UPD,
			P_QTDCASCO_REAL_UPD,
			o.OF_PARAPINTARFORA
		from
			ordemfabrico as o 
			inner join entidade cl on OF_E_ID_ENC = cl.E_ID 
			inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id 
			inner join of_fp as fp on of_id = fp.offp_of_id and fp.offp_fp_id = 18 
			left join offp_eq as a1 on fp.offp_id = a1.offpeq_offp_id and a1.offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join offp_eq as a2 on fp.offp_id = a2.offpeq_offp_id and a2.offpeq_chefe = 0 
			left join entidade ent on a1.offpeq_e_id = ent.e_id 
			inner join of_fp as fp1 on of_id = fp1.offp_of_id and fp1.offp_fp_id in (1,67)
			inner join ordemfabrico as o1 on fp1.offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id 
			inner join turno on fp1.offp_turn_id = turn_id
			left join produto_camada_tipo on fp1.offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id 
		where
			cast(fp1.offp_data_prevista as date) = @dt
			and fp1.offp_turn_id is not null
			and o.of_id < 10000000
		union
		select 
			o.of_id,
			p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ' Cliente: ' + cl.E_NOME as p_nome,
			p.P_ID as ProdutoId,
			p.P_QTDDECK as QtdIdealGelDeck,
			p.P_QTDCASCO as QtdIdealGelCasco,		
			dbo.of_Cores(o.of_id,0) as cores,
			o.of_observacoes,
			cast(fp1.offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio,
			turn_nome,
			ent.e_nome,
			a1.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador1id,
			a2.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador2id,
			'' of_nome,
			fp1.offp_of_id_mld as MoldeId,
			(select top 1 p3.p_nome from produto as p3 inner join movimento on p3.p_id = mov_p_id where p3.p_tp_id = 10 and mov_of_id = o.of_id and mov_atrib_id = 9) as banco,
			o.of_arm_id, o.of_p_id_cdeck, o.of_p_id_ccasco, o.of_p_id_gola, o.of_p_id_lateral_fr, o.of_p_id_lateral_tr, o.of_p_id_quinas, o.of_p_id_quinas_tr, o.of_p_id_topo_fr, o.of_p_id_topo_tr,
			p.p_qtddeck + p.p_qtdcasco as qtdGel,
			p.P_QTDDECK_REAL as QtdIdealGelDeckReal,
			p.P_QTDCASCO_REAL as QtdIdealGelCascoReal,
			dbo.of_Fibras(o.of_id) as Fibras,
			o.of_turn_id,
			P_QTDDECK_REAL_UPD,
			P_QTDCASCO_REAL_UPD,
			o.OF_PARAPINTARFORA
		from
			ordemfabrico as o 
			inner join entidade cl on OF_E_ID_ENC = cl.E_ID 
			inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id 
			left join of_fp as fp on of_id = fp.offp_of_id and fp.offp_fp_id = 18 
			left join offp_eq as a1 on fp.offp_id = a1.offpeq_offp_id and a1.offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join offp_eq as a2 on fp.offp_id = a2.offpeq_offp_id and a2.offpeq_chefe = 0 
			left join entidade ent on a1.offpeq_e_id = ent.e_id 
			inner join of_fp as fp1 on of_id = fp1.offp_of_id and fp1.offp_fp_id in (1,67)
			inner join turno on fp1.offp_turn_id = turn_id
			left join produto_camada_tipo on fp1.offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id 
		where
			cast(fp1.offp_data_prevista as date) = @dt
			and fp1.offp_turn_id is not null
			and o.of_id between 70000 and 89999
		order by
			cast(fp1.offp_data_prevista as date),
			o.of_turn_id
	else
		select 
			o.of_id,
			p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + ' Cliente: ' + cl.E_NOME as p_nome,
			p.P_ID as ProdutoId,
			p.P_QTDDECK as QtdIdealGelDeck,
			p.P_QTDCASCO as QtdIdealGelCasco,		
			dbo.of_Cores(o.of_id,0) as cores,
			o.of_observacoes,
			cast(fp1.offp_data_prevista as date) as of_datainicio,
			turn_nome,
			ent.e_nome,
			a1.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador1id,
			a2.OFFPEQ_E_ID as Operador2id,
			o1.of_nome,
			fp1.offp_of_id_mld as MoldeId,
			(select top 1 p3.p_nome from produto as p3 inner join movimento on p3.p_id = mov_p_id where p3.p_tp_id = 10 and mov_of_id = o.of_id and mov_atrib_id = 9) as banco,
			o.of_arm_id, o.of_p_id_cdeck, o.of_p_id_ccasco, o.of_p_id_gola, o.of_p_id_lateral_fr, o.of_p_id_lateral_tr, o.of_p_id_quinas, o.of_p_id_quinas_tr, o.of_p_id_topo_fr, o.of_p_id_topo_tr,
			p.p_qtddeck + p.p_qtdcasco as qtdGel,
			p.P_QTDDECK_REAL as QtdIdealGelDeckReal,
			p.P_QTDCASCO_REAL as QtdIdealGelCascoReal,
			o.OF_PARAPINTARFORA
		from
			ordemfabrico as o 
			inner join entidade cl on OF_E_ID_ENC = cl.E_ID 
			inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id 
			left join of_fp as fp on of_id = fp.offp_of_id and fp.offp_fp_id = 18 
			left join offp_eq as a1 on fp.offp_id = a1.offpeq_offp_id and a1.offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join offp_eq as a2 on fp.offp_id = a2.offpeq_offp_id and a2.offpeq_chefe = 0 
			left join entidade ent on a1.offpeq_e_id = ent.e_id 
			inner join of_fp as fp1 on of_id = fp1.offp_of_id and fp1.offp_fp_id in (1,36)
			left join ordemfabrico as o1 on fp1.offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id 
			left join turno on fp1.offp_turn_id = turn_id
			left join produto_camada_tipo on fp1.offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id 
		where
			cast(fp1.offp_data_prevista as date) = @dt and o.of_id > 10000000
			and fp1.offp_of_id_mld is not null
			and fp1.offp_turn_id is not null
		order by
			fp1.offp_data_prevista,
			o.of_turn_id
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PlanoLaminagem`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_PlanoLaminagem]

as

begin transaction

select
	p.p_nome,
	p1.p_nome as of_cordeck,
	p2.p_nome as of_corcasco,
	o.of_id,
	e1.e_nome as emp_primeironome,
	e.e_nome as cl_nome,
	o1.of_nome,
	o.of_turn_id,
	datepart(ww,o.of_datainicio) as semana,
	datepart(dw,o.of_datainicio) as dia,
	datepart(yy,o.of_datainicio) as ano
from
	ordemfabrico as o inner join
	produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id left join
	produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join 
	produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join 
	entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join
	of_fp on o.of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 1 inner join 
	offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
	entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id inner join
	ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id
where 
	year(o.of_datainicio) = year(getdate()) and
	datepart(ww,o.of_datainicio) between datepart(ww,getdate()) and datepart(ww,getdate()) + 1 and
	o.of_of_id_mld is not null

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_Precos_de_Custo_OFs`(@of_id int, @tipo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-02 15:31* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Precos_de_Custo_OFs]

@of_id int,
@tipo int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	declare @data smalldatetime, @modelo nvarchar(max), @fact float, @dataFim smalldatetime
	select @data = coalesce(of_datainicio, of_data), @modelo = p_nome, @dataFim = coalesce(of_datafim, of_datainicio, of_data) from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id;

	-- @fact em 27/05/2011 foi 1.15 para custos das OFs para a KPMG
	-- @fact em 31/05/2011 foi 1.15 para custos das Matrizes

	set @fact = 1

	declare @t table
	(tp_nome nvarchar(max), p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, p_nome nvarchar(max), p_medida nvarchar(max), mov_quantidade float, pai nvarchar(max), pai_nome nvarchar(max), 
		fp_nome nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, data_mov smalldatetime, data_entrada smalldatetime, preco_a_data float, fornc_a_data nvarchar(max),nivel int);

	declare @counter int
	set @counter = 1

	insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	(select tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id),''), 
			p.p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
		m.mov_quantidade * (case when p.p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), 
		convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) as pai, p1.p_nome, fp_nome, 
		(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 and m.mov_precounitario = 0 then p.p_precocusto when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else m.mov_precounitario end) as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, @counter
	from produto as p inner join movimento as m on p.p_id = m.mov_p_id
			left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id left join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id
			inner join produto_tipo on p.p_tp_id = tp_id left join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where m.mov_of_id = @of_id and m.mov_acessorio_adicional = 0 and p.p_tp_id <> 81 and (p1.P_TP_ID is null or p1.P_TP_ID <> 81))
	
	while @@rowcount > 0
	begin
		set @counter = @counter + 1

		insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
		(select pt.tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),comp_p_p_id) + t.p_id, comp_p_p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
			comp_quantidade * (case when p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), 
			t.p_id, t.p_nome, 
			convert(nvarchar(max),''), (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 then p.p_precocusto else 0 end) as p_precocusto, comp_tpcomp_id, t.nivel + 1
		from @t as t inner join produto_componente on t.p_id_ant = comp_p_id and t.p_id_ant not in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 84)
			inner join produto as p on comp_p_p_id = p.p_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
			inner join produto_tipo as pt on p.p_tp_id = pt.tp_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 2 and nivel = @counter - 1)
	end

	declare @interno bit = (select p_fabricointerno from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id)

	update @t set data_mov = dt, data_entrada = mov_datasaida, preco_a_data = coalesce(x.precoData, p.p_precocusto), fornc_a_data = e_nome 
	from @t as t 
		outer apply (select top 1 MOV_PRECOUNITARIO as precoData, mov_datasaida, mov_e_id, mov_data dt from movimento where MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 and MOV_DATA <= @data and MOV_P_ID = t.p_id_ant and mov_arm_id is not null and mov_e_id is not null and mov_datasaida is not null order by MOV_DATA desc) x
		--left join movimento on t.p_id_ant = mov_p_id 
		--left join (select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
		--		where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_data <= @data and mov_arm_id is not null and mov_e_id is not null and mov_datasaida is not null
		--		group by mov_p_id) as ult on mov_p_id = id and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1
		inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
		inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	where t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2) --and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_arm_id = 1

	declare @nivel int 
	set @nivel = (select max(nivel) from @t)

	while (@nivel > 1)
	begin
		update ts set ts.preco_a_data = (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.val end)
			from (select pai, sum(mov_quantidade * coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto)) as val 
				from @t where  nivel = @nivel and tpcomp = 2 group by pai) as t 
				inner join @t as ts on t.pai = ts.p_id 
				inner join produto as p on ts.p_id_ant = p.p_id
		where ts.nivel = @nivel - 1

		set @nivel = @nivel - 1
	end
	/***************************************************************************************************/

	declare @total float
	set @total = (select sum(mov_quantidade * coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto)) from @t where tpcomp = 1)

	if (@tipo = 1)
	begin
		select t.tp_nome, t.p_id, t.p_id_ant, t.p_nome, t.p_medida, t.mov_quantidade, t.pai, t.pai_nome, t.fp_nome, 
			(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, null),0) else t.p_precocusto end) as p_precocusto, 
			t.tpcomp, t.data_mov, 
			t.data_entrada, coalesce((case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.preco_a_data end), t.p_precocusto) as preco_a_data, t.fornc_a_data, t.nivel, @total as total, @modelo as modelo,
			(case when p.p_id = 22394 then isnull(dbo.co2_GGF_OF(dateadd(day, -(datepart(day,@data)-1), @data), dateadd(day, -(datepart(day,@datafim)-1), @datafim)), p.P_CO2) when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 and x.COMP_ID is null then -1 when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 and x.COMP_ID is not null then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p.p_id, null),0) else p.P_CO2 end) P_CO2, p_pesolam, p_fabricointerno
		from @t as t inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
			outer apply (select top 1 comp_id from produto_componente where comp_p_id = p.p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2) x
		--where p_precocusto > 0.0
		order by t.tpcomp, t.tp_nome, t.p_nome
	end
	else if (@tipo = 4)
	begin
		select t.tp_nome, t.p_id, t.p_id_ant, t.p_nome, t.p_medida, t.mov_quantidade, t.pai, t.pai_nome, t.fp_nome, 
			(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, null),0) else t.p_precocusto end) as p_precocusto, 
			t.tpcomp, t.data_mov, 
			t.data_entrada, coalesce((case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.preco_a_data end), t.p_precocusto) as preco_a_data, t.fornc_a_data, t.nivel, @total as total, @modelo as modelo, p.p_pcont_id
		from @t as t inner join produto as p on t.p_id = p.p_id
		where tpcomp = 1
		order by tpcomp, tp_nome, p_nome
	end
	else if (@tipo = 2)
	begin
		declare @t1 table
		(tp_nome nvarchar(max), p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, p_nome nvarchar(max), p_medida nvarchar(max), mov_quantidade float, pai nvarchar(max), pai_nome nvarchar(max), 
			fp_nome nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, data_mov smalldatetime, data_entrada smalldatetime, preco_a_data float, fornc_a_data nvarchar(max),nivel int);

		insert into @t1 (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, data_mov, data_entrada, preco_a_data, fornc_a_data, nivel)
		select tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, data_mov, 
			data_entrada, coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto) as preco_a_data, fornc_a_data, nivel
		from @t 
		where tpcomp = 1 and p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2)
		group by tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, data_mov, 
			data_entrada, coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto), fornc_a_data, nivel
		union all
		select t.tp_nome, t.p_id, t.p_id_ant, t.p_nome, t.p_medida, t.mov_quantidade * t1.mov_quantidade, t.pai, t.pai_nome, t.fp_nome, t.p_precocusto, t.tpcomp, t.data_mov, 
			t.data_entrada, coalesce(t.preco_a_data, t.p_precocusto) as preco_a_data, t.fornc_a_data, t.nivel
		from @t as t inner join @t as t1 on t.pai = t1.p_id 
		where t.tpcomp = 2 and t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2)
		group by t.tp_nome, t.p_id, t.p_id_ant, t.p_nome, t.p_medida, t.mov_quantidade * t1.mov_quantidade, t.pai, t.pai_nome, t.fp_nome, t.p_precocusto, t.tpcomp, t.data_mov, 
			t.data_entrada, coalesce(t.preco_a_data, t.p_precocusto), t.fornc_a_data, t.nivel

		--select * from @t1 order by tp_nome, p_nome

		select t.tp_nome, t.p_id_ant, t.p_nome, t.p_medida, sum(t.mov_quantidade) as mov_quantidade, coalesce((case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.preco_a_data end), t.p_precocusto) as preco_a_data, t.data_mov, 
			t.data_entrada, t.fornc_a_data, @total as total, @modelo as modelo 
		from @t1 as t inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id 
		where p.p_fabricointerno = 0  and data_mov is not null
		group by t.tp_nome, t.p_id_ant, t.p_nome, t.p_medida, t.data_mov, 
			t.data_entrada, coalesce((case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.preco_a_data end), t.p_precocusto), t.fornc_a_data
		order by t.tp_nome, t.p_nome
	end
	else if (@tipo = 3)
		select tot = @total

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Precos_OFs_M`(@tipo int, @fase int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Precos_OFs_M]

@tipo int,
@fase int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if (@fase > 0)
	select 
		of_id, of_nome, p.p_nome, fp_nome, of_data as of_datainicio, of_datafim, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_precounitario = 0 then p1.p_precocusto else mov_precounitario end))
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id left join produto as p1 on mov_p_id = p1.p_id and p1.p_tp_id <> 84
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where 
		p.p_tp_id = @tipo and of_fp_id = @fase and p1.p_tp_id not in (10,11,12,14,62,74,84)
	group by 
		of_id, of_nome, p.p_nome, fp_nome, of_data, of_datafim
	order by
		of_nome
else if (@fase = -1)
	select 
		of_id, of_nome, p.p_nome, fp_nome, of_data as of_datainicio, of_datafim, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_precounitario = 0 then p1.p_precocusto else mov_precounitario end))
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id left join produto as p1 on mov_p_id = p1.p_id and p1.p_tp_id <> 84
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where 
		p.p_tp_id = @tipo and p1.p_tp_id not in (10,11,12,14,62,74,84)
	group by 
		of_id, of_nome, p.p_nome, fp_nome, of_data, of_datafim
	order by
		of_nome
else if (@fase = -2)
	select 
		of_id, of_nome, p.p_nome, fp_nome, of_data as of_datainicio, of_datafim, sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_precounitario = 0 then p1.p_precocusto else mov_precounitario end))
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id left join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id left join produto as p1 on mov_p_id = p1.p_id and p1.p_tp_id <> 84
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where 
		p.p_tp_id = @tipo and of_fp_id <> 17 and p1.p_tp_id not in (10,11,12,14,62,74,84)
	group by 
		of_id, of_nome, p.p_nome, fp_nome, of_data, of_datafim
	order by
		of_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PrecosCusto`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-11 11:22* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PrecosCusto]

@p_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if (@p_id is null)
	begin

		with p (id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem) as
		(
			select tp.tp_id, tp.tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),''), convert(float,0.0), convert(float,0.0), convert(nvarchar(max),''), tp1.tp_id 
				from produto_tipo as tp left join produto_tipo as tp1 on tp.tp_tp_id = tp1.tp_id
			union all
			select p_id, p_nome, p_medida, (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else convert(float,p_precocusto) end) as p_precocusto, convert(float,1), tp_nome, id
					from p inner join produto on id = p_tp_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		)

		select *, 0 as p_stock, 0 as p_stockmin, 0 as p_qtdencomenda, 0 as consumido, 0 as p_necessidades from p order by nome

	end
	else
	begin

		if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id = @p_id) in (select tp_id from produto_tipo where tp_id in (1,82,83,84) or tp_tp_id in (1,82,83,84) or tp_tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1)) or tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1)))) -- Barcos, Moldes, Matrizes, Construções
		begin

			with p (id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem) as
			(
				select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when tp_id = 84 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_x(p_id, null) when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else convert(float,p_precocusto) end), convert(float,comp_quantidade), tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),'')
						from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1 
						inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
					where comp_p_id = @p_id and p_tp_id <> 84
				union all
				select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when tp_id = 84 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_x(p_id, null) when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else convert(float,p_precocusto) end), convert(float,comp_quantidade*qtd), tp_nome, nome
						from p inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join 
								produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1
						inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
			)

			select id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end) as p_stock, p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, coalesce(cons.qtdd,0) as consumido, isnull(zx.qtdNec,0) p_necessidades
				from 
					p inner join produto on id = p_id 
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(getdate()) group by mov_p_id) cons on p_id = cons.mov_p_id 
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id
					outer apply (select sum(quantidade) qtdNec from dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista(p_id)) zx
				--group by 
				--	id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end), p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, p_necessidades
			union all
			select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, convert(float,dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_x(p_id, null)), convert(float,comp_quantidade), tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),''), 0 as p_stock, 0 as p_stockmin, 0 as p_qtdencomenda, 0 as consumido, 0 as p_necessidades
				from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
						left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
					where comp_p_id = @p_id and p_tp_id = 84

		end
		else
		begin

			with p (id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem) as
			(
				select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else convert(float,p_precocusto) end) as p_precocusto, convert(float,comp_quantidade), tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),'')
						from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 
						inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
					where comp_p_id = @p_id
				union all
				select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else convert(float,p_precocusto) end) as p_precocusto, convert(float,comp_quantidade*qtd), tp_nome, nome
						from p inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join 
								produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id and (comp_tpcomp_id = 2 or p_id = 22394)  /*Gastos gerais de fabrico*/ 
						inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
			)

			select id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end) as p_stock, p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, coalesce(sum(mov_quantidade),0) as consumido, isnull(zx.qtdNec,0) p_necessidades
				from 
					p 
					inner join produto on id = p_id 
					left join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id and mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(getdate())
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id
					outer apply (select sum(quantidade) qtdNec from dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista(p_id)) zx
				group by id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end), p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, zx.qtdNec

		end

	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PrecosCusto_Comparacao`(@produtos nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-02-27 15:18* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PrecosCusto_Comparacao]

@produtos nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;


CREATE TABLE #produtos
(
	prod int
)

if (Charindex(',', @produtos,2)>0)
begin
	insert into #produtos (prod) values (cast(Substring(@produtos,0,Charindex(',', @produtos,0)) as int))
	set @produtos=Substring(@produtos,Charindex(',', @produtos,2),len(@produtos))
end
else
begin
	insert into #produtos (prod) values (cast(@produtos as int))
end

while (len(@produtos)>2 and Charindex(',', @produtos,2)>0)
begin
	insert into #produtos (prod) values (cast(Substring(@produtos,2,Charindex(',', @produtos,2)-2) as int))
	set @produtos=Substring(@produtos,Charindex(',', @produtos,2),len(@produtos))
end

insert into #produtos (prod) values (cast(Substring(@produtos,2,len(@produtos)) as int));

with p (id, nome, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, co2) as
(
	select p2.p_id, p2.p_nome, convert(float,(case when p2.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p2.p_id, null),0) else p2.p_precocusto end)), convert(float,comp_quantidade), tp_nome, p1.P_NOME,
		(case when p2.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p2.p_id, null),0) else p2.P_CO2 * p2.P_PESOLAM end) * COMP_QUANTIDADE P_CO2
			from #produtos as p inner join produto as p1 on p.prod = p1.p_id inner join produto_componente on p1.p_id = comp_p_id inner join produto as p2 on comp_p_p_id = p2.p_id inner join produto_tipo on p2.p_tp_id = tp_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1
	union all
	select p_id, p_nome, convert(float,(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else p_precocusto end)), convert(float,comp_quantidade * qtd), tp_nome, origem,
		(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else P_CO2 * P_PESOLAM end) * COMP_QUANTIDADE * qtd P_CO2
			from p inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1
)

select tipo, id, nome, origem, sum(qtd) as qtd, preco, co2, null pai from p where tipo <> 'Construções' group by tipo, id, nome, origem, preco, co2
--union
--select tp_nome tipo, p_id id, p_nome nome, '', comp_quantidade, 0, p_co2, comp_p_id pai from produto inner join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id where comp_p_id in (select distinct id from p) and comp_tpcomp_id = 2

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PrecosCusto_M_Comparacao`(@produtos nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PrecosCusto_M_Comparacao]

@produtos nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON;


CREATE TABLE #produtos
(
	prod nvarchar(max)
)

if (Charindex(',', @produtos,2)>0)
begin
	insert into #produtos (prod) values (Substring(@produtos,0,Charindex(',', @produtos,0)))
	set @produtos=Substring(@produtos,Charindex(',', @produtos,2),len(@produtos))
end
else
begin
	insert into #produtos (prod) values (@produtos)
end

while (len(@produtos)>2 and Charindex(',', @produtos,2)>0)
begin
	insert into #produtos (prod) values (Substring(@produtos,2,Charindex(',', @produtos,2)-2))
	set @produtos=Substring(@produtos,Charindex(',', @produtos,2),len(@produtos))
end

insert into #produtos (prod) values (Substring(@produtos,2,len(@produtos)));


select tp_nome, p.p_nome, m.mov_quantidade, of_nome as pai, p.p_precocusto, p1.p_nome as modelo
	from produto as p inner join movimento as m on p.p_id = m.mov_p_id
		 inner join produto_tipo on p.p_tp_id = tp_id left join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id 
		 inner join #produtos on m.mov_of_id = convert(int,prod) inner join ordemfabrico on convert(int,prod) = of_id
		 inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id = p1.p_id
	where tp_id not in (10,11,12,14,62,74,84)
	order by fp_sequencia, tp_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Preformance_Individual_Ult3`(@e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-12-16 08:22 · modificado 2025-07-10 13:35* · 🔎 `producao`, `retorno`, `disciplina`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Preformance_Individual_Ult3] 
	@e_id int
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dataX date = '2025/02/01'

	declare @t_dts table(i date, f date, visto bit default 0)
	insert into @t_dts (i,f)
	select top 3 a.EOBS_DATA_INI, a.EOBS_DATA_FIM from ENTIDADE_OBS as a where a.EOBS_EOBSTP_ID = 23 and a.EOBS_E_ID = @e_id and a.EOBS_DATA_INI is not null and a.EOBS_DATA_FIM is not null and EOBS_DATA < @dataX order by a.EOBS_DATA desc

	declare @t table(dI date, dF date, barcos int, extPint float, extDesm float, coefs float, 
					rtns int, culpado int, tot float, totRet_New int, e_nome nvarchar(max), 
					e_id int, fp_id int, fp nvarchar(max), fp_sequencia int, faltas float, 
					h_Ext float, h_trb float, aj_ext float, h_Perdidas float, equipa int, 
					fp_hora_coef float, hProdTotal float, total_OFs int, total_Retornos int, total_RetornosCulpado int, 
					e_fp_id int, ret_Provocados int, tempo_a_descontar float, ferias float, temp float, 
					faseFunc nvarchar(max), seqFunc int, barcosComErros int, baixas float)

	declare @i date, @f date

	while exists (select * from @t_dts where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 @i = i, @f = f from @t_dts where visto = 0

		insert into @t (barcos, extPint, extDesm, coefs, rtns, culpado, tot, totRet_New, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp, fp_sequencia, faltas, h_Ext, h_trb, aj_ext, h_Perdidas, equipa, fp_hora_coef, hProdTotal, total_OFs, 
						total_Retornos, total_RetornosCulpado, e_fp_id, ret_Provocados, tempo_a_descontar, ferias, temp, faseFunc, seqFunc, barcosComErros, baixas)
		exec Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Agrup_Geral 2019, 54, @i, @f, ' 08:00', ' 17:00', @e_id

		update @t set dI = @i, dF = @f where dI is null and dF is null

		update @t_dts set visto = 1 where i = @i and f = @f
	end

	select 
		cast(av.EOBS_DATA as date) as Data_Avaliacao,
		E_ID, 
		E_NOME,
		FP_NOME as EmpFase,
		isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as n_OFs,
		isnull(perf.TotRet_Culpado, 0) as TotRet_Culpado,
		isnull(perf.barcosComErros,0) as OFs_ComErros,
		isnull(perf.absentismo, 0) as absentismo,
		isnull(descs.dif,0) as descontos_hExtra,
		isnull(perf.H_Saldo, 0) as Horas_Trabalhadas,
		isnull(perf.Saldo, 0) as Saldo_hProduzidas_hTrabalhadas,
		round(isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0),2) as Produtividade,
		--isnull(procDesc.processos,0) as processos_Disciplinares,
		e_fp_id, 
		it.EOBSITEM_DESCR,
		it.EOBSITEM_VALOR,
		case when E_FP_ID in (43,20,52,51,8,38,37) 
						or (E_FP_ID in (1,36,18,6,5) and isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) < 0.2)
				then null
			when E_FP_ID in (1,36,18,6)
				then case when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.barcosComErros, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float)  <= 0.1
								then 5
							when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.barcosComErros, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float)  <= 0.15
								then 4
							when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.barcosComErros, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float)  <= 0.2
								then 3
							when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.barcosComErros, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float)  <= 0.5
								then 2
							when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.barcosComErros, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float)  > 0.5
								then 3
							else 0
					end 
					-
					case when isnull(perf.absentismo, 0) > 0.05 
							then 1
							else 0
					end
					-
					case when cast(isnull(perf.TotRet_Culpado, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.TotRet_Culpado, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0.2
						then 1
						else 0
					end
			when E_FP_ID = 5
				then case when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.2 
								then 0
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.7 
								then 1
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.89
								then 2
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.95 
								then 3
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 1.1 
								then 4
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) > 1.1 
								then 5
					end
					-
					case when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.TotRet_Culpado, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) < 0.1
								then 0
							when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.TotRet_Culpado, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) <= 0.2
								then 1
							when  cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.TotRet_Culpado, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0.2
								then 2
					end
					-
					case when isnull(perf.absentismo, 0) > 0.05 
							then 1
							else 0
					end
			else
				case when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.2 
								then 0
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.7 
								then 1
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.89
								then 2
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 0.95 
								then 3
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) <= 1.1 
								then 4
							when isnull(perf.SaldoPercent, 0) > 1.1 
								then 5
					end
					-
					case when cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0 and cast(isnull(perf.TotRet_Culpado, 0) as float) / cast(isnull(perf.barcos, 0) as float) > 0.2
						then 1
						else 0
					end
					-
					case when isnull(perf.absentismo, 0) > 0.05 
							then 1
							else 0
					end
		end as nota_Quantitativa
		, av.EOBS_DATA_INI as periodoInicio
		, av.EOBS_DATA_FIM as periodoFim
		, ai.AITEM_OBS as descricaoItemAval
	from
		(select top 3 a.EOBS_ID, a.EOBS_DATA, a.EOBS_E_ID, a.EOBS_DATA_INI, a.EOBS_DATA_FIM, E_ID, E_FP_ID from ENTIDADE_OBS as a inner join ENTIDADE on EOBS_E_ID = E_ID where a.EOBS_EOBSTP_ID = 23 and a.EOBS_E_ID = @e_id and a.EOBS_DATA_INI is not null and a.EOBS_DATA_FIM is not null and EOBS_DATA < @dataX order by a.EOBS_DATA desc) as av
		inner join ENTIDADE_OBS_ITEM as it on av.EOBS_ID = it.EOBSITEM_EOBS_ID
		left join (select dI, dF, e_nome, --e_fp_id,
						t.e_id as eId,
						sum(t.barcos) as barcos,
						sum(t.culpado + t.ret_Provocados) as TotRet_Culpado,
						t.h_trb + t.h_Ext - t.faltas - t.baixas - t.ferias + t.h_Perdidas + t.aj_ext as H_Saldo,
						t.faltas / t.h_trb as absentismo,
						sum((case when t.fp_id = 40 then t.temp else t.fp_hora_coef * t.tot end) - t.tempo_a_descontar) - (t.h_trb + t.h_Ext - t.faltas - t.baixas - t.ferias + t.h_Perdidas + t.aj_ext) as Saldo,
						sum((case when t.fp_id = 40 then t.temp else t.fp_hora_coef * t.tot end) - t.tempo_a_descontar) / (t.h_trb + t.h_Ext - t.faltas - t.baixas - t.ferias + t.h_Perdidas + t.aj_ext) as SaldoPercent,
						sum(t.barcosComErros) as barcosComErros
					from 
						@t as t
					group by 
						dI, dF, e_id, e_nome, e_fp_id,
						t.e_id,
						t.h_trb + t.h_Ext - t.faltas - t.baixas - t.ferias + t.h_Perdidas + t.aj_ext,
						t.faltas / t.h_trb) as perf on E_ID = perf.eId and perf.dI = av.EOBS_DATA_INI and perf.dF = av.EOBS_DATA_FIM
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on e_fp_id = FP_ID
		outer apply (select movent_e_id, SUM(cast(datediff(HH,movent_data_i,movent_data_f) as float)) as dif from ENT_MOV where MOVENT_MET_ID = 1 and MOVENT_DATA_I between av.EOBS_DATA_INI and av.EOBS_DATA_FIM and MOVENT_E_ID = E_ID and movent_data_f < movent_data_i group by MOVENT_E_ID) as descs
		inner join AVALIACOES_ITEMS as ai on it.EOBSITEM_DESCR = ai.AITEM_DESCR
	where
		it.EOBSITEM_VALOR > 0
		and E_ID = @e_id
	order by 
		EOBS_DATA
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PreformanceSub`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PreformanceSub]
	@ano int,
	@semana int,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime, @hi1 nvarchar(max), @hf1 nvarchar(max), @a int, @s int
	set @di1 = @di
	set @df1 = @df
	set @hi1 = @hi
	set @hf1 = @hf
	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1
	--select @di, @df, datepart(weekday,@df), datepart(hh,@df)

	----declare @h_trb int = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and dateadd(dd,-1,@df)) + ((case when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) < 13 then datepart(hh,@df) when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) >= 13 then datepart(hh,@df) -1 else 8 end)-8)
	declare @h_trb int = (select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df1))
	
	--select @h_trb

	select sum((case when offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as Barcos, 
		sum((case when offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 then of_coeficiente + 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then of_coeficiente + 0.1 
			when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 then of_coeficiente + 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then of_coeficiente + 0.2
			when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 4 when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 8 else of_coeficiente end) + 
				(case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)) + (case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(rt.coef_Return,0) else 0 end) as coefs,
		sum((case when offp_return = 0 then 0 else 1 end)) as rtns, isnull(culpado,0) as culpado,
		fp_nome as fp,
		(case when e_fp_id <> offp_fp_id then '(*) ' + e_nome when e_chefe = 1 then e_nome else 'Ajudante: ' + e_nome end) as e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then coalesce(f.faltas,0) else 0 end) as faltas, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then coalesce(x.h_ext,0) else 0 end) as h_Ext, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
		coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) else isnull(perd_fase.h_perd,0) * -1 end) as h_Perdidas,
		coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
		fp_hora_coef
	from of_fp 
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id 
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as perd_tot on e_id = perd_tot.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, movent_fp_id,  
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and offp_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
		left join  (select Funcionario, Fase, sum(rtns) as rtns, sum(case when culpado = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as culpado, sum(coefs) as coef_Return from dbo.retornosFuncionario where cast(dataRep as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date) group by Funcionario, Fase) as rt on isnull(e_id,1) = isnull(Funcionario,1) and fp_id = Fase
	where offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
	group by 
		isnull(culpado,0), fp_nome, offp_fp_id, (case when e_fp_id <> offp_fp_id then '(*) ' + e_nome when e_chefe = 1 then e_nome else 'Ajudante: ' + e_nome end), e_id, e_fp_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0), coalesce(x.h_ext,0), coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), fp_hora_coef, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) else isnull(perd_fase.h_perd,0) * -1 end), rt.coef_Return
	union
	select 0 as Barcos, 0 as coefs, 
		0 as rtns, 0 as culpado, 
		fp_nome as fp,
		e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0) as faltas, coalesce(x.h_ext,0) as h_Ext, @h_trb as h_Trb, coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, 
		isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) as h_Perdidas, coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, fp_hora_coef
	from entidade_tipo inner join entidade on ent_id = e_ent_id and e_chefe = 1 inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as perd_tot on e_id = perd_tot.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, movent_fp_id,  
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and e_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
	where e_activo = 1 and e_id not in (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id where cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)/* and offp_return = 0*/) and e_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38))
	group by fp_nome, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, perd_tot.h_perd, perd_fase.h_perd, fp_sequencia, coalesce(f.faltas,0), coalesce(x.h_ext,0), coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), fp_hora_coef
	union
	select 0 as Barcos, 0 as coefs, 
		0 as rtns, 0 as culpado, 
		fp_nome as fp,
		'Ajudante: ' + e_nome as e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, sum(coalesce(f.faltas,0)) as faltas, sum(coalesce(x.h_ext,0)) as h_Ext, @h_trb as h_Trb, coalesce(aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, 
		isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) as h_Perdidas, coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, fp_hora_coef
	from entidade_tipo inner join entidade on ent_id = e_ent_id and e_activo = 1 and e_chefe = 0 inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as aj_ext 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 13 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as aj on e_id = aj.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, 
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id) as perd_tot on e_id = perd_tot.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, movent_fp_id,  
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di1 and @df1 group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and e_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
	where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38))
		and e_id not in (select distinct offpeq_e_id from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offpeq_chefe = 1 and cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
			and offp_return = 0 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)))
	group by fp_nome, fp_id, fp_sequencia, e_nome, perd_tot.h_perd, perd_fase.h_perd, e_id, coalesce(aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), fp_hora_coef
	order by fp, barcos desc, e_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PreformanceSub_V2`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @e_id int, @fp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-10-21 13:18* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`, `peso`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PreformanceSub_V2]
	@ano int = 0,
	@semana int = 0,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max),
	@e_id int = null,
	@fp_id int = null
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime, @hi1 nvarchar(max), @hf1 nvarchar(max), @a int, @s int
	set @di1 = @di
	set @df1 = @df
	set @hi1 = @hi
	set @hf1 = @hf
	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1
	--select @di, @df, datepart(weekday,@df), datepart(hh,@df)

	----declare @h_trb int = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and dateadd(dd,-1,@df)) + ((case when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) < 13 then datepart(hh,@df) when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) >= 13 then datepart(hh,@df) -1 else 8 end)-8)
	declare @h_trb int = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(@di1, @df1)
						--(select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						--from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df1))

	select fpMain.offp_id, of_id, 
		(case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as Barcos,
		(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end) as extPint,
		(case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) as extDesm,
		fpMain.offp_coeficiente as coefs,
		(fpMain.OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X * FP_HORA_COEF) / isnull(nFs.n,1.0) Valor,
		isnull(nFs.n,1.0) as nFunc,
		fpMain.offp_return as rtns,
		(case when eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0 else 1 end) as culpado,
		(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
		round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)
		else
		round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
				when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))
				else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
			* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
			+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
			+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3) end) as tot,
		func.e_nome, 
		func.e_id,
		fp_id,
		fp_nome as fp,
		fp_sequencia,
		(case when func.e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0) else 0 end) as faltas, 
		(case when func.e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0) else 0 end) as h_Ext, 
		(case when func.e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
		coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0) as aj_ext, 
		(case when func.e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) else isnull(eMovsFP.hPerdidas,0) * -1 end) as h_Perdidas,
		coalesce(func.e_e_id, func.e_id) as equipa, 
		fp_hora_coef,
		(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
		round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
				when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
			* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 4 else 0 end)
			+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
			+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3) * fp_hora_coef 
		else
		round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
				when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
				else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
			* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
			+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
			+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3) * fp_hora_coef end) as tempoTeorico,
		cast((case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as float) AS hProdTotal,
		fpMain.offp_observacoes,
		fpMain.offp_problemas,
		cl.e_nome as cliente,
		p_nome,
		of_referencia,
		count(distinct nBarcos.id) as barcosSimultaneos, fpMain.offp_datainicio as inicioFase,  fpMain.offp_datafim as fimFase, dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim) as minutosTrabalhados,
		0 as culpadoRetorno,
		isnull(PesoDesm, 0) PesoDesm, isnull(PesoAcab, 0) PesoAcab, P_PESOLAM PesoDesmIdeal, P_PESOACAB PesoAcabIdeal
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join (select 
						offpeq_e_id as eid, offp_id as id, offp_datainicio as dt 
					from 
						of_fp 
						inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id) as nBarcos on  nBarcos.dt between fpMain.offp_datainicio and fpMain.offp_datafim and eq.offpeq_e_id = nBarcos.eid
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id 			/* Chefe e Aj. retorno */
		left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		left join (select movent_eId, movent_fpId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId, movent_fpId) as eMovsFP on e_id = eMovsFP.movent_eId and fp_id = eMovsFP.movent_fpId
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo on e_id = hTeo.eid  
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo2 on e_id = hTeo2.eid 
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		inner join entidade as cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_peso PesoDesm from of_fp where offp_of_id = of_id and offp_fp_id = 6 order by offp_sequencia) desm  
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_peso PesoAcab from of_fp where offp_of_id = of_id and offp_fp_id = 8 order by offp_sequencia) acab 
	where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and of_id < 10000000 and
		fpMain.offp_fp_id = @fp_id  
		and (case when @e_id is null then 1 else func.e_id end) = (case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end)
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
	group by 
		fpMain.offp_id, of_id, fpMain.offp_return, fpMain.offp_coeficiente, fpMain.OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, of_pint_class, of_pint_class, of_pfora_class, fpMain.offp_fp_id, 
		fp_coef_extra, of_coeficiente_extra, eqResp.offpeq_e_id, fp_sequencia, func.e_nome, func.e_id, fp_id, fp_nome, func.e_fp_id, func.e_e_id, 
		fp_hora_coef, eMovs.faltas, eMovs.hExtra, eMovs.hPerdidas, eMovs.hAjuda, eMovsFP.hPerdidas, hTeo.hProdTotal, nFs.n, fpMain.offp_observacoes, fpMain.offp_problemas, cl.e_nome, p_nome, of_referencia,
		fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim, fp_retornos_por_tempo, hTeo2.hProdTotal,
		PesoDesm, PesoAcab, P_PESOLAM, P_PESOACAB --, fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim
	union
	select 
		fp_Ret.OFFP_ID, OF_ID, 1 as Barcos, 0 as extPint, 0 as extDesm, 
		fp_Ret.OFFP_COEFICIENTE as coefs, 
		(fp_Ret.OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X * FP_HORA_COEF) / (case when eq1Aj.OFFPEQ_E_ID is null then 1 else 2 end) Valor,
		(case when eq1Aj.OFFPEQ_E_ID is null then 1 else 2 end) as nFunc, 1 as rtns, 1 as culpado, fp_Ret.OFFP_COEFICIENTE as tot, '' as e_nome, null as e_id, @fp_id as fp_id,
		'' as fp, 1 as fp_sequencia, 0 as faltas, 0 as h_Ext, 0 as  h_Trb, 0 as aj_ext, 0 as h_Perdidas, null as equipa, 0 as fp_hora_coef, 0 as tempoTeorico, 0 as hProdTotal, '' as offp_observacoes, '' as offp_problemas, E_NOME as cliente, P_NOME, OF_REFERENCIA, 0 as barcosSimultaneos,
		fp_Ret.OFFP_DATAINICIO as inicioFase, fp_Ret.OFFP_DATAFIM as fimFase, DATEDIFF(n,fp_Ret.OFFP_DATAINICIO,fp_Ret.OFFP_DATAFIM) as minutosTrabalhados,
		1 as culpadoRetorno, 
		0, 0, 0, 0
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join ENTIDADE on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = p_id
		inner join OF_FP as fp on OF_ID = fp.OFFP_OF_ID
		inner join OF_FP as fp_Ret on fp.OFFP_ID = fp_Ret.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on fp_Ret.OFFP_FP_ID = fp_id
		left join OFFP_EQ as eq on fp.OFFP_ID = eq.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
		left join OFFP_EQ as eqAj on fp.OFFP_ID = eqAj.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqAj.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 0
		left join OFFP_EQ as eq1 on fp_Ret.OFFP_ID = eq1.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eq1.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
		left join OFFP_EQ as eq1Aj on fp_Ret.OFFP_ID = eq1Aj.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eq1Aj.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
	where
		fp.OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_id
		and fp_Ret.OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_id
		and (eq.OFFPEQ_E_ID = @e_id or eqAj.OFFPEQ_E_ID = @e_id)
		and eq1.OFFPEQ_E_ID <> @e_id
		and eq1Aj.OFFPEQ_E_ID <> @e_id
		and cast(fp_Ret.OFFP_DATAFIM as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
		and fp_Ret.OFFP_RETURN = 1
	order by of_id, fp_sequencia
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Agrup`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-11-07 13:03* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Agrup]
	@ano int,
	@semana int,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max),
	@e_id int = null
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime, @hi1 nvarchar(max), @hf1 nvarchar(max), @a int, @s int
	set @di1 = @di
	set @df1 = @df
	set @hi1 = @hi
	set @hf1 = @hf
	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1
	--select @di, @df, datepart(weekday,@df), datepart(hh,@df)

	----declare @h_trb int = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and dateadd(dd,-1,@df)) + ((case when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) < 13 then datepart(hh,@df) when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) >= 13 then datepart(hh,@df) -1 else 8 end)-8)
	declare @h_trb int = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(@di1, @df1)
						--(select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						--from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df1))
	
	select 
		0 as Barcos, 0 as extPint, 0 as extDesm, 0 as coefs, 0 as rtns, 0 as culpado, 0 as tot, 0 as totRet_New, '* Ajudas exterrnas *' as e_nome, 1 as e_id, movent_fpid as fp_id, fp_nome as fp, fp_sequencia, 0 as faltas, 0 as h_Ext, 0 as h_Trb, 0 as aj_ext, 
		sum(hPerdidas) * -1 as h_Perdidas,null as equipa, fp_hora_coef, 0 as hProdTotal, isnull(fpTot.ofs,0) as Total_OFs, isnull(fpTot.retornos,0) as Total_Retornos, isnull(fpTot.ret_culpado,0) as Total_RetCulpados, 0 as e_fp_id,
		0 as Ret_Provocados,
		0 as tempo_a_descontar,
		0 as ferias
	from 
		dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) inner join fases_producao on movent_fpid = fp_id
		left join dbo.fase_OFs_Retornos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as fpTot on fp_id = fpTot.fpid 
	where 
		fp_producao = 1
	group by 
		movent_fpId, fp_nome, fp_sequencia, fp_hora_coef,
		fpTot.ofs, fpTot.retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado
	union
	select sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end/*case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) else 0.0 end*/)) as Barcos,
			sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extPint,
			sum((case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extDesm,
			sum(fpMain.offp_coeficiente/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as coefs,
			sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as rtns,
			sum(case when eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0 else 1 end) as culpado,
			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) 
			else
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) end) as tot,
			sum(round(cast((case when (fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null) or fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3 )) as totRet_New,
			e_nome + (case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id and func.e_chefe = 0 then ' (ajudante)' when e_fp_id <> fpMain.offp_fp_id then ' (*)' else '' end) as e_nome, 
			e_id,
			fp_id,
			fp_nome as fp,
			fp_sequencia,
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0) else 0.0 end) as faltas,
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0) else 0.0 end) as h_Ext, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
			coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0) as aj_ext,
			 
			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo2.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
							when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
							else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
						* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
							when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
							when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
						+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
						+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo2.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.ferias,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end)
			else
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
						when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
						else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
					* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
						when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
						when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
					+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
					+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.ferias,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end) end) as h_Perdidas,
			coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
			fp_hora_coef, 
			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as hProdTotal, 
			fpTot.ofs as Total_OFs, 
			fpTot.retornos as Total_Retornos, 
			fpTot.ret_culpado as Total_RetCulpados, 
			e_fp_id,
			sum(isnull(retProv.ids,0)) as Ret_Provocados,
			sum(isnull(retProv.tempo,0)) as tempo_a_descontar, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.ferias,0) else 0.0 end) as ferias
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join offp_eq as eqResp1 on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp1.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp1.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		left join (select movent_eId, movent_fpId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId, movent_fpId) as eMovsFP on e_id = eMovsFP.movent_eId and fp_id = eMovsFP.movent_fpId
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo on e_id = hTeo.eid 
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo2 on e_id = hTeo2.eid 
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		inner join dbo.fase_OFs_Retornos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as fpTot on fp_id = fpTot.fpid 
		outer apply (select 
						count(offp_id) as ids,
						offp_offp_id_return as id_Pai,
						offp_fp_id as fase_Id,
```
