```sql
						--sum(dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.offp_datainicio, f.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p.p_nome)*0.5)) as tempo,
						sum(dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.offp_datainicio, f.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp.fp_hora_coef, 
																		0.5 * 
																		((case when fp.fp_coef_extra = 1 then o.of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + f.offp_coeficiente))) as tempo
					from 
						of_fp as f
						left join offp_eq as e on f.offp_id = e.offpeq_offp_id and e.offpeq_chefe = 1
						left join offp_eq as e1 on f.offp_id = e1.offpeq_offp_id and e1.offpeq_chefe = 0
						inner join ordemfabrico as o on f.offp_of_id = o.of_id
						inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id
						inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					where
						fpMain.offp_id = f.offp_offp_id_return 
						and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e.offpeq_e_id ,0)
						and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e1.offpeq_e_id ,0)
						and f.offp_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id
					group by 
						offp_offp_id_return, offp_fp_id) as retProv
	where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and
		fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
	group by 
		eMovs.faltas, eMovs.hExtra, eMovs.hPerdidas, eMovs.hAjuda, eMovsFP.hPerdidas, hTeo.hProdTotal, hTeo2.hProdTotal, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_nome, e_fp_id, e_e_id, fp_sequencia, fpMain.offp_fp_id, fp_hora_coef, func.e_chefe,
		fpTot.ofs, fpTot.retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado, e_fp_id, fp_retornos_por_tempo, eMovs.ferias
	order by fp_sequencia
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Agrup_Geral`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-28 14:21 · modificado 2020-12-14 14:06* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Agrup_Geral]
	@ano int,
	@semana int,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max),
	@e_id int = null
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime, @hi1 nvarchar(max), @hf1 nvarchar(max), @a int, @s int
	set @di1 = @di
	set @df1 = @df
	set @hi1 = @hi
	set @hf1 = @hf
	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1
	
	
	declare @h_trb int = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(@di1, @df1)
	
	select 
			sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as Barcos,
			sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extPint,	
			sum((case when fp_offp.fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extDesm,	
			sum(fpMain.offp_coeficiente/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as coefs,	
			sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 1 else 0 end) as rtns,	
			sum(case when eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0 else 1 end) as culpado,				
			(case 
				when fp_offp.fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 
					then sum(round(cast((case 
											when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null 
												then 0.0
											when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null 
												then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
											else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
										end) 
						* ((case 
								when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 
								when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 
								when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
								when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 
								when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
								when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 
								when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 
								when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 
								else 0 
							end)
						+ (case 
								when fp_offp.fp_coef_extra = 1 
									then of_coeficiente_extra 
								else 0 
							end)
						+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) 
				else
					sum(
					round(
					cast(
						(case 
							when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null 
								then 0.0
							when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null 
								then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_offp.fp_hora_coef, 
												0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
												((case 
													when fpMain.offp_return = 1 
														then 0 
													when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 
														then 0.25 
													when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
														then 0.1 
													when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 
														then 0.5 
													when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
														then 0.2
													when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 
														then 0.5 
													when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 
														then 1 
													when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 
														then 2 
													else 0 
												end)
												+ (case 
													when fp_offp.fp_coef_extra = 1 
														then of_coeficiente_extra 
													else 0 
												end) 
												+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
							else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
								* ((case 
										when fpMain.offp_return = 1 
											then 0 
										when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 
											then 0.25 
										when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
											then 0.1 
										when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 
											then 0.5 
										when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
											then 0.2
										when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 
											then 0.5 
										when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 
											then 1 
										when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 
											then 2 
										else 0 
									end)
								+ (case 
										when fp_offp.fp_coef_extra = 1 
											then of_coeficiente_extra 
										else 0 
									end)
								+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float
						),
						3)
						) 
			end) as tot,
				
				sum(round(cast((case when (fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null) or fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_offp.fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_offp.fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_offp.fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3 )) as totRet_New,
			e_nome,
			e_id,
			fp_offp.fp_id,
			fp_offp.fp_nome as fp,
			fp_offp.fp_sequencia,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) as faltas,
			isnull(eMovs.hExtra,0) as h_Ext, 
			@h_trb as h_Trb, 
			isnull(eMovs.hAjuda,0) as aj_ext,
			isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) as h_Perdidas,
			coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
			fp_offp.fp_hora_coef, 
			(case when fp_offp.fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as hProdTotal, 
			fpTot.ofs as Total_OFs, 
			fpTot.retornos as Total_Retornos, 
			fpTot.ret_culpado as Total_RetCulpados, 
			e_fp_id,
			sum(isnull(retProv.ids,0)) as Ret_Provocados,
			sum(isnull(retProv.tempo,0)) + ISNULL(chk.tempo,0) as tempo_a_descontar, 
			isnull(eMovs.ferias,0) as ferias,
			sum(
				case 
					when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id then 0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome)*(0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)))
				end
			) as temp,
			fp_e.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
			fp_e.FP_SEQUENCIA as seqFunc,
			isnull(chk.barcos,0) as barcosComErros, 
			isnull(eMovs.baixas,0) as baixas
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = p_id
		inner join fases_producao as fp_offp on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_offp.fp_id
		inner join fases_producao as fp_e on e_fp_id = fp_e.fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join offp_eq as eqResp1 on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp1.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp1.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		left join (select movent_eId, movent_fpId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId, movent_fpId) as eMovsFP on e_id = eMovsFP.movent_eId and fp_offp.fp_id = eMovsFP.movent_fpId
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo on e_id = hTeo.eid 
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo2 on e_id = hTeo2.eid 
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		inner join dbo.fase_OFs_Retornos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as fpTot on fp_offp.fp_id = fpTot.fpid 
		outer apply (select 
						count(offp_id) as ids,
						offp_offp_id_return as id_Pai,
						offp_fp_id as fase_Id,
						--sum(dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.offp_datainicio, f.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p.p_nome)*0.5)) as tempo,
						sum(dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.offp_datainicio, f.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), 
																		0.5 * 
																		((case when fp.fp_coef_extra = 1 then o.of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + f.offp_coeficiente)*fp.fp_hora_coef)) as tempo
					from 
						of_fp as f
						left join offp_eq as e on f.offp_id = e.offpeq_offp_id and e.offpeq_chefe = 1
						left join offp_eq as e1 on f.offp_id = e1.offpeq_offp_id and e1.offpeq_chefe = 0
						inner join ordemfabrico as o on f.offp_of_id = o.of_id
						inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id
						inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					where
						fpMain.offp_id = f.offp_offp_id_return 
						and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e.offpeq_e_id ,0)
						and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e1.offpeq_e_id ,0)
						and f.offp_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id
					group by 
						offp_offp_id_return, offp_fp_id) as retProv
		outer apply (select 
						e_id as eIdd,
						count(of_id) as barcos,
						sum(((a.ofch_gravidade)/3.0) * offp_coeficiente * FP_HORA_COEF) as tempo
					from 
						dbo.funcionario_Erros_Entre_DTs(func.e_id, cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as a
					where
						PLI_FP_ID = fpMain.offp_fp_id
						and PLI_FP_ID in (51,18,1,36,6)
					group by 
						e_id, 
						e_nome) as chk
	where 
		/*of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
		and*/ fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,37)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
		and (case when @e_id is null then 1 else func.E_ID end) = ISNULL(@e_id, 1)
		and of_id < 10000000
	group by 
		eMovs.faltas, eMovs.hExtra, eMovs.hPerdidas, eMovs.hAjuda, eMovsFP.hPerdidas, hTeo.hProdTotal, hTeo2.hProdTotal, e_nome, e_id, fp_offp.fp_id, fp_offp.fp_nome, e_fp_id, e_e_id, fp_offp.fp_sequencia, fpMain.offp_fp_id, fp_offp.fp_hora_coef, func.e_chefe,
		fpTot.ofs, fpTot.retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado, e_fp_id, fp_offp.fp_retornos_por_tempo, eMovs.ferias, fp_e.FP_NOME, fp_e.FP_SEQUENCIA, chk.tempo, chk.barcos, eMovs.baixas
	--order by e_nome, fp_sequencia
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Func`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @e_id int, @fp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-07-22 10:35* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PreformanceSub_V2_Func]
	@ano int,
	@semana int,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max),
	@e_id int = null,
	@fp_id int = null
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime, @hi1 nvarchar(max), @hf1 nvarchar(max), @a int, @s int
	set @di1 = @di
	set @df1 = @df
	set @hi1 = @hi
	set @hf1 = @hf
	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1
	--select @di, @df, datepart(weekday,@df), datepart(hh,@df)

	----declare @h_trb int = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and dateadd(dd,-1,@df)) + ((case when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) < 13 then datepart(hh,@df) when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) >= 13 then datepart(hh,@df) -1 else 8 end)-8)
	declare @h_trb int = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(@di1, @df1)
						--(select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						--from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df1))

	select sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end/*case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) else 0.0 end*/)) as Barcos,
			sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extPint,
			sum((case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extDesm,
			--sum(fpMain.offp_coeficiente/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as coefs,
			sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as rtns,
			sum(case when eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0 else 1 end) as culpado,

			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) 
			else
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) end) as tot,

			sum(round(cast((case when (fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null) or fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3 )) as totRet_New,
			e_nome + (case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id and func.e_chefe = 0 then ' (ajudante)' when e_fp_id <> fpMain.offp_fp_id then ' (*)' else '' end) as e_nome, 
			e_id,
			fp_id,
			fp_nome as fp,
			fp_sequencia,
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0) else 0 end) as faltas, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0) else 0 end) as h_Ext, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
			coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0) as aj_ext,

			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo2.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
							when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
							else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
						* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
							when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
							when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
						+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
						+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo2.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end)
			else
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
						when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
						else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
					* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
						when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
						when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
					+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
					+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end) end) as h_Perdidas,

			coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
			fp_hora_coef, (case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as hProdTotal, fpTot.ofs as Total_OFs, fpTot.retornos as Total_Retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado as Total_RetCulpados, e_fp_id,
			(fp_hora_coef * (case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) 
			else
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) end))/(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as percent_hTrab
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id 			/* Chefe e Aj. retorno */
		left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		left join (select movent_eId, movent_fpId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId, movent_fpId) as eMovsFP on e_id = eMovsFP.movent_eId and fp_id = eMovsFP.movent_fpId
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo on e_id = hTeo.eid 
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo2 on e_id = hTeo2.eid 
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		inner join dbo.fase_OFs_Retornos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as fpTot on fp_id = fpTot.fpid 
	where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and
		fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date) 
		and ((case when @e_id is null then 1 else e_id end) = isnull(@e_id,1) or (case when @e_id is null then 1 else e_e_id end) = isnull(@e_id,1))
		and (case when @fp_id is null then 1 else e_fp_id end) = isnull(@fp_id,1)
	group by 
		eMovs.faltas, eMovs.hExtra, eMovs.hPerdidas, eMovs.hAjuda, eMovsFP.hPerdidas, hTeo.hProdTotal, hTeo2.hProdTotal, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_nome, e_fp_id, e_e_id, fp_sequencia, fpMain.offp_fp_id, fp_hora_coef, func.e_chefe,
		fpTot.ofs, fpTot.retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado, e_fp_id, fp_retornos_por_tempo
	order by fp_sequencia
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_PreformanceSub_V3_Agrup`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_PreformanceSub_V3_Agrup]
	@ano int,
	@semana int,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime, @hi1 nvarchar(max), @hf1 nvarchar(max), @a int, @s int
	set @di1 = @di
	set @df1 = @df
	set @hi1 = @hi
	set @hf1 = @hf
	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1
	--select @di, @df, datepart(weekday,@df), datepart(hh,@df)

	----declare @h_trb int = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and dateadd(dd,-1,@df)) + ((case when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) < 13 then datepart(hh,@df) when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) >= 13 then datepart(hh,@df) -1 else 8 end)-8)
	declare @h_trb int = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(@di1, @df1)
						--(select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						--from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df1))
	
	select 
		0 as Barcos, 0 as extPint, 0 as extDesm, 0 as coefs, 0 as rtns, 0 as culpado, 0 as tot, 0 as totRet_New, '* Ajudas exterrnas *' as e_nome, 1 as e_id, movent_fpid as fp_id, fp_nome as fp, fp_sequencia, 0 as faltas, 0 as h_Ext, 0 as h_Trb, 0 as aj_ext, 
		sum(hPerdidas) * -1 as h_Perdidas,null as equipa, fp_hora_coef, 0 as hProdTotal, isnull(fpTot.ofs,0) as Total_OFs, isnull(fpTot.retornos,0) as Total_Retornos, isnull(fpTot.ret_culpado,0) as Total_RetCulpados, 0 as e_fp_id
	from 
		dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) inner join fases_producao on movent_fpid = fp_id
		left join dbo.fase_OFs_Retornos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as fpTot on fp_id = fpTot.fpid 
	where 
		fp_producao = 1
	group by 
		movent_fpId, fp_nome, fp_sequencia, fp_hora_coef,
		fpTot.ofs, fpTot.retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado
	union
	select sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as Barcos,
			0 as extPint,
			0 as extDesm,
			sum(dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as coefs,
			sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as rtns,
			sum(case when eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0 else 1 end) as culpado,
			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) 
			else
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) end) as tot,
			sum(round(cast((case when (fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null) or fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3 )) as totRet_New,
			e_nome + (case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id and func.e_chefe = 0 then ' (ajudante)' when e_fp_id <> fpMain.offp_fp_id then ' (*)' else '' end) as e_nome, 
			e_id,
			fp_id,
			fp_nome as fp,
			fp_sequencia,
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0) else 0.0 end) as faltas, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0) else 0.0 end) as h_Ext, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
			coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0) as aj_ext,
			 
			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo2.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
							when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
							else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
						* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
							when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
							when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
						+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
						+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo2.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end)
			else
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
						when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
						else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
					* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
						when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
						when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
					+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
					+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end) end) as h_Perdidas,

			coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
			fp_hora_coef, (case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as hProdTotal, fpTot.ofs as Total_OFs, fpTot.retornos as Total_Retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado as Total_RetCulpados, e_fp_id
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id 			/* Chefe e Aj. retorno */
		left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		left join (select movent_eId, movent_fpId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId, movent_fpId) as eMovsFP on e_id = eMovsFP.movent_eId and fp_id = eMovsFP.movent_fpId
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo on e_id = hTeo.eid 
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo2 on e_id = hTeo2.eid 
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		inner join dbo.fase_OFs_Retornos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as fpTot on fp_id = fpTot.fpid 
	where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and
		fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
	group by 
		eMovs.faltas, eMovs.hExtra, eMovs.hPerdidas, eMovs.hAjuda, eMovsFP.hPerdidas, hTeo.hProdTotal, hTeo2.hProdTotal, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_nome, e_fp_id, e_e_id, fp_sequencia, fpMain.offp_fp_id, fp_hora_coef, func.e_chefe,
		fpTot.ofs, fpTot.retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado, e_fp_id, fp_retornos_por_tempo
	order by fp_sequencia
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Preparador`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Preparador]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		o.of_id,
		p.p_nome,
		p1.p_nome as cdeck,
		p2.p_nome as ccasco,
		e.e_nome,
		o.of_observacoes,
		e1.e_nome as emp,
		o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome
	from
		ordemfabrico as o inner join
		produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id left join
		produto as p1 on o.of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join
		produto as p2 on o.of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id left join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 4 left join
		offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join 
		entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join
		ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join
		turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id left join
		entidade as e on o.of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join 
		fases_producao on o.of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		o.of_fp_id in (6,22) and (o.of_sequencia <> 99 or o.of_sequencia is null)
	order by 
		o.of_fp_id, o.of_id
		
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Producao_Facturacao`(@pais nvarchar(max), @tipo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 12:00* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Producao_Facturacao] 

@pais nvarchar(max),
@tipo int -- 1: Barcos; 2: Facturação

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @data_i smalldatetime, @data_f smalldatetime
	set @data_i = convert(nvarchar(max), (case when month(getdate()) > 9 then year(getdate()) else year(getdate())-1 end)) + '/10/01'
	set @data_f = convert(nvarchar(max), (case when month(getdate()) > 9 then year(getdate())+1 else year(getdate()) end)) + '/09/30'

	if @tipo = 1
		select distinct e_id, e_nome, isnull(epoca1.ofs,0) as ofs1, isnull(epoca2.ofs,0) as ofs2, isnull(epoca3.ofs,0) as ofs3, E_FACT_EPOCA
		from ENTIDADE left join 
			(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_DATAFIM between @data_i and @data_f group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca1 on E_ID = epoca1.id left join 
			(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year,-1,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-1,@data_f) group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca2 on E_ID = epoca2.id left join 
			(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year,-2,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-2,@data_f) group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca3 on E_ID = epoca3.id
		where E_PAIS = @pais and E_ACTIVO = 1 --and epoca1.ofs > 0
		group by e_id, e_nome, isnull(epoca1.ofs,0), isnull(epoca2.ofs,0), isnull(epoca3.ofs,0), E_FACT_EPOCA
	else if @tipo = 2
		select distinct e_id, e_nome, rtrim(ltrim(fact1.nome)) as nome, sum(isnull(fact1.TotalSemIva,0)) as tot1, sum(isnull(fact2.TotalSemIva,0)) as tot2, sum(isnull(fact3.TotalSemIva,0)) as tot3, E_FACT_EPOCA
		from ENTIDADE left join 
			(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_DATAFIM between @data_i and @data_f group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca1 on E_ID = epoca1.id left join 
			ENTIDADE_PHC on E_ID = EPHC_E_ID left join
			(select ft.no, cl.nome, round(convert(float,sum(ft.ettiliq)),2) as TotalSemIva from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.cl on ft.no = cl.no where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and ft.ousrdata between @data_i and @data_f group by ft.no, cl.nome) as fact1 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact1.no left join
			(select ft.no, cl.nome, round(convert(float,sum(ft.ettiliq)),2) as TotalSemIva from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.cl on ft.no = cl.no where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and ft.ousrdata between dateadd(year,-1,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-1,@data_f) group by ft.no, cl.nome) as fact2 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact2.no left join
			(select ft.no, cl.nome, round(convert(float,sum(ft.ettiliq)),2) as TotalSemIva from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.cl on ft.no = cl.no where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and ft.ousrdata between dateadd(year,-2,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-2,@data_f) group by ft.no, cl.nome) as fact3 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact3.no
		where E_PAIS = @pais and E_ACTIVO = 1 --and epoca1.ofs > 0
		group by e_id, e_nome, fact1.nome, isnull(epoca1.ofs,0), E_FACT_EPOCA

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Producao_Facturacao_Detalhe_Barcos`(@e_id int)
