```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Producao_Facturacao_Detalhe_Barcos]

@e_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @data_i smalldatetime, @data_f smalldatetime
	set @data_i = convert(nvarchar(max), (case when month(getdate()) > 9 then year(getdate()) else year(getdate())-1 end)) + '/10/01' --(case when month(getdate()) > 9 then convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())) + '/10/01' else convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())-1) + '/10/01' end)
	set @data_f = convert(nvarchar(max), (case when month(getdate()) > 9 then year(getdate())+1 else year(getdate()) end)) + '/09/30' --(case when month(getdate()) > 9 then convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())+1) + '/09/30' else convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())) + '/09/30' end)


	select distinct e_id, e_nome, '' as TP_NOME, isnull(epoca1.ofs,0) as ofs1, isnull(epoca1.coefs,0) as coefs1, isnull(epoca2.ofs,0) as ofs2, isnull(epoca2.coefs,0) as coefs2, isnull(epoca3.ofs,0) as ofs3, isnull(epoca3.coefs,0) as coefs3
	from ENTIDADE left join 
		(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs, sum(of_coeficiente) as coefs from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_DATAFIM between @data_i and @data_f group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca1 on E_ID = epoca1.id left join 
		(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs, sum(of_coeficiente) as coefs from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year,-1,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-1,@data_f) group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca2 on E_ID = epoca2.id left join 
		(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs, sum(of_coeficiente) as coefs from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year,-2,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-2,@data_f) group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca3 on E_ID = epoca3.id --left join
		--ENTIDADE_PHC on E_ID = EPHC_E_ID left join
		--(select no, nome, round(convert(float,sum(eivain1 + eivain2 + eivain3 + eivain4)),2) as TotalSemIva from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and ousrdata between @data_i and @data_f group by no, nome) as fact1 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact1.no left join
		--(select no, nome, round(convert(float,sum(eivain1 + eivain2 + eivain3 + eivain4)),2) as TotalSemIva from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and ousrdata between dateadd(year,-1,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-1,@data_f) group by no, nome) as fact2 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact2.no left join
		--(select no, nome, round(convert(float,sum(eivain1 + eivain2 + eivain3 + eivain4)),2) as TotalSemIva from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and ousrdata between dateadd(year,-2,@data_i) and dateadd(year,-2,@data_f) group by no, nome) as fact3 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact3.no
	where E_id = @e_id --and E_ACTIVO = 1 and epoca1.ofs > 0
	--group by e_id, e_nome, epoca1.TP_NOME

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Producao_Facturacao_Detalhe_Facturacao`(@e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 12:01* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Producao_Facturacao_Detalhe_Facturacao]

@e_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @data_i smalldatetime, @data_f smalldatetime
	set @data_i = convert(nvarchar(max), (case when month(getdate()) > 9 then year(getdate()) else year(getdate())-1 end)) + '/10/01' --(case when month(getdate()) > 9 then convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())) + '/10/01' else convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())-1) + '/10/01' end)
	set @data_f = convert(nvarchar(max), (case when month(getdate()) > 9 then year(getdate())+1 else year(getdate()) end)) + '/09/30' --(case when month(getdate()) > 9 then convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())+1) + '/09/30' else convert(nvarchar(max), year(getdate())) + '/09/30' end)

	select (case when month(ousrdata) > 9 then year(ousrdata)+1 else year(ousrdata) end) as epoca, nmdoc, fno, no, nome, morada, local, codpost, 
		round(convert(float,ettiliq),2) as TotalSemIva, 
		ettiva as Iva, eivain1 + eivain2 + eivain3 + eivain4 + eivav1 + eivav2 + eivav3 + eivav4 as Total, 
		ousrinis, ousrdata
	from entidade_phc inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on ephc_phc_id = no 
	where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and ousrdata between dateadd(year,-2,@data_i) and @data_f and ephc_e_id = @e_id
	order by ousrdata desc

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoCapacidade`(@dt smalldatetime, @dt_transp smalldatetime, @fases nvarchar(max), @fluxo bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`, `molde`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoCapacidade]

	@dt smalldatetime,
	@dt_transp smalldatetime = null,
	@fases nvarchar(max),
	@fluxo bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if @fluxo = 0
begin
	if @dt_transp is null
	begin
		--convert(nvarchar(max),sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(f.perda,0)) + '/' + convert(nvarchar(max),sum(e_produtividade))
		if cast(@dt as date) = cast(getdate() as date) -- do dia
		begin
			
			set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

			select fp_nome, count(distinct of_id) as barcos,
				(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then '3)Em processo' else '2)Em espera' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			from ordemfabrico inner join --(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, min(offp_ordem) as ord from of_fp group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as f on of_id = f.ofid and of_fp_id = f.fpid inner join 
				of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id /*and offp_ordem = f.ord*/ inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id and of_fp_id = fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
			and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > cast(@dt as date) or offp_datafim is null)
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then '3)Em processo' else '2)Em espera' end)
			union
			select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos, (case when offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' else '5)Retorno' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and 
				cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date)
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome, (case when offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' else '5)Retorno' end)--,'4)Feito'
			union
			select fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
				(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
			where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
			union
			select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			union
			select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			order by fp_sequencia, estado
		end
		else -- Historico
		begin
		--declare @dt smalldatetime = '2017/10/10'
			set @dt = convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),@dt,103)+ ' 23:59:00',103)
				
			select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos, 
				(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then '3)Em processo' 
				when cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno'
				when (cast(offp_datainicio as date) >= cast(@dt as date) or offp_datainicio is null) and cast(fp_ant.fim as date) < cast(@dt as date) then '2)Em espera' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			from ordemfabrico inner join --(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, min(offp_ordem) as ord from of_fp group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as f on of_id = f.ofid inner join 
				of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id /*and f.fpid = offp_fp_id and offp_ordem = f.ord*/ inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
				left join (select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, offp_datafim as fim from of_fp) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and
				((cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null)) or
				(cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 0) or (cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 1) or 
				((cast(offp_datainicio as date) >= cast(@dt as date) or offp_datainicio is null) and cast(fp_ant.fim as date) < cast(@dt as date)))
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome, (case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then '3)Em processo' 
				when cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno'
				when (cast(offp_datainicio as date) >= cast(@dt as date) or offp_datainicio is null) and cast(fp_ant.fim as date) < cast(@dt as date) then '2)Em espera' end)
			union
			select fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4 
			from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, sum(e_produtividade) as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date) group by movent_e_id) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
			where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome, f.perda
			union
			select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			union
			select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			order by fp_sequencia, estado
		end
	end
	else
	begin
		select fp_nome, count(distinct of_id) as barcos,
			(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= cast(@dt as date) and (offp_datafim > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then '3)Em processo' 
			else '2)Em espera' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
		from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id and of_fp_id = fp_id inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
		where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and cast(tr_data as date) = cast(@dt_transp as date)
			and (cast(offp_datafim as date) > cast(@dt as date) or offp_datafim is null)
		group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= cast(@dt as date) and (offp_datafim > @dt or offp_datafim is null) then '3)Em processo' 
			else '2)Em espera' end)
		union
		select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos, (case when offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' else '5)Retorno' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
		from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
		where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date)
			and cast(tr_data as date) = cast(@dt_transp as date)
		group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome, offp_return--,'4)Feito'
		union
		select fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4 
		from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
		(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where e_activo = 1 --and e_id not in (select movent_e_id, sum(e_produtividade) as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and @dt between movent_data_i and movent_data_f)
		--and e_chefe = 1
		group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
	end
end
else
begin
	if @dt_transp is null
	begin
		set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

		select 
			fp_nome, count(ultPass.ofid) as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
		from 
			fases_producao inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
		where 
			ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem = @dt
		group by 
			fp_nome, fp_sequencia
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		order by fp_sequencia, estado		
	end
	else
	begin		
		set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

		select 
			fp_nome, count(ultPass.ofid) as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
		from 
			fases_producao inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
			inner join transp_of on ultPass.ofid = trof_of_id inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
		where 
			tr_data = @dt_transp
		group by 
			fp_nome, fp_sequencia
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		order by fp_sequencia, estado		
	end
end
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoCapacidade_Acumulado`(@dt smalldatetime, @fluxo bit, @verEspera bit, @fases nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoCapacidade_Acumulado]
	
	@dt smalldatetime,
	@fluxo bit,
	@verEspera bit,
	@fases nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	--declare @dt smalldatetime
	--set @dt = '2016/09/16'

	declare @dt_ant smalldatetime
	set @dt_ant = convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),dateadd(day,(datepart(weekday, @dt))*-1,@dt),103)+ ' 23:59:00',103)

	declare @nDias int
	--if datepart(week,@dt) < datepart(week,getdate())
		--set @nDias = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt))
	--else
		set @nDias = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt) and dtrb_data <= @dt)

	if @fluxo = 0
	begin
		if @verEspera = 1
			select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos,
				(case when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and
				year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt)
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' end)
			union
			select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos,
				(case when (convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),offp_datainicio,103),103) >= @dt_ant or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt_ant then '2)Em espera no inicio da semana' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
				left join (select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, offp_datafim as fim from of_fp) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and
				((convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),offp_datainicio,103),103) >= @dt_ant or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt_ant)
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when (convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),offp_datainicio,103),103) >= @dt_ant or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt_ant then '2)Em espera no inicio da semana' end)
			union
			select fp_nome, (sum(e_produtividade)*@nDias) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, sum(e_produtividade) as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and year(movent_data_i) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,movent_data_i) = datepart(week,@dt) and convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),movent_data_i,103),103) <= convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),@dt,103),103) group by movent_e_id) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
			where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome
			union
			select 'Cura', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			union
			select 'Desmolde', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			order by fp_sequencia, estado
		else if @verEspera = 0
			select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos,
				(case when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' end) as estado, fp_sequencia, 
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and
				year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and cast(offp_datafim as date) <= cast(@dt as date)
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' end)
			union
			select fp_nome, (sum(e_produtividade)*@nDias) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, sum(e_produtividade) as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and year(movent_data_i) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,movent_data_i) = datepart(week,@dt) and convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),movent_data_i,103),103) <= convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),@dt,103),103) group by movent_e_id) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
			where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
			group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome
			union
			select 'Cura', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			union
			select 'Desmolde', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
			order by fp_sequencia, estado
	end
	else
	begin
		select 
			fp_nome, count(ultPass.ofid) as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp_sequencia, 
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
				sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
		from 
			fases_producao inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
		where 
			year(ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = year(@dt ) and datepart(week,ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = datepart(week,@dt)
		group by 
			fp_nome, fp_sequencia
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		order by fp_sequencia, estado		
	end
	--------declare @dt_ant smalldatetime
	--------set @dt_ant = convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),dateadd(day,(datepart(weekday, @dt))*-1,@dt),103)+ ' 23:59:00',103)

	--------declare @nDias int
	----------if datepart(week,@dt) < datepart(week,getdate())
	--------	--set @nDias = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt))
	----------else
	--------	set @nDias = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt) and dtrb_data <= @dt)



	--------select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos,
	--------	(case when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) then '4)Feito'end) as estado, fp_sequencia
	--------from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
	--------	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
	--------where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct prodf_fp_id from produto_fase where prodf_fabrico = 1) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and
	--------	year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),offp_datafim,103),103) <= convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),@dt,103),103)
	--------group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) then '4)Feito' end)
	--------union
	--------select fp_nome, count(of_id) as barcos,
	--------	(case when (convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),offp_datainicio,103),103) >= @dt_ant or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt_ant then '2)Em espera' end) as estado, fp_sequencia
	--------from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
	--------	left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
	--------	left join (select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, offp_datafim as fim from of_fp) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
	--------where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct prodf_fp_id from produto_fase where prodf_fabrico = 1) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and
	--------	((convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),offp_datainicio,103),103) >= @dt_ant or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt_ant)
	--------group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome,(case when (convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),offp_datainicio,103),103) >= @dt_ant or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt_ant then '2)Em espera' end)
	--------union
	--------select fp_nome, (sum(e_produtividade)*@nDias) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
	--------(select movent_e_id, sum(e_produtividade) as perda 
	--------	from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id 
	--------		where met_met_id = 2 and year(movent_data_i) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,movent_data_i) = datepart(week,@dt) and 
	--------			convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),movent_data_i,103),103) <= convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),@dt,103),103) group by movent_e_id) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
	--------where e_activo = 1 
	--------group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome
	--------union
	--------select 'Cura', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia
	--------union
	--------select 'Desmolde', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia
	--------order by fp_sequencia, estado
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoCapacidade_Sub`(@fp_id nvarchar(max), @estado nvarchar(max), @dt smalldatetime, @semana int, @dt_transp smalldatetime, @fluxo bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoCapacidade_Sub]
	
	@fp_id nvarchar(max),
	@estado nvarchar(max),
	@dt smalldatetime,
	@semana int = null,
	@dt_transp smalldatetime = null,
	@fluxo bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	set @dt = cast(@dt as date)

	set @estado = (case when @estado = '2)Em espera no inicio da semana' then '2)Em espera' else @estado end)

	if @fluxo = 0
	begin
		if @dt_transp is null
		begin
			if @semana is null
			begin
				if cast(@dt as date) = cast(getdate() as date) -- do dia
					select of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
						coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome
					from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
						left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
						inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
						left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id 
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
					where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
						and (case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt) then '3)Em processo' 
						when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt  and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' when of_fp_id = fp_id and offp_datainicio is null and offp_datafim is null then '2)Em espera' end) = @estado and fp_nome = @fp_id
					order by coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), tr_descricao
				else
					select of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
					coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome
					from ordemfabrico inner join 
						of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
						left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
						inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
						left join (select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, offp_datafim as fim from of_fp) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
						left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
					where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and
					((cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date)) or ((cast(offp_datainicio as date) >= @dt or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt) or
					((cast(offp_datainicio as date) >= @dt or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt))
						and (case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt) then '3)Em processo' 
						when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt  and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' when (cast(offp_datainicio as date) >= @dt or offp_datainicio is null) and fp_ant.fim < @dt then '2)Em espera' end) = @estado and fp_nome = @fp_id
					order by coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), tr_descricao
			end
			else
			begin
				declare @dt_ant smalldatetime
				set @dt_ant = convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),dateadd(day,(datepart(weekday, @dt))*-1,@dt),103)+ ' 23:59:00',103)

				select of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
				coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome, tr_descricao
				from ordemfabrico inner join
					of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
					inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
					left join (select offp_of_id as idof, cast(offp_datafim as date) as dt_f, offp_ordem as ord from of_fp) as fp_ant on of_id = fp_ant.idof and offp_ordem - 1 = fp_ant.ord
					left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
				where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
					and (case when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' 
					when year(offp_datafim) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,@dt) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' end) = @estado and fp_nome = @fp_id
					 --and cast(offp_datafim as date) <= cast(@dt as date)
				union 
				select of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
				coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome, tr_descricao
				from ordemfabrico inner join
					of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
					inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
					left join (select offp_of_id as idof, cast(offp_datafim as date) as dt_f, offp_ordem as ord from of_fp) as fp_ant on of_id = fp_ant.idof and offp_ordem - 1 = fp_ant.ord
					left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
				where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
					and (case when fp_ant.dt_f < cast(@dt_ant as date) and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datainicio  >= cast(@dt_ant as date)) then '2)Em espera' end) = @estado and fp_nome = @fp_id
					 --and cast(offp_datafim as date) <= cast(@dt as date)
				order by tr_data, tr_descricao
			end
		end
		else
		begin
			select of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome
			from ordemfabrico inner join 
				of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
				inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
				left join (select offp_of_id as idof, cast(offp_datafim as date) as dt_f, offp_ordem as ord from of_fp) as fp_ant on of_id = fp_ant.idof and offp_ordem - 1 = fp_ant.ord
				left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
			where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
				and (case when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt) then '3)Em processo' 
				when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 0 then '4)Feito' when cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(@dt as date) and offp_return = 1 then '5)Retorno' when fp_ant.dt_f <= cast(@dt as date) and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datainicio  > cast(@dt as date)) then '2)Em espera' end) = @estado and fp_nome = @fp_id
				and cast(tr_data as date) = cast(@dt_transp as date)
			order by coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), tr_descricao
		end
	end
	else
	begin
		if @dt_transp is null
		begin
			if @semana is null
			begin
				select 
					of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
					coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome
				from 
					ordemfabrico inner join
					(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as data_Ult_Passagem 
						from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where fp_nome = @fp_id group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on of_id = ultPass.ofid
					inner join of_fp on ultPass.ofid = offp_of_id and ultPass.fpid = offp_fp_id and ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem = offp_datafim
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
					left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
					inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
					inner join fases_producao on ultPass.fpid = fp_id
					inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
					left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
					left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
				where 
					cast(ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem as date) = @dt
				order by coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), tr_descricao
			end
			else
			begin
				select 
					of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
					coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome
				from 
					ordemfabrico inner join
					(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as data_Ult_Passagem 
						from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where fp_nome = @fp_id group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on of_id = ultPass.ofid
					inner join of_fp on ultPass.ofid = offp_of_id and ultPass.fpid = offp_fp_id and ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem = offp_datafim
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
					left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
					left join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
					inner join fases_producao on ultPass.fpid = fp_id
					inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
					left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
					left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
				where 
					year(ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = datepart(week,@dt)
				order by coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), tr_descricao
			end
		end
		else
		begin
			select 
					of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel, convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte, 
					coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fpp.fpnome
				from 
					ordemfabrico inner join
					(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as data_Ult_Passagem 
						from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where fp_nome = @fp_id group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on of_id = ultPass.ofid
					inner join of_fp on ultPass.ofid = offp_of_id and ultPass.fpid = offp_fp_id and ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem = offp_datafim
					left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
					left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
					left join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
					inner join fases_producao on ultPass.fpid = fp_id
					inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
					left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
					left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						inner join (select fp_id as fpid, fp_nome as fpnome from fases_producao) as fpp on of_fp_id = fpp.fpid
				where 
					cast(ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem as date) = @dt and cast(tr_data as date) = @dt
				order by coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), tr_descricao
		end
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoCapacidade_Sub_Capacidade`(@fp_id nvarchar(max), @dt smalldatetime, @semana int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoCapacidade_Sub_Capacidade] 

	@fp_id nvarchar(max),
	@dt smalldatetime,
	@semana int = null
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @semana is null
	begin
		select e_nome, (case when ft.flt>0 then 0 else e_produtividade end) as e_produtividade, ft.flt as presente, e_produtividade as teorico
		from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join (select movent_e_id, count(*) as flt from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id and met_met_id = 2 
			where convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),@dt,103),103) = convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),movent_data_i,103),103) group by movent_e_id) as ft on e_id = ft.movent_e_id
		where e_activo = 1 and fp_nome = @fp_id
		order by e_nome
	end
	else
	begin
		declare @nDias int
		if datepart(week,@dt) < datepart(week,getdate())
			set @nDias = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt))
		else
			set @nDias = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt) and dtrb_data <= @dt)

		select e_nome, e_produtividade * (@nDias - coalesce(ft.flt,0)) as e_produtividade, ft.flt as presente, e_produtividade * coalesce(ft.flt,0) as teorico
		from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join (select movent_e_id, count(*) as flt from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id and met_met_id = 2 
			where year(movent_data_i) = year(@dt) and datepart(week, movent_data_i) = datepart(week,@dt) group by movent_e_id) as ft on e_id = ft.movent_e_id
		where e_activo = 1 and fp_nome = @fp_id
		order by e_nome
	end

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoCapacidade_V2`(@dt date, @fases nvarchar(max), @fluxo bit, @tipo int, @inclAcess bit, @estado nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-31 13:56* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`, `molde`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoCapacidade_V2]
	@dt date,
	@fases nvarchar(max),
	@fluxo bit = 0,
	@tipo int,
	@inclAcess bit = 0,
	@estado nvarchar(max) = null
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if @fluxo = 0
begin

	declare @inicioSem date = dateadd(day, (datepart(weekday, @dt)-1) * -1, @dt)
	declare	@fimSemana date = dateadd(day, 6, @inicioSem)
	declare @nDias int = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt) and dtrb_data <= @dt)

	-- Do dia agrupado
	if @tipo = 1
		select fp.fp_nome, 
			count(of_id) as barcos, 
			(
				case 
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 0
					then '4)Feito'
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 1
					then '5)Retorno'
					when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
						and 
						(
							cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt
							or offp_datafim is null
						)
					then '3)Em processo'
					when fp_ant.fim <= @dt and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @dt) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt)
					then '2)Em espera'
					when fp_ant.fim is null and offp_datainicio is null and of_fp_id not in (11,32)
					then '6)Futuros'
				end
			) as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado, offp_return, '' as fases, 0 offp_retorno_grave,
			0 as pedidoMaterial
		from ordemfabrico 
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
			left join 
				(
					select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp
				) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
		where of_id not between 70000 and 89999
			and of_id < 10000000
			and p_nome not like '400 %'
			and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) 
			and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
			and (
					-- 4)Feito ou 5)Retorno
					( 
						cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt
						and offp_return = 0
					)
					or
					(
						cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt
						and offp_return = 1
					)
					or 
					-- 3)Em processo
					( 
						cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
						and 
						(
							cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt
							or offp_datafim is null
						)
					)
					or
					-- 2)Em espera
					(
						fp_ant.fim <= @dt and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @dt) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt)
					)
					or
					-- 6)Futuros
					(fp_ant.fim is null and offp_datainicio is null and of_fp_id not in (11,32)) 
				)
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		group by fp.fp_sequencia, fp.fp_nome,
			(
				case 
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 0
					then '4)Feito'
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 1
					then '5)Retorno'
					when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
						and 
						(
							cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt
							or offp_datafim is null
						)
					then '3)Em processo'
					when fp_ant.fim <= @dt and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @dt) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt)
					then '2)Em espera'
					when fp_ant.fim is null and offp_datainicio is null and of_fp_id not in (11,32)
					then '6)Futuros'
				end
			)
			,p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome, e1.e_nome,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), linha, fp1.fp_nome, offp_return
		--union
		--select fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		--, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '','', '',0,0
		--from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
		--	(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		--where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		--group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		--union
		--select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '','', '',0, 0
		--union
		--select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '','', '',0, 0
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
	-- Do dia (OFs)
	else if @tipo = 2
		select 
			zx.*, 
			dbo.of_Pedido_Estado(zx.barcos) as pedidoMaterial
		from
			(select fp.fp_nome, 
						of_id as barcos, 
						(
							case 
								when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 0
								then '4)Feito'
								when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 1
								then '5)Retorno'
								when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
									and 
									(
										cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt
										or offp_datafim is null
									)
								then '3)Em processo'
								when fp_ant.fim <= @dt and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @dt) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt)
								then '2)Em espera'
								when fp_ant.fim is null and offp_datainicio is null and of_fp_id not in (11,32)
								then '6)Futuros'
							end
						) as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
						(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, 
						(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
						(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, 
						(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
						, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel,
						convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
						coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado, offp_return, dbo.of_Fases_txt(of_id) as fases, offp_retorno_grave,
						0 as pedidoMaterial,
						case when z1.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end cqMont
					from ordemfabrico 
						inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
						inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
						left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
						inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
						inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
						inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
						left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
						left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
						left join 
							(
								select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp
							) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
						left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
						outer apply (select distinct ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK from OF_CHECKLIST ch where ch.OFCH_OF_ID = OF_ID and ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK = 74 and ch.OFCH_ESTADO is not null) z1
					where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
						and of_id < 10000000
						and p_nome not like '400 %'
						and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) 
						and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
						and (
								-- 4)Feito ou 5)Retorno
								( 
									cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt

								or
								(
									cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt
									and offp_return = 1
								)
								or 
								-- 3)Em processo
								( 
									cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
									and 
									(
										cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt
										or offp_datafim is null
									)
								)
								or
								-- 2)Em espera
								(
									fp_ant.fim <= @dt and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @dt) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt)
								)

			where
				case when @estado is null then '1' else zx.estado end = isnull(@estado,'1')
	-- Da semana agrupado
	else if @tipo = 3
		select fp.fp_nome, 
			count(of_id) as barcos, 
			(
				case 
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 0
					then '4)Feito'
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 1
					then '5)Retorno'
					when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt

							cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt

					then '3)Em processo'
					when fp_ant.fim <= @inicioSem and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @inicioSem) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @inicioSem)
					then '2)Em espera no inicio da semana'
				end
			) as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado, offp_return, '' as fases, 0 offp_retorno_grave,
			0 as pedidoMaterial
		from ordemfabrico 
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id

			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
			left join 
				(
					select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp
				) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
		where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
			and of_id < 10000000
			and p_nome not like '400 %'
			and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) 
			and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
			and (
					-- 4)Feito ou 5)Retorno
					( 
						cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt
						and offp_return = 0
					)

						)
					)
					or
					-- 2)Em espera
					(
						fp_ant.fim <= @inicioSem and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @inicioSem) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @inicioSem)
					)
				)
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		group by fp.fp_sequencia, fp.fp_nome,
			(
				case 
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 0
					then '4)Feito'
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 1
					then '5)Retorno'
					when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
						and
```
