```sql
					then '3)Em processo'
					when fp_ant.fim <= @inicioSem and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @inicioSem) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @inicioSem)
					then '2)Em espera no inicio da semana'
				end
			)
			,p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome, e1.e_nome,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), linha, fp1.fp_nome, offp_return
		--union
		--select fp_nome, (sum(e_produtividade)*@nDias) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4
		--	, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '',0,0
		--from entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
		--(select movent_e_id, sum(e_produtividade) as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and year(movent_data_i) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,movent_data_i) = datepart(week,@dt) and convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),movent_data_i,103),103) <= convert(smalldatetime,convert(nvarchar(10),@dt,103),103) group by movent_e_id) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		--where e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		--group by fp_sequencia, fp_nome
		--union
		--select 'Cura', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '','','',0,0
		--union
		--select 'Desmolde', 20 * @nDias as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '','','',0,0
		order by fp_sequencia, estado

	-- Da semana (OFs)
	else if @tipo = 4
	select 
		*
	from
		(select fp.fp_nome, 
			of_id as barcos, 
			(
				case 
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 0
					then '4)Feito'
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 1
					then '5)Retorno'
					when cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
						and 
						(
							cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt
							or offp_datafim is null
						)
					then '3)Em processo'
					when fp_ant.fim <= @inicioSem and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @inicioSem) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @inicioSem)
					then '2)Em espera no inicio da semana'
				end
			) as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, 
			(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, 
			(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado, offp_return, '' as fases, 0 offp_retorno_grave,
			0 as pedidoMaterial
		from ordemfabrico 
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
			left join 
				(
					select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp
				) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
		where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
			and of_id < 10000000
			and p_nome not like '400 %'
			and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) 
			and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
			and (
					-- 4)Feito ou 5)Retorno
					( 
						cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt
						and offp_return = 0
					)
					or
					(
						cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt
						and offp_return = 1
					)
					or 
					-- 3)Em processo
					( 
						cast(offp_datainicio as date) <= @dt 
						and 
						(
							cast(offp_datafim as date) > @dt
							or offp_datafim is null
						)
					)
					or
					-- 2)Em espera
					(
						fp_ant.fim <= @inicioSem and (offp_datainicio is null or cast(offp_datainicio as date) > @inicioSem) and (offp_datafim is null or cast(offp_datafim as date) > @inicioSem)
					)
				)
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)) zzz
	where
		case when @estado is null then '1' else estado end = isnull(@estado,'1')
end
else if @fluxo = 1
	if @tipo = 1 -- Fluxo agrupado
		select 
			fp.fp_nome, count(ultPass.ofid) as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, '' as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado
		from 
			fases_producao as fp inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
			inner join ordemfabrico on ultPass.ofid = of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		where 
			ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem = @dt
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		group by 
			fp.fp_nome, fp.fp_sequencia, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), linha, fp1.fp_nome
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
	else if @tipo = 2 -- Fluxo  (OFs)
		select 
			fp.fp_nome, ultPass.ofid as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, (case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, (case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, '' as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado
		from 
			fases_producao as fp inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
			inner join ordemfabrico on ultPass.ofid = of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		where 
			ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem = @dt
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
	else if @tipo = 3 -- fluxo semana agrupado
		select 
			fp.fp_nome, count(ultPass.ofid) as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, '' as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado
		from 
			fases_producao as fp inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
			inner join ordemfabrico on ultPass.ofid = of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		where 
			year(ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = year(@dt ) and datepart(week,ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = datepart(week,@dt)
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		group by 
			fp.fp_nome, fp.fp_sequencia,
			p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), linha, fp1.fp_nome
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
	else if @tipo = 4 -- fluxo semana (OFs)
		select 
			fp.fp_nome, ultPass.ofid as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, (case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, (case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, '' as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estad
		from 
			fases_producao as fp inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
			inner join ordemfabrico on ultPass.ofid = of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		where 
			year(ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = year(@dt ) and datepart(week,ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem) = datepart(week,@dt)
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoCapacidade_V3`(@dt date, @fases nvarchar(max), @fluxo bit, @tipo int, @inclAcess bit, @estado nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2023-09-13 13:36 · modificado 2023-11-27 16:21* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`, `molde`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoCapacidade_V3]
	@dt date,
	@fases nvarchar(max),
	@fluxo bit = 0,
	@tipo int,
	@inclAcess bit = 0,
	@estado nvarchar(max) = null
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if @fluxo = 0
begin

	declare @inicioSem date = dateadd(day, (datepart(weekday, @dt)-1) * -1, @dt)
	declare	@fimSemana date = dateadd(day, 6, @inicioSem)
	declare @nDias int = (select count(*) from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = year(@dt) and datepart(week,dtrb_data) = datepart(week,@dt) and dtrb_data <= @dt)

	-- Do dia agrupado
	if @tipo = 1
		select fp.fp_nome, 
			count(of_id) as barcos, 
			(
				case 
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 0
					then '4)Feito'
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 1
					then '5)Retorno'
				end
			) as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado, offp_return, '' as fases, 0 offp_retorno_grave,
			0 as pedidoMaterial
		from ordemfabrico 
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
			left join 
				(
					select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp
				) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			left join (select offp_id offpId, offp_fp_id fpCulpa from of_fp) culpa on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = culpa.offpId
		where of_id not between 70000 and 89999
			and of_id < 10000000
			and P_ID not in (26020, 44989, 28016, 45873) 
			and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) 
			and of_e_id_enc <> 19747
			and (
					-- 4)Feito ou 5)Retorno
					( 
						cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt
						and offp_return = 0
					)
					or
					(
						cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt
						and offp_return = 1
						and culpa.fpCulpa = OFFP_FP_ID
					)
				)
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		group by fp.fp_sequencia, fp.fp_nome,
			(
				case 
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 0
					then '4)Feito'
					when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 1
					then '5)Retorno'
				end
			)
			,p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome, e1.e_nome,

		order by fp_sequencia, estado
	-- Do dia (OFs)
	else if @tipo = 2
		select 
			zx.*, 
			dbo.of_Pedido_Estado(zx.barcos) as pedidoMaterial
		from
			(select fp.fp_nome, 
						of_id as barcos, 
						(
							case 
								when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 0
								then '4)Feito'
								when cast(offp_datafim as date) = @dt and offp_return = 1
								then '5)Retorno'
							end
						) as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
						(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, 
						(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
						(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3,

					from ordemfabrico 
						inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
						inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
						left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
						inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
						inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
						inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
						left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
						left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
						left join 
							(
								select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp
							) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1

			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3,

			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, e1.e_nome as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado, offp_return, '' as fases, 0 offp_retorno_grave,
			0 as pedidoMaterial
		from ordemfabrico 
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id
			left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
			left join entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
			left join 
				(
					select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp
				) as fp_ant on fp_ant.id = offp_of_id and fp_ant.ordem = offp_ordem - 1
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			left join (select offp_id offpId, offp_fp_id fpCulpa from of_fp) culpa on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = culpa.offpId

			and offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) 
			and of_e_id_enc <> 19747

					(

				)
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		group by fp.fp_sequencia, fp.fp_nome,

					then '4)Feito'

			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), linha, fp1.fp_nome, offp_return
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
	-- Da semana (OFs)
	else if @tipo = 4

			(

					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 0

					when cast(offp_datafim as date) between @inicioSem and @dt and offp_return = 1

			0 as pedidoMaterial
		from ordemfabrico 
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id

					select offp_of_id as id, offp_ordem as ordem, cast(offp_datafim as date) as fim from of_fp

			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = of_id
			left join (select offp_id offpId, offp_fp_id fpCulpa from of_fp) culpa on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = culpa.offpId

			and of_id < 10000000

end
else if @fluxo = 1
	if @tipo = 1 -- Fluxo agrupado
		select 
			fp.fp_nome, count(ultPass.ofid) as barcos, '4)Feito' as estado, fp.fp_sequencia, 
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 1' then 1 else 0 end) as l1, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 2' then 1 else 0 end) as l2,
			sum(case when linha = 'Linha 3' then 1 else 0 end) as l3, sum(case when linha = 'Linha 0' then 1 else 0 end) as l4
			, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome as cliente, '' as responsavel,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao as transporte,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())) as tr_data, linha, fp1.fp_nome as of_estado
		from 
			fases_producao as fp inner join
			(select offp_of_id as ofid, offp_fp_id as fpid, cast(max(coalesce(offp_datafim, dateadd(year,10,getdate()))) as date) as data_Ult_Passagem from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id where offp_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,',')) group by offp_of_id, offp_fp_id) as ultPass on fp_id = ultPass.fpid
			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
			inner join ordemfabrico on ultPass.ofid = of_id 
			inner join fases_producao as fp1 on of_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
			inner join entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		where 
			ultPass.data_Ult_Passagem = @dt
			and (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else p_gera_of end) = (case when @inclAcess = 1 then 1 else 0 end)
		group by 
			fp.fp_nome, fp.fp_sequencia, p_nome, of_referencia, e.e_nome,
			convert(nvarchar(max), tr_data, 103) + ' - ' + tr_descricao,
			coalesce(tr_data,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), linha, fp1.fp_nome
		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''

			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid
			inner join ordemfabrico on ultPass.ofid = of_id

			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		from

		from

		from

			left join dbo.of_linha_prod on id_of = ultPass.ofid

		union
		select 
			fp_nome, sum(e_produtividade) - coalesce(sum(f.perda),0) as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		from 
			entidade inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id left join
			(select movent_e_id, e_produtividade as perda from ent_mov inner join ent_mov_tipo on movent_met_id = met_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where met_met_id = 2 and cast(@dt as date) = cast(movent_data_i as date)) as f on e_id = f.MOVENT_E_ID
		where 
			e_activo = 1 and e_fp_id in (select number from [dbo].[fn_SplitInt](@fases,','))
		group by 
			fp_sequencia, fp_nome--, f.perda
		union
		select 'Cura', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 10 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		union
		select 'Desmolde', 20 as barcos, '1)Capacidade' as estado, 11 as fp_sequencia, 0 as l1, 0 as l2, 0 as l3, 0 as l4, '', '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
		order by fp_sequencia, estado
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoMensal`(@tipo int, @inicio int, @fim int, @classe int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `producao`, `produç`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nuno André
-- Create date: 22/03/2007
-- Description:	Lista Produção Mensal Todos
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoMensal]

@tipo int,
@inicio int,
@fim int,
@classe int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare @ano int

CREATE TABLE #prod
(
	OrdsFabs int,
	Coefs float,
	Mes int,
	Ano int
)

if (@classe=-1)
begin
	if (@tipo=1) /* Por Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
			sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) as Ano 
		from
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		where
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) between @inicio and @fim
		group by
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) order by datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM)
	end
	else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */
	begin	
		select 
			count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
			sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano 
		from
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		where
			year(of_datafim) between @inicio and @fim
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), datepart(mm, of_datafim)		
	end
	else if (@tipo=3) /* Por Homologo Época */
	begin
		if (month(getdate()) < 9)
			select 
				count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
				sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
				datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
				(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano 
			from
				ordemfabrico inner join 
				produto on of_p_id=p_id 
			where
				year(of_datafim) between @inicio and @fim
				and (month(of_datafim) > 9 or month(of_datafim) <= month(getdate())) --and month(of_datafim) <= month(getdate())
			group by 
				(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), datepart(mm, of_datafim)
		else
			select 
				count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
				sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
				datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
				(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano 
			from
				ordemfabrico inner join 
				produto on of_p_id=p_id 
			where
				year(of_datafim) between @inicio and @fim
				and month(of_datafim) between 9 and month(getdate())
			group by 
				(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), datepart(mm, of_datafim)
	end
	else if (@tipo=4) /* Por Homologo Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
			sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) as Ano 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		where 
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) between @inicio and @fim
			and month(of_datafim) <= month(getdate())
		group by 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) order by datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM)
	end
end
else if (@classe>-1)
begin
	if (@tipo=1) /* Por Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
			sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) as Ano 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		where 
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) between @inicio and @fim
			and p_tp_id=@classe
		group by 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) order by datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM)
	end
	else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */
	begin	
		select 
			count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
			sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano 
		from
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		where
			year(of_datafim) between @inicio and @fim
			and p_tp_id=@classe
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), datepart(mm, of_datafim)
	end
	else if (@tipo=3) /* Por Homologo Época */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
			sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano 
		from
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		where
			year(of_datafim) between @inicio and @fim
			and (month(of_datafim) > 9 or month(of_datafim) <= month(getdate()))
			and p_tp_id=@classe
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), datepart(mm, of_datafim)
	end
	else if (@tipo=4) /* Por Homologo Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as OrdsFabs, 
			sum(of_coeficiente) as Coefs, 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM) as Mes, 
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) as Ano 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		where 
			datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) between @inicio and @fim
			and month(of_datafim) <= month(getdate())
			and p_tp_id=@classe
		group by 
			datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM) order by datepart(yy, OF_DATAFIM), datepart(mm, OF_DATAFIM)
	end
end

	    
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoMensalAcabador`(@ano int, @mes int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_ProducaoMensalAcabador]

@ano int,
@mes int

as 

begin transaction

select 
	of_id, 
	p_nome, 
	of_coeficiente, 
	offp_datafim, 
	of_fp_id,  
	e_nome
from 
	ordemfabrico inner join
	produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
	of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id inner join 
	offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 inner join
	entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
where 
	--of_fp_id in (9,10,12, 13) and 
	offp_fp_id=8 
	and datepart(yy,offp_datafim)=@ano 
	and datepart(mm,offp_datafim)=@mes
order by 
	e_nome, offp_datafim

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoMes`(@ano int, @mes int, @classe int)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nuno Andre
-- Create date: 15/06/2007
-- Description:	Lista total por modelo num determinado mês
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_ProducaoMes] 

@ano int,
@mes int,
@classe int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@classe > -1)

	select 
		p_nome, 
		count(of_id), 
		sum(of_coeficiente) as coef 
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join 
		produto on of_p_id=p_id 
	where 
		 datepart(yy,of_datafim)=@ano and 
		datepart(mm,of_datafim)=@mes and p_tp_id = @classe
	group by
		 p_nome
	order by 
		p_nome

else

	select 
		p_nome, 
		count(of_id), 
		sum(of_coeficiente) as coef 
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join 
		produto on of_p_id=p_id 
	where 
		 datepart(yy,of_datafim)=@ano and 
		datepart(mm,of_datafim)=@mes
	group by
		 p_nome
	order by 
		p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_ProducaoTrimestre`(@inicio int, @fim int, @classe int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_ProducaoTrimestre]

@inicio int,
@fim int,
@classe int

as

create table #p (ofid int, coef float, ano int, trim nvarchar(10))

if (@classe > -1)
begin

	insert into #p (ofid, coef, ano, trim)
	select 
		count(of_id) as ofs, 
		sum(p_coeficiente) as coefs, 
		datepart(yy, of_datafim) as ano, 
		(case when month(of_datafim) between 1 and 3 then 'trimestre1'
			  when month(of_datafim) between 4 and 6 then 'trimestre2'
			  when month(of_datafim) between 7 and 9 then 'trimestre3'
			  when month(of_datafim) between 10 and 12 then 'trimestre4' end) as trim
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join 
		produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join 
		produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
	where 
		datepart(yy, of_datafim) between @inicio and @fim and tp_id = @classe
	group by 
		of_datafim

end
else
begin

	insert into #p (ofid, coef, ano, trim)
	select 
		count(of_id) as ofs, 
		sum(p_coeficiente) as coefs, 
		datepart(yy, of_datafim) as ano, 
		(case when month(of_datafim) between 1 and 3 then 'trimestre1'
			  when month(of_datafim) between 4 and 6 then 'trimestre2'
			  when month(of_datafim) between 7 and 9 then 'trimestre3'
			  when month(of_datafim) between 10 and 12 then 'trimestre4' end) as trim
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join 
		produto on of_p_id=p_id
	where 
		datepart(yy, of_datafim) between @inicio and @fim
	group by 
		of_datafim

end

select sum(ofid) as OFs, sum(coef) as COEFs, ano as Ano, trim as Trim from #p group by ano, trim order by ano, trim
```

#### `dbo.Report_Tempo_Medio_Acabamento`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `producao`, `reparac`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_Tempo_Medio_Acabamento]
as

select year(offp_datafim) as Ano, month(offp_datafim) as Mes, fp_nome as Fase, 
	   avg(datediff(dd,offp_datainicio, offp_datafim)) as Media
from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
where year(offp_datafim) between year(getdate())-1 and year(getdate()) and fp_id = 8 and 
	  datediff(dd,offp_datainicio, offp_datafim) < 20
group by year(offp_datafim), month(offp_datafim), fp_nome
union 
select EP_ANO as Ano, EP_MES as Mes, 'HoraBarco' as Fase,
(sum(EP_HORAS) - sum(EP_REPARACOES)) / (select sum(of_coeficiente) from ordemfabrico where year(of_datafim) = EP_ANO and month(of_datafim) = EP_MES) as Media
from entidade_pontos where EP_ANO between year(getdate())-1 and year(getdate())
group by EP_ANO, EP_MES
order by Ano, Mes, Fase


--select year(offp_datafim) as Ano, month(offp_datafim) as Mes, fp_nome as Fase, 
--	   avg(datediff(dd,offp_datainicio, offp_datafim)) Media
--from of_fp inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
--where year(offp_datafim) between year(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate()))-1 and year(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate())) 
--	  and month(offp_datafim) between month(dateadd(mm,-3,getdate())) and month(getdate()) and fp_id = 8 and 
--	  datediff(dd,offp_datainicio, offp_datafim) < 20
--group by year(offp_datafim), month(offp_datafim), fp_nome
--order by Ano, Mes, Fase
```

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_TOP10_Cliente]
as


					/*Top 10 do ano corrente e top 10 do ano anterior*/

--select top 10 row_number() over (order by count(of_id) desc) as rowNumber, 
--	e_nome as Cliente, 
--	count(of_id) as Num, year(of_datafim) as Ano
--from ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
--where year(of_datafim) = year(getdate())-1 and month(of_datafim) < month(getdate())
--group by e_nome,
--		year(of_datafim)
--union
--select top 10 row_number() over (order by count(of_id) desc) as rowNumber, 
--	e_nome as Cliente, 
--	count(of_id) as Num, year(of_datafim) as Ano
--from ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
--where year(of_datafim) = year(getdate()) and month(of_datafim) < month(getdate())
--group by e_nome,
--		year(of_datafim)
--order by Ano desc, Num desc



					/*Top 10 do ano corrente e correspondentes do ano anterior*/

declare @t table (rowNumber int,Cliente nvarchar(max),Num int,Ano int)

insert into @t (rowNumber,Cliente,Num,Ano) 
(select top 10 row_number() over (order by count(of_id) desc) as rowNumber, 
	e_nome as Cliente, 
	count(of_id) as Num, year(of_datafim) as Ano
from ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
where year(of_datafim) = year(getdate()) and month(of_datafim) < month(getdate())
group by e_nome,
		year(of_datafim))

insert into @t (rowNumber,Cliente,Num,Ano)

	Cliente, 
	count(of_id) as Num, year(of_datafim) as Ano
from ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join @t on e_nome = Cliente
where year(of_datafim) = year(getdate())-1 and month(of_datafim) < month(getdate())
group by rowNumber,Cliente,
		year(of_datafim))

select * from @t order by Ano desc, rowNumber
```

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_TOP10_Cliente_Anual]
as

declare @t table (rowNumber int,Cliente nvarchar(max),Num int,Ano int)

insert into @t (rowNumber,Cliente,Num,Ano) 
(select top 10 row_number() over (order by count(of_id) desc) as rowNumber,

where year(of_datafim) = year(getdate()) - 1
group by e_nome,
		year(of_datafim))

(select rowNumber, 
	Cliente, 
	count(of_id) as Num, year(of_datafim) as Ano
from ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join @t on e_nome = Cliente
```

```sql
group by rowNumber, 
```
```sql
		Pais, 
		year(of_datafim))
```

```sql
select * from @t order by Ano desc, rowNumber
```

#### `dbo.Report_TotalBarcosPorCliente`(@tipo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_TotalBarcosPorCliente]

@tipo int

as

begin transaction

if (@tipo=1) /* Por Ano */
begin
	select 
		e_id, 
		e_nome,
		year(of_datafim) as Ano,
		coalesce(count(of_id),0) as total
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
	where
		year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate())
	group by 
		e_id, e_nome, year(of_datafim)
	order by 
		year(of_datafim) desc, count(of_id) desc
end
else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */
begin
	select 
		e_id, 
		e_nome,
		(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano,
		coalesce(count(of_id),0) as total
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
	where
		year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate())
	group by 
		e_id, e_nome, (case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end)
	order by 
		(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) desc, count(of_id) desc
end
else if (@tipo=3) /* Homologa Por Época */
begin
	if (month(getdate()) < 9)
		select 
			e_id, 
			e_nome,
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano,
			coalesce(count(of_id),0) as total
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		where
			year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate()) and (month(of_datafim) > 9 or month(of_datafim) <= month(getdate()))
		group by 
			e_id, e_nome, (case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end)
		order by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) desc, count(of_id) desc
	else
		select 
			e_id, 
			e_nome,
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as Ano,
			coalesce(count(of_id),0) as total
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		where
			year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate()) and month(of_datafim) between 9 and month(getdate())
		group by 
			e_id, e_nome, (case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end)
		order by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) desc, count(of_id) desc
end
else if (@tipo=4) /* Homologa Por Ano */
begin
	select 
		e_id, 
		e_nome,
		year(of_datafim) as Ano,
		coalesce(count(of_id),0) as total
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
	where
		year(of_datafim) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate()) and month(of_datafim) between 1 and month(getdate())
	group by 
		e_id, e_nome, year(of_datafim)
	order by 
		year(of_datafim) desc, count(of_id) desc
end

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_TotalPorModelo`(@tipo int, @classe int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_TotalPorModelo]

@tipo int,
@classe int

as
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if (@classe = -1)
begin
	if (@tipo=1) /* Por Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont, 
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			datepart(yy,of_datafim) as epoca, np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			datepart(yy,of_datafim)>(datepart(yy,getdate())-5) 
			and of_datafim is not null and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by 
			np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome, datepart(yy,of_datafim) 
		order by 
			datepart(yy,of_datafim) desc, cont desc
	end
	else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont, 
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as epoca,
			np_nome, 
			m_nome, 
			tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			year(of_datafim) > year(getdate())-5
			and of_datafim is not null  and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome
		order by epoca desc, cont desc
	end
	else if (@tipo=3) /* Por Homologo Época */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont,
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as epoca,
			np_nome, 
			m_nome, 
			tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			year(of_datafim) > year(getdate())-5
			and (month(of_datafim) >= 10 or month(of_datafim) < month(getdate()))
			and of_datafim is not null  and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome
		order by cont desc
	end
	else if (@tipo=4) /* Por Homologo Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont,
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			year(of_datafim) as epoca,
			np_nome, 
			m_nome, 
			tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			year(of_datafim) > year(getdate())-5
			and month(of_datafim) between 1 and month(getdate())
			and of_datafim is not null and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by
			year(of_datafim), np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome 
		order by datepart(yy,of_datafim) desc, cont desc
	end


end
else
begin
	if (@tipo=1) /* Por Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont, 
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			datepart(yy,of_datafim) as epoca, np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			datepart(yy,of_datafim)>(datepart(yy,getdate())-5) 
			and of_datafim is not null and p_tp_id = @classe and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by 
			np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome, datepart(yy,of_datafim) 
		order by 
			datepart(yy,of_datafim) desc, cont desc
	end
	else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont, 
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as epoca,
			np_nome, 
			m_nome, 
			tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			year(of_datafim) > year(getdate())-5
			and of_datafim is not null and p_tp_id = @classe  and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome
		order by epoca desc, cont desc
	end
	else if (@tipo=3) /* Por Homologo Época */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont,
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end) as epoca,
			np_nome, 
			m_nome, 
			tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			year(of_datafim) > year(getdate())-5
			and (month(of_datafim) >= 10 or month(of_datafim) < month(getdate()))
			and of_datafim is not null  and p_tp_id = @classe and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) > 9 then year(of_datafim)+1 else year(of_datafim) end), np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome
		order by cont desc
	end
	else if (@tipo=4) /* Por Homologo Ano */
	begin
		select 
			count(of_id) as cont,
			(((case when np_nome='0' then '' else convert(nvarchar(50), np_nome) + ' ' end)) 
					+ m_nome + (case when tam_nome='UNICO' then '' else (' ' + convert(nvarchar(50), tam_nome)) end)) as Modelo,
			year(of_datafim) as epoca,
			np_nome, 
			m_nome, 
			tam_nome 
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join 
			produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join 
			produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join 
			produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join 
			produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			year(of_datafim) > year(getdate())-5
			and month(of_datafim) between 1 and month(getdate())
			and of_datafim is not null and p_tp_id = @classe and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
		group by
			year(of_datafim), np_nome, m_nome, tam_nome 
		order by datepart(yy,of_datafim) desc, cont desc
	end


end


END
```

#### `dbo.Report_TotalPorModeloConstrucao`(@np nvarchar(100), @m nvarchar(100), @tam nvarchar(100), @ano int, @tipo int, @classe int)

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_TotalPorModeloConstrucao] 

@np nvarchar(50), 
@m nvarchar(50), 
@tam nvarchar(50),

as
begin transaction
if (@classe = -1)

	begin

			count(of_id) as cont,

		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id

		where 
			datepart(yy,of_datafim) = @ano and np_nome = @np and m_nome = @m and tam_nome = @tam
		group by

		order by cont desc
	end
	else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */

			inner join produto_tamanho on p_tam_id = tam_id inner join produto_numero_pocos on p_np_id = np_id inner join produto_modelo on p_m_id = m_id
		where 
			((year(of_datafim) = @ano - 1 and month(of_datafim) >= 10) or
			(year(of_datafim) = @ano and month(of_datafim) < 10))

else
begin

		group by

		order by cont desc

	else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */
	begin

		where

			(year(of_datafim) = @ano and month(of_datafim) < month(getdate())))
			and np_nome=@np and m_nome=@m and tam_nome=@tam and p_tp_id = @classe
		group by p_nome

	if (@tipo=4) /* Por Homologo Ano */
```

#### `dbo.Report_Transporte_Fabrica`(@of_datatransporte smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Transporte_Fabrica]

@of_datatransporte smalldatetime

as
begin
	set nocount on;

select 
	e.e_nome,
	'*' + convert(nvarchar(10), of_id) + '*' as OrdFab,
	tr_data as of_transporte,
	p.p_nome as Modelo,
	dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as CorDeck, p2.p_nome as CorCasco,
	fp.fp_nome as Estado,
	e1.e_nome,
	of_referencia as Referencia,
	substring(p3.p_nome, 0, Charindex(' ',p3.p_nome,0)) as of_embalagem
from
	ordemfabrico inner join
	entidade as e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id inner join
	produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
	--left join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id left join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id 
	left join fases_producao as fp on of_fp_id = fp.fp_id left join
	of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 8 left join
	offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
	entidade as e1 on offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id left join 
	movimento on of_id = mov_of_id and mov_p_id in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 81) left join
	produto as p3 on mov_p_id = p3.p_id inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id
where
	tr_data = @of_datatransporte
order by 
	e.e_nome, Estado, p.p_nome

end
```

#### `dbo.Report_Transportes_Balanco`(@data_i smalldatetime, @data_f smalldatetime, @trtp_trtp_id int, @para_Nos bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-03-24 09:17* · 🔎 `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Transportes_Balanco]

@data_i smalldatetime,
@data_f smalldatetime,
@trtp_trtp_id int,
@para_Nos bit

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		p.paises_nome, m.mais, mn.menos, m.mais - mn.menos, count(t.tr_id) as num, (case when d.docs > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as docs, p.paises_id
	from 
		transporte as t left join paises as p on t.tr_paises_id = p.paises_id 
		left join 
		(select 
				paises_nome, sum(trval_valor) as mais 
			from 
				transporte 
				inner join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id 
				inner join transp_val on tr_id = trval_tr_id 
				inner join valor on trval_val_id = val_id 
				inner join transp_tipo as tp on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
			where 
				val_tpval_id = 1 
				and tr_data between @data_i and @data_f 
				and trtp_trtp_id = @trtp_trtp_id 
				and tr_transporte_nosso = @para_Nos 
			group by 
				paises_nome) as m on m.paises_nome = p.paises_nome
		left join 
		(select 
				paises_nome, sum(trval_valor) as menos 
			from 
				transporte 
				inner join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id 
				inner join transp_val on tr_id = trval_tr_id 
				inner join valor on trval_val_id = val_id 
				inner join transp_tipo as tp on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
			where 
				val_tpval_id = 2 
				and tr_data between @data_i and @data_f 
				and trtp_trtp_id = @trtp_trtp_id 
				and tr_transporte_nosso = @para_Nos 
			group by 
				paises_nome) as mn on mn.paises_nome = p.paises_nome
		inner join transp_tipo as tp on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id left join
		(select 
				tr_paises_id, count(trdoc_docs_id) as docs 
			from 
				transporte 
				left join transp_docs on tr_id = trdoc_tr_id and trdoc_tratado = 0 and tr_data between @data_i and @data_f 
			group by 
				tr_paises_id) as d on d.tr_paises_id = t.tr_paises_id
	where 
		tr_data between @data_i and @data_f and tp.trtp_trtp_id = @trtp_trtp_id and tr_transporte_nosso = @para_Nos --and paises_id <> 197
	group by 
		p.paises_nome, m.mais, mn.menos, m.mais - mn.menos, (case when d.docs > 0 then 1 else 0 end), p.paises_id
	order by 
		p.paises_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Transportes_Balanco_Detalhe`(@data_i smalldatetime, @data_f smalldatetime, @paises_nome nvarchar(max), @trtp_trtp_id int, @para_Nos bit, @verTodos bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Transportes_Balanco_Detalhe]

@data_i smalldatetime,
@data_f smalldatetime,
@paises_nome nvarchar(max),
@trtp_trtp_id int,
@para_Nos bit,
@verTodos bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

select t.tr_id, t.tr_data, t.tr_data_criacao, t.tr_descricao, paises_nome, dest_nome, trtp_nome, e_nome, t.tr_morada, t.tr_observacoes,
		count(of_id) as barcos, d.docs, m.mais, mn.menos, m.mais-mn.menos as valor, fts.facts
from transporte as t left join entidade on t.tr_e_id = e_id left join transp_tipo on t.tr_trtp_id = trtp_id left join transp_destino on t.tr_dest_id = dest_id left join paises on t.tr_paises_id = paises_id left join transp_of on t.tr_id = trof_tr_id left join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id inner join 
	 (select tr_id, count(trdoc_docs_id) as docs from transporte left join transp_docs on tr_id = trdoc_tr_id and trdoc_tratado = 0 group by tr_id) as d on d.tr_id = t.tr_id
	left join (select trval_tr_id, sum(trval_valor) as mais from transp_val inner join valor on trval_val_id = val_id where val_tpval_id = 1 group by trval_tr_id) as m on m.trval_tr_id = t.tr_id
	left join (select trval_tr_id, sum(trval_valor) as menos from transp_val inner join valor on trval_val_id = val_id where val_tpval_id = 2 group by trval_tr_id) as mn on mn.trval_tr_id = t.tr_id
	left join (select tr_id as id, Stuff((SELECT distinct ', ' + OF_FACT + ' - ' + e_nome
					FROM ordemfabrico inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
					where trof_tr_id = tr_id and OF_FACT is not null
					FOR XML path('')),1,1,'') as facts
				from transporte 
				where tr_data between @data_i and @data_f) as fts on t.tr_id = fts.id
where tr_data between @data_i and @data_f and paises_nome like (case when @verTodos = 0 then @paises_nome else '%' end) and trtp_trtp_id = @trtp_trtp_id and tr_transporte_nosso = @para_Nos
group by t.tr_id, t.tr_data, t.tr_data_criacao, t.tr_descricao, paises_nome, dest_nome, trtp_nome, e_nome, t.tr_morada, t.tr_observacoes,d.docs,m.mais, mn.menos, fts.facts
order by paises_nome, t.tr_data desc, t.tr_descricao

END
```

#### `dbo.Report_Transportes_Frederico`(@data datetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-04-07 16:39* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `preco`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE procedure [dbo].[Report_Transportes_Frederico]

@data datetime

as 

begin transaction

	select 
		e_nome as Cliente, tr_descricao, cast(of_id as nvarchar) as OrdFab, tr_descricao as of_transporte, of_data, tp_nome as Classe, p_id as Id, p.p_nome as Modelo, p.p_pesoacab, of_observacoes,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_enc_id as Encomenda,
		tr_data as DataT, of_referencia as Referencia, fp_sequencia,
		/*(case when capa.mov_p_id is null then 'Não' else 'Sim' end)*/ '' as capa, 
		of_transportedoc, oftu_nome, embalagem.p_nome as Embalagem, embalagem.p_pesolam as peso_emb, of_precovenda as p_precovenda, of_fact, of_linhaacab, 
		coalesce(p500.qtd,0) as p5, coalesce(p250.qtd,0) as p25, coalesce(p100.qtd,0) as p1, isnull(ext.val,0) as valExt
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id=p.p_id 
		left join entidade on of_e_id_enc=e_id
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		left join of_tipouso on of_oftu_id = oftu_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id 
		inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id 
		--left join (select mov_p_id, mov_of_id from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where p_tp_id = 74) as capa on of_id = capa.mov_of_id 
		left join (select p_nome, p_pesolam, mov_of_id from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where p_tp_id = 81) as embalagem on of_id = embalagem.mov_of_id 
		left join (select mov_of_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 26037/*20425*/ group by mov_of_id) as p500 on of_id = p500.mov_of_id 
		left join (select mov_of_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 26036 /*20424*/ group by mov_of_id) as p250 on of_id = p250.mov_of_id 
		left join (select mov_of_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 22676 group by mov_of_id) as p100 on of_id = p100.mov_of_id
		left join (select mov_of_id as ofid, sum(mov_precovenda * mov_quantidade) as val from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where (mov_acessorio_adicional = 1 or (mov_atrib_id is not null and mov_precovenda > 0)) group by mov_of_id) as ext on of_id = ext.ofid
	where tr_data=@data
	union
	select 
		e_nome as Cliente, tr_descricao, isnull(mov_shop_order_id, 00000) as OrdFab, tr_descricao as of_transporte, null as of_data, 'ACESSÓRIOS EXTRA' as Classe, 0 as Id, 'ACESSÓRIO' as Modelo, 0 as p_pesoacab, '' as of_observacoes,
		' '  as Estado, 0 as Encomenda, tr_data as DataT, '' as Referencia, 10000 as fp_sequencia, '' as capa, '' as of_transportedoc, '' as oftu_nome, '' as Embalagem, 0 as peso_emb, 
		sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_precovenda = 0 then p_precovenda else mov_precovenda end)) as p_precovenda, '' as of_fact, '' as of_linhaacab, 
	0 as p5, 0 as p25, 0 as p1, 0 as valExt
	from 
		movimento 
		left join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
		inner join transporte on mov_tr_id = tr_id
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
	where 
		tr_data = @data
	group by 
		e_nome, tr_descricao, mov_shop_order_id, tr_data
	order by of_transporte, Cliente, fp_sequencia desc

commit transaction
```

#### `dbo.Report_Transportes_Resumo`(@dt date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_Transportes_Resumo]
	@dt date
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	select 
		cast(tr_data as date) as dt, 
		e_id, 
		e_nome, 
		fp_id, 
		fp_nome, 
		count(of_id) as barcos, 
		sum(of_coeficiente) as coefs, 
		coalesce(ac.acabados,0) as acabados, 
		td.todos, 
		td_fp.todosFP, 
		td_fp.coefsFP, 
		fp_sequencia, 
		(case 
			when of_fp_id <> offp_fp_id and offp_datainicio is null and offp_datafim is null then 'Fut.' 
			when of_fp_id = offp_fp_id and offp_datainicio is null and offp_datafim is null then 'Em esp.' 
			when of_fp_id = offp_fp_id and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null then 'Em proc.' 
			else '!!!' 
		end) as estado, 
		f.h, f.fp_hora_coef
	from 
		transporte 
		inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_datafim is null 
		inner join (select *, dbo.HorasRestantesSemana_Fase(fp_id) as h from fases_producao) as f on offp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select 
						of_e_id_enc as id, 
						count(of_id) as acabados 
					from 
						transporte 
						inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
						inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
						inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
						inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
					where 
						year(@dt) = year(tr_data) 
						and datepart(week,@dt) = datepart(week,tr_data) 
						and fp_sequencia > 22 
						and p_fabricointerno = 1 
					group by 
						of_e_id_enc) as ac on e_id = ac.id
		inner join (select 
						of_e_id_enc as id, 
						count(of_id) as todos 
					from 
						transporte 
						inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
						inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
						inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
					where 
						year(@dt) = year(tr_data) 
						and datepart(week,@dt) = datepart(week,tr_data) 
						and p_fabricointerno = 1 
					group by 
						of_e_id_enc) as td on e_id = td.id
		inner join (select 
						offp_fp_id as id, 
						count(offp_of_id) as todosFP, 
						sum(of_coeficiente) as coefsFP 
					from 
						transporte 
						inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
						inner join of_fp on trof_of_id = offp_of_id 
						inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id
					where 
						year(@dt) = year(tr_data) 
						and datepart(week,@dt) = datepart(week,tr_data) 
						and offp_datafim is null 
					group by 
						offp_fp_id) as td_fp on offp_fp_id = td_fp.id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
	where 
		year(tr_data) between year(dateadd(d,-7,@dt)) and year(@dt)
		and datepart(week,tr_data) between datepart(week,dateadd(d,-7,@dt)) and datepart(week,@dt) 
		and p_fabricointerno = 1 
		and offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where (fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) or fp_sequencia > 22)
	group by 
		cast(tr_data as date), 
		e_id, 
		e_nome, 
		fp_id, 
		fp_nome, 
		coalesce(ac.acabados,0), 
		td.todos, 
		td_fp.todosFP, 
		td_fp.coefsFP, 
		fp_sequencia, 
		(case when of_fp_id <> offp_fp_id and offp_datainicio is null and offp_datafim is null then 'Fut.' when of_fp_id = offp_fp_id and offp_datainicio is null and offp_datafim is null then 'Em esp.' when of_fp_id = offp_fp_id and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null then 'Em proc.' else '!!!' end), 
		f.h, 
		f.fp_hora_coef
	order by 
		e_nome, 
		fp_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Report_VolumeVendasPais`(@tipo int, @paises nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Report_VolumeVendasPais]

@tipo int,
@paises nvarchar(max)

AS

create table #paises
(
	pais nvarchar(max)
)

if (Charindex(',', @paises,2)>0)
begin
	insert into #paises (pais) values (Substring(@paises,0,Charindex(',', @paises,0)))
	set @paises=Substring(@paises,Charindex(',', @paises,2),len(@paises))
end
else
begin
	insert into #paises (pais) values (@paises)
end

while (len(@paises)>2 and Charindex(',', @paises,2)>0)
begin
	insert into #paises (pais) values (Substring(@paises,2,Charindex(',', @paises,2)-2))
	set @paises=Substring(@paises,Charindex(',', @paises,2),len(@paises))
end

insert into #paises (pais) values (Substring(@paises,2,len(@paises)))

create table #prod
(
	pais nvarchar(max),
	ano int,
	vol float
)


if (@tipo=1) /* Por Ano */
begin
	insert into #prod (Pais, Ano, Vol)
	(select 
		e_pais, year(tr_data), coalesce(sum(p_precovenda),0)
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id
	where
		year(tr_data) between year(getdate()) - 3 and year(getdate())
		and e_pais in (select * from #paises)
		and (of_oftu_id is null or of_oftu_id=1 or of_oftu_id=2)
	group by
		e_pais, year(tr_data))
end
else if (@tipo=2) /* Por Época */
begin
	insert into #prod (Pais, Ano, Vol)
	(select 
		e_pais, (case when month(tr_data) > 9 then year(tr_data) + 1 else year(tr_data) end) as epoca, coalesce(sum(p_precovenda),0)
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id
	where
		e_pais in (select * from #paises)
		and (of_oftu_id is null or of_oftu_id=1 or of_oftu_id=2)
		and year(tr_data) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate())
		and tr_data <= getdate()
	group by
		e_pais, (case when month(tr_data) > 9 then year(tr_data) + 1 else year(tr_data) end))
end
else if (@tipo=3) /* Por Homologo Época */
begin
	insert into #prod (Pais, Ano, Vol)
	(select 
		e_pais, (case when month(tr_data) > 9 then year(tr_data) + 1 else year(tr_data) end) as epoca, coalesce(sum(p_precovenda),0)
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id
	where
		(month(tr_data) > 9 or month(tr_data) <= month(getdate())) and
		e_pais in (select * from #paises)
		and (of_oftu_id is null or of_oftu_id=1 or of_oftu_id=2)
		and year(tr_data) between year(getdate())-3 and year(getdate())
	group by
		e_pais, (case when month(tr_data) > 9 then year(tr_data) + 1 else year(tr_data) end))
end
else if (@tipo=4) /* Por Homologo Ano */
begin
	insert into #prod (Pais, Ano, Vol)
	(select
		e_pais, year(tr_data), coalesce(sum(p_precovenda),0)
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id
	where
		year(tr_data) between year(getdate()) - 3 and year(getdate())
		and month(tr_data) <= month(getdate())
		and e_pais in (select * from #paises)
		and (of_oftu_id is null or of_oftu_id=1 or of_oftu_id=2)
	group by
		e_pais, year(tr_data))
end


select * from #prod order by Pais,Ano

drop table #paises
drop table #prod
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Centro`(@res_id int, @res_e_id int, @res_ce_id int, @res_data_ini smalldatetime, @res_data_fim smalldatetime, @res_obs nvarchar(max), @res_tpcr_id int, @res_data_tpcr smalldatetime, @res_tr_id int, @tarefa int, @ce_ce_id int, @res_contacto nvarchar(max), @res_facturado bit, @res_pais_id int, @res_equipa nvarchar(max), @res_obs_fact nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-03-15 16:51* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Centro]

@res_id int = null, 
@res_e_id int = null,  
@res_ce_id int, 
@res_data_ini smalldatetime, 
@res_data_fim smalldatetime, 
@res_obs nvarchar(max) = '',
@res_tpcr_id int = 1,
@res_data_tpcr smalldatetime = null,
@res_tr_id int = null,
@tarefa int, 
@ce_ce_id int, 
@res_contacto nvarchar(max) = '',
@res_facturado bit = 0,
@res_pais_id int = null,
@res_equipa nvarchar(max) = '', 
@res_obs_fact nvarchar(max) = ''

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @ofs bit, --identifica se é a fase em que são atribuidas as OFs
			@data_Tr_nova smalldatetime,
			@res_tr_id_ant int, 
			@entidade int

	set @entidade = (case when @ce_ce_id = 3 then 20070 else 20085 end)

--	set @res_data_ini = convert(varchar(10),@res_data_ini, 1)
--	set @res_data_fim = convert(varchar(10),@res_data_fim, 1)

    if (@tarefa = 0) /*apagar*/
	begin
		delete from centro_modelos_qtd where cm_res_id = @res_id
		delete from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_res_id = @res_id
		delete from centro_reserva where res_id = @res_id
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 1)/*inserir*/
	begin
		insert into centro_reserva (res_e_id, res_ce_id, res_data_ini, res_data_fim, res_obs, res_tpcr_id, res_tr_id, res_contacto, res_facturado, res_pais_id, res_equipa, res_obs_fact)
		values (@res_e_id, @res_ce_id, @res_data_ini, @res_data_fim, @res_obs, @res_tpcr_id, @res_tr_id, @res_contacto, @res_facturado, @res_pais_id, @res_equipa, @res_obs_fact)

		select @res_id = @@identity

		set @ofs = (select tpcr_reserva_barcos from centro_reserva_estado where tpcr_id = @res_tpcr_id)

		set @data_Tr_nova = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @res_tr_id)

		----if (@ofs = 'True') exec Reservas_Reserva_OFs @res_id, @res_data_ini, @res_data_fim, @entidade

		insert into centro_reserva_checklist (crchkl_crchkli_id, crchkl_res_id, crchkl_descr, crchkl_tratado)
		(select crchkli_id, @res_id, crchkli_descr, 0 from centro_reserva_cheklist_items where crchkli_std = 1 and crchkli_eliminado is null)

		if (@res_tr_id is not null) ---- and @ofs = 'True')
		begin

			insert into transp_of (trof_tr_id, trof_of_id) (select @res_tr_id, ro_of_id from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_res_id = @res_id and ro_of_id not in (select trof_of_id from transp_of where trof_tr_id = @res_tr_id))

			update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @res_tr_id from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id 
				left join transp_of on of_tr_id = trof_tr_id left join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id and tr_data > @data_Tr_nova
					where ro_res_id = @res_id
		end
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 2)/*actualizar*/
	begin
		if (@res_tpcr_id <> (select res_tpcr_id from centro_reserva where res_id = @res_id)) 
		begin
			set @res_data_tpcr = getdate()
		end

		set @ofs = (select tpcr_reserva_barcos from centro_reserva_estado where tpcr_id = @res_tpcr_id)

		set @data_Tr_nova = (select tr_data from transporte where tr_id = @res_tr_id)

		set @res_tr_id_ant = (select res_tr_id from centro_reserva where res_id = @res_id)

		if (@res_tr_id is not null) ---- and @ofs = 'True')
		begin
			if (@res_tr_id_ant is null or @res_tr_id = @res_tr_id_ant)
			begin
				insert into transp_of (trof_tr_id, trof_of_id) (select @res_tr_id, ro_of_id from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_res_id = @res_id and ro_of_id not in (select trof_of_id from transp_of where trof_tr_id = @res_tr_id))
				update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @res_tr_id from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id 
					left join transp_of on of_tr_id = trof_tr_id left join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id and tr_data > @data_Tr_nova
						where ro_res_id = @res_id and (of_tr_id = @res_tr_id_ant or of_tr_id is null)
			end
			else if (@res_tr_id <> @res_tr_id_ant)
			begin
				update transp_of set trof_tr_id = @res_tr_id from centro_reserva_ofs inner join transp_of on ro_of_id = trof_of_id where ro_res_id = @res_id and trof_tr_id = @res_tr_id_ant
				insert into transp_of (trof_tr_id, trof_of_id) (select @res_tr_id, ro_of_id from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_res_id = @res_id and ro_of_id not in (select trof_of_id from transp_of where trof_tr_id = @res_tr_id))
				
					update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @res_tr_id from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id 
					left join transp_of on of_tr_id = trof_tr_id left join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id and tr_data > @data_Tr_nova
						where ro_res_id = @res_id and (of_tr_id = @res_tr_id_ant or of_tr_id is null)
			end				
		end
		else if (@res_tr_id is null) ---- or @ofs = 'False')
		begin
			----delete transp_of from centro_reserva inner join centro_reserva_ofs on res_id = ro_res_id inner join transp_of on ro_of_id = trof_of_id where res_id = @res_id

			set @res_tr_id_ant = (select res_tr_id from centro_reserva where res_id = @res_id)

			while exists (select * from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id where of_tr_id = @res_tr_id_ant and ro_res_id = @res_id)
			begin
				declare @tr int, @of int

				set @of = (select top 1 of_id from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id where of_tr_id = @res_tr_id_ant and ro_res_id = @res_id)

				set @tr = (select top 1 tr_id from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id 
							inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id where of_id = @of and tr_data >= getdate() and ro_res_id = @res_id order by tr_data)

				update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @tr where of_id = @of
			end
		end

		update centro_reserva set 
			res_e_id = @res_e_id, res_ce_id = @res_ce_id, res_data_ini = @res_data_ini, res_data_fim = @res_data_fim, res_obs = @res_obs, res_tpcr_id = @res_tpcr_id, 
			res_data_tpcr = isnull(@res_data_tpcr,res_data_tpcr), res_tr_id = @res_tr_id, res_contacto = @res_contacto, res_facturado = @res_facturado, res_pais_id = @res_pais_id, res_equipa = @res_equipa, res_obs_fact = @res_obs_fact
		where res_id = @res_id

		update centro_reserva_ofs set ro_data_ini = @res_data_ini, ro_data_fim = @res_data_fim where ro_res_id = @res_id
	end
	
	select id = @res_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Centro_CheckList`(@crchkl_crchkli_id int, @crchkl_res_id int, @crchkl_descr nvarchar(max), @crchkl_tratado bit, @tarefa int)

```sql
END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Centro_Detalhe`(@res_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-02-21 15:08 · modificado 2022-02-24 13:51* · 🔎 `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Centro_Detalhe]

@res_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		res_id, res_pais_id, isnull(res_equipa,'') res_equipa, res_e_id, res_ce_id, isnull(q.pess,0) pess, res_data_ini, res_data_fim, res_tpcr_id, res_facturado, res_data, res_data_tpcr, 
		coalesce(q.tot,0) as quarto, coalesce(q.t_n,0) as q_nosso, coalesce(t.tot,0) as transfer, coalesce(t.tot_n,0) as nosso, coalesce(qt.tot,0) - coalesce(r.tot,0) as Falta, res_obs, res_tr_id, isnull(res_contacto,'') res_contacto,
		ce_nome, tpcr_nome, ISNULL(cast(cast(tr_data as date) as nvarchar(max)) + ' - ' + tr_descricao, '') transporte, isnull(ps.NAME,'') pais_nome, ISNULL(e_nome,'') e_nome, res_obs_fact
	from 
		centro_reserva 
		inner join CENTRO_RESERVA_ESTADO on RES_TPCR_ID = TPCR_ID
		inner join centro_estagio on res_ce_id = ce_id 
		left join entidade on RES_E_ID = E_ID
		left join PAISES_SITE ps on RES_PAIS_ID = ps.ID
		left join TRANSPORTE on RES_TR_ID = TR_ID
		left join (select 
						crq_res_id, sum((crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) * crq_preco * datediff(dd,crq_data_ent, crq_data_sai)) as tot,	
						sum((crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) * (crq_preco - crq_preco_nosso) * datediff(dd,crq_data_ent, crq_data_sai)) as t_n,
						sum(crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) as pess
					from 
						centro_reserva_quartos 
					group by crq_res_id) as q on res_id = q.crq_res_id 
		left join (select 
						crt_res_id, sum(crt_preco) as tot, sum(crt_preco*coalesce(crtr_valor,1)) as tot_n 
					from 
						centro_reserva_transfer 
						left join centro_reserva_transfer_respons on crt_crtr_id = crtr_id 
					group by crt_res_id) as t on res_id = t.crt_res_id 
		left join (select cm_res_id, sum(cm_qtd) as tot from centro_modelos_qtd group by cm_res_id) as qt on res_id = qt.cm_res_id
		left join (select ro_res_id, count(*) as tot from centro_reserva_ofs group by ro_res_id) as r on res_id = r.ro_res_id
	where 
		RES_ID = @res_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Centro_Lista`(@ce_ce_id int)
