```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Centro_Lista]

@ce_ce_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		res_id, res_pais_id, isnull(res_equipa,'') res_equipa, res_e_id, res_ce_id, isnull(q.pess,0) pess, res_data_ini, res_data_fim, res_tpcr_id, res_facturado, res_data, res_data_tpcr, 
		coalesce(q.tot,0) as quarto, coalesce(q.t_n,0) as q_nosso, coalesce(t.tot,0) as transfer, coalesce(t.tot_n,0) as nosso, coalesce(qt.tot,0) - coalesce(r.tot,0) as Falta, res_obs, res_tr_id, isnull(res_contacto,'') res_contacto,
		ce_nome, tpcr_nome, ISNULL(cast(cast(tr_data as date) as nvarchar(max)) + ' - ' + tr_descricao, '') transporte, isnull(ps.NAME,'') pais_nome, ISNULL(e_nome,'') e_nome
	from 
		centro_reserva 
		inner join CENTRO_RESERVA_ESTADO on RES_TPCR_ID = TPCR_ID
		inner join centro_estagio on res_ce_id = ce_id 
		left join entidade on RES_E_ID = E_ID
		left join PAISES_SITE ps on RES_PAIS_ID = ps.ID
		left join TRANSPORTE on RES_TR_ID = TR_ID
		left join (select 
						crq_res_id, sum((crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) * crq_preco * datediff(dd,crq_data_ent, crq_data_sai)) as tot,	
						sum((crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) * (crq_preco - crq_preco_nosso) * datediff(dd,crq_data_ent, crq_data_sai)) as t_n,
						sum(crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) as pess
					from 
						centro_reserva_quartos 
					group by crq_res_id) as q on res_id = q.crq_res_id 
		left join (select 
						crt_res_id, sum(crt_preco) as tot, sum(crt_preco*coalesce(crtr_valor,1)) as tot_n 
					from 
						centro_reserva_transfer 
						left join centro_reserva_transfer_respons on crt_crtr_id = crtr_id 
					group by crt_res_id) as t on res_id = t.crt_res_id 
		left join (select cm_res_id, sum(cm_qtd) as tot from centro_modelos_qtd group by cm_res_id) as qt on res_id = qt.cm_res_id
		left join (select ro_res_id, count(*) as tot from centro_reserva_ofs group by ro_res_id) as r on res_id = r.ro_res_id
	where 
		ce_ce_id = @ce_ce_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Centro_Lista_Qtds`(@res_id int, @dt_ini smalldatetime, @dt_fim smalldatetime, @ce_ce_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-03-09 11:32* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Centro_Lista_Qtds]

@res_id int,
@dt_ini smalldatetime,
@dt_fim smalldatetime, 
@ce_ce_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @e_id int
	set @e_id = (case when @ce_ce_id = 3 then 20070 else 20085 end)

	declare @disp table (qt int, nome nvarchar(max))

	if (@e_id = 20070)
		insert into @disp (qt, nome)
		select count(of_id) as qtd, p_nome
		from entidade inner join ordemfabrico on e_id = of_e_id_enc inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		where e_id in (20070, 20085, 24909, 28671, 29943) and of_id not in (select distinct ro_of_id from centro_reserva_ofs 
						where ro_res_id = @res_id or ro_data_ini between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or 
										ro_data_fim between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or (ro_data_ini <= @dt_ini and ro_data_fim >= @dt_fim))
		group by p_nome
	else if (@e_id = 20085)
		insert into @disp (qt, nome)
		select count(of_id) as qtd, p_nome
		from entidade inner join ordemfabrico on e_id = of_e_id_enc inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		where e_id in (20070, 20085, 24909, 28671, 29943) and of_id not in (select distinct ro_of_id from centro_reserva_ofs 
						where ro_res_id = @res_id or ro_data_ini between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or 
										ro_data_fim between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or (ro_data_ini <= @dt_ini and ro_data_fim >= @dt_fim))
		group by p_nome

	select cm_id, cm_modelo,
			cm_qtd, coalesce(ofs.cont,0) as atrib, coalesce(sum(qt),0) as qt
	from @disp right join centro_modelos_qtd on nome like cm_modelo left join 
		(select cm_modelo as model, count(of_id) as cont
				from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join centro_modelos_qtd on p_nome like cm_modelo
					where ro_res_id = @res_id and cm_res_id = @res_id group by cm_modelo) as ofs on ofs.model like cm_modelo
	where cm_res_id = @res_id group by cm_id, cm_modelo, cm_qtd, ofs.cont

END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Centro_Qtd`(@cm_id int, @cm_res_id int, @cm_qtd int, @cm_modelo nvarchar(max), @tarefa int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-03-08 14:41* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Centro_Qtd]

@cm_id int = null, 
@cm_res_id int,  
--@cm_np_id int,  
--@cm_m_id int,  
--@cm_tam_id int,  
@cm_qtd int,
@cm_modelo nvarchar(max),
@tarefa int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@tarefa = 0) /*apagar*/
	begin
		declare @tr_id int
		set @tr_id = (select res_tr_id from centro_reserva where res_id = @cm_res_id)

		if (@tr_id is not null)
		begin
			delete transp_of 
				from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id
					where p_nome like @cm_modelo and ro_res_id = @cm_res_id

			update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = null 
				from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
					where p_nome like @cm_modelo and ro_res_id = @cm_res_id and of_tr_id = @tr_id
		end

		delete from centro_modelos_qtd where cm_id = @cm_id

		delete centro_reserva_ofs 
			from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
				where p_nome like @cm_modelo and ro_res_id = @cm_res_id
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 1)/*inserir*/
	begin
		insert into centro_modelos_qtd (cm_res_id, cm_modelo, cm_qtd)
		values (@cm_res_id, @cm_modelo, @cm_qtd)

		set @cm_id = @@IDENTITY
	end
	else if (@tarefa = 2)/*actualizar*/
	begin
		declare @mod nvarchar(max)
		set @mod = (select cm_modelo from centro_modelos_qtd where cm_id = @cm_id)

		if (@mod <> @cm_modelo)
		delete centro_reserva_ofs 
			from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
				where p_nome like @mod and ro_res_id = @cm_res_id

		update centro_modelos_qtd set cm_res_id = @cm_res_id, cm_modelo = @cm_modelo, cm_qtd = @cm_qtd
		where cm_id = @cm_id
	end

	select id = @cm_id
END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Lista_OFs`(@res_id int, @dt_ini smalldatetime, @dt_fim smalldatetime, @modelo nvarchar(max), @tarefa int, @ce_ce_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-02-19 10:21* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Lista_OFs]

@res_id int,
@dt_ini smalldatetime = null,
@dt_fim smalldatetime = null,
@modelo nvarchar(max) = '%',
@tarefa int, 
@ce_ce_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @e_id int
	set @e_id = (case when @ce_ce_id = 3 then 20070 else 20085 end)

	declare @res table (ro_res_id int, ro_of_id int, p_id int, model nvarchar(max), modelo nvarchar(max), cores nvarchar(max), ro_data_ini smalldatetime, ro_data_fim smalldatetime)

	insert into @res (ro_res_id, ro_of_id, p_id, model, modelo, cores, ro_data_ini, ro_data_fim)
	select ro_res_id, ro_of_id, p.p_id, cm_modelo, p.p_nome as modelo, dbo.of_Cores(ro_of_id,0), ro_data_ini, ro_data_fim
	from centro_reserva_ofs inner join ordemfabrico on ro_of_id = of_id inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join centro_modelos_qtd on p_nome like cm_modelo 
		--inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id
	where
		ro_res_id = @res_id and cm_res_id = @res_id

	if (@tarefa = 1) 
		select 
			r.ro_res_id, r.ro_of_id, p_id, model, modelo, cores, r.ro_data_ini, r.ro_data_fim, fp_nome, ce_livre.ce_nome as loca, of_referencia as Ref
		from 
			@res as r 
			inner join ordemfabrico on r.ro_of_id = of_id 
			inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
			left join (select ro_of_id as o, max(ro_data_fim) as data from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_data_fim < @dt_ini group by ro_of_id) as livre on r.ro_of_id = livre.o 
			left join (select ro_res_id as id, ro_of_id as o, ro_data_fim from centro_reserva_ofs) as ro on livre.o = ro.o and livre.data = ro.ro_data_fim 
			left join (select res_id as id, ce_nome from centro_reserva inner join centro_estagio on res_ce_id = ce_id) as ce_livre on ro.id = ce_livre.id
		order by 
			modelo
	else if (@tarefa = 2)
	begin
		if (@e_id = 20070)
			select of_id, p.p_nome as modelo, dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, livre.data as livre, isnull(ce_livre.ce_nome,'') as loca, ocup.data as ocupado, ocupF.dataF as ocupadoF, isnull(ce_ocup.ce_nome,'') as loca1, fp_nome, e_nome, of_referencia as Ref
			from produto as p inner join ordemfabrico on p.p_id = of_p_id inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
				--inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id 
				left join (select ro_of_id as o, max(ro_data_fim) as data from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_data_fim < @dt_ini or ro_data_fim between @dt_ini and @dt_fim group by ro_of_id) as livre on of_id = livre.o left join
				(select ro_res_id as id, ro_of_id as o, ro_data_fim from centro_reserva_ofs) as ro on livre.o = ro.o and livre.data = ro.ro_data_fim left join
				(select res_id as id, ce_nome from centro_reserva inner join centro_estagio on res_ce_id = ce_id) as ce_livre on ro.id = ce_livre.id left join
				(select ro_of_id as o, min(ro_data_ini) as data from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_data_ini >= @dt_ini or @dt_ini between ro_data_ini and ro_data_fim group by ro_of_id) as ocup on of_id = ocup.o left join
				(select ro_of_id as o, ro_data_ini as dataI, ro_data_fim as dataF from centro_reserva_ofs) as ocupF on ocupF.o = ocup.o and ocupF.dataI = ocup.data left join
				(select ro_res_id as id, ro_of_id as o, ro_data_ini from centro_reserva_ofs) as ro1 on ocup.o = ro1.o and ocup.data = ro1.ro_data_ini left join
				(select res_id as id, ce_nome from centro_reserva inner join centro_estagio on res_ce_id = ce_id) as ce_ocup on ro1.id = ce_ocup.id
				 inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
			where p.p_nome like @modelo and of_e_id_enc in (40544, 31903) /*(20070, 20085, 24909, 28671, 29943, 31638, 31903)*/ and of_id not in (select ro_of_id from @res) and OF_ID < 10000000 and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
		else if (@e_id = 20085)
			select of_id, p.p_nome as modelo, dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, livre.data as livre, isnull(ce_livre.ce_nome,'') as loca, ocup.data as ocupado, ocupF.dataF as ocupadoF, isnull(ce_ocup.ce_nome,'') as loca1, fp_nome, e_nome, of_referencia as Ref
			from produto as p inner join ordemfabrico on p.p_id = of_p_id inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
				--inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id 
				left join (select ro_of_id as o, max(ro_data_fim) as data from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_data_fim < @dt_ini or ro_data_fim between @dt_ini and @dt_fim group by ro_of_id) as livre on of_id = livre.o left join
				(select ro_res_id as id, ro_of_id as o, ro_data_fim from centro_reserva_ofs) as ro on livre.o = ro.o and livre.data = ro.ro_data_fim left join
				(select res_id as id, ce_nome from centro_reserva inner join centro_estagio on res_ce_id = ce_id) as ce_livre on ro.id = ce_livre.id left join
				(select ro_of_id as o, min(ro_data_ini) as data from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_data_ini >= @dt_ini or @dt_ini between ro_data_ini and ro_data_fim group by ro_of_id) as ocup on of_id = ocup.o left join
				(select ro_of_id as o, ro_data_ini as dataI, ro_data_fim as dataF from centro_reserva_ofs) as ocupF on ocupF.o = ocup.o and ocupF.dataI = ocup.data left join
				(select ro_res_id as id, ro_of_id as o, ro_data_ini from centro_reserva_ofs) as ro1 on ocup.o = ro1.o and ocup.data = ro1.ro_data_ini left join
				(select res_id as id, ce_nome from centro_reserva inner join centro_estagio on res_ce_id = ce_id) as ce_ocup on ro1.id = ce_ocup.id
				 inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
			where p.p_nome like @modelo and of_e_id_enc in (40544, 31903) /*(20070, 20085, 24909, 28671, 29943, 31638, 31903)*/ and of_id not in (select ro_of_id from @res) and OF_ID < 10000000 and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Reserva_OFs`(@res_id int, @dt_ini smalldatetime, @dt_fim smalldatetime, @e_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Reserva_OFs]

@res_id int, 
@dt_ini smalldatetime, 
@dt_fim smalldatetime, 
@e_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @qtd int, @mod nvarchar(max)

	declare @res table (cm_modelo nvarchar(max), qtd int)

	set @dt_ini = convert(varchar(10),@dt_ini, 1)
	set @dt_fim = convert(varchar(10),@dt_fim, 1)

	insert into @res (cm_modelo, qtd)
	select cm_modelo, cm_qtd - coalesce(count(ro_of_id),0)
	from centro_modelos_qtd inner join produto on p_nome like cm_modelo left join
		ordemfabrico on p_id = of_p_id left join centro_reserva_ofs on of_id = ro_of_id and ro_res_id = @res_id
	where cm_res_id = @res_id
	group by cm_modelo, cm_qtd
	having cm_qtd - coalesce(count(ro_of_id),0) > 0

	while exists(select * from @res)
	begin
		set @mod = ''
		set @qtd = 0

		select top 1 @mod = cm_modelo, @qtd = qtd from @res

		if (@e_id = 20070)
		begin
			insert into centro_reserva_ofs (ro_res_id, ro_of_id, ro_data_ini, ro_data_fim)
			select top (@qtd) @res_id, of_id, @dt_ini, @dt_fim from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			where of_e_id_enc = @e_id and of_id not in (select distinct ro_of_id from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_res_id = @res_id or ro_data_ini between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or ro_data_fim between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or (ro_data_ini <= @dt_ini and ro_data_fim >= @dt_fim)) and
				p_nome like @mod
		end
		else if (@e_id = 20085)
		begin
			insert into centro_reserva_ofs (ro_res_id, ro_of_id, ro_data_ini, ro_data_fim)
			select top (@qtd) @res_id, of_id, @dt_ini, @dt_fim from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
			where of_e_id_enc in (20070, 20085) and of_id not in (select distinct ro_of_id from centro_reserva_ofs where ro_res_id = @res_id or ro_data_ini between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or ro_data_fim between @dt_ini and @dt_fim or (ro_data_ini <= @dt_ini and ro_data_fim >= @dt_fim)) and
				p_nome like @mod
			order by of_e_id_enc desc
		end

		delete from @res where cm_modelo = @mod and qtd = @qtd
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Troca_OFs`(@of_id_act int, @of_id_new int, @res_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Troca_OFs] 

@of_id_act int,
@of_id_new int,
@res_id int

AS

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @tr_id int
	set @tr_id = (select res_tr_id from centro_reserva where res_id = @res_id)

    update centro_reserva_ofs set ro_of_id = @of_id_new where ro_res_id = @res_id and ro_of_id = @of_id_act

	if (@tr_id is not null) 
	begin
		update transp_of set trof_of_id = @of_id_new where trof_tr_id = @tr_id and trof_of_id = @of_id_act

		update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = null where of_id = @of_id_act

		update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @tr_id where of_id = @of_id_new
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Reservas_Verifica_Disponibilidade`(@data_I smalldatetime, @data_F smalldatetime, @centro int, @num_Pess int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Reservas_Verifica_Disponibilidade]
 
@data_I smalldatetime, 
@data_F smalldatetime, 
@centro int, 
@num_Pess int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @t_dias table (dt smalldatetime, ano int, mes int, dia int, num_Pess int)
	declare @dia int, @pess int
	set @dia = 0
	set @pess = 0

	while (@dia <= datediff(dd,@data_I, @data_F))
	begin
		set @pess = (select ce_numpess - coalesce((select sum(crq_single + crq_double * 2 + crq_triple * 3) 
						from centro_reserva_quartos inner join centro_reserva on crq_res_id = res_id
					where dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I) between crq_data_ent and crq_data_sai and res_ce_id = @centro and res_tpcr_id <> 4),0) 
			from centro_estagio where ce_id = @centro)

		insert into @t_dias (dt,ano,mes,dia,num_Pess) values (dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I),year(dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I)), month(dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I)), day(dateadd(dd, @dia, @data_I)), @pess)

		if (@pess < @num_Pess)
		begin
			set @data_I = dateadd(dd, @dia+1, @data_I)
			set @data_F = dateadd(dd, @dia+1, @data_F)
			set @dia = 0
			set @pess = 140
		end
		else
		begin
			set @pess = 140
			set @dia = @dia + 1
		end
	end

	select 'É possivel entre estas datas ' + convert(varchar(10),@data_I,103) + ' e '  + convert(varchar(10),@data_F,103)

END
```

#### `dbo.RevisaoOFs_Lista`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[RevisaoOFs_Lista]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select of_revisto, of_parapintarfora, e_nome, of_referencia, of_id, p.p_nome as modelo, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as deck, p2.p_nome as Casco, 
		count(atch_id) as Anexos, of_observacoes, fpL.offp_observacoes as obsLaminagem, fpP.offp_observacoes as obsPintura, fpC.offp_observacoes as obsColagem, of_datainicio
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id
		left join of_attach on of_id = atch_of_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join of_fp as fpL on of_id = fpL.offp_of_id and fpL.offp_fp_id = 1 inner join of_fp as fpP on of_id = fpP.offp_of_id and fpP.offp_fp_id = 18
		inner join of_fp as fpC on of_id = fpC.offp_of_id and fpC.offp_fp_id = 4
	where (of_observacoes <> '' or fpL.offp_observacoes <> '' or fpP.offp_observacoes <> '' or of_p_id_cdeck = 20577 or of_p_id_ccasco = 20577 or of_supervisaolaminagem = 1) and of_fp_id = 11 and of_revisto = 0
	group by e_nome, of_referencia, of_id, p.p_nome, p1.p_nome, p2.p_nome, of_observacoes, fpL.offp_observacoes, fpP.offp_observacoes, fpC.offp_observacoes, of_datainicio, of_revisto, of_parapintarfora
	order by e_nome, p.p_nome, of_referencia
END
```

#### `dbo.RevisaoOFs_UpdateOF`(@of_revisto bit, @of_parapintarfora bit, @of_id int, @of_referencia nvarchar(max), @of_observacoes nvarchar(max), @obsLaminagem nvarchar(max), @obsPintura nvarchar(max), @obsColagem nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[RevisaoOFs_UpdateOF]

@of_revisto bit, 
@of_parapintarfora bit,
@of_id int,
@of_referencia nvarchar(max), 
@of_observacoes nvarchar(max), 
@obsLaminagem nvarchar(max), 
@obsPintura nvarchar(max), 
@obsColagem  nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Laminagem
    update of_fp set offp_observacoes = @obsLaminagem where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 1
	
	-- Pintura
    update of_fp set offp_observacoes = @obsPintura where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 18
	
	-- Colagem
    update of_fp set offp_observacoes = @obsPintura where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 4

	update ordemfabrico set of_revisto = @of_revisto, of_parapintarfora = @of_parapintarfora, of_referencia = @of_referencia, of_observacoes = @of_observacoes where of_id = @of_id

END
```

#### `dbo.rfid_DetalheTransporte`(@tr_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rfid_DetalheTransporte]
	
	@tr_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select tr_id, trtp_id, trtp_nome, e_nome as transportador, tr_data, tr_descricao, coalesce(ac.acab,0) as carregados, coalesce(tot.t,0) as barcos
	from transporte inner join ordemfabrico on tr_id = of_tr_id left join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id left join entidade on tr_e_id = e_id left join
		(select of_tr_id, count(of_id) as acab from ordemfabrico where of_fp_id = 12 AND of_tr_id = @tr_id group by of_tr_id) as ac on tr_id = ac.of_tr_id left join
		(select trof_tr_id, count(trof_of_id) as t from transp_of inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id where tr_id = @tr_id group by trof_tr_id) as tot on tr_id = tot.trof_tr_id
	where tr_id = @tr_id
	order by tr_data asc, tr_descricao

END
```

#### `dbo.rfid_ListaTransportes`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rfid_ListaTransportes]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @NewLineChar AS CHAR(2) = CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)

    select distinct 
		tr_id, 
		e_nome as transportador, 
		trtp_id, 
		trtp_nome, 
		tr_data, 
		tr_descricao + (case when encs.MOV_TR_ID is not null then @NewLineChar + ' **ACESSÓRIOS**' else '' end)  as tr_descricao, 
		coalesce(ac.acab,0) as carregados, 
		coalesce(tot.t,0) as barcos
	from transporte 
		inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
		left join entidade on tr_e_id = e_id 
		left join (select of_tr_id, count(of_id) as acab from ordemfabrico where of_tr_id is not null and of_fp_id = 12 group by of_tr_id) as ac on tr_id = ac.of_tr_id 
		left join (select trof_tr_id, count(trof_of_id) as t from transp_of inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data >= dateadd(day,-4,getdate()) group by trof_tr_id) as tot on tr_id = tot.trof_tr_id
		left join (select mov_tr_id, count(mov_id) as qtd from movimento where mov_tr_id is not null group by mov_tr_id) as encs on tr_id = encs.MOV_TR_ID 
	where tr_data >= dateadd(day,-4,getdate())
	order by tr_data asc, tr_descricao

END
```

#### `dbo.rfid_OFsTransporte`(@tr_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rfid_OFsTransporte]
	
	@tr_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select of_id, of_tag_id, p_nome, e_nome as cliente, of_referencia, fp_nome, (case when of_fp_id = 12 then 1 else 0 end) as carregado, 1 as o
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where of_tr_id = @tr_id
	union
	select isnull(mov_shop_order_id, 00000), '', 'ACESSÓRIOS EXTRA', e_nome, e_nome, '' as fp_nome, 0 as carregado, 0 as o from movimento left join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id where mov_tr_id = @tr_id
	order by o, p_nome, of_referencia

END
```

#### `dbo.rfid_TagPesquisa`(@tag_id nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rfid_TagPesquisa]
	
	@tag_id nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @of_id int, @p_nome nvarchar(max),  @e_nome nvarchar(max),  @of_referencia nvarchar(max), @of_tr_id int, @trtp_nome nvarchar(max)

    select @of_id = of_id, @p_nome = p_nome, @e_nome = e_nome, @of_referencia = of_referencia, @trtp_nome = trtp_nome, @of_tr_id = of_tr_id
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id left join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id
	where of_tag_id = @tag_id

	if (@of_id is null) select estado = 0, 0, '', '', '' -- não encontrado
	else if (@of_id is not null and @of_tr_id is not null) select estado = 1, @of_id as of_id, @p_nome as p_nome, @e_nome as e_nome, @trtp_nome as trtp_nome, @of_tr_id as of_tr_id
	else if (@of_id is not null and @of_tr_id is null) select estado = 2, @of_id as of_id, @p_nome as p_nome, @e_nome as e_nome, @trtp_nome as trtp_nome, @of_tr_id as of_tr_id

END
```

#### `dbo.rfid_Transporte_OF`(@of_id int, @tr_id int, @dest_id int, @trtp_id int, @e_id int, @pais int, @descricao nvarchar(max), @data smalldatetime, @nosso bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rfid_Transporte_OF]
	
	@of_id int,
	@tr_id int = null,
	@dest_id int = null,
	@trtp_id int = null,
	@e_id int = null,
	@pais int = null, 
	@descricao nvarchar(max) = '',
    @data smalldatetime = null,
	@nosso bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if @tr_id is null
	begin
		if @data is null set @data = convert(smalldatetime,convert(nchar(10),dateadd(day,6 - datepart(weekday,getdate()), getdate()),101))

		exec @tr_id = Transportes_Add @tr_dest_id = @dest_id, @tr_trtp_id = @trtp_id, @tr_e_id = @e_id, @tr_data = @data, @tr_pais = @pais, @tr_descricao = @descricao, @tr_transporte_nosso = @nosso

		exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @of_id = @of_id, @tr_id = @tr_id
	end
	else exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @of_id = @of_id, @tr_id = @tr_id

END
```

#### `dbo.SendMail`(@De varchar(250), @Para nvarchar(max), @CC nvarchar(max), @BCC nvarchar(max), @Assunto nvarchar(400), @Texto nvarchar(max), @HTML smallint, @SourceErro nvarchar(400) OUTPUT, @MsgErro nvarchar(1000) OUTPUT, @Anexo nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-06-27 13:46*

```sql
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--  Data		: 03/10/2007
--  Autor		: 
--  Projecto    : 
--  Descricao 	: Envia Email's
--  Usado em 	: 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
													
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SendMail]
	  @De			varchar(250)	= NULL
	, @Para			nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @CC			nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @BCC			nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @Assunto		nvarchar(200)	= NULL
	, @Texto		nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @HTML			smallint		= NULL	--> (0) Não é html (1) é html

	, @SourceErro	nvarchar(200)	= NULL OUT
	, @MsgErro		nvarchar(500)	= NULL OUT
	, @Anexo        nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL

AS 

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 	 Variáveis Diversas
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	DECLARE   @MsgId		int 
			, @Error		int 
			, @SMTP			nvarchar(200)

	--SET @SMTP = 'mail.novis.pt'
	--SET @SMTP = 'mail.nelo.eu'
	SET @SMTP = 'smtp.gmail.com'
	--SET @SMTP = 'mail.kanguru.pt'
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 	 Validações Diversas
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	IF LEN(ISNULL(@De,''))		= 0	SET @MsgErro = 'Obrigatório definir... De:'
	IF LEN(ISNULL(@Para,''))	= 0	SET @MsgErro = 'Obrigatório definir... Para:'
	IF LEN(ISNULL(@Assunto,''))	= 0	SET @MsgErro = 'Obrigatório definir... Assunto:'
	IF LEN(ISNULL(@Texto,''))	= 0	SET @MsgErro = 'Obrigatório definir... Texto do email'

	IF LEN(ISNULL(@MsgErro,'')) > 0
	Begin
		Raiserror (@MsgErro,16,1)
		Return 1
	End
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 	 Processo
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	EXEC sp_OACreate 'CDO.Message', @MsgId OUT			--> Cria Objecto para enviar mensagem 

	-- Configura Serviço
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendusing").Value','2'			--> Configuração objecto
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpserver").Value', @SMTP		--> Configura  SMTP server

	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpauthenticate").Value', '1'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendusername").Value', 'nelo.production.div@gmail.com'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendpassword").Value', 'ztgwlrqobnjqedrh' --'canoagem'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpusessl").Value', 'True'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpconnectiontimeout").Value', '350'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpserverport").Value', '465'
	
	EXEC sp_OAMethod		@MsgId, 'Configuration.Fields.Update', null																		--> Salva configuração do objecto
	
	DECLARE @outVar INT
	SET @outVar = NULL
if @Anexo is not null
	EXEC sp_OAMethod		@MsgId, 'AddAttachment', @outVar OUT, @Anexo

	-- Define Paramentros do Email
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'From'	  , @De
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'To'		  , @Para
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'BCC'		  , @BCC
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'CC'		  , @CC
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'Subject'	  , @Assunto
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty   @MsgId  , 'MailFormat', 1
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty   @MsgId  , 'ReplyTo', 'nuno.andre@nelo.eu'

	IF ISNULL(@HTML,0) = 0
			EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'TextBody', @Texto
	ELSE	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'HTMLBody', @Texto

	EXEC @Error = sp_OAMethod	@MsgId, 'Send', NULL

	-- Sample error handling. 
	IF @Error <> 0 
		EXEC @Error = sp_OAGetErrorInfo NULL, @SourceErro OUT, @MsgErro OUT 

	-- Destroi Objecto
	EXEC @Error = sp_OADestroy @MsgId 

	IF LEN(ISNULL(@MsgErro,'')) > 0 	Return 1
	Else								Return 0
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SendMail_Comunicacao]
	  @De			varchar(250)	= NULL
	, @Para			nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @CC			nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @BCC			nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @Assunto		nvarchar(200)	= NULL
	, @Texto		nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @HTML			smallint		= NULL	--> (0) Não é html (1)é html
	, @com_id		int
	, @ReplyTo      nvarchar(MAX)	= NULL
	, @SourceErro	nvarchar(200)	= NULL OUT
	, @MsgErro		nvarchar(500)	= NULL OUT

AS

	select @Assunto = com_assunto, @Texto = com_mensagem, @ReplyTo = ISNULL(com_replyto, 'nelo@nelo.eu') from comunicacao where com_id = @com_id

	declare @atch nvarchar(max) = ''

	if exists (select * from comunicacao_anexo where comatch_com_id = @com_id)
	begin
		declare @outvar int, @Anexo nvarchar(MAX)
		declare @tb table (caminho nvarchar(MAX))
		insert into @tb (caminho) (select comatch_origem from comunicacao_anexo where comatch_com_id = @com_id)

		while exists (select * from @tb)
		begin
			SET @outVar = NULL
			set @Anexo = (select top 1 caminho from @tb)

			set @atch += @Anexo + ';'

			delete from @tb where caminho = @Anexo
		end
	end

	set @atch = substring(@atch,0,len(@atch))
	--print @atch

	declare @email nvarchar(max)
	declare @allMails table(email nvarchar(max))
	declare @tMails table(email nvarchar(max))
	declare @erros table(emails nvarchar(max))

	insert into @allMails (email) 
	(select distinct 
		replace(E_EMAIL, ',', ';') 
	from 
		entidade 
		inner join ENT_TP_PROD on e_id = ETP_E_ID 
		inner join comunicacao_produto_tipo on ETP_TP_ID = comtp_tp_id 
	where 
		comtp_com_id = @com_id 
		and len(E_EMAIL) > 6 
		and e_activo = 1 
		AND e_passwd <> ''
		and CHARINDEX(' ', e_email) = 0 
		and CHARINDEX('<', e_email) = 0 
		and CHARINDEX('>', e_email) = 0
		and CHARINDEX('@', e_email) > 0
		and CHARINDEX('.', e_email, CHARINDEX('@', e_email)) > 0)

	set @Para = 'nunandre@gmail.com; nuno.mendes@nelorowing.com; andre.santos@nelo.eu; nuno.ramos@nelo.eu; '

	while exists(select * from @allMails)
	begin
		
		insert into @tMails (email) select top 5 email from @allMails
	
		while exists(select * from @tMails)
		begin
			select top 1 @email = email from @tMails

			set @Para += @email + '; '

			delete from @tMails where email = @email
			delete from @allMails where email = @email
		end

		EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail 
									@profile_name='NELO',
									@recipients='nuno.andre@nelo.eu',
									@blind_copy_recipients = @Para,
									@subject=@Assunto,
									@body=@Texto,
									@body_format = 'HTML',
									@reply_to = @ReplyTo,
									@file_attachments = @atch

		if @@ERROR = 0
		begin
			insert into @erros(emails) values (@Para)
			--insert into @allMails(email) (select a.Number from dbo.fn_SplitStr(@Para, ';') a)
		end

		set @Para = ''
	end
	
	if exists(select * from @erros)
		return 1
	else
	begin
		UPDATE comunicacao SET com_enviado = 1, com_para += @Para WHERE COM_ID = @com_id
			
		return 0
	end
```

```sql
	EXEC sp_OACreate 'CDO.Message', @MsgId OUT			--> Cria Objecto para enviar mensagem

	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpusessl").Value', 'True'

	EXEC sp_OAMethod		@MsgId, 'Configuration.Fields.Update', null																		--> Salva configuração do objecto


	select @Assunto = com_assunto, @Texto = com_mensagem from comunicacao where com_id = @com_id

	if exists (select * from comunicacao_anexo where comatch_com_id = @com_id)

			print @outVar
			delete from @tb where caminho = @Anexo
		end
	end

	--declare @email nvarchar(max)

	--insert into @tMails (email) (select distinct replace(E_EMAIL, ',', ';') from entidade inner join ENT_TP_PROD on e_id = ETP_E_ID inner join comunicacao_produto_tipo on ETP_TP_ID = comtp_tp_id where comtp_com_id = @com_id and len(E_EMAIL) > 6 and e_activo = 1 and CHARINDEX(' ', e_email) = 0 and CHARINDEX('<', e_email) = 0 and CHARINDEX('>', e_email) = 0)
	
	--set @Para = 'nunandre@gmail.com; nuno.mendes@nelorowing.com; andre.santos@nelo.eu; nuno.ramos@nelo.eu; '
	
	--while exists(select * from @tMails)
	--begin
	--	select top 1 @email = email from @tMails

	--	set @Para += @email + '; '

	--	delete from @tMails where email = @email
	--end


	-- Define Paramentros do Email
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'From'	  , @De
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'To'		  , 'nuno.andre@nelo.eu'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'BCC'		  , @Para
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'CC'		  , @CC
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'Subject'	  , @Assunto
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty   @MsgId  , 'MailFormat', 1
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty   @MsgId  , 'ReplyTo', @De
	
	IF ISNULL(@HTML,0) = 0
			EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'TextBody', @Texto
	ELSE	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'HTMLBody', @Texto
	
	EXEC @Error = sp_OAMethod	@MsgId, 'Send', NULL
	
	-- Sample error handling. 
	IF @Error <> 0 
	begin
		EXEC @Error = sp_OAGetErrorInfo NULL, @SourceErro OUT, @MsgErro OUT 
	end
	-- Destroi Objecto
	EXEC @Error = sp_OADestroy @MsgId 

	IF NOT LEN(ISNULL(@MsgErro,'')) > 0

	IF LEN(ISNULL(@MsgErro,'')) > 0 	Return @MsgErro
	Else								Return 0
```

```sql
	IF LEN(ISNULL(@Para,''))	= 0	SET @MsgErro = 'Obrigatório definir... Para:'
	IF LEN(ISNULL(@Assunto,''))	= 0	SET @MsgErro = 'Obrigatório definir... Assunto:'

	IF LEN(ISNULL(@MsgErro,'')) > 0
	Begin
		Raiserror (@MsgErro,16,1)
		Return 1
	End
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 	 Processo

	EXEC sp_OACreate 'CDO.Message', @MsgId OUT			--> Cria Objecto para enviar mensagem 

	-- Configura Serviço
	
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendusing").Value', '2'			--> Configuração objecto
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpserver").Value', @SMTP		--> Configura  SMTP server

	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpauthenticate").Value', '1'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendusername").Value', 'nelo.shipments@gmail.com'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/sendpassword").Value', 'qokbqzptpbeshofu' --'canoagem'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpusessl").Value', 'True'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpconnectiontimeout").Value', '350'
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId, 'Configuration.fields("http://schemas.microsoft.com/cdo/configuration/smtpserverport").Value', '465'
	
	EXEC sp_OAMethod		@MsgId, 'Configuration.Fields.Update', null																		--> Salva configuração do objecto

	if exists (select * from sgidi_pasta inner join sgidi_ficheiro on sgidip_id = sgidif_sgidip_id where sgidif_e_id = @of_e_id_enc and sgidip_tr_id = @tr_id and sgidif_data_eliminado is null) -- and (sgidif_nome like 'FT_%' or sgidif_nome like 'GR_%'))
	begin
		declare @outvar int, @Anexo nvarchar(MAX)

		while exists (select * from @tb)
		begin
			SET @outVar = NULL
			set @Anexo = (select top 1 caminho from @tb)

			EXEC sp_OAMethod		@MsgId, 'AddAttachment', @outVar OUT, @Anexo

			delete from @tb where caminho = @Anexo
		end
	end

	--EXEC sp_OAMethod		@MsgId, 'AddAttachment', @outVar OUT, @Anexo
	
	-- Define Paramentros do Email
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'From'	  , @De
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'To'		  , @Para
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'BCC'		  , @BCC
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'CC'		  , @CC
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'Subject'	  , @Assunto
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty   @MsgId  , 'MailFormat', 1
	EXEC sp_OASetProperty   @MsgId  , 'ReplyTo', 'nuno.andre@nelo.eu;nuno.veloso@nelo.eu;andre.santos@nelo.eu'

	IF ISNULL(@HTML,0) = 0
			EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'TextBody', @Texto
	ELSE	EXEC sp_OASetProperty	@MsgId	, 'HTMLBody', @Texto

	EXEC @Error = sp_OAMethod	@MsgId, 'Send', NULL

	-- Sample error handling. 
	IF @Error <> 0 
		EXEC @Error = sp_OAGetErrorInfo NULL, @SourceErro OUT, @MsgErro OUT 

	-- Destroi Objecto
	EXEC @Error = sp_OADestroy @MsgId 

	IF NOT LEN(ISNULL(@MsgErro,'')) > 0 UPDATE TRANSPORTE SET TR_DOCSENVIADOS = 1 WHERE TR_ID = @tr_id

	IF LEN(ISNULL(@MsgErro,'')) > 0 	Return 1
	Else								Return 0
```

#### `dbo.SGIDI_Div`(@sgidi_id int, @sgidi_descricao nvarchar(max), @sgidi_data smalldatetime, @sgidi_e_id int, @sgidi_sgiditp_id int, @sgidi_imagem nvarchar(max), @tarefa int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SGIDI_Div]

@sgidi_id int = null, 
@sgidi_descricao nvarchar(max), 
@sgidi_data smalldatetime, 
@sgidi_e_id int, 
@sgidi_sgiditp_id int,
@sgidi_imagem nvarchar(max)=null, 
@tarefa int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@tarefa = 0) --insert
		insert into sgidi (sgidi_descricao, sgidi_data, sgidi_e_id, sgidi_sgiditp_id, sgidi_imagem)
		values (@sgidi_descricao, @sgidi_data, @sgidi_e_id, @sgidi_sgiditp_id, @sgidi_imagem)
	else if (@tarefa = 1) --update
		update sgidi set sgidi_descricao = @sgidi_descricao, sgidi_data = @sgidi_data, sgidi_e_id = @sgidi_e_id,
			sgidi_sgiditp_id = @sgidi_sgiditp_id, sgidi_imagem = @sgidi_imagem
		where sgidi_id = @sgidi_id
	else if (@tarefa = 2) --delete
		delete from sgidi where sgidi_id = @sgidi_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Sincroniza_Cartoes_RFID`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-03-17 15:07*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Sincroniza_Cartoes_RFID] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	--Verifica e corrige cartões com menos de 10 digitos na BD Innux
	update [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] set CartaoAlternativo = substring('0000000000', 9-len(CartaoAlternativo), 10-len(CartaoAlternativo))  + CartaoAlternativo where len(CartaoAlternativo) < 10

	-- Sincroniza tabela Entidade com BD Innux
    update entidade set e_cartao_rfid = cast(isnull(f.CartaoAlternativo,'') as nvarchar(max))
	--select f.CartaoAlternativo 
	from 
		entidade 
		inner join ENTIDADE_TIPO on E_ENT_ID = ENT_ID
		left join Innux.dbo.Funcionarios as f on cast(e_id as nvarchar(10)) = f.Numero
	where
		ENT_ENT_ID = 19

	update entidade set e_cartao_rfid = '0' where len(e_cartao_rfid) < 5

	-- Sincroniza tabela AspNetUsers com BD Innux
    update [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUsers] set [CartaoRfid] = E_CARTAO_RFID /*cast(f.CartaoAlternativo as nvarchar(max))*/, Name = e_nome
	--select *
	from 
		[MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUsers] 
		--inner join Innux.dbo.Funcionarios as f on cast([ExternalIdUser] as nvarchar(10)) = f.Numero 
		inner join entidade on ExternalIdUser = e_id
	where 
		isnull([CartaoRfid],'') <> E_CARTAO_RFID --cast(f.CartaoAlternativo as nvarchar(max)) 
		or Name <> e_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.sp_alterdiagram`(@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int, @version int, @definition varbinary(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-04-04 10:04 · modificado 2022-04-04 10:04*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_alterdiagram
	(
		@diagramname 	sysname,
		@owner_id	int	= null,
		@version 	int,
		@definition 	varbinary(max)
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on
	
		declare @theId 			int
		declare @retval 		int
		declare @IsDbo 			int
		
		declare @UIDFound 		int
		declare @DiagId			int
		declare @ShouldChangeUID	int
	
		if(@diagramname is null)
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Invalid ARG', 16, 1)
			return -1
		end
	
		execute as caller;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID();	 
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner'); 
		if(@owner_id is null)
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		revert;
	
		select @ShouldChangeUID = 0
		select @DiagId = diagram_id, @UIDFound = principal_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @owner_id and name = @diagramname 
		
		if(@DiagId IS NULL or (@IsDbo = 0 and @theId <> @UIDFound))
		begin
			RAISERROR ('Diagram does not exist or you do not have permission.', 16, 1);
			return -3
		end
	
		if(@IsDbo <> 0)
		begin
			if(@UIDFound is null or USER_NAME(@UIDFound) is null) -- invalid principal_id
			begin
				select @ShouldChangeUID = 1 ;
			end
		end

		-- update dds data			
		update dbo.sysdiagrams set definition = @definition where diagram_id = @DiagId ;

		-- change owner
		if(@ShouldChangeUID = 1)
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set principal_id = @theId where diagram_id = @DiagId ;

		-- update dds version
		if(@version is not null)
			update dbo.sysdiagrams set version = @version where diagram_id = @DiagId ;

		return 0
	END
```

#### `dbo.sp_creatediagram`(@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int, @version int, @definition varbinary(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-04-04 10:04 · modificado 2022-04-04 10:04*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_creatediagram
	(
		@diagramname 	sysname,
		@owner_id		int	= null, 	
		@version 		int,
		@definition 	varbinary(max)
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS 'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		set nocount on
	
		declare @theId int
		declare @retval int
		declare @IsDbo	int
		declare @userName sysname
		if(@version is null or @diagramname is null)
		begin
			RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1);
			return -1
		end
	
		execute as caller;
		select @theId = DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(); 
		select @IsDbo = IS_MEMBER(N'db_owner');
		revert; 
		
		if @owner_id is null
		begin
			select @owner_id = @theId;
		end
		else
		begin
			if @theId <> @owner_id
			begin
				if @IsDbo = 0
				begin
					RAISERROR (N'E_INVALIDARG', 16, 1);
					return -1
				end
				select @theId = @owner_id
			end
		end
		-- next 2 line only for test, will be removed after define name unique
		if EXISTS(select diagram_id from dbo.sysdiagrams where principal_id = @theId and name = @diagramname)
		begin
			RAISERROR ('The name is already used.', 16, 1);
			return -2
		end
	
		insert into dbo.sysdiagrams(name, principal_id , version, definition)
				VALUES(@diagramname, @theId, @version, @definition) ;
		
		select @retval = @@IDENTITY 
		return @retval
	END
```

#### `dbo.sp_helpdiagrams`(@diagramname sysname, @owner_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-04-04 10:04 · modificado 2022-04-04 10:04*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_helpdiagrams
	(
		@diagramname sysname = NULL,
		@owner_id int = NULL
	)
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @user sysname
		DECLARE @dboLogin bit
		EXECUTE AS CALLER;
			SET @user = USER_NAME();
			SET @dboLogin = CONVERT(bit,IS_MEMBER('db_owner'));
		REVERT;
		SELECT
			[Database] = DB_NAME(),
			[Name] = name,
			[ID] = diagram_id,
			[Owner] = USER_NAME(principal_id),
			[OwnerID] = principal_id
		FROM
			sysdiagrams
		WHERE
			(@dboLogin = 1 OR USER_NAME(principal_id) = @user) AND
			(@diagramname IS NULL OR name = @diagramname) AND
			(@owner_id IS NULL OR principal_id = @owner_id)
		ORDER BY
			4, 5, 1
	END
```

```sql
	END
```

#### `dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-04-04 10:04 · modificado 2022-04-04 10:04*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams
	AS
	BEGIN
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagrams') IS NOT NULL
			return 0;
	
		CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagrams
		(
			name sysname NOT NULL,
			principal_id int NOT NULL,	-- we may change it to varbinary(85)
			diagram_id int PRIMARY KEY IDENTITY,
			version int,
	
			definition varbinary(max)
			CONSTRAINT UK_principal_name UNIQUE
			(
				principal_id,
				name
			)
		);


		/* Add this if we need to have some form of extended properties for diagrams */
		/*
		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.sysdiagram_properties') IS NULL
		BEGIN
			CREATE TABLE dbo.sysdiagram_properties
			(
				diagram_id int,
				name sysname,
				value varbinary(max) NOT NULL
			)
		END
		*/

		IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.dtproperties') IS NOT NULL
		begin
			insert into dbo.sysdiagrams
			(
				[name],
				[principal_id],
				[version],
				[definition]
			)
			select	 
				convert(sysname, dgnm.[uvalue]),
				DATABASE_PRINCIPAL_ID(N'dbo'),			-- will change to the sid of sa
				0,							-- zero for old format, dgdef.[version],
				dgdef.[lvalue]
			from dbo.[dtproperties] dgnm
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dggd on dggd.[property] = 'DtgSchemaGUID' and dggd.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]	
				inner join dbo.[dtproperties] dgdef on dgdef.[property] = 'DtgSchemaDATA' and dgdef.[objectid] = dgnm.[objectid]
				
			where dgnm.[property] = 'DtgSchemaNAME' and dggd.[uvalue] like N'_EA3E6268-D998-11CE-9454-00AA00A3F36E_' 
			return 2;
		end
		return 1;
	END
```

#### `dbo.Stock_Armazem_Produto`(@p_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-19 11:20*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Stock_Armazem_Produto]

@p_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select arm_id as Id, arm_nome as Armazem, cast(coalesce(ent.tot,0) - coalesce(sai.tot,0) as decimal(10,2)) as Stock
	from
		armazem left join 
		(select mov_arm_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_p_id = @p_id and mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_arm_id) as ent on arm_id = ent.mov_arm_id left join
		(select mov_arm_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot from movimento where mov_p_id = @p_id and mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_arm_id) as sai on arm_id = sai.mov_arm_id
	where arm_activo = 1
END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[StockMinBarcos_Lista]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, p_stockmin, 
	(select count(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_p_id = p_id and of_e_id_enc = 20334) as stock, 
	(select count(of_id) from ordemfabrico where of_p_id = p_id and of_e_id_enc = 20334) - p_stockmin as dif
	from produto_tipo inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id where p_tp_id in (8,9) and p_activo = 1 and p_stockmin > 0 order by tp_nome, p_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.task_AcertaPrecosMovimentos`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-09 09:48* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[task_AcertaPrecosMovimentos] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dt smalldatetime
	set @dt = dateadd(day,-1,getdate())

	declare @t table (id int, preco float)

	insert into @t (id, preco)
	select 
		mov_id, dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id 
		inner join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id
	where 
		mov_tpmov_id = 2 
		and tp_tp_id in (2,51) 
		and p_fabricointerno = 0 
		and p_tem_stock = 1 
		and mov_data >= @dt 
		and mov_precounitario <> dbo.mov_preco(mov_p_id,mov_data)
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome, mov_data

	update 
		movimento 
	set 
		mov_precounitario = preco 
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join @t on mov_id = id 
	where 
		mov_precounitario <> preco

END
```

#### `dbo.task_ConvertePDFs`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[task_ConvertePDFs]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @t table (id_attach int, id_of nvarchar(max)) 
	insert into @t (id_attach, id_of)(select atch_id, cast(atch_of_id as nvarchar(max)) from OF_ATTACH inner join ordemfabrico on atch_of_id = of_id where ATCH_IMAGE like '%.pdf' and (ATCH_TIPO <> 4 or ATCH_TIPO is null) and year(of_data) >= 2017 group by atch_id, atch_of_id)

	declare @of_id nvarchar(max), @atch_id int

	while exists (select * from @t)
	begin
		select top 1 @of_id = id_of, @atch_id = id_attach from @t
		if len(@of_id) > 0
		begin		
			exec WebService_Call @atch_id, 'http://producao.nelo.eu/api/OF/GenImagens/'
			delete from @t where id_attach = @atch_id
			--print @of_id
		end
		--WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:05'
	end

	delete @t
	insert into @t (id_attach, id_of)(select atch_id, cast(atch_of_id as nvarchar(max)) from OF_ATTACH inner join ordemfabrico on atch_of_id = of_id where (ATCH_IMAGE like '%.doc' or ATCH_IMAGE like '%.docx' or ATCH_IMAGE like '%.xls' or ATCH_IMAGE like '%.xlsx' or ATCH_IMAGE like '%.eps') and (ATCH_TIPO <> 4 or ATCH_TIPO is null) and cast(of_data as date) = cast(getdate() as date) group by atch_id, atch_of_id)

	
	while exists (select * from @t)
	begin
		select top 1 @of_id = id_of, @atch_id = id_attach from @t
		if len(@of_id) > 0
		begin		
			exec WebService_Call @atch_id, 'http://producao.nelo.eu/api/OF/GenPDF/'
			delete from @t where id_attach = @atch_id
			--print @of_id
		end
		--WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:05'
	end

	update of_fp set OFFP_PLANEAMENTO = 1 where offp_fp_id = 1 and OFFP_PLANEAMENTO = 0

END
```

#### `dbo.task_Correccoes_OFs`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[task_Correccoes_OFs]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	/* Corrige Armazem sem data de inicio */
	update of_fp set offp_datainicio = of_datafim
	from
	(select of_id, of_datafim from ordemfabrico where of_fp_id in (9,10,12,13,14) and 
		of_id not in (select distinct offp_of_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 9 and offp_datainicio is not null) and 
		of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and year(of_data) > year(getdate())-3) as tb inner join
		(select offp_of_id as ofid, min(offp_ordem) as ord from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 9 and offp_datainicio is null group by offp_of_id) as ff on tb.OF_ID = ff.ofid
		inner join of_fp on ff.ofid = offp_of_id and offp_ordem = ff.ord
	where offp_fp_id = 9


	/* Corrige Entregue sem data de inicio */
	update of_fp set offp_datainicio = of_datafim
	from
	(select of_id, of_datafim from ordemfabrico where of_fp_id in (12,13,14) and 
		of_id not in (select distinct offp_of_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 12 and offp_datainicio is not null) and 
		of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and year(of_data) > year(getdate())-3) as tb inner join
		(select offp_of_id as ofid, min(offp_ordem) as ord from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 12 and offp_datainicio is null group by offp_of_id) as ff on tb.OF_ID = ff.ofid
		inner join of_fp on ff.ofid = offp_of_id and offp_ordem = ff.ord
	where offp_fp_id = 12


	/*	Insere pintura fora nos "para pintar fora"	*/
	declare curcapa cursor for
	select distinct of_id from ordemfabrico inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id in (4,8) where of_parapintarfora = 1 and of_id not in (select distinct offp_of_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 35) and fp_sequencia < 14

	open curcapa
	declare @of_id int, @offp_id int, @offp_ordem int

	fetch next from curcapa into @of_id while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		if (select count(offp_id) from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 4 and offp_of_id = @of_id) > 1
		begin
			select top 1 @offp_id = offp_id, @offp_ordem = offp_ordem from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 4 and offp_of_id = @of_id order by offp_ordem desc
			update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @offp_ordem
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, 35, @offp_ordem)
		end
		else 
		begin
			select top 1 @offp_id = offp_id, @offp_ordem = offp_ordem from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 8 and offp_of_id = @of_id order by offp_ordem desc
			update of_fp set offp_ordem = offp_ordem + 1 where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_ordem >= @offp_ordem
			insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_ordem) values (@of_id, 35, @offp_ordem)
		end

	fetch next from curcapa into @of_id
	end
	close curcapa
	deallocate curcapa

END
```

#### `dbo.Task_EntidadePHC_Facturacao`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-11-06 14:04 · modificado 2023-10-13 12:02* · 🔎 `disciplina`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_EntidadePHC_Facturacao]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @data_i date = cast(year(getdate())-1 as nvarchar(max)) + '/01/01', @data_f date = getdate()

	delete from ENTIDADE_PHC_FACT where EPHCF_ANO >= YEAR(@data_i)

	insert into [dbo].[ENTIDADE_PHC_FACT] ([EPHCF_EPHC_ID], [EPHCF_ANO], [EPHCF_MES], [EPHCF_DIA], [EPHCF_EPOCA], [EPHCF_TP_ID_DISCIP], [EPHCF_TP_ID], [EPHCF_FACTURADO])
	select 
		EPHC_ID,
		year(ft.ousrdata) as Ano,
		month(ft.ousrdata) as Mes,
		day(ft.ousrdata) as dia,
		case when month(ft.ousrdata) > 9 then year(ft.ousrdata) + 1 else year(ft.ousrdata) end as epoca,
		p_tp_id_disciplina as id_disciplina,
		p_tp_id,
		round(convert(float,sum(fi.esltt * (case when ft.ndoc = 4 then -1 else 1 end))),2) as TotalSemIva
	from
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.fno = ft.fno and fi.ndoc = ft.ndoc
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st on fi.ref = st.ref
		left join ENTIDADE_PHC on no = EPHC_PHC_ID
		left join produto on st.u_idprod = p_id
	where 
		ft.anulado = 0 
		and ft.ndoc in (1,4) 
		and cast(ft.ousrdata as date) between @data_i and @data_f
		and fi.ref <> 'AAA'
		and fi.ref <> 'BOATASS'
		and ft.fno not in (select 
								distinct fno 
							from 
								[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi 
							where 
								design like '%Only%' 
								or design like '%só para%' 
								or design like '%fins ad%' 
								or design like '%purpose%' 
								or design like '%consignment%')
	group by 
		EPHC_ID,
		p_id,
		p_tp_id_disciplina,
		p_tp_id, 
		year(ft.ousrdata), 
		month(ft.ousrdata),
		day(ft.ousrdata)
END
```

#### `dbo.Task_Faltas_Dia_Seguinte`()

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_Faltas_Dia_Seguinte] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	if datepart(DW,getdate()) between 2 and 6
	begin
		if exists(select 
							E_ID as ID, E_NOME as Funcionario, ent_nome	as Funcao, MET_NOME as Tipo, MOVENT_DATA_I as Data_I, MOVENT_DATA_F as Data_F, MOVENT_OBSERVACOES as Obs
						from 
							ENTIDADE
							inner join ENT_MOV on E_ID = MOVENT_E_ID
							inner join ENT_MOV_TIPO on MOVENT_MET_ID = MET_ID
							inner join ENTIDADE_TIPO on E_ENT_ID = ENT_ID 
						where
							cast(MOVENT_DATA_I as date) = CAST(dateadd(day,(case when datepart(DW,getdate()) = 6 then 3 else 1 end),getdate()) as date)
							and MET_MET_ID in (2,14))
		begin
			DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max); 
			SET @html =  
			N'<html><head><title>Funcionários que vão faltar amanhã:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
			N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
			N'<h3>Funcionários:</h3>' + 
			N'<font size="2" face="Arial" >' +
			N'<h7><table border="1">' + 
			N'<tr>' + 
				N'<th width="50">ID</th>' + 
				N'<th width="200">Funcionário</th>' + 
				N'<th width="110">Função</th>' + 
				N'<th width="110">Tipo</th>' + 
				N'<th width="110">Data I.</th>' +  
				N'<th width="110">Data F.</th>' +  
				N'<th width="40">Horas</th>' + 
				N'<th width="200">Obs.</th>' + 
			N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 
 
			SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
							(select 
								[@bgcolor] = (case when ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by e_nome)%2 = 1 then  '#d3d3d3' else 'white' end),
								'',
								td = e_id,
								'',
								td = e_nome,
								'',
								td = ent_nome,
								'',
								td = met_nome,
								'',
								td = CONVERT(nchar(16), MOVENT_DATA_I, 20),
								'',
								td = CONVERT(nchar(16), MOVENT_DATA_F, 20),
								'',
								td = case when DATEPART(hour,MOVENT_DATA_I) < 12 and DATEPART(hour,MOVENT_DATA_F) > 13 then DATEDIFF(hour,MOVENT_DATA_I, MOVENT_DATA_F) - 1 else DATEDIFF(hour,MOVENT_DATA_I, MOVENT_DATA_F) end,
								'',
								td = MOVENT_OBSERVACOES
			from 
				ENTIDADE
				inner join ENT_MOV on E_ID = MOVENT_E_ID
				inner join ENT_MOV_TIPO on MOVENT_MET_ID = MET_ID
				inner join ENTIDADE_TIPO on E_ENT_ID = ENT_ID 
			where
				cast(MOVENT_DATA_I as date) = CAST(dateadd(day,(case when datepart(DW,getdate()) = 6 then 3 else 1 end),getdate()) as date)
				and MET_MET_ID in (2,14)
			order by 
				e_nome FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		
			declare @body nvarchar(max)
			SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) +  
						N'</table></font></body></html>';
		
		--select @body
		declare @subject nvarchar(max) = 'Funcionários que vão faltar no dia: ' + cast(CAST(dateadd(day,(case when datepart(DW,getdate()) = 6 then 3 else 1 end),getdate()) as date) as nvarchar(max))

			exec SendMail 
				@De ='nelo.production.div@gmail.com', 
				--@Para = 'nunandre@gmail.com',
				@Para ='tiago.gomes@nelo.eu; alexcosta.nelo@gmail.com;nunandre@gmail.com;andre.santos@nelo.eu;nuno.veloso@nelo.eu;sergio.vale.25@hotmail.com;jone.nelo@gmail.com;nuno.ramos@nelo.eu;marto.fontes@gmail.com',
				@CC = 'andre.santos@nelo.eu',
				@BCC = null,
				@Assunto = @subject,
				@Texto = @body, 
				@HTML = 1, 
				@SourceErro = null, 
				@MsgErro = null, 
				@Anexo = null
		end
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Task_Fase_Erros_Dia`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-07-23 15:38 · modificado 2025-01-28 15:22* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `peso`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_Fase_Erros_Dia] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if exists(SELECT * FROM dbo.fase_Erros_Dia(1,dateadd(day,-1,GETDATE())))
	begin
		declare @t table (of_id int, offp_datafim date, p_nome nvarchar(max), e_nome nvarchar(max), ofch_descr nvarchar(max), ofch_gravidade nvarchar(max), ord int, cor int, constEntrou nvarchar(max), constSaiu nvarchar(max))
		insert into @t (of_id, offp_datafim, p_nome, e_nome, ofch_descr, ofch_gravidade, ord, constEntrou)
		SELECT 
			a.of_id, a.offp_datafim, 
			a.p_nome + ' (' + cast(isnull(OFFP_PESO,0) as nvarchar(max)) + ' kg ideal: ' + cast(p.P_PESOLAM as nvarchar(max)) + ' kg)' + case when IdConstrucao is null then '' else ' ** Construção alterada **' end, 
			e_nome, ofch_descr, ofch_gravidade, ord,
			'<table border="1"><tr><th>Id</th><th width="100%">Produto</th><th>Unidade</th><th>Entrou</th><th>Saiu</th></tr>' + (select
										cast('<td>' + cast(IdProduto as nvarchar(max)) + ' </td><td>' + Produto + ' </td><td>' + Unidade + ' </td><td>' + cast(sum(case when x = 'Entrou' then QtdOf else 0 end) as nvarchar(max)) + ' </td><td>' + cast(sum(case when x = 'Saiu' then QtdOf else 0 end) as nvarchar(max))  + '</td>' as xml)
									from dbo.of_AlteracoesConstrucao_v2(a.of_id)
									group by IdConstrucao, IdProduto, Produto,Unidade 
									order by Produto 
									FOR XML path(N'tr')) + '</table>'
		FROM 
			dbo.fase_Erros_Dia(1,dateadd(day,-1,GETDATE())) a 
			inner join ORDEMFABRICO o on a.OF_ID = o.OF_ID
			inner join produto p on o.OF_P_ID = p.P_ID
			left join of_fp on a.OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID and OFFP_FP_ID = 6 
			outer apply (select top 1
								p_id IdConstrucao
							from
								dbo.of_AlteracoesConstrucao(o.of_id)) ax
		order by 
			e_nome, a.OF_ID, ofch_descr

		declare @row int = 1, @of_ant int = 0, @cor_ant int = 0, @nRows int = @@Rowcount

		while @row <= @nRows
		begin
			if @row > 1
				select @of_ant = of_id, @cor_ant = cor from @t where ord = @row - 1

			update @t set cor = (case when @of_ant = of_id or @row = 1 then @cor_ant when @cor_ant = 0 then 1 else 0 end) where ord = @row

			set @row += 1
		end

		DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max); 
		SET @html =  
		N'<html><head><title>Avaliação diária, erros de Laminagem:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
		N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
		N'<h3>Avaliação diária, erros de Laminagem:</h3>' + 
		N'<font size="2" face="Arial" >' +
		N'<h7><table border="1">' + 
		N'<tr>' + 
			N'<th width="50">OF</th>' + 
			N'<th width="110">Data Lam.</th>' + 
			N'<th width="300">Modelo</th>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Funcionário</th>' + 
			N'<th width="150">Problema</th>' + 
			N'<th width="110">Gravidade</th>' + 
			N'<th width="600">Construcao</th>' +
		N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 
 
		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
						(select 
							[@bgcolor] = (case when cor = 0 then  '#d3d3d3' else 'white' end),
							'',
							td = of_id,
							'',
							td = CONVERT(nchar(16), offp_datafim, 20),
							'',
							td = p_nome,
							'',
							td = e_nome,
							'',
							td = ofch_descr,
							'',
							td = ofch_gravidade,
							'',
							td = isnull(convert(xml,constEntrou),'')
		from
			@t --dbo.fase_Erros_Dia(1,GETDATE())
		order by 
			e_nome, OF_ID, ofch_descr FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		--select @table
		
		declare @body nvarchar(max)
		SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) +  
					N'</table></font></body></html>';
		
		--select @body
		declare @subject nvarchar(max) = 'Avaliação diária, erros de Laminagem: ' + cast(CAST(getdate() as date) as nvarchar(max))

		exec SendMail 
			@De ='nelo.prodution.div@gmail.com', 
			@Para = 'jmartins71988@gmail.com; guilherme.ramos@nelo.eu', --'miguelrodrigues23@hotmail.com',
			@CC = 'andre.santos@nelo.eu',
			@BCC = 'nunandre@gmail.com', --
			@Assunto = @subject,
			@Texto = @body, 
			@HTML = 1, 
			@SourceErro = null, 
			@MsgErro = null, 
			@Anexo = null
	end
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_Kits_Fase_Dia] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	
	declare @t table(OfId int, Modelo nvarchar(max), Cliente nvarchar(max), Fase nvarchar(max), Alteracoes nvarchar(max))

	insert into @t
	select * from 
	(select distinct offp_of_id, p_nome, e_nome, fp_nome,
		'<table border="1"><tr><th>Id</th><th width="100%">Produto</th><th>Unidade</th><th>Entrou</th><th>Total EUR</th><th>Saiu</th><th>Total EUR</th></tr>' + (select
						cast('<td>' + cast(IdProduto as nvarchar(max)) + ' </td><td>' + Produto + ' </td><td>' + Unidade + ' </td><td>' + cast(sum(case when x = 'Entrou' then QtdOf else 0 end) as nvarchar(max)) + ' </td><td>' + cast(round(sum(case when x = 'Entrou' then QtdOf * PrecoUni else 0 end),2) as nvarchar(max)) + '</td><td>' + cast(sum(case when x = 'Saiu' then QtdOf else 0 end) as nvarchar(max)) + ' </td><td>' + cast(round(sum(case when x = 'Saiu' then QtdOf * PrecoUni else 0 end),2) as nvarchar(max)) + '</td>' as xml)
					from dbo.of_AlteracoesFase(offp_of_id)
					group by IdConstrucao, IdProduto, Produto,Unidade 
					order by Produto 
					FOR XML path(N'tr')) + '</table>' zx
	from
		of_fp
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on offp_fp_id = fp_id
		inner join movimento on offp_of_id = mov_of_id and mov_fp_id = offp_fp_id
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
	where
		year(offp_datafim) = year(dateadd(day,-7,getdate()))
		and datepart(week,offp_datafim) = datepart(week,dateadd(day,-7,getdate()))
		--cast(offp_datafim as date) = cast(dateadd(day,-1,getdate()) as date)
		and mov_p_id in (53561,53524,53553)) b
	where
		zx is not null

	if exists(select * from @t)
	begin
		DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max); 
		SET @html =  
		N'<html><head><title>Alterações dos materiais das fases:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
		N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
		N'<h3>Alterações:</h3>' + 
		N'<font size="2" face="Arial" >' +
		N'<h7><table border="1">' + 
		N'<tr>' + 
			N'<th width="50">OF</th>' + 
			N'<th width="300">Modelo</th>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Cliente</th>' +
			N'<th width="110">Fase</th>' + 
			N'<th width="600">Alterações</th>' +
		N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 
 
		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
						(select 
							--[@bgcolor] = (case when cor = 0 then  '#d3d3d3' else 'white' end),
							--'',
							td = OfId,
							'',
							td = Modelo,
							'',
							td = Cliente,
							'',
							td = Fase,
							'',
							td = isnull(convert(xml,Alteracoes),'')
		from
			@t --dbo.fase_Erros_Dia(1,GETDATE())
		order by 
			Fase, Cliente, Modelo FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		--select @table
		
		declare @body nvarchar(max)
		SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) +  
					N'</table></font></body></html>';
		
		--select @body
		declare @subject nvarchar(max) = 'Alterações dos materiais das fases: ' + cast(CAST(getdate() as date) as nvarchar(max))

		exec SendMail 
			@De ='nelo.prodution.div@gmail.com', 
			@Para = 'nunandre@gmail.com', --'jmartins71988@gmail.com; guilherme.ramos@nelo.eu', --'miguelrodrigues23@hotmail.com',
			--@CC = 'andre.santos@nelo.eu',
			@BCC = 'nunandre@gmail.com', --
			@Assunto = @subject,
			@Texto = @body, 
			@HTML = 1, 
			@SourceErro = null, 
			@MsgErro = null, 
			@Anexo = null
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Task_Limite_HExtra`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-02-03 13:11* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_Limite_HExtra] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if exists(SELECT movent_eId, sum(hExtra)/60.0 as tot FROM [dbo].[funcionario_movimentos_minutos] (
			   cast(dateadd(day, (day(getdate())-1) * -1, getdate()) as date)
			  ,cast(getdate() as date)
			  ,null)
			group by movent_eId
			having sum(hExtra)/60.0 >= 20.0)
	begin
		DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max); 
		SET @html =  
		N'<html><head><title>Funcionários com mais de 40 horas extra:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
		N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
		N'<h3>Funcionários:</h3>' + 
		'<table border="1">' + 
		N'<tr>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Área</th>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Funcionário</th>' + 
			N'<th width="60">Isenção</th>' + 
			N'<th width="60">Nº de horas</th>' + 
		N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 
 
		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
						(select 
							[@bgcolor] = (case when ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by fp_nome, e_isencao_horario, e_nome)%2 = 1 then  '#E0E0E0' else 'white' end),
							'',
							td = fp_nome,
							'',
							td = e_nome,
							'',
							td = (case when e_isencao_horario = 1 then 'Sim' else ' - ' end),
							'' , 
							[td/font/@color] = (case when cast(sum(hExtra)/60.0 as decimal(10,2)) > 40 then  'red' else 'black' end),
							[td/font] = cast(sum(hExtra)/60.0 as decimal(10,2))
		from [dbo].[funcionario_movimentos_minutos] (
			   cast(dateadd(day, (day(getdate())-1) * -1, getdate()) as date)
			  ,cast(getdate() as date)
			  ,null) as a inner join entidade on movent_eId = e_id
			  left join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
		group by fp_nome, e_nome, e_isencao_horario
		having sum(hExtra)/60.0 >= 20.0 order by fp_nome, e_isencao_horario, e_nome FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		
		declare @body nvarchar(max)
		SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) +  
					N'</table></body></html>';
		
	--select @body

		exec SendMail 'nelo.production.div@gmail.com', 'alexcosta.nelo@gmail.com;nunandre@gmail.com;andre.santos@nelo.eu;luis.miguel@nelo.eu;joao.costa@nelo.eu,tiago.gomes@nelo.eu',null,null,'Limite de horas extra atingido!!',@body, 1, null, null, null
	end
END
```

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nuno A.
-- Create date: 29-05-2018
-- Description:	Tarefa para actualizar OFs no formato antigo abertas no site, para o novo formato
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_OF_Converte_Versao] 
	

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @dt_i smalldatetime = '2018-05-23 00:00'


    insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_quantidade, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, mov_desconto, mov_observacoes, mov_problema, mov_numutil, mov_of_id, mov_e_id, mov_p_id, mov_tpmov_id, mov_mov_id, mov_arm_id, mov_lm_id, 
							mov_server, mov_tr_id, mov_prodf_id, mov_pl_id, mov_qtd_bal, mov_deck_part, mov_lote, mov_acerto, mov_acessorio_adicional, mov_defeituoso, mov_satisfeito, mov_id_pedido, mov_atrib_id)
	(select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtddeck, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Deck', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 1
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id 
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union
	select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtdcasco, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Casco', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 2
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_ccasco = p1.p_id 
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union
	select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtddeck * 0.1, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Gola', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 25
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_gola = p1.p_id 
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union
	select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtd_laterais/2.0, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Lateral_fr', '', 0,

		and (of_p_id_lateral_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_lateral_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_quinas <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_quinas_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_topo_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_topo_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck) 
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union

		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Lateral_tr', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 21
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_lateral_tr = p1.p_id
		and (of_p_id_lateral_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_lateral_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_quinas <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_quinas_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_topo_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_topo_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck)  
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union
	select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtd_quinas/2.0, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Quinas_fr', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 22
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_quinas = p1.p_id
		and (of_p_id_lateral_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_lateral_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_quinas <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_quinas_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
```
