```sql
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union
	select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtd_quinas/2.0, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Quinas_tr', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 23
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_quinas_tr = p1.p_id
		and (of_p_id_lateral_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_lateral_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_quinas <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_quinas_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_topo_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_topo_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck) 
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union
	select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtd_topos/2.0, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Topo_fr', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 17
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_topo_fr = p1.p_id
		and (of_p_id_lateral_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_lateral_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_quinas <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_quinas_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_topo_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_topo_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck)  
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	union
	select coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio), null, p.p_qtd_topos/2.0, (case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p1.p_id, coalesce(of_data,of_datainicio)),0) else p1.p_precocusto end), p1.p_precovenda, 0, 
		'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '', 0, of_id, of_e_id, p1.p_id, (case when cast(of_datainicio as date) <= cast(getdate() as date) then 2 else 4 end), null, 1, null, 'SERVER', null, null, null, 0, 'Topo_tr', '', 0,
		0, 0, 0, null, 19
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_topo_tr = p1.p_id
		and (of_p_id_lateral_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_lateral_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_quinas <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_quinas_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck
		or of_p_id_topo_fr <> of_p_id_cdeck or of_p_id_topo_tr <> of_p_id_cdeck) 
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0
	)


	update movimento set mov_atrib_id = (case when p_tp_id = 10 then 9 when p_tp_id = 11 then 4 when p_tp_id = 12 then 6 when p_tp_id = 14 then 3 when p_tp_id = 62 then 5 when p_tp_id = 63 then 7 when p_tp_id = 65 then 13
		when p_tp_id = 74 then 11 when p_tp_id = 134 then 12 when p_tp_id = 135 then 14 when p_tp_id = 136 then 14 when p_tp_id = 154 then 16 when p_tp_id = 167 then 26 end)
	from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id where mov_of_id is not null and mov_atrib_id is null and of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0



	/* APAGA MOVIMENTOS DE CORES */
	create table #tt (id int, lvl int)

	declare @counter int
	set @counter = 0

	insert into #tt (id, lvl) (SELECT mov_id, @counter from ordemfabrico inner join movimento on mov_atrib_id is null and of_id = mov_of_id and 
																(of_p_id_cdeck = mov_p_id or of_p_id_ccasco = mov_p_id or of_p_id_lateral_fr = mov_p_id or of_p_id_lateral_tr = mov_p_id or of_p_id_quinas = mov_p_id 
																or of_p_id_quinas_tr = mov_p_id or of_p_id_topo_fr = mov_p_id or of_p_id_topo_tr = mov_p_id or of_p_id_gola = mov_p_id) and of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null) and of_versao_nova = 0)

	while @@ROWCOUNT > 0
	begin
		SET @counter = @counter + 1

		insert into #tt (id, lvl) (select mov_id, @counter from #tt inner join movimento on id = mov_mov_id and lvl = @counter - 1)
	end

	delete movimento_attach from #tt inner join movimento_attach on id = match_mov_id

	delete m from #tt inner join movimento as m on id = m.mov_id

	drop table #tt


	update ordemfabrico set of_versao_nova = 1 
	from ordemfabrico --inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id 
	where of_data >= @dt_i and (OF_CRIADOR in ('','Web') or OF_CRIADOR is null)
END
```

#### `dbo.Task_OFs_Para_Pintar_Fora`()

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		NAndre
-- Create date: 2021/09/21
-- Description:	Lista ofs que vão ser pintadas com aparelho
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE Task_OFs_Para_Pintar_Fora
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if exists(select offp_of_id from of_fp inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and cast(offp_data_prevista as date) = cast(dateadd(day,-1,getdate()) as date) and of_parapintarfora = 1)
	begin
		DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max); 
		SET @html =  
		N'<html><head><title>Barcos para laminar amanhã que vão ser pintados com aparelho/gel7004:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
		N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
		N'<h3>Barcos:</h3>' + 
		'<table border="1">' + 
		N'<tr>' + 
			N'<th width="60">OF</th>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Modelo</th>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Cliente</th>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Referencia</th>' + 
			N'<th width="300">Observações</th>' + 
		N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 
 
		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
						(select 
							[@bgcolor] = 'white',
							'',
							td = of_id,
							'',
							td = p_nome,
							'',
							td = e_nome,
							'' , 
							td = of_referencia,
							'' , 
							td = of_observacoes
		from 
			of_fp 
			inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
			inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		where 
			OFFP_FP_ID = 1 
			and cast(offp_data_prevista as date) = cast(dateadd(day,-1,getdate()) as date) 
			and of_parapintarfora = 1 
		FOR 
			XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		
		declare @body nvarchar(max)
		SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) +  
					N'</table></body></html>';

		exec SendMail 'nelo.production.div@gmail.com', 'manuel.ramos@nelo.eu;andre.santos@nelo.eu;nuno.andre@nelo.eu',null,null,'Barcos para laminar amanhã que vão ser pintados com aparelho/gel7004',@body, 1, null, null, null
	end	

	--select @body
END
```

#### `dbo.Task_Pecas_Em_Falta_de_Transportes`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-07-30 09:04 · modificado 2022-12-06 15:58* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_Pecas_Em_Falta_de_Transportes] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if exists(select 
					E_NOME, 
					OF_ID, P_ID, P_NOME, 
					sum(MOV_QUANTIDADE), 
					cast(tr_data as nvarchar(max)) + ': ' + TR_DESCRICAO as tr
				from 
					MOVIMENTO 
					inner join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = OF_ID
					inner join TRANSP_OF on OF_ID = TROF_OF_ID
					inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID
					inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
					left join ATRIBUTO on MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
					inner join entidade on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID
				where 
					OF_FP_ID = 12
					and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 4
					and TR_DATA between '2019/07/19' and getdate()
					and ((MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null and ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT = 'Acessórios') 
						or MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1)
				group by 
					E_ID, E_NOME, OF_ID, P_ID, P_NOME, cast(tr_data as nvarchar(max)) + ': ' + TR_DESCRICAO)
	begin
		DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max); 
		SET @html =  
		N'<html><head><title>Peças em falta de barcos já enviados: </title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
		N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
		N'<h3>Peças:</h3>' + 
		N'<font size="2" face="Arial" >' +
		N'<h7><table border="1">' + 
		N'<tr>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Cliente</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50">OF</th>' +  
			N'<th width="50">Id</th>' + 
			N'<th width="200">Produto</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50">Qtd</th>' + 
			N'<th width="250">Transporte</th>' + 
		N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 
 
		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
						(select 
							[@bgcolor] = (case when ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by e_nome)%2 = 1 then  '#d3d3d3' else 'white' end),
							'',
							td = e_nome,
							'',
							td = OF_ID,
							'',
							td = P_ID,
							'',
							td = P_NOME,
							'',
							td = cast(sum(MOV_QUANTIDADE) as decimal(12,2)),
							'',
							td = cast(tr_data as nvarchar(max)) + ': ' + TR_DESCRICAO
						from 
							MOVIMENTO 
							inner join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = OF_ID
							inner join TRANSP_OF on OF_ID = TROF_OF_ID
							inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID
							inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
							left join ATRIBUTO on MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
							inner join entidade on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID
						where 
							OF_FP_ID = 12
							and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 4
							and TR_DATA between '2019/07/19' and getdate()
							and ((MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null and ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT = 'Acessórios') 
								or MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1)
							and E_NELO = 0
						group by 
							E_ID, E_NOME, OF_ID, P_ID, P_NOME, cast(tr_data as nvarchar(max)) + ': ' + TR_DESCRICAO
						order by 
							E_NOME, OF_ID, P_NOME FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		
		declare @body nvarchar(max)
		SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) +  
					N'</table></font></body></html>';

	--select @body
	declare @subject nvarchar(max) = 'Peças em falta de barcos já enviados'

		exec SendMail 
			@De ='nelo.prodution.div@gmail.com', 
			--@Para = 'nunandre@gmail.com',
			@Para ='alexcosta.nelo@gmail.com;nuno.veloso@nelo.eu;jone.nelo@gmail.com;nuno.ramos@nelo.eu;henrique.silva@nelo.eu',
			@CC = 'andre.santos@nelo.eu;nunandre@gmail.com',
			@BCC = null,
			@Assunto = @subject,
			@Texto = @body, 
			@HTML = 1, 
			@SourceErro = null, 
			@MsgErro = null, 
			@Anexo = null
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Task_Pedidos_OFs`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-12-20 16:58 · modificado 2025-11-13 16:46* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `reparac`, `custo`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_Pedidos_OFs]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @t table (movId int, pId int, movQtd float, armId int, ofId int, extra bit, movMovId int, fpId int, movObs nvarchar(max), visto bit default 0, vistoComponentes bit default 0)

	declare @mov_id int, @mov_mov_id int, @p_id int, @mov_quantidade float, @p_arm_id int, @dt smalldatetime = getdate(), @of_id int, @notas nvarchar(max), @ofId_txt nvarchar(max), @extra bit, @mov_observacoes nvarchar(max)

	declare @tOfs table (ofId int, visto bit default 0)
	insert into @tOfs (ofId)
	(select 
		distinct offp_of_id 
	from 
		OF_FP 
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID and OFFP_FP_ID = OF_FP_ID
	where 
		(
			(
				--OFFP_FP_ID in (case when DATEPART(DW,getdate()) = 6 then 53 else 5 end,case when DATEPART(DW,getdate()) = 6 then 47 else 5 end,5,22,33,35,40,42,63,65,66) 
				OFFP_FP_ID in (42, 74, 46, 33, 35, 66,8)
				and of_fp_id not in (8,9,49,50,10,12,13,14) 
				and (DATEDIFF(N,offp_datainicio,getdate()) < 900 or offp_datainicio is null)
			) 
			or OF_FP_ID = 46
		) 
		and OFFP_OF_ID not in (select distinct isnull(ped_of_id, 1) from pedidos where ped_of_id is not null) 
		and of_id < 10000000 
		and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
		and of_id not between 200000 and 299999
		and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747)

	while exists (select * from @tOfs where visto = 0)
	begin

		select top 1 @of_id = ofId from @tOfs where visto = 0

		update @tOfs set visto = 1 where ofId = @of_id
		
		insert into @t (movId, pId, movQtd, armId, ofId, extra, movObs) 
		select 
			mov_id, p_id, mov_quantidade, p_arm_id, of_id, mov_acessorio_adicional, 
			case when len(replace(mov_observacoes, 'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '')) > 0 then 'OPÇÕES: ' + replace(mov_observacoes, 'OF: ' + cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)), '') else '' end
		from 
			dbo.of_Acessorios_Preparacao(@of_id,null)

		while exists (select * from @t where visto = 0)
		begin
			select top 1 @mov_id = movId, @p_id = pId, @mov_quantidade = movQtd, @of_id = ofId, @extra = extra, @mov_observacoes = movObs from @t where visto = 0

			update @t set visto = 1 where movId = @mov_id and pId = @p_id

			select @notas = 'Pedido de peças da OF ' + cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max)) + ' - ' + p_nome + ' Cliente: ' + E_NOME + isnull(' c/ transp. a ' + cast(tr_data as nvarchar(max)), ' sem transp.') from ORDEMFABRICO inner join produto on of_p_id = P_ID left join TRANSPORTE on of_tr_id = TR_ID inner join ENTIDADE on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID where of_id = @of_id

			exec [dbo].[Fornecedor_Add_Pedido]
				@mov_e_id = 19747,
				@mov_data = @dt,
				@mov_p_id = @p_id,
				@mov_quantidade = @mov_quantidade,
				@mov_observacoes = @mov_observacoes,
				@mov_e_id_responsavel = null,
				@mov_data_aprovado = null,
				@ped_notas = @notas,
				@mov_tpmov_id = 12,
				@mov_of_id = @of_id,
				@mov_acessorio_adicional = @extra

			set @ofId_txt = cast(@of_id as nvarchar(max))
			
		end

		delete @t

		insert into @t (movId, pId, movQtd, armId, ofId, extra, vistoComponentes)
		select	
			mov_id, mov_p_id, mov_quantidade, mov_arm_id, mov_of_id, mov_acessorio_adicional, 1
		from 
			pedidos inner join movimento on ped_id = mov_id_pedido and ped_e_id = mov_e_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
		where
			PED_OF_ID = @of_id
			and p_saidas_auto = 0

		while exists (select * from @t where visto = 0)
		begin
			select top 1 @mov_id = movId, @p_id = pId, @mov_quantidade = movQtd, @of_id = ofId, @extra = extra, @mov_mov_id = movMovId from @t where visto = 0

			update @t set visto = 1 where movId = @mov_id

			insert into @t (movId, pId, movQtd, armId, movMovId, fpId)
			select 
				COMP_ID * 1000,
				comp_p_p_id,
				comp_quantidade * @mov_quantidade,
				p_arm_id,
				@mov_mov_id,
				COMP_FP_ID
			from
				PRODUTO_COMPONENTE
				inner join PRODUTO on COMP_P_P_ID = P_ID
			where
				COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 1
				and COMP_P_ID = @p_id
				and p_saidas_auto = 0
		end
			
		insert into movimento (mov_data, mov_datasaida, mov_p_id, mov_quantidade, mov_precounitario, mov_precovenda, 
								mov_e_id, mov_observacoes, mov_tpmov_id, mov_desconto, mov_arm_id, mov_e_id_responsavel, 
								mov_of_id, mov_qtd_bal, MOV_ID_PEDIDO, MOV_FP_ID, MOV_MOV_ID)
		(select 
			@dt, 
			null, 
			pId, 
			movQtd,
			isnull(case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(pId, null) else P_PRECOCUSTO end,0),
			P_PRECOVENDA,
			19747,
			@notas,
			12,
			0,
			armId,
			null,
			null,
			0,
			null,
			fpId,
			movMovId
		from
			@t
			inner join produto on pId = p_id
		where
			vistoComponentes = 0)

		delete @t
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.task_PlaneamentoPrevisao`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-02-25 11:25*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[task_PlaneamentoPrevisao]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	exec dbo.Planeamento_Previsão 7, 9

	/*Põe tempos de espera a zero*/
	update produto set p_tempo_espera = 0 where p_tempo_espera > 0

	/*Calcula tempos de espera*/
	update produto set p_tempo_espera = z.tempo
	--select *
	from 
		(select 
			replace(replace(modelo,' (L)',''), ' (Tr)', '') as modelo, 
			datediff(day,getdate(),max(dt_lam)) + 10 as tempo
		from 
			Z_PrevisaoPlano 
		group by 
			replace(replace(modelo,' (L)',''), ' (Tr)', '')) as z 
	inner join (select 
					p_np_id as np, 
					p_m_id as model, 
					p_tam_id as tam, 
					p_nome as nome 
				from 
					produto) as p on ltrim(rtrim(z.modelo)) = p.nome 
	inner join produto on p_np_id = p.np and p_m_id = p.model and p_tam_id = p.tam

END
```

#### `dbo.task_PrecoCusto_Modelos_OFs`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-04-02 15:23* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`, `preço`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[task_PrecoCusto_Modelos_OFs]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	/*Actualiza preços de custo dos modelos*/
	set nocount on;

	declare curCapa cursor for
	select 
		distinct p_id
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
	where 
		(of_data >= dateadd(year,-1,getdate()) 
		and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 
		and of_id < 10000000) 
		and (P_PRECO_TEMP = 0 
			or p_preco_temp_inflacionado = 0) 
		and tp_id in (select a.tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1) a)

	OPEN curCapa
	DECLARE @p_id INT

	fetch next from curCapa into @p_id while @@fetch_status=0
	begin

		update produto set p_preco_temp =  dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(@p_id,null), p_preco_temp_inflacionado = dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X_Inflacionado(@p_id,null) where p_id = @p_id
		print @p_id

	fetch next from curCapa into @p_id
	end
	close curCapa
	deallocate curCapa

	/* Actualiza preço de custo das OFs */

	update 
		--top(250) 
		ordemfabrico 
	set 
		of_precocusto_dt = case when of_precocusto_dt = 0 then dbo.PrecoCusto_OF(of_id, 3) else of_precocusto_dt end, 
		of_precocusto_dt_inflacionado = case when of_precocusto_dt_inflacionado = 0 then dbo.PrecoCusto_OF_Inflacionado(of_id, 3) else of_precocusto_dt_inflacionado end 
	-- select of_id, of_precocusto_dt, of_precocusto_dt_inflacionado, of_fp_id from ordemfabrico
	where of_datafim >= dateadd(year,-1,getdate()) and (of_precocusto_dt = 0 or of_precocusto_dt_inflacionado = 0) and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and of_id < 10000000


END
```

#### `dbo.Task_ProdutosCriadosEmArmazem`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-06-30 09:03 · modificado 2020-07-01 09:51* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_ProdutosCriadosEmArmazem] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max), @body nvarchar(max), @subject nvarchar(max)

	declare @p table(pId int)
	declare @resp table(eId int, eNome nvarchar(max), eEmail nvarchar(max), armId int, armNome nvarchar(max), visto bit default 0)
	declare @eId int, @eNome nvarchar(max), @eEmail nvarchar(max), @armId int, @armNome nvarchar(max)

	insert into @resp (eId, eNome, eEmail, armId, armNome)
	select distinct e_id, e_nome, e_email, arm_id, ARM_NOME from entidade inner join ARMAZEM on e_id = ARM_E_ID_RESP where charindex('@',e_email) > 0 and charindex('.',e_email, charindex('@',e_email)) > charindex('@',e_email) and ARM_TEM_STOCK = 1 and arm_id not in (6,7)

	while exists(select * from @resp where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 @eId = eId, @eNome = eNome, @eEmail = eEmail, @armId = armId, @armNome = armNome from @resp where visto = 0

		insert into @p (pId)
		select distinct
			p_id 
		from 
			produto
			inner join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id
		where 
			cast(P_DATACRIACAO as date) = cast(dateadd(day,-1,getdate()) as date)
			and P_ARM_ID = @armId
			and P_ACTIVO = 1
			and P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
		

		SET @html =  
			N'<html><head><title>Produtos criados:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
			N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
			N'<h3>Produtos criados::</h3>' + 
			N'<font size="2" face="Arial" >' +
			N'<h7><table border="1">' + 
			N'<tr>' + 
				N'<th width="15%">Tipo</th>' + 
				N'<th width="5%">Id</th>' + 
				N'<th width="20%">Nome</th>' + 
				N'<th width="7%">Fab. int.</th>' + 
				N'<th width="7%">Tem stock</th>' +  
				N'<th width="7%">Saidas auto</th>' +  
				N'<th width="10%">Unid</th>' + 
				N'<th width="10%">Stock</th>' + 
				N'<th width="14%">Criado por</th>' + 
			N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 

		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
								(select
									[@bgcolor] = (case when ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by TP_NOME, P_NOME)%2 = 1 then  '#d3d3d3' else 'white' end),
									'',
									td = TP_NOME,
									'',
									td = p_id,
									'',
									td = p_nome,
									'',
									td = case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = case when P_TEM_STOCK = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = case when P_SAIDAS_AUTO = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = UNI_NOME,
									'',
									td = case when P_TEM_STOCK = 1 then cast(isnull(st.stock,0) as nvarchar(max)) else '-' end,
									'',
									td = E_NOME
								from
									@p
									INNER JOIN produto ON pId = P_ID
									inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
									inner join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
									left join (select a.P_ID as id, round(sum(a.Stock),2) as stock from dbo.produto_stocks_por_armazem a group by a.P_ID) st on P_ID = st.id
									inner join entidade on p_e_id_criador = e_id
								order by TP_NOME, P_NOME
								FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) + N'</table></font></body></html>';

		set @subject = 'Produtos criados ontem no armazem: ' + @armNome

		if @table is not null
			exec SendMail 
				@De ='nelo.production.div@gmail.com', 
				@Para = @eEmail,
				@CC = 'nunandre@gmail.com',
				@BCC = null,
				@Assunto = @subject,
				@Texto = @body, 
				@HTML = 1, 
				@SourceErro = null, 
				@MsgErro = null, 
				@Anexo = null

		update @resp set visto = 1 where eId = @eId and armId = @armId
		delete @p
	end
END
```

```sql
	set @txt += N'<font color=black>2)  </font><a href="http://reports.nelo.eu:8009/neloreportserver/Pages/ReportViewer.aspx?%2fReports_2016%2fCheckList_Matriz&dt_I=' + cast(@dI as nchar(10)) + '&dt_F=' + cast(@dF as nchar(10)) + '&faseFiltro=' + cast(@faseFiltro as nvarchar(max)) + '&rs:Command=Render">Avaliação de desmolde: Erros</><br>'
	set @txt += N'<font color=black>3)  </font><a href="http://reports.nelo.eu:8009/neloreportserver/Pages/ReportViewer.aspx?%2fReports_2016%2fProbs&i=' + cast(@dI as nchar(10)) + '&f=' + cast(@dF as nchar(10)) + '&rs:Command=Render">Avaliação de desmolde: Resumo</><br>'
```

#### `dbo.task_shop_UpdCosts`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-02-12 16:20 · modificado 2020-08-28 10:38* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		NR
-- Create date: 
-- Description:	
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[task_shop_UpdCosts] 
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Criar registo para guardar o custo no Magento, caso nao exista
	EXEC ('INSERT INTO catalog_product_entity_decimal (attribute_id, store_id, entity_id, value)
SELECT 79, 0, entity_id, 0
FROM catalog_product_entity p
WHERE p.entity_id NOT IN (SELECT entity_id FROM catalog_product_entity_decimal WHERE attribute_id = 79)') AT MY_SQL

	-- Actualiza custos
	UPDATE c SET c.value = coalesce(CASE WHEN P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 THEN dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id,null) ELSE p.P_PRECOCUSTO END, 0)
	from 
		OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
		'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
		'SELECT * FROM catalog_product_entity_decimal WHERE attribute_id = 79') as c INNER JOIN
		OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
		'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
		'SELECT * FROM catalog_product_entity') as e ON c.entity_id = e.entity_id INNER JOIN
		PRODUTO as p ON CAST(p.p_id as VARCHAR) = e.sku

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[task_Shop_UpdStocks]
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;


	exec PHC_InsereProdutos

	--exec dbo.LojaOnline_VerificaEncomendas

	
	--print 'ACERTAR STOCKS'

	update st set st.qty = (case when coalesce(stt.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else coalesce(stt.stock,0) end), st.is_in_stock = (case when coalesce(stt.stock,0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end)
	--select st.qty,  tp_nome, p_nome, p_stock, st.is_in_stock, p_fabricointerno
	from 
		OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
		'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
		'select * from catalog_product_entity') as p inner join 
		OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
		'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
		'select * from cataloginventory_stock_item') as st on p.entity_id = st.product_id 
		inner join produto on p.sku = convert(varchar, p_id) inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id --order by tp_nome, p_nome
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then mov_quantidade else mov_quantidade * -1 end) as stock from movimento where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) group by mov_p_id) as stt on p_id = stt.mov_p_id
	where
		p_loja = 1 and p_tem_stock = 1
	
	/* actualiza produtos cujos componentes estão em falta */
	update st set st.is_in_stock = 0
	--select distinct st.qty, tp_nome, pPai.p_nome, pPai.p_stock, st.is_in_stock, pPai.p_fabricointerno--, pFilho.P_NOME, stt.stock
	from 
		OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
		'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
		'select * from catalog_product_entity') as p inner join 
		OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
		'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
		'select * from cataloginventory_stock_item') as st on p.entity_id = st.product_id 
		inner join produto pPai on p.sku = convert(varchar, pPai.p_id) 
		inner join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE on pPai.P_ID = COMP_P_ID
		inner join produto pFilho on COMP_P_P_ID = pFilho.P_ID
		inner join produto_tipo on pFilho.p_tp_id = tp_id
		left join (select mov_p_id, sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then mov_quantidade else mov_quantidade * -1 end) as stock from movimento where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) group by mov_p_id) as stt on pFilho.p_id = stt.mov_p_id
	where
		pPai.p_loja = 1 and pPai.p_tem_stock = 0 and pFilho.p_tem_stock = 1 and pFilho.p_loja = 1 and COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 2 and stt.stock <= 0

	--print 'ACERTAR ESTADOS'
/*
	NUNO RAMOS
	Não perecer ser preciso fazer isto já quye é feita uma indexação regular no magento
	------------

	update sst set sst.stock_status = (case when coalesce(stt.stock,0) > 0 then 1 else 0 end)
	--select *
	from 
	OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
	'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
	'select * from catalog_product_entity') as p inner join 
	OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
	'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
	'select * from cataloginventory_stock_item') as st on p.entity_id = st.product_id inner join 
	produto on p.sku = convert(varchar, p_id) inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id inner join 
	OPENROWSET('MSDASQL',
	'DSN=MySQL_Remoto;DATABASE=nelopt_magento;',
	'select * from cataloginventory_stock_status') as sst on st.product_id = sst.product_id
	left join (select mov_p_id, sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then mov_quantidade else mov_quantidade * -1 end) as stock from movimento where mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) group by mov_p_id) as stt on p_id = stt.mov_p_id
	where 
		p_loja = 1 and p_fabricointerno = 0 and p_tem_stock = 1
*/

END
```

#### `dbo.Task_Shrink_DBLogFile`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-08-17 09:59 · modificado 2020-08-17 09:59*

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE Task_Shrink_DBLogFile 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	-- Truncate the log by changing the database recovery model to SIMPLE.
    ALTER DATABASE [MAR-KAYAKS] SET RECOVERY SIMPLE;

	-- Shrink the truncated log file to 100 MB. 
	DBCC SHRINKFILE ([MAR-KAYAKS_log], 100);

	-- Reset the database recovery model.  
	ALTER DATABASE [MAR-KAYAKS] SET RECOVERY FULL;

END
```

#### `dbo.Task_StocksPrevisao`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-06-11 11:21* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_StocksPrevisao] 
	
AS
BEGIN

	set nocount on;

	declare @arm_e_id_resp nvarchar(max), 
		@e_email nvarchar(max),
		@html nvarchar(max), 
		@table nvarchar(max),
		@di date = dateadd(month,-6,getdate()), 
		@df date = getdate(),
		@interno bit = 0,
		@subj nvarchar(max),
		@body nvarchar(max),
		@email nvarchar(max),
		@arms nvarchar(max)

	declare curOFs_StockPrevisao cursor for
	select distinct arm_e_id_resp, e_email from ARMAZEM inner join entidade on arm_e_id_resp = e_id where len(e_email) > 5

	open curOFs_StockPrevisao
	declare @of_id int, @p_id int

	fetch next from curOFs_StockPrevisao into @arm_e_id_resp, @e_email while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		SET @html =  
		N'<html><head><title>Product List</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
		N'<body style="font-family: Arial; font-size: 8pt">' + 
		N'<h2>Lista:</h2>' + 
		'<table border="1">' + 
		N'<tr>' + 
			N'<th width="100">Tipo</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50">Id</th>' + 
			N'<th width="150">Modelo</th>' + 
			N'<th width="150">Fornecedor</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50">Prazo entrega</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50" align="right">Consumo</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50" align="right">Média</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50" align="right">Stock</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50" align="right">Necessidade</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50" align="right">Pedido</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50" align="right">Meses stock</th>' + 
			N'<th width="50" align="right">Cobert. necess.</th>'  + 
		N'</tr>' + CHAR(10);


		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
				(select 
					[@bgcolor] = (case when ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by tp_nome, a.p_nome)%2 = 1 then  '#E0E0E0' else 'white' end),
					'',
					td = tp_nome,
					'',
					td = a.p_id_ant,
					'',
					td = a.p_nome,
					'' , 
					td = isnull(e_nome,(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then 'NELO' else 'não atribuido!' end)),
					'' , 
					td = isnull(e_prazoentrega,''),
					'' , 
					td = cast(a.tot as decimal(12,2)), --Consumo
					'' , 			
					td = cast(isnull(a.med,0) as decimal(12,2)), --Média
					'' , 
					td = cast(isnull(arm.stock,0) as decimal(12,2)), --Stock
					'' , 
					td = cast(isnull(zx.qtd,0) as decimal(12,2)), --Necessidade
					'' ,  
					td = cast(isnull(pedidos.qtd,0) as decimal(12,2)), --Pedido
					'',
					[td/@bgcolor] = (case when isnull(a.med,0) > 0 and isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(a.med,1) < 1 then 'red' 
										when isnull(a.med,0) > 0 and isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(a.med,1) < 2 then 'orange' 
										when isnull(a.med,0) > 0 and isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(a.med,1) < 3 then 'khaki' 
										else 'LightGreen' end),
					td = (case when isnull(a.med,0) > 0 then cast(isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(a.med,1) as decimal(12,2)) else 999 end),
					'',
					[td/@bgcolor] = (case when isnull(zx.qtd,0) > 0 and isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(zx.qtd,0) <= 1 then 'red' 
										when isnull(zx.qtd,0) > 0 and isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(zx.qtd,0) <= 1.5 then 'khaki' 
										else 'LightGreen' end),
					td = (case when isnull(zx.qtd,0) > 0 then cast(isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(zx.qtd,0) as decimal(12,2)) else 999 end)
		from
			(select 
				mov_p_id as p_id_ant, p_nome, sum(mov_quantidade) as tot,
				sum(mov_quantidade)/(case when datediff(day,min(mov_data),max(mov_data))/30.0 > 0.0 then datediff(day,min(mov_data),max(mov_data))/30.0 else 1.0 end) as med
				from 
					movimento inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = p_id
				where 
					cast(mov_data as date) between @di and @df and mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_observacoes not like 'Movimento do Armazem %' 
				group by 
					mov_p_id, p_nome) as a
			inner join (select 
								p_id, sum(Stock) as stock 
							from 
								dbo.produto_stocks_por_armazem 
							group by 
								p_id) as arm on p_id_ant = arm.p_id
			outer apply (select sum(quantidade) qtd from dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista(a.p_id_ant)) zx
			--left join (select 
			--					mov_p_id, 
			--					sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd 
			--				from 
			--					movimento 
			--					inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
			--				where 
			--					mov_tpmov_id = 4 
			--					and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 
			--				group by 
			--					mov_p_id) as m on a.p_id_ant = m.mov_p_id
			left join (select 
								mov_p_id, 
								sum(mov_quantidade) as qtd 
							from 
								movimento 
							where 
								mov_tpmov_id = 9
								and mov_satisfeito = 0 
							group by 
								mov_p_id) as pedidos on a.p_id_ant = pedidos.mov_p_id
			left join produto as p on a.p_id_ant = p.p_id left join entidade on p.p_e_id = e_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		where 
			p_activo = 1
			and (case when @interno = 0 then p.p_fabricointerno else 0 end) = 0 
			and (p.p_arm_id in (select distinct arm_id from armazem where arm_e_id_resp = @arm_e_id_resp)
				or P_E_ID_RESP = @arm_e_id_resp)
		group by 
			tp_nome, a.p_id_ant, a.p_nome, e_id, zx.qtd, arm.stock, e_nome, e_prazoentrega, p.p_fabricointerno, pedidos.qtd,a.med, a.tot
		having 
			(isnull(a.med,0) > 0 
			and isnull(arm.stock,0)/(isnull(a.med,1)) < 3) 
			or (isnull(zx.qtd,0) > 0 
				and isnull(arm.stock,0)/isnull(zx.qtd,0) <= 1.5)
		order by 
			(case when isnull(a.med,0) > 0 then cast(isnull(arm.stock,0)/(isnull(a.med,1)) as decimal(12,2)) else 999 end)  
		FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE));


		set @arms  = (select distinct arm_nome + ',' as [text()] 
						from armazem inner join entidade on arm_e_id_resp = e_id 
						where len(e_email) > 5 and arm_e_id_resp = @arm_e_id_resp 
						for xml path (''))

		set @subj = 'Previsão de stocks: ' + substring(@arms, 0, len(@arms))

		SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) +  
					N'</table></body></html>';

		set @email = 'nunandre@gmail.com;luis.miguel@nelo.eu;andre.santos;nuno.veloso@nelo.eu;nuno.ramos@nelo.eu;' + @e_email

		exec SendMail 'nelo.prodution.div@gmail.com', @email,null,null,@subj,@body, 1, null, null, null

	fetch next from curOFs_StockPrevisao into @arm_e_id_resp, @e_email
	end
	close curOFs_StockPrevisao
	deallocate curOFs_StockPrevisao

END
```

#### `dbo.Task_VerificacaoDeProdutos`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2020-06-29 15:35 · modificado 2022-06-27 13:24* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_VerificacaoDeProdutos] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max), @body nvarchar(max), @subject nvarchar(max), @varVerificacao nvarchar(max) = (select var_valor from variaveis where var_id = 1)

	declare @p table(pId int)
	declare @resp table(eId int, eNome nvarchar(max), eEmail nvarchar(max), armId int, armNome nvarchar(max), visto bit default 0)
	declare @eId int, @eNome nvarchar(max), @eEmail nvarchar(max), @armId int, @armNome nvarchar(max)

	insert into @resp (eId, eNome, eEmail, armId, armNome)
	select distinct e_id, e_nome, e_email, arm_id, ARM_NOME from entidade inner join ARMAZEM on e_id = ARM_E_ID_RESP where charindex('@',e_email) > 0 and charindex('.',e_email, charindex('@',e_email)) > charindex('@',e_email) and ARM_TEM_STOCK = 1 and arm_id not in (6,7)

	while exists(select * from @resp where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 @eId = eId, @eNome = eNome, @eEmail = eEmail, @armId = armId, @armNome = armNome from @resp where visto = 0

		insert into @p (pId)
		select distinct
			p_id 
		from 
			produto
			inner join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id
		where 
			cast(p_id as nvarchar(max)) like '%' + @varVerificacao
			and P_ARM_ID = @armId
			and P_ACTIVO = 1
			and P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
			and mov_data > dateadd(month,-6,getdate())
		

		SET @html =  
			N'<html><head><title>Verificar stocks e dados dos seguintes produtos:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
			N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
			N'<h3>Verificar stocks e dados dos seguintes produtos::</h3>' + 
			N'<font size="2" face="Arial" >' +
			N'<h7><table border="1">' + 
			N'<tr>' + 
				N'<th width="15%">Tipo</th>' + 
				N'<th width="5%">Id</th>' + 
				N'<th width="34%">Nome</th>' + 
				N'<th width="7%">Fab. int.</th>' + 
				N'<th width="7%">Tem stock</th>' +  
				N'<th width="7%">Saidas auto</th>' +  
				N'<th width="10%">Unid</th>' + 
				N'<th width="10%">Stock</th>' + 
			N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 

		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
								(select 
									[@bgcolor] = (case when ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by TP_NOME, P_NOME)%2 = 1 then  '#d3d3d3' else 'white' end),
									'',
									td = TP_NOME,
									'',
									td = p_id,
									'',
									td = p_nome,
									'',
									td = case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = case when P_TEM_STOCK = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = case when P_SAIDAS_AUTO = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = UNI_NOME,
									'',
									td = case when P_TEM_STOCK = 1 then cast(isnull(st.stock,0) as nvarchar(max)) else '-' end
								from
									@p
									INNER JOIN produto ON pId = P_ID
									inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
									inner join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
									left join (select a.P_ID as id, round(sum(a.Stock),2) as stock from dbo.produto_stocks_por_armazem a group by a.P_ID) st on P_ID = st.id
								where 
									P_ACTIVO = 1
									and P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
								order by TP_NOME, P_NOME
								FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		if (@table is not null)
		begin
			SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) + N'</table></font></body></html>';

			set @subject = 'Verificação de dados/stocks de alguns produtos do armazem: ' + @armNome

			exec SendMail 
				@De ='nelo.production.div@gmail.com', 
				@Para = @eEmail,
				@CC = 'nunandre@gmail.com',
				@BCC = null,
				@Assunto = @subject,
				@Texto = @body, 
				@HTML = 1, 
				@SourceErro = null, 
				@MsgErro = null, 
				@Anexo = null

			print @subject
		end		

		update @resp set visto = 1 where eId = @eId and armId = @armId
		delete @p
	end

	update variaveis set var_valor = cast(case when cast(@varVerificacao as int) < 9 then cast(@varVerificacao as int) + 1 else 0 end as nvarchar(max)) where var_id = 1
END
```

#### `dbo.Task_VerificacaoDeProdutos_teste`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2022-06-27 12:04 · modificado 2022-06-27 13:15* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Task_VerificacaoDeProdutos_teste] 
	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @html nvarchar(max), @table nvarchar(max), @body nvarchar(max), @subject nvarchar(max), @varVerificacao nvarchar(max) = (select var_valor from variaveis where var_id = 1)

	declare @p table(pId int)
	declare @resp table(eId int, eNome nvarchar(max), eEmail nvarchar(max), armId int, armNome nvarchar(max), visto bit default 0)
	declare @eId int, @eNome nvarchar(max), @eEmail nvarchar(max), @armId int, @armNome nvarchar(max)

	insert into @resp (eId, eNome, eEmail, armId, armNome)
	select distinct e_id, e_nome, e_email, arm_id, ARM_NOME from entidade inner join ARMAZEM on e_id = ARM_E_ID_RESP where charindex('@',e_email) > 0 and charindex('.',e_email, charindex('@',e_email)) > charindex('@',e_email) and ARM_TEM_STOCK = 1 and arm_id not in (6,7)

	while exists(select * from @resp where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 @eId = eId, @eNome = eNome, @eEmail = eEmail, @armId = armId, @armNome = armNome from @resp where visto = 0

		insert into @p (pId)
		select distinct
			p_id 
		from 
			produto
			inner join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id
		where 
			cast(p_id as nvarchar(max)) like '%' + @varVerificacao
			and P_ARM_ID = @armId
			and P_ACTIVO = 1
			and P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
			and mov_data > dateadd(month,-6,getdate())
		

		SET @html =  
			N'<html><head><title>Verificar stocks e dados dos seguintes produtos:</title></head>' + CHAR(10) + 
			N'<body style="font-family: Arial">' + 
			N'<h3>Verificar stocks e dados dos seguintes produtos::</h3>' + 
			N'<font size="2" face="Arial" >' +
			N'<h7><table border="1">' + 
			N'<tr>' + 
				N'<th width="15%">Tipo</th>' + 
				N'<th width="5%">Id</th>' + 
				N'<th width="34%">Nome</th>' + 
				N'<th width="7%">Fab. int.</th>' + 
				N'<th width="7%">Tem stock</th>' +  
				N'<th width="7%">Saidas auto</th>' +  
				N'<th width="10%">Unid</th>' + 
				N'<th width="10%">Stock</th>' + 
			N'</tr>' + CHAR(10); 

		SELECT @table = CONVERT(nvarchar(max), 
								(select 
									[@bgcolor] = (case when ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by TP_NOME, P_NOME)%2 = 1 then  '#d3d3d3' else 'white' end),
									'',
									td = TP_NOME,
									'',
									td = p_id,
									'',
									td = p_nome,
									'',
									td = case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = case when P_TEM_STOCK = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = case when P_SAIDAS_AUTO = 0 then '-' else 'Sim' end,
									'',
									td = UNI_NOME,
									'',
									td = case when P_TEM_STOCK = 1 then cast(isnull(st.stock,0) as nvarchar(max)) else '-' end
								from
									@p
									INNER JOIN produto ON pId = P_ID
									inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
									inner join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID
									left join (select a.P_ID as id, round(sum(a.Stock),2) as stock from dbo.produto_stocks_por_armazem a group by a.P_ID) st on P_ID = st.id
								where 
									P_ACTIVO = 1
									and P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
								order by TP_NOME, P_NOME
								FOR XML PATH(N'tr'), TYPE)); 

		if (@table is not null)
		begin
			SET @body = @html + @table + CHAR(10) + N'</table></font></body></html>';

			set @subject = 'Verificação de dados/stocks de alguns produtos do armazem: ' + @armNome

			--exec SendMail 
			--	@De ='nelo.production.div@gmail.com', 
			--	@Para = @eEmail,
			--	@CC = 'nunandre@gmail.com',
			--	@BCC = null,
			--	@Assunto = @subject,
			--	@Texto = @body, 
			--	@HTML = 1, 
			--	@SourceErro = null, 
			--	@MsgErro = null, 
			--	@Anexo = null

			select @eEmail mail, @subject subj, @body body, @table tab 
		end

		update @resp set visto = 1 where eId = @eId and armId = @armId
		delete @p
	end

	--update variaveis set var_valor = cast(case when cast(@varVerificacao as int) < 9 then cast(@varVerificacao as int) + 1 else 0 end as nvarchar(max)) where var_id = 1
END
```

#### `dbo.TesteStock_2Escolha_Lista`(@tipo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TesteStock_2Escolha_Lista]

@tipo int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		of_id as OrdFab, p.p_nome as Modelo, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as CorDeck, p2.p_nome as CorCasco, 
		of_oftu_id, e_nome as Cliente, fp_id, of_pago, of_datapagamento, of_referencia as Referencia,
		(select top 1 convert(nvarchar(max),tr_data,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(tr_descricao,'') 
				from transporte left join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
				where trof_of_id = of_id and trof_enviado = 1 order by tr_data desc) as UltTR,
		of_tr_id
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join 
		--produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id inner join 
		entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where 
		of_oftu_id = @tipo 
	order by 
		e_nome, fp_id desc, p.p_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.TesteStock_2Escolha_Upd`(@OF_ID int, @OF_EOF_ID int, @OF_REFERENCIA nvarchar(max), @OF_OFTU_ID int, @OF_DATAPAGAMENTO datetime, @OF_PAGO bit, @of_tr_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TesteStock_2Escolha_Upd]

@OF_ID int,
@OF_EOF_ID INT,
@OF_REFERENCIA NVARCHAR(MAX),
@OF_OFTU_ID INT,
@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO DATETIME = NULL,
@OF_PAGO BIT,
@of_tr_id int = null


AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION

exec dbo.Transportes_Add_OF @OF_ID, @of_tr_id

if (@OF_OFTU_ID = 100000) set @OF_OFTU_ID = null

Update ORDEMFABRICO 
set
OF_FP_ID=@OF_EOF_ID,
OF_REFERENCIA=@OF_REFERENCIA,
OF_OFTU_ID=@OF_OFTU_ID,
OF_DATAPAGAMENTO=@OF_DATAPAGAMENTO,
OF_PAGO=@OF_PAGO
where
OF_ID = @OF_ID

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.TintasAcabamento`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2025-02-04 16:33 · modificado 2025-04-21 10:23* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `v_of`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TintasAcabamento]
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @TincomilGeral table(of_id int, p_nome nvarchar(max), of_referencia nvarchar(max), of_parapintarfora bit, of_ral_main nvarchar(max), of_ral_sec nvarchar(max), visto bit, of_fp_id int)

	declare @Tincomil table(Ral nvarchar(max), Qtd float, QtdNaoLaminados float)

	insert into @TincomilGeral
	select 
		of_id, p_nome, of_referencia, of_parapintarfora, of_ral_main, of_ral_sec, 0, of_fp_id
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID 
	where 
		(len(OF_RAL_MAIN ) > 1 
		or len(OF_RAL_SEC) > 1)
		and of_fp_id in (32,11,71,78,20,21,51,18,36,1,67,54,2,6,3,28,4,53,47)
	
	while exists(select * from @TincomilGeral where visto = 0)
	begin
		declare @princ nvarchar(max), @sec nvarchar(max), @ofId int, @ofFpId int

		select top 1 @ofId = of_id, @princ = of_ral_main, @sec = of_ral_sec, @ofFpId = of_fp_id from @TincomilGeral where visto = 0

		-- inserir noutra tabela os princ e sec separados pelo ";"
		if (len(@princ) > 1)
			insert into @Tincomil(Ral, Qtd, QtdNaoLaminados)
			select ltrim(rtrim(REPLACE(REPLACE(a.Number, CHAR(13),' '), CHAR(10),' '))), 1, case when @ofFpId = 11 then 1 else 0 end from dbo.fn_SplitStr(@princ, ';') a
		if (len(@sec) > 1)
			insert into @Tincomil(Ral, Qtd, QtdNaoLaminados)
			select ltrim(rtrim(REPLACE(REPLACE(a.Number, CHAR(13),' '), CHAR(10),' '))), 0.3, case when @ofFpId = 11 then 0.3 else 0 end from dbo.fn_SplitStr(@sec, ';') a

		update @TincomilGeral set visto = 1 where of_id = @ofId
	end

	insert into @Tincomil(Ral, Qtd)
	select '7035', sum(mov_quantidade) from movimento inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id where mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_p_id = 50934 and of_fp_id in (32,11,71,78,20,21,51,18,36,1,67,54,2,6,3,28,4,53,47)

	--select * from @Tincomil

	select 
		ltrim(rtrim(a.Ral)) Ral, b.P_ID IdProduto, b.p_nome Produto, isnull(b.Entradas,0) - isnull(b.Saidas,0) Stock, sum(a.Qtd) Qtd, isnull(sum(a.QtdNaoLaminados),0) QtdNaoLaminados, 
			isnull(round(pedidos.qtd,2),0) as Pedido, 
			isnull(round(pedidos.qtd_porAprovar,2),0) as PedidoPorAprovar
	from 
		@Tincomil a 
		outer apply (select top 1 * 
					from 
						produto 
						cross apply (select mov_p_id id, sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then mov_quantidade else 0 end) Entradas, sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then mov_quantidade else 0 end) Saidas 
										from movimento where mov_p_id = p_id group by mov_p_id) x 
										where p_tp_id = 449 and p_activo = 1 and p_descontinuado = 0 and p_nome like '%' + ltrim(rtrim(a.Ral)) + '%') b
		left join (select 
						p.mov_p_id, p.mov_e_id, cast(min(mov_data_aprovado) as date) as dtt, 
						sum(case when mov_data_aprovado is not null then p.mov_quantidade - isnull(ent.entQtd,0) else 0 end) as qtd, 
						sum(case when mov_data_aprovado is null then p.mov_quantidade - isnull(ent.entQtd,0) else 0 end) as qtd_porAprovar
					from 
						movimento as p 
						outer apply (select sum(MOV_QUANTIDADE) as entQtd from movimento m where m.MOV_MOV_ID = p.MOV_ID) ent
					where 
						p.mov_tpmov_id = 9 and p.MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 
					group by p.mov_p_id, p.mov_e_id, ent.entQtd) pedidos on b.p_id = pedidos.MOV_P_ID
	where 
		len(ltrim(rtrim(a.Ral))) > 1 
	group by	
		ltrim(rtrim(a.Ral)), b.P_ID, b.p_nome, isnull(b.Entradas,0) - isnull(b.Saidas,0) , isnull(round(pedidos.qtd,2),0), isnull(round(pedidos.qtd_porAprovar,2),0)
	order by 
		ltrim(rtrim(a.Ral))
END
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OF_Detalhe`(@of_id int, @offp_fp_id int, @offp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-03-09 13:28* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OF_Detalhe]

@of_id int = null,
@offp_fp_id int = null,
@offp_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
if (@offp_id is null and @offp_fp_id is not null)
	select
		 fp_nome
		,e_nome
		,of_supervisao
		,of_id
		,p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as modelo
		,dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores --,p1.p_nome as deck ,p2.p_nome as casco
		,of_observacoes
		,offp_datainicio
		,offp_datafim
		,fp.offpeq_e_id as responsavel
		,fp1.offpeq_e_id as assistente
		,offp_peso
		,offp_peso_deck_ant
		,offp_peso_deck_dp
		,offp_peso_casco_ant
		,offp_peso_casco_dp
		,offp_problemas
		,offp_observacoes
		,molde.offp_of_id_mld as of_of_id_mld
		, q.MOV_ID as resina_mov_id
		, q.MOV_P_ID as resina_Id
		,coalesce(q.mov_quantidade,0) as resina
		,(case when p.p_qtd_resina > 0 then p.p_qtd_resina else coalesce(q.comp_quantidade, 0) end) as comp_quantidade
		,coalesce(q.mov_qtd_bal,0) as mov_qtd_bal
		,offp_id
		, p.p_qtddeck_real as p_qtddeck_real --,(case when p1.p_nome like '%Clear%' then p.p_qtddeck_real_trans else p.p_qtddeck_real end) as p_qtddeck_real
		,round(offp_peso_deck_dp - offp_peso_deck_ant,2) as peso_deck
		,p.p_qtdcasco_real as p_qtdcasco_real --,(case when p2.p_nome like '%Clear%' then p.p_qtdcasco_real_trans else p.p_qtdcasco_real end) p_qtdcasco_real
		,round(offp_peso_casco_dp - offp_peso_casco_ant,2) as peso_casco, coalesce(p500.qtd,0) as p5, coalesce(p250.qtd,0) as p25, coalesce(p100.qtd,0) as p1
		,of_p_id_topo_fr, of_p_id_topo_tr, of_p_id_lateral_fr, of_p_id_lateral_tr, of_p_id_quinas, of_p_id_quinas_tr, of_p_id_gola, offp_offpcl_id, offp_horas_rep, 
		offp_controlo, offp_temperatura, offp_humidade
		,p.p_pesolam, p.p_pesoacab, of_acerto_resina, p.p_dif_ideal_pa_d, p.p_dif_ideal_pa_lx, p.p_dif_ideal_lx_acab, coalesce(pesoAnt.peso,0) as peso, offp_return, coalesce(atch.atchs,0) as anexos, fp_id,
		p.p_id, e_id, isnull(molde.util,0) as of_numutil, molde.estado as estadoMolde
	from
		ordemfabrico as o1 inner join 
		entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join
		produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id cross apply -- inner join
		(select top 1 offp_id as id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id and offp_datafim is null and offp_of_id = of_id order by offp_ordem) as fpp inner join
		of_fp on fpp.id = offp_id left join
		offp_eq as fp on offp_id = fp.offpeq_offp_id and fp.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
		offp_eq as fp1 on offp_id = fp1.offpeq_offp_id and fp1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id inner join
		fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id left join 
		(select 
				m1.mov_id, m1.mov_p_id, m1.mov_quantidade, m1.mov_of_id, comp_quantidade, m1.mov_qtd_bal
			from 
				movimento as m 
				inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id 
				inner join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id 
				inner join produto as p3 on m.mov_p_id = p3.p_id 
				inner join produto_componente on p3.p_id = comp_p_id --and comp_p_p_id = p1.P_ID --in (21399,20448,27484)
				inner join produto as p2 on comp_p_p_id = p2.p_id 
			where 
				p3.p_tp_id = 84 
				and p1.P_TP_ID = 288 
				and p2.P_TP_ID = 288) as q on of_id = q.mov_of_id left join
		(select mov_of_id, mov_quantidade as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 26037) as p500 on of_id = p500.mov_of_id left join
		(select mov_of_id, mov_quantidade as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 26036) as p250 on of_id = p250.mov_of_id left join
		(select mov_of_id, mov_quantidade as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 22676) as p100 on of_id = p100.mov_of_id left join
		(select offp_of_id, offp_peso as peso from of_fp where offp_fp_id = (case when @offp_fp_id in (5,33) then 6 when @offp_fp_id = 22 then 5 end)) as pesoAnt on of_id = pesoAnt.offp_of_id
		left join (select atch_of_id, count(atch_id) as atchs from of_attach group by atch_of_id) as atch on of_id = atch.atch_of_id
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id, offp_of_id_mld, o.of_numutil as util, o.of_fp_id as estado from of_fp inner join ordemfabrico as o on offp_of_id_mld = of_id where offp_fp_id in (1,67) and offp_of_id = o1.of_id order by offp_datafim desc) as molde
	where
		of_id = @of_id
		and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
else if (@offp_id is not null)
	select
		 fp_nome
		,e_nome
		,of_supervisao
		,of_id
		,p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as modelo
		,dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores --,p1.p_nome as deck ,p2.p_nome as casco
		,of_observacoes
		,offp_datainicio
		,offp_datafim
		,fp.offpeq_e_id as responsavel
		,fp1.offpeq_e_id as assistente
		,offp_peso
		,offp_peso_deck_ant
		,offp_peso_deck_dp
		,offp_peso_casco_ant
		,offp_peso_casco_dp
		,offp_problemas
		,offp_observacoes
		,molde.offp_of_id_mld as of_of_id_mld
		, q.MOV_ID as resina_mov_id
		, q.MOV_P_ID as resina_Id
		,coalesce(q.mov_quantidade,0) as resina
		,(case when p.p_qtd_resina > 0 then p.p_qtd_resina else coalesce(q.comp_quantidade, 0) end) as comp_quantidade
		,coalesce(q.mov_qtd_bal,0) as mov_qtd_bal
		,offp_id
		, p.p_qtddeck_real as p_qtddeck_real --,(case when p1.p_nome like '%Clear%' then p.p_qtddeck_real_trans else p.p_qtddeck_real end) as p_qtddeck_real
		,round(offp_peso_deck_dp - offp_peso_deck_ant,2) as peso_deck
		,p.p_qtdcasco_real as p_qtdcasco_real --,(case when p2.p_nome like '%Clear%' then p.p_qtdcasco_real_trans else p.p_qtdcasco_real end) p_qtdcasco_real
		,round(offp_peso_casco_dp - offp_peso_casco_ant,2) as peso_casco, coalesce(p500.qtd,0) as p5, coalesce(p250.qtd,0) as p25, coalesce(p100.qtd,0) as p1
		,of_p_id_topo_fr, of_p_id_topo_tr, of_p_id_lateral_fr, of_p_id_lateral_tr, of_p_id_quinas, of_p_id_quinas_tr, of_p_id_gola, offp_offpcl_id, offp_horas_rep, 
		offp_controlo, offp_temperatura, offp_humidade
		,p.p_pesolam, p.p_pesoacab, of_acerto_resina, p.p_dif_ideal_pa_d, p.p_dif_ideal_pa_lx, p.p_dif_ideal_lx_acab, coalesce(pesoAnt.peso,0) as peso, offp_return, coalesce(atch.atchs,0) as anexos, fp_id,
		p.p_id, e_id, isnull(molde.util,0) as of_numutil, molde.estado as estadoMolde
	from
		ordemfabrico as o1 inner join 
		entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join
		produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id left join
		offp_eq as fp on offp_id = fp.offpeq_offp_id and fp.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
		offp_eq as fp1 on offp_id = fp1.offpeq_offp_id and fp1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id inner join
		fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id left join 
		(select 
				m1.mov_id, m1.mov_p_id, m1.mov_quantidade, m1.mov_of_id, comp_quantidade, m1.mov_qtd_bal
			from 
				movimento as m 
				inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id 
				inner join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id 
				inner join produto as p3 on m.mov_p_id = p3.p_id 
				inner join produto_componente on p3.p_id = comp_p_id --and comp_p_p_id = p1.P_ID --in (21399,20448,27484)
				inner join produto as p2 on comp_p_p_id = p2.p_id 
			where 
				p3.p_tp_id = 84 
				and p1.P_TP_ID = 288 
				and p2.P_TP_ID = 288) as q on of_id = q.mov_of_id left join
		(select mov_of_id, mov_quantidade as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 26037) as p500 on of_id = p500.mov_of_id left join
		(select mov_of_id, mov_quantidade as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 26036) as p250 on of_id = p250.mov_of_id left join
		(select mov_of_id, mov_quantidade as qtd from movimento where mov_p_id = 22676) as p100 on of_id = p100.mov_of_id left join
		(select offp_of_id, offp_peso as peso from of_fp where offp_fp_id = (case when @offp_fp_id in (5,33) then 6 when @offp_fp_id = 22 then 5 end)) as pesoAnt on of_id = pesoAnt.offp_of_id
		left join (select atch_of_id, count(atch_id) as atchs from of_attach group by atch_of_id) as atch on of_id = atch.atch_of_id
		outer apply (select top 1 offp_of_id, offp_of_id_mld, o.of_numutil as util, o.of_fp_id as estado from of_fp inner join ordemfabrico as o on offp_of_id_mld = of_id where offp_fp_id  in (1,67) and offp_of_id = o1.of_id order by offp_datafim desc) as molde
	where
		offp_id = @offp_id
else if @offp_id is null
begin
	set @offp_fp_id = (select of_fp_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	select
		 fp_nome
		,e_nome
		,of_supervisao
		,of_id
		,p.p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as modelo
		,dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores --,p1.p_nome as deck ,p2.p_nome as casco
		,of_observacoes
		,offp_datainicio
		,offp_datafim
		,fp.offpeq_e_id as responsavel
		,fp1.offpeq_e_id as assistente
		,offp_peso
		,offp_peso_deck_ant
		,offp_peso_deck_dp
		,offp_peso_casco_ant
		,offp_peso_casco_dp
		,offp_problemas
		,offp_observacoes
		,of_of_id_mld
		,offp_offpcl_id, offp_horas_rep, offp_controlo, offp_temperatura, offp_humidade
		,p.p_pesolam, p.p_pesoacab, of_acerto_resina, p.p_dif_ideal_pa_d, p.p_dif_ideal_pa_lx, p.p_dif_ideal_lx_acab, fp_id,
		p.p_id, e_id, 0 as of_numutil
	from
		ordemfabrico inner join 
		entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join
		produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join
		--produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id inner join
		of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id left join
		offp_eq as fp on offp_id = fp.offpeq_offp_id and fp.offpeq_chefe = 1 left join
		offp_eq as fp1 on offp_id = fp1.offpeq_offp_id and fp1.offpeq_chefe = 0 inner join
		fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
	where
		of_id = @of_id
		and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
end

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmp_ListaAcessorios]

@of_id int,
@fp_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

--    select 
--		mov_id, tp_id, tp_nome, p_nome, mov_quantidade
--	from 
--		movimento inner join 
--		produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join 
--		produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
--	where 
--		mov_of_id = @of_id and tp_fp_id = @fp_id and tp_editavel = 1
--	order by 
--		tp_nome, p_nome

	select 
		mov_id, tp_id, tp_nome, p_nome, coalesce(mov_quantidade, 0) as mov_quantidade
	from 
		(select tp_id, tp_nome from produto_tipo where tp_fp_id = @fp_id and tp_editavel = 1) as tp left join
		(select mov_id, p_tp_id, p_nome, mov_quantidade from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_of_id = @of_id) as m on tp.tp_id = m.p_tp_id
	order by 
		tp_nome, p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OFsEmp_ListaEmps_Teste`(@fp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `molde`

```sql
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmp_ListaEmps_Teste]

@fp_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@fp_id in (6,18)) -- Pintor/Desmoldador (-1, 6, 11)
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 6, 11) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome
	else if (@fp_id in (1,11)) -- Laminagem (-1, 5, 11, 16)
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 5, 11, 16) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome
	else if (@fp_id = 4) -- Colador (-1, 9, 11)
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 9, 11) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome
	else if (@fp_id in (5,7)) -- Pintor Acab. (-1, 9, 11)
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 34, 11) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome
	else if (@fp_id = 22) -- Lixagem/ Pq Desmolde (-1, 26, 11)
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 35, 26, 11) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome
	else if (@fp_id = 8) -- Montador (-1, 7, 26, 11)
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 37, 11) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome
	else if (@fp_id = 3) -- Cortador/Preparador de Barcos (-1, 7, 26, 11)
		select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 7, 26, 11) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome
	else if (@fp_id = 33) -- Acabador (-1, 7, 26, 11)
			select e_id, e_nome from entidade where e_ent_id in (-1, 7, 26, 11) and e_activo = 1 order by e_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OFsEmp_Pega`(@of_id int, @offp_fp_id int, @pegar bit, @pecas bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmp_Pega]

@of_id int,
@offp_fp_id int,
@pegar bit,
@pecas bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@offp_fp_id = 18) -- Pintura
	begin
		-- Fim de Não laminado
		if (@pegar = 1)
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 11
		-- Inicio da Pintura
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 18
		-- Actualiza OF para Pintura
		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 18 where of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id in (1,2)) -- Laminagem/Cura
	begin
		-- Inicio de Fase
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id in (4,5)) -- Colagem/Pintura Acabamento
	begin
		-- Fim de Corte
		if (@pegar = 1)
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 3 and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 4 and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null
		end

		-- Inicio de Colagem/Pintura Acabamento
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
		-- Actualiza OF para Colagem
		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = (case when @pegar = 1 then @offp_fp_id else of_fp_id end) where of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id = 6) --Desmolde
	begin
		-- Fim de Estufa
		if (@pegar = 1)
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 2
		-- Inicio de Desmolde
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 6
		-- Actualiza OF para Desmolde
		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 6 where of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id in (8,22)) -- Acabamento
	begin
		-- Fim de Parque Acabamento
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end), offp_pecas = @pecas where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 7
		-- Inicio de Acabamento
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end), offp_pecas = @pecas where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
		-- Actualiza OF para Acabamento
		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = (case when @pegar = 1 then @offp_fp_id else 7 end) where of_id = @of_id

		if ((select offp_controlo from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 8) = 1)
			raiserror('Falar com o Responsável antes de começar a mexer no barco!!', 16, 1)
	end

	set @offp_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id)

	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @offp_fp_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OFsEmp_Pega_V01`(@of_id int, @offp_fp_id int, @pegar bit, @pecas bit)

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmp_Pega_V01]

@of_id int,
@offp_fp_id int,
@pegar bit,
@pecas bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    if (@offp_fp_id = 18) -- Pintura
	begin
		-- Fim de Não laminado
		if (@pegar = 1)
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 11
		-- Inicio da Pintura
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 18
		-- Actualiza OF para Pintura
		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 18 where of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id in (1,2)) -- Laminagem/Cura
	begin
		-- Inicio de Fase
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id in (4,5)) -- Colagem/Pintura Acabamento
	begin
		-- Fim de Corte
		if (@pegar = 1)
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 3 and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null
			if @offp_fp_id = 5
				update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 4 and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null
			if @offp_fp_id = 4
				update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null
		end

		-- Inicio de Colagem/Pintura Acabamento
		if @pecas = 0 and @offp_fp_id = 4
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = null, offp_datafim = null where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 7

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 7 where of_id = @of_id
		end
		else if @pecas = 1 and @offp_fp_id = 4
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = coalesce(offp_datainicio, getdate()), offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 7

			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 7 where of_id = @of_id
		end
		else
		begin
			update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
			-- Actualiza OF para Colagem
			update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = (case when @pegar = 1 then @offp_fp_id else of_fp_id end) where of_id = @of_id
		end
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id = 6) --Desmolde
	begin
		-- Fim de Estufa
		if (@pegar = 1)
			update of_fp set offp_datafim = getdate() where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 2
		-- Inicio de Desmolde
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end) where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 6
		-- Actualiza OF para Desmolde
		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = 6 where of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id in (8,22)) -- Acabamento
	begin
		-- Fim de Parque Acabamento
		update of_fp set offp_datafim = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end), offp_pecas = @pecas where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 7
		-- Inicio de Acabamento
		update of_fp set offp_datainicio = (case when @pegar = 1 then getdate() else null end), offp_pecas = @pecas where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = @offp_fp_id
		-- Actualiza OF para Acabamento
		update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = (case when @pegar = 1 then @offp_fp_id else 7 end) where of_id = @of_id

		if ((select offp_controlo from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 8) = 1)
			raiserror('Falar com o Responsável antes de começar a mexer no barco!!', 16, 1)
	end

	set @offp_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id)

	exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @offp_fp_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OFsEmp_Upd`(@of_id int, @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @responsavel int, @assistente int, @of_of_id_mld int, @offp_peso float, @offp_peso_deck_ant float, @offp_peso_deck_dp float, @offp_peso_casco_ant float, @offp_peso_casco_dp float, @resina_qtd float, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @of_supervisao bit, @offp_fp_id int, @mov_qtd_bal float, @p500 int, @p250 int, @p100 int, @offp_offpcl_id int, @offp_horas_rep float, @offp_controlo bit, @offp_pinturatemp float, @offp_pinturahumid float, @offp_id int, @resina_p_id int, @resina_mov_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-11-26 14:07* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`, `peso`, `molde`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmp_Upd]

@of_id int,
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null,
@responsavel int = null,
@assistente int = null,
@of_of_id_mld int = null,
@offp_peso float = 0,
@offp_peso_deck_ant float = 0,
@offp_peso_deck_dp float = 0,
@offp_peso_casco_ant float = 0,
@offp_peso_casco_dp float = 0,
@resina_qtd float = 0,
@offp_problemas nvarchar(max) = '',
@offp_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@of_supervisao bit = 0,
@offp_fp_id int,
@mov_qtd_bal float = 0,
@p500 int = 0,
@p250 int = 0,
@p100 int = 0,
@offp_offpcl_id int = null,
@offp_horas_rep float = 0,
@offp_controlo bit = 0,
@offp_pinturatemp float = 0, 
@offp_pinturahumid float = 0,
@offp_id int = null,
@resina_p_id int = null,
@resina_mov_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and @of_supervisao = 1 and @offp_datafim is not null) -- Acabamento/Acabamento Pintura
	raiserror('Peça a um Superior para visturiar esta Ordem de Fabrico!!!',16,1)
else if (@offp_fp_id = 18 and @offp_datafim is not null and (@offp_peso_deck_ant = 0 or @offp_peso_deck_dp = 0 or @offp_peso_casco_ant = 0 or @offp_peso_casco_dp = 0)) -- Pintura
	raiserror('Tem de preencher os pesos do molde!!!',16,1)
else if (@offp_fp_id = 6 and @offp_datafim is not null and (@offp_peso = 0 or @of_of_id_mld is null)) -- Desmolde
	raiserror('Tem de preencher o peso do barco e o molde!!!',16,1)
else if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and @offp_datafim is not null and @offp_peso = 0) -- Acabamento/Acabamento Pintura
	raiserror('Tem de preencher o peso do barco!!!',16,1)
else
begin

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase @of_id, @offp_fp_id, @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_peso, @offp_problemas, @responsavel, @assistente, @offp_id, @offp_observacoes, @offp_peso_deck_ant, @offp_peso_deck_dp, @offp_peso_casco_ant, @offp_peso_casco_dp, @offp_offpcl_id, @offp_horas_rep, @offp_pinturatemp, @offp_pinturahumid, @offp_controlo

	if (@offp_fp_id = 1)
	begin
		if @resina_mov_id is not null
		begin
			declare @mov_mov_id int, @tpMov int = case when @offp_datafim is null then 4 else 11 end
			select @mov_mov_id = mov_mov_id from MOVIMENTO where MOV_ID = @resina_mov_id
			exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio_V2 @p_id = @resina_p_id, @qtd = @resina_qtd, @of_id = @of_id, @mov_id = @resina_mov_id, @tpmov_id = @tpMov, @mov_mov_id = @mov_mov_id

			update MOVIMENTO set MOV_QTD_BAL = @mov_qtd_bal where MOV_OF_ID = @of_id and MOV_P_ID = @resina_p_id and MOV_QUANTIDADE = @resina_qtd
		end
		else
			begin
				declare @resina int, @mov int
				select @mov = m.mov_id, @resina = m.mov_p_id 
						from movimento as m inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto as p on m1.mov_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on m.mov_p_id = p1.p_id
								where /*m.mov_p_id in (21399,20448,27484) and*/ m.mov_of_id = @of_id and p.p_tp_id = 84 and p1.p_tp_id = 288


				if (@resina is not null and @resina_qtd > 0)
				begin
					exec produtosassociados_upd @resina, @resina_qtd, @of_id

					update movimento set mov_qtd_bal = @mov_qtd_bal where mov_id = @mov
				end
				else if (@resina_qtd > 0)
					exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @resina, @resina_qtd, @of_id, 288
			end
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and @offp_datafim is not null)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_datafim = @offp_datafim where of_id = @of_id	
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id = 6 and @offp_datafim is not null)
	begin 
		if (select of_supervisaolaminagem from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id) = 1
		begin
			declare @txt nvarchar(max), @txt_link nvarchar(max)
			set @txt = 'Supervisão: foi desmoldada a OF: ' + convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id)
			set @txt_link = '<a href="http://agents.nelo.eu/ReportServer$SQLEXPRESS/Pages/ReportViewer.aspx?%2fReports+MAR-Kayaks_New%2fOrdemfabrico&rs:Command=Render&of_id='  + convert(nvarchar(max),@of_id) + '">Ver OF!!</a>'
		
			exec dbo.SendMail 'desmolde@gmail.com', 'eduardojppinto@hotmail.com', NULL, 'nunandre@gmail.com', @txt, @txt_link, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL
		end
	end

	if (@offp_fp_id in (8,22,33))
	begin
		exec OF_Pesos125 @of_id, @p500, @p250, @p100
	end

	declare @util int

	if (@offp_fp_id = 6 and @offp_datafim is not null)
	begin
		set @offp_fp_id = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))

		update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil + 1 where of_id = @of_of_id_mld
		
		set @util = (select of_numutil from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_of_id_mld)
	end

	set @offp_fp_id = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))
	update of_fp set offp_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 1 and offp_datafim is null and offp_data_prevista is not null
	update ordemfabrico set of_fp_id = @offp_fp_id where of_id = @of_id
	
	if @offp_datafim is not null
		exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @offp_fp_id

	if (@util >= 5)
		select rep = 1
	else
		select rep = 0
end

END
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OFsEmp_Upd_Teste`(@of_id int, @offp_datainicio smalldatetime, @offp_datafim smalldatetime, @responsavel int, @assistente int, @of_of_id_mld int, @offp_peso float, @offp_peso_deck_ant float, @offp_peso_deck_dp float, @offp_peso_casco_ant float, @offp_peso_casco_dp float, @resina_qtd float, @offp_problemas nvarchar(max), @offp_observacoes nvarchar(max), @of_supervisao bit, @offp_fp_id int, @mov_qtd_bal float, @p500 int, @p250 int, @p100 int, @offp_offpcl_id int, @offp_horas_rep float, @offp_controlo bit, @offp_pinturatemp float, @offp_pinturahumid float)

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmp_Upd_Teste]

@of_id int,
@offp_datainicio smalldatetime = null,
@offp_datafim smalldatetime = null,
@responsavel int = null,
@assistente int = null,
@of_of_id_mld int = null,
@offp_peso float = 0,
@offp_peso_deck_ant float = 0,
@offp_peso_deck_dp float = 0,
```
