```sql
@p500 int = 0,
@p250 int = 0,
@p100 int = 0,
@offp_offpcl_id int = null,
@offp_horas_rep float = 0,
@offp_controlo bit = 0,
@offp_pinturatemp float = 0, 
@offp_pinturahumid float = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and @of_supervisao = 1 and @offp_datafim is not null) -- Acabamento/Acabamento Pintura
	raiserror('Peça a um Superior para visturiar esta Ordem de Fabrico!!!',16,1)
else if (@offp_fp_id = 18 and @offp_datafim is not null and (@offp_peso_deck_ant = 0 or @offp_peso_deck_dp = 0 or @offp_peso_casco_ant = 0 or @offp_peso_casco_dp = 0)) -- Pintura
	raiserror('Tem de preencher os pesos do molde!!!',16,1)
else if (@offp_fp_id = 6 and @offp_datafim is not null and (@offp_peso = 0 or @of_of_id_mld is null)) -- Desmolde
	raiserror('Tem de preencher o peso do barco e o molde!!!',16,1)
else if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and @offp_datafim is not null and @offp_peso = 0) -- Acabamento/Acabamento Pintura
	raiserror('Tem de preencher o peso do barco!!!',16,1)
else
begin

	if (@offp_fp_id = 1)
	begin
		declare @resina int, @mov int
		select @mov = m.mov_id, @resina = m.mov_p_id 
				from movimento as m inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto on m1.mov_p_id = p_id
						where m.mov_p_id in (21399,20448,27484) and m.mov_of_id = @of_id and p_tp_id = 84

		if (@resina is not null and @resina_qtd > 0)
		begin
			exec produtosassociados_upd @resina, @resina_qtd, @of_id
			update movimento set mov_qtd_bal = @mov_qtd_bal where mov_id = @mov
		end
		else if (@resina_qtd > 0)
			exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio @resina, @resina_qtd, @of_id, 57
	end
	else if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and @offp_datafim is not null)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_datafim = @offp_datafim where of_id = @of_id
	end

	------else if (@offp_fp_id = 6 and @offp_datainicio is not null)
	------begin
	------	update of_fp set offp_datafim = @offp_datainicio where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 2 and offp_datafim is null
	------	--update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datainicio, offp_datafim = @offp_datainicio where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 3
	------end

	------if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and exists(select * from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 9 and offp_datafim is null and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datainicio <> @offp_datafim)))
	------	update of_fp set offp_datainicio = @offp_datafim where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 9 and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datainicio <> @offp_datafim) and offp_datafim is null
	------else if (@offp_fp_id = 8 and @offp_datafim is not null)

	exec OrdemFabrico_UpdateFase_teste @of_id, @offp_fp_id, @offp_datainicio, @offp_datafim, @offp_peso, @offp_problemas, @responsavel, @assistente, null, @offp_observacoes, @offp_peso_deck_ant, @offp_peso_deck_dp, @offp_peso_casco_ant, @offp_peso_casco_dp, @offp_offpcl_id, @offp_horas_rep, @offp_pinturatemp, @offp_pinturahumid, @offp_controlo

	if (@offp_fp_id in (8,22,33))
	begin
		declare @mov_500 int, @mov_250 int, @mov_100 int
		--Pesos 500
		set @mov_500 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 20425)
		if (@mov_500 is not null and @p500 > 0)
			exec produtosassociados_upd 20425, @p500, @of_id, @mov_500
		else if (@mov_500 is null and @p500 > 0)
			exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 20425, @p500, @of_id, 101
		else if (@mov_500 is not null and @p500 = 0)
			exec produtosassociados_del 20425, @of_id, @mov_500

		--Pesos 250
		set @mov_250 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 20424)
		if (@mov_250 is not null and @p250 > 0)
			exec produtosassociados_upd 20424, @p250, @of_id, @mov_250
		else if (@mov_250 is null and @p250 > 0)
			exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 20424, @p250, @of_id, 101
		else if (@mov_250 is not null and @p250 = 0)
			exec produtosassociados_del 20424, @of_id, @mov_250

		--Pesos 100
		set @mov_100 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 22676)
		if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 > 0)
			exec produtosassociados_upd 22676, @p100, @of_id, @mov_100 -- Psos de 100g = 20423
		else if (@mov_100 is null and @p100 > 0)
			exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 22676, @p100, @of_id, 101
		else if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 = 0)
			exec produtosassociados_del 22676, @of_id, @mov_100
	end

	declare @util int

	if (@offp_fp_id = 6)
	begin
		set @offp_fp_id = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))

		update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil + 1 where of_id = @of_of_id_mld
		
		set @util = (select of_numutil from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_of_id_mld)
	end

	set @offp_fp_id = (select dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id))
	update ordemfabrico set of_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld, of_fp_id = @offp_fp_id where of_id = @of_id

	if @offp_datafim is not null
		exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @offp_fp_id

	if (@util >= 5)
		select rep = 1
	else
		select rep = 0
end

END
```

```sql
else
begin

	else if (@offp_fp_id in (8,22) and @offp_datafim is not null)
		insert into of_fp (offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offp_datainicio) values (@of_id, 9, @offp_datafim)

	if (@offp_fp_id in (8,22))
	begin
		declare @mov_500 int, @mov_250 int, @mov_100 int
		--Pesos 500
		set @mov_500 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 20425)
		if (@mov_500 is not null and @p500 > 0)
			exec produtosassociados_upd 20425, @p500, @of_id, @mov_500
		else if (@mov_500 is null and @p500 > 0)
			exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 20425, @p500, @of_id, 101
		else if (@mov_500 is not null and @p500 = 0)
			exec produtosassociados_del 20425, @of_id, @mov_500

		--Pesos 250
		set @mov_250 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 20424)
		if (@mov_250 is not null and @p250 > 0)
			exec produtosassociados_upd 20424, @p250, @of_id, @mov_250
		else if (@mov_250 is null and @p250 > 0)
			exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 20424, @p250, @of_id, 101
		else if (@mov_250 is not null and @p250 = 0)
			exec produtosassociados_del 20424, @of_id, @mov_250

		--Pesos 100
		set @mov_100 = (select mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_p_id = 22676)
		if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 > 0)
			exec produtosassociados_upd 22676, @p100, @of_id, @mov_100 -- Psos de 100g = 20423
		else if (@mov_100 is null and @p100 > 0)
			exec ordemfabrico_addacessorio 22676, @p100, @of_id, 101
		else if (@mov_100 is not null and @p100 = 0)
			exec produtosassociados_del 22676, @of_id, @mov_100
	end

	declare @util int

	if (@offp_fp_id = 6)
	begin
		set @offp_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id)

		update ordemfabrico set of_numutil = of_numutil + 1, of_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld, of_fp_id = @offp_fp_id where of_id = @of_of_id_mld

		set @util = (select of_numutil from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_of_id_mld)
	end
	else
	begin
		set @offp_fp_id = dbo.VerificaEstadoOF(@of_id)

		update ordemfabrico set of_of_id_mld = @of_of_id_mld, of_fp_id = @offp_fp_id where of_id = @of_id
	end

	if @offp_datafim is not null
		exec MovimentoFase_Sai @of_id, @offp_fp_id

	if (@util >= 5)
		select rep = 1
	else
		select rep = 0
end

END
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OFsEmpregado_Lista`(@EMP_ID int, @EMP_TIPO int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-03-09 13:16* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmpregado_Lista]

@EMP_ID int,
@EMP_TIPO int = null

AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION

if @EMP_TIPO is null
	select @EMP_TIPO = e_ent_id from entidade where e_id = @EMP_ID

if @EMP_TIPO in (5,16) -- Laminadores
begin
	if (@EMP_TIPO = 16)
		select 
			(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, 
			o.of_id as ID, p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as Modelo, o1.of_nome,
			fp_nome as Estado, o.of_supervisao, (case when o.of_fp_id in (2,3,4) then 4 else o.of_fp_id end) as fp_id, o.of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, offpeq_e_id, offp_id, cl.e_nome as Cliente
		from 
			ordemfabrico as o  
			inner join produto on o.of_p_id=p_id 
			inner join of_fp on o.of_id=offp_of_id 
			left join ordemfabrico as o1 on offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id
			inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id 
			INNER JOIN fases_producao ON o.of_fp_id = fp_id 
			inner join turno on offp_turn_id = turn_id
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			inner join entidade as cl on o.of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		where 
			o.of_fp_id in (1) 
			and offp_fp_id = 1 
			and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID 
			and (o.of_id not between 70000 and 89999)
			and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		order by 
			fp_sequencia, o.of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
	else if not exists (select * from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id where of_fp_id = 1 and offp_fp_id = 1 and offp_datafim is null and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999))
		select 
			(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, o.of_id as ID, p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as Modelo, o1.of_nome,
			fp_nome as Estado, o.of_supervisao, o.of_fp_id as fp_id, o.of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, offpeq_e_id, offp_id, cl.e_nome as Cliente
		from 
			ordemfabrico as o 
			inner join produto on o.of_p_id=p_id 
			inner join of_fp on o.of_id=offp_of_id 
			left join ordemfabrico as o1 on offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id
			inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id 
			INNER JOIN fases_producao ON o.of_fp_id = fp_id 
			inner join turno on offp_turn_id = turn_id
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			inner join entidade as cl on o.of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		where 
			o.of_fp_id in (1,18) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (o.of_id not between 70000 and 89999)
			and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		order by 
			fp_sequencia, o.of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
	else
		select 
			(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, o.of_id as ID, p_nome + isnull(' **' + tpcam_nome + '**','') as Modelo, o1.of_nome,
			fp_nome as Estado, o.of_supervisao, o.of_fp_id as fp_id, o.of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, offpeq_e_id, offp_id, cl.e_nome as Cliente
		from 
			ordemfabrico as o 
			inner join produto on o.of_p_id=p_id 
			inner join of_fp on o.of_id=offp_of_id 
			left join ordemfabrico as o1 on offp_of_id_mld = o1.of_id
			inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id 
			INNER JOIN fases_producao ON o.of_fp_id = fp_id 
			inner join turno on offp_turn_id = turn_id
			left join produto_camada_tipo on offp_tpcam_id = tpcam_id
			inner join entidade as cl on o.of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		where 
			o.of_fp_id in (1) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (o.of_id not between 70000 and 89999)
			and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		order by	
			fp_sequencia, o.of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
end
else if @EMP_TIPO in (6,8) -- Pintor
begin
	If (@EMP_ID = 20696)
	begin
		select  
			(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
			fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
			(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, null as offpeq_e_id, offp_id, 
			isnull(datediff(day,offp_datainicio,getdate()),0) as tempo, cl.e_nome as Cliente
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id 
			inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
			INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
			inner join (select offp_of_id as ofid, cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as dtPrev from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (1,67) and cast(offp_data_prevista as date) between convert(varchar(10),getdate(),1) and dateadd(dd,1,getdate())) as dt on of_id = dt.ofid
			inner join entidade as cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		where of_fp_id = 11 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and OF_ID < 10000000
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		union
		select 
			(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
			fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
			(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, null as offpeq_e_id, offp_id, 
			isnull(datediff(day,offp_datainicio,getdate()),0) as tempo, cl.e_nome as Cliente
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
			inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id 
			inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
			INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
			inner join entidade as cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		where of_fp_id in (5,6,18,2,3,4,22)
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and OF_ID < 10000000
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		order by Estado, Modelo
	end
	else
	begin
		select  
			(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
			fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
			(case when of_fp_id in (11,32,51) then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, null as offpeq_e_id, offp_id, 
			isnull(datediff(day,offp_datainicio,getdate()),0) as tempo, cl.e_nome as Cliente
		from 
			ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
			INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
			inner join (select offp_of_id as ofid, cast(offp_data_prevista as date) as dtPrev from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (1,67) and cast(offp_data_prevista as date) between convert(varchar(10),getdate(),1) and dateadd(dd,7,getdate())) as dt on of_id = dt.ofid
			inner join entidade as cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		where 
			of_fp_id in (11,32,51) 
			and offp_fp_id = (case when of_fp_id in (11,32,51) then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and OF_ID < 10000000
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		union
		select 
			(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
			fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
			(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 2 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, null as offpeq_e_id, offp_id, 
			isnull(datediff(day,offp_datainicio,getdate()),0) as tempo, cl.e_nome as Cliente
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
			INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
			inner join entidade as cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		where of_fp_id in (2,6,18) --and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 2 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and OF_ID < 10000000
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		order by Estado, Modelo
	end
end
else 
begin
	select 
		(case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
		of_fp_id as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas, offpeq_e_id, offp_id, isnull(datediff(day,offp_datainicio,getdate()),0) as tempo, cl.e_nome as Cliente
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id 
		inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = of_fp_id
		left join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id 
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
		left join entidade as cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
	where 
		of_fp_id in (select efp_fp_id from entidade_fase where efp_e_id = @EMP_ID and efp_qualificado = 0 and efp_datafim is null) 
		and (
				offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID 
				or coalesce(offpeq_e_id,0) = (case when fp_lista_atribuidos = 1 then -1 else 0 end)
			)
		and (case when fp_planeamento = 1 then cast(offp_data_prevista as date) else '1900/01/01' end) = (case when fp_planeamento = 1 then cast(getdate() as date) else '1900/01/01' end)
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
	order by offpeq_e_id desc, fp_sequencia, Pegar desc, of_id
end


COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OFsEmpregado_Lista_Teste`(@EMP_ID int, @EMP_TIPO int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmpregado_Lista_Teste]

@EMP_ID int,
@EMP_TIPO int

AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION

if @EMP_TIPO in (5,16) -- Laminadores
begin
	if (@EMP_TIPO = 16)
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, o.of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, o.of_supervisao, (case when o.of_fp_id in (2,3,4) then 4 else o.of_fp_id end) as fp_id, o.of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico as o inner join ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join produto on o.of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on o.of_id=offp_of_id
		inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON o.of_fp_id = fp_id inner join turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id
		where o.of_fp_id in (1) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (o.of_id < 70000 or o.of_id > 89999)
		order by fp_sequencia, o.of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
	else if not exists (select * from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id where of_fp_id = 1 and offp_fp_id = 1 and offp_datafim is null and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999))
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, o.of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, o.of_supervisao, o.of_fp_id as fp_id, o.of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico as o inner join ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join produto on o.of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on o.of_id=offp_of_id
		inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON o.of_fp_id = fp_id inner join turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id
		where o.of_fp_id in (1,18) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (o.of_id < 70000 or o.of_id > 89999)
		order by fp_sequencia, o.of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
	else
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, o.of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, o1.of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, o.of_supervisao, o.of_fp_id as fp_id, o.of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico as o inner join ordemfabrico as o1 on o.of_of_id_mld = o1.of_id inner join produto on o.of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on o.of_id=offp_of_id
		inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON o.of_fp_id = fp_id inner join turno on o.of_turn_id = turn_id
		where o.of_fp_id in (1) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (o.of_id < 70000 or o.of_id > 89999)
		order by fp_sequencia, o.of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
end
else if @EMP_TIPO = 7 -- Acabadores
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
	(case when of_fp_id = 7 and @EMP_TIPO = 7 then 33 when of_fp_id = 7 and @EMP_TIPO = 35 then 22 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (7,33) and offp_fp_id in (33) and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO = 35 -- Lixadores
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
	(case when of_fp_id = 7 and @EMP_TIPO = 35 then 22 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (7,22) and offp_fp_id in (22) and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO = 37 -- Montadores
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
	(case when of_fp_id = 7 and @EMP_TIPO = 37 then 33 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	left join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (7,8) and offp_fp_id in (8) /*and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID*/ and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO = 34 -- Pintor Acabamento 34
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
	(case when of_fp_id = 7 and @EMP_TIPO = 34 then 5 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (7,5) and offp_fp_id in (5) and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999) and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=26 -- Preparador de Barcos
begin

	select  (case when corte.offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, of_fp_id as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, corte.offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join
	(select offp_of_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_pecas from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 3) as corte on of_id = corte.offp_of_id inner join
	(select offp_of_id, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_pecas from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 6) as desm on of_id = desm.offp_of_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where desm.offp_datafim is not null and corte.offp_datafim is null and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999) and (of_datafim is null or of_datafim = '1900-01-01')
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=6 -- Pintor
begin
	If (@EMP_ID = 20696)
	begin
		select  (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id = 11 and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
			and of_datainicio between convert(varchar(10),getdate(),1) and dateadd(dd,1,getdate())
		union
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id in (5,6,18,2,3,4,22) and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
		order by Estado, Modelo
	end
	else
	begin
		select  (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id = 11 and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
			and of_datainicio between convert(varchar(10),getdate(),1) and dateadd(dd,1,getdate())
		union
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 2 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id in (2,6,18) and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 2 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
		order by Estado, Modelo
	end
end
else if @EMP_TIPO in (9) -- Colador 9/
begin

	select 
	(case when fp1.offp_datainicio is null then 'False' when fp1.offp_datainicio is not null then 'true' end) as Pegar,
	of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo, '' as of_nome,
	fp.fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
	4 as fp_id, --(case when @EMP_TIPO = 9 then 4 else 5 end) as fp_id, 
	of_arm_id_lam
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
	INNER JOIN FASES_PRODUCAO as fp ON OF_FP_ID=fp.FP_ID left join
	(select min(offp_id) as id, offp_of_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 4 and offp_datafim is null group by offp_of_id) as fpp on of_id = fpp.offp_of_id
	left join of_fp as fp1 on fp1.offp_id = fpp.id and fp1.offp_fp_id = 4 and fp1.offp_datafim is null
	where of_fp_id = 4 and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by of_id

end


COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OFsEmpregado_Lista_V01]

@EMP_ID int,
@EMP_TIPO int

AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION

if @EMP_TIPO in (5,16) -- Laminadores
begin
	if (@EMP_TIPO = 16)
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, (case when of_fp_id in (2,3,4) then 4 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id inner join turno on of_turn_id = turn_id
		where of_fp_id in (1,2,3,4) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
		order by fp_sequencia, of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
	else if not exists (select * from ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id where of_fp_id = 1 and offp_fp_id = 1 and offp_datafim is null and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999))
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, of_fp_id as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id inner join turno on of_turn_id = turn_id
		where of_fp_id in (1,2,3,4) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
		order by fp_sequencia, of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
	else
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, of_fp_id as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id inner join turno on of_turn_id = turn_id
		where of_fp_id in (1,2,3,4) and offp_fp_id = 1 and offpeq_e_id = @EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
		order by fp_sequencia, of_datainicio asc, turn_sequencia asc--Pegar desc, of_id
end
else if @EMP_TIPO in (7,35) -- Acabadores/Lixador
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
	(case when of_fp_id = 7 and @EMP_TIPO = 7 then 8 when of_fp_id = 7 and @EMP_TIPO = 35 then 22 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (7,8,22) and offp_fp_id in (8,22) and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=26 -- Preparador de Barcos
begin

	select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, of_fp_id as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
	/*inner join offp_eq on offp_id=offpeq_offp_id*/ INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id 
	where of_fp_id in (3) and offp_fp_id=of_fp_id /*and offpeq_e_id=@EMP_ID */and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end
else if @EMP_TIPO=6 -- Pintor
begin
	If (@EMP_ID = 20696)
	begin
		select  (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id = 11 and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
			and of_datainicio between convert(varchar(10),getdate(),1) and dateadd(dd,1,getdate())
		union
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id in (5,6,18,2,3,4,22) and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
		order by Estado, Modelo
	end
	else
	begin
		select  (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id = 11 and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
			and of_datainicio between convert(varchar(10),getdate(),1) and dateadd(dd,1,getdate())
		union
		select (case when offp_datainicio is null then 'false' else 'true' end) as Pegar, of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
		fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao, 
		(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 5 then 6 else of_fp_id end) as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, offp_pecas
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id inner join of_fp on of_id=offp_of_id
		INNER JOIN fases_producao ON of_fp_id = fp_id
		where of_fp_id in (2,6,18) and of_datainicio is not null 
			and offp_fp_id=(case when of_fp_id = 11 then 18 when of_fp_id = 2 then 6 else of_fp_id end) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999)
		order by Estado, Modelo
	end
end
else if @EMP_TIPO in (9,34) -- Colador/Pintor Acabamento
begin

	select 
	(case when fp1.offp_datainicio is null then 'False' when fp1.offp_datainicio is not null then 'true' end) as Pegar,
	of_id as ID, p_nome as Modelo,
	fp.fp_nome as Estado, of_supervisao,
	(case when @EMP_TIPO = 9 then 4 else 5 end)
		as fp_id, of_arm_id_lam, t.offp_pecas
	from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id=p_id
	INNER JOIN FASES_PRODUCAO as fp ON OF_FP_ID=fp.FP_ID inner join
	(select offp_of_id as id , offp_pecas from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 7) as t on of_id = t.id
	inner join of_fp as fp1 on of_id = fp1.offp_of_id and fp1.offp_fp_id in (4,5)
	where of_fp_id in (4,5) and (of_id < 70000 or of_id > 89999) and fp1.offp_datafim is null
	order by Pegar desc, of_id

end


COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```

#### `dbo.Touch_OrdemFabrico_ListaReparacoes`(@of_nome nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-09-16 16:07* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `reparac`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Touch_OrdemFabrico_ListaReparacoes]

@of_nome nvarchar(max)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		offp_id, offp_problemas, offp_observacoes, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offpeq_e_id 
	from 
		ordemfabrico inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
	where 
		of_id = @of_nome
		and offp_fp_id = 14
	order by
		offp_datainicio desc
END
```

#### `dbo.Tracking_UpdateTransporte`(@codTransporte int, @dataChegada datetime, @dataPrevistaChegada datetime, @codEstado int, @latitude decimal, @longitude decimal, @ultimoUpdate datetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-12-06 11:27* · 🔎 `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Tracking_UpdateTransporte] 
	@codTransporte int,
	@dataChegada datetime = null, 
	@dataPrevistaChegada datetime = null, 
	@codEstado int = null, 
	@latitude decimal(15,12) = null, 
	@longitude decimal(15,12) = null, 
	@ultimoUpdate datetime = getdate
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	update transporte
		set 
		tr_data_entrega = isnull(@dataChegada, tr_data_entrega), 
		tr_data_entrega_prev = isnull(cast(@dataPrevistaChegada as smalldatetime), tr_data_entrega_prev ), 
		tr_estado_cod = isnull(@codEstado, tr_estado_cod ), 
		tr_latitude = @latitude, 
		tr_longitude = @longitude,
		tr_coord_ult_upd = @ultimoUpdate
		where 
		tr_id = @codTransporte

	if @@ERROR <> ''
		select result = 0
	else
		select result = 1

END
```

#### `dbo.transporte_Anexos`(@tr_id int, @caminho nvarchar(max), @utilizador int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `produç`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[transporte_Anexos]
 
	@tr_id int,
	@caminho nvarchar(max),
	@utilizador int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @sgidip_id int

	select @sgidip_id = sgidip_id from sgidi_pasta where sgidip_tr_id = @tr_id and sgidip_nome = 'Fotos produção'

	if @sgidip_id is null
	begin
		insert into sgidi_pasta (sgidip_nome, sgidip_sgidip_id, sgidip_criador, sgidip_tr_id) values ('Fotos produção', null, 'Automático', @tr_id) 

		set @sgidip_id = @@identity
	end

	insert into sgidi_ficheiro (sgidif_nome, sgidif_descr, sgidif_tipo, sgidif_data, sgidif_sgidif_id, sgidif_sgidip_id, sgidif_caminho, sgidif_criador, sgidif_publico, sgidif_E_id) 
	values (reverse(substring(reverse(@caminho),0,charindex('\',reverse(@caminho),0))), '', reverse(substring(reverse(@caminho),0,charindex('.',reverse(@caminho),0))), getdate(), null, @sgidip_id, @caminho, @utilizador, 0, null) 

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Add]

@tr_dest_id int, 
@tr_trtp_id int, 
@tr_e_id int = null, 
@tr_data smalldatetime, 
@tr_data_regresso smalldatetime = null,
@tr_pais int, 
@tr_morada nvarchar(max) = '', 
@tr_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_descricao nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_transporte_nosso bit = 0,
@tr_google_nao bit = 0,
@tr_contacto_destino nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_track_tipo  nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_track_nr  nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_publico bit = 0,
@tr_track_link nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_tracker_id int = '',
@tr_tracker_data date = null,
@tr_data_entrega date = null,
@tr_data_entrega_prev date = null,
@tr_trtp_id_emb int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @id int, @trtp_trtp_id int

    insert into transporte
           (tr_dest_id
           ,tr_trtp_id
           ,tr_e_id
           ,tr_data
		   ,tr_data_regresso
           ,tr_paises_id
           ,tr_morada
           ,tr_observacoes
		   ,tr_descricao
		   ,tr_transporte_nosso
		   ,tr_google_nao
		   ,tr_contacto_destino
		   ,tr_track_tipo
		   ,tr_track_nr
		   ,tr_publico
		   ,tr_track_link
		   ,tr_tracker_id
		   ,tr_tracker_data
		   ,tr_data_entrega
		   ,tr_data_entrega_prev
		   ,tr_trtp_id_emb)
     values
           (@tr_dest_id
           ,@tr_trtp_id
           ,@tr_e_id
           ,@tr_data
		   ,@tr_data_regresso
           ,@tr_pais
           ,@tr_morada
           ,@tr_observacoes
		   ,@tr_descricao
		   ,@tr_transporte_nosso
		   ,@tr_google_nao
		   ,@tr_contacto_destino
		   ,@tr_track_tipo
		   ,@tr_track_nr
		   ,@tr_publico
		   ,@tr_track_link
		   ,@tr_tracker_id
		   ,@tr_tracker_data
		   ,@tr_data_entrega
		   ,@tr_data_entrega_prev
		   ,@tr_trtp_id_emb)

	set @id = @@identity

	select @trtp_trtp_id = trtp_trtp_id from transp_tipo where trtp_id = @tr_trtp_id

	insert into transp_docs (trdoc_docs_id, trdoc_tr_id, trdoc_docs_nome)
	(select dtd_docs_id, @id, docs_nome from transp_docs_dest_tipo inner join transp_docs_std on dtd_docs_id = docs_id
	where (dtd_dest_id = @tr_dest_id and dtd_trtp_id = @tr_trtp_id) or (dtd_dest_id = 8 and dtd_trtp_id = @tr_trtp_id)
		 or (dtd_dest_id = @tr_dest_id and dtd_trtp_id = (case when @trtp_trtp_id = 10 then 9 else 16 end)) or 
		(dtd_dest_id = 8 and dtd_trtp_id = (case when @trtp_trtp_id = 10 then 9 else 16 end)))

	insert into transp_val (trval_val_id, trval_tr_id) (select val_id, @id from valor)

	select id = @id

	return @id

END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Add_OF`(@of_id int, @tr_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-04-10 13:47* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Add_OF]

@of_id int,
@tr_id int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @of_tr_id int

	set @of_tr_id = (select of_tr_id from ordemfabrico where of_id = @of_id)

	if (@of_tr_id is not null and @tr_id is null)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = null where of_id = @of_id

		delete transp_of where trof_tr_id = @of_tr_id and trof_of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@of_tr_id is not null and @tr_id is not null and @of_tr_id <> @tr_id)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @tr_id where of_id = @of_id

		update transp_of set trof_tr_id = @tr_id where trof_tr_id = @of_tr_id and trof_of_id = @of_id
	end
	else if (@of_tr_id is null and @tr_id is not null)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @tr_id where of_id = @of_id

		insert into transp_of (trof_tr_id, trof_of_id, trof_altura, trof_comprimento, trof_largura) (select @tr_id, @of_id, p_altura, p_comprimento, p_largura from ORDEMFABRICO inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id)
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Del`(@tr_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Del]

@tr_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	delete transp_val where trval_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete transp_of where trof_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete transp_docs where trdoc_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete transp_desp where trdesp_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete transp_entidade where tre_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete sgidi_ficheiro from sgidi_pasta inner join sgidi_ficheiro on sgidip_id = sgidif_sgidip_id where sgidip_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete sgidi_pasta where sgidip_tr_id = @tr_id

	update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = null where of_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete transp_datas where trdt_tr_id = @tr_id

	delete transporte where tr_id = @tr_id
END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Lista`(@data_I smalldatetime, @data_F smalldatetime, @trtp_trtp_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-04-02 10:49* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `producao`, `preco`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Lista]

@data_I smalldatetime = null,
@data_F smalldatetime = null,
@trtp_trtp_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

if (@trtp_trtp_id = 19)	
	select 
		t.tr_id, t.tr_data, t.tr_data_regresso, t.tr_data_criacao, t.tr_descricao, t.tr_paises_id, t.tr_dest_id, t.tr_trtp_id, t.tr_e_id, t.tr_observacoes, t.tr_morada,
		count(tre_id) as pessoas, coalesce(p.tot,0) as docs,
		coalesce(d.total,0) as valor, coalesce(d.total_est,0) as valor_estimado, 0 as valorBarcos, tr_transporte_nosso, tr_contacto_destino, tr_track_tipo, tr_track_nr, tr_track_link, 
		tr_celeste, tr_co2, tr_tracker_id, tr_tracker_data, tr_data_entrega, tr_data_entrega_prev, tr_trtp_id_emb
	from 
		transporte as t 
		inner join transp_tipo on t.tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
		left join transp_entidade on tr_id = tre_tr_id 
		left join (select trdesp_tr_id, sum(trdesp_qtd * trdesp_valor) as total, SUM(trdesp_valor_estimado) as total_est from transp_desp group by trdesp_tr_id) as d on tr_id = d.trdesp_tr_id 
		left join (select tre_tr_id, count(tre_id) as tot from transp_entidade where tre_marcado = 0 group by tre_tr_id) as p on tr_id = p.tre_tr_id
	where 
		tr_data between @data_I and @data_F 
		and trtp_trtp_id = @trtp_trtp_id
	group by 
		t.tr_id, t.tr_data, t.tr_data_regresso, t.tr_data_criacao, t.tr_descricao, t.tr_paises_id, t.tr_dest_id, t.tr_trtp_id, t.tr_e_id, t.tr_morada, t.tr_observacoes, p.tot, d.total, d.total_est, tr_transporte_nosso, tr_contacto_destino, 
		tr_track_tipo, tr_track_nr, tr_track_link, tr_celeste, tr_co2, tr_tracker_id, tr_tracker_data, tr_data_entrega, tr_data_entrega_prev, tr_trtp_id_emb
	order by 
		t.tr_data desc, t.tr_descricao
else
	select 
		t.tr_id, t.tr_data, t.tr_data_regresso, t.tr_data_criacao, t.tr_descricao, t.tr_paises_id, t.tr_dest_id, t.tr_trtp_id, t.tr_e_id, t.tr_observacoes, t.tr_morada,
		count(of_id) as barcos, coalesce(prd.ofs,0) as emProd, tr_publico, d.docs,
		round(m.mais-mn.menos,0) as valor, 0 as valor_estimado, round(coalesce(sum(of_precovenda),0),0) as valorBarcos, tr_transporte_nosso, tr_contacto_destino, tr_track_tipo, tr_track_nr, tr_track_link, 
		tr_celeste, tr_co2, tr_tracker_id, tr_tracker_data, tr_data_entrega, 
		tr_data_entrega_prev, tr_trtp_id_emb, (case when pecas.mov_trid is not null  then 1 else 0 end) as pecas, isnull(seg.TRDOC_DOCNUM, 'Não aplicável!') as Seguro
	from 
		transporte as t 
		left join transp_of on t.tr_id = trof_tr_id 
		left join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join transp_tipo on t.tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
		inner join (select tr_id, count(trdoc_docs_id) as docs from transporte left join transp_docs on tr_id = trdoc_tr_id and trdoc_tratado = 0 group by tr_id) as d on d.tr_id = t.tr_id
		left join (select trdoc_tr_id, TRDOC_DOCNUM from transp_docs where TRDOC_DOCS_ID = 12) as seg on seg.TRDOC_TR_ID = t.TR_ID
		left join (select trval_tr_id, sum(trval_valor) as mais from transp_val inner join valor on trval_val_id = val_id where val_tpval_id = 1 group by trval_tr_id) as m on m.trval_tr_id = t.tr_id
		left join (select trval_tr_id, sum(trval_valor) as menos from transp_val inner join valor on trval_val_id = val_id where val_tpval_id = 2 group by trval_tr_id) as mn on mn.trval_tr_id = t.tr_id
		left join (select tr_id as id, count(of_id) as ofs 
						from ordemfabrico inner join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
							where tr_data between @data_I and @data_F and trtp_trtp_id = @trtp_trtp_id and p_fabricointerno = 1 and fp_sequencia < dbo.fase_Sequencia_Armazem() group by tr_id) as prd on t.tr_id = prd.id
		left join (select distinct mov_tr_id as mov_trid from movimento where mov_tr_id is not null) as pecas on t.tr_id = pecas.mov_trid
	where 
		tr_data between @data_I and @data_F 
		and trtp_trtp_id = @trtp_trtp_id
	group by 
		t.tr_id, t.tr_data, t.tr_data_regresso, t.tr_data_criacao, t.tr_descricao, t.tr_paises_id, t.tr_dest_id, t.tr_trtp_id, t.tr_e_id, t.tr_morada, t.tr_observacoes, d.docs, m.mais, mn.menos, tr_transporte_nosso, tr_contacto_destino, 
		tr_track_tipo, tr_track_nr, tr_track_link, tr_celeste, tr_co2, tr_tracker_id, tr_tracker_data, tr_data_entrega, tr_data_entrega_prev, tr_trtp_id_emb, prd.ofs, tr_publico, (case when pecas.mov_trid is not null  then 1 else 0 end),
		seg.TRDOC_DOCNUM
	order by 
		t.tr_data desc, 
		t.tr_descricao

END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Lista_Mails`(@dt_i smalldatetime, @dt_f smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Lista_Mails]

@dt_i as smalldatetime,
@dt_f as smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select distinct tr_id, tr_data, tr_descricao, coalesce(REPLACE(tr_contacto_destino, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), '<br>'),'') as tr_contacto_destino, coalesce('http://connect.track-trace.com/for/nelo/' + tr_track_tipo + '/' + tr_track_nr,'') as tr_track, of_e_id_enc, e_email, tr_track_link 
	from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join sgidi_pasta on tr_id = sgidip_tr_id inner join sgidi_ficheiro on sgidip_id = sgidif_sgidip_id and sgidif_e_id = e_id
		where trof_enviado = 1 and cast(tr_data as date) between cast(@dt_i as date) and cast(@dt_f as date)
end
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Lista_Movimentos`()

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Lista_Movimentos]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	with r (Id, nome, Familia, Tipo) as
	(select 
		tp_id, tp_nome, coalesce(tp_tp_id,0), 1 
	from 
		produto_tipo 
	where 
		tp_id not in (1,82,83,84) and (tp_tp_id not in (1,82,83,84) or tp_tp_id is null) 
	union all
	select 
		p_id, p_nome, p_tp_id, 2
	from r inner join produto on Id = p_tp_id)

	select * from r

END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Lista_OFs`(@of_datatransporte smalldatetime, @e_id int, @pecas bit)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-02-21 11:07* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `reparaç`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Lista_OFs]

@of_datatransporte smalldatetime,
@e_id int = null,
@pecas bit = 0

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select distinct 
		e_nome, 
		of_id, 
		(case when len(of_nome)>0 then cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)) + '/' + of_nome else cast(of_id as nvarchar(max)) end) as id, 
		p.p_nome, p.p_np_id, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores,
		case when @e_id is null
			then case when dbo.of_Pedido_Estado(of_id) = -1 then '1) Sem pedido'
					when dbo.of_Pedido_Estado(of_id) = 0 then '2) Pedido'
					when dbo.of_Pedido_Estado(of_id) = 1 then '3) Em preparação'
					else '4) Satisfeito' end
		else
		case when dbo.of_Pedido_Estado_Por_Armazem(of_id, @e_id) = -1 then '1) Sem pedido'
			when dbo.of_Pedido_Estado_Por_Armazem(of_id, @e_id) = 0 then '2) Pedido'
			when dbo.of_Pedido_Estado_Por_Armazem(of_id, @e_id) = 1 then '3) Em preparação'
			else '4) Satisfeito' end
		end as pedidoMaterial,
		of_arm_id, 
		of_fp_id, 
		eqq.offpeq_e_id, 
		--pfora.offpeq_e_id as acab2,
		--g.offpeq_e_id as lixador,
		--h.offpeq_e_id as pintoracabador,
		--coalesce(h.fp, 0) as pintado,
		of_pago, 
		of_datapagamento, 
		of_referencia, 
		of_sequencia, 
		of_oftu_id, 
		of_transportedoc,
		emb.embalagem,
		convert(nvarchar(max),OF_TR_DATA_ULT,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(of_tr_desc_ult,'') as UltTR,
		of_tr_id,
		OF_TR_DATA_ULT as UltData,
		of_tr_desc_ult as descr_ant,
		tr_data,
		tr_descricao,
		of_linhaacab
	FROM
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id
		left join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 33 and offp_return = 0
		left join offp_eq as eqq on offp_id = eqq.offpeq_offp_id and eqq.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id
		inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id 
		left join (select mov_of_id as ofId, p_id as embalagem from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_of_id is not null and p_tp_id = 81) as emb on OF_ID = emb.ofId
		--left join (select 
		--				offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offpeq_e_id, offp_ordem
		--				, row_number() OVER (partition BY offp_of_id, offp_fp_id ORDER BY isnull(offp_datafim, dateadd(y, 1, getdate())) DESC, offp_ordem) AS x
		--			from 
		--				of_fp 
		--				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id 
		--			where 
		--				OFFP_FP_ID = 22 
		--				and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		--				and offp_return = 0) as g on of_id = g.offp_of_id and g.x = 1
		--left join (select 
		--				offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offpeq_e_id, offp_ordem 
		--				, row_number() OVER (partition BY offp_of_id, offp_fp_id ORDER BY isnull(offp_datafim, dateadd(y, 1, getdate())) DESC, offp_ordem) AS x
		--			from 
		--				/*dbo.of_Fases_ord 
		--				inner join*/ of_fp --on id = offp_id 
		--				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id 
		--			where 
		--				OFFP_FP_ID = 35 
		--				and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		--				and offp_return = 0) as pfora on of_id = pfora.offp_of_id and pfora.x = 1
		--left join (select 
		--				offp_of_id, offp_fp_id, offpeq_e_id, (case when offp_datafim is null then 0 else 1 end) as fp, offp_ordem 
		--				, row_number() OVER (partition BY offp_of_id, offp_fp_id ORDER BY isnull(offp_datafim, dateadd(y, 1, getdate())) DESC, offp_ordem) AS x
		--			from 
		--				/*dbo.of_Fases_ord 
		--				inner join*/ of_fp --on id = offp_id 
		--				left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id 
		--			where 
		--				OFFP_FP_ID = 5 
		--				and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		--				and offp_return = 0) as h on of_id = h.offp_of_id and h.x = 1
	where
		tr_data = @of_datatransporte
		and case when @pecas = 1 then 0 else of_id end < case when @pecas = 1 then 1 else 10000000 end
	order by
		e_nome, p.p_nome
END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Lista_OFs_Teste`(@of_datatransporte smalldatetime)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Lista_OFs_Teste]

@of_datatransporte smalldatetime

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

select
	e_nome, of_id, p.p_nome, p.p_np_id, p1.p_nome as CorCasco, p2.p_nome as CorDeck, of_arm_id, of_fp_id, eqq.offpeq_e_id,
	g.offpeq_e_id as lixador,
	b.offpeq_e_id as colador,
	coalesce(b.fp,0) as colado,
	h.offpeq_e_id as pintoracabador,
	coalesce(h.fp, 0) as pintado,
	of_pago, of_datapagamento, of_referencia, of_oftu_id, of_transportedoc,
	(select p_id from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_of_id = of_id and p_tp_id = 81) as embalagem,
	convert(nvarchar(max),OF_TR_DATA_ULT,105)+ ' - ' + coalesce(of_tr_desc_ult,'') as UltTR,
	of_tr_id,
	OF_TR_DATA_ULT as UltData,
	of_tr_desc_ult as descr_ant,
	tr_data,
	tr_descricao
FROM
	ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
	left join produto as p1 on of_p_id_ccasco = p1.p_id
	left join produto as p2 on of_p_id_cdeck = p2.p_id
	inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 33
	left join offp_eq as eqq on offp_id = eqq.offpeq_offp_id and eqq.offpeq_chefe = 1
	left join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
	inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id
	inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id left join 
	--(select max(tr_data) as dt_ant, trof_of_id
	--	from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id where trof_enviado = 1 group by trof_of_id) as x on of_id = x.trof_of_id left join
	--(select tr_data as data_ant, tr_descricao as descr_ant, trof_of_id
	--	from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id where trof_enviado = 1) as ant on ant.trof_of_id = x.trof_of_id and ant.data_ant = x.dt_ant left join
	(select offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, (case when offp_datafim is null then 0 else 1 end) as fp from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 4 and offpeq_chefe = 1) as b on of_id = b.offp_of_id left join
	(select offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 22 and offpeq_chefe = 1) as g on of_id = g.offp_of_id left join
	(select offp_of_id, offpeq_e_id, (case when offp_datafim is null then 0 else 1 end) as fp from of_fp left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id where offp_fp_id = 5 and offpeq_chefe = 1) as h on of_id = h.offp_of_id
where
	tr_data = @of_datatransporte
order by
	e_nome, p.p_nome

END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Lista_Upd`(@tr_id int, @tr_dest_id int, @tr_trtp_id int, @tr_e_id int, @tr_data_criacao smalldatetime, @tr_data smalldatetime, @tr_data_regresso smalldatetime, @tr_pais int, @tr_morada nvarchar(max), @tr_observacoes nvarchar(max), @tr_descricao nvarchar(max), @tr_transporte_nosso bit, @tr_google_nao bit, @tr_contacto_destino nvarchar(max), @tr_publico bit, @tr_celeste nvarchar(max), @Seguro nvarchar(max))
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-04-13 15:32* · 🔎 `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Lista_Upd]

@tr_id int,
@tr_dest_id int, 
@tr_trtp_id int, 
@tr_e_id int, 
@tr_data_criacao smalldatetime, 
@tr_data smalldatetime, 
@tr_data_regresso smalldatetime = null, 
@tr_pais int, 
@tr_morada nvarchar(max) = '', 
@tr_observacoes nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_descricao nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_transporte_nosso bit = 0,
@tr_google_nao bit = 0,
@tr_contacto_destino nvarchar(max) = '',
@tr_publico bit = 0,
@tr_celeste nvarchar(max) = null,
@Seguro nvarchar(max) = null


AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @tr_dest_id_ant int, @tr_trtp_id_ant int, @trtp_trtp_id int

	select @tr_dest_id_ant = tr_dest_id, @tr_trtp_id_ant = tr_trtp_id, @trtp_trtp_id = trtp_trtp_id from transporte inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id where tr_id = @tr_id

    update transporte
	   set tr_dest_id = @tr_dest_id
		  ,tr_trtp_id = @tr_trtp_id
		  ,tr_e_id = @tr_e_id
		  ,tr_data_criacao = @tr_data_criacao
		  ,tr_data = @tr_data
		  ,tr_data_regresso = @tr_data_regresso
		  ,tr_paises_id = @tr_pais
		  ,tr_morada = @tr_morada
		  ,tr_observacoes = @tr_observacoes
		  ,tr_descricao = @tr_descricao
		  ,tr_transporte_nosso = @tr_transporte_nosso
		  ,tr_google_nao = @tr_google_nao
		  ,tr_contacto_destino = @tr_contacto_destino
		  ,tr_publico = isnull(@tr_publico,tr_publico)
		  ,tr_celeste = coalesce(@tr_celeste, tr_celeste)
	 where tr_id = @tr_id

	if (@tr_dest_id_ant <> @tr_dest_id or (@tr_dest_id_ant is null and @tr_dest_id is not null) or @tr_trtp_id_ant <> @tr_trtp_id or (@tr_trtp_id_ant is null and @tr_trtp_id is not null))
	begin
		insert into transp_docs (trdoc_docs_id, trdoc_tr_id, trdoc_docs_nome)
		(select dtd_docs_id, @tr_id, docs_nome from transp_docs_dest_tipo inner join transp_docs_std on dtd_docs_id = docs_id
		where ((dtd_dest_id = @tr_dest_id and dtd_trtp_id = @tr_trtp_id) or (dtd_dest_id = 8 and dtd_trtp_id = @tr_trtp_id)
		 or (dtd_dest_id = @tr_dest_id and dtd_trtp_id = (case when @trtp_trtp_id = 10 then 9 else 16 end)) or 
		(dtd_dest_id = 8 and dtd_trtp_id = (case when @trtp_trtp_id = 10 then 9 else 16 end))) and 
		dtd_docs_id not in (select distinct trdoc_docs_id from transp_docs where trdoc_tr_id = @tr_id))
	end
	
	if @Seguro is not null
	begin
			if exists(select * from TRANSP_DOCS where TRDOC_TR_ID = @tr_id and TRDOC_DOCS_ID = 12)
				update TRANSP_DOCS set TRDOC_DATA = case when len(@Seguro) > 1 then getdate() else null end, TRDOC_DOCNUM = @Seguro, TRDOC_TRATADO = case when len(@Seguro) > 1 then 1 else 0 end where TRDOC_TR_ID = @tr_id and TRDOC_DOCS_ID = 12
			else
				insert into TRANSP_DOCS (TRDOC_DATA, TRDOC_DOCNUM, TRDOC_TR_ID, TRDOC_DOCS_ID, TRDOC_TRATADO) values (case when len(@Seguro) > 1 then getdate() else null end, @Seguro, @tr_id, 12, case when len(@Seguro) > 1 then 1 else 0 end)
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_ListaBarcos`(@tr_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-04-01 10:20* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `preco`, `peso`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_ListaBarcos]

@tr_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @NewLineChar AS CHAR(2) = CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)

    select of_id, (case when len(of_nome)>0 then convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) + '/' + of_nome else convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) end) as id, 
		of_p_id, p.p_nome as Modelo, 
		dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as Cores, --p1.p_nome as Deck, p2.p_nome as Casco, 
		e_nome, of_referencia, fp_nome, arm_nome as Armazem, trof_enviado, of_pago, of_datapagamento, 
		of_transportedoc, of_precovenda, of_desconto as e_desconto, of_fact, oftu_nome as TP, of_data, 
		trof_leva_pecas as pecas, of_sequencia, 
		'(' + cast(p.p_comprimento as nvarchar(max)) + '*' + cast(p.p_largura as nvarchar(max)) + '*' + cast(p.p_altura as nvarchar(max)) + ')' as dimensoes,
		--'Contacto: ' + @NewLineChar + isnull(EM_CONTACTO,'') + @NewLineChar + @NewLineChar + 'Morada: ' + @NewLineChar + isnull(EM_MORADA,'') + @NewLineChar + @NewLineChar + 'Tlf: ' + isnull(EM_TELEFONE,'') as MoradaEnvio
		'Contacto: ' + isnull(EM_CONTACTO,'') + '; Morada: ' + isnull(EM_MORADA,'') + '; Tlf: ' + isnull(EM_TELEFONE,'') as MoradaEnvio
		, p.P_PESOACAB PesoAcab, trof_altura, trof_comprimento, trof_largura
	from 
		transp_of 
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join armazem on of_arm_id = arm_id 
		left join of_tipouso on of_oftu_id = oftu_id
		left join entidade_morada on of_em_id = em_id
		--outer apply (select top 1 offp_peso PesoAcab from of_fp where offp_of_id = of_id and offp_fp_id = 8 order by offp_datafim) peso
	where 
		trof_tr_id = @tr_id 
	order by 
		e_nome, Modelo
END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_ListaMoradas`(@pais int, @tipo int, @emb int, @tr_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-03-25 16:31* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_ListaMoradas] 

	@pais int, 
	@tipo int, 
	@emb int = null, 
	@tr_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    select 
		e_nome as Cliente, e_morada as Morada, 0.000000000 as Latitude, 0.000000000 as Longitude, 2 as ord
	from 
		entidade 
	where 
		e_id in (select distinct of_e_id_enc from transp_of inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id where trof_tr_id = @tr_id) 
		and (len(e_morada) > 5 
			or len(e_moradaentrega) > 5)
	union
	select 
		distinct e_nome as Cliente, tr_morada as Morada, tr_latitude_dest as Latitude, tr_longitude_dest as Longitude, 3 as ord
	from 
		transporte 
		inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
	where 
		tr_trtp_id = @tipo 
		and tr_paises_id = @pais 
		and len(tr_morada) > 5 
		and e_id in (select distinct of_e_id_enc from transp_of inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id where trof_tr_id = @tr_id)
	union
	select 
		e_nome as Cliente, em_morada as Morada, em_latitude as Latitude, em_longitude as Longitude, 1 as ord
	from 
		transporte 
		inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id 
		inner join entidade_morada on e_id = em_e_id
	where 
		tr_trtp_id = @tipo 
		and e_id in (select distinct of_e_id_enc from transp_of inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id where trof_tr_id = @tr_id)
	order by ord, Cliente
END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Mail_Datas`(@dI date, @dF date)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Mail_Datas]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@dI date,
	@dF date
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare curTR cursor for
	select distinct tr_id, tr_descricao, REPLACE(tr_contacto_destino, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), '<br>'), 'http://connect.track-trace.com/for/nelo/' + tr_track_tipo + '/' + tr_track_nr, of_e_id_enc, e_email, tr_track_link 
		from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id inner join sgidi_pasta on tr_id = sgidip_tr_id inner join sgidi_ficheiro on sgidip_id = sgidif_sgidip_id and sgidif_e_id = e_id
			where tr_data between @dI and @dF and trof_enviado = 1 /*/*and year(tr_data) = year(dateadd(ww,-3,getdate())) and datepart(ww,tr_data) = datepart(ww,dateadd(ww,-3,getdate())) */
			and tr_docsenviados = 0 and tr_data < dateadd(day,-3,getdate())*/

	open curTR
	declare @tr_id int, @tr_descricao nvarchar(max), @tr_contacto_destino nvarchar(max), @track  nvarchar(max), @e_id int, @e_email nvarchar(max), @track_link nvarchar(max)

	fetch next from curTR into @tr_id, @tr_descricao, @tr_contacto_destino, @track, @e_id, @e_email, @track_link while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		declare @t table(linha nvarchar(max)) 
		declare @txt  nvarchar(max), @corlinha bit, @res nvarchar(max), @res1 nvarchar(max), @msg nvarchar(500)

		set @txt = '<font color=black size=1>Dear ,<br><br>Joint follows the list of boats and invoice for the boats sent last friday.<br><br>Contacts/Notes:<br>' + isnull(@tr_contacto_destino,'') + '<br><br>' + '<a href="' + isnull(@track_link,'') + '">' + (case when len(@track_link)>5 then 'Track Shipment' else '' end) + '<a/>'

		set @txt = @txt + '<br><br><table border="1"><tr style="background-color:gray"><th width="10%"><span style="color:white">OF</span></th><th width="25%"><span style="color:white">Modelo</span></th><th width="15%"><span style="color:white">Deck</span></th><th width="15%"><span style="color:white">Casco</span></th><th width="25%"><span style="color:white">Cliente</span></th><th width="10%"><span style="color:white">Ref</span></th></tr>'
	
		insert into @t (linha) 
		select '<tr style="background-color:FFC"><td>' + convert(nvarchar(max),of_id) + '</td><td>' + p.p_nome + '</td><td>' + p1.p_nome + '</td><td>' + p2.p_nome + '</td><td>' + e_nome + '</td><td>' + of_referencia
		from ordemfabrico inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id 
			inner join transp_of on of_id = trof_of_id inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		where tr_id = @tr_id and trof_enviado = 1 and of_e_id_enc = @e_id

		set @corlinha = 0

		if exists(select * from @t)
		begin
			while exists (select top 1 linha from @t)
			begin
				if @corlinha = 0
				begin			
					set @corlinha = 1
					set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 Replace(linha,'style="background-color:FFC','style="background-color:white') from @t)
				end
				else
				begin
					set @corlinha = 0
					set @txt = @txt + (select top 1 linha from @t)
				end
			
				delete @t where linha = (select top 1 linha from @t)
			end

			set @tr_descricao = 'Shipment: ' + @tr_descricao + ' | Week: ' + convert(nvarchar(max),datepart(ww,getdate())-1)

			EXEC	[dbo].[SendMail_Transp]
					@De = N'transportes@gmail.com',
					@Para = N'nunandre@gmail.com',
					--@CC = N'nuno.veloso@nelo.eu',
					--@BCC = N'nunandre@gmail.com',
					@Assunto = @tr_descricao,
					@Texto = @txt,
					@HTML = 1,
					@tr_id = @tr_id,
					@of_e_id_enc = @e_id,
					@MsgErro = @msg out

					print @msg
					--WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:10' --hh:mm:ss
				
		end

	fetch next from curTR into @tr_id, @tr_descricao, @tr_contacto_destino, @track, @e_id, @e_email, @track_link
	end
	close curTR
	deallocate curTR

END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Rack_Desconta`()
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-09-04 16:01 · modificado 2020-07-28 15:55* · 🔎 `preco`, `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Rack_Desconta]

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @t table(trId int, trData date, trDescr nvarchar(max), trtpId int, trtpNome nvarchar(max), visto bit default 0)
	insert into @t (trId, trData, trDescr, trtpId, trtpNome)
	select 
		TR_ID, TR_DATA, TR_DESCRICAO, TRTP_ID, TRTP_NOME
	from 
		TRANSPORTE 
		inner join TRANSP_TIPO on TR_TRTP_ID_EMB = TRTP_ID
		inner join TRANSP_OF on TR_ID = TROF_TR_ID
	where 
		TR_TRTP_ID_EMB in (29,30,31,33,34,35,37,38,39,45,46,47,48,49,50,51)
		and TR_DATA between '2020/07/21' /*'2019/09/04'*/ and DATEADD(day,-7,getdate())
		and TR_ID not in (select distinct isnull(mov_tr_id,0) from MOVIMENTO where MOV_P_ID in (28967,28897) and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 2)

	declare @descr nvarchar(max), @trId int, @dt date, @qtd_Cavaletes int, @qtd_Xs int

	while exists(select * from @t where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 
			@trId = trId, 
			@dt = trData, 
			@qtd_Cavaletes = (case
								when trtpId in (29,33,45,46,49)
									then 2
								when trtpId in (30,34,47,50) 
									then 3
								when trtpId in (31,35,48,51)
									then 4
								else 0 end), 
			@qtd_Xs = (case
						when trtpId in (29,33,45,46,49)
							then 2
						when trtpId in (30,34,47,50)
							then 4
						when trtpId in (31,35,48,51)
							then 6
						else 0 end), 
			@descr = CAST(trData as nvarchar(max)) + ' - ' + trDescr 
		from 
			@t 
		where 
			visto = 0

		if @qtd_Cavaletes > 0
			exec Inventario_Add_Movimento 
								@mov_data = @dt,
								@mov_datafact = null,
								@mov_p_id = 28897, -- Cavaletes
								@mov_tpmov_id = 2,
								@mov_precovenda = 0,
								@mov_quantidade = @qtd_Cavaletes,
								@mov_observacoes = @descr,
								@mov_e_id = null,
								@mov_desconto = 0,
								@mov_acerto = 0,
								@mov_defeituoso = 0,
								@mov_e_id_responsavel = null,
								@mov_tr_id = @trId

		if @qtd_Xs > 0
			exec Inventario_Add_Movimento 
								@mov_data = @dt,
								@mov_datafact = null,
								@mov_p_id = 28896, -- X's
								@mov_tpmov_id = 2,
								@mov_precovenda = 0,
								@mov_quantidade = @qtd_Xs,
								@mov_observacoes = @descr,
								@mov_e_id = null,
								@mov_desconto = 0,
								@mov_acerto = 0,
								@mov_defeituoso = 0,
								@mov_e_id_responsavel = null,
								@mov_tr_id = @trId

		update @t set visto = 1 where trId = @trId
	end
END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Rem_Barco`(@trof_tr_id int, @trof_of_id int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Rem_Barco]

@trof_tr_id int,
@trof_of_id int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	declare @tr_id_prox int
	
	set @tr_id_prox = (select top 1 tr_id 
						from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id 
						where trof_of_id = @trof_of_id and tr_id <> @trof_tr_id and tr_data >= getdate() order by tr_data)

    update ordemfabrico set of_tr_id = @tr_id_prox where of_id = @trof_of_id

	delete transp_of where trof_tr_id = @trof_tr_id and trof_of_id = @trof_of_id

END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Tipo`(@ano int, @semana_I int, @semana_F int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `transp`

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Tipo]

@ano int, 
@semana_I int, 
@semana_F int

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		tp_id, tp_nome, datepart(ww,tr_data) as ww, count(of_id), coalesce(acab.tot,0) as acabados, coalesce(pacab.tot,0) as pacaba, coalesce(nlam.tot,0) as nlamin
	from 
		transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		left join 
		(select tp_id as tp, datepart(ww,tr_data) as ww1, count(of_id) as tot
			from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
				inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
			where 
				year(tr_data) = @ano and datepart(ww,tr_data) between @semana_I and @semana_F and of_fp_id in (9,10,12)
			group by tp_id, datepart(ww,tr_data)) as acab on tp_id = acab.tp and datepart(ww,tr_data) = acab.ww1
		left join 
		(select tp_id as tp, datepart(ww,tr_data) as ww1, count(of_id) as tot
			from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
				inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
			where 
				year(tr_data) = @ano and datepart(ww,tr_data) between @semana_I and @semana_F and of_fp_id = 7
			group by tp_id, datepart(ww,tr_data)) as pacab on tp_id = pacab.tp and datepart(ww,tr_data) = pacab.ww1
		left join 
		(select tp_id as tp, datepart(ww,tr_data) as ww1, count(of_id) as tot
			from transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
				inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
			where 
				year(tr_data) = @ano and datepart(ww,tr_data) between @semana_I and @semana_F and of_fp_id = 11
			group by tp_id, datepart(ww,tr_data)) as nlam on tp_id = nlam.tp and datepart(ww,tr_data) = nlam.ww1
	where 
		year(tr_data) = @ano and datepart(ww,tr_data) between @semana_I and @semana_F
	group by
		tp_id, tp_nome, datepart(ww,tr_data), acab.tot, pacab.tot, nlam.tot

END
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Tipo_Add`(@trtp_nome nvarchar(max), @trtp_trtp_id int)

```sql
@trtp_nome nvarchar(max),
```

#### `dbo.Transportes_Tipo_Detalhe`(@ano int, @semana int, @tipo int)
*Stored Procedure · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

```sql
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[Transportes_Tipo_Detalhe]

@ano int, 
@semana int, 
@tipo int = null

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	select 
		e_nome, of_id, p.p_nome, p1.p_nome as deck, p2.p_nome as casco, fp_nome
	from 
		transporte inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on of_p_id_cdeck = p1.p_id
		inner join produto as p2 on of_p_id_ccasco = p2.p_id inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where 
		year(tr_data) = @ano and datepart(ww,tr_data) = @semana and p.p_tp_id = @tipo
	order by 
		e_nome, p.p_nome

END
```
