#### `dbo.co2_GGF_OF`(@i date, @f date)
*Scalar Function · criado 2025-06-02 15:21 · modificado 2025-06-02 15:21*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION co2_GGF_OF 
(
	@i date, @f date
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @co2 float

	select 
		@co2 = avg(cast(replace(replace(MOV_OBSERVACOES, 'CO2 =',''),',','.') as float))
	from
		movimento
	where
		mov_tpmov_id = 6 
		and mov_p_id = 22394
		and mov_data between @i and @f

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @co2

END
```

#### `dbo.CO2Produto_Interno`(@p_id int, @dt smalldatetime)
*Scalar Function · criado 2023-01-06 16:01 · modificado 2023-05-19 13:12* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[CO2Produto_Interno]
(
	@p_id int,
	@dt smalldatetime = getdate
)
RETURNS FLOAT
AS
BEGIN
	declare @co2 float

	declare @data smalldatetime--, @modelo nvarchar(max)
	set @data = @dt
	
	declare @t table
	(p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, comp_qtd float, pai nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, preco_a_data float, nivel int, co2 float);
	
	with cte (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel, co2) as
	(
		select convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_quantidade, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, 1,
				(case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p1.p_id, null),0) else p1.P_CO2 * p1.P_PESOLAM end) 
		from produto as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where p.p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 
		union all
		select convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_qtd * comp_quantidade, (case when comp_p_p_id = 22394 /*Gastos gerais de fabrico*/ then convert(nvarchar(max),@p_id) else convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) end) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, 2 as tpcomp, p.nivel + 1, 
				(case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p1.p_id, null),0) else p1.P_CO2 * p1.P_PESOLAM end) 
		from cte as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id_ant = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 2 or comp_p_p_id = 22394 /*Gastos gerais de fabrico*/ 
	)

	insert into @t (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel, co2)
	select * from cte where cte.p_id not in (select pai from cte)
	
	set @co2 = (select round(sum(comp_qtd * co2),4) from @t)
    
	return @co2

END
```

#### `dbo.CO2Produto_Interno_X`(@p_id int, @dt smalldatetime)
*Scalar Function · criado 2023-01-06 15:30 · modificado 2023-01-09 10:35* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`, `peso`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[CO2Produto_Interno_X]
(
	@p_id int,
	@dt smalldatetime = null
)
RETURNS FLOAT
AS
BEGIN
	declare @co2 float

	declare @data smalldatetime, @fact float
	set @data = @dt
	
	set @fact = 1
	
	declare @t table
	(p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, comp_qtd float, pai nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, preco_a_data float, nivel int, co2 float);

	with cte (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel, co2) as
	(
		select cast(p1.p_id as nvarchar(max)) + coalesce(cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_quantidade * (case when p.p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, 1, 
				(case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p1.p_id, null),0) else p1.P_CO2 * p1.P_PESOLAM end) 
		from produto as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where p.p_id = @p_id --and comp_tpcomp_id = 1
		union all
		select cast(p1.p_id as nvarchar(max)) + coalesce(cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_qtd * comp_quantidade, cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, comp_tpcomp_id as tpcomp, p.nivel + 1,
				(case when p1.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.CO2Produto_Interno(p1.p_id, null),0) else p1.P_CO2 * p1.P_PESOLAM end)
		from cte as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id_ant = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 1
	)

	insert into @t (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel, co2)
	select * from cte --where cte.p_id not in (select pai from cte)

	set @co2 = (select round(sum(comp_qtd * co2),2) from @t)
    
	return @co2

END
```

#### `dbo.comunicacaoFases`(@com_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2024-02-02 11:29 · modificado 2024-02-02 11:35* · 🔎 `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[comunicacaoFases]
(
	@com_id int
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @result nvarchar(max)

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	select @result = replace(Stuff((
		select ', ' + fp_nome + '; '
			from COMUNICACAO_FASES_PRODUCAO inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on COMFP_FP_ID = FP_ID 
			where COMFP_COM_ID = @com_id 
			order by FP_NOME FOR XML path('')),1,1,''),', ',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10))

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN ltrim(@result)

END
```

#### `dbo.converteStringParaNumeric`(@of_fact nvarchar(max))
*Scalar Function · criado 2021-01-07 16:13 · modificado 2021-01-07 16:35*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION converteStringParaNumeric 
(
	@of_fact nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS numeric(10,0)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @Result numeric(10,0)

	declare @of_fact_n nvarchar(max) = ''

	while len(@of_fact) > 0
	begin
		set @of_fact_n += case when isnumeric(substring(@of_fact,1,1)) = 1 then substring(@of_fact,1,1) else '' end
		--print case when isnumeric(substring(@of_fact,1,1)) = 1 then substring(@of_fact,1,1) else '' end

		set @of_fact = substring(@of_fact, 2, len(@of_fact))
		--print substring(@of_fact, 2, len(@of_fact))
	end

	set @Result = case when len(@of_fact_n) between 2 and 10 and isnumeric(@of_fact_n) = 1 then cast(@of_fact_n as numeric(10,0)) else 0 end

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @Result

END
```

#### `dbo.emails_Funcionarios`()
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-08-05 14:51 · modificado 2019-08-05 14:51*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION emails_Funcionarios 
(
	
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @dt_mails table(eId int, email nvarchar(max))

	insert into @dt_mails (eId, email)
	select e_id, e_email 
	from ENTIDADE inner join ENTIDADE_TIPO on E_ENT_ID = ENT_ID
	where E_ACTIVO = 1
	and ENT_ENT_ID = 19
	and LEN(e_email) > 5

	--select * from @dt_mails

	declare @emails nvarchar(max) = '', @e_id int, @email nvarchar(max)

	while exists(select * from @dt_mails)
	begin
		select top 1 @e_id = eId, @email = ltrim(rtrim(email)) from @dt_mails

		if LEN(@emails) < 5
			set @emails = @email
		else	
			set @emails = @emails + '; ' + @email

		delete from @dt_mails where eId = @e_id
	end
	return @emails
END
```

#### `dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas`(@di1 smalldatetime, @df1 smalldatetime)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fabrica_Horas_Teoricas] 
(
	@di1 as smalldatetime,
	@df1 as smalldatetime
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @horas int

	select @horas = sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @horas

END
```

#### `dbo.fn_diagramobjects`()
*Scalar Function · criado 2022-04-04 10:04 · modificado 2022-04-04 10:04*

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_diagramobjects() 
	RETURNS int
	WITH EXECUTE AS N'dbo'
	AS
	BEGIN
		declare @id_upgraddiagrams		int
		declare @id_sysdiagrams			int
		declare @id_helpdiagrams		int
		declare @id_helpdiagramdefinition	int
		declare @id_creatediagram	int
		declare @id_renamediagram	int
		declare @id_alterdiagram 	int 
		declare @id_dropdiagram		int
		declare @InstalledObjects	int

		select @InstalledObjects = 0

		select 	@id_upgraddiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_upgraddiagrams'),
			@id_sysdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sysdiagrams'),
			@id_helpdiagrams = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagrams'),
			@id_helpdiagramdefinition = object_id(N'dbo.sp_helpdiagramdefinition'),
			@id_creatediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_creatediagram'),
			@id_renamediagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_renamediagram'),
			@id_alterdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_alterdiagram'), 
			@id_dropdiagram = object_id(N'dbo.sp_dropdiagram')

		if @id_upgraddiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 1
		if @id_sysdiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 2
		if @id_helpdiagrams is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 4
		if @id_helpdiagramdefinition is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 8
		if @id_creatediagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 16
		if @id_renamediagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 32
		if @id_alterdiagram  is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 64
		if @id_dropdiagram is not null
			select @InstalledObjects = @InstalledObjects + 128
		
		return @InstalledObjects 
	END
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_BancoHoras_Saldo`(@e_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- author:		<author,,name>
-- create date: <create date, ,>
-- description:	<description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE function [dbo].[funcionario_BancoHoras_Saldo]
(
	@e_id int
)
returns float
as
begin
	-- declare the return variable here
	declare @valor float

	-- add the t-sql statements to compute the return value here
	select @valor = cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 15 -- a dever 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) * -1
					when movent_met_id = 16 -- a haver
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float)
	from
			ent_mov
	where	
		movent_met_id in (15,16) and movent_e_id = @e_id

	-- return the result of the function
	return isnull(@valor,0)

end
```

#### `dbo.getNextEAN`()
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		NR
-- Create date: 
-- Description:	
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[getNextEAN] 
(
)
RETURNS decimal(13,0)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @Result decimal(13,0)
	DECLARE @MyCursor CURSOR;
	DECLARE @tmp integer, @prev as integer

	SET @MyCursor = CURSOR FOR
		SELECT right(left(p_ean, 12), 4) as id
		FROM produto
		WHERE p_ean is not null -- AND p_ean <> ''
		ORDER BY id 

    OPEN @MyCursor 
    FETCH NEXT FROM @MyCursor 
    INTO @tmp

	SET @prev = @tmp

    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @tmp - @prev < 2
    BEGIN
		SET @prev = @tmp
	    FETCH NEXT FROM @MyCursor 
		INTO @tmp
    END; 

    CLOSE @MyCursor ;
    DEALLOCATE @MyCursor;

	SET @Result = @prev + 1

	
	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
--	SELECT @Result = @p1

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @Result

END
```

#### `dbo.HorasRestantesSemana_Fase`(@fp_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[HorasRestantesSemana_Fase] 
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@fp_id int
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN
	declare @ano int = year(getdate()), @semana int = datepart("WW", getdate()), @pf_emps int, @faltas float

	declare @h_trb float = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where year(dtrb_data) = @ano and datepart("WW", dtrb_data) = @semana and dtrb_data > convert(nchar(10),getdate(),101)) + (17-(case when year(getdate()) >= @ano and datepart(week,getdate()) = @semana and datepart(weekday,getdate()) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,getdate()) < 13 then datepart(hh,getdate())+1 when year(getdate()) >= @ano and datepart(week,getdate()) = @semana and datepart(weekday,getdate()) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,getdate()) >= 13 then datepart(hh,getdate()) else 17 end))

	set @pf_emps = coalesce((select count(e_id) from entidade where e_fp_id = @fp_id and e_activo = 1),0)

	set @faltas = coalesce((select sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as faltas 
				from ent_mov inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id where e_fp_id = @fp_id and movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and year(movent_data_i) = @ano and datepart("WW", movent_data_i) = @semana and movent_data_i >= getdate()),0)

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN (@h_trb * @pf_emps) - @faltas

END
```

```sql
AS
BEGIN
```

#### `dbo.minutos_Trabalhados`(@di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[minutos_Trabalhados]
(
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @min int

	if cast(@di as date) = cast(@df as date)
		set @min = (case when datepart(hour,@di) < 12 and datepart(hour,@df) >= 13 and @di <= @df then datediff(n,@di, @df) - 60 when @di <= @df then datediff(n,@di, @df) else 0 end)
	else
		select @min = sum((case when dtrb_data = cast(@di as date) and dtrb_data <> cast(@df as date) and datepart(hour, @di) < 12 then (16*60.0) - ((datepart(hour, @di) * 60.0) + datepart(n, @di))
						when  dtrb_data = cast(@di as date) and dtrb_data <> cast(@df as date) and datepart(hour, @di) between 12 and 17 then (17*60.0) - (datepart(hour, @di) * 60.0 + datepart(n, @di))
						when  dtrb_data = cast(@di as date) and dtrb_data <> cast(@df as date) and datepart(hour, @di) > 17 then 0
						when dtrb_data <> cast(@df as date) and dtrb_data <> cast(@di as date) then 8.0*60.0 
						when dtrb_data = cast(@df as date) and datepart(hour,@df) > 12 /*and datediff(n, cast(@df as date), @df) - 8.0*60.0 > 4.0*60.0*/ then datediff(n, cast(@df as date), @df) - 9.0*60.0 
						when dtrb_data = cast(@df as date) and datepart(hour,@df) < 12 then datediff(n, cast(@df as date), @df) - 8.0*60.0 end)) --else datediff(n, cast(@df as date), @df) - 8.0*60.0 end)) 
					from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and cast(@df as date)
					
	select @min = isnull(@min,0)
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @min

END
```

#### `dbo.of_Acessorios`(@of_id int, @english bit)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `v_of`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Acessorios]
(
	@of_id int,
	@english bit = 0
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @result nvarchar(max)

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	select @result = (case when @english = 0 then replace(Stuff((select ', ' + atrib_nome_pt + ': ' + p_nome --+ char(13) + char(10)
			from movimento inner join atributo on mov_atrib_id = atrib_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
					where mov_of_id = @of_id and atrib_familia_pt = 'Acessórios' order by atrib_ordem FOR XML path('')),1,1,''),', ',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)) 
	else
	replace(Stuff((select ', ' + atrib_nome_en + ': ' + (case when len(isnull(p_nome_en,'')) >1 then p_nome_en else p_nome end) --+ char(13) + char(10)
			from movimento inner join atributo on mov_atrib_id = atrib_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
					where mov_of_id = @of_id and atrib_familia_pt = 'Acessórios' order by atrib_ordem FOR XML path('')),1,1,''),', ',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)) 
	end)

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN ltrim(@result)

END
```

```sql
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_AcessoriosExtra]
(
	@of_id int,
	@english bit = 0
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @result nvarchar(max)

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	select @result = (case when @english = 0 then replace(Stuff((select ', ' + p_nome + ' (' + cast(sum(mov_quantidade) as nvarchar(max)) + ' ' + uni_nome + ')'
			from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
					where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_acessorio_adicional = 1 group by p_nome, uni_nome order by p_nome FOR XML path('')),1,1,''),', ',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)) 
	else
	replace(Stuff((select ', ' + (case when len(isnull(p_nome_en,'')) >1 then p_nome_en else p_nome end) + ' (' + cast(sum(mov_quantidade) as nvarchar(max)) + ' ' + uni_nome + ')'
			from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
					where mov_of_id = @of_id and mov_acessorio_adicional = 1 group by (case when len(isnull(p_nome_en,'')) >1 then p_nome_en else p_nome end), uni_nome order by (case when len(isnull(p_nome_en,'')) >1 then p_nome_en else p_nome end) FOR XML path('')),1,1,''),', ',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)) 
	end)

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN ltrim(@result)

END
```

```sql
(

)

AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @result nvarchar(max)

	-- Return the result of the function

END
```

#### `dbo.of_Fases_txt`(@of_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2020-01-28 15:58* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Fases_txt]
(
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @result nvarchar(max)

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	select @result = replace(Stuff((select ', ' + fp_nome + ': ' + cast(cast(offp_datafim as date) as nvarchar(max)) + '  (' + isnull(e_nome, '') + ')'
					from 
						of_fp 
						left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
						left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
						inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
					where 
						offp_of_id = @of_id 
						and offp_return = 0
						and offp_fp_id in (47,53) 
						and offp_datafim is not null
						and fp_producao = 1
					order by 
						offp_datafim 
					FOR XML path('')),1,1,''),', ',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10))

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @result

END
```

#### `dbo.of_Fibras`(@of_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-06-22 11:21* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `v_of`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Fibras] 
(
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @result nvarchar(max)

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	select @result = replace(Stuff((select ', ' + p.p_nome + ' (' + uni_nome + '): ' + cast(m1.MOV_QUANTIDADE as nvarchar(max))
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join movimento m on of_id = m.mov_of_id
		inner join produto as p1 on m.mov_p_id = p1.p_id
		--inner join produto_componente on p1.p_id = comp_p_id 
		inner join movimento m1 on m.MOV_ID = m1.MOV_MOV_ID
		inner join produto as p on m1.MOV_P_ID = p.p_id 
		inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where 
		of_id = @of_id 
		and p1.p_tp_id = 84 
		and p.p_tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(60)) --= 60 
	order by	
		p.p_nome FOR XML path('')),1,1,''),', ',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10))

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN ltrim(@result)

END
```

#### `dbo.of_HIN_VortexN10`()
*Scalar Function · criado 2023-04-03 13:08 · modificado 2023-11-28 10:30* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_HIN_VortexN10] 
(
	
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @result nvarchar(max)

	declare @meses table(mes int, letra nvarchar(max))

	declare @dt date = getdate(), @sufixo nvarchar(max) = '19BASIC', @desenho nvarchar(max) = 'T3'

	insert into @meses(mes, letra)
	select 1, 'A'
	union
	select 2, 'B'
	union
	select 3, 'C'
	union
	select 4, 'D'
	union
	select 5, 'E'
	union
	select 6, 'F'
	union
	select 7, 'G'
	union
	select 8, 'H'
	union
	select 9, 'I'
	union
	select 10, 'J'
	union
	select 11, 'K'
	union
	select 12, 'L'

	declare @OFs int
	select @OFs = isnull(max(cast(SUBSTRING(OF_NOME,10,4) as int)),0) + 1 from ORDEMFABRICO where OF_P_ID = 28016

	select @result = @sufixo + @desenho + case when @OFs < 10 then '000' when @OFs < 100 then '00' when @OFs < 1000 then '0' else '' end +  cast(@OFs as nvarchar(max)) + letra + substring(cast(year(getdate()) as nvarchar(max)),4,1) from @meses where mes = DATEPART(month,@dt)

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @result

END
```

```sql
	DECLARE @resultado int

				when a.satisf = 0 and a.insatisf > 0

			SUM(case when mov_satisfeito = 1 then 1 else 0 end) satisf, SUM(case when mov_satisfeito = 0 then 1 else 0 end) insatisf

			PEDIDOS
			inner join MOVIMENTO on PED_E_ID = MOV_E_ID and PED_ID = MOV_ID_PEDIDO
			inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @resultado
```

#### `dbo.of_ProximaFase`(@of_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-11-11 14:06 · modificado 2019-11-11 14:30* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_ProximaFase] 
(
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	declare @fp_id int

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	select top 1 @fp_id = offp_fp_id from OF_FP inner join ORDEMFABRICO on OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and OFFP_DATAINICIO is null and OFFP_DATAFIM is null and OFFP_FP_ID <> OF_FP_ID

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN isnull(@fp_id, 9)
END
```

#### `dbo.of_Vale_Horas`(@modelo nvarchar(max))
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-01-26 15:39*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Vale_Horas] 
(
	@modelo nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	declare @vale_Horas int

	select 	
		@vale_Horas = (case 
							when 
									CHARINDEX('K2 ', @modelo,0) = 1 
									or CHARINDEX('K4 ', @modelo,0) = 1 
									or CHARINDEX('C2 ', @modelo,0) = 1 
									or CHARINDEX('C4 ', @modelo,0) = 1 
									or CHARINDEX('Ocean ski 600', @modelo,0) = 1 
									or CHARINDEX('Skiff ', @modelo,0) = 1 
									or CHARINDEX('Double ', @modelo,0) = 1 
									or CHARINDEX('TR ', @modelo,0) = 1
								Then 8
							else 
								4
						end)

	-- return the result of the function
	return @vale_horas

END
```

#### `dbo.offp_Minutos_Esperados`(@of_id int, @fp_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-12-11 14:29 · modificado 2020-02-06 15:02* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- ============================================= select * from fases_producao
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[offp_Minutos_Esperados]
(
	@of_id int, @fp_id int
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @result int
	if @fp_id < 1000
		select @result = 
			(case
				when offp_fp_id in (11,32,2) then -1
				when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and culpado = 1 then 0
				when offp_fp_id = 40 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(P_NOME) 
				else (OFFP_COEFICIENTE + case when FP_COEF_EXTRA = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end + case when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 
																then 0.25 
															when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
																then 0.1 
															when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 
																then 0.5 
															when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
																then 0.2
															when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 
																then 0.5 
															when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 
																then 1 
															when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 
																then 2 
															else 0 
														end)
					* f.FP_HORA_COEF
			end 
			/ 
			case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and culpado = 0 then 2 else 1 end)		
			*
			60
		from 
			ORDEMFABRICO
			cross apply (select top 1 
								fp.offp_fp_id, fp.offp_coeficiente, FP_COEF_EXTRA, fp.offp_return, case when eq.offpeq_e_id =  eq1.offpeq_e_id then 1 else 0 end as culpado, FP_HORA_COEF
							from 
								OF_FP as fp
								left join OFFP_EQ as eq on fp.OFFP_ID = eq.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID 
								left join OF_FP as fp1 on fp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = fp1.OFFP_ID
								left join OFFP_EQ as eq1 on fp1.OFFP_ID = eq1.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eq1.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
							where 
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID 
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_id 
								and fp.OFFP_DATAFIM is null
							order by 
								fp.OFFP_SEQUENCIA) as f
			inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID 
		where
			OF_ID = @of_id																			
	else
		select @result = 
			(case 
				when offp_fp_id in (11,32,2) then -1
				when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and culpado = 1 then 0
				when offp_fp_id = 40 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(P_NOME) 
				else (OFFP_COEFICIENTE + case when FP_COEF_EXTRA = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end + case when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 
																then 0.25 
															when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
																then 0.1 
															when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 
																then 0.5 
															when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) 
																then 0.2
															when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 
																then 0.5 
															when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 
																then 1 
															when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 
																then 2 
															else 0 
														end)
					* f.FP_HORA_COEF
			end 
			/ 
			case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and culpado = 0 then 2 else 1 end)		
			*
			60
		from 
			ORDEMFABRICO
			cross apply (select top 1 
								fp.offp_fp_id, fp.offp_coeficiente, FP_COEF_EXTRA, fp.offp_return, case when eq.offpeq_e_id =  eq1.offpeq_e_id then 1 else 0 end as culpado, FP_HORA_COEF
							from 
								OF_FP as fp
								left join OFFP_EQ as eq on fp.OFFP_ID = eq.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID 
								left join OF_FP as fp1 on fp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = fp1.OFFP_ID
								left join OFFP_EQ as eq1 on fp1.OFFP_ID = eq1.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eq1.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
							where 
								fp.OFFP_ID = @fp_id
							order by 
								fp.OFFP_SEQUENCIA) as f
			inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID 
		where
			OF_ID = @of_id

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @result

END
```

#### `dbo.Ponto_Hora_Entrada`(@e_id int, @dIn date)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:46*

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Ponto_Hora_Entrada] 
(
	@e_id int, 
	@dIn date
)
RETURNS smalldatetime
AS
BEGIN
	declare @dt smalldatetime

	SELECT 
		@dt = min(m.[Data] + m.[Hora])
	FROM 	 
		[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m
		inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] inner join entidade on e_id = f.[Numero]
	where cast(m.[Data] as date) = @dIn and f.[Numero] = @e_id
	group by m.[IDFuncionario], f.[Numero],f.[Nome], f.[IDPlanoTrabalho],m.[Data]

	return @dt

END
```

#### `dbo.PrecoCusto_OF`(@of_id int, @tipo int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-05-21 11:44* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[PrecoCusto_OF]
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@of_id int,
	@tipo int
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN
	declare @total float

	declare @data smalldatetime, @modelo nvarchar(max), @fact float
	select @data = coalesce(of_datainicio, of_data), @modelo = p_nome from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id;

	set @fact = 1

	declare @t table
	(tp_nome nvarchar(max), p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, p_nome nvarchar(max), p_medida nvarchar(max), mov_quantidade float, pai nvarchar(max), pai_nome nvarchar(max), 
		fp_nome nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, data_mov smalldatetime, data_entrada smalldatetime, preco_a_data float, fornc_a_data nvarchar(max),nivel int);

	declare @counter int
	set @counter = 1

	insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	(select tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id),''), 
			p.p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
		m.mov_quantidade * (case when p.p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), 
		convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) as pai, p1.p_nome, fp_nome, 
		(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 and m.mov_precounitario = 0 then p.p_precocusto when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else m.mov_precounitario end) as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, @counter
	from produto as p inner join movimento as m on p.p_id = m.mov_p_id
			left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id left join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id
			inner join produto_tipo on p.p_tp_id = tp_id left join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where m.mov_of_id = @of_id and m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0 and p.P_TP_ID <> 81 and (p1.P_TP_ID is null or p1.P_TP_ID <> 81) /*81: Embalagem e componentes*/)

	while @@rowcount > 0
	begin
		set @counter = @counter + 1

		insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
		(select pt.tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),comp_p_p_id) + t.p_id, comp_p_p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
			comp_quantidade * (case when p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), 
			t.p_id, t.p_nome, 
			convert(nvarchar(max),''), (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 then p.p_precocusto else 0 end) as p_precocusto, comp_tpcomp_id, t.nivel + 1
		from @t as t inner join produto_componente on t.p_id_ant = comp_p_id and t.p_id_ant not in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 84)
			inner join produto as p on comp_p_p_id = p.p_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
			inner join produto_tipo as pt on p.p_tp_id = pt.tp_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 2 and nivel = @counter - 1)
	end

	declare @interno bit = (select p_fabricointerno from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id)
	
	--if @interno = 1
	--begin
	--	insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	--	select 'Gel Coat', (case when @data < '2011/05/01' then convert(nvarchar(max),21934) else convert(nvarchar(max),22391) end), 
	--		(case when @data < '2011/05/01' then convert(nvarchar(max),21934) else convert(nvarchar(max),22391) end), 'Clear', 'Kg', 2.0, NULL,
	--	NULL, 'Pintura', 0, 1, 1 
	--end

	update @t set data_mov = dt, data_entrada = mov_datasaida, preco_a_data = coalesce(x.precoData, p.p_precocusto), fornc_a_data = e_nome 
	from @t as t 
		outer apply (select top 1 MOV_PRECOUNITARIO as precoData, mov_datasaida, mov_e_id, mov_data dt from movimento where MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 and MOV_DATA <= @data and MOV_P_ID = t.p_id_ant and mov_arm_id is not null and mov_e_id is not null and mov_datasaida is not null order by MOV_DATA desc) x
		inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	where t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2) --and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_arm_id = 1

	--declare @nivel int 
	--set @nivel = (select max(nivel) from @t)

	--while (@nivel > 1)
	--begin
	--	update ts set ts.preco_a_data = (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.val end)
	--		from (select pai, sum(mov_quantidade * coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto)) as val 
	--			from @t where  nivel = @nivel and tpcomp = 2 group by pai) as t inner join @t as ts on t.pai = ts.p_id  
	--			inner join produto as p on ts.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	--	where ts.nivel = @nivel - 1

	--	set @nivel = @nivel - 1
	--end

	--set @total = (select sum(mov_quantidade * coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto)) from @t where tpcomp = 1)
	set @total = (select sum(mov_quantidade * case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) when preco_a_data > 0 then preco_a_data else t.p_precocusto end) from @t t inner join produto as p on p_id_ant = p.p_id where tpcomp = 1)
	
	
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @total

END
```

#### `dbo.PrecoCusto_OF_Inflacionado`(@of_id int, @tipo int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2024-10-04 16:14 · modificado 2025-05-21 11:43* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[PrecoCusto_OF_Inflacionado]
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@of_id int,
	@tipo int
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN

	declare @fInflacao float
	select @fInflacao = cast(var_valor as float) from VARIAVEIS where VAR_ID = 2

	declare @total float

	declare @data smalldatetime, @modelo nvarchar(max), @fact float
	select @data = coalesce(of_datainicio, of_data), @modelo = p_nome from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id;

	set @fact = 1

	declare @t table
	(tp_nome nvarchar(max), p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, p_nome nvarchar(max), p_medida nvarchar(max), mov_quantidade float, pai nvarchar(max), pai_nome nvarchar(max), 
		fp_nome nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, data_mov smalldatetime, data_entrada smalldatetime, preco_a_data float, fornc_a_data nvarchar(max),nivel int);

	declare @counter int
	set @counter = 1

	insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	(select tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id),''), 
			p.p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
		m.mov_quantidade * (case when p.p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end) * (case when p.P_TP_ID = 90 then @fInflacao else 1 end), 
		convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) as pai, p1.p_nome, fp_nome, 
		(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 and m.mov_precounitario = 0 then p.p_precocusto when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else m.mov_precounitario end) as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, @counter
	from produto as p inner join movimento as m on p.p_id = m.mov_p_id
			left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id left join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id
			inner join produto_tipo on p.p_tp_id = tp_id left join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where m.mov_of_id = @of_id and m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0 and p.P_TP_ID <> 81 and (p1.P_TP_ID is null or p1.P_TP_ID <> 81) /*81: Embalagem e componentes*/)

	while @@rowcount > 0
	begin
		set @counter = @counter + 1

		insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
		(select pt.tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),comp_p_p_id) + t.p_id, comp_p_p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
			comp_quantidade * (case when p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), -- * (case when p.P_TP_ID = 90 then @fInflacao else 1 end), 
			t.p_id, t.p_nome, 
			convert(nvarchar(max),''), (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 then p.p_precocusto else 0 end) as p_precocusto, comp_tpcomp_id, t.nivel + 1
		from @t as t inner join produto_componente on t.p_id_ant = comp_p_id and t.p_id_ant not in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 84)
			inner join produto as p on comp_p_p_id = p.p_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
			inner join produto_tipo as pt on p.p_tp_id = pt.tp_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 2 and nivel = @counter - 1)
	end


	declare @interno bit = (select p_fabricointerno from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id)
	
	--if @interno = 1
	--begin
	--	insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	--	select 'Gel Coat', (case when @data < '2011/05/01' then convert(nvarchar(max),21934) else convert(nvarchar(max),22391) end), 
	--		(case when @data < '2011/05/01' then convert(nvarchar(max),21934) else convert(nvarchar(max),22391) end), 'Clear', 'Kg', 2.0, NULL,
	--	NULL, 'Pintura', 0, 1, 1 
	--end

	update @t set data_mov = dt, data_entrada = mov_datasaida, preco_a_data = coalesce(x.precoData, p.p_precocusto), fornc_a_data = e_nome 
	from @t as t 
		outer apply (select top 1 MOV_PRECOUNITARIO as precoData, mov_datasaida, mov_e_id, mov_data dt from movimento where MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 and MOV_DATA <= @data and MOV_P_ID = t.p_id_ant and mov_arm_id is not null and mov_e_id is not null and mov_datasaida is not null order by MOV_DATA desc) x
		inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	where t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2) --and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_arm_id = 1

	--declare @nivel int 
	--set @nivel = (select max(nivel) from @t)

	--while (@nivel > 1)
	--begin
	--	update ts set ts.preco_a_data = (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.val end)
	--		from (select pai, sum(mov_quantidade * coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto)) as val 
	--			from @t where  nivel = @nivel and tpcomp = 2 group by pai) as t inner join @t as ts on t.pai = ts.p_id  
	--			inner join produto as p on ts.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	--	where ts.nivel = @nivel - 1

	--	set @nivel = @nivel - 1
	--end

	set @total = (select sum(mov_quantidade * case when P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) when preco_a_data > 0 then preco_a_data else t.p_precocusto end) from @t t inner join produto as p on p_id_ant = p.p_id where tpcomp = 1)

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @total

END
```

#### `dbo.PrecoProduto_Construcao`(@p_id int, @dt smalldatetime)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[PrecoProduto_Construcao]
(
	@p_id int,
	@dt smalldatetime = getdate
)
RETURNS FLOAT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	declare @preco float

--	
--	declare @p_id int
--	set @p_id = 20982

	declare @data smalldatetime--, @modelo nvarchar(max)
	set @data = @dt
	--select @data = coalesce(of_datainicio, of_data), @modelo = p_nome from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id;

	declare @t table
	(p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, comp_qtd float, pai nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, preco_a_data float, nivel int);

	declare @counter int = 1

	insert into @t (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	(select convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_quantidade, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, @counter
		from produto as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where p.p_id = @p_id)

	while @@ROWCOUNT > 0
	begin
		set @counter = @counter + 1

		insert into @t (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
		(select convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_qtd * comp_quantidade, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, comp_tpcomp_id as tpcomp, p.nivel + 1
		from @t as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id_ant = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id and nivel = @counter - 1)
	end

	update @t set p_precocusto = (case when p.p_tp_id = 84 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Construcao(p.p_id, null) when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, null),0) else convert(float,p.p_precocusto) end)--(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, null),0) else coalesce(mov_precounitario, p.p_precocusto) end) 
	from @t as t left join 
	(select mov_p_id, mov_precounitario, mov_e_id from movimento inner join 
		(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
			where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_data <= @data
			group by mov_p_id) as ult on mov_p_id = id and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 where mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on t.p_id_ant = m.mov_p_id
		left join entidade on m.mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	where t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2)


	set @preco = (select round(sum(comp_qtd * p_precocusto),2) from @t)
    

	-- Return the result of the function
	return @preco

END
```

#### `dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno`(@p_id int, @dt smalldatetime)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2020-04-30 10:37* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[PrecoProduto_Interno]
(
	@p_id int,
	@dt smalldatetime = getdate
)
RETURNS FLOAT
AS
BEGIN
	declare @preco float

	declare @data smalldatetime--, @modelo nvarchar(max)
	set @data = @dt
	
	declare @t table
	(p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, comp_qtd float, pai nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, preco_a_data float, nivel int);
	
	with cte (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel) as
	(
		select convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_quantidade, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, 1
		from produto as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where p.p_id = @p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 
		union all
		select convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id),''), 
				p1.p_id, comp_qtd * comp_quantidade, (case when comp_p_p_id = 22394 /*Gastos gerais de fabrico*/ then convert(nvarchar(max),@p_id) else convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) end) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, 2 as tpcomp, p.nivel + 1
		from cte as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id_ant = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 2 or comp_p_p_id = 22394 /*Gastos gerais de fabrico*/ 
	)

	insert into @t (p_id, p_id_ant, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	select * from cte where cte.p_id not in (select pai from cte)


	update @t set p_precocusto = coalesce(mov_precounitario, p.p_precocusto) 
	from @t as t left join 
	(select mov_p_id, mov_precounitario, mov_e_id from movimento inner join 
		(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
			where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_data <= @data
			group by mov_p_id) as ult on mov_p_id = id and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 where mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on t.p_id_ant = m.mov_p_id
		left join entidade on m.mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	where t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2)

	set @preco = (select round(sum(comp_qtd * p_precocusto),2) from @t)
    

	-- Return the result of the function
	return @preco

END
```

```sql
	from @t as t left join

		(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
			where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_data <= @data
			group by mov_p_id) as ult on mov_p_id = id and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 where mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on t.p_id_ant = m.mov_p_id
		left join entidade on m.mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	where t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2)

	set @preco = (select round(sum(comp_qtd * a.p_precocusto),2) from @t a inner join produto p on p_id_ant = p.p_id where p.P_TP_ID = 90 and p.P_ID <> 22394)
   
	-- Return the result of the function
	return @preco

END
```

#### `dbo.produto_OFsEmCurso`(@p_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2020-11-06 09:54 · modificado 2021-01-28 23:15* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produto_OFsEmCurso] 
(
	@p_id int
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	declare @txt nvarchar(max) = '' -- = 'Estado (Em espera/Em curso)'

	--declare @p_id int = 29317
	declare @t table(fp_nome nvarchar(max), FP_SEQUENCIA int, ofs_EmEspera int, ofs_EmCurso int, visto bit default 0)
	declare @fp_nome nvarchar(max)

	insert into @t (fp_nome, FP_SEQUENCIA, ofs_EmEspera, ofs_EmCurso)
	select
		fp_nome,
		FP_SEQUENCIA,
		sum(case when OFFP_DATAINICIO is null then 1 else 0 end) as ofs_EmEspera,
		sum(case when OFFP_DATAINICIO is null then 0 else 1 end) as ofs_EmCurso
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OF_FP_ID = FP_ID
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and of_fp_id = offp_fp_id
	where
		OF_P_ID = @p_id
		and offp_fp_id not in (12,49,50)
		and (offp_datainicio is null or offp_datafim is null)
	group by
		fp_nome,
		FP_SEQUENCIA
	order by 
		FP_SEQUENCIA

	declare @first bit = 1

	while exists(select * from @t where visto = 0)
	begin
		select top 1 @fp_nome = fp_nome, @txt += case when @first = 0 then char(13) + char(10) else '' end + fp_nome + ' (' + cast(ofs_EmEspera as nvarchar(max)) + '/' + cast(ofs_EmCurso as nvarchar(max)) + ')' from @t where visto = 0 order by FP_SEQUENCIA
		update @t set visto = 1 where fp_nome = @fp_nome
		set @first = 0
	end

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @txt

END
```

#### `dbo.produto_OFsEmCurso_inteiro`(@p_id int)

```sql
	RETURN @ofs

END
```

```sql
BEGIN
	DECLARE @Result nvarchar(max)

	SELECT @Result = coalesce(@Result + '; ', '') + p_nome + ' * ' + cast(sum(Qtd) as nvarchar(max)) FROM OpenJson(@acessorios)
	with(
		Id int '$.id',
		Qtd float '$.quantity'
	)
	inner join produto on Id = p_id
	group by p_nome

	RETURN @Result

END
```

#### `dbo.provas_id_por_Funcionario`(@e_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[provas_id_por_Funcionario] 
(
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @id int

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	select top 1
		@id = t.tr_id
	from 
		transporte as t 
		inner join transp_tipo on t.tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
		inner join transp_entidade on tr_id = tre_tr_id
	where 
		trtp_trtp_id = 19
		and tre_e_id = @e_id
		and GETDATE() between tr_data and tr_data_regresso
	order by 
		t.tr_data

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @id

END
```

#### `dbo.Query_to_HTMLtable`(@query nvarchar(max))
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Query_to_HTMLtable]
(
	@query nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @HTML_table nvarchar(max)
	set @HTML_table = '<br><br><table border="1"><tr style="background-color:gray">'

	declare curcapa cursor for
	select Name from dbo.get_QueryColumnNames(@query)

	open curcapa

	--declare @of_id int, @ord int, @dt smalldatetime
	declare @name nvarchar(max)

	--fetch next from curcapa into @of_id, @ord, @dt while @@fetch_status = 0
	fetch next from curcapa into @name while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin

		set @HTML_table = @HTML_table + '<th><span style="color:white">' + @name + '</span></th>'

	--fetch next from curcapa into @of_id, @ord, @dt
	fetch next from curcapa into @name
	end
	close curcapa
	deallocate curcapa

	set @HTML_table= @HTML_table + '</tr>'
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @HTML_table

END
```

#### `dbo.removeNaoNumericos`(@string nvarchar(max))
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-11-21 14:16 · modificado 2019-11-21 14:28*

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION removeNaoNumericos 
(
	@string nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @result nvarchar(max) = ''

	while len(@string) > 0
	begin
		if isnumeric(SUBSTRING(@string,1,1)) = 1
			set @result = @result + SUBSTRING(@string,1,1)

		set @string = SUBSTRING(@string,2,LEN(@string)-1)
	end

	RETURN @result
END
```

#### `dbo.Transporte_JSonDestinos`()
*Scalar Function · criado 2022-01-13 17:00 · modificado 2022-01-18 11:09* · 🔎 `transp`

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Transporte_JSonDestinos] 
(
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @locais nvarchar(max) --= 'Porto, Portugal; Lisboa, Portugal; Algarve, Portugal'
	DECLARE @NewLineChar AS nvarchar(max) = CHAR(13) + CHAR(10)
	declare @json nvarchar(max) = '{' + @NewLineChar + char(9) + '"version": "' + cast(datediff(s,'1970-01-01 00:00:00',getdate()) as nvarchar(max)) + '",' + @NewLineChar + char(9) + '"routes":{'
	
	declare @trId int, @trDescr nvarchar(max), @trData date

	declare @Routes table(trId int, trDescricao nvarchar(max), trMorada nvarchar(max), trData date, visto bit default 0)

	insert into @Routes (trId, trDescricao, trMorada, trData)
	select tr_id, tr_descricao, tr_morada, tr_data
	from transporte 
	where
		TR_PAISES_ID = 199
		and TR_DATA >= getdate()

	while exists(select * from @Routes where visto = 0)
	begin
		--select top 1 @trId = trId, @trDescr = cast(trId as nvarchar(max)) + ' - ' + trDescricao, @trData = trData from @Routes where visto = 0
		select top 1 @trId = trId, @trDescr = trDescricao, @trData = trData, @locais = trMorada from @Routes where visto = 0

		--set @json += @NewLineChar + char(9) + char(9) +'"Data": "' + cast(@trData  as nvarchar(max)) + '",'
		set @json += @NewLineChar + char(9) + char(9) +'"' + cast(@trId as nvarchar(max)) + '":{' + @NewLineChar + char(9) + char(9) + char(9) + '"departure": "' + cast(@trData as nvarchar(max)) + '",' + @NewLineChar + char(9) + char(9) + char(9) + '"description": "' + @trDescr + '",' + @NewLineChar + char(9) + char(9) + char(9) + '"route": ["' + replace(@locais,';','","') + '"]' + @NewLineChar + char(9) + char(9) + '},'
	
		update @Routes set visto = 1 where trId = @trId
	end
	set @json = SUBSTRING(@json,0,len(@json))
	set @json += @NewLineChar + char(9) + '}' + @NewLineChar + '}'

	return @json

END
```

#### `dbo.udf_get_check_digit_ucc_ean13`(@ACode varchar(12))
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[udf_get_check_digit_ucc_ean13]
 (
   @ACode AS VARCHAR(12)
)
RETURNS INTEGER
AS BEGIN
  RETURN (10 - (3* CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 1, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 2, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + 3* CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 3, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 4, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + 3* CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 5, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 6, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + 3* CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 7, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 8, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + 3* CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 9, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 10, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + 3* CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 11, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 12, 1) AS INTEGER)
                + 3* CAST(SUBSTRING('0' + @ACode, 13, 1) AS INTEGER)
               )%10
         )%10
END;
```

#### `dbo.ult_preco_fornecedor`(@p_id int, @e_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-09-05 11:04* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ult_preco_fornecedor]
(
	@p_id int,
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS float
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	declare @prec float

	set @prec = (select top 1 mov_precounitario from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_p_id = @p_id and mov_e_id = @e_id and mov_datasaida is not null order by mov_data desc)

	if @prec is null or @prec = 0
		select @prec = p_precocusto from PRODUTO where P_ID = @p_id

	-- Return the result of the function
	return coalesce(@prec,0.0)

END
```

```sql
(

)
RETURNS int
AS

	-- Declare the return variable here
	declare @pontos int

	set @pontos = coalesce((select pontos_pontos from pontos where @horasganhas between pontos_min and pontos_max),0)

END
```

#### `dbo.VerificaEstadoOF`(@of_id int)
*Scalar Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-11-13 10:54* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[VerificaEstadoOF]
(
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	declare @estado int

	select top 1 @estado = offp_fp_id from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and ((offp_datainicio is not null and offp_datafim is null) or (offp_datainicio is null and offp_datafim is null)) order by coalesce(offp_datainicio,dateadd(year,100,getdate())), offp_ordem

	if 	@estado is null
		select top 1 @estado = offp_fp_id from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id order by OFFP_ORDEM desc

	-- Return the result of the function
	return @estado

END
```

#### `dbo.agente_ProdutosFornecidos`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-02-28 15:13 · modificado 2025-04-29 16:33*

**Devolve:** `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `uni_nome` nvarchar(100), `stock` float, `meses` float, `media` float, `p_stockmin` float, `necessidades` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[agente_ProdutosFornecidos] 
(	
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		p_id, 
		case when len(p_nome_en) > 3 then p_nome_en else p_nome end p_nome, 
		uni_nome, 
		s.stock, 
		case when s.stock <= 0 or s.consumido / 12.0 = 0 then 0 else s.stock / ( s.consumido / 12.0) end meses, 
		s.consumido / 12.0 media, 
		p_stockmin,
		necessidades
	from 
		produto_entidade pe 
		inner join produto on pe.PF_P_ID = p_id 
		inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id 
		outer apply (select 
							sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then mov_quantidade when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then mov_quantidade * -1.0 else 0.0 end) stock, 
							sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data >= dateadd(year,-1,getdate()) then mov_quantidade else 0 end) consumido,
							sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 4 and mov_data >= dateadd(year,-1,getdate()) then mov_quantidade else 0 end) necessidades
						from 
							movimento 
						where 
							mov_p_id = p_id) s 
	where 
		pe.pf_e_id = @e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.avaliacao_Desmolde`(@dI date, @dF date, @fp_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `molde`

**Devolve:** `eid` int, `enome` nvarchar, `ajid` int, `lam_n_Grave` int, `lam_Grave` int, `lam_mt_Grave` int, `pint_n_Grave` int, `pint_Grave` int, `pint_mt_Grave` int, `interior_n_Grave` int, `interior_Grave` int, `interior_mt_Grave` int, `gola_n_Grave` int, `gola_Grave` int, `gola_mt_Grave` int, `molde_n_Grave` int, `molde_Grave` int, `molde_mt_Grave` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[avaliacao_Desmolde] 
(	
	@dI date,
	@dF date,
	@fp_id int = 1
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select e_id as eid, e_nome as enome, e_e_id as ajid,
		sum(isnull(lam.n_Grave,0)) as lam_n_Grave, sum(isnull(lam.Grave,0)) as lam_Grave, sum(isnull(lam.mt_Grave,0)) as lam_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(pint.n_Grave,0)) as pint_n_Grave, sum(isnull(pint.Grave,0)) as pint_Grave, sum(isnull(pint.mt_Grave,0)) as pint_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(interior.n_Grave,0)) as interior_n_Grave, sum(isnull(interior.Grave,0)) as interior_Grave, sum(isnull(interior.mt_Grave,0)) as interior_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(gola.n_Grave,0)) as gola_n_Grave, sum(isnull(gola.Grave,0)) as gola_Grave, sum(isnull(gola.mt_Grave,0)) as gola_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(molde.n_Grave,0)) as molde_n_Grave, sum(isnull(molde.Grave,0)) as molde_Grave, sum(isnull(molde.mt_Grave,0)) as molde_mt_Grave
	from of_fp as fp_lam inner join offp_eq as eq_lam on eq_lam.offpeq_offp_id = fp_lam.offp_id /*and eq_lam.offpeq_chefe = 1*/ inner join entidade on e_id = offpeq_e_id 
		inner join of_fp as fp_desm on fp_lam.offp_of_id = fp_desm.offp_of_id and fp_desm.offp_fp_id = 6 left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Laminagem' group by ofch_of_id) as lam on fp_lam.offp_of_id = lam.ofch_of_id and fp_desm.offp_probs_lam_inocente = 0 left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Pintura' group by ofch_of_id) as pint on fp_lam.offp_of_id = pint.ofch_of_id and fp_desm.offp_probs_pint_inocente = 0 left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Interior' group by ofch_of_id) as interior on fp_lam.offp_of_id = interior.ofch_of_id left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Gola' group by ofch_of_id) as gola on fp_lam.offp_of_id = gola.ofch_of_id left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Molde' group by ofch_of_id) as molde on fp_lam.offp_of_id = molde.ofch_of_id
	where cast(fp_desm.offp_probs_data as date) between @dI and @dF and fp_lam.offp_fp_id = @fp_id
	group by e_id, e_nome, e_e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.avaliacao_Desmolde_OF`(@dI date, @dF date, @fp_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `molde`

**Devolve:** `ofid` int, `eid` int, `enome` nvarchar, `ajid` int, `lam_n_Grave` int, `lam_Grave` int, `lam_mt_Grave` int, `pint_n_Grave` int, `pint_Grave` int, `pint_mt_Grave` int, `interior_n_Grave` int, `interior_Grave` int, `interior_mt_Grave` int, `gola_n_Grave` int, `gola_Grave` int, `gola_mt_Grave` int, `molde_n_Grave` int, `molde_Grave` int, `molde_mt_Grave` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
create FUNCTION [dbo].[avaliacao_Desmolde_OF] 
(	
	@dI date,
	@dF date,
	@fp_id int = 1
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select fp_lam.offp_of_id as ofid, e_id as eid, e_nome as enome, e_e_id as ajid,
		sum(isnull(lam.n_Grave,0)) as lam_n_Grave, sum(isnull(lam.Grave,0)) as lam_Grave, sum(isnull(lam.mt_Grave,0)) as lam_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(pint.n_Grave,0)) as pint_n_Grave, sum(isnull(pint.Grave,0)) as pint_Grave, sum(isnull(pint.mt_Grave,0)) as pint_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(interior.n_Grave,0)) as interior_n_Grave, sum(isnull(interior.Grave,0)) as interior_Grave, sum(isnull(interior.mt_Grave,0)) as interior_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(gola.n_Grave,0)) as gola_n_Grave, sum(isnull(gola.Grave,0)) as gola_Grave, sum(isnull(gola.mt_Grave,0)) as gola_mt_Grave, 
		sum(isnull(molde.n_Grave,0)) as molde_n_Grave, sum(isnull(molde.Grave,0)) as molde_Grave, sum(isnull(molde.mt_Grave,0)) as molde_mt_Grave
	from of_fp as fp_lam inner join offp_eq as eq_lam on eq_lam.offpeq_offp_id = fp_lam.offp_id /*and eq_lam.offpeq_chefe = 1*/ inner join entidade on e_id = offpeq_e_id 
		inner join of_fp as fp_desm on fp_lam.offp_of_id = fp_desm.offp_of_id and fp_desm.offp_fp_id = 6 left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Laminagem' group by ofch_of_id) as lam on fp_lam.offp_of_id = lam.ofch_of_id and fp_desm.offp_probs_lam_inocente = 0 left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Pintura' group by ofch_of_id) as pint on fp_lam.offp_of_id = pint.ofch_of_id and fp_desm.offp_probs_pint_inocente = 0 left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Interior' group by ofch_of_id) as interior on fp_lam.offp_of_id = interior.ofch_of_id left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Gola' group by ofch_of_id) as gola on fp_lam.offp_of_id = gola.ofch_of_id left join
		(select ofch_of_id, sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as n_Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as Grave,
			sum(case when ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as mt_Grave from of_checklist where ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_descr = 'Molde' group by ofch_of_id) as molde on fp_lam.offp_of_id = molde.ofch_of_id
	where cast(fp_desm.offp_probs_data as date) between @dI and @dF and fp_lam.offp_fp_id = @fp_id
	group by fp_lam.offp_of_id, e_id, e_nome, e_e_id
)
```
