#### `dbo.Entidade_Barcos_Ano_Epoca`(@dtI_epoca smalldatetime, @dtF_epoca smalldatetime, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-06-28 14:32 · modificado 2022-06-28 14:52* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

**Devolve:** `Ano` int, `ofsAno` int, `ofsEpoca` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION Entidade_Barcos_Ano_Epoca 
(
	@dtI_epoca smalldatetime, @dtF_epoca smalldatetime, @e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select a.Ano, a.ofs ofsAno, b.ofs ofsEpoca
	from
		(select 
			'Ano' as tp, 
			year(of_datafim) as Ano, 
			count(of_id) as ofs 
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
		where 
			of_e_id_enc = @e_id 
			and year(of_datafim) > year(getdate()) - 4
			and of_id < 10000000 
		group by 
			year(of_datafim)) a
		left join
		(select 
			'Época' as tp, 
			(case when month(of_datafim) < 10 then year(of_datafim) else year(of_datafim) + 1 end) as Ano, 
			count(of_id) as ofs 
		from 
			ordemfabrico 
		where 
			of_e_id_enc = @e_id 
			and of_datafim between dateadd(year,-3, @dtI_epoca) and @dtF_epoca 
			and of_id < 10000000 
		group by 
			(case when month(of_datafim) < 10 then year(of_datafim) else year(of_datafim) + 1 end)) b on a.Ano = b.Ano
)
```

#### `dbo.entidade_EncomendasEmCurso_Valor`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `preco`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `tr_data` date, `paises_nome` nvarchar, `ofs` int, `valor` float, `trtp_nome` nvarchar, `e_nome` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_EncomendasEmCurso_Valor]
(	
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		tr_data, paises_nome, count(of_id) as ofs, sum(of_precovenda * (1-(of_desconto/100))) as valor, trtp_nome, e_nome
	from 
		transporte 
		inner join transp_of on trof_tr_id = tr_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join paises on tr_paises_id = paises_id 
		inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
		left join entidade on tr_e_id = e_id
	where 
		of_e_id_enc = @e_id 
		and tr_data >= convert(smalldatetime, convert(nvarchar(10),getdate(),101))
		and OF_ID < 10000000
	group by 
		tr_data, 
		paises_nome, 
		trtp_nome, 
		e_nome 
	union
	select 
		null as tr_data, '' as paises_nome, count(of_id) as ofs, sum(of_precovenda * (1-(of_desconto/100))) as valor, '' as trtp_nome, '' as e_nome
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
	where  
		of_e_id_enc = @e_id 
		and of_tr_id is null
		and of_fp_id not in (12,13,14)
		and OF_ID < 10000000
)
```

#### `dbo.Entidade_Facturacao_Barcos`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-07-07 13:38 · modificado 2024-01-03 13:42* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `Ano` int, `ofs` int, `ofsHomo` int, `TotalSemIva` float, `TotalSemIvaHomo` float, `valor` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Entidade_Facturacao_Barcos]
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		E_ID,
		E_NOME,
		epoca1.Ano,
		epoca1.ofs,
		isnull(epocaHomo.ofs,0) ofsHomo,
		sum(isnull(fact1.TotalSemIva,0)) TotalSemIva,
		sum(isnull(fact1Homo.TotalSemIva,0)) TotalSemIvaHomo,
		isnull(x.valor, 0) valor
	from 
		ENTIDADE 
		inner join ENTIDADE_PHC on E_ID = EPHC_E_ID 
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.cl on ephc_phc_id = cl.no 
		inner join (select of_e_id_enc as id, year(OF_DATAFIM) Ano, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs from ORDEMFABRICO where year(OF_DATAFIM) between YEAR(getdate()) - 6 and YEAR(getdate()) group by of_e_id_enc, year(OF_DATAFIM)) as epoca1 on E_ID = epoca1.id 
		left join (select of_e_id_enc id, SUM(OF_PRECOVENDA) valor from ORDEMFABRICO inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OF_FP_ID = FP_ID where FP_PRODUCAO = 1 and OF_ID < 10000000 group by of_e_id_enc) x on E_ID = x.id
		left join (select 
						no, 
						year(cast(ousrdata as date)) Ano,
						round(convert(float,sum(ettiliq)),2) as TotalSemIva 
					from 
						[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft 
					where 
						anulado = 0 
						and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') 
						and year(cast(ousrdata as date)) between YEAR(getdate()) - 6 and YEAR(getdate()) 
					group by 
						no, year(cast(ousrdata as date))) as fact1 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact1.no and epoca1.Ano = fact1.Ano
		left join (select 
						of_e_id_enc as id, year(OF_DATAFIM) Ano, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs 
					from ORDEMFABRICO 
					where 
						OF_DATAFIM between cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date) and GETDATE() 
						or OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year, -1, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -1, GETDATE())
						or OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year, -2, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -2, GETDATE())
						or OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year, -3, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -3, GETDATE())
						or OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year, -4, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -4, GETDATE())
						or OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year, -5, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -5, GETDATE())
						or OF_DATAFIM between dateadd(year, -6, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -6, GETDATE())
					group by of_e_id_enc, year(OF_DATAFIM)						
					) as epocaHomo on E_ID = epocaHomo.id and epocaHomo.Ano = epoca1.Ano
		left join (select 
						no, 
						year(cast(ousrdata as date)) Ano,
						round(convert(float,sum(ettiliq)),2) as TotalSemIva 
					from 
						[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft 
					where 
						anulado = 0 
						and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') 
						and (ousrdata between cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date) and GETDATE() 
						or ousrdata between dateadd(year, -1, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -1, GETDATE())
						or ousrdata between dateadd(year, -2, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -2, GETDATE())
						or ousrdata between dateadd(year, -3, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -3, GETDATE())
						or ousrdata between dateadd(year, -4, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -4, GETDATE())
						or ousrdata between dateadd(year, -5, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -5, GETDATE())
						or ousrdata between dateadd(year, -6, cast(DATEADD(DAY, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate()) - 1) * - 1, getdate()) as date)) and dateadd(year, -6, GETDATE()))
					group by 
						no, year(cast(ousrdata as date))) as fact1Homo on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact1Homo.no and epocaHomo.Ano = fact1Homo.Ano
	where 
		E_ACTIVO = 1
		and E_NELO = 0
	group by
		E_ID,
		E_NOME,
		epoca1.Ano,
		epoca1.ofs,
		epocaHomo.ofs,
		x.valor
)
```

#### `dbo.Entidade_Objectivos_Facturacao`(@data_i date, @data_f date, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-06-28 14:29 · modificado 2023-10-13 11:54* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`

**Devolve:** `e_id` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `Epoca` float, `E_FACT_EPOCA` decimal, `percEpoca` float, `Trimestre` float, `E_FACT_TRIMESTRE` decimal, `perc_Trimestre` float, `ContaCorrente` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Entidade_Objectivos_Facturacao] 
(	
	@data_i date, @data_f date, @e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		distinct e_id, 
		e_nome, 
		convert(float,sum(isnull(fact1.TotalSemIva,0))) as Epoca, 
		E_FACT_EPOCA, 
		case when e_fact_epoca = 0 then 0 else convert(float,sum(isnull(fact1.TotalSemIva,0)))/e_fact_epoca end as percEpoca, 
		convert(float,sum(isnull(fact2.TotalSemIva,0))) as Trimestre, 
		isnull(E_FACT_TRIMESTRE, 0) E_FACT_TRIMESTRE,
		case when isnull(E_FACT_TRIMESTRE, 0) = 0 then 0 else convert(float,sum(isnull(fact2.TotalSemIva,0)))/E_FACT_TRIMESTRE end as perc_Trimestre, 
		isnull(sum(cc.ContaCorrente),0) as ContaCorrente
	from 
		ENTIDADE left join 
		(select of_e_id_enc as id, COUNT(OF_id) as ofs from ORDEMFABRICO where cast(OF_DATAFIM as date) between @data_i and @data_f group by of_e_id_enc) as epoca1 on E_ID = epoca1.id inner join 
		ENTIDADE_PHC on E_ID = EPHC_E_ID inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.cl on ephc_phc_id = cl.no left join
		(select no, round(convert(float,sum(ettiliq)),2) as TotalSemIva from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and cast(ousrdata as date) between @data_i and @data_f group by no) as fact1 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact1.no left join
		(select no, round(convert(float,sum(ettiliq)),2) as TotalSemIva 
			from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft 
			where anulado = 0 and nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') and year(ousrdata) = year(getdate()) and 
				month(ousrdata) between (case when month(getdate()) < 4 then 1 when month(getdate()) between 4 and 6 then 4 when month(getdate()) between 7 and 9 then 7 else 10 end) and (case when month(getdate()) < 4 then 3 when month(getdate()) between 4 and 6 then 6 when month(getdate()) between 7 and 9 then 9 else 12 end)
			group by no) as fact2 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact2.no left join
		(select conta, sum(convert(float,edeb)) - sum(convert(float,ecre)) as ContaCorrente from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) group by conta) as cc on cl.conta = cc.conta
	where E_ID = @e_id and E_ACTIVO = 1 /*and epoca1.ofs > 0*/
	group by e_id, e_nome, E_FACT_EPOCA, E_FACT_TRIMESTRE
)
```

#### `dbo.entidade_Owner_Child_Ent`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

**Devolve:** `e_id` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `default` bit

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_Owner_Child_Ent] 
(	
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct
		e_id, 
		e_nome, 
		(case when e_id = @e_id then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end) as [default] 
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		inner join ent_tp_prod on tp_id = etp_tp_id 
		inner join entidade on etp_e_id = e_id 
	where 
		(case when @e_id = 21079 then @e_id else tp_ent_owner end) = @e_id and e_id <> 21079 and e_activo = 1
)
```

#### `dbo.entidade_Owner_ProxTransportes`(@e_id int, @tp_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-06-26 15:18* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `preco`, `disciplina`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `transp_Id` int, `transp_Data` date, `dataCriacao` smalldatetime, `of_id` int, `of_referencia` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `modelo` nvarchar, `valor` float, `status` varchar(21), `transp_Tipo` nvarchar, `transp_Transportadora` nvarchar, `cliente_Id` int, `cliente_Nome` nvarchar, `cliente_Pais` nvarchar, `ISO2` char(2), `tipo` int, `tipo_Descr` varchar(16), `of_datafim` smalldatetime, `tempoEnt` int, `diasAberto` int, `p_tp_id_disciplina` int, `modelo_sem_construcao` nvarchar, `OF_FACT` nvarchar, `fact_data` date

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_Owner_ProxTransportes] 
(	
	@e_id int,
	@tp_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		tr_id as transp_Id,
		tr_data as transp_Data,
		of_data as dataCriacao, 
		of_id, 
		case when of_p_id in (28016,45873) then '(external ID: ' + OF_NOME + ') ' + of_referencia else of_referencia end of_referencia,
		p_id,
		p_nome as modelo,
		of_precovenda * (1.0-(of_desconto/100.0)) as valor, 
		case when @e_id = 30231 
			then (case when of_fp_id in (32,11) and of_datainicio is null then 'Pending' when of_fp_id in (12) then 'Delivered' when of_fp_id in (13,14) then 'Under repair' when of_fp_id in (49) then 'Finished (2nd choice)' when of_fp_id in (9) then 'Finished' 
						when of_fp_id in (1,2,3,63,6,4) then 'Processing' when of_fp_id in (33,42,46) then 'Finishing' when of_fp_id = 8 then 'Q.C.' else 'Processing' end)
			else (case when of_fp_id in (32,11) and of_datainicio is null then 'Pending' when of_fp_id in (12) then 'Delivered' when of_fp_id in (13,14) then 'Under repair' when of_fp_id in (49) then 'Finished (2nd choice)' when of_fp_id in (9) then 'Finished' else 'Processing' end)
		end as status,
		trtp_nome as transp_Tipo, 
		e.e_nome as transp_Transportadora,
		cl.e_id as cliente_Id,
		cl.e_nome as cliente_Nome,
		name as cliente_Pais,
		ISO2,
		1 as tipo,
		'Prox_Transportes' as tipo_Descr,
		of_datafim,
		trs.tempoEnt,
		datediff(d,of_data, getdate()) as diasAberto,
		p_tp_id_disciplina,
		reverse(replace(reverse(p_nome),case 
						when CHARINDEX(' ', reverse(p_nome), 0) <= 4 then SUBSTRING(reverse(p_nome), 0, 1 + CHARINDEX(' ', reverse(p_nome), 0))
						when CHARINDEX('.', reverse(p_nome), 0) <= 4 then SUBSTRING(reverse(p_nome), 0, 1 + CHARINDEX('.', reverse(p_nome), 0))
						else p_nome
					end,'')) as modelo_sem_construcao,
		OF_FACT,
		cast(fdata as date) as fact_data
	from 
		transporte 
		inner join transp_of on trof_tr_id = tr_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id 
		inner join entidade cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		left join paises_site on cl.e_pais_id = id
		inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
		left join entidade e on tr_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join ent_tp_prod on p_tp_id_disciplina = etp_tp_id 
		left join (select 
						P_ID as id,
						P_NOME as nome,
						AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempoEnt
					from 
						PRODUTO
						inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
						cross apply (select top 1 tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID and TR_DATA < GETDATE() order by tr_data) as x
					where 
						OF_DATA > DATEADD(year,-1,getdate())
						and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
					group by 
						P_ID,
						P_NOME) as trs on P_ID = trs.id
		left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on OF_FACT collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS = cast(fno as nvarchar(max))
	where 
		etp_e_id = @e_id 
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else ETP_TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
		and etp_brand_manager = 1
		and tr_data >= convert(smalldatetime, convert(nvarchar(10),getdate(),101)) 
		and of_id < 10000000
		and cl.e_nelo = 0
		and OF_FP_ID not in (13,14)
	union
	select 
		null as transp_Id,
		null as transp_Data, 
		of_data as dataCriacao,
		of_id, 
		case when of_p_id in (28016,45873) then '(external ID: ' + OF_NOME + ') ' + of_referencia else of_referencia end of_referencia,
		p_id,
		p_nome as modelo,
		of_precovenda * (1.0-(of_desconto/100.0)) as valor, 
		case when @e_id = 30231 
			then (case when of_fp_id in (32,11) and of_datainicio is null then 'Pending' when of_fp_id in (12) then 'Delivered' when of_fp_id in (13,14) then 'Under repair' when of_fp_id in (49) then 'Finished (2nd choice)' when of_fp_id in (9) then 'Finished' 
						when of_fp_id in (1,2,3,63,6,4) then 'Processing' when of_fp_id in (33,42,46) then 'Finishing' when of_fp_id = 8 then 'Q.C.' else 'Processing' end)
			else (case when of_fp_id in (32,11) and of_datainicio is null then 'Pending' when of_fp_id in (12) then 'Delivered' when of_fp_id in (13,14) then 'Under repair' when of_fp_id in (49) then 'Finished (2nd choice)' when of_fp_id in (9) then 'Finished' else 'Processing' end)
		end as status,
		'' as transp_Tipo, 
		'' as transp_Transportadora,
		cl.e_id as cliente_Id,
		cl.e_nome as cliente_Nome,
		name as cliente_Pais,
		ISO2,
		2 as tipo,
		'Sem_Transporte' as tipo_Descr,
		of_datafim,
		trs.tempoEnt,
		datediff(d,of_data, getdate()) as diasAberto,
		p_tp_id_disciplina,
		reverse(replace(reverse(p_nome),case 
						when CHARINDEX(' ', reverse(p_nome), 0) <= 4 then SUBSTRING(reverse(p_nome), 0, 1 + CHARINDEX(' ', reverse(p_nome), 0))
						when CHARINDEX('.', reverse(p_nome), 0) <= 4 then SUBSTRING(reverse(p_nome), 0, 1 + CHARINDEX('.', reverse(p_nome), 0))
						else p_nome
					end,'')) as modelo_sem_construcao,
		OF_FACT,
		cast(fdata as date) as fact_data
	from 
		ordemfabrico
		inner join entidade cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		left join paises_site on cl.e_pais_id = id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join ent_tp_prod on p_tp_id_disciplina = etp_tp_id
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select 
						P_ID as id,
						P_NOME as nome,
						AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempoEnt
					from 
						PRODUTO
						inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
						cross apply (select top 1 tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID and TR_DATA < GETDATE() order by tr_data) as x
					where 
						OF_DATA > DATEADD(year,-1,getdate())
						and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
					group by 
						P_ID,
						P_NOME) as trs on P_ID = trs.id
		left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on OF_FACT collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS = cast(fno as nvarchar(max))
	where
		etp_e_id = @e_id  
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else ETP_TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
		and etp_brand_manager = 1
		and (fp_producao = 1
			or OF_FP_ID = 9)
		and of_tr_id is null
		and cl.e_nelo = 0
		and OF_FP_ID not in (13,14)
	union
	select 
		tr_id as transp_Id,
		tr_data as transp_Data, 
		of_data as dataCriacao, 
		of_id, 
		case when of_p_id in (28016,45873) then '(external ID: ' + OF_NOME + ') ' + of_referencia else of_referencia end of_referencia,
		p_id,
		p_nome as modelo,
		of_precovenda * (1.0-(of_desconto/100.0)) as valor, 
		case when @e_id = 30231 
			then (case when of_fp_id in (32,11) and of_datainicio is null then 'Pending' when of_fp_id in (12) then 'Delivered' when of_fp_id in (13,14) then 'Under repair' when of_fp_id in (49) then 'Finished (2nd choice)' when of_fp_id in (9) then 'Finished' 
						when of_fp_id in (1,2,3,63,6,4) then 'Processing' when of_fp_id in (33,42,46) then 'Finishing' when of_fp_id = 8 then 'Q.C.' else 'Processing' end)
			else (case when of_fp_id in (32,11) and of_datainicio is null then 'Pending' when of_fp_id in (12) then 'Delivered' when of_fp_id in (13,14) then 'Under repair' when of_fp_id in (49) then 'Finished (2nd choice)' when of_fp_id in (9) then 'Finished' else 'Processing' end)
		end as status,
		trtp_nome as transp_Tipo, 
		tr.e_nome as transp_Transportadora,
		cl.e_id as cliente_Id,
		cl.e_nome as cliente_Nome,
		name as cliente_Pais,
		ISO2,
		3 as tipo,
		'Barcos_Enviados' as tipo_Descr,
		of_datafim,
		trs.tempoEnt,
		datediff(d,of_data, getdate()) as diasAberto,
		p_tp_id_disciplina,
		reverse(replace(reverse(p_nome),case 
						when CHARINDEX(' ', reverse(p_nome), 0) <= 4 then SUBSTRING(reverse(p_nome), 0, 1 + CHARINDEX(' ', reverse(p_nome), 0))
						when CHARINDEX('.', reverse(p_nome), 0) <= 4 then SUBSTRING(reverse(p_nome), 0, 1 + CHARINDEX('.', reverse(p_nome), 0))
						else p_nome
					end,'')) as modelo_sem_construcao,
		OF_FACT,
		cast(fdata as date) as fact_data
	from 
		ordemfabrico  
		cross apply (select top 1
						tr_id, tr_data, trtp_nome, e_nome
					from 
						transporte 
						inner join transp_of on trof_tr_id = tr_id
						inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id 
						left join entidade e on tr_e_id = e.e_id
					where 
						year(tr_data) >= year(getdate())-3
						and tr_data < cast(getdate() as date) 
						and trof_of_id = of_id
					order by tr_data) as tr
		inner join entidade cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id
		left join paises_site on cl.e_pais_id = id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join ent_tp_prod on p_tp_id_disciplina = etp_tp_id
		left join (select 
						P_ID as id,
						P_NOME as nome,
						AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempoEnt
					from 
						PRODUTO
						inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
						cross apply (select top 1 tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID and TR_DATA < GETDATE() order by tr_data) as x
					where 
						OF_DATA > DATEADD(year,-1,getdate())
						and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
					group by 
						P_ID,
						P_NOME) as trs on P_ID = trs.id
		left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on OF_FACT collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS = cast(fno as nvarchar(max))
	where		
		etp_e_id = @e_id  
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else ETP_TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
		and etp_brand_manager = 1
		and of_id < 10000000
		and cl.e_nelo = 0
		and YEAR(of_data) >= YEAR(getdate()) - 4
)
```

#### `dbo.entidade_Owner_TemposMediosDisciplina`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `disciplina`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `ano` int, `mes` int, `trimestre` int, `id` int, `nome` nvarchar, `tempo_Entm` int, `tempo_Fabrico` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_Owner_TemposMediosDisciplina]
(	
	@e_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		0 as mes,
		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data) as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		produto_tipo
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
		inner join (select offp_of_id, cast(min(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt_Lam from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and offp_data_prevista is not null group by offp_of_id) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
		cross apply (select top 1 tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID and TR_DATA < GETDATE() order by tr_data) as x
	where 
		(case when @e_id is null then 1 else tp_ent_owner end) = isnull(@e_id,1)
		and year(x.tr_data) = YEAR(getdate())
		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
	group by 
		YEAR(x.tr_data),
		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME
	union
	select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		0 as mes,
		0 as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		produto_tipo
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
		inner join (select offp_of_id, cast(min(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt_Lam from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and offp_data_prevista is not null group by offp_of_id) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
		cross apply (select top 1 tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID and TR_DATA < GETDATE() order by tr_data) as x
	where 
		(case when @e_id is null then 1 else tp_ent_owner end) = isnull(@e_id,1)
		and year(x.tr_data) between YEAR(getdate())-3 and YEAR(getdate())-1
		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
	group by 
		YEAR(x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME
	union
	select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		month(x.tr_data) as mes,
		0 as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		produto_tipo
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
		inner join (select offp_of_id, cast(min(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt_Lam from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and offp_data_prevista is not null group by offp_of_id) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
		cross apply (select top 1 tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID and TR_DATA < GETDATE() order by tr_data) as x
	where 
		(case when @e_id is null then 1 else tp_ent_owner end) = isnull(@e_id,1)
		and year(x.tr_data) = YEAR(getdate())
		and month(x.tr_data) = month(getdate())
		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
	group by 
		YEAR(x.tr_data),
		month(x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME
	--order by 
	--	ano,
	--	trimestre,
	--	nome
)
```

#### `dbo.entidade_Owner_TemposMediosDisciplina_Matriz`(@e_id int, @tp_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `disciplina`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `id` int, `nome` nvarchar, `ano_Menos_3_TE` int, `ano_Menos_3_TF` int, `ano_Menos_2_TE` int, `ano_Menos_2_TF` int, `ano_Menos_1_TE` int, `ano_Menos_1_TF` int, `trims_1_TE` int, `trims_1_TF` int, `trims_2_TE` int, `trims_2_TF` int, `trims_3_TE` int, `trims_3_TF` int, `trims_4_TE` int, `trims_4_TF` int, `Mes_Menos_1_TE` int, `Mes_Menos_1_TF` int, `mes_TE` int, `mes_TF` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_Owner_TemposMediosDisciplina_Matriz]
(	
	@e_id int,
	@tp_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	Select 
		trims_1.id, trims_1.nome, 
		ano_Menos_3.tempo_Entm as ano_Menos_3_TE, ano_Menos_3.tempo_Fabrico as ano_Menos_3_TF,
		ano_Menos_2.tempo_Entm as ano_Menos_2_TE, ano_Menos_2.tempo_Fabrico as ano_Menos_2_TF,
		ano_Menos_1.tempo_Entm as ano_Menos_1_TE, ano_Menos_1.tempo_Fabrico as ano_Menos_1_TF,
		trims_1.tempo_Entm as trims_1_TE, trims_1.tempo_Fabrico as trims_1_TF,
		trims_2.tempo_Entm as trims_2_TE, trims_2.tempo_Fabrico as trims_2_TF,
		trims_3.tempo_Entm as trims_3_TE, trims_3.tempo_Fabrico as trims_3_TF,
		trims_4.tempo_Entm as trims_4_TE, trims_4.tempo_Fabrico as trims_4_TF,
		Mes_Menos_1.tempo_Entm as Mes_Menos_1_TE, Mes_Menos_1.tempo_Fabrico as Mes_Menos_1_TF,
		Mes.tempo_Entm as mes_TE, Mes.tempo_Fabrico as mes_TF
	from
	(select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		0 as mes,
		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data) as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id)
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
		inner join (select offp_of_id, cast(min(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt_Lam from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and offp_data_prevista is not null group by offp_of_id) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
		inner join (select trof_of_id, MIN(tr_data) as tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TR_DATA < GETDATE() group by trof_of_id) as x on OF_ID = x.TROF_OF_ID
	where 
		year(x.tr_data) = YEAR(getdate())
		and DATEPART(q, x.tr_data) = 1
		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
	group by 
		YEAR(x.tr_data),
		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME) as trims_1
	left join
	(select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		0 as mes,
		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data) as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id)
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
		inner join (select offp_of_id, cast(min(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt_Lam from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and offp_data_prevista is not null group by offp_of_id) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
		inner join (select trof_of_id, MIN(tr_data) as tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TR_DATA < GETDATE() group by trof_of_id) as x on OF_ID = x.TROF_OF_ID
	where 
		year(x.tr_data) = YEAR(getdate())
		and DATEPART(q, x.tr_data) = 2
		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
	group by 
		YEAR(x.tr_data),
		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME) as trims_2 on trims_1.id = trims_2.id
	left join
	(select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		0 as mes,
		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data) as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id)
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID

	group by

		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME) as trims_3 on trims_1.id = trims_3.id
	left join
	(select

		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data) as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,

		DATEPART(q, x.tr_data),

		TP_NOME) as trims_4 on trims_1.id = trims_4.id
	left join
	(select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		0 as mes,
		0 as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,

		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,

	from

		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID

	left join
	(select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		0 as mes,
		0 as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,

	from

		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID

	where

		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
	group by 
		YEAR(x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME) as ano_Menos_3 on trims_1.id = ano_Menos_3.id
	left join
	(select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		month(x.tr_data) as mes,
		0 as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id)
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina

		inner join (select offp_of_id, cast(min(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt_Lam from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and offp_data_prevista is not null group by offp_of_id) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
		inner join (select trof_of_id, MIN(tr_data) as tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TR_DATA < GETDATE() group by trof_of_id) as x on OF_ID = x.TROF_OF_ID
	where 
		year(x.tr_data) = YEAR(getdate())
		and month(x.tr_data) = month(getdate())
		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
	group by 
		YEAR(x.tr_data),
		month(x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME) as Mes on trims_1.id = Mes.id
	left join
	(select 
		YEAR(x.tr_data) as ano,
		month(x.tr_data) as mes,
		0 as trimestre,
		TP_ID as id,
		TP_NOME as nome,
		AVG(datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data)) as tempo_Entm,
		AVG(datediff(d,lam.dt_Lam,of_datafim)) as tempo_Fabrico
	from 
		dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id)
		inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = p_tp_id_disciplina
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on P_ID = OF_P_ID 
		inner join (select offp_of_id, cast(min(offp_data_prevista) as date) as dt_Lam from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 1 and offp_data_prevista is not null group by offp_of_id) as lam on of_id = lam.offp_of_id
		inner join (select trof_of_id, MIN(tr_data) as tr_data from TRANSP_OF inner join TRANSPORTE on TROF_TR_ID = TR_ID where TR_DATA < GETDATE() group by trof_of_id) as x on OF_ID = x.TROF_OF_ID
	where 
		year(x.tr_data) = YEAR(dateadd(m,-1,getdate()))
		and month(x.tr_data) = month(dateadd(m,-1,getdate()))
		and datediff(d,of_data,x.tr_data) < 180
		and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else TP_ID end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
	group by

		month(x.tr_data),
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME) as Mes_Menos_1 on trims_1.id = Mes_Menos_1.id
```

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_Procura_Agente_Pais] 
(	
	@p_id int, 
	@pais_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct
		case when ofs.agentes > 1 then 20680 else E_ID end as E_ID, 
		case when ofs.agentes > 1 then 'Andre Santos' else E_NOME end as E_NOME, 
		case when ofs.agentes > 1 then 'andre.santos@nelo.eu' else E_EMAIL end as E_EMAIL
	from 
		ENTIDADE 
		inner join ENT_TP_PROD on E_ID = ETP_E_ID 
		inner join PRODUTO on ETP_TP_ID = P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA 
		inner join (select 
						E_PAIS_ID as paisId,
						count(e_id) as agentes 
					from 
						ENTIDADE 
						inner join ENT_TP_PROD on E_ID = ETP_E_ID 
						inner join PRODUTO on ETP_TP_ID = P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA 
					group by 
						E_PAIS_ID) as ofs on E_PAIS_ID = ofs.paisId 
		where 
			E_ENT_ID = 2 
			and E_PAIS_ID = @pais_id 
			and P_ID = @p_id 
			and len(E_LOGIN) > 1
```

#### `dbo.fase_Erros_Dia`(@fp_id int, @dt date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-07-23 13:18 · modificado 2019-07-23 16:15* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

**Devolve:** `OF_ID` int, `OFFP_DATAFIM` smalldatetime, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO` smalldatetime, `OFCH_DESCR` nvarchar, `OFCH_ESTADO` int, `OFCH_GRAVIDADE` varchar(5), `ord` bigint

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fase_Erros_Dia] 
(	
	@fp_id int, @dt date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		OF_ID, OFFP_DATAFIM, P_NOME, E_ID, E_NOME, OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO, OFCH_DESCR, OFCH_ESTADO, (case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 'Baixo' when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 'Médio' else 'Alto' end) as OFCH_GRAVIDADE, ROW_NUMBER() over (Order by e_nome, OF_ID, ofch_descr) as ord
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
		INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
		INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR
		INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID AND OFFP_FP_ID = PLI_FP_ID 
		INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID AND OFFPEQ_CHEFE = PLI_CULPA_CHEFE
		INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
	WHERE
		CAST(OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO AS date) = @dt
		AND OFCH_ESTADO > 1
		and PLI_FP_ID = @fp_id
		and OFFP_RETURN = 0
)
```

#### `dbo.fase_OFs_Retornos`(@di date, @df date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-11-08 11:42* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

**Devolve:** `fpid` int, `ofs` int, `retornos` int, `ret_culpado` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fase_OFs_Retornos]
(	
	@di date,
	@df date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select fpMain.offp_fp_id as fpid, 
		sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as ofs, 
		sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as retornos, 
		sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = fpResp.offp_fp_id then 1 else 0 end) as ret_culpado
	from 
			of_fp as fpMain
			--left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
			--left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
			inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
			inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
			left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
			--left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpResp.offp_id = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id 			/* Chefe e Aj. retorno */
	where
			fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,37)) 
			and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between @di and @df
	group by fpMain.offp_fp_id
)
```

#### `dbo.fn_Report_ChecklistMatriz`(@dt_I date, @dt_F date, @fase int, @familias nvarchar(max), @semenal bit)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `producao`, `disciplina`

**Devolve:** `ano` int, `mes` int, `semana` int, `ofch_descr` nvarchar, `fp_id` int, `fp_nome` nvarchar, `eid` int, `func` nvarchar, `qtd` int, `ofch_estado` int, `tipo` varchar(12), `items` int, `ord` int, `ofch_gravidade` int, `ddtt` date

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_Report_ChecklistMatriz] 
(	
	@dt_I date, 
	@dt_F date,
	@fase int,
	@familias nvarchar(max),
	@semenal bit = 1
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		year((case when @fase = 8 then of_datafim else ofch_data_actualizacao end)) as ano,
		month((case when @fase = 8 then of_datafim else ofch_data_actualizacao end)) as mes,
		0 as semana,
		ofch_descr,
		fp.fp_id, 
		fp.fp_nome,  
		coalesce(f.eid,0) as eid, 
		coalesce(f.func,'') as func, 
		tot.qtd, 
		coalesce(ofch_estado,0) as ofch_estado, 
		(case 
			when ofch_estado = 1 then 'Ok' 
			when ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5) and ofch_gravidade = 1 then 'Ñ Ok - Baixo' 
			when ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5) and ofch_gravidade = 2 then 'Ñ Ok - Médio' 
			when ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5) and ofch_gravidade = 3 then 'Ñ Ok - Alto' 
			else 'Não revisto' end) as tipo, 
		count(ofch_id) as items,
		(case 
			when ofch_estado = 1 then 1 
			when ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5) and ofch_gravidade = 1 then 2 
			when ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5) and ofch_gravidade = 2 then 3
			when ofch_estado in (3,2,4,5) and ofch_gravidade = 3 then 4 
			else 5 end) as ord, ofch_gravidade,
		cast(dateadd(d,(day((case when @fase = 8 then of_datafim else ofch_data_actualizacao end))-1)*-1,(case when @fase = 8 then of_datafim else ofch_data_actualizacao end)) as date) as ddtt
	from ordemfabrico
```

#### `dbo.fornecedor_PedidosArmazem`(@e_id_responsavel int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-12-09 12:03 · modificado 2019-12-19 09:25*

**Devolve:** `mov_id` int, `e_id` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `mov_data` date, `previsao` date, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `uni_nome` nvarchar(100), `mov_quantidade` float, `mov_qtd_ent` float, `mov_id_pedido` int, `frn_uni` nvarchar(100), `pf_conversao` float, `responsavel` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fornecedor_PedidosArmazem]
(	
	@e_id_responsavel int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		m.mov_id, e.e_id, e.e_nome, cast(m.mov_data as date) as mov_data, cast(dateadd(day,e.e_prazoentrega,m.mov_data) as date) as previsao, p_id, p_nome, u.uni_nome, 
		round(m.mov_quantidade,2) as mov_quantidade, round(coalesce(sum(m1.mov_quantidade),0),2) as mov_qtd_ent, m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome as frn_uni, pf_conversao,
		e1.e_nome as responsavel
	from
		movimento as m 
		inner join produto on m.mov_p_id = p_id
		inner join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
		left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id 
		inner join unidade as u on p_uni_id = u.uni_id 
		inner join entidade as e on m.mov_e_id = e.e_id
		inner join produto_entidade on p_id = pf_p_id and pf_e_id = e_id 
		inner join unidade as u1 on pf_uni_id = u1.uni_id
		left join entidade as e1 on m.mov_e_id_responsavel = e1.e_id 
	where
		m.mov_tpmov_id = 9 
		and m.mov_satisfeito = 0 
		and (ARM_E_ID_RESP = @e_id_responsavel
			or ARM_E_ID_AJUD = @e_id_responsavel)
	group by
		m.mov_id, e.e_id, e.e_nome, m.mov_data, cast(dateadd(day,e.e_prazoentrega,m.mov_data) as date), p_id, p_nome, u.uni_nome, 
		round(m.mov_quantidade,2), m.mov_id_pedido, u1.uni_nome, pf_conversao,
		e1.e_nome
)
```

#### `dbo.fp_ListaBarcosEmFase`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-12-06 17:17 · modificado 2020-10-02 09:04* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `OF_ID` int, `P_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `OFFP_DATAINICIO` smalldatetime, `OFFP_DATAFIM` smalldatetime, `tempoEsperado` float, `decorrido` int, `completo` float, `ChefeId` int, `Chefe` nvarchar, `AjudanteId` int, `Ajudante` nvarchar, `OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA` smalldatetime, `OFFP_TURN_ID` int, `TR_DATA` date, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fp_ListaBarcosEmFase] 
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		OF_ID, P_ID, P_NOME, fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO, fp.OFFP_DATAFIM, 
		(case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 40 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome) else fp.OFFP_COEFICIENTE * FP_HORA_COEF end) * 60 as tempoEsperado,
		DATEDIFF(n,fp.offp_datainicio,getdate()) as decorrido,
		case when (case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 40 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome) else fp.OFFP_COEFICIENTE * FP_HORA_COEF end) * 60 = 0 then 0 else DATEDIFF(n,fp.offp_datainicio,getdate())/((case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 40 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome) else fp.OFFP_COEFICIENTE * FP_HORA_COEF end) * 60) end as completo, 
		fp.ChefeId, fp.Chefe, fp.AjudanteId, fp.Ajudante, fp.OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA, fp.OFFP_TURN_ID, TR_DATA, E_ID, E_NOME

	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		cross apply (select top 1 
							offp_of_id, OFFP_FP_ID, offp_datainicio, offp_datafim, offp_coeficiente, OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA,
							OFFP_TURN_ID, e.E_ID as ChefeId, e.E_NOME as Chefe, e1.E_ID as AjudanteId, e1.E_NOME as Ajudante 
						from 
							OF_FP 
							left join OFFP_EQ as fpeq on OFFP_ID = fpeq.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and fpeq.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 
							left join ENTIDADE as e on fpeq.OFFPEQ_E_ID = e.E_ID 
							left join OFFP_EQ as fpeq1 on OFFP_ID = fpeq1.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and fpeq1.OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 0 
							left join ENTIDADE as e1 on fpeq1.OFFPEQ_E_ID = e1.E_ID 
						where 
							OFFP_OF_ID = of_id 
							and OFFP_FP_ID = OF_FP_ID 
							and OFFP_DATAFIM is null 
						order by 
							OFFP_SEQUENCIA) as fp
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on fp.OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		left join TRANSPORTE on OF_TR_ID = tr_id
		inner join ENTIDADE on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID
	where
		OF_FP_ID = 40
		and of_id < 10000000 
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_Disponibilidade_Fase`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2020-01-29 10:25 · modificado 2020-01-29 11:26* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `EFP_FP_ID` int, `FP_NOME` nvarchar, `principal` bit, `atribuido` bit

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION funcionario_Disponibilidade_Fase 
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct
		E_ID,
		E_NOME,
		EFP_FP_ID,
		FP_NOME,
		cast(case when E_FP_ID <> EFP_FP_ID then 0 else 1 end as bit) as principal,
		cast(case when x.OFFP_FP_ID is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) as atribuido
	from 
		entidade 
		inner join ENTIDADE_FASE on e_id = EFP_E_ID
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on EFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
		left join (select distinct OFFP_FP_ID, OFFPEQ_E_ID from OF_FP inner join OFFP_EQ on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID where OFFP_DATAINICIO is null or (OFFP_DATAINICIO is not null and OFFP_DATAFIM is null)) as x on E_ID = x.OFFPEQ_E_ID and EFP_FP_ID = x.OFFP_FP_ID
		left join (select * from ENT_MOV inner join ENT_MOV_TIPO on MOVENT_MET_ID = MET_ID where MET_MET_ID = 2 or MOVENT_MET_ID = 15) as f on E_ID = f.MOVENT_E_ID and getdate() between MOVENT_DATA_I and MOVENT_DATA_F
	where 
		e_activo = 1 
		and EFP_DATAFIM is null
		and EFP_QUALIFICADO = 0
		--and x.OFFP_FP_ID is null
		and f.MOVENT_ID is null
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_Erros_Dia`(@e_id int, @dt date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-07-12 15:17 · modificado 2023-10-20 13:33* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

**Devolve:** `OF_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO` smalldatetime, `OFCH_DESCR` nvarchar, `OFCH_ESTADO` int, `OFCH_GRAVIDADE` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_Erros_Dia] 
(	
	@e_id int, @dt date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		OF_ID, P_NOME, E_ID, E_NOME, OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO, OFCH_DESCR, OFCH_ESTADO, OFCH_GRAVIDADE
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
		INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
		--inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
		--INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR and PLI_FP_ID = OFCH_FP_ID and PLI_FP_ID_CHK = OFCH_FP_ID_CHK
		INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OFFP_ID = OFCH_OFFP_ID_CULPA 
		INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
		INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
	WHERE
		CAST(OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO AS date) = @dt
		AND OFCH_ESTADO > 1
		and E_ID = @e_id
		and OFFP_RETURN = 0
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_Erros_Entre_DTs`(@e_id int, @dt_I date, @dt_F date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-11-08 13:17 · modificado 2023-10-20 13:33* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `OF_ID` int, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `OFCH_GRAVIDADE` int, `OFFP_COEFICIENTE` float, `PLI_FP_ID` int, `FP_HORA_COEF` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_Erros_Entre_DTs] 
(	
	@e_id int, @dt_I date, @dt_F date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, max(OFCH_GRAVIDADE) as OFCH_GRAVIDADE, OFFP_COEFICIENTE, OFFP_FP_ID PLI_FP_ID, FP_HORA_COEF
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
		INNER JOIN PRODUTO ON OF_P_ID = P_ID
		--inner join PRODUTO_LISTA on P_PL_ID = PL_ID
		--INNER JOIN PRODUTO_LISTA_ITEMS ON PL_ID = PLI_PL_ID and PLI_DESCR = OFCH_DESCR
		INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OFFP_ID = OFCH_OFFP_ID_CULPA  
		INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --AND (case when PLI_CULPA_CHEFE = 0 then OFFPEQ_CHEFE else 0 end) = 0
		INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
	WHERE
		CAST(OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO AS date) between @dt_I and @dt_F
		AND OFCH_ESTADO > 1
		and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 1
		and E_ID = @e_id
		and OFFP_RETURN = 0
		
	group by 
		OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE, OFFP_FP_ID, FP_HORA_COEF
	union
	select
		fp.OFFP_OF_ID as OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 2 else 3 end as OFCH_GRAVIDADE, fpLam.OFFP_COEFICIENTE, 36 as PLI_FP_ID, 1 as FP_HORA_COEF
	from
		OF_FP as fp
		inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
		inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
		inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
	where 
		cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between @dt_I and @dt_F
		and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)
		and E_ID = @e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horas_consumidas`(@di date, @df date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-11-16 16:44* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `qtd` float, `preco` float, `trb` numeric, `dif` numeric, `factor` numeric, `conta` int, `ofs` int, `ofspecas` int, `hOFs` numeric, `contaOFs` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horas_consumidas]
(	
	@di date, 
	@df date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		p.p_id, 
		p.p_nome, 
		round(sum(mov_quantidade),0) as qtd,  
		preco, 
		0.0 as trb,
		0.0 as dif, 
		1.0 as factor, 
		1 as conta,
		isnull(n,0) as ofs,
		isnull(nPecas,0) as ofspecas,
		0.0 as hOFs,
		0 as contaOFs
	from 
		produto p
		inner join movimento on p.p_id = mov_p_id 
		/********************************/
		left join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = OF_ID and OF_P_ID not in (44989, 45060, 45059, 45061, 28016, 45873)
		--inner join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = p1.P_ID
		--inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p1.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		/*******************************/
		cross apply 
		 (select top 1 mov_data as dt, mov_p_id as id, mov_precounitario as preco
		  from movimento 
		  where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_datasaida is not null and p.p_id = mov_p_id
		  order by mov_data desc) as mvs
		left join (select fp_p_id as idp, count(distinct offp_of_id) as n, sum(case when offp_of_id >= 10000000 then 1 else 0 end) nPecas 
				from 
					of_fp 
					inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
					/********************************/
					inner join ORDEMFABRICO on OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID and OF_P_ID not in (44989, 45060, 45059, 45061, 28016, 45873)
					--inner join produto on OF_P_ID = P_ID
					--inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
					/*******************************/
				where 
					offp_datafim between @di and @df 
					and offp_return = 0 
					/********************************/
					--and OFFP_OF_ID < case when OFFP_FP_ID = 1 then 10000000 else 50000000 end 
					--and tp_nome not like case when OFFP_FP_ID = 1 then 'parceria%' else '' end
					/********************************/
					group by fp_p_id) as o on  p.p_id = o.idp					
	where 
		p.p_tp_id = 90 
		and mov_data between @di and @df 
		and mov_tpmov_id in (11, 2) 
		/********************************/
		--and MOV_OF_ID < case when MOV_P_ID = 20794 then 10000000 else 50000000 end
		--and tp_nome not like case when MOV_P_ID = 20794 then 'parceria%' else '' end
		/********************************/
	group by 
		p.p_id, p.p_nome, preco, n, nPecas
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horas_consumidas_v2`(@di date, @df date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2023-11-20 11:26 · modificado 2023-11-20 12:00* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `qtd` float, `qtdParc` float, `preco` float, `trb` numeric, `dif` numeric, `factor` numeric, `conta` int, `ofs` int, `ofsParc` int, `ofspecas` int, `hOFs` numeric, `contaOFs` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horas_consumidas_v2]
(	
	@di date, 
	@df date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		p.p_id, 
		p.p_nome, 
		round(sum(case when tp_nome not like 'Parceria%' or tp_nome is null then mov_quantidade else 0 end),0) as qtd,
		round(sum(case when tp_nome like 'Parceria%' then mov_quantidade else 0 end),0) as qtdParc,  
		preco, 
		0.0 as trb,
		0.0 as dif, 
		1.0 as factor, 
		1 as conta,
		isnull(n,0) as ofs,
		isnull(nParc,0) as ofsParc,
		isnull(nPecas,0) as ofspecas,
		0.0 as hOFs,
		0 as contaOFs
	from 
		produto p
		inner join movimento on p.p_id = mov_p_id 
		/********************************/
		left join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = OF_ID and OF_P_ID not in (44989, 45060, 45059, 45061, 28016, 45873)
		left join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = p1.P_ID
		left join PRODUTO_TIPO on p1.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		/*******************************/
		cross apply 
		 (select top 1 mov_data as dt, mov_p_id as id, mov_precounitario as preco
		  from movimento 
		  where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_datasaida is not null and p.p_id = mov_p_id
		  order by mov_data desc) as mvs
		left join (select
					fp_p_id as idp, 
					sum(case when tp_nome like 'Parceria%' then 1 else 0 end) nParc,
					sum(case when tp_nome not like 'Parceria%' then 1 else 0 end) as n, 
					sum(case when offp_of_id >= 10000000 then 1 else 0 end) nPecas 
				from 
					of_fp 
					inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
					/********************************/
					inner join ORDEMFABRICO on OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID and OF_P_ID not in (44989, 45060, 45059, 45061, 28016, 45873)
					inner join produto on OF_P_ID = P_ID
					inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
					/*******************************/
				where 
					offp_datafim between @di and @df 
					and offp_return = 0 
					/********************************/
					--and OFFP_OF_ID < case when OFFP_FP_ID = 1 then 10000000 else 50000000 end 
					--and tp_nome not like case when OFFP_FP_ID = 1 then 'parceria%' else '' end
					/********************************/
					group by 
						fp_p_id) as o on  p.p_id = o.idp
	where 
		p.p_tp_id = 90 
		and mov_data between @di and @df 
		and mov_tpmov_id in (11, 2) 
		/********************************/
		--and MOV_OF_ID < case when MOV_P_ID = 20794 then 10000000 else 50000000 end
		--and tp_nome not like case when MOV_P_ID = 20794 then 'parceria%' else '' end
		/********************************/
	group by 
		p.p_id, p.p_nome, preco, n, nPecas, nParc
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horas_produtivas`(@di date, @df date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-10-09 17:02* · 🔎 `producao`

**Devolve:** `ent_nome` nvarchar, `fp_id` int, `fp_nome` nvarchar, `e_nome` nvarchar, `hTeoricas` int, `faltas` float, `hExtra` float, `hAjuda` float, `total` float, `conta` int, `contaOFs` int, `fp_p_id` int, `Contribuinte` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horas_produtivas]
(	
	@di date, 
	@df date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		ent_nome, fp_id, fp_nome, e_nome, 
		isnull(dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(dbo.maximo_dt(@di, e_dataentrada), @df),0) as hTeoricas,
		isnull(sum(faltas),0.0) + isnull(sum(ferias),0.0) + (case when E_DATAENTRADA < '2023-08-01' then 144 else 0 end) + isnull(sum(Baixas),0.0) as faltas, 
		isnull(sum(hExtra),0.0) as hExtra, 
		isnull(sum(hAjuda),0.0) as hAjuda/*, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas*/, 
		isnull(dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(dbo.maximo_dt(@di, e_dataentrada), @df) + sum(isnull(hExtra,0.0) - isnull(faltas,0.0) - (case when E_DATAENTRADA < '2023-08-01' then 144 else 0 end) + isnull(hAjuda,0.0)),0) - isnull(sum(ferias),0.0) - isnull(sum(Baixas),0.0) as total, 
		1 as conta, 
		0 as contaOFs, 
		fp_p_id,
		e_contribuinte Contribuinte
	from 
		entidade 
		left join dbo.funcionario_movimentos(@di, @df, null) fm on fm.movent_eid = e_id 
		inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id 
		inner join entidade_tipo on e_ent_id = ent_id 
	where 
		e_activo = 1 and ent_ent_id = 19 
	group by 
		ent_nome, 
		fp_id, 
		fp_nome, 
		e_nome, 
		e_dataentrada, 
		fp_p_id,
		e_contribuinte 
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horasPerdidas`(@dI date, @dF date, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `producao`

**Devolve:** `fp_nome` nvarchar, `e_nome` nvarchar, `data` date, `hPerd` int, `movent_observacoes` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horasPerdidas] 
(	
	@dI date,
	@dF date,
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		isnull(fp_nome,'') as fp_nome, e_nome, cast(movent_data_i as date) as data, (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) as hPerd, movent_observacoes
	from 
		ent_mov left join fases_producao on movent_fp_id = fp_id inner join entidade on movent_e_id = e_id
	where 
		movent_met_id = 12 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between @dI and @dF and movent_e_id = @e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasBarco`(@di1 date, @df1 date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `retorno`

**Devolve:** `eid` int, `func` nvarchar, `of_id` int, `fp_nome` nvarchar, `extPint` numeric, `extDesm` float, `coefFase` float, `hProdBarco` float, `nFunc` int, `of_referencia` nvarchar, `offp_observacoes` nvarchar, `offp_problemas` nvarchar, `offp_return` bit, `cliente` nvarchar, `modelo` nvarchar, `fp_hora_coef` float, `culpado` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horasTeoricasBarco]
(	
	@di1 date,
	@df1 date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		e.e_id as eid, e.e_nome as func, of_id, fp_nome,
		(case when o.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 when of_pfora_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 4 when of_pfora_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 8 else 0 end) as extPint,
		(case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) as extDesm,
		o.offp_coeficiente as coefFase,
		--(((case when o.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then o.offp_coeficiente + 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then of_coeficiente + 0.1 
		--		when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then o.offp_coeficiente+ 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then o.offp_coeficiente+ 0.2
		--		when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 when of_pfora_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 4 when of_pfora_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 8 else o.offp_coeficiente end) + 
		--			(case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)) / (case when eq1.offpeq_e_id is null then 1 else 2 end)) * fp_hora_coef
		round(cast((case when o.offp_return = 1 and eqRtn.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
			when o.offp_return = 1 and eqRtn.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(o.offp_datainicio, o.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when o.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + o.offp_coeficiente))
			else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
		* ((case when o.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
			when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
			when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and o.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
		+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
		+ o.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3) * fp_hora_coef as hProdBarco,
		(case when eq1.offpeq_e_id is null then 1 else 2 end) as nFunc, of_referencia, o.offp_observacoes, o.offp_problemas, o.offp_return, e1.e_nome as cliente, p_nome as modelo, fp_hora_coef, (case when eqRtn.offpeq_e_id is null then 0 else 1 end) as culpado
	from 
		of_fp as o 
		inner join ordemfabrico on o.offp_of_id = of_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		left join offp_eq as eq on o.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join offp_eq as eq1 on o.offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 0 
		left join entidade as e on eq.offpeq_e_id = e.e_id or eq1.offpeq_e_id = e.e_id
		left join entidade as e1 on of_e_id_enc = e1.e_id
		inner join fases_producao on o.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on o.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		--left join  (select 
		--					Funcionario, Fase, sum(rtns) as rtns, sum(case when culpado = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as culpado, sum(coefs) as coef_Return 
		--				from 
		--					dbo.retornosFuncionario 
		--				where 
		--					cast(dataRep as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date) 
		--				group by 
		--					Funcionario, Fase) as rt on isnull(e.e_id,1) = isnull(Funcionario,1) and fp_id = Fase
		left join of_fp as rtn on o.offp_offp_id_return = rtn.offp_id left join offp_eq as eqRtn on rtn.offp_id = eqRtn.offpeq_offp_id and (eqRtn.offpeq_e_id = e.e_id or eqRtn.offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id)
	where 
		o.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(o.offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal`(@di1 date, @df1 date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

**Devolve:** `eid` int, `hProdTotal` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal]
(	
	@di1 date,
	@df1 date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		e_id as eid,
		sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
			when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))
			else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
		* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
			when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
			when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
		+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
		+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3) * fp_hora_coef) as hProdTotal
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id 			/* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join offp_eq as eqResp1 on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp1.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp1.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
	where 
		fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between @di1 and @df1
	group by 
		e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade`(@di1 date, @df1 date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-11-19 10:36* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

**Devolve:** `eid` int, `hProdTotal` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade]
(	
	@di1 date,
	@df1 date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		e_id as eid,
		sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
				when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
			* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
				when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
				when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
			+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
			+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3) * fp_hora_coef) as hProdTotal
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id 			/* Chefe e Aj. retorno */
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
	where 
		fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between @di1 and @df1
	group by 
		e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_V2`(@di1 date, @df1 date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

**Devolve:** `eid` int, `hProdTotal` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_V2]
(	
	@di1 date,
	@df1 date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		e_id as eid,
		sum(
			case 
			when fpMain.offp_fp_id = 40 and fpMain.offp_return = 0 then dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)
			when fpMain.offp_fp_id = 40 and fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id then 0
			when fpMain.offp_fp_id = 40 and fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p_nome)*(0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)))
			else round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																			0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																			((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																			when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																			when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																					+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))
							else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
						* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
							when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
							when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
						+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
						+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3) * fp_hora_coef
		end
		) as hProdTotal
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id-- and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id		/* Chefe e Aj. retorno */and eqResp.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join offp_eq as eqResp1 on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp1.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp1.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
	where 
		fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between @di1 and @df1
	group by 
		e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_ListaActivos`()

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- Description:	<Description,,>

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_ListaActivos] 
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		e.e_id, ent_nome, e.e_nome, pe.nome as e_nome_phc, fp_nome, e1.e_nome as ajud, e.e_telefone, e.e_morada, e.e_datanascimento, e.e_contribuinte, e.e_tv_id, e.e_dataentrada,

		left join fases_producao on e.e_fp_id = fp_id left join entidade as e1 on e.e_e_id = e1.e_id
	where

)
```
