#### `dbo.funcionario_ListaFases_SemPrincipal`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-05-15 09:57 · modificado 2025-05-15 14:48* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `FuncionarioId` int, `FuncionarioNome` nvarchar, `FasePrincipalId` int, `FasePrincipal` nvarchar, `FaseHistId` int, `FaseHistNome` nvarchar, `FaseHistSequencia` int, `ultimo` date

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION funcionario_ListaFases_SemPrincipal 
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		e_id FuncionarioId, e_nome FuncionarioNome, fpMain.fp_id FasePrincipalId, fpMain.FP_NOME FasePrincipal, fp.fp_id FaseHistId, fp.fp_nome FaseHistNome, fp.fp_sequencia FaseHistSequencia, cast(max(offp_datafim) as date) ultimo
	from
		entidade
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpMain on E_FP_ID = fpMain.FP_ID
		inner join offp_eq on e_id = offpeq_e_id
		inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on offp_fp_id = fp.fp_id-- and e_fp_id <> OFFP_FP_ID
	where
		offp_datafim >= '2024/01/01'
		and e_activo = 1
		and fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
	group by
		e_id, e_nome, fpMain.fp_id, fpMain.FP_NOME, fp.fp_id, fp.fp_nome, fp.fp_sequencia
	--order by 
	--	e_nome, fp.fp_sequencia
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_movimentos`(@di date, @df date, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-11-23 14:37*

**Devolve:** `movent_eId` int, `movent_fpId` int, `faltas` float, `Baixas` float, `ferias` float, `hExtra` float, `hAjuda` float, `hPerdidas` float, `hBanco` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_movimentos]
(	
	@di date,
	@df date,
	@e_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		(case when movent_met_id = 13 then movent_e_e_id else movent_e_id end) as movent_eId, 
		movent_fp_id as movent_fpId,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id in (4,/*5,*/6) and dtrb_data is not null 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float) as faltas,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id in (7,8,9) and dtrb_data is not null 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float) as Baixas,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 10 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float) as ferias,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 1 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float) as hExtra,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 13 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float) as hAjuda,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 12 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float) as hPerdidas,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 15 -- A dever 
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) * -1 end) 
					when movent_met_id = 16 -- A haver
						then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60.0 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) 
					else 0 end)/60.0 as float) as hBanco
	from
		ent_mov left join dias_trabalho on cast(movent_data_i as date) = cast(dtrb_data as date)
	where 
		movent_met_id in (/*Faltas:*/ 4,5,6,7,8,9,10,/*H Ext.:*/ 1,/*H Ajuda.:*/ 13,/*H Perdidas.:*/ 12,/*Banco de horas:*/15,16) and cast(movent_data_i as date) between @di and @df 
		and (case when @e_id is not null then movent_e_id else 1 end) = (case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end)
	group by 
		(case when movent_met_id = 13 then movent_e_e_id else movent_e_id end), movent_fp_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos`(@di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-11-23 14:37*

**Devolve:** `Ano` int, `Mes` int, `movent_eId` int, `movent_fpId` int, `faltas` float, `baixas` float, `ferias` float, `hExtra` float, `hAjuda` float, `hPerdidas` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_movimentos_minutos]
(	
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@e_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select year(movent_data_i) as Ano, month(movent_data_i) as Mes,
		(case when movent_met_id = 13 then movent_e_e_id else movent_e_id end) as movent_eId, movent_fp_id as movent_fpId,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id in (4,/*5,*/6) /*and dtrb_data is not null*/ then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) else 0 end) as float) as faltas,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id in (7,8,9) /*and dtrb_data is not null*/ then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) else 0 end) as float) as baixas,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 10 /*and dtrb_data is not null*/ then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) else 0 end) as float) as ferias,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 1 then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, dbo.minimo_dt(movent_data_f, @df))-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, dbo.minimo_dt(movent_data_f, @df)) end) else 0 end) as float) as hExtra,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 13 then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, dbo.minimo_dt(movent_data_f, @df))-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, dbo.minimo_dt(movent_data_f, @df)) end) else 0 end) as float) as hAjuda,
		cast(sum(case when movent_met_id = 12 then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>=13 then datediff(n,movent_data_i, dbo.minimo_dt(movent_data_f, @df))-60 else datediff(n,movent_data_i, dbo.minimo_dt(movent_data_f, @df)) end) else 0 end) as float) as hPerdidas
	from
		ent_mov left join dias_trabalho on cast(movent_data_i as date) = cast(dtrb_data as date)
	where 
		movent_met_id in (/*Faltas:*/ 4,5,6,7,8,9,10,/*H Ext.:*/ 1,/*H Ajuda.:*/ 13,/*H Perdidas.:*/ 12) 
		and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@di as date) and cast(@df as date) 
		and (case when @e_id is not null then movent_e_id else 1 end) = (case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end)
	group by 
		year(movent_data_i), month(movent_data_i), (case when movent_met_id = 13 then movent_e_e_id else movent_e_id end), movent_fp_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_pecas`(@fp int, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-02-16 15:01* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `tp_id` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `prodf_id` int, `p_imagem` nvarchar, `prodf_fp_id` int, `fp_nome` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_pecas]
(	
	@fp int,
	@e_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		distinct tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, prodf_id, p_imagem, prodf_fp_id, fp_nome
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		inner join produto on tp_id = p_tp_id 
		inner join produto_fase on p_id = prodf_p_id 
		inner join fases_producao on prodf_fp_id = fp_id
		left join lista_produto on p_id = lp_p_id 
		left join entidade on lp_l_id = e_l_id
	where 
		prodf_fp_id = @fp 
		and tp_tp_id not in (select tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1) a inner join INTERVALO on a.tp_id = INTERVALO_TP_ID and INTERVALO_INICIO < 10000000) 
		--and (case when @e_id is null then 1 else e_id end) = isnull(@e_id, 1) 
		and prodf_data_eliminado is null
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_PedidosActivos`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-09-24 16:52 · modificado 2021-12-09 14:58* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

**Devolve:** `MOV_ID` int, `TP_ID` int, `TP_NOME` nvarchar, `P_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `UNI_NOME` nvarchar(100), `qtd` float, `P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR` float

```sql
-- =============================================

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_PedidosActivos]
(	
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		MOV_ID, TP_ID, TP_NOME, P_ID, P_NOME, UNI_NOME, MOV_QUANTIDADE * P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR as qtd, P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR

)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_PicagensDia`(@data date, @e_id int)

#### `dbo.funcionario_PresencasINNUX`(@data date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-10-28 11:05*

**Devolve:** `e_id` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `tot` numeric, `hExtra` float, `tempoTotal` float, `faltas` float, `passagens` bigint, `PontoMin` smalldatetime, `PontoMax` smalldatetime, `TermMin` smalldatetime, `TermMax` smalldatetime

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_PresencasINNUX]
(	
	@data date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		e_id,
		e_nome, 
		sum(Conta) as tot, 
		isnull(y.hExtra,0.0)/60.0 as hExtra, 
		isnull(sum(Conta),0) - (isnull(y.hExtra,0.0)/60.0) as tempoTotal, 
		isnull(y.faltas,0.0)/60.0 as faltas, 
		isnull(max(rNum),0) as passagens, 
		min(picos) as PontoMin, 
		(case when max(proxPico) > min(picos) then max(proxPico) else null end) as PontoMax, 
		t.DataMin as TermMin, 
		(case when t.DataMax > t.DataMin then t.DataMax else null end) as TermMax
	from
	(select m.[IDFuncionario], 
		e_id, e_nome, 
		cast(m.[Data] + m.[Hora] as smalldatetime) as picos,
		x.proxPico, 
		datediff(n, cast(m.[Data] + m.[Hora] as smalldatetime), x.proxPico) as minutos, 
		datediff(n, cast(m.[Data] + m.[Hora] as smalldatetime), x.proxPico)/60.0 as horas,
		(case when ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e_nome ORDER BY cast(m.[Data] + m.[Hora] as smalldatetime) ASC)%2 = 0 then 0.0 else datediff(n, cast(m.[Data] + m.[Hora] as smalldatetime), x.proxPico)/60.0 end) as Conta, 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e_nome ORDER BY cast(m.[Data] + m.[Hora] as smalldatetime) ASC) as rNum
	FROM 	 
		entidade
		inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on e_id = f.[Numero]  and f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] is not null --and f.[IDPlanoTrabalho] in (3,4)
		left join [Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m on m.[IDFuncionario] = f.[IDFuncionario] and cast(m.[Data] as date) = @data
		outer apply (select top 1
						cast(m1.[Data] + m1.[Hora] as smalldatetime) as proxPico
					from
						[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoes] as m1
					where	
						cast(m1.[Data] as date) = cast(m.[Data] as date) and cast(m1.[Data] + m1.[Hora] as smalldatetime) > cast(m.[Data] + m.[Hora] as smalldatetime) and m1.[IDFuncionario] = m.[IDFuncionario]) as x
	where	
		e_activo = 1) as x
	left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(hExtra) as hExtra from dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(@data,@data,null) group by movent_eId) as y on e_id = y.movent_eId
	left join (select 
					[IDFuncionario], min(cast([Data] + [Hora] as smalldatetime)) as DataMin, max(cast([Data] + [Hora] as smalldatetime)) as DataMax 
				from 
					[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoesAcesso]
				where 
					cast([Data] as date) = @data
				group by 
					[IDFuncionario]) as t on x.[IDFuncionario] = t.[IDFuncionario]
	group by 
		e_id, e_nome, y.hExtra, t.DataMin, t.DataMax, y.faltas
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_Resumo_HExtra_Ferias_BHoras`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-11-23 13:18* · 🔎 `custo`

**Devolve:** `HExtra` float, `HExtra_MesAnt` float, `Ferias` float, `horas` float, `E_ISENCAO_HORARIO` bit, `SaldoHE` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_Resumo_HExtra_Ferias_BHoras] 
(	
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		round(isnull(he.horas,0),2) as HExtra,
		round(isnull(he_Ant.horas,0),2) as HExtra_MesAnt,
		isnull(ferias.dias,0) as Ferias,
		round(isnull(dbo.funcionario_BancoHoras_Saldo(@e_id),0),2) as horas,
		E_ISENCAO_HORARIO,
		case when E_ISENCAO_HORARIO = 1 then isnull(zx.MOVENT_CC,0)/E_CUSTOHORA/2 else 0 end SaldoHE		
	from
		entidade 
		outer apply (select top 1 MOVENT_CC from ENT_MOV where MOVENT_MET_ID = 11 and MOVENT_E_ID = E_ID order by MOVENT_DATA_PAG desc) zx
		left join 
		(select 
				movent_eId, 
				'Horas Extra' as tipo,
				sum(hExtra) / 60 as horas
			from 
				dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(cast(cast(dateadd(D, (datepart(DAY,getdate())-1)*-1,getdate()) as date) as smalldatetime),GETDATE(),@e_id)
			group by movent_eId) as he on e_id = he.movent_eId
		left join 
		(select 
				movent_eId, 
				'Horas Extra' as tipo,
				sum(hExtra) / 60 as horas
			from 
				dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(cast(cast(dateadd(month, -1, dateadd(D, (datepart(DAY,getdate())-1)*-1,getdate())) as date) as smalldatetime),cast(cast(dateadd(D, (datepart(DAY,getdate()))*-1,getdate()) as date) as smalldatetime) + cast('1900/01/01 23:59:00' as smalldatetime),@e_id)
			group by movent_eId) as he_Ant on e_id = he_Ant.movent_eId
		left join 
		(select 
				movent_eId, 
				'Férias' as tipo,
				sum(ferias) / 480 as dias
			from 
				dbo.funcionario_movimentos_minutos(dateadd(D, (datepart(DAYOFYEAR,getdate())-1)*-1,getdate()),GETDATE(),@e_id)
			group by 
				movent_eId) as ferias on e_id = ferias.movent_eId
	where 
		E_ID = @e_id
)
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_UltimosProdutosPedidos`(@e_id int, @desde smalldatetime)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-09-12 16:50 · modificado 2019-09-16 14:13* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

**Devolve:** `tp_id` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `UNI_NOME` nvarchar(100), `ultQtd` float, `conversao` float, `P_IMAGEM` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_UltimosProdutosPedidos]
(	
	@e_id int,
	@desde smalldatetime
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct 
		tp_id, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, UNI_NOME, uQ.ultQtd * P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR as ultQtd, P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR as conversao, P_IMAGEM
	from 
		MOVIMENTO 
		inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID 
		cross apply (select top 1 MOV_QUANTIDADE as ultQtd from MOVIMENTO where MOV_P_ID = P_ID and MOV_E_ID = @e_id and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 2 order by MOV_DATA desc) as uQ
		left join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID_MOVIMENTOS = UNI_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = tp_id
	where 
		MOV_DATA >= @desde
		and MOV_E_ID = @e_id
)
```

```sql
		of_nome,
		of_observacoes,
		offp_observacoes,
		offp_problemas,
		cast(Round(datediff(hh,dt.fimAnterior, getdate()) / 24.0,0) as int) haDias,
		eChefe.e_id funciomnarioId,
		isnull(eChefe.e_nome,'') funciomnario,
		eAjud.e_id funciomnarioIdAjud,
		isnull(eAjud.e_nome,'') funciomnarioAjud,
		offp_datainicio
	from
		Ordemfabrico
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join of_fp offp on of_id = offp_of_id
		left join offp_eq eqChefe on offp_id = eqChefe.offpeq_offp_id and eqChefe.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join entidade eChefe on eqChefe.offpeq_e_id = eChefe.e_id
		left join offp_eq eqAjud on offp_id = eqAjud.offpeq_offp_id and eqAjud.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join entidade eAjud on eqAjud.offpeq_e_id = eAjud.e_id
		outer apply (select max(offp_datafim) fimAnterior from of_fp where offp_of_id = of_id) dt
	where
		offp_fp_id = 14
		and offp_datafim is null
		and of_id between 70000 and 79999
)
```

#### `dbo.Innux_EntradaBalneario_ForaDeHoras`(@dt_i date, @dt_f date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-07-31 15:32 · modificado 2019-07-31 15:32*

**Devolve:** `ent_nome` nvarchar, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `dt` datetime

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION Innux_EntradaBalneario_ForaDeHoras 
(	
	@dt_i date, @dt_f date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		ent_nome, E_ID, E_NOME, tm.Data + tm.Hora as dt
	from
		[Innux].[dbo].[TerminaisMarcacoesAcesso] as tm
		inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Terminais] as t on tm.IDTerminal = t.IDTerminal
		inner join [Innux].[dbo].[Funcionarios] as f on tm.IDFuncionario = f.IDFuncionario
		inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].[dbo].ENTIDADE on f.Numero = E_ID
		inner join [MAR-KAYAKS].[dbo].ENTIDADE_TIPO on E_ENT_ID = ENT_ID
	where
		tm.Data between @dt_i and @dt_f
		and tm.IDTerminal = 4
		and (tm.Hora between '08:30:00' and '09:42:00'
			or tm.Hora between '10:12:00' and '11:58:00'
			or tm.Hora between '13:10:00' and '14:42:00'
			or tm.Hora between '15:12:00' and '19:58:00')
)
```

#### `dbo.inventario_ListaPedidosProduto`(@p_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-08-05 09:13 · modificado 2024-07-23 09:26* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `OrdFab` nvarchar, `Modelo` nvarchar, `Cliente` nvarchar, `DataLam` smalldatetime, `Quantidade` float, `Estado` nvarchar, `Sai` nvarchar, `Origem` nvarchar, `mov_id` int, `mov_atrib_id` int, `atrib_nome` nvarchar, `mov_mov_id` int, `transporte` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[inventario_ListaPedidosProduto]
(	
	@p_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		cast(coalesce(of_id, ped_id) as nvarchar(max)) as OrdFab, 
		isnull(p.p_nome + isnull(' (' + ATRIB_NOME_PT + ')',''), 'Pedido: ' + isnull(PED_SHOP_ORDER_ID, '')) as Modelo,
		isnull(e.e_nome, ePed.e_nome) as Cliente,
		of_datainicio as DataLam,
		mov.mov_quantidade as Quantidade,
		isnull(fp.fp_nome,'') as Estado,
		(case when fp1.fp_nome is null then fp2.fp_nome else fp1.fp_nome end) as Sai,
		(case when p1.p_nome is null or p1.P_ID = p.P_ID then '' else p1.p_nome end) as Origem,
		mov.mov_id, mov.mov_atrib_id, isnull(ATRIB_NOME_PT,'') atrib_nome, mov.mov_mov_id,
		cast(tr_data as nvarchar(max)) + ' - ' + tr_descricao transporte
	from
		PEDIDOS 
		inner join entidade ePed on PED_E_ID = ePed.E_ID
		inner join movimento as mov on PED_ID = mov.MOV_ID_PEDIDO and PED_E_ID = MOV_E_ID
		left join ordemfabrico on OF_ID = PED_OF_ID and PED_E_ID = 19747
		left join produto as p on of_p_id = p.p_id 
		left join entidade e on of_e_id_enc = e.e_id and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747
		left join fases_producao as fp on of_fp_id = fp.fp_id 
		left join produto as p2 on mov.mov_p_id = p2.p_id 
		left join produto_tipo as tp1 on p2.p_tp_id = tp1.tp_id 
		left join fases_producao as fp2 on tp1.tp_fp_id = fp2.fp_id 
		left join movimento as mov1 on mov.mov_mov_id = mov1.mov_id 
		left join produto as p1 on mov1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id 
		left join produto_tipo as tp on p1.p_tp_id = tp.tp_id 
		left join fases_producao as fp1 on tp.tp_fp_id = fp1.fp_id
		left join ATRIBUTO on mov.MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
		left join transporte on OF_TR_ID = TR_ID
	where 
		mov.mov_p_id = @p_id
		and mov.mov_tpmov_id = 12
		and mov.MOV_SATISFEITO = 0
)
```

#### `dbo.of_Acessorios_Preparacao_old`(@of_id int, @arm_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-12-20 15:09 · modificado 2020-03-23 09:00* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `reparac`

**Devolve:** `MOV_ID` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `mov_quantidade` float, `P_ARM_ID` int, `ARM_NOME` nvarchar, `of_id` int, `MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL` bit

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Acessorios_Preparacao]
(	
	@of_id int, 
	@arm_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct
		MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome,
		mov_quantidade,
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join MOVIMENTO on OF_ID = MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO p on MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE as pc on (pc.COMP_P_ID = OF_P_ID or COMP_L_ID = p1.P_L_ID) and (pc.COMP_P_P_ID = p.P_ID or pc.COMP_ATRIB_ID = MOV_ATRIB_ID)
		left join ARMAZEM on p.P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
	where
		MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and pc.COMP_FP_ID = 46
		and p.P_TEM_STOCK = 1
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else p.P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)
	union
	select distinct
		MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p_id,
		p_nome,
		mov_quantidade,
		P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join MOVIMENTO on OF_ID = MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
	where
		MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)
)
```

#### `dbo.of_AcessoriosPrincipais`(@of_id int, @extra bit)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-10-25 14:54* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`

**Devolve:** `mov_p_id` int, `mov_quantidade` float, `tp_id` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_nome` nvarchar, `atrib_id` int, `atrib_nome_pt` nvarchar, `p_imagem` nvarchar, `p_tem_stock` bit, `p_stock` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_AcessoriosPrincipais] 
(	
	@of_id int,
	@extra bit
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		mov_p_id, mov_quantidade, tp_id, tp_nome, p_nome, atrib_id, atrib_nome_pt, p_imagem, p_tem_stock, (case when p_tem_stock = 0 then 0 else round(coalesce(ent.total,0) - coalesce(said.total,0),2) end) as p_stock
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left join atributo on mov_atrib_id = atrib_id
		left join (select mov_p_id as pId, sum(mov_quantidade) as total from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.pId 
		left join (select mov_p_id as pId, sum(mov_quantidade) as total from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as said on p_id = said.pId
	where 
		(case when @extra = 0 then mov_atrib_id else 1 end) is not null
		 and (case when @extra = 0 then atrib_familia_en else '' end) <> 'Design'
		and mov_acessorio_adicional = @extra 
		and mov_of_id = @of_id
)
```

```sql
-- =============================================

-- Description:	<Description,,>

(	
	@of_id int
)

AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		const.p_id IdConstrucao, const.p_nome Construcao, prod.p_id IdProduto, prod.p_nome Produto, mProds.mov_quantidade QtdOf, pc.comp_id
	from
		movimento mConst
		inner join produto const on mConst.mov_p_id = const.p_id
		inner join movimento mProds on mConst.mov_id = mProds.mov_mov_id
		inner join produto prod on mProds.mov_p_id = prod.p_id

	where

		and mConst.mov_of_id = @of_id
```

#### `dbo.of_AlteracoesConstrucao_Comparacao_SEMANAL`(@data date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-02-05 10:52 · modificado 2025-02-05 13:45* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `custo`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `OfId` int, `Preco` varchar(8), `idConst` int, `Constrtucao` nvarchar, `Tipo` nvarchar, `idProduto` int, `Produto` nvarchar, `Unidade` nvarchar(100), `Qtd` float, `PrecoCusto` float, `DataLam` date

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION of_AlteracoesConstrucao_Comparacao_SEMANAL
(	
	@data date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		mConst.mov_of_id OfId, 'OF' Preco, pConst.p_id idConst, pConst.p_nome Constrtucao, tp_nome Tipo, pProds.p_id idProduto, pProds.p_nome Produto, uni_nome Unidade, mProds.mov_quantidade Qtd, pProds.p_precocusto PrecoCusto, cast(offp_data_prevista as date) DataLam
	from
		movimento mConst 
		inner join of_fp on mov_of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id in (1,67)
		inner join produto pConst on mConst.mov_p_id = pConst.p_id 
		inner join movimento mProds on mConst.mov_id = mProds.mov_mov_id
		inner join produto pProds on mProds.mov_p_id = pProds.p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on pProds.p_tp_id = tp_id
		inner join unidade on pProds.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where
		year(offp_data_prevista) = year(@data)
		and datepart(week,offp_data_prevista) = datepart(week,@data)
		and pConst.p_tp_id = 84
		and pProds.p_tp_id <> 288 /*Resina*/
	union all
	select
		mConst.mov_of_id OfId, 'Standard' Preco, pConst.p_id idConst, pConst.p_nome Constrtucao, tp_nome Tipo, pProds.p_id idProduto, pProds.p_nome Produto, uni_nome Unidade, comp_quantidade Qtd, pProds.p_precocusto PrecoCusto, cast(offp_data_prevista as date) DataLam
	from
		movimento mConst 
		inner join of_fp on mov_of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id in (1,67)
		inner join produto pConst on mConst.mov_p_id = pConst.p_id 
		inner join produto_componente on pConst.p_id = comp_p_id
		inner join produto pProds on comp_p_p_id = pProds.p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on pProds.p_tp_id = tp_id
		inner join unidade on pProds.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where
		year(offp_data_prevista) = year(@data)
		and datepart(week,offp_data_prevista) = datepart(week,@data)
		and pConst.p_tp_id = 84
		and pProds.p_tp_id <> 288 /*Resina*/
)
```

```sql
		inner join produto const on mConst.mov_p_id = const.p_id
		inner join movimento mProds on mConst.mov_id = mProds.mov_mov_id
		inner join produto prod on mProds.mov_p_id = prod.p_id
		inner join unidade on prod.p_uni_id = uni_id
		left join produto_componente pc on mConst.mov_p_id = pc.comp_p_id and mProds.mov_p_id = pc.comp_p_p_id and mProds.mov_quantidade = pc.comp_quantidade
	where
		const.p_tp_id = 84 /*Construção*/
		and pc.comp_id is null
		and mConst.mov_of_id = @of_id
		and prod.p_tp_id <> 288 /*Resina*/
	union 
	select
		const.p_id IdConstrucao, const.p_nome Construcao, prod.p_id IdProduto, prod.p_nome Produto, pc.comp_quantidade QtdOf, mProds.mov_id Correspondencia, 'Saiu' x, uni_nome Unidade
	from
		movimento mConst
		inner join produto_componente pc on mConst.mov_p_id = pc.comp_p_id 
		inner join produto const on mConst.mov_p_id = const.p_id
		inner join produto prod on pc.comp_p_p_id = prod.p_id
		inner join unidade on prod.p_uni_id = uni_id
		left join movimento mProds on mConst.mov_id = mProds.mov_mov_id and mProds.mov_p_id = pc.comp_p_p_id and mProds.mov_quantidade = pc.comp_quantidade
	where
		const.p_tp_id = 84 /*Construção*/
		and mProds.mov_id is null
		and mConst.mov_of_id = @of_id
		and prod.p_tp_id <> 288 /*Resina*/
	union 
	select
		const.p_id IdConstrucao, const.p_nome Construcao, prod.p_id IdProduto, prod.p_nome Produto, pc.comp_quantidade QtdOf, mProds.mov_id Correspondencia, 'Standard' x, uni_nome Unidade
	from
		movimento mConst
		inner join produto_componente pc on mConst.mov_p_id = pc.comp_p_id 
		inner join produto const on mConst.mov_p_id = const.p_id
		inner join produto prod on pc.comp_p_p_id = prod.p_id
		inner join unidade on prod.p_uni_id = uni_id
		inner join movimento mProds on mConst.mov_id = mProds.mov_mov_id and mProds.mov_p_id = pc.comp_p_p_id and mProds.mov_quantidade = pc.comp_quantidade
```

#### `dbo.of_AlteracoesFase_SEMANAL`(@data date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-06-02 10:24 · modificado 2025-06-02 14:15* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `custo`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `OfId` int, `Preco` varchar(8), `idConst` int, `Constrtucao` nvarchar, `Tipo` nvarchar, `idProduto` int, `Produto` nvarchar, `Unidade` nvarchar(100), `Qtd` float, `PrecoCusto` float, `DataLam` date, `e_nome` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_AlteracoesFase_SEMANAL]
(	
	@data date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		mConst.mov_of_id OfId, 'OF' Preco, pConst.p_id idConst, pConst.p_nome Constrtucao, tp_nome Tipo, pProds.p_id idProduto, pProds.p_nome Produto, uni_nome Unidade, mProds.mov_quantidade Qtd, pProds.p_precocusto PrecoCusto, cast(offp_data_prevista as date) DataLam, e_nome
	from
		movimento mConst 
		inner join of_fp on mov_of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = mConst.mov_fp_id 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
		inner join produto pConst on mConst.mov_p_id = pConst.p_id 
		inner join movimento mProds on mConst.mov_id = mProds.mov_mov_id
		inner join produto pProds on mProds.mov_p_id = pProds.p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on pProds.p_tp_id = tp_id
		inner join unidade on pProds.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where
		year(OFFP_DATAFIM) = year(@data)
		and datepart(week,OFFP_DATAFIM) = datepart(week,@data)
		and pConst.p_tp_id = 479 /*Kits Fase*/
		--and pProds.p_tp_id <> 288 /*Resina*/
	union all
	select
		mConst.mov_of_id OfId, 'Standard' Preco, pConst.p_id idConst, pConst.p_nome Constrtucao, tp_nome Tipo, pProds.p_id idProduto, pProds.p_nome Produto, uni_nome Unidade, comp_quantidade Qtd, pProds.p_precocusto PrecoCusto, cast(offp_data_prevista as date) DataLam, e_nome
	from
		movimento mConst 
		inner join of_fp on mov_of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = mConst.mov_fp_id 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id
		inner join produto pConst on mConst.mov_p_id = pConst.p_id 
		inner join produto_componente on pConst.p_id = comp_p_id
		inner join produto pProds on comp_p_p_id = pProds.p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on pProds.p_tp_id = tp_id
		inner join unidade on pProds.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where
		year(OFFP_DATAFIM) = year(@data)
		and datepart(week,OFFP_DATAFIM) = datepart(week,@data)
		and pConst.p_tp_id = 479 /*Kits Fase*/
		--and pProds.p_tp_id <> 288 /*Resina*/
)
```

#### `dbo.OF_Aluguer`(@of_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-02-14 11:47 · modificado 2024-06-17 14:45* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`, `reparaç`, `custo`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `id` int, `Centro` nvarchar, `Reserva` nvarchar, `Equipa` nvarchar, `Inicio` smalldatetime, `Fim` smalldatetime, `Dias` float, `valorDia` float, `Total` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[OF_Aluguer]
(	
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		RO_OF_ID id, CE_NOME Centro, rE.E_NOME as Reserva, RES_EQUIPA Equipa, RO_DATA_INI Inicio, RO_DATA_FIM Fim, cast(round(DATEDIFF(hour, RO_DATA_INI, RO_DATA_FIM)/24.0,0) as float) Dias, 4.0 valorDia, round(DATEDIFF(hour, RO_DATA_INI, RO_DATA_FIM)/24.0,0) * 4.0 Total
	from 
		CENTRO_RESERVA_OFS 
		inner join CENTRO_RESERVA on RO_RES_ID = RES_ID
		inner join CENTRO_ESTAGIO p on RES_CE_ID = CE_ID
		inner join ENTIDADE rE on RES_E_ID = rE.E_ID
	where
		RO_OF_ID = @of_id
	union
	select
		ofr_of_id id, 'Provas' Centro, OFR_BOOKING_NAME as Reserva, OFR_BOOKING_NTEAM Equipa, OFR_DATA_ENTREGA Inicio, OFR_DATA_RECEBIDO Fim, cast(round(DATEDIFF(hour, OFR_DATA_ENTREGA, OFR_DATA_RECEBIDO)/24.0,0) as float) Dias, case when OFR_BOOKING_VALOR > 0 then OFR_BOOKING_VALOR else x.price end valorDia, case when OFR_BOOKING_VALOR > 0 then OFR_BOOKING_VALOR else x.price end Total
	from 
		OF_RENTAL_PROVAS 
		inner join dbo.Rental_Bookings() xb on OFR_BOOKING_ID = xb.bookingId
		inner join dbo.Rental_Provas_todas() x on xb.event_id = x.id
	where
		OFR_OF_ID = @of_id
	union
	select
		offp_of_id id, 'Reparações' Centro, 'NELO' as Reserva, isnull(e_nome,'Sem funcionário') Equipa, OFFP_DATAINICIO Inicio, OFFP_DATAFIM Fim, 
		cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(offp_datainicio, offp_datafim)/60.0/8.0 as float) Dias, 
		coalesce(E_CUSTOHORA,p_precocusto, 0) valorDia, 
		(case when dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(offp_datainicio, offp_datafim) = 0 then 8 else dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(offp_datainicio, offp_datafim)/60.0 end) * coalesce(E_CUSTOHORA,p_precocusto, 0) * -1 Total
	from
		OF_FP
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
		left join PRODUTO on FP_P_ID = P_ID
		left join OFFP_EQ on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
		left join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
	where
		OFFP_FP_ID in (14,76,77)
		and OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is not null
)
```

#### `dbo.of_AvaliacaoDesmolde`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-01-23 10:57* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `molde`

**Devolve:** `BarcoId` int, `BarcoNome` nvarchar, `moldeId` int, `FaseID` int, `OF_FP_ID` int, `InicioLaminagem` smalldatetime, `Cliente` nvarchar, `fase` nvarchar, `OF_TR_DATA_PREVISTA` smalldatetime, `Observacoes` nvarchar, `DeckId` int, `CascoId` int, `Deck` int, `Casco` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_AvaliacaoDesmolde] 
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	SELECT 
		of_id as BarcoId, 
		p1.p_nome as BarcoNome, 
		laminagem.offp_of_id_mld as moldeId, 
		desmolde.offp_id as FaseID, 
		OF_FP_ID, 
		laminagem.OFFP_DATAINICIO as InicioLaminagem, 
		e_nome as Cliente, 
		fase.fp_nome as fase,
		OF_TR_DATA_PREVISTA, 
		OF_OBSERVACOES as Observacoes, 
		null as DeckId, 
		null as CascoId, 
		null as Deck, 
		null as Casco 
	 FROM 
		ordemfabrico INNER JOIN 
		produto p1 ON p_id = of_p_id cross apply
		(select top 1 offp_id, offp_of_id, offp_datainicio from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 6 and offp_of_id = of_id order by offp_datainicio desc) as desmolde cross apply
		(select top 1 offp_id, offp_of_id, offp_datainicio, offp_of_id_mld from of_fp where offp_fp_id in (1,67) and offp_of_id = of_id order by offp_datainicio desc) as  laminagem inner join
		fases_producao fase ON fase.fp_id = of_fp_id INNER JOIN
		entidade e ON e.e_id = ordemfabrico.of_e_id_enc inner join
		(select distinct ofch_of_id from of_checklist where ofch_fp_id_chk = 6 and ofch_estado is null) as chk on of_id = chk.ofch_of_id
	 WHERE 
		/*of_fp_id IN (3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 22) 
		AND */desmolde.OFFP_DATAINICIO BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-7,GETDATE()) AND DATEADD(day,2,GETDATE())
)
```

```sql

(	
	
)

AS
RETURN 
(
	SELECT 
		of_id as BarcoId, 
		p1.p_nome as BarcoNome, 
		laminagem.offp_of_id_mld as moldeId,
```

#### `dbo.of_Cores_Antigas`(@of_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`

**Devolve:** `deckId` int, `deckNome` nvarchar, `cascoId` int, `cascoNome` nvarchar, `topoFrId` int, `topoFrNome` nvarchar, `topoTrId` int, `topoTrNome` nvarchar, `quinasFrId` int, `quinasFrNome` nvarchar, `quinasTrId` int, `quinasTrNome` nvarchar, `lateraisFrId` int, `lateraisFrNome` nvarchar, `lateraisTrId` int, `lateraisTrNome` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Cores_Antigas]
(	
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select p.p_id as deckId, p.p_nome as deckNome,
			p1.p_id as cascoId, p1.p_nome as cascoNome,
			p2.p_id as topoFrId, p2.p_nome as topoFrNome,
			p3.p_id as topoTrId, p3.p_nome as topoTrNome,
			p4.p_id as quinasFrId, p4.p_nome as quinasFrNome,
			p5.p_id as quinasTrId, p5.p_nome as quinasTrNome,
			p6.p_id as lateraisFrId, p6.p_nome as lateraisFrNome,
			p7.p_id as lateraisTrId, p7.p_nome as lateraisTrNome
	from
		ordemfabrico
		left join produto as p on of_p_id_cdeck = p.p_id
		left join produto as p1 on of_p_id_ccasco = p1.p_id
		left join produto as p2 on of_p_id_topo_fr = p2.p_id
		left join produto as p3 on of_p_id_topo_tr = p3.p_id
		left join produto as p4 on of_p_id_quinas = p4.p_id
		left join produto as p5 on of_p_id_quinas_tr = p5.p_id
		left join produto as p6 on of_p_id_lateral_fr = p6.p_id
		left join produto as p7 on of_p_id_lateral_tr = p7.p_id
	where 
		of_id = @of_id
)
```

#### `dbo.OF_Entidade_Historico`(@of_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-02-15 14:55 · modificado 2022-02-15 15:42* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `Data` datetime, `DonoActual` nvarchar, `Valor` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION OF_Entidade_Historico
(	
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		oe.OFE_DATA [Data], 
		eAnt.E_NOME DonoActual,
		oe.OFE_OF_PRECOVENDA Valor
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		left join OF_ENTIDADE oe on OF_ID = oe.OFE_OF_ID
		left join ENTIDADE eAnt on oe.OFE_E_ID_ANTERIOR = eAnt.E_ID
	where 
		OF_ID = @of_id
		and eAnt.E_NELO = 0
		and OF_DATAFIM < OFE_DATA
	union
	select
		GETDATE() [Data], 
		e_nome DonoActual,
		OF_PRECOVENDA Valor
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join ENTIDADE on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID	
		outer apply (select top 1 e_id donoAntId, e_nome donoAntNome, OFE_DATA dt, OFE_OF_PRECOVENDA val from OF_ENTIDADE inner join ENTIDADE on OFE_E_ID_ANTERIOR = E_ID where OFE_OF_ID = OF_ID order by OFE_DATA desc) oeAnt
	where
		OF_ID = @of_id
		and E_NELO = 0
)
```

#### `dbo.of_EstadosActuais`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

**Devolve:** `ofId` int, `ofFpId` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_EstadosActuais] 
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct
		o.offp_of_id as ofId,
		o.offp_fp_id as ofFpId
	from
		OF_FP o 
		left join OFFP_LINK on o.OFFP_ID = OFFPL_OFFP_ID_PROX
		left join OF_FP o1 on OFFPL_OFFP_ID_ANT = o1.OFFP_ID --and o1.OFFP_DATAFIM is not null
	where 
		o.OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		and (o1.OFFP_ID is null or o1.OFFP_DATAFIM is not null)
)
```

#### `dbo.of_GetReparacoesFinalizadas`(@ord int, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-05-17 10:33 · modificado 2024-12-17 10:37* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `reparac`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `Cliente` nvarchar, `Proprietario` nvarchar, `of_id` int, `Referencia` nvarchar, `Modelo` nvarchar, `Fim` smalldatetime, `FuncionarioId` int, `Funcionario` nvarchar, `Valor` float, `TotalPecas` float, `Reparacao` nvarchar, `NotasFuncionario` nvarchar, `Estado` nvarchar, `offp_id` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_GetReparacoesFinalizadas] 
(	
	@ord int = -1, @e_id int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		cl.e_nome Cliente,
		isnull(prop.e_nome,'') Proprietario,
		of_id,
		of_referencia Referencia,
		p_nome Modelo,
		offp_datafim Fim,
		func.e_id FuncionarioId,
		isnull(func.e_nome,'') Funcionario,
		offp_valor_fact Valor, 
		isnull(p.TotalPecas, 0) TotalPecas,
		isnull(offp_observacoes,'') Reparacao,
		isnull(offp_problemas,'') NotasFuncionario,
		fp_nome Estado
		, offp_id
	from
		of_fp 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
		left join entidade func on offpeq_e_id = func.e_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join entidade cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id 
		left join entidade prop on of_e_id = prop.e_id 
		left join (select mov_offp_id, cast(sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as float) TotalPecas from movimento where mov_offp_id is not null group by mov_offp_id) p on offp_id = p.MOV_OFFP_ID
	where
		offp_fp_id in (76,77)
		and offp_datafim is not null
		and case when @ord = -1 then 1 else year(offp_datafim) end = case when @ord = -1 then 1 else year(dateadd(month, -2 + @ord, getdate())) end
		and case when @ord = -1 then 1 else month(offp_datafim) end = case when @ord = -1 then 1 else month(dateadd(month, -2 + @ord, getdate())) end
		and case when @e_id is null then 1 else func.e_id end = case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end
)
```

#### `dbo.of_GetReparacoesFinalizadas_EntreDatas`(@e_id int, @dI date, @dF date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-08-19 16:55 · modificado 2024-11-18 14:43* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `reparac`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `Cliente` nvarchar, `Proprietario` nvarchar, `of_id` int, `Referencia` nvarchar, `Modelo` nvarchar, `Fim` smalldatetime, `FuncionarioId` int, `Funcionario` nvarchar, `Valor` float, `TotalPecas` float, `Reparacao` nvarchar, `NotasFuncionario` nvarchar, `Estado` nvarchar, `offp_id` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_GetReparacoesFinalizadas_EntreDatas] 
(	
	@e_id int = null,
	@dI date,
	@dF date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		cl.e_nome Cliente,
		isnull(prop.e_nome,'') Proprietario,
		of_id,
		of_referencia Referencia,
		p_nome Modelo,
		offp_datafim Fim,
		func.e_id FuncionarioId,
		isnull(func.e_nome,'') Funcionario,
		offp_valor_fact Valor, 
		isnull(p.TotalPecas, 0) TotalPecas,
		isnull(offp_observacoes,'') Reparacao,
		isnull(offp_problemas,'') NotasFuncionario,
		fp_nome Estado
		, offp_id
	from
		of_fp 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
		left join entidade func on offpeq_e_id = func.e_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join entidade cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id 
		left join entidade prop on of_e_id = prop.e_id 
		left join (select mov_offp_id, cast(sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as float) TotalPecas from movimento where mov_offp_id is not null group by mov_offp_id) p on offp_id = p.MOV_OFFP_ID
	where
		offp_fp_id in (76,77)
		and cast(offp_datafim as date) between @dI and @dF
		--and case when @ord = 0 then 1 else year(offp_datafim) end = case when @ord = 0 then 1 else year(dateadd(month, case when @ord = 1 then -1 else 0 end, getdate())) end
		--and case when @ord = 0 then 1 else month(offp_datafim) end = case when @ord = 0 then 1 else month(dateadd(month, case when @ord = 1 then -1 else 0 end, getdate())) end
		and case when @e_id is null then 1 else func.e_id end = case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end
)
```

#### `dbo.of_GetReparacoesFinalizadas_Report`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-11-18 14:27 · modificado 2024-11-18 14:36* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `reparac`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `Cliente` nvarchar, `Proprietario` nvarchar, `of_id` int, `Referencia` nvarchar, `Modelo` nvarchar, `Fim` smalldatetime, `FuncionarioId` int, `Funcionario` nvarchar, `Valor` float, `TotalPecas` float, `Reparacao` nvarchar, `NotasFuncionario` nvarchar, `Estado` nvarchar, `offp_id` int, `aReceber` float, `Ano` int, `Mes` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_GetReparacoesFinalizadas_Report] 
(	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		cl.e_nome Cliente,
		isnull(prop.e_nome,'') Proprietario,
		of_id,
		of_referencia Referencia,
		p_nome Modelo,
		offp_datafim Fim,
		func.e_id FuncionarioId,
		isnull(func.e_nome,'') Funcionario,
		offp_valor_fact Valor, 
		isnull(p.TotalPecas, 0) TotalPecas,
		isnull(offp_observacoes,'') Reparacao,
		isnull(offp_problemas,'') NotasFuncionario,
		fp_nome Estado
		, offp_id,
		offp_valor_fact * 0.25 aReceber,
		year(offp_datafim) Ano, month(offp_datafim) Mes
	from
		of_fp 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
		left join entidade func on offpeq_e_id = func.e_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join entidade cl on of_e_id_enc = cl.e_id 
		left join entidade prop on of_e_id = prop.e_id 
		left join (select mov_offp_id, cast(sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as float) TotalPecas from movimento where mov_offp_id is not null group by mov_offp_id) p on offp_id = p.MOV_OFFP_ID
	where
		offp_fp_id in (76,77)
		and year(offp_datafim) >= year(getdate()) - 1
		--and case when @ord = 0 then 1 else year(offp_datafim) end = case when @ord = 0 then 1 else year(dateadd(month, case when @ord = 1 then -1 else 0 end, getdate())) end
		--and case when @ord = 0 then 1 else month(offp_datafim) end = case when @ord = 0 then 1 else month(dateadd(month, case when @ord = 1 then -1 else 0 end, getdate())) end
		--and case when @e_id is null then 1 else func.e_id end = case when @e_id is null then 1 else @e_id end
)
```

#### `dbo.of_moldes_possiveis`(@of_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `molde`

**Devolve:** `of_id` int, `of_nome` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_moldes_possiveis]
(	
	@of_id int 
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select o1.of_id, (case when o1.of_fp_id in (13,14) then '(PR) ' when o1.of_fp_id = 16 then '(PA) ' else '' end) + o1.of_nome as of_nome
	from ordemfabrico as o inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id inner join produto as p1 on p.P_NP_ID = p1.P_NP_ID and p.p_m_id = p1.p_m_id and p.p_tam_id = p1.p_tam_id
	inner join ordemfabrico as o1 on p1.p_id = o1.of_p_id 
	where o.of_id = @of_id and o1.of_fp_id in (13,14,15,16) and o1.of_id between 70000 and 79999
)
```

#### `dbo.of_Pecas_Em_Fase`(@data date, @fp_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-06-08 10:49* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `of_id` int, `tp_id` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `p_imagem` nvarchar, `cores` varchar(1), `of_referencia` nvarchar, `of_dataentrega` smalldatetime, `offp_id` int, `offp_datainicio` smalldatetime, `offp_datafim` smalldatetime, `offp_observacoes` nvarchar, `offp_problemas` nvarchar, `offpeq_e_id_chefe` int, `offpeq_e_id_ajud` int, `ultimaFase` bit, `offp_fp_id` int, `of_fp_id` int, `offp_data_prevista` date

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Pecas_Em_Fase] 
(	
	@data date, 
	@fp_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select --distinct
		of_id, 
		tp_id,
		tp_nome,
		p_id,
		p_nome,
		p_imagem, 
		'' as cores,--dbo.of_Cores(of_id,0) as cores,
		of_referencia,
		of_dataentrega,
		offp.offp_id,
		offp.offp_datainicio,
		offp.offp_datafim,
		offp.offp_observacoes,
		offp.offp_problemas,
		eq.offpeq_e_id as offpeq_e_id_chefe,
		eq1.offpeq_e_id as offpeq_e_id_ajud,
		cast((case when offp1.offp_id is null then 1 else 0 end) as bit) as ultimaFase, offp.offp_fp_id, of_fp_id,
		cast(offp.offp_data_prevista as date) as offp_data_prevista
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		inner join of_fp as offp on of_id = offp.offp_of_id and offp.offp_fp_id = @fp_id
		left join offp_eq as eq on offp.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join offp_eq as eq1 on offp.offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and eq1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id 
		left join of_fp as offp1 on of_id = offp1.offp_of_id and offp1.offp_ordem = offp.offp_ordem + 1
	where 
		of_id > 10000000
		and of_fp_id = @fp_id
		and offp.offp_fp_id = @fp_id
		and (fp_planeamento = 1 and (cast(offp.offp_data_prevista as date) <= @data or offp.offp_data_prevista is null) 
			--or (fp_planeamento = 1 and (cast(offp.offp_data_prevista as date) <= @data or offp.offp_data_prevista is null)) 
			or (fp_planeamento = 0 and of_fp_id = @fp_id) 
			or cast(offp.offp_datafim as date) = @data)
)
```

#### `dbo.of_Pecas_Em_Fases`(@pId int, @fpId int, @armId int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-11-22 10:08 · modificado 2019-11-22 10:08* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `TP_ID` int, `TP_NOME` nvarchar, `P_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `ARM_ID` int, `ARM_NOME` nvarchar, `FP_ID` int, `FP_NOME` nvarchar, `FP_SEQUENCIA` int, `ofs` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION of_Pecas_Em_Fases 
(	
	@pId int, 
	@fpId int, 
	@armId int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME,
		P_ID,
		P_NOME,
		ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		FP_ID,
		FP_NOME,
		FP_SEQUENCIA,
		COUNT(of_id) as ofs
	from	
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OF_FP_ID = FP_ID
		inner join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
	where
		OF_ID > 10000000
		and (case when @pId is null then 1 else p_id end) = isnull(@pId,1)
		and (case when @fpId is null then 1 else fp_id end) = isnull(@fpId,1)
		and (case when @armId is null then 1 else arm_id end) = isnull(@armId,1)
	group by
		TP_ID,
		TP_NOME,
		P_ID,
		P_NOME,
		ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		FP_ID,
		FP_NOME,
		FP_SEQUENCIA
)
```

#### `dbo.of_SaidasFase`(@OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA date, @OFFP_TURN_ID int, @of int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-12-05 09:44 · modificado 2019-12-05 09:54* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`

**Devolve:** `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `mov_of_id` int, `modelo` nvarchar, `uni_nome` nvarchar(100), `Qtd` float, `MOV_TPMOV_ID` int, `MOV_ID` int, `p_nome` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION of_SaidasFase
(	
	@OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA date = null,
	@OFFP_TURN_ID int = null,
	@of int = null
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		tp_nome, p.p_id, mov_of_id, p1.P_NOME as modelo, uni_nome, SUM(mov_quantidade) as Qtd, MOV_TPMOV_ID, MOV_ID, p.p_nome 
	from 
		MOVIMENTO 
		inner join PRODUTO as p on MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID 
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p.P_TP_ID = TP_ID 
		inner join UNIDADE on p.P_UNI_ID = UNI_ID 
		inner join OF_FP on MOV_OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID 
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = OF_ID 
		inner join PRODUTO as p1 on OF_P_ID = p1.P_ID 
	where 
		OFFP_FP_ID = 1 
		and (case when @of is null then OFFP_TURN_ID else 1 end) = (case when @of is null then @OFFP_TURN_ID else 1 end) 
		and (case when @of is null then cast(OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA as date) else '2019/01/01' end) = (case when @of is null then @OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA  else '2019/01/01' end)
		and TP_FP_ID = 1 
		and p.P_TEM_STOCK = 1 
		and (case when @of is null then 1 else of_id end) = isnull(@of,1) 
	group by 
		tp_nome, p.p_id, p.p_nome, mov_of_id, uni_nome, MOV_TPMOV_ID, MOV_ID, p1.P_NOME 
)
```

#### `dbo.PaddlingCenter_Top_Circuito`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-11-15 09:59 · modificado 2022-11-15 13:22*

**Devolve:** `RowNum` bigint, `e_id` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `BestLap` time, `Meu` bit, `Tipo` nvarchar(112)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[PaddlingCenter_Top_Circuito] 
(	
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		RowNum, e_id, e_nome, BestLap, cast(case when E_ID = @e_id then 1 else 0 end as bit) Meu, 'Geral\' + e_genero Tipo 
	from 
		(select 
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY min(et.ETR_TEMPO) ASC) AS RowNum, e_id, e_nome, min(et.ETR_TEMPO) BestLap, e_genero 
		from 
			ENTIDADE_TREINOS et 
			inner join ENTIDADE on et.ETR_E_ID = E_ID 
		where 
			et.ETR_CIRCUITO = 1 
		group by 
			e_id, e_nome, e_genero ) a 
	where 
		a.RowNum <= 10 
		or a.E_ID = @e_id --order by RowNum
	union
	select 
		*, cast(case when E_ID = @e_id then 1 else 0 end as bit) Meu, 'Masculino' Tipo 
	from 
		(select 
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY min(et.ETR_TEMPO) ASC) AS RowNum, e_id, e_nome, min(et.ETR_TEMPO) BestLap 
		from 
			ENTIDADE_TREINOS et 
			inner join ENTIDADE on et.ETR_E_ID = E_ID 
		where 
			et.ETR_CIRCUITO = 1 
			and E_GENERO = 'Masculino' 
		group by 
			e_id, e_nome) a 
	where 
		a.RowNum <= 10 
		or a.E_ID = @e_id --order by RowNum
	union
	select 
		*, cast(case when E_ID = @e_id then 1 else 0 end as bit) Meu, 'Feminino' Tipo 
	from 
		(select 
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY min(et.ETR_TEMPO) ASC) AS RowNum, e_id, e_nome, min(et.ETR_TEMPO) BestLap 
		from 
			ENTIDADE_TREINOS et 
			inner join ENTIDADE on et.ETR_E_ID = E_ID 
		where 
			et.ETR_CIRCUITO = 1 
			and E_GENERO = 'Feminino' 
		group by 
			e_id, e_nome) a 
	where 
		a.RowNum <= 10 
		or a.E_ID = @e_id 

)
```

#### `dbo.pedido_Items`(@pedido int, @funcionario_Pedido int, @e_id_arm int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-11-23 14:22 · modificado 2022-11-23 15:59* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `mov_id` int, `TP_NOME` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `p_arm_id` int, `uni_nome` nvarchar(100), `mov_quantidade` int, `mov_qtd_bal` float, `mov_tpmov_id` int, `mov_precounitario` float, `mov_observacoes` nvarchar, `PED_NOTAS` nvarchar, `MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL` bit, `PED_DATA` smalldatetime, `editar` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[pedido_Items] 
(	
	@pedido int,
	@funcionario_Pedido int,
	@e_id_arm int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select --distinct
	    mov_id,
		TP_NOME,
        p_id,
	    p_nome + 
		case
			when ARM_E_ID_RESP = @e_id_arm OR ARM_E_ID_AJUD = @e_id_arm then
				case when MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 and MOV_OF_ID < 10000000 then ' (extra)' else '' end +
				case when charindex('OPÇÕES:',mov_observacoes,0) > 0 then ' ' + SUBSTRING(mov_observacoes,charindex('OPÇÕES:',mov_observacoes,0),len(mov_observacoes) - charindex('OPÇÕES:',mov_observacoes,0)+1) else '' end
			else ' (** Arm: ' + ARM_NOME + ' **)'
		end as p_nome,
        p_arm_id,
        uni_nome,
	    0 as mov_quantidade,
        mov_quantidade as mov_qtd_bal,
        mov_tpmov_id,
        mov_precounitario,
        mov_observacoes,
		PED_NOTAS,
		MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		PED_DATA,
		case when ARM_E_ID_RESP = @e_id_arm OR ARM_E_ID_AJUD = @e_id_arm then 1 else 0 end editar
    from 
	    produto
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
	    inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
	    left join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id and mov_id_pedido = @pedido
		inner join PEDIDOS on MOV_ID_PEDIDO = PED_ID and PED_E_ID = @funcionario_Pedido
    where
	    mov_id_pedido = @pedido
		and mov_e_id = @funcionario_Pedido
        and mov_tpmov_id = 12
		--and (ARM_E_ID_RESP = @e_id_arm 
		--	or ARM_E_ID_AJUD = @e_id_arm)
)
```

#### `dbo.pedidos_Detalhe`(@pedido_Id int, @e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-10-02 15:06* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `preco`, `preço`

**Devolve:** `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `pf_descricao` nvarchar, `uni_nome` nvarchar(100), `frn_Uni` nvarchar(100), `pf_codigo` nvarchar, `pf_conversao` float, `mov_quantidade` float, `mov_precounitario` float, `total` float, `mov_observacoes` nvarchar, `qtd_Nelo` float, `preco_Nelo` float, `p_imagem` nvarchar, `incluir_imagens` bit, `stock` float, `mensal` float, `diasStock` float, `fornecedor_Id` int, `fornecedor_Nome` nvarchar, `e_prazoentrega` int, `e_email` nvarchar, `mov_data` date, `responsavel_Nome` nvarchar, `responsavel_Email` nvarchar, `fornContacto` nvarchar, `ped_notas` nvarchar, `ped_pt` bit, `p_tem_stock` bit, `mov_id` int, `contabilidade` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[pedidos_Detalhe]
(	
	@pedido_Id int,
	@e_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		tp_nome, 
		p_id, 
		p_nome, 
		pf_descricao, 
		u.uni_nome, 
		isnull(u1.uni_nome, u.uni_nome) as frn_Uni, 
		pf_codigo, 
		(case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end) as pf_conversao, 
		mov_quantidade * (case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end) as mov_quantidade, 
		mov_precounitario / (case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end) as mov_precounitario,--dbo.ult_preco_fornecedor(p_id,pf_e_id)/(case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end) as mov_precounitario, 
		(mov_quantidade * (case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end)) * (mov_precounitario/(case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end)) as total, --(mov_quantidade * (case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end)) * (dbo.ult_preco_fornecedor(p_id,pf_e_id)/(case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end)) as total,
		/*'(ult. preço = ' + cast(dbo.ult_preco_fornecedor(p_id,pf_e_id)*(case when pf_conversao = 0 then 1 else pf_conversao end) as nvarchar(max)) + '€/' + u.uni_nome + ')' as*/ mov_observacoes, 
		mov_quantidade as qtd_Nelo,
		mov_precounitario as preco_Nelo, --dbo.ult_preco_fornecedor(p_id,pf_e_id) as preco_Nelo,
		p_imagem, 
		mov_envia_anexo as incluir_imagens,
		isnull(st.stock,0) as stock,
		isnull(med.mensal,0) as mensal,
		isnull(st.stock,0)/(case when isnull(med.mensal,0)/30.0 > 0 then isnull(med.mensal,0)/30.0 else 1 end) as diasStock,
		e.e_id as fornecedor_Id,
		e.e_nome as fornecedor_Nome,
		e.e_prazoentrega,
		ped_email as e_email,
		cast(mov_data as date) as mov_data,
		e1.e_nome as responsavel_Nome,
		e1.e_email as responsavel_Email,
		ped_contacto as fornContacto,
		ped_notas,
		ped_pt,
		p_tem_stock,
		mov_id,
		isnull(pcont_nome,'Sem tipo!') contabilidade
	From 
		entidade as e
		inner join produto_entidade  on e.e_id = pf_e_id
		inner Join produto On pf_p_id = p_id 
		left join produto_contabilidade_tipo on p_pcont_id = pcont_id
		inner Join unidade as u on p_uni_id = u.uni_id 
		inner Join produto_tipo On p_tp_id = tp_id 
		left Join unidade as u1 on pf_uni_id = u1.uni_id 
		inner join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id and mov_id_pedido = @pedido_Id and mov_tpmov_id = 9 --and mov_satisfeito = 0
		inner join pedidos on mov_e_id = ped_e_id and mov_id_pedido = ped_id
		inner join entidade as e1 on mov_e_id_responsavel = e1.e_id
		left join 
			(
				select 
					mov_p_id as pId,
					sum(mov_quantidade * (case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then -1 else 1 end)) as stock
				from 
					movimento
				where
					mov_tpmov_id in (1,2)
				group by
					mov_p_id
			) as st on pf_p_id = st.pId
		left join 
			(
				select 
					mov_p_id as pId,
					sum(mov_quantidade)/(case when datediff(day,min(mov_data),max(mov_data))/30.0 > 0.0 then datediff(day,min(mov_data),max(mov_data))/30.0 else 1.0 end) as mensal
				from 
					movimento
				where
					mov_tpmov_id in (2)
					and mov_observacoes not like 'Movimento do Armazem %'
					and mov_data between dateadd(month,-12,getdate()) and getdate()
				group by
					mov_p_id
			) as med on pf_p_id = med.pId
	Where 
		e.e_id = @e_id
		and p_activo = 1
)
```

#### `dbo.pedidos_Lista_Aprovacao`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-10-14 11:41* · 🔎 `preco`

**Devolve:** `id` nvarchar, `mov_data` date, `responsavelId` int, `responsavel` nvarchar, `fornecedorId` int, `fornecedor` nvarchar, `mov_id_pedido` int, `items` int, `total` float, `ped_contacto` nvarchar, `ped_email` nvarchar, `reponsavelEmail` nvarchar, `fornecedorPrazoEntrega` int, `ped_notas` nvarchar, `ped_pt` bit, `ped_prontopagamento` bit, `iva` bit

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[pedidos_Lista_Aprovacao]
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		cast(e1.e_id as nvarchar(max)) + '_' + cast(mov_id_pedido as nvarchar(max)) as id,
		cast(min(mov_data) as date) as mov_data,
		e.e_id as responsavelId,
		e.e_nome as responsavel,

		e1.e_id as fornecedorId,
		e1.e_nome as fornecedor,
		mov_id_pedido,
		count(mov_id) as items,
		sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as total, --sum(mov_quantidade * dbo.ult_preco_fornecedor(mov_p_id,e1.e_id)) as total
		ped_contacto, ped_email, e.e_email reponsavelEmail, e1.E_PRAZOENTREGA fornecedorPrazoEntrega, ped_notas, ped_pt, ped_prontopagamento,
		cast(case when e1.e_pais = 'Portugal' then 1 else 0 end as bit) iva
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join entidade as e on mov_e_id_responsavel = e.e_id
		inner join entidade as e1 on mov_e_id = e1.e_id
		inner join pedidos on mov_e_id = ped_e_id and mov_id_pedido = ped_id
	where 
		mov_tpmov_id = 9
		and mov_data_aprovado is null
	group by 
		e.e_id,
		e.e_nome,
		e1.e_id,
		e1.e_nome,
		mov_id_pedido,
		ped_contacto, ped_email, e.e_email, e1.E_PRAZOENTREGA, ped_notas, ped_pt, ped_prontopagamento,
		cast(case when e1.e_pais = 'Portugal' then 1 else 0 end as bit)
)
```

```sql
		e2.e_nome as aprovador,
		mov_data_aprovado,
		ped_contacto, ped_email, e.e_email reponsavelEmail, e1.E_PRAZOENTREGA fornecedorPrazoEntrega, ped_pt, ped_notas, ped_prontopagamento, ped_pago, ped_pagar,
		cast(case when e1.e_pais = 'Portugal' then 1 else 0 end as bit) iva,
		ped_prioritario
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join entidade as e on mov_e_id_responsavel = e.e_id
		inner join entidade as e1 on mov_e_id = e1.e_id
		inner join entidade as e2 on mov_e_id_aprova = e2.e_id
		inner join pedidos on mov_e_id = ped_e_id and mov_id_pedido = ped_id
	where 
		mov_tpmov_id = 9
		and cast(mov_data_aprovado as date) between @dI and @dF
	group by 
		cast(mov_data as date),
		e.e_id,
		e.e_nome,
		e1.e_id,
		e1.e_nome,
		mov_id_pedido,
		e2.e_nome,
		mov_data_aprovado,
		ped_contacto, ped_email, e.e_email, e1.E_PRAZOENTREGA, ped_pt, ped_notas, ped_prontopagamento, ped_pago, ped_pagar,
		cast(case when e1.e_pais = 'Portugal' then 1 else 0 end as bit),
		ped_prioritario
	--order by 
	--	mov_data_aprovado desc
)
```

#### `dbo.pedidos_ListaPorProduto`(@e_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2020-07-15 13:23 · modificado 2021-11-11 10:56* · 🔎 `preco`

**Devolve:** `PED_ID` int, `PED_OF_ID` varchar(50), `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `p_arm_id` int, `uni_nome` nvarchar(100), `mov_quantidade` float, `mov_qtd_bal` float, `mov_tpmov_id` int, `mov_precounitario` float, `mov_observacoes` nvarchar, `Stock` float, `items` int, `ofId` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[pedidos_ListaPorProduto] 
(	
	@e_id INT
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
        PED_ID,
        case when PED_OF_ID is null and len(isnull(mov_shop_order_id,'')) < 3 then cast(mov_id_pedido as varchar(50)) when len(isnull(mov_shop_order_id,'')) >= 3 then mov_shop_order_id else cast(PED_OF_ID as varchar(50)) end as PED_OF_ID,
	    p.p_id,
	    p.p_nome + case when mov_acessorio_adicional = 1 then ' (*** EXTRA ***)' else '' end as p_nome,
        p_arm_id,
        uni_nome,
	    mov_qtd_bal as mov_quantidade,
        round(mov_quantidade * p_uni_mov_factor,4) as mov_qtd_bal,
        mov_tpmov_id,
        mov_precounitario,
        case when charindex('[**',mov_observacoes,0) > 0 then SUBSTRING(mov_observacoes,charindex('[**',mov_observacoes,0),len(mov_observacoes) - charindex('[**',mov_observacoes,0)+1) else '' end as mov_observacoes,
		round(arm.Stock * p_uni_mov_factor,1) as Stock,
		case when ent.items > 0 then 1 else 0 end as items,
		case when PED_OF_ID is null then 0 else 1 end as ofId
    from 
	    produto as p
		inner join ARMAZEM on p.P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
	    inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id_movimentos = uni_id
	    left join movimento on p.p_id = mov_p_id --and mov_id_pedido = @pedido
		inner join pedidos on MOV_ID_PEDIDO = PED_ID and MOV_E_ID = PED_E_ID
		left join dbo.produto_stocks_por_armazem as arm on p.P_ID = arm.P_ID and p.P_ARM_ID = arm.Armazem_Id
		left join (select 
					    mov_e_id as eId, mov_id_pedido as pedidoId, COUNT(mov_id) as items 
				    from 
					    MOVIMENTO
						inner join ARMAZEM on MOV_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
				    where 
					    MOV_ID_PEDIDO is not null 
						and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 2 
						and (ARM_E_ID_RESP = @e_id 
							or ARM_E_ID_AJUD = @e_id)
				    group by mov_e_id, mov_id_pedido) as ent on MOV_E_ID = ent.eId and MOV_ID_PEDIDO = ent.pedidoId
    where
	    mov_tpmov_id = 12
		and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0
		and (ARM_E_ID_RESP = @e_id 
			or ARM_E_ID_AJUD = @e_id)
)
```

#### `dbo.pedidos_Por_Func_Forn`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-08-01 19:59* · 🔎 `preco`

**Devolve:** `data` date, `responsavel_Id` int, `responsavel_Nome` nvarchar, `fornecedor_Id` int, `fornecedor_Nome` nvarchar, `total` float, `ARM_NOME` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[pedidos_Por_Func_Forn]
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		cast(mov_data_aprovado as date) as data,
		e.e_id as responsavel_Id,
		e.e_nome as responsavel_Nome,
		e1.e_id as fornecedor_Id,
		e1.e_nome as fornecedor_Nome,
		sum(mov_quantidade * mov_precounitario) as total,
		ARM_NOME
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join entidade as e on mov_e_id_responsavel = e.e_id
		inner join entidade as e1 on mov_e_id = e1.e_id
		inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
		left join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
	where 
		mov_tpmov_id = 9
		and mov_data_aprovado is not null
	group by 
		cast(mov_data_aprovado as date),
		e.e_id,
		e.e_nome,
		e1.e_id,
		e1.e_nome,
		ARM_NOME
)
```

#### `dbo.Performance_Func_Agrup`(@di date, @df date, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @eid int, @fpid int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

**Devolve:** `Barcos` int, `extPint` float, `extDesm` float, `rtns` int, `culpado` int, `tot` float, `totRet_New` float, `h_Trb` float, `h_Ext` float, `faltas` float, `ferias` float, `aj_ext` float, `h_Perdidas` float, `percent_absent` float, `hSaldo` float, `hCoef` float, `fp_hora_coef` float, `hProdTotal` float, `percent_hTrab` float, `saldo_T_R` float, `premio` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Performance_Func_Agrup]
(
	@di date, @df date, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @eid int, @fpid int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then Barcos else 0 end) as Barcos, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then extPint else 0.0 end) as extPint, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then extDesm else 0.0 end) as extDesm, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then rtns else 0 end) as rtns, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then culpado else 0 end) as culpado, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then tot else 0 end) as tot, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then totRet_New else 0.0 end) as totRet_New, 
		--e_nome, e_id, e_fp_id, equipa, fp_id, fp, fp_sequencia,
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then h_Trb else 0.0 end) as h_Trb, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then h_Ext else 0.0 end) as h_Ext, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then faltas else 0.0 end) as faltas, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then ferias else 0.0 end) as ferias, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then aj_ext else 0.0 end) as aj_ext, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then h_Perdidas else 0.0 end) as h_Perdidas, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then percent_absent else 0.0 end) as percent_absent,
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end) else 0 end) as hSaldo,
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then (case when tot > 0 then (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end)/tot else 0 end) else 0 end) as hCoef,
		fp_hora_coef as fp_hora_coef, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then hProdTotal else 0 end) as hProdTotal, 
		sum(case when e_id = @eid then percent_hTrab else 0 end) as percent_hTrab,
		sum(case when e_fp_id = fp_id and e_id = @eid then (fp_hora_coef * tot)-(case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end) else 0 end) as saldo_T_R,
		--(case 
		--	when sum(fp_hora_coef * tot + tolerancia - (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end)) <= -8 /*or percent_absent > 0.25 or e_fp_id <> fp_id*/ then 0
		--	when sum(fp_hora_coef * tot + tolerancia - (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end)) between -8 and 0
		--		then floor(8+sum((fp_hora_coef * tot + tolerancia) - (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end))) * premioHora
		(case 
			when sum(case when e_fp_id = fp_id and e_id = @eid then (fp_hora_coef * tot) - tempo_a_descontar - (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end) else 0 end)+16 <= 0 
					or sum(case when e_id = @eid then percent_absent else 0.0 end) > 0.25
					or sum(case when e_id = @eid then (culpado + Ret_Provocados) else 0.0 end)/sum(case when e_id = @eid then Barcos else 0 end) > 0.2 then 0
			when sum(case when e_fp_id = fp_id and e_id = @eid then (fp_hora_coef * tot) - tempo_a_descontar - (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end) else 0 end)+16 between 0 and 8
				then floor(sum(case when e_fp_id = fp_id and e_id = @eid then (fp_hora_coef * tot) - tempo_a_descontar - (case when e_fp_id = fp_id then (h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas) * percent_hTrab else h_Trb + h_Ext - ferias - faltas + aj_ext + h_Perdidas end) else 0 end)+16) * premioHora
			else 8 * premioHora end) as premio
	from dbo.Performance_Func(@di,@df,@hi,@hf, @eid, @fpid)
	group by premioHora, fp_hora_coef
)
```

#### `dbo.phc_Facturacao_Ultimos6Meses`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-04-04 13:53 · modificado 2025-04-04 15:51*

**Devolve:** `Ano` int, `Mes` int, `semana` int, `tot` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION phc_Facturacao_Ultimos6Meses
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		year(f.fdata) Ano,
		month(f.fdata) Mes,
		datepart(week,f.fdata) as semana,
		sum((case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end)) as tot
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft as f 
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi as f1 on f.fno = f1.fno
		left join (select e_id, e_nome, ephc_phc_id, display_name, region_name from entidade inner join entidade_phc on ephc_e_id = e_id inner join PAISES_SITE ps on E_PAIS_ID = ps.ID where e_nelo = 0) x on f.no = ephc_phc_id
	where 
		(f.nmdoc = 'Factura' 
			or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') 
		and f.anulado = 0
		and f.fdata > = dateadd(month,-5,getdate())
		and f.fno not in (select distinct fno from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi where design like '%Only%' or design like '%só para%' or design like '%fins ad%' or design like '%purpose%' or design like '%consignment%')
	group by 
		year(f.fdata), month(f.fdata), datepart(week,f.fdata)
)
```

#### `dbo.phc_Movimentos`()
