**Devolve:** `ClienteFornecedor` varchar(12), `DocumentoId` char(25), `Documento` varchar(60), `FacturaNumero` numeric, `FacturaData` date, `Entidade` varchar(55), `dataLancamento` date, `DataDO` date, `DataVencimento` date, `Pago` float, `PartePaga` float, `Total` float, `edeb` float, `ecre` float, `CC` float, `EC` float, `Forn` bit

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[phc_Movimentos]
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end ClienteFornecedor,
		d.dostamp DocumentoId, m.adoc Documento, 
		isnull(f.fno, 0) FacturaNumero, cast(f.fdata as date) FacturaData, m.descricao Entidade, cast(m.data as date) dataLancamento,
		cast(d.u_datadoc as date) DataDO, cast(d.u_datavenc as date) DataVencimento, cast(d.u_pago as float) Pago, cast(d.u_partepag as float) PartePaga, 
		cast(d.edebfin as float) Total,
		isnull(sum(cast(m.edeb as float)),0) edeb, isnull(sum(cast(m.ecre as float)),0) ecre, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) as float) CC, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) + isnull(fr.cc, 0) as float) EC,
		cast(case when fr.cc is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Forn
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.do d
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml m on d.dostamp = m.dostamp
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '21%' group by descricao) cl on m.descricao = cl.descr
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '22%' group by descricao) fr on m.descricao = fr.descr
		left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft f on m.adoc = cast(f.fno as nvarchar(max)) and m.conta like '21%' and (f.nmdoc = 'Factura' or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') and f.anulado = 0
	where
		m.data >= '2025-01-01'
		and m.conta like '21%'
	group by
		case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end,
		d.dostamp, m.adoc, f.fno, f.fdata, m.descricao, m.data, d.u_datadoc, d.u_datavenc, d.u_pago, d.u_partepag, d.edebfin, cl.cc, fr.cc

	--select 
	--	case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end ClienteFornecedor,
	--	d.dostamp DocumentoId, m.adoc Documento, 
	--	isnull(f.fno, 0) FacturaNumero, cast(f.fdata as date) FacturaData, m.descricao Entidade, cast(m.data as date) dataLancamento,
	--	cast(d.u_datadoc as date) DataDO, cast(d.u_datavenc as date) DataVencimento, cast(d.u_pago as float) Pago, cast(d.u_partepag as float) PartePaga, 
	--	cast(d.edebfin as float) Total,
	--	isnull(sum(cast(m.edeb as float)),0) edeb, isnull(sum(cast(m.ecre as float)),0) ecre
	--from 
	--	[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.do d
	--	inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml m on d.dostamp = m.dostamp
	--	left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft f on m.adoc = cast(f.fno as nvarchar(max)) and m.conta like '21%' and (f.nmdoc = 'Factura' or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') and f.anulado = 0
	--where
	--	m.data >= dateadd(year,-1,getdate())
	--	and (m.conta like '21%'
	--		or m.conta like '22%') 
	--group by
	--	case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end,
	--	d.dostamp, m.adoc, f.fno, f.fdata, m.descricao, m.data, d.u_datadoc, d.u_datavenc, d.u_pago, d.u_partepag, d.edebfin
)
```

#### `dbo.phc_Movimentos_Detalhado`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-07-29 16:07 · modificado 2025-07-30 10:37*

**Devolve:** `ClienteFornecedor` varchar(12), `PagamentoRecebimento` varchar(15), `dinome` varchar(40), `dino` numeric, `docnome` varchar(40), `adoc` varchar(60), `data` date, `ano` int, `quarter` int, `conta` varchar(15), `descricao` varchar(55), `rubrica` varchar(20), `edeb` float, `ecre` float, `ecreIVA` float, `edebIVA` float, `Valor` float, `descritivo` varchar(135), `fno` numeric, `fdata` datetime, `nome` char(55), `nmdoc` varchar(20), `ettiliq` numeric, `etotal` numeric, `u_datadoc` date, `u_datavenc` date, `u_pago` bit, `u_partepag` numeric, `dostamp` char(25)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION phc_Movimentos_Detalhado
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		case when m.conta like '21%' then 'Clientes' else 'Fornecedores' end ClienteFornecedor,
		case when m.conta like '21%' and m.edeb > 0 then 'Facturas' when m.conta like '21%' and m.ecre > 0 then 'Recebimento' 
			when m.conta like '22%' and m.edeb > 0 then 'Pagamentos a F.' 
			when m.conta like '22%' and m.cre > 0 then 'Compras a F.' else 'Fodeu' end PagamentoRecebimento,
		m.dinome, m.dino, m.docnome, m.adoc, 
		cast(m.data as date) data, year(cast(m.data as date)) ano, datepart(quarter,m.data) quarter,
		m.conta, m.descricao, m.rubrica, /*m.deb, m.cre,*/ 
		cast(m.edeb as float) edeb, cast(m.ecre as float) ecre, 
		cast(iva.ecreIVA as float) ecreIVA, cast(iva.edebIVA as float) edebIVA,
		case when m.conta like '21%' and cast(m.edeb as float) > 0 then cast(m.edeb as float) * - 1 when m.conta like '21%' and cast(m.ecre as float) > 0 then cast(m.ecre as float)
			when m.conta like '22%' and cast(m.edeb as float) > 0 then cast(m.edeb as float) when m.conta like '22%' and cast(m.ecre as float) > 0 then cast(m.ecre as float) * - 1 else 0 end Valor, m.descritivo
		, f.fno, f.fdata, f.nome, f.nmdoc, f.ettiliq, f.etotal
		, cast(d.u_datadoc as date) u_datadoc, cast(d.u_datavenc as date) u_datavenc, d.u_pago, d.u_partepag, d.dostamp
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.do d
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml m on d.dostamp = m.dostamp
		left join (select m1.dostamp, sum(m1.ecre) ecreIVA, sum(m1.edeb) edebIVA from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml m1 where m1.conta like '24%' group by m1.dostamp) iva on iva.dostamp = m.dostamp
		left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft f on m.adoc = cast(f.fno as nvarchar(max)) and m.conta like '21%' and (f.nmdoc = 'Factura' or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') and f.anulado = 0
	where
		m.data >= dateadd(year,-1,getdate())
		and (m.conta like '21%'
		or m.conta like '22%') 
)
```

```sql
		case when sum(cast(m.edeb as float)) > 0 then isnull(sum(cast(m.edeb as float)),0) else isnull(sum(cast(m.ecre as float)),0) end Total,  -- cast(d.edebfin as float) Total,
		isnull(sum(cast(m.edeb as float)),0) edeb, isnull(sum(cast(m.ecre as float)),0) ecre, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) as float) CC, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) + isnull(fr.cc, 0) as float) EC,
		cast(case when fr.cc is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Forn, m.docnome, d.u_pago, d.u_pagar, u_datapag
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.do d
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml m on d.dostamp = m.dostamp
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '21%' group by descricao) cl on m.descricao = cl.descr
		left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '22%' group by descricao) fr on m.descricao = fr.descr

	--	cast(d.u_datadoc as date) DataDO, cast(d.u_datavenc as date) DataVencimento, cast(d.u_pago as float) Pago, cast(d.u_partepag as float) PartePaga, 
	--	cast(d.edebfin as float) Total,
	--	isnull(sum(cast(m.edeb as float)),0) edeb, isnull(sum(cast(m.ecre as float)),0) ecre, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) * -1 as float) CC, cast(isnull(cl.cc, 0) + isnull(fr.cc, 0) as float) EC,
	--	cast(case when fr.cc is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Forn, m.docnome

	--	left join (select descricao descr, sum(edeb) - sum(ecre) cc from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml where year(data) = year(getdate()) and conta like '21%' group by descricao) fr on m.descricao = fr.descr
	--	left join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft f on m.adoc = cast(f.fno as nvarchar(max)) and m.conta like '21%' and (f.nmdoc = 'Factura' or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') and f.anulado = 0
```

#### `dbo.problemas_Area`(@i date, @f date, @fp_id int, @fp_id_chk int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-07-11 08:41* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `ofch_data_actualizacao` smalldatetime, `ofch_of_id` int, `ofch_descr` nvarchar, `ofch_estado` int, `ofch_gravidade` int, `Estado` varchar(5), `fp_nome` nvarchar, `chefe` nvarchar, `Injustificadas` numeric, `JustifPaga` numeric, `Justif` numeric, `BaixaSegSoc` numeric, `BaixaSegur` numeric, `BaixaSeguroParc` numeric, `Ferias` numeric, `e_id` int, `Est` varchar(15), `ofch_culpa_chefe` bit

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[problemas_Area] 
(	
	@i date, 
	@f date, 
	@fp_id int = null, 
	@fp_id_chk int = 6
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		isnull(ofch_data_actualizacao,offp_datafim) as ofch_data_actualizacao, 
		ofch_of_id, 
		ofch_descr, 
		isnull(ofch_estado,1) as ofch_estado, 
		ofch_gravidade, 
		(case 
			when ofch_gravidade = 1 and ofch_estado = 3 then 'Baixo'
			when ofch_gravidade = 2 and ofch_estado = 3 then 'Médio'
			when ofch_gravidade = 3 and ofch_estado = 3 then 'Alto' else '' end) as Estado, 
		fp_nome, e1.e_nome as chefe,
		coalesce(Inj.tot,0) as Injustificadas, coalesce(JustPag.tot,0) as JustifPaga, coalesce(Just.tot,0) as Justif, coalesce(BaixaSS.tot,0) as BaixaSegSoc, coalesce(BaixaSeguro.tot,0) as BaixaSegur, coalesce(BaixaSeguroP.tot,0) as BaixaSeguroParc, coalesce(Ferias.tot,0) as Ferias,
		e1.e_id, 
		(case when isnull(ofch_estado,1) = 1 then 'OK' when isnull(ofch_estado,1) = 3 then 'Não OK c/ grau:' end) as Est
		, ofch_culpa_chefe
	from
		OF_CHECKLIST
		inner join of_fp on ofch_of_id = offp_of_id and ofch_fp_id = offp_fp_id
		inner join offp_eq as eq1 on offp_id = eq1.offpeq_offp_id and (case when @fp_id = 1 then 1 else eq1.offpeq_chefe end) = (case when @fp_id = 1 then 1 else ofch_culpa_chefe end)
		inner join entidade as e1 on eq1.offpeq_e_id = e1.e_id
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id left join
		(select movent_met_id, movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 4 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@i as date) and cast(@f as date) group by movent_met_id, movent_e_id) as Inj on e_id = Inj.movent_e_id left join 		
		(select movent_met_id, movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 5 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@i as date) and cast(@f as date) group by movent_met_id, movent_e_id) as JustPag on e_id = JustPag.movent_e_id left join 	
		(select movent_met_id, movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 6 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@i as date) and cast(@f as date) group by movent_met_id, movent_e_id) as Just on e_id = Just.movent_e_id left join 	
		(select movent_met_id, movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 7 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@i as date) and cast(@f as date) group by movent_met_id, movent_e_id) as BaixaSS on e_id = BaixaSS.movent_e_id left join 	
		(select movent_met_id, movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 8 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@i as date) and cast(@f as date) group by movent_met_id, movent_e_id) as BaixaSeguro on e_id = BaixaSeguro.movent_e_id left join 	
		(select movent_met_id, movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_desconta_laminador = 1 and movent_met_id = 9 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@i as date) and cast(@f as date) group by movent_met_id, movent_e_id) as BaixaSeguroP on e_id = BaixaSeguroP.movent_e_id left join 	
		(select movent_met_id, movent_e_id,
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_I) < 12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_F) > 13 then datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 - 1 else datediff(n, movent_data_I, movent_data_F)/60.0 end)) as tot
		from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 10 and cast(movent_data_i as date) between cast(@i as date) and cast(@f as date) group by movent_met_id, movent_e_id) as Ferias on e_id = Ferias.movent_e_id
	where 
		--(
		--	(
		--		cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @i and @f
		--		and ofch_estado in (1,3)
		--	)
		--	or 
		--	(
		--		cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) is null
		--		and cast(offp_datafim as date) between @i and @f
		--		and ofch_estado is null

		--	)
		--) 
		cast(ofch_data_actualizacao as date) between @i and @f
		and (ofch_estado in (1,3) or ofch_estado is null)
		and (case when @fp_id is null then 1 else ofch_fp_id end) = isnull(@fp_id,1)		
		and ofch_fp_id_chk = @fp_id_chk
)
```

#### `dbo.problemas_Area_Agrup`(@i date, @f date, @fp_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

**Devolve:** `e_id` int, `chefe` nvarchar, `OFs_OKs` numeric, `OFs_N_OKs` numeric, `OKs` int, `N_OKs` int, `N_OKs_Baixo` int, `N_OKs_Medio` int, `N_OKs_Alto` int, `Injustificadas` numeric, `JustifPaga` numeric, `Justif` numeric, `BaixaSegSoc` numeric, `BaixaSegur` numeric, `BaixaSeguroParc` numeric, `Ferias` numeric, `ano` int, `mes` int, `semana` int, `percentOKs` numeric, `OF_Gravidade_Baixo` int, `OF_Gravidade_Medio` int, `OF_Gravidade_Alto` int, `ofch_culpa_chefe` bit

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[problemas_Area_Agrup]
(	
	@i date,
	@f date,
	@fp_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		e_id, chefe, 
		sum(case when N_OKs = 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as OFs_OKs,
		sum(case when N_OKs > 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as OFs_N_OKs,
		sum(OKs) as OKs, sum(N_OKs) as N_OKs, sum(N_OKs_Baixo) as N_OKs_Baixo, sum(N_OKs_Medio) as N_OKs_Medio, sum(N_OKs_Alto) as N_OKs_Alto,
		Injustificadas, JustifPaga, Justif, BaixaSegSoc, BaixaSegur, BaixaSeguroParc, Ferias, 
		ano,
		mes,
		semana,
		sum(case when N_OKs = 0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end) / count(OKs) as percentOKs,
		sum(case when OF_Gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) OF_Gravidade_Baixo,
		sum(case when OF_Gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) OF_Gravidade_Medio,
		sum(case when OF_Gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) OF_Gravidade_Alto,
		ofch_culpa_chefe
	from
	(select 
		year(ofch_data_actualizacao) as ano,
		month(ofch_data_actualizacao) as mes,
		datepart(ww,ofch_data_actualizacao) as semana,
		ofch_of_id,	
		e_id, 
		chefe,
		sum(case when ofch_estado = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as OKs,
		sum(case when ofch_estado = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as N_OKs,
		sum(case when ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as N_OKs_Baixo,
		sum(case when ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as N_OKs_Medio,
		sum(case when ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as N_OKs_Alto,
		(case
			when sum(case when ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_gravidade = 3 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 3
			when sum(case when ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_gravidade = 2 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 2
			when sum(case when ofch_estado = 3 and ofch_gravidade = 1 then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 1
			else 0
			end
		) as OF_Gravidade,
		Injustificadas, JustifPaga, Justif, BaixaSegSoc, BaixaSegur, BaixaSeguroParc, Ferias,
		ofch_culpa_chefe
	from 
		dbo.problemas_Area(@i,@f,@fp_id,6) 
	group by
		year(ofch_data_actualizacao),
		month(ofch_data_actualizacao),
		datepart(ww,ofch_data_actualizacao),
		ofch_of_id,	
		e_id, 
		chefe,
		Injustificadas, JustifPaga, Justif, BaixaSegSoc, BaixaSegur, BaixaSeguroParc, Ferias,
		ofch_culpa_chefe) as a
	group by 
		ano,
		mes,
		semana,
		e_id, chefe, 
		Injustificadas, JustifPaga, Justif, BaixaSegSoc, BaixaSegur, BaixaSeguroParc, Ferias,
		ofch_culpa_chefe
)
```

#### `dbo.producao_Erro_QuemFezFase`(@erro nvarchar(max), @dI date, @dF date, @fp_Pretendida int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `func` nvarchar, `ofch_gravidade` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `OF_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[producao_Erro_QuemFezFase]
(	
	@erro nvarchar(max), 
	@dI date, 
	@dF date,
	@fp_Pretendida int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		func, ofch_gravidade, e_nome, OF_ID, P_NOME
	from 
		OF_CHECKLIST
		outer apply (select top 1 e_nome as func from OF_FP inner join OFFP_EQ on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID where OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_Pretendida and OFFP_OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as polimento
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on OFCH_OF_ID = OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join ENTIDADE on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID
	where
		cast(OFCH_DATA_ACTUALIZACAO as date) between @dI and @dF
		and OFCH_DESCR = @erro
		and OFCH_GRAVIDADE in (1,2,3)
)
```

#### `dbo.produto_Classes`(@tipo int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

**Devolve:** `tp_id` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `tptp_id` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produto_Classes] 
(	
	@tipo int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	with cte (id, nome, tptp_id, nivel) as
	(
		select tp_id, tp_nome, tp_tp_id, 1 from produto_tipo where tp_id = @tipo
		union all
		select tp_id, tp_nome, tp_tp_id, nivel + 1 from cte inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on id = tp_tp_id
	)

	select id as tp_id, nome as tp_nome, tptp_id from cte
)
```

#### `dbo.produto_NecessidadesFase_OFs`(@prodf_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `v_of`

**Devolve:** `mov_id` int, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `mov_quantidade` float, `mov_of_id` int, `feito` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produto_NecessidadesFase_OFs] 
(	
	@prodf_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select m.mov_id, p_id, p_nome, m.mov_quantidade, m.mov_of_id, isnull(m1.feito,0) as feito
	from produto_fase inner join movimento as m on prodf_p_id = m.mov_p_id inner join produto on prodf_p_id = p_id inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id
		left join (select 
						mov_mov_id, sum((case when mov_tpmov_id = 7 then mov_quantidade else mov_quantidade * -1 end)) as feito 
					from 
						movimento 
					where 
						mov_prodf_id = @prodf_id and mov_mov_id is not null 
					group by 
						mov_mov_id) as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id
	where prodf_id = @prodf_id and of_datafim is null
)
```

#### `dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades`(@p_id int, @dataTransporte date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-05-12 14:09 · modificado 2026-01-14 10:00* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `pId` int, `produto` nvarchar, `stock` float, `necessidadesOfs` float, `necessidadesPedidos` float, `necTotal` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produto_Stock_Necessidades]
(	
	@p_id int,
	@dataTransporte date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		z.pId,
		z.produto,
		isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then z.qtd else 0 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then z.qtd else 0 end),0) stock,
		sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 4 and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and of_id < 10000000 then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end) necessidadesOfs,
		sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 12 and MOV_E_ID <> 19747 and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and MOV_OF_ID is null then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end) necessidadesPedidos,
		case when z.pId = @p_id 
				then sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 4 and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and of_id < 10000000 
					then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end) + sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 12 and MOV_E_ID <> 19747 and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and MOV_OF_ID is null then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end)
			when isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then z.qtd else 0 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then z.qtd else 0 end),0) > sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 4 and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and of_id < 10000000 then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end) + sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 12 and MOV_E_ID <> 19747 and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and MOV_OF_ID is null then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end)
				then 0
			when isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then z.qtd else 0 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then z.qtd else 0 end),0) > 0 
				then sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 4 and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and of_id < 10000000 then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end) + sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 12 and MOV_E_ID <> 19747 and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and MOV_OF_ID is null then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end) - (isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then z.qtd else 0 end),0) - isnull(sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then z.qtd else 0 end),0))
				else sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 4 and of_e_id_enc <> 19747 and of_id < 10000000 then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end) + sum(case when mov_tpmov_id = 12 and MOV_E_ID <> 19747 and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0 and MOV_OF_ID is null then z.qtd * z.qtdComp else 0 end)
			end necTotal
	from
		(select
			mov_p_id pId, p.p_nome produto, mov_tpmov_id, of_e_id_enc, of_id, MOV_E_ID, MOV_SATISFEITO, MOV_OF_ID, mov_quantidade qtd, 1 qtdComp, isnull(eof.e_nome, emov.e_nome) cliente, isnull(pof.p_nome, p.p_nome) Modelo
		from
			movimento
			inner join produto p on mov_p_id = p.p_id
			left join entidade eMov on mov_e_id = eMov.e_id
			left join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			left join produto pOf on of_p_id = pOf.P_ID
			left join entidade eOf on of_e_id_enc = eOf.e_id
		where
			mov_p_id = @p_id
			and mov_tpmov_id in (1,2,4,12)
			and case when @dataTransporte is null or len(MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID) > 5 then '1982/05/10' else tr_data end <= case when @dataTransporte is null or len(MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID) > 5 then '1982/05/11' else @dataTransporte end
		union all
		select
			mov_p_id pId, p.p_nome produto, mov_tpmov_id, of_e_id_enc, of_id, MOV_E_ID, MOV_SATISFEITO, MOV_OF_ID, mov_quantidade qtd, comp_quantidade qtdComp, isnull(eof.e_nome, emov.e_nome) cliente, isnull(pof.p_nome, p.p_nome) Modelo
		from
			produto_componente 
			inner join movimento on comp_p_id = mov_p_id 
			inner join produto p on mov_p_id = p.p_id
			left join entidade eMov on mov_e_id = eMov.e_id
			left join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id
			left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
			left join produto pOf on of_p_id = pOf.P_ID
			left join entidade eOf on of_e_id_enc = eOf.e_id
		where
			comp_p_p_id = @p_id
			and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
			and mov_tpmov_id in (1,2,4,12)
			and case when @dataTransporte is null or len(MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID) > 5 then '1982/05/10' else tr_data end <= case when @dataTransporte is null or len(MOV_SHOP_ORDER_ID) > 5 then '1982/05/11' else @dataTransporte end) z
	group by 
		z.pId,
		z.produto
)
```

#### `dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista`(@p_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2025-06-06 10:30 · modificado 2026-05-13 15:19* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `of_id` int, `Modelo` nvarchar, `cliente` nvarchar, `DataOf` date, `Quantidade` float, `Estado` nvarchar, `Sai` varchar(1), `Origem` nvarchar, `mov_id` int, `mov_atrib_id` int, `mov_mov_id` int, `Transporte` varchar(1)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista]
(	
	@p_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		of_id, isnull(pof.p_nome, p.p_nome) Modelo, isnull(eof.e_nome, emov.e_nome) cliente, cast(of_data as date) DataOf, m.mov_quantidade Quantidade, fp_nome Estado, '' Sai, isnull(p1.p_nome,'') Origem, m.mov_id, m.mov_atrib_id, m.mov_mov_id, '' Transporte 
	from
		movimento m
		inner join produto p on m.mov_p_id = p.p_id
		left join entidade eMov on m.mov_e_id = eMov.e_id
		left join movimento m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id
		left join produto p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id
		left join ordemfabrico on m.mov_of_id = of_id
		left join produto pOf on of_p_id = pOf.P_ID
		left join entidade eOf on of_e_id_enc = eOf.e_id
		left join FASES_PRODUCAO on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		m.mov_p_id = @p_id
		and m.mov_tpmov_id = 4
		and of_id < 10000000
		and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747
	union all
	select
		of_id, isnull(pof.p_nome, p.p_nome) Modelo, isnull(eof.e_nome, emov.e_nome) cliente, cast(of_data as date) DataOf, mov_quantidade Quantidade, fp_nome Estado, '' Sai, '' Origem, mov_id, mov_atrib_id, mov_mov_id, '' Transporte  
	from
		movimento
		inner join produto p on mov_p_id = p.p_id
		left join entidade eMov on mov_e_id = eMov.e_id
		left join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id
		left join produto pOf on of_p_id = pOf.P_ID
		left join entidade eOf on of_e_id_enc = eOf.e_id
		left join FASES_PRODUCAO on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		mov_p_id = @p_id
		and mov_tpmov_id = 12
		and of_id is null
		and mov_satisfeito = 0
		and mov_e_id <> 19747
	union all
	select
		null of_id, p.p_nome Modelo, null cliente, null DataOf, 
		case when x.stock > sum(mov_quantidade * comp_quantidade) then 0 when x.stock < 0 then sum(mov_quantidade * comp_quantidade) else sum(mov_quantidade * comp_quantidade) - x.stock end Quantidade, 
		'' Estado, '' Sai, '' Origem, null mov_id, null mov_atrib_id, null mov_mov_id, '' Transporte  
	from
		produto_componente 
		inner join movimento on comp_p_id = mov_p_id 
		inner join produto p on mov_p_id = p.p_id
		outer apply (select mov_p_id id, sum(mov_quantidade * case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then -1 else 1 end) stock from movimento where mov_p_id = p_id and mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) group by mov_p_id) x
		left join entidade eMov on mov_e_id = eMov.e_id
		left join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id
		left join produto pOf on of_p_id = pOf.P_ID
		left join entidade eOf on of_e_id_enc = eOf.e_id
		left join FASES_PRODUCAO on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		comp_p_p_id = @p_id
		and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
		and mov_tpmov_id = 4
		and of_id < 10000000
		and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747
	group by
		mov_p_id, p.p_nome, mov_tpmov_id, MOV_SATISFEITO, x.stock, comp_quantidade
	union all
	select
		null of_id, p.p_nome Modelo, null cliente, cast(of_data as date) DataOf, 
		sum(mov_quantidade) Quantidade, 
		fp_nome Estado, '' Sai, '' Origem, null mov_id, null mov_atrib_id, null mov_mov_id, '' Transporte  
	from
		produto_componente 
		inner join movimento on comp_p_id = mov_p_id 
		inner join produto p on mov_p_id = p.p_id
		outer apply (select mov_p_id id, sum(mov_quantidade * case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then -1 else 1 end) stock from movimento where mov_p_id = p_id and mov_tpmov_id in (1,2) group by mov_p_id) x
		left join entidade eMov on mov_e_id = eMov.e_id
		left join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id
		left join produto pOf on of_p_id = pOf.P_ID
		left join entidade eOf on of_e_id_enc = eOf.e_id
		left join FASES_PRODUCAO on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where
		comp_p_p_id = @p_id
		and comp_tpcomp_id = 2
		and mov_tpmov_id = 12
		and of_id is null
		and mov_satisfeito = 0
		and mov_e_id <> 19747
	group by
		mov_p_id, p.p_nome, mov_tpmov_id, MOV_SATISFEITO, x.stock, comp_quantidade, fp_nome, of_data
)
```

#### `dbo.produto_tipos_de_camada`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

**Devolve:** `id` int, `nome` nvarchar, `pai` int, `nivel` int, `ordem` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produto_tipos_de_camada] 
(

RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	with cte (id, nome, pai, nivel, ordem) as 
	(
		select tpcam_id, tpcam_nome, isnull(tpcam_tpcam_id_pai,-1), 1, tpcam_ordem from produto_camada_tipo where tpcam_tpcam_id_pai is null
		union all
		select tpcam_id, tpcam_nome, tpcam_tpcam_id_pai, nivel + 1, tpcam_ordem from produto_camada_tipo inner join cte on tpcam_tpcam_id_pai = id
	)

	select * from cte --order by nivel, nome
)
```

#### `dbo.produtoDetalhe`(@p_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-07-28 15:29 · modificado 2025-06-11 11:23* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`, `peso`, `disciplina`

**Devolve:** `P_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `P_NOME_EN` nvarchar, `P_DESCRICAO` nvarchar, `P_DESCRICAO_EN` nvarchar, `P_TP_ID` int, `P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA` int, `P_PRECOCUSTO` float, `P_PRECODEALER` float, `P_PRECOVENDA` float, `P_EAN` decimal, `P_COD_PAUTAL` nvarchar, `P_PCONT_ID` int, `P_FABRICOINTERNO` bit, `P_TEM_STOCK` bit, `P_LOJA` bit, `P_DESCONTINUADO` bit, `P_DESENVOLVIMENTO` bit, `P_SAIDAS_AUTO` bit, `P_ARM_ID` int, `P_UNI_ID` int, `P_UNI_ID_MOVIMENTOS` int, `P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR` float, `stock` float, `necessidades` float, `encomendas` nvarchar, `consumido` float, `media` float, `P_PONTO_ENCOMENDA` int, `P_QTDENCOMENDA` float, `P_STOCKMIN` float, `P_STOCK_LINHA` bit, `P_RESINA_MIX` bit, `P_PECAS_CICLO` int, `P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA` int, `P_QTD_MONTAGEM` int, `P_CICLO_2PX` bit, `P_CICLO_PRENSA` bit, `P_REF_UNIV` nvarchar, `P_E_ID_RESP` int, `P_E_ID` int, `P_COEFICIENTE` float, `P_QTD_RESINA` float, `P_PESOLAM` float, `P_PESOACAB` float, `P_QTDDECK` float, `P_QTDCASCO` float, `P_QTDDECK_REAL` float, `P_QTDCASCO_REAL` float, `P_COMPRIMENTO` float, `P_LARGURA` float, `P_ALTURA` float, `P_NP_ID` int, `P_M_ID` int, `P_TAM_ID` int, `P_L_ID` int, `P_PL_ID` int, `P_GERA_OF` bit

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produtoDetalhe]
(	
	@p_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		P_ID, P_NOME, isnull(P_NOME_EN,'') P_NOME_EN, P_DESCRICAO, isnull(P_DESCRICAO_EN,'') P_DESCRICAO_EN, P_TP_ID, P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA,
		(case 
			when P_TP_ID = 84 
				then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Construcao(p_id, null),0)
			when P_NP_ID is not null and P_M_ID is not null and P_TAM_ID is not null
				then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(p_id, null),0)
			when p_fabricointerno = 1 
				then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) 
			else p_precocusto 
		end) P_PRECOCUSTO,
		P_PRECODEALER, P_PRECOVENDA, isnull(P_EAN,0) P_EAN, P_COD_PAUTAL, P_PCONT_ID,
		P_FABRICOINTERNO, P_TEM_STOCK, P_LOJA, P_DESCONTINUADO, P_DESENVOLVIMENTO,
		cast(P_SAIDAS_AUTO as bit) P_SAIDAS_AUTO, P_ARM_ID, P_UNI_ID, P_UNI_ID_MOVIMENTOS, P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR,
		case when P_TEM_STOCK = 1 then isnull(z.entradas,0) - isnull(z.saidas,0) else 0 end stock,
		isnull(n.qtd,0) necessidades,
		CAST(isnull(z.pedidos,0) as nvarchar(max)) + '/' + CAST(isnull(z.pedidosNAprovados,0) as nvarchar(max)) encomendas,
		isnull(z.consumido,0) consumido,
		cast(0.0 as float) media,
		P_PONTO_ENCOMENDA, P_QTDENCOMENDA, P_STOCKMIN, P_STOCK_LINHA, P_RESINA_MIX,
		P_PECAS_CICLO, P_NUM_CICLOS_DIA, P_QTD_MONTAGEM, P_CICLO_2PX, P_CICLO_PRENSA,
		isnull(P_REF_UNIV,'') P_REF_UNIV, P_E_ID_RESP, P_E_ID, P_COEFICIENTE, P_QTD_RESINA, P_PESOLAM,
		P_PESOACAB, P_QTDDECK, P_QTDCASCO, P_QTDDECK_REAL, P_QTDCASCO_REAL,
		P_COMPRIMENTO, P_LARGURA, P_ALTURA, P_NP_ID, P_M_ID, P_TAM_ID,
		P_L_ID, P_PL_ID, P_GERA_OF
	from 
		PRODUTO
		outer apply (select sum(quantidade) qtd from dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades_Lista(p_id)) n
		outer apply (select
						SUM(case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then mov_quantidade else 0 end) entradas,
						SUM(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then mov_quantidade else 0 end) saidas,
						SUM(case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 and mov_data >= dateadd(month,-12,getdate()) then mov_quantidade else 0 end) consumido,
						--SUM(case when mov_tpmov_id in (4,12) then mov_quantidade else 0 end) necessidades,
						SUM(case when mov_tpmov_id = 9 and MOV_DATA_APROVADO is not null then mov_quantidade - ISNULL(y.ent,0) else 0 end) pedidos,
						SUM(case when mov_tpmov_id = 9 and MOV_DATA_APROVADO is null then mov_quantidade else 0 end) pedidosNAprovados
					from
						MOVIMENTO n
						outer apply (select SUM(mov_quantidade) ent from MOVIMENTO m where m.MOV_MOV_ID = n.MOV_ID and n.MOV_TPMOV_ID = 9 ) y
					where
						MOV_P_ID = P_ID
						and MOV_TPMOV_ID in (1,2,9)
						--and MOV_TPMOV_ID in (1,2,4,9,12)
						and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0) z
	where
		P_ID = @p_id
)
```

#### `dbo.produtoTipo_Necessidades`(@fp_id int, @dt_Tr date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2025-10-02 16:42* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `Tipo` nvarchar, `Id` int, `Produto` nvarchar, `StockMin` float, `Stock` float, `Necessidades` float, `planeados` float, `a_Repor_Urg` float, `a_Repor` float, `stockFase` int, `emProcesso` float, `tempoMin` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produtoTipo_Necessidades] 
(	
	@fp_id int,
	@dt_Tr date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct
		tp_nome + isnull(' (sai: ' + fp_nome + ')','') as Tipo, p_id as Id, p_nome as Produto, 
		p_stockmin as StockMin, isnull(movs.entradas,0) - isnull(movs.saidas,0) as Stock, 
		--isnull(round(movs.necess,0),0) as Necessidades, 
		--coalesce(round(nec.total,2),0) + ISNULL(necDeriv.Quantidade,0) Necessidades,
		isnull(zx.necTotal,0) Necessidades, 
		case when p_gera_of = 1 then isnull(plano.planeados,0) else isnull(planeadoMovs,0) end planeados,
		(case when (isnull(movs.entradas,0) - isnull(movs.saidas,0)) - isnull(zx.necTotal,0) + isnull(plano.planeados,0) < 0
			then ((isnull(movs.entradas,0) - isnull(movs.saidas,0)) - isnull(zx.necTotal,0) + isnull(plano.planeados,0)) * -1
			else 0 end) as a_Repor_Urg, 
		(case when p_stockmin - (isnull(movs.entradas,0) - isnull(movs.saidas,0)) + isnull(zx.necTotal,0) - isnull(plano.planeados,0) > 0
			then p_stockmin - (isnull(movs.entradas,0) - isnull(movs.saidas,0)) + isnull(zx.necTotal,0) - isnull(plano.planeados,0)
			else 0 end) as a_Repor, 
		isnull(stFase.stockFase,0) stockFase,
		case when p_gera_of = 1 then isnull(emProc.emProcesso,0) else isnull(planeadoMovs - planeadoMovsFeitos,0) end emProcesso,
		case when PRODF_TEMPO > 0 then PRODF_TEMPO else isnull(mdo.qtd,0) * 60.0 end as tempoMin
	from 
		produto_tipo 
		left join FASES_PRODUCAO on tp_fp_id = fp_id
		inner join produto pp on tp_id = p_tp_id
		inner join produto_fase on p_id = prodf_p_id
		left join (select 
						mov_p_id, 
						sum((case when mov_tpmov_id = 1 then mov_quantidade else 0 end)) as entradas,
						sum((case when mov_tpmov_id = 2 then mov_quantidade else 0 end)) as saidas--,
						--sum((case when mov_tpmov_id in (4,12) and (MOV_OF_ID < 10000000 or MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 or MOV_OF_ID is null or tp_id is not null) and (@dt_Tr is null or cast(tr_data as date) <= @dt_Tr) then mov_quantidade else 0 end)) + isnull(xxx.qtd,0) as necess
					from
						movimento m
						left join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id
						left join produto on OF_P_ID = p_id 
						left join dbo.produto_Classes(1) on P_TP_ID = tp_id
						left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id --and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < GETDATE())
						left join (select id, sum(q) as qtd from 
							(select 
								COMP_P_P_ID as id, 
								case when (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end) < 0 then 0
									else (SUM(mov_quantidade) * COMP_QUANTIDADE) - (case when isnull(st.stock,0) < 0 then 0 else isnull(st.stock,0) end)
								end as q 
							from 
								PRODUTO_COMPONENTE 
								inner join MOVIMENTO on COMP_P_ID = MOV_P_ID 
								inner join ordemfabrico on mov_of_id = of_id 
								left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id 
								left join (select p_id as pId, SUM(Stock) as stock from [dbo].[produto_stocks_por_armazem] group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_ID = st.pId
							where 
								COMP_TPCOMP_ID = 2 
								and case when @dt_Tr is null then getdate() else tr_data end between getdate() and isnull(@dt_Tr,dateadd(month,1,getdate()))
								and of_fp_id not in (9,10,12,13,14)
								/*and TR_ID not in (select distinct trdt_tr_id from TRANSP_DATAS where TRDT_DATA_ACTUAL < @data)*/
							group by 
								COMP_P_P_ID, COMP_QUANTIDADE, st.stock) as x
						group by id) as xxx on m.MOV_P_ID = xxx.id 
					where	
						mov_tpmov_id in (1,2/*,4*/)
						or (mov_tpmov_id = 12 and mov_of_id is null and MOV_E_ID <> 19747 and  /*len(mov_shop_order_id) > 5 and*/ MOV_SATISFEITO = 0)
					group by 
						mov_p_id, xxx.qtd) as movs on p_id = movs.mov_p_id
		left join (select 	
						comp_p_id as id,
						comp_quantidade as qtd
					from 
						produto_componente 
						inner join fases_producao on comp_p_p_id = fp_p_id
					where 
						fp_id = @fp_id) as mdo on p_id = mdo.id
		left join (select
						of_p_id,
						COUNT(of_id) planeados
					from
						ORDEMFABRICO
						inner join OF_FP on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
					where
						OFFP_FP_ID = @fp_id
						--and cast(OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA as date) >= cast(dateadd(week,-2,GETDATE()) as date)
						and year(OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA) = year(getdate()) and datepart(WEEK,OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA) = datepart(WEEK,getdate())
						and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
					group by
						OF_P_ID) plano on P_ID = plano.OF_P_ID
		left join (select
						m.mov_p_id, sum(m.mov_quantidade) planeadoMovs, isnull(sum(mf.mov_quantidade),0) planeadoMovsFeitos
					from 
						movimento m
						left join movimento mf on m.mov_id = mf.mov_mov_id
					where
						m.mov_tpmov_id = 15 
						and year(m.mov_data) = year(getdate()) and datepart(WEEK,m.mov_data) = datepart(WEEK,getdate())
					group by
						m.mov_p_id) planoMovs on p_id = planoMovs.mov_p_id
		left join (select
						of_p_id,
						COUNT(of_id) stockFase
					from
						ORDEMFABRICO
					where
						OF_FP_ID = @fp_id
					group by
						OF_P_ID) stFase on P_ID = stFase.OF_P_ID
		left join (select 
						OF_P_ID, count(of_id) emProcesso
					from
						ORDEMFABRICO
						inner join OF_FP on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = @fp_id and OFFP_DATAFIM is not null
					where
						OF_FP_ID not in (9,49,50,12)
					group by
						OF_P_ID) emProc on P_ID = emProc.OF_P_ID 
		outer apply (select sum(necTotal) necTotal from dbo.produto_Stock_Necessidades(p_id, @dt_Tr)) zx
		-- outer apply (select 
		--				mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as total 
		--			from 
		--				movimento left join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = of_id and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747 
		--				left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		--			where 
		--				MOV_P_ID = p_id 
		--				and case when @dt_Tr is null then '2000/01/01' else TR_DATA end <= case when @dt_Tr is null then '2001/01/01' else @dt_Tr end
		--				and ((mov_tpmov_id = 4 and (MOV_OF_ID < 10000000 or MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1)) 
		--					or (mov_tpmov_id = 12 and MOV_E_ID <> 19747 and mov_satisfeito = 0 and (MOV_OF_ID is null or len(mov_shop_order_id) > 5))) 
		--			group by mov_p_id) as nec
		--outer apply (select 
		--				COMP_P_P_ID id, sum((case when movs.stock - movs.necessidades - p_stockmin < 0 then (movs.stock - movs.necessidades - p_stockmin) * -1 else movs.stock - movs.necessidades - p_stockmin end) * comp_quantidade) as Quantidade
		--			from 
		--				produto 
		--				inner join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_id left join 
		--				(select 
		--						mov_p_id as pId, sum(case when MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 then MOV_QUANTIDADE else 0 end) - sum(case when MOV_TPMOV_ID = 2 then MOV_QUANTIDADE else 0 end) as stock, sum(case when MOV_TPMOV_ID = 4 then MOV_QUANTIDADE else 0 end) as necessidades
		--					from
		--						movimento 
		--						left join ORDEMFABRICO on MOV_OF_ID = of_id and OF_E_ID_ENC <> 19747 
		--						left join transporte on of_tr_id = tr_id
		--					where 
		--						case when @dt_Tr is null then '2000/01/01' else TR_DATA end <= case when @dt_Tr is null then '2001/01/01' else @dt_Tr end
		--						and (MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1
		--						or  MOV_TPMOV_ID = 2
		--						or (MOV_TPMOV_ID = 4
		--							and (mov_of_id < 10000000
		--								or MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1))
		--						or (MOV_TPMOV_ID = 12
		--							and MOV_OF_ID is null
		--							and MOV_SATISFEITO = 0
		--							and MOV_E_ID <> 19747))
		--					group by MOV_P_ID) as movs on P_ID = movs.pId
		--			where 
		--				p_tp_id not in (select a.tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1) a) 
		--				and comp_p_p_id = pp.p_id 
		--				and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 
		--				and movs.stock - movs.necessidades - p_stockmin < 0 
		--				and movs.necessidades > 0.0 
		--			group by 
		--				COMP_P_P_ID) necDeriv
	where
		p_activo = 1
		and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		and p_descontinuado = 0
		and prodf_fp_id = @fp_id 
		and prodf_data_eliminado is null 
		and prodf_prodf_id is null
		and tp_tp_id <> 1
		and (P_TP_ID not in (select a.tp_id from dbo.produto_Classes(1) a) or P_TP_ID in (331,383,262,439,160) /*DD Pagaias,Ocean P1*/)
)
```

#### `dbo.provas_ListaOFsRental`(@inicio date, @fim date, @prvId int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-07-31 08:48 · modificado 2026-01-16 09:55* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `preco`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `ofId` int, `modelo` nvarchar, `referencia` nvarchar, `estado` nvarchar, `dtMaxAntes` date, `descrAntes` nvarchar, `dtMinDepois` date, `descrDepois` nvarchar, `provaAntes` nvarchar, `dtFimAntes` date, `provaDepois` nvarchar, `dtInicioDepois` date, `Cliente` nvarchar, `receita` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[provas_ListaOFsRental]
(	
	@inicio date, @fim date, @prvId int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		of_id ofId, p_nome modelo, of_referencia referencia, fp_nome estado, tr.dtMaxAntes, tr.descrAntes, tr_d.dtMinDepois, tr_d.descrDepois, prv.provaAntes, prv.dtFimAntes, prv_d.provaDepois, prv_d.dtInicioDepois, e_nome Cliente, isnull(rec.receita, 0) receita
	from 
		ordemfabrico 
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id 
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id 
		outer apply (select top 1 trof_of_id, tr_data dtMaxAntes, tr_descricao descrAntes from transp_of inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data < @inicio and of_id = trof_of_id order by tr_data desc) tr 
		outer apply (select top 1 trof_of_id, tr_data dtMinDepois, tr_descricao descrDepois from transp_of inner join transporte on trof_tr_id = tr_id where tr_data > @fim and  of_id = trof_of_id order by tr_data desc) tr_d
		outer apply (select top 1 PRV_NOME provaAntes, PRV_DATA_F dtFimAntes from PROVAS_OF inner join PROVAS on PRVOF_PRV_ID = PRV_ID where PRVOF_OF_ID = OF_ID and PRV_DATA_I < @inicio and prv_data_eliminado is null order by PRV_DATA_I desc) prv
		outer apply (select top 1 PRV_NOME provaDepois, PRV_DATA_I dtInicioDepois from PROVAS_OF inner join PROVAS on PRVOF_PRV_ID = PRV_ID where PRVOF_OF_ID = OF_ID and PRV_DATA_I > @fim and prv_data_eliminado is null order by PRV_DATA_I desc) prv_d
		outer apply (select prvof_of_id OfId, cast(sum(PRVB_PRECO) as float) receita from provas inner join provas_of on prv_id = prvof_prv_id left join provas_booking on prv_id = prvb_prv_id and prvb_of_id = prvof_of_id inner join PAISES_SITE p on prv_pais_id = p.ID where prvof_of_id = of_id and prv_data_i <= getdate() and prv_data_eliminado is null and prvb_id is not null group by prvof_of_id) rec
	where 
		of_e_id_enc in (31903, 35967, 23397, 34656, 40544, case when @prvId = 41 then 38844 else 0 end, case when @prvId = 44 then 40634 else 0 end)
		and of_id not in (select prvof_of_id from provas_of where prvof_prv_id = @prvId)
		and of_id < 10000000
)
```

#### `dbo.provasListaOfsDeModelo`(@provaId int, @modelo nvarchar(max))
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-08-27 13:18 · modificado 2024-08-27 14:49* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `OfId` int, `Modelo` nvarchar, `Referencia` nvarchar, `Estado` nvarchar, `Acabado` date

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION provasListaOfsDeModelo 
(	
	@provaId int, @modelo nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		of_id OfId, p_nome Modelo, OF_REFERENCIA Referencia, FP_NOME Estado, cast(of_datafim as date) Acabado
	from
		PROVAS_OF
		inner join ORDEMFABRICO on PRVOF_OF_ID = OF_ID
		inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		inner join fases_producao on of_fp_id = fp_id
	where 
		prvof_prv_id = @provaId
		and P_NOME = @modelo
		and of_id not in (select prvb_of_id from PROVAS_BOOKING where PRVB_PRV_ID = @provaId and PRVB_OF_ID > 0)
)
```

#### `dbo.Rental_Bookings`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-02-14 11:07 · modificado 2022-02-14 11:07*

#### `dbo.Rental_Provas_Bookings_Boats`(@booking_id int)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-03-30 16:36 · modificado 2022-04-05 09:37* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`

**Devolve:** `Modelo` nvarchar(1534), `qty` int, `Atribuidos` int, `remarks` ntext

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Rental_Provas_Bookings_Boats] 
(	
	@booking_id int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select  
        b.Modelo, b.qty, isnull(y.Atribuidos,0) Atribuidos , remarks 
    from  
        (select 
				booking_id, type + ' ' + model + ' ' + size Modelo, qty, remarks
			from 
				openquery([RENTAL], 
				'select 
					bi.booking_id, bb.type, bb.model, bb.size, bi.qty, bi.remarks
				from 
					nelopt_rental.events_booking ev 
					inner join nelopt_rental.events_booking_items bi on ev.id = bi.booking_id 
					inner join nelopt_rental.events_boats b on bi.boat_id = b.id 
					inner join nelopt_rental.boats bb on b.boat_id = bb.id')
			where
					booking_id = @booking_id) b  
            left join (select OFR_BOOKING_ID, p_nome, COUNT(of_id) Atribuidos
						from 
							OF_RENTAL_PROVAS 
					        inner join ORDEMFABRICO on OFR_OF_ID = OF_ID  
							inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
						where
							OFR_BOOKING_ID = @booking_id
						group by
							OFR_BOOKING_ID, p_nome) y on b.booking_id = y.OFR_BOOKING_ID and y.P_NOME like b.Modelo + '%'
)
```

#### `dbo.ReparacoesProvas_ListaOfs`(@dt smalldatetime)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2023-04-14 12:09 · modificado 2023-04-18 15:51* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`, `reparac`

**Devolve:** `RepId` int, `Equipa` nvarchar, `Atleta` nvarchar, `Contacto` nvarchar, `REP_NOTAS` nvarchar, `OfId` int, `Modelo` nvarchar, `Estado` nvarchar, `ROFFP_E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `ROFFP_ID` int, `FP_ID` int, `Laminagem` bit, `Pintura` bit, `Verniz` bit, `Cura` bit, `Lixagem` bit, `Polimento` bit, `Montagem` bit, `LaminagemFim` smalldatetime, `PinturaFim` smalldatetime, `VernizFim` smalldatetime, `CuraFim` smalldatetime, `LixagemFim` smalldatetime, `PolimentoFim` smalldatetime, `MontagemFim` smalldatetime

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ReparacoesProvas_ListaOfs] 
(	
	@dt smalldatetime
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		REP_ID RepId, REP_EQUIPA Equipa, REP_ATLETA Atleta, REP_CONTACTO Contacto, REP_NOTAS, isnull(OF_ID,0) OfId, isnull(p_nome, '') Modelo, isnull(FP_NOME,'Pronto') Estado, isnull(ROFFP_E_ID,0) ROFFP_E_ID, isnull(E_NOME, '') E_NOME, isnull(a.ROFFP_ID,0) ROFFP_ID, isnull(FP_ID,0) FP_ID,
		cast(case when laminagem.roffp_id is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Laminagem,
		cast(case when pintura.roffp_id is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Pintura,
		cast(case when verniz.roffp_id is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Verniz,
		cast(case when cura.roffp_id is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Cura,
		cast(case when lixagem.roffp_id is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Lixagem,
		cast(case when polimento.roffp_id is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Polimento,
		cast(case when montagem.roffp_id is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) Montagem,
		laminagem.roffp_data_f LaminagemFim,
		pintura.roffp_data_f PinturaFim,
		verniz.roffp_data_f VernizFim,
		cura.roffp_data_f CuraFim,
		lixagem.roffp_data_f LixagemFim,
		polimento.roffp_data_f PolimentoFim,
		montagem.roffp_data_f MontagemFim
	from 
		reparacoes_provas 
		outer apply (select top 1 OF_ID, P_NOME from REP_OF_FP inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on roffp_fp_id = fp_id inner join ORDEMFABRICO on roffp_of_id = OF_ID inner join produto on OF_P_ID = P_ID where roffp_rep_id = rep_id order by roffp_sequencia) o
		outer apply (select top 1 roffp_id, roffp_e_id, E_NOME, fp_id, fp_nome from REP_OF_FP inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on roffp_fp_id = fp_id left join entidade on ROFFP_E_ID = E_ID where roffp_rep_id = rep_id and roffp_data_f is null order by roffp_sequencia) a 
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 1) laminagem
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 18) pintura
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 73) verniz
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 2) cura
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 40) lixagem
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 42) polimento
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 46) montagem
	where REP_ENTREGA = @dt 
)
```

#### `dbo.ReparacoesProvas_ListaOfs_Fases`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2023-04-14 12:09 · modificado 2023-04-18 15:57* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `producao`, `reparac`

**Devolve:** `REP_ID` int, `REP_EQUIPA` nvarchar, `REP_ATLETA` nvarchar, `REP_ENTREGA` smalldatetime, `OF_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `ROFFP_ID` int, `FP_ID` int, `FP_NOME` nvarchar, `Estado` int, `ROFFP_SEQUENCIA` int, `ROFFP_DATA_I` smalldatetime, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `LamId` int, `LamDt` smalldatetime, `PintId` int, `PintDt` smalldatetime, `VernizId` int, `VernizDt` smalldatetime, `CuraId` int, `CuraDt` smalldatetime, `LixId` int, `LixDt` smalldatetime, `PoliId` int, `PoliDt` smalldatetime, `MontId` int, `MontDt` smalldatetime, `REP_NOTAS` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ReparacoesProvas_ListaOfs_Fases]
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select
		REP_ID, REP_EQUIPA, REP_ATLETA, REP_ENTREGA, OF_ID, P_NOME, rf.ROFFP_ID, FP_ID, FP_NOME, dbo.VerificaEstadoOF_ReparacoesProvas(OF_ID) Estado, ROFFP_SEQUENCIA, ROFFP_DATA_I, E_ID, E_NOME,
		laminagem.ROFFP_ID LamId, laminagem.ROFFP_DATA_F LamDt,
		pintura.ROFFP_ID PintId, pintura.ROFFP_DATA_F PintDt,
		verniz.ROFFP_ID VernizId, verniz.ROFFP_DATA_F VernizDt,
		cura.ROFFP_ID CuraId, cura.ROFFP_DATA_F CuraDt,
		lixagem.ROFFP_ID LixId, lixagem.ROFFP_DATA_F LixDt,
		polimento.ROFFP_ID PoliId,	polimento.ROFFP_DATA_F PoliDt,
		montagem.ROFFP_ID MontId, montagem.ROFFP_DATA_F MontDt,
		REP_NOTAS
	from
		REPARACOES_PROVAS
		inner join REP_OF_FP rf on REP_ID = ROFFP_REP_ID
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on ROFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
		left join ENTIDADE on ROFFP_E_ID = E_ID
		left join ORDEMFABRICO on ROFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID
		left join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 1) laminagem
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 18) pintura
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 73) verniz
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 2) cura
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 40) lixagem
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 42) polimento
		outer apply (select roffp_id, roffp_data_f from REP_OF_FP where ROFFP_REP_ID = REP_ID and ROFFP_FP_ID = 46) montagem
	where
		rf.ROFFP_DATA_F is null
)
```

#### `dbo.report_BarcosAcabados_PesoOK`(@dI date, @dF date, @desvio float)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-07-09 09:12 · modificado 2019-07-09 09:12* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `peso`, `disciplina`

**Devolve:** `ano` int, `mes` int, `TP_NOME` nvarchar, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `P_PESOACAB` float, `Barcos` int, `media` float, `Oks` int, `N_Oks` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION report_BarcosAcabados_PesoOK
(	
	@dI date = '2019/06/01', 
	@dF date = '2019/07/01', 
	@desvio float = 0.25
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		year(@dF) + 10 as ano, 
		0 as mes, 
		TP_NOME, 
		P_NOME, 
		P_PESOACAB, 
		COUNT(of_id) as Barcos, 
		round(avg(P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO),2) as media, 
		sum(case when P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO between @desvio * -1 and @desvio then 1 else 0 end) as Oks, 
		sum(case when P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO not between @desvio * -1 and @desvio then 1 else 0 end) as N_Oks
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA = TP_ID
		cross apply (select top 1 offp_of_id, offp_peso from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 8 and OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as pesos 
	where
		cast(OF_DATAFIM as date) between @dI and @dF
		and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		and P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO between -3 and 3
	group by
		TP_NOME, P_NOME, P_PESOACAB
	union
	select 
		year(@dF) + 5 as ano, 
		DATEPART(week,OF_DATAFIM) as mes, 
		TP_NOME, 
		P_NOME, 
		P_PESOACAB, 
		COUNT(of_id) as Barcos, 
		round(avg(P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO),2) as media, 
		sum(case when P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO between @desvio * -1 and @desvio then 1 else 0 end) as Oks, 
		sum(case when P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO not between @desvio * -1 and @desvio then 1 else 0 end) as N_Oks
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA = TP_ID
		cross apply (select top 1 offp_of_id, offp_peso from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 8 and OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as pesos 
	where
		cast(OF_DATAFIM as date) between DATEADD(week,-3,dateadd(day, (datepart(weekday, @dF)-1)*-1,@dF)) and @dF
		and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		and P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO between -3 and 3
	group by
		TP_NOME, P_NOME, P_PESOACAB, DATEPART(week,OF_DATAFIM)
	union
	select 
		year(OF_DATAFIM) as ano, 
		month(OF_DATAFIM) as mes, 
		TP_NOME, 
		P_NOME, 
		P_PESOACAB, 
		COUNT(of_id) as Barcos, 
		round(avg(P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO),2) as media, 
		sum(case when P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO between @desvio * -1 and @desvio then 1 else 0 end) as Oks, 
		sum(case when P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO not between @desvio * -1 and @desvio then 1 else 0 end) as N_Oks
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA = TP_ID
		cross apply (select top 1 offp_of_id, offp_peso from OF_FP where OFFP_FP_ID = 8 and OFFP_OF_ID = OF_ID order by OFFP_DATAINICIO) as pesos 
	where
		cast(OF_DATAFIM as date) between @dI and @dF
		and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
		and P_PESOACAB - pesos.OFFP_PESO between -3 and 3
	group by
		TP_NOME, P_NOME, P_PESOACAB, year(OF_DATAFIM), month(OF_DATAFIM)
)
```

#### `dbo.report_Previsao_Produto_substituto`(@p_id int, @dt date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `tipo` nvarchar, `pai` nvarchar, `filho` nvarchar, `barcos` int, `qtd_Uni` float, `nome` nvarchar, `mov_precounitario` float

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[report_Previsao_Produto_substituto]
(	
	@p_id int,
	@dt date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select tp_nome as tipo, p1.p_nome as pai, p.p_nome as filho, count(of_id) as barcos, cp.comp_quantidade as qtd_Uni, prt.nome, prt.mov_precounitario
	from produto_componente as cp 
		inner join produto_componente as cp1 on cp.comp_p_id = cp1.comp_p_p_id 
		inner join produto as p on cp1.comp_p_p_id = p.p_id 
		inner join produto as p1 on cp1.comp_p_id = p1.p_id 
		inner join produto_tipo on p1.p_tp_id = tp_id 
		inner join ordemfabrico on cp1.comp_p_id = of_p_id
		inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id and offp_fp_id = 1
		left join (select top 1 mov_p_id, p_nome as nome, mov_precounitario from movimento inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id where mov_p_id = @p_id and mov_datasaida is not null and mov_tpmov_id = 1 order by mov_datasaida desc) as prt on cp.comp_p_p_id = prt.mov_p_id
	where cp.comp_p_p_id = @p_id and cast(offp_data_prevista as date) >= @dt and of_id not between 70000 and 89999
	group by tp_nome, p1.p_nome, p.p_nome, cp.comp_quantidade, prt.nome, prt.mov_precounitario
)
```

#### `dbo.tiderace_Entre_Datas`(@de date, @ate date, @modelo_comeca_por nvarchar(max))
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2020-11-05 08:59 · modificado 2025-05-05 12:02* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `producao`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `OF_ID` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `OF_REFERENCIA` nvarchar, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `FP_NOME` nvarchar, `OF_DATAFIM` smalldatetime, `TR_DATA` date, `OF_FACT` nvarchar, `fdata` date, `etotal` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[tiderace_Entre_Datas]
(	
	@de date,
	@ate date,
	@modelo_comeca_por nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		OF_ID, P_NOME, OF_REFERENCIA, E_NOME, FP_NOME, OF_DATAFIM, TR_DATA, OF_FACT, cast(x.fdata as date) fdata, isnull(cast(x.etotal as float),0) etotal
	from	
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join ENTIDADE on OF_E_ID_ENC = E_ID
		inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		outer apply (select top 1 tr_data from TRANSPORTE inner join TRANSP_OF on TR_ID = TROF_TR_ID where TROF_OF_ID = OF_ID order by TR_DATA desc) as j
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OF_FP_ID = FP_ID
		outer apply (select top 1 cast(offp_datainicio as date) offp_datainicio from of_fp where offp_of_id = of_id and offp_fp_id = 12 and offp_datainicio is not null order by offp_datainicio) d
		outer apply (select fdata, etotal from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft where nmdoc = 'Factura' and cast(fno as nvarchar(max)) = OF_FACT) x
	where 
		p_nome like @modelo_comeca_por + '%' 
		and (d.OFFP_DATAINICIO between @de and @ate
		or cast(x.fdata as date) between @de and @ate)
)
```

#### `dbo.tracking_production_by_transp_date`(@dataInicial date, @dataFinal date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2020-01-24 14:34 · modificado 2026-03-20 09:23* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `retorno`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `TR_ID` int, `TR_DATA` date, `TR_DESCRICAO` nvarchar, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `OF_ID` int, `FP_NOME` nvarchar, `FP_ID` int, `OFFP_ID` int, `OFFP_ORDEM` int, `OFFP_RETURN` bit, `OFFP_DATAINICIO` smalldatetime, `OFFPEQ_E_ID` int, `funcionario` nvarchar, `P_Id` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `tempoEsperado` int, `minutosTrabalhados` int, `offp_retorno_grave` bit, `brilhante` bit, `cores` nvarchar

```sql
--select * from [dbo].[tracking_production_by_transp_date]('2020-01-01', '2020-02-01')

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[tracking_production_by_transp_date] 
(	
	@dataInicial date, @dataFinal date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	SELECT 
		t.TR_ID, 
		t.TR_DATA,
		t.TR_DESCRICAO,  
		e.E_ID, 
		e.E_NOME, 
		o.OF_ID, 
		fp.FP_NOME, 
		fp.FP_ID,
		f.OFFP_ID, 
		f.OFFP_ORDEM, 
		case when z.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else OFFP_RETURN end OFFP_RETURN, 
		f.OFFP_DATAINICIO, 
		ef.OFFPEQ_E_ID, 
		efunc.E_NOME as funcionario, 
		p.P_Id, 
		p.P_NOME, 
		dbo.offp_Minutos_Esperados(of_id,fp_id) as tempoEsperado,
		case when f.OFFP_DATAINICIO is not null then dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.OFFP_DATAINICIO, getdate()) else 0 END AS minutosTrabalhados,
		offp_retorno_grave,
		cast(case when br.MOV_ID is null then 0 else 1 end as bit) brilhante,
		[dbo].[of_Cores] (o.OF_ID,0) cores
	FROM 
		ORDEMFABRICO as o
		JOIN OF_FP as f on o.OF_ID = f.OFFP_OF_ID
		JOIN FASES_PRODUCAO as fp on fp.FP_ID = f.OFFP_FP_ID
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[OFFP_EQ] as ef on f.offp_id = ef.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --and e.E_ID = ef.OFFPEQ_E_ID
		JOIN ENTIDADE as e on o.OF_E_ID_ENC = e.E_ID
		LEFT JOIN ENTIDADE as efunc on ef.OFFPEQ_E_ID = efunc.E_ID
		JOIN PRODUTO as p on o.OF_P_ID = p.P_ID
		left join TRANSPORTE as t on o.OF_TR_ID = t.TR_ID
		outer apply (select distinct ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK from OF_CHECKLIST ch where ch.OFCH_OF_ID = OF_ID and ch.OFCH_FP_ID_CHK = OF_FP_ID and ch.OFCH_ESTADO is not null) z
		outer apply (select top 1 mov_id from movimento where mov_of_id = of_id and mov_p_id = 41577) br
	WHERE 
		CAST(isnull(t.TR_DATA, '1900/01/01') AS date) >= @dataInicial
		and CAST(isnull(t.TR_DATA, '1900/01/01') AS date) <= @dataFinal
		and f.OFFP_DATAFIM is NULL
		and o.of_id < 10000000
		and fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
		and e.E_ID <> 19747
		and o.OF_FP_ID not in (9,10,12)
		and p_nome not like '400 %' 
		and p_nome not like '% 510 %'
	ORDER BY 
		t.TR_DATA, E_NOME,o.OF_ID, f.OFFP_ORDEM offset 0 rows
)
```

#### `dbo.tracking_productionRTM_by_transp_date`(@dataInicial date, @dataFinal date)
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2023-03-16 10:08 · modificado 2023-11-22 10:32* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `v_of`, `producao`, `retorno`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `TR_ID` int, `TR_DATA` date, `TR_DESCRICAO` nvarchar, `E_ID` int, `E_NOME` nvarchar, `OF_ID` int, `FP_NOME` nvarchar, `FP_ID` int, `OFFP_ID` int, `OFFP_ORDEM` int, `OFFP_RETURN` bit, `OFFP_DATAINICIO` smalldatetime, `OFFPEQ_E_ID` int, `funcionario` nvarchar, `P_Id` int, `P_NOME` nvarchar, `tempoEsperado` int, `minutosTrabalhados` int, `offp_retorno_grave` bit

```sql
--select * from [dbo].[tracking_production_by_transp_date]('2020-01-01', '2020-02-01')

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[tracking_productionRTM_by_transp_date] 
(	
	@dataInicial date, @dataFinal date
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	SELECT t.TR_ID, 
		t.TR_DATA,
		t.TR_DESCRICAO,  
		e.E_ID, 
		e.E_NOME, 
		o.OF_ID, 
		fp.FP_NOME, 
		fp.FP_ID,
		f.OFFP_ID, 
		f.OFFP_ORDEM, 
		f.OFFP_RETURN, 
		f.OFFP_DATAINICIO, 
		ef.OFFPEQ_E_ID, 
		efunc.E_NOME as funcionario, 
		p.P_Id, 
		p.P_NOME + case when p.p_id = 26020 then ' (' + pCor.p_nome + ')' else '' end P_NOME, 
		dbo.offp_Minutos_Esperados(of_id,fp_id) as tempoEsperado,
		case when f.OFFP_DATAINICIO is not null then dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.OFFP_DATAINICIO, getdate()) else 0 END AS minutosTrabalhados,
		offp_retorno_grave
	FROM 
		ORDEMFABRICO as o
		JOIN OF_FP as f on o.OF_ID = f.OFFP_OF_ID
		JOIN FASES_PRODUCAO as fp on fp.FP_ID = f.OFFP_FP_ID
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[OFFP_EQ] as ef on f.offp_id = ef.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID --and e.E_ID = ef.OFFPEQ_E_ID
		JOIN ENTIDADE as e on o.OF_E_ID_ENC = e.E_ID
		LEFT JOIN ENTIDADE as efunc on ef.OFFPEQ_E_ID = efunc.E_ID
		JOIN PRODUTO as p on o.OF_P_ID = p.P_ID
		left join TRANSPORTE as t on o.OF_TR_ID = t.TR_ID
		left join movimento on o.OF_ID = mov_of_id and MOV_ATRIB_ID = 38
		left join produto pCor on MOV_P_ID = pCor.p_id
	WHERE 
		CAST(isnull(t.TR_DATA, '1900/01/01') AS date) >= @dataInicial
		and CAST(isnull(t.TR_DATA, '1900/01/01') AS date) <= @dataFinal
		and f.OFFP_DATAFIM is NULL
		and o.of_id < 10000000
		--and fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
		and e.E_ID <> 19747
		and o.OF_FP_ID in (71, 53,46, 8, 9, 10)
		and (p.p_nome like '400 %' or p.p_nome like '% 510 %' or p.p_nome like 'TR Vortex %')
	ORDER BY t.TR_DATA, E_NOME,o.OF_ID, f.OFFP_ORDEM offset 0 rows
)
```

#### `dbo.transporte_ListaActivos`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2024-02-27 11:48* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `tr_id` int, `tr_data` date, `tr_descricao` nvarchar, `e_nome` nvarchar, `tr_data_entrega_prev` date, `trtp_nome` nvarchar, `tracker_nome` nvarchar, `track` nvarchar, `e_id` int, `tr_trtp_id` int, `tr_track_tipo` nvarchar, `tr_track_nr` nvarchar, `operador` varchar(50), `PAISES_NOME` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[transporte_ListaActivos]
(		
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		distinct tr_id, /*convert(nchar(10),tr_data, 103) as*/  tr_data, tr_descricao, e_nome, tr_data_entrega_prev, trtp_nome, isnull(tracker_nome,'') tracker_nome,
		'http://fabrica.nelo.eu/tracking/?trackimo=' + isnull(cast(TR_TRACKER_ID as nvarchar(max)),'') + '&codEncomenda=' + isnull(cast(TR_ID as nvarchar(max)),'') as track, 
		--isnull('http://fabrica.nelo.eu/tracking/?trackimo=' + cast(TR_TRACKER_ID as nvarchar(max)) + '&codEncomenda=' + cast(TR_ID as nvarchar(max)),'') as track, 
		e_id, tr_trtp_id, tr_track_tipo, tr_track_nr, tOpe.empresa as operador, isnull(PAISES_NOME,'') PAISES_NOME
	from 
		transporte 
		inner join transp_tipo on tr_trtp_id = trtp_id
		inner join transp_of on tr_id = trof_tr_id
		inner join ordemfabrico on trof_of_id = of_id
		inner join entidade on of_e_id_enc = e_id
		left join transp_tracker on tr_tracker_id = tracker_id
		left join TransporteOperador tOpe on tOpe.codOperador = tr_operador_codigo
		left join PAISES on TR_PAISES_ID = PAISES_ID
	where 
		cast(tr_data as date) between cast(dateadd(month,-2, getdate()) as date) and cast(dateadd(day,-1, getdate()) as date)	 
		and tr_data_entrega is null
		and trtp_trtp_id = 10
		and TRTP_ID <> 4
		and OF_FP_ID = 12
)
```

#### `dbo.transporte_ListaFuturos`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2022-07-06 16:34 · modificado 2024-02-28 11:50* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `transp`

**Devolve:** `tr_id` int, `tr_data` date, `tr_descricao` nvarchar, `e_nome` nvarchar, `tr_data_entrega_prev` date, `trtp_id` int, `trtp_nome` nvarchar, `TR_MORADA` nvarchar, `TR_OBSERVACOES` nvarchar, `acabados` int, `naoAcabados` int, `paises_id` int, `PAISES_NOME` nvarchar, `tr_dest_id` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[transporte_ListaFuturos]
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select distinct 
		tr_id, tr_data, tr_descricao, isnull(e_nome, '') e_nome, tr_data_entrega_prev, trtp_id, trtp_nome, TR_MORADA, TR_OBSERVACOES, isnull(tot.acabados,0) acabados, isnull(tot.naoAcabados, 0) naoAcabados, isnull(paises_id,0) paises_id, isnull(PAISES_NOME,'') PAISES_NOME, isnull(tr_dest_id,0) tr_dest_id 
	from 
		transporte 
		left join (select trof_tr_id id, SUM(case when OF_FP_ID IN (9,10,12) then 1 else 0 end) acabados, SUM(case when OF_FP_ID not IN (9,10,12) then 1 else 0 end) naoAcabados from ORDEMFABRICO inner join TRANSP_OF on OF_ID = TROF_OF_ID where OF_ID < 10000000 group by trof_tr_id) tot on TR_ID = tot.id
		left join entidade on tr_e_id = e_id 
		left join TRANSP_TRACKER on TR_TRACKER_ID = TRACKER_ID 
		inner join TRANSP_TIPO on TR_TRTP_ID = TRTP_ID 
		inner join TRANSP_OF on TR_ID = TROF_TR_ID 
		left join PAISES on TR_PAISES_ID = PAISES_ID
	where 
		TROF_ENVIADO = 0 
		and TR_TRTP_ID in (1,2,3,4,9,17) 
		and TR_DATA < GETDATE()
	union
	select distinct 
		tr_id, tr_data, tr_descricao, isnull(e_nome, '') e_nome, tr_data_entrega_prev, trtp_id, trtp_nome, TR_MORADA, TR_OBSERVACOES, isnull(tot.acabados,0) acabados, isnull(tot.naoAcabados, 0) naoAcabados, isnull(paises_id,0) paises_id, isnull(PAISES_NOME,'') PAISES_NOME, isnull(tr_dest_id,0) tr_dest_id
	from 
		transporte 
		left join (select trof_tr_id id, SUM(case when OF_FP_ID IN (9,10,12) then 1 else 0 end) acabados, SUM(case when OF_FP_ID not IN (9,10,12) then 1 else 0 end) naoAcabados from ORDEMFABRICO inner join TRANSP_OF on OF_ID = TROF_OF_ID where OF_ID < 10000000 group by trof_tr_id) tot on TR_ID = tot.id
		left join entidade on tr_e_id = e_id 
		left join TRANSP_TRACKER on TR_TRACKER_ID = TRACKER_ID 
		inner join TRANSP_TIPO on TR_TRTP_ID = TRTP_ID 
		left join TRANSP_OF on TR_ID = TROF_TR_ID 
		left join PAISES on TR_PAISES_ID = PAISES_ID
	where 
		TR_TRTP_ID in (1,2,3,4,9,17) 
		and TR_DATA >= GETDATE()
)
```

```sql
		offpeq_e_id,
		e.e_nome,
		case when offp_datainicio is null then 'Em espera' else 'Em processo' end as tipo,
		case when offp_datainicio is null then 2 else 1 end as ord,
		stt.x as pecasEmFalta,
		isnull(tr_data,dateadd(yy,10,getdate())) as tr_data,
		OFFP_ID,
		cl.e_id as clienteId,
		cl.E_NOME as clienteNome
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join entidade cl on OF_E_ID_ENC = cl.e_id
		inner join produto on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join of_fp on of_id = OFFP_OF_ID and OF_FP_ID = OFFP_FP_ID
		left join OFFP_EQ on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
		left join ENTIDADE e on OFFPEQ_E_ID = e.E_ID
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OF_FP_ID = FP_ID
		outer apply (select count(comp_id) as x from PRODUTO_COMPONENTE inner join (select p_id, sum(Stock) as Stock from produto_stocks_por_armazem group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_P_ID = st.P_ID where COMP_P_ID = OF_P_ID and COMP_FP_ID = 47 and st.Stock < COMP_QUANTIDADE) as stt
		left join TRANSPORTE on of_tr_id = TR_ID
	where 
		of_fp_id = 47
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
	union
	select 
		of_id, 
		P_NOME,
		fp_id,
		fp_nome,
		offp_datainicio,
		offp_datafim,
		offpeq_e_id,
		e.e_nome,
		'Futuro' as tipo,
		3 as ord,
		stt.x as pecasEmFalta,
		isnull(tr_data,dateadd(yy,10,getdate())) as tr_data,
		OFFP_ID,
		cl.e_id as clienteId,
		cl.E_NOME as clienteNome
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join entidade cl on OF_E_ID_ENC = cl.e_id
		inner join produto on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join of_fp on of_id = OFFP_OF_ID and OF_FP_ID = OFFP_FP_ID
		left join OFFP_EQ on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and OFFPEQ_CHEFE = 1
		left join ENTIDADE e on OFFPEQ_E_ID = e.E_ID
		inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OF_FP_ID = FP_ID
		outer apply (select count(comp_id) as x from PRODUTO_COMPONENTE inner join (select p_id, sum(Stock) as Stock from produto_stocks_por_armazem group by p_id) as st on COMP_P_P_ID = st.P_ID where COMP_P_ID = OF_P_ID and COMP_FP_ID = 47 and st.Stock < COMP_QUANTIDADE) as stt
		left join TRANSPORTE on of_tr_id = TR_ID
	where 
		of_fp_id in (4,53)
		and OFFP_DATAINICIO is not null
		and OFFP_DATAFIM is null
		AND OF_ID in (select distinct offp_of_id from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 47 and OFFP_DATAINICIO is null)
)
```

#### `dbo.wordpress_RegisterMyBoat`()
*Inline Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-12-10 15:33 · modificado 2019-12-12 09:09* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`

**Devolve:** `data` date, `email` ntext, `ofId` ntext, `Nome` ntext, `DateOfBirth` ntext, `Gender` ntext, `Country` ntext

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[wordpress_RegisterMyBoat] 
(	
	
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	select 
		cast(dateadd(ss, submit_time, '19700101') as date) as data, email, ofId, Nome, DateOfBirth, Gender, Country
	from
		ORDEMFABRICO
		inner join OPENQUERY(WORDPRESS, 
									'SELECT
										submit_time, 
										MAX(IF(field_name=''your-email'', field_value, NULL )) AS ''email'',
										MAX(IF(field_name=''your-serial-model'', field_value, NULL )) AS ''ofId'',
										MAX(IF(field_name=''your-name'', field_value, NULL )) AS ''Nome'',
										MAX(IF(field_name=''your-date-of-birth'', field_value, NULL )) AS ''DateOfBirth'',
										MAX(IF(field_name=''your-gender'', field_value, NULL )) AS ''Gender'',
										MAX(IF(field_name=''your-country'', field_value, NULL )) AS ''Country''
									FROM 
										wpm6_cf7dbplugin_submits
									WHERE
										form_name = ''Nelo Register''
										and (field_name = ''your-serial-model'' 
											or field_name = ''your-email'' 
											or field_name = ''your-name''
											or field_name=''your-date-of-birth''
											or field_name=''your-gender''
											or field_name=''your-country'')
									group by 
										submit_time
									order by 
										submit_time;') as x on cast(OF_ID as nvarchar(max)) = cast(x.ofId as nvarchar(max))
)
```
