#### `dbo.devolveAnoMes`(@desdeAno int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-05-10 14:49 · modificado 2024-05-10 14:49*

**Devolve:** `Ano` int, `Mes` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION devolveAnoMes 
(
	@desdeAno int
)
RETURNS 
@t table
(
	Ano int, Mes int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @mes int = 1

	while @desdeAno <= year(getdate())
	begin

		while @mes <= 12
		begin

			insert into @t (Ano, Mes) values (@desdeAno, @mes)
			set @mes += 1
		end

		set @mes = 1
		set @desdeAno += 1
	end
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.entidade_Owner_Performance_Epoca`(@e_id int, @tp_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 12:03* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `disciplina`

**Devolve:** `e_id` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `e_pais` nvarchar, `segmento_id` int, `Barcos` int, `Epoca` float, `obj_OFs` int, `obj_Val` float, `percObj_Val` float, `percObj_OFs` float, `Trimestre` float, `ContaCorrente` float, `obj_OFs_Marca` int, `obj_Val_Marca` float, `e_pais_id` int, `ISO2` nvarchar, `CONTINENT` nvarchar(4)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_Owner_Performance_Epoca] 
(
	@e_id int,
	@tp_id int = null
)
RETURNS 
@t TABLE 
(
	e_id int, e_nome nvarchar(max), e_pais nvarchar(max), segmento_id int, Barcos int, Epoca float, obj_OFs int, obj_Val float, percObj_Val float, percObj_OFs float, Trimestre float, ContaCorrente float, obj_OFs_Marca int, obj_Val_Marca float,
	e_pais_id int, ISO2 nvarchar(max), CONTINENT nvarchar(2)--, id_disciplina int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @data_i date, @data_f date--, @familia int, @tp_ent_owner_obj_of int, @tp_ent_owner_obj_val float

	--select @familia = tp_id, @tp_ent_owner_obj_of = tp_ent_owner_obj_of, @tp_ent_owner_obj_val = tp_ent_owner_obj_of from produto_tipo where tp_ent_owner = @e_id

	set @data_i = convert(date, convert(nvarchar(max),(case when month(getdate()) < 10 then year(getdate()) - 1 else year(getdate()) end)) + '-10-01')
	set @data_f = convert(date, convert(nvarchar(max),(case when month(getdate()) < 10 then year(getdate()) else year(getdate())+1 end)) + '-10-01')

	insert into @t (e_id, e_nome, e_pais, segmento_id, Barcos, Epoca, obj_OFs, obj_Val, percObj_Val, percObj_OFs, Trimestre, ContaCorrente, obj_OFs_Marca, obj_Val_Marca, e_pais_id, ISO2, CONTINENT)
	(select 
		distinct e_id, 
		e_nome, 
		name, 
		tp_id,
		isnull(epoca1.ofs,0) as Barcos,
		convert(float,sum(isnull(fact1.TotalSemIva,0))) as Epoca, 
		etp_obj_of as obj_OFs,
		etp_obj_val as obj_Val, 
		(case when etp_obj_val = 0 then 1 else convert(float,sum(isnull(fact1.TotalSemIva,0)))/etp_obj_val end) as percObj_Val, 
		(case when etp_obj_of = 0 then 1 else convert(float,sum(isnull(epoca1.ofs,0)))/etp_obj_of end) as percObj_OFs,
		convert(float,sum(isnull(fact2.TotalSemIva,0))) as Trimestre,
		sum(isnull(cc.ContaCorrente,0)) as ContaCorrente,
		obj_OFs as obj_OFs_Marca,
		obj_Val as obj_Val_Marca, 
		e_pais_id, 
		ISO2, CONTINENT
	from
		dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id)
		inner join ent_tp_prod on tp_id = etp_tp_id  and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else tp_id end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
		inner join ENTIDADE on etp_e_id = e_id
		left join paises_site on e_pais_id = id
		left join (select 
						of_e_id_enc as id, 
						p_tp_id_disciplina as id_disciplina,
						COUNT(OF_id) as ofs 
					from 
						ORDEMFABRICO 
						inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
						inner join dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id) on p_tp_id_disciplina = tp_id and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else tp_id end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
					where 
						cast(OF_DATAFIM as date) between @data_i and @data_f 
						and of_id < 10000000
					group by of_e_id_enc, 
						p_tp_id_disciplina) as epoca1 on E_ID = epoca1.id and tp_id = epoca1.id_disciplina
		inner join ENTIDADE_PHC on E_ID = EPHC_E_ID 
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.cl on ephc_phc_id = cl.no 
		left join (select 
						no, 
						p_tp_id_disciplina as id_disciplina,
						round(convert(float,sum(fi.esltt * (case when ft.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito' then -1 else 1 end))),2) as TotalSemIva 
					from
						[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi
						inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.fno = ft.fno
						inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st on fi.ref = st.ref
						inner join produto on st.u_idprod = p_id
						inner join dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id) on p_tp_id_disciplina = tp_id and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else tp_id end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
					where 
						/*p_tp_id_disciplina = @familia
						and*/ ft.anulado = 0 
						and ft.nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') 
						and cast(ft.ousrdata as date) between @data_i and @data_f 
					group by 
						no, 
						p_tp_id_disciplina) as fact1 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact1.no and tp_id = fact1.id_disciplina
		left join (select 
						no, 
						p_tp_id_disciplina as id_disciplina,
						round(convert(float,sum(fi.esltt * (case when ft.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito' then -1 else 1 end))),2) as TotalSemIva 
					from 
						[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi
						inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft on fi.fno = ft.fno
						inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.st on fi.ref = st.ref
						inner join produto on st.u_idprod = p_id 
						inner join dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id) on p_tp_id_disciplina = tp_id and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else tp_id end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
					where 
						/*p_tp_id_disciplina = @familia
						and*/ ft.anulado = 0 
						and (case when @tp_id is null then 1 else tp_id end) = ISNULL(@tp_id,1)
						and ft.nmdoc in ('Factura','Nota de Crédito') 
						and year(ft.ousrdata) = year(getdate()) 
						and month(ft.ousrdata) between (case when month(getdate()) < 4 then 1 when month(getdate()) between 4 and 6 then 4 when month(getdate()) between 7 and 9 then 7 else 10 end) and (case when month(getdate()) < 4 then 3 when month(getdate()) between 4 and 6 then 6 when month(getdate()) between 7 and 9 then 9 else 12 end)
					group by no, 
						p_tp_id_disciplina) as fact2 on EPHC_PHC_ID = fact2.no  and tp_id = fact2.id_disciplina
		left join (select 
						conta, 
						sum(convert(float,edeb)) - sum(convert(float,ecre)) as ContaCorrente 
					from 
						[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ml 
					where 
						year(data) = year(getdate()) 
					group by conta) as cc on cl.conta = cc.conta
	where 
		/*etp_tp_id in (select tp_id from dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id)
		and*/ E_ACTIVO = 1		
		and E_NELO = 0
	group by 
		e_id, e_nome, name, tp_id,
		epoca1.ofs, etp_obj_of, etp_obj_val, 
		e_pais_id, 
		ISO2, obj_OFs, obj_Val, CONTINENT)
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.entidade_Owner_Performance_Evol`(@e_id int, @data_i date, @data_f date, @tp_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2023-10-13 12:03* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `OF_E_ID_ENC`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `disciplina`

**Devolve:** `e_id` int, `e_nome` nvarchar, `e_pais` nvarchar, `Ano` int, `Mes` int, `Epoca` int, `segmento_Id` int, `segmento` nvarchar, `Barcos` int, `Epoca_Val` float, `Epoca_Outros` float, `e_fact_epoca` float, `obj_OFs` int, `obj_Val` float, `obj_OFs_Marca` int, `obj_Val_Marca` float, `e_pais_id` int, `ISO2` nvarchar, `CONTINENT` nvarchar(4), `classeId` int, `classeNome` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[entidade_Owner_Performance_Evol]
(
	@e_id int,
	@data_i date,
	@data_f date,
	@tp_id int = null
)
RETURNS 
@t TABLE 
(
	e_id int, e_nome nvarchar(max), e_pais nvarchar(max), Ano int, Mes int, Epoca int, segmento_Id int, segmento nvarchar(max), Barcos int, 
	Epoca_Val float, Epoca_Outros float, e_fact_epoca float, obj_OFs int, obj_Val float, obj_OFs_Marca int, obj_Val_Marca float,
	e_pais_id int, ISO2 nvarchar(max), CONTINENT nvarchar(2), classeId int, classeNome nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @tempo table(ano int, mes int, epoca int)
	declare @dif int = datediff(month, @data_i, @data_f)

	while @dif >= 0
	begin
		insert into @tempo (ano, mes, epoca) values (year(dateadd(month, @dif,@data_i)), month(dateadd(month, @dif,@data_i)), (case when month(dateadd(month, @dif,@data_i)) > 9 then year(dateadd(month, @dif,@data_i)) + 1 else year(dateadd(month, @dif,@data_i)) end))
		set @dif -= 1
	end

	insert into @t (e_id, e_nome, e_pais, Ano, Mes, Epoca, segmento_Id, segmento, Barcos, Epoca_Val, Epoca_Outros, e_fact_epoca, obj_OFs, obj_Val, obj_OFs_Marca, obj_Val_Marca, e_pais_id, ISO2, CONTINENT, classeId, classeNome)
	(select 
		distinct e_id, 
		e_nome, 
		ps.NAME as e_pais, 
		t.ano,
		t.mes,
		t.epoca,
		a.tp_id,
		a.tp_nome,
		isnull(epoca1.ofs,0) as Barcos,
		convert(float,isnull(fact1.tot,0)),
		0,
		e_fact_epoca,
		etp_obj_of as obj_OFs,
		etp_obj_val as obj_Val,
		obj_OFs as obj_OFs_Marca,
		obj_Val as obj_Val_Marca, 
		e_pais_id, 
		ISO2,
		CONTINENT,
		tp.TipoId,
		tp.TipoNome
	from
		dbo.entidade_Owner_Disciplinas(@e_id) a 
		inner join ent_tp_prod on a.tp_id = etp_tp_id  
		inner join (select distinct tp_id as TipoId, tp_nome as TipoNome, P_TP_ID_DISCIPLINA as DiscipId from PRODUTO_TIPO inner join PRODUTO on TP_ID = P_TP_ID) as tp on a.tp_id = tp.DiscipId
		inner join ENTIDADE on etp_e_id = e_id
		left join paises_site as ps on e_pais_id = id
		inner join @tempo as t on 1 = 1
		left join (select	
						isnull(EPHC_E_ID,25541) as EPHC_E_ID,
						b.EPHCF_TP_ID_DISCIP,
						b.EPHCF_TP_ID,
						tp.TP_NOME,
						b.EPHCF_ANO,
						b.EPHCF_MES,
						sum(b.EPHCF_FACTURADO) as tot
					from
						ENTIDADE_PHC_FACT as b
						left join ENTIDADE_PHC  on EPHC_ID = EPHCF_EPHC_ID
						left join PRODUTO_TIPO as tp on EPHCF_TP_ID = tp.tp_id
					group by 
						EPHC_E_ID,
```

#### `dbo.fn_SplitInt`(@List nvarchar(8000), @Delimiter char(1))
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-10-25 10:17*

**Devolve:** `Position` int, `Number` bigint

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_SplitInt]
(
    @List       nvarchar(4000),
    @Delimiter  char(1)= ','
)
RETURNS @Values TABLE
(
    Position int IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    Number bigint
)

AS

  BEGIN

  -- set up working variables
  DECLARE @Index INT
  DECLARE @ItemValue nvarchar(max)
  SELECT @Index = 1 

  -- iterate until we have no more characters to work with
  WHILE @Index > 0

    BEGIN

      -- find first delimiter
      SELECT @Index = CHARINDEX(@Delimiter,@List)

      -- extract the item value
      IF @Index  > 0     -- if found, take the value left of the delimiter
        SELECT @ItemValue = LEFT(@List,@Index - 1)
      ELSE               -- if none, take the remainder as the last value
        SELECT @ItemValue = @List

      -- insert the value into our new table
	  if ISNUMERIC(@ItemValue) = 1
	      INSERT INTO @Values (Number) VALUES (CAST(@ItemValue AS bigint))

      -- remove the found item from the working list
      SELECT @List = RIGHT(@List,LEN(@List) - @Index)

      -- if list is empty, we are done
      IF LEN(@List) = 0 BREAK

    END

  RETURN

  END
```

#### `dbo.fn_SplitStr`(@List nvarchar(8000), @Delimiter char(1))

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_SplitStr]
(
    @List       nvarchar(4000),
    @Delimiter  char(1)= ','
)
RETURNS @Values TABLE
(
    Position int IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    Number nvarchar(max)
)

AS

  BEGIN

  -- set up working variables
  DECLARE @Index INT
  DECLARE @ItemValue nvarchar(max)
  SELECT @Index = 1 

  -- iterate until we have no more characters to work with
  WHILE @Index > 0

    BEGIN

      -- find first delimiter
      SELECT @Index = CHARINDEX(@Delimiter,@List)

      -- extract the item value
      IF @Index  > 0     -- if found, take the value left of the delimiter
        SELECT @ItemValue = LEFT(@List,@Index - 1)
      ELSE               -- if none, take the remainder as the last value
        SELECT @ItemValue = @List

      -- insert the value into our new table
	  --if ISNUMERIC(@ItemValue) = 1
	      INSERT INTO @Values (Number) VALUES (ltrim(rtrim(@ItemValue)))

      -- remove the found item from the working list
      SELECT @List = RIGHT(@List,LEN(@List) - @Index)

      -- if list is empty, we are done
      IF LEN(@List) = 0 BREAK

    END

  RETURN

  END
```

#### `dbo.fornecedores_Comppras`()
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-05-13 16:53 · modificado 2024-05-14 14:58* · 🔎 `preco`

**Devolve:** `Ano` int, `Mes` int, `FornecedorId` int, `Fornecedor` nvarchar, `ProdutoId` int, `Produto` nvarchar, `TotalAcumulado` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION fornecedores_Comppras
(
	
)
RETURNS 
@t TABLE 
(
	Ano int, Mes int, FornecedorId int, Fornecedor nvarchar(max), ProdutoId int, Produto nvarchar(max), TotalAcumulado float default 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	insert into @t (Ano, Mes, FornecedorId, Fornecedor, ProdutoId, Produto) select Ano, Mes, E_ID, e_nome, pf_p_id, p_nome from dbo.devolveAnoMes(2020) full join entidade on 1 = 1 full join PRODUTO_ENTIDADE pe on e_id = pe.pf_e_id inner join produto on pf_p_id = p_id where E_ENT_ID = 18

	--select 
	--	Ano, Mes, FornecedorId, Fornecedor, isnull(p_id,0) ProdutoId, isnull(p_nome, '') Produto, isnull(tot,0) Acumulado
	update t set TotalAcumulado = tot
	from
		@t t
		inner join (select year(mov_data) a, month(mov_data) m, mov_e_id, mov_p_id pId, sum(mov_precounitario * mov_quantidade) tot from movimento where MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1 group by year(mov_data), month(mov_data), mov_e_id, mov_p_id) a on Ano = a and Mes = m and MOV_E_ID = FornecedorId and ProdutoId = a.pId
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_PerformanceUltimos3Meses`()
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-04-23 11:33 · modificado 2026-06-03 16:55* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `OF_DATAFIM`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `reparaç`, `retorno`, `preco`, `molde`

**Devolve:** `eId` int, `eNome` nvarchar, `barcos` int, `erros1` int, `erros2` int, `erros3` int, `premio` float, `absentismi` float, `ordem` int, `ano` int, `mes` int, `fpId` int, `faseFunc` nvarchar, `irs` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_PerformanceUltimos3Meses]
(
	
)
RETURNS 
@t TABLE 
(
	eId int, eNome nvarchar(max), barcos int, erros1 int, erros2 int, erros3 int, premio float, absentismi float, ordem int, ano int, mes int, fpId int, faseFunc nvarchar(max), irs float
)
AS
BEGIN

	declare @dI date = dateadd(day,-datepart(DAY,dateadd(day,-datepart(DAY,getdate()),getdate())) + 1, dateadd(day,-datepart(DAY,getdate()),getdate())) , @dF date = dateadd(day,-datepart(DAY,getdate()),getdate())

	declare @dIt smalldatetime, @dFt smalldatetime
	set @dIt = dateadd(hour,8,cast(@dI as smalldatetime))
	set @dFt = dateadd(hour,17,cast(@dF as smalldatetime))

	--declare @t table(eId int, eNome nvarchar(max), barcos int, erros1 int, erros2 int, erros3 int, premio float, absentismi float, ordem int, ano int, mes int, fpId int, faseFunc nvarchar(max), irs float)

	declare @meses int = 0

	/*Calcular Prémio*/
	declare @h_trb float

	declare @facturadoLoja float, @barcosPreparados int, @ganhoInjeccao float, @qtdCNC float, @corteCostura float, @serralharia float, @barcosComMascara int, @nFunc int, @premioFases float

	declare @facturacaoLoja table(ano int, mes int, total float)
	insert into @facturacaoLoja (ano, mes, total)
	(select 
		ano, mes, total 
	from 
		OPENQUERY(SHOP,'SELECT year(si.created_at) ano, month(si.created_at) mes, cast(sum(si.subtotal) as float) total FROM `paddle-m2-db`.sales_invoice si inner join `paddle-m2-db`.sales_order so on si.order_id = so.entity_id where so.state = ''complete'' group by year(si.created_at), month(si.created_at);')
	)

	while @meses <= 10 + month(getdate())
	begin
		select 
			@facturadoLoja = cast(a.total as float) 
		from 
			@facturacaoLoja a
		where
			a.ano = year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt))
			and a.mes = month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt))

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @facturadoLoja * 0.002, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (32044,24652,20653,25157)

		select	
			@barcosPreparados = count(distinct of_id)
		from
			ORDEMFABRICO
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
			--inner join (select distinct m.mov_of_id ofId from movimento m inner join movimento m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id inner join produto on m1.mov_p_id = p_id where p_tp_id = 84 and m.mov_satisfeito = 1) mov on of_id = ofId
		where
			OFFP_DATA_PREVISTA between dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt) and dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt)
			and OFFP_DATAFIM between dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt) and dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt)
			and offp_of_id < 10000000

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @barcosPreparados * case when e_id <> 25046 then 0.75 else 0.375 end, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (27640,25550,25046,20715)

		select 
			@barcosComMascara = count(of_id)
		from
			ORDEMFABRICO
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
		where
			(OF_PFORA_CLASS > 1
			or OF_PARAPINTARFORA = 1)
			and offp_fp_id = 65
			and OFFP_DATAFIM between dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt) and dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt)

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @barcosComMascara, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (27640,25550,25046,20715)

		select
			@ganhoInjeccao = sum(mov_quantidade * case when p_id = 52411 then 0.81
					when p_id = 51018 then 9.34
					when p_id = 53719 then 1.55
					when p_id = 53772 then 1.96
					when p_id = 22672 then 3.32 end)
		from
			movimento
			inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
		where 
			cast(mov_data as date) between dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt) and dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt)
			and mov_tpmov_id in (1)
			and p_id in (52411,51018,53719,53772,22672)
			and MOV_ACERTO = 0

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @ganhoInjeccao * case when e_id = 35710 then 0.03 else 0.015 end, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (35710, 30323)

		select 
			@qtdCNC = sum(mov_quantidade)
		from
			movimento 
			inner join ORDEMFABRICO on mov_of_id = of_id
			inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on of_fp_id = fp_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id 
			inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id
		where 
			OFFP_DATAFIM between dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt) and dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt)
			and mov_tpmov_id in (2,11)
			and mov_p_id = 21147
			and mov_of_id is not null
			and offp_fp_id = 20

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @qtdCNC * 0.5, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (35710, 30323)

		select
			@corteCostura = sum(p_precovenda)
		from
			ORDEMFABRICO
			inner join produto m on of_p_id = m.p_id
			inner join of_fp on of_id = offp_of_id
		where
			offp_fp_id = 48
			and OFFP_DATAFIM between dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt) and dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt)

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @corteCostura * case when e_id = 32044 then 0.0015 else 0.002 end, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (25215,25373,29944,25159,32044)

		select 
			@serralharia = sum(mov_quantidade * (p_precovenda - coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0)))
		from
			movimento 
			inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
			inner join produto_componente on p_id = comp_p_id
		where
			comp_p_p_id = 21637
			and P_FABRICOINTERNO = 1
			and cast(mov_data as date) between @dI and @dF
			and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 1
			and p_precovenda > 0

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @serralharia * 0.002, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (20606,25113,20653,25052,20684)

		set @h_trb = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt), dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt))

		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			count(a.of_id) barcos,
			sum(a.Gravidade_1) ErrosGrau_1,
			sum(a.Gravidade_2) ErrosGrau_2,
			sum(a.Gravidade_3) ErrosGrau_3,
			round(sum(
				case 
					--when a.of_id < 10000000 and (a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or a.Gravidade_2 > 0) 
					when a.of_id < 10000000 and (a.Gravidade_3 > 0 or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.of_datafim < '2025/10/01') or (a.Gravidade_2 > 0 and a.fp_id not in (1,67) and a.of_datafim >= '2025/10/01'))
						then 0
					when a.of_id >= 10000000 and a.Gravidade_3 > 0
						then 0
					when a.of_id >= 10000000 and a.Gravidade_2 > 0
						then (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end / 2
					else
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os erros de gravidade 1 a não descontar nada ** (a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF * case when a.Gravidade_1 > 0 then 0.5 else 1 end) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end */
						(a.valOFFP * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
						--(case when a.of_id < 10000000 and a.fp_id in (1,67) then 6 else a.valOFFP end * a.FP_HORA_COEF) / case when a.Funcionarios > 0 then a.Funcionarios else 1 end
				end
			),1) premio,
			isnull(eMovs.faltas,0) / @h_trb absentismo,
			@meses ord,
			year(@dI) Ano,
			month(@dI) Mes,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		from
			(select distinct
				of_id,
				of_datafim,
				tp_nome, 
				np_nome,
				P_ID,
				P_NOME,
				OFFP_ID,
				fp.FP_ID,
				fp.FP_NOME,
				e_id,
				e_nome,
				E_FP_ID,
				OFFP_ORDEM,
				OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X,
				OFFP_RETURN,
				isnull(nFs.n,0) as Funcionarios,
				fp.FP_HORA_COEF,
				round(case when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and (OFFP_ID <> x.offpId or OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X = 0) then 0
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 3 then  0.15/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID = 4 then  0.25/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (28,47,22,42,66)  then  0.20/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (5,40,63)  then  0.50/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 1 and OFFP_FP_ID in (33,35)  then  0.75/fp.FP_HORA_COEF
						when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 1 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then 0
						/** 30/03/2023 André disse para passar os retornos não graves a não descontar nada ** when OFFP_RETURN = 0 and x1.Grave = 0 and x1.IdRetornoCulpa is not null then OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X / 2 **/
						else OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X end,2) as valOFFP,
					isnull(erros.grave_1,0) as Gravidade_1, 
					isnull(erros.grave_2,0) as Gravidade_2, 
					case when offp_fp_id = 1 and of_id > 10000000 and of_fp_id in (49,50) then 1 else isnull(erros.grave_3,0) end as Gravidade_3,
				fpFunc.FP_NOME as faseFunc,
				e_taxa_irs
			from 
				ORDEMFABRICO
				inner join PRODUTO on OF_P_ID = P_ID
				left join PRODUTO_NUMERO_POCOS on P_NP_ID = NP_ID
				inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
				inner join OF_FP ofFp on OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID
				left join (select offp_id offpId, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on offp_id = nFs.offpId
				inner join OFFP_EQ as eq on offp_id = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
				inner join entidade on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				left join OFFP_EQ as eqMain on OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = eqMain.OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID and eqMain.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID offpId from OF_FP a inner join OFFP_EQ b on OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								where a.OFFP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN and a.OFFP_FP_ID = ofFp.OFFP_FP_ID and b.OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID order by OFFP_DATAFIM) x
				outer apply (select top 1 OFFP_ID IdRetornoCulpa, OFFP_RETORNO_GRAVE Grave from OF_FP where offp_return = 1 and OFFP_OFFP_ID_RETURN = ofFp.offp_id) x1
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fp on OFFP_FP_ID = fp.FP_ID 
				inner join FASES_PRODUCAO fpFunc on E_FP_ID = fpFunc.FP_ID 
				left join (select offp_id as Idd, offp_of_id as OfIdd from of_fp where offp_fp_id = 5 and offp_datafim is not null) as pa on OF_ID = pa.OfIdd 
				left join (select
								OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, OFFP_FP_ID PLI_FP_ID,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_1,  
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_2,
								sum(case when OFCH_GRAVIDADE = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as grave_3
							from
								ORDEMFABRICO 
								inner join OF_CHECKLIST on OF_ID = OFCH_OF_ID
								INNER JOIN OF_FP ON OF_ID = OFFP_OF_ID and ofch_offp_id_culpa = offp_id
								INNER JOIN OFFP_EQ ON OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID 
								INNER JOIN ENTIDADE ON OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
								inner join FASES_PRODUCAO on OFFP_FP_ID = FP_ID
							WHERE
								OFCH_ESTADO > 1
								and OFCH_GRAVIDADE > 0
							group by 
								OF_ID, E_ID, E_NOME, OFFP_COEFICIENTE_X, OFFP_FP_ID
							union
							select
								fp.OFFP_OF_ID ofId, E_ID eId, 
								36 as PLI_FP_ID,
								0 as grave_1,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 49 then 1 else 0 end as grave_2,
								case when fp.OFFP_FP_ID = 50 then 1 else 0 end as grave_3
							from
								OF_FP as fp
								inner join OF_FP as fpLam on fp.OFFP_OF_ID = fpLam.OFFP_OF_ID and fpLam.OFFP_FP_ID = 36
								inner join OFFP_EQ on fpLam.OFFP_ID = OFFPEQ_OFFP_ID
								inner join ENTIDADE on OFFPEQ_E_ID = E_ID
							where 
								cast(fp.OFFP_DATAINICIO AS date) between @dI and @dF
								and fp.OFFP_FP_ID in (49,50)) erros on OFFP_OF_ID = erros.ofId and e_id = erros.eId and OFFP_FP_ID = erros.PLI_FP_ID and OFFP_RETURN = 0
			where
				fp.FP_PRODUCAO = 1
				and (
						(
							cast(OF_DATAFIM AS date) between @dI and @dF
							and OF_ID < 10000000
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_FP_ID = 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							--and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50)
						)
						or 
						(
							cast(OFFP_DATAFIM AS date)  between @dI and @dF
							and OFFP_DATAFIM >= '2021/11/01'
							and OFFP_FP_ID <> 1
							and OF_ID > 10000000
							and OFFP_RETURN = 0
							and OF_FP_ID in (9,49,50,12)
						)
					)
				and OF_ID not between 70000 and 89999
				and OFFP_FP_ID in (3,47,53,42,18,40,22,4,33,1,35,5,63,66,67,68,36,28,54,65,6,51,46,71,74,66,51,8,6)) a --in (select distinct ax.faseId from @valores_Aux ax)
			left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(baixas) as baixas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@dI as date), cast(@dF as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on a.e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		group by 
			a.E_ID,
			a.E_NOME,
			eMovs.faltas,
			a.E_FP_ID,
			a.faseFunc,
			a.e_taxa_irs
		
		select @nFunc = count(distinct eId), @premioFases = sum(premio) from @t where eId <> 20368 /*Rui Ervilha*/ and fpId in (18, 6, 51) /*Pintura, Desmolde, Preparação de Molde*/
	
		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @premioFases / @nFunc, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (20368)

		select @nFunc = count(distinct eId), @premioFases = sum(premio) from @t where eId <> 20365 /*Alexandre Costa*/ and fpId in (3,4,5,8,22,33,35,40,42,46,47,53,66,74,77) /*'Controlo de qualidade Montagem', 'Acabamento 2', 'Montagem / Finalização', 'Lixagem - água', 'Reparação', 'Lixagem - seco', 'Lixagem - polimento', 'Acabamento - Envernizamento', 'Colagem Peças', 'Pintura Acabamento', 'Colagem Golas', 'Colagem Barcos', 'Controlo de qualidade Final', 'Acabamento 3', 'Corte', */
	
		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @premioFases / @nFunc, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (20365)

		select @nFunc = count(distinct eId), @premioFases = sum(premio) from @t where eId <> 20726 /*Jorginho*/ and fpId in (1) /*Laminagem*/
	
		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @premioFases / @nFunc, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (20726)
	
		select @nFunc = count(distinct eId), @premioFases = sum(premio) from @t where eId <> 30323 /*Joana Lopes*/ and fpId in (71) /*Rotomoldagem*/
	
		insert into @t (eId, eNome, barcos, erros1, erros2, erros3, premio, absentismi, ordem, ano, mes, fpId, faseFunc, irs)
		select e_id, e_nome, 0, 0, 0, 0, @premioFases / @nFunc, 0, 0, year(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), month(dateadd(month,-@meses, @dIt)), 0, '', 0 from entidade where e_id in (30323)

		set @meses += 1

		set @dIt = dateadd(month,-1, @dIt)
		set @dFt = dateadd(day,day(@dFt)*-1,@dFt)
		set @dI = dateadd(month,-1, @dI)
		set @dF = dateadd(day,-1, dateadd(month,1,@dI))
	end

	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.funcionario_ProdutosArmazem`(@e_id int, @fp_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-09-09 13:22 · modificado 2022-04-06 09:24* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

**Devolve:** `idTipo` int, `tipo` nvarchar, `id` int, `nome` nvarchar, `uni` nvarchar, `conversao` float, `imagem` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[funcionario_ProdutosArmazem]
(
	@e_id int,
	@fp_id int = null
)
RETURNS 
@t TABLE 
(
	idTipo int,
	tipo nvarchar(max),
	id int,
	nome nvarchar(max),
	uni nvarchar(max),
	conversao float,
	imagem nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	if @fp_id is null
		select @fp_id = e_fp_id from ENTIDADE where E_ID = @e_id
	
	insert into @t (idTipo,tipo,id,nome,uni,conversao, imagem)
	select distinct
		TP_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p_id,
		p_nome,
		UNI_NOME,
		P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR,
		P_IMAGEM
	from 
		movimento 
		inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join ENTIDADE on MOV_E_ID = E_ID
		inner join ENTIDADE_FASE on E_ID = EFP_E_ID
		inner join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID_MOVIMENTOS = UNI_ID
	where
		P_ACTIVO = 1
		and P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
		and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 2
		and MOV_ARM_ID = 12
		and MOV_DATA between DATEADD(day,-180,getdate()) and getdate()
		and E_FP_ID in (select EFP_FP_ID from ENTIDADE_FASE where EFP_QUALIFICADO = 0 and EFP_E_ID = @e_id and EFP_DATAFIM is null)

	if @@ROWCOUNT < 10
	begin
		delete @t

		insert into @t (idTipo,tipo,id,nome,uni,conversao, imagem)
		select distinct
			TP_ID,
			tp_nome,
			p_id,
			p_nome,
			UNI_NOME,
			P_UNI_MOV_FACTOR,
			P_IMAGEM
		from 
			movimento 
			inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
			inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
			inner join ENTIDADE on MOV_E_ID = E_ID 
			inner join ENTIDADE_FASE on E_ID = EFP_E_ID
			inner join UNIDADE on P_UNI_ID_MOVIMENTOS = UNI_ID
		where
			P_ACTIVO = 1
			and P_DESCONTINUADO = 0
			and MOV_TPMOV_ID = 2
			and MOV_ARM_ID = 12
			and MOV_DATA between DATEADD(day,-180,getdate()) and getdate()
			--and ENT_ENT_ID = 19
	end

	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.get_QueryColumnNames`(@query nvarchar(max))
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27*

**Devolve:** `Name` nvarchar

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[get_QueryColumnNames] 
(
	@query nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS @values TABLE 
(
	Name nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO @Values (Name)
	(SELECT name FROM sys.dm_exec_describe_first_result_set (@query, NULL, 0))
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.of_Acessorios_Atribuidos`(@offp_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2021-01-21 13:55* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`

**Devolve:** `mov_id` int, `of_id_mae` int, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `fp_id` int, `fp_nome` nvarchar, `mov_quantidade` float, `gera_of` bit, `mov_tipo` int, `of_id_filha` int, `atrib_id` int, `atrib_nome` nvarchar, `extra` bit, `mov_e_id_responsavel` int, `p_imagem` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Acessorios_Atribuidos]
(
	@offp_id int
)
RETURNS 
@t TABLE 
(
	mov_id int
	, of_id_mae int
	, p_id int
	, p_nome nvarchar(max)
	, fp_id int
	, fp_nome nvarchar(max)
	, mov_quantidade float
	, gera_of bit
	, mov_tipo int
	, of_id_filha int
	, atrib_id int
	, atrib_nome nvarchar(max)
	, extra bit
	, mov_e_id_responsavel int
	, p_imagem nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @tTemp table
	(
		idLinha int
		, mov_id int
		, of_id_mae int
		, p_id int
		, p_nome nvarchar(max)
		, fp_id int
		, fp_nome nvarchar(max)
		, mov_qtd_pedida float
		, gera_of bit
		, mov_tipo int
		, of_id_filha int
		, atrib_id int
		, atrib_nome nvarchar(max)
		, extra bit
		, mov_e_id_responsavel int
		, p_imagem nvarchar(max)
		, mov_qtd_feita float
		, p_saidas_auto bit
	)

	insert into @tTemp (idLinha, mov_id, of_id_mae, p_id, p_nome, fp_id , fp_nome, mov_qtd_pedida, gera_of, mov_tipo, of_id_filha, atrib_id, atrib_nome, extra, mov_e_id_responsavel, p_imagem, mov_qtd_feita, p_saidas_auto)
	(select distinct ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY p_nome ASC), 
		mov_id, 
		mov_of_id,
		p_id, 
		p_nome, 
		tp_fp_id,
		fp_nome,
		mov_quantidade,
		p_gera_of,
		mov_tpmov_id,
		of_id,
		atrib_id,
		atrib_nome_pt,
		mov_acessorio_adicional,
		mov_e_id_responsavel, 
		p_imagem,
		mov_qtd_bal,
		p_saidas_auto
	from
		of_fp 
		inner join movimento on offp_of_id = mov_of_id
		left join atributo on mov_atrib_id = atrib_id
		inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id
		inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		inner join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join ordemfabrico on mov_id = of_mov_id
	where 
		offp_id = @offp_id and ((mov_atrib_id is not null and atrib_familia_en <> 'Design') or mov_acessorio_adicional = 1))

	declare @countFeitas float, @countFalta float, @id int
	while exists(select * from @tTemp)
	begin
		select top 1 @id = idLinha, @countFeitas = mov_qtd_feita, @countFalta = mov_qtd_pedida - mov_qtd_feita from @tTemp

		while @countFeitas > 0
		begin
			insert into @t (mov_id, of_id_mae, p_id, p_nome, fp_id , fp_nome, mov_quantidade, gera_of, mov_tipo, of_id_filha, atrib_id, atrib_nome, extra, mov_e_id_responsavel, p_imagem)
			(select 
				mov_id, of_id_mae, p_id, p_nome, fp_id , fp_nome, 1, gera_of, (case when p_saidas_auto = 1 then 2 else 11 end) as mov_tipo, of_id_filha, atrib_id, atrib_nome, extra, mov_e_id_responsavel, p_imagem
			from @tTemp
			where idLinha = @id
			)		

			set @countFeitas = @countFeitas - 1
		end
		while @countFalta > 0
		begin
			insert into @t (mov_id, of_id_mae, p_id, p_nome, fp_id , fp_nome, mov_quantidade, gera_of, mov_tipo, of_id_filha, atrib_id, atrib_nome, extra, mov_e_id_responsavel, p_imagem)
			(select distinct
				mov_id, of_id_mae, p_id, p_nome, fp_id , fp_nome, 1, gera_of, 4 as mov_tipo, of_id_filha, atrib_id, atrib_nome, extra, mov_e_id_responsavel, p_imagem
			from @tTemp	
			where idLinha = @id
			)	

			set @countFalta = @countFalta - 1
		end

		delete from @tTemp where idLinha = @id
	end
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.of_Acessorios_Preparacao`(@of_id int, @arm_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2020-03-23 08:56 · modificado 2025-06-09 16:30* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `reparac`

**Devolve:** `MOV_ID` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `mov_quantidade` float, `P_ARM_ID` int, `ARM_NOME` nvarchar, `of_id` int, `MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL` bit, `p_tem_stock` bit, `mov_observacoes` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Acessorios_Preparacao]
(
	@of_id int, 
	@arm_id int = null
)
RETURNS 
@acess TABLE 
(
	MOV_ID int,
	tp_nome nvarchar(max),
	p_id int,
	p_nome nvarchar(max),
	mov_quantidade float,
	P_ARM_ID int,
	ARM_NOME nvarchar(max),
	of_id int,
	MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL bit,
	p_tem_stock bit,
	mov_observacoes nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	insert into @acess (MOV_ID, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, mov_quantidade, P_ARM_ID, ARM_NOME, of_id, MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL, p_tem_stock, mov_observacoes)
	select distinct
		m.MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome,
		m.mov_quantidade,
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		m.MOV_OBSERVACOES + isnull(' [** ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' **]', '')
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join MOVIMENTO m on OF_ID = m.MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO p on m.MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE as pc on (pc.COMP_P_ID = OF_P_ID or COMP_L_ID = p1.P_L_ID) and (pc.COMP_P_P_ID = p.P_ID or pc.COMP_ATRIB_ID = MOV_ATRIB_ID) and pc.COMP_ELIMINADO is null
		left join ARMAZEM on p.P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
		left join MOVIMENTO mPai on m.MOV_MOV_ID = mPai.MOV_ID
		left join PRODUTO pPai on mPai.MOV_P_ID = pPai.P_ID and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
	where
		m.MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and pc.COMP_FP_ID = 46
		and m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0
		and p.P_TEM_STOCK = 1
		--and p.P_SAIDAS_AUTO = 0 /* activei condição em 10/02/2023 para não haver saidas duplicadas (pedido + fecho OF) */
		and case when p.P_ARM_ID = 18 then p.P_SAIDAS_AUTO else 1 end = case when p.P_ARM_ID = 18 then 0 else 1 end /* Nos pedidos ao armazem "Corte & Costura" não vai buscar o q tem saidas automaticas */
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else p.P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)
	union
	select 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY p_id ASC) AS MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p_id,
		p_nome + '(*)',
		sum(mov_quantidade),
		P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		P_TEM_STOCK,
		'[** Extra **] ' + MOV_OBSERVACOES
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join MOVIMENTO on OF_ID = MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
		left join atributo on mov_atrib_id = atrib_id
	where
		MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 -- (MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 or ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT = 'Acessorios Extra')
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)
	group by
		tp_nome,
		p_id,
		p_nome + '(*)',
		P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		P_TEM_STOCK,
		MOV_OBSERVACOES
	union
	select 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY p.p_id ASC) AS MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + '(*)',
		sum(m.mov_quantidade),
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		--'[** Extra **] origem: ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' obs: ' + mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES
		case when mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 then '[** Extra **] ' else '' end + 'origem: ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' obs: ' + mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join MOVIMENTO m on OF_ID = m.MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO p on m.MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM on p.P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
		left join MOVIMENTO mPai on m.MOV_MOV_ID = mPai.MOV_ID
		left join PRODUTO pPai on mPai.MOV_P_ID = pPai.P_ID and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
		left join ATRIBUTO on mPai.MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
		left join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE as pc on p.P_ID = COMP_P_P_ID and pc.COMP_L_ID = p1.P_L_ID and pc.COMP_ELIMINADO is null
	where
		m.MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and (mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 or (mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0 and pc.COMP_ID is null))
		and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else p.P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)		
	group by
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + '(*)',
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		pPai.P_NOME,
		mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES,
		mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL

	insert into @acess (MOV_ID, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, mov_quantidade, P_ARM_ID, ARM_NOME, of_id, MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL, p_tem_stock, mov_observacoes)
	select distinct
		m.MOV_ID,
		tp.tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + isnull(' (' + a.p_nome + ')',''),
		m.mov_quantidade,
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		arm.ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		a.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		isnull(' [** ' + a.p_nome + ' **]','')
	from 
		@acess a
		inner join movimento pai on a.MOV_ID = pai.MOV_ID /* 2023-02-23 adicionei para poder ir buscar produtos associados dos movimentos q tenham atributo */
		inner join movimento m on a.mov_id = m.mov_mov_id
		inner join PRODUTO p on m.MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO tp on P_TP_ID = tp.TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM arm on p.P_ARM_ID = arm.ARM_ID
	where 
		(a.p_tem_stock = 0 or pai.MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null 
		or p.p_saidas_auto = 0  /* Produtos associados que não têm saidas automaticaS*/
		) /* 2023-02-23 adicionei "or pai.MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null" para poder ir buscar produtos associados dos movimentos q tenham atributo */
		and p.P_ARM_ID in (13,9,18)

	delete from @acess where p_tem_stock = 0 or P_ARM_ID not in (13,9,18)
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.of_Acessorios_Preparacao_Teste`(@of_id int, @arm_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2021-02-11 09:36 · modificado 2021-02-12 12:14* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `reparac`

**Devolve:** `MOV_ID` int, `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `mov_quantidade` float, `P_ARM_ID` int, `ARM_NOME` nvarchar, `of_id` int, `MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL` bit, `p_tem_stock` bit, `mov_observacoes` nvarchar

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[of_Acessorios_Preparacao_Teste]
(
	@of_id int, 
	@arm_id int = null
)
RETURNS 
@acess TABLE 
(
	MOV_ID int,
	tp_nome nvarchar(max),
	p_id int,
	p_nome nvarchar(max),
	mov_quantidade float,
	P_ARM_ID int,
	ARM_NOME nvarchar(max),
	of_id int,
	MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL bit,
	p_tem_stock bit,
	mov_observacoes nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	insert into @acess (MOV_ID, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, mov_quantidade, P_ARM_ID, ARM_NOME, of_id, MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL, p_tem_stock, mov_observacoes)
	select distinct
		m.MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome,
		m.mov_quantidade,
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		m.MOV_OBSERVACOES + isnull(' [** ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' **]', '')
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join MOVIMENTO m on OF_ID = m.MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO p on m.MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE as pc on (pc.COMP_P_ID = OF_P_ID or COMP_L_ID = p1.P_L_ID) and (pc.COMP_P_P_ID = p.P_ID or pc.COMP_ATRIB_ID = MOV_ATRIB_ID)
		left join ARMAZEM on p.P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
		left join MOVIMENTO mPai on m.MOV_MOV_ID = mPai.MOV_ID
		left join PRODUTO pPai on mPai.MOV_P_ID = pPai.P_ID and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
	where
		m.MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and pc.COMP_FP_ID = 46
		and m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0
		and p.P_TEM_STOCK = 1
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else p.P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)
	union
	select 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY p_id ASC) AS MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p_id,
		p_nome + '(*)',
		sum(mov_quantidade),
		P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		P_TEM_STOCK,
		'[** Extra **] ' + MOV_OBSERVACOES
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join MOVIMENTO on OF_ID = MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO on MOV_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM on P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
	where
		MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)
	group by
		tp_nome,
		p_id,
		p_nome + '(*)',
		P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		P_TEM_STOCK,
		MOV_OBSERVACOES
	union
	select 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY p.p_id ASC) AS MOV_ID,
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + '(*)',
		sum(m.mov_quantidade),
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		--'[** Extra **] origem: ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' obs: ' + mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES
		case when mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 then '[** Extra **] ' else '' end + 'origem: ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' obs: ' + mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join MOVIMENTO m on OF_ID = m.MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO p on m.MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM on p.P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
		left join MOVIMENTO mPai on m.MOV_MOV_ID = mPai.MOV_ID
		left join PRODUTO pPai on mPai.MOV_P_ID = pPai.P_ID and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
		left join ATRIBUTO on mPai.MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
		left join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE as pc on p.P_ID = COMP_P_P_ID and pc.COMP_L_ID = p1.P_L_ID
	where
		m.MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		--and mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1
		--and ((mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1) or (mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0 and mPai.MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null and ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT <> 'Cores' and pc.COMP_ID is null))
		--and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
		and ((mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0) 
			or (mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0 and ATRIB_FAMILIA_PT <> 'Cores' and pc.COMP_ID is null and TP_FP_ID = 46))
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else p.P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)		
	group by
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + '(*)',
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		pPai.P_NOME,
		mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES,
		mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL

	insert into @acess (MOV_ID, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, mov_quantidade, P_ARM_ID, ARM_NOME, of_id, MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL, p_tem_stock, mov_observacoes)
	select distinct
		m.MOV_ID,
		tp.tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + isnull(' (' + a.p_nome + ')',''),
		m.mov_quantidade,
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		arm.ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		a.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		isnull(' [** ' + a.p_nome + ' **]','')
	from 
		@acess a
		inner join movimento m on a.mov_id = m.mov_mov_id
		inner join PRODUTO p on MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO tp on P_TP_ID = tp.TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM arm on p.P_ARM_ID = arm.ARM_ID
	where 
		a.p_tem_stock = 0

	delete from @acess where p_tem_stock = 0
	
	RETURN 
END
```

```sql
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		--'[** Extra **] origem: ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' obs: ' + mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES
		case when mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 then '[** Extra **] ' else '' end + 'origem: ' + pPai.P_NOME + ' obs: ' + mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES
	from 
		ORDEMFABRICO 
		inner join produto p1 on OF_P_ID = P_ID
		inner join MOVIMENTO m on OF_ID = m.MOV_OF_ID
		inner join PRODUTO p on m.MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on p.P_TP_ID = TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM on p.P_ARM_ID = ARM_ID
		left join MOVIMENTO mPai on m.MOV_MOV_ID = mPai.MOV_ID
		left join PRODUTO pPai on mPai.MOV_P_ID = pPai.P_ID and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
		left join ATRIBUTO on mPai.MOV_ATRIB_ID = ATRIB_ID
		left join PRODUTO_COMPONENTE as pc on p.P_ID = COMP_P_P_ID and pc.COMP_L_ID = p1.P_L_ID and pc.COMP_ELIMINADO is null
	where
		m.MOV_OF_ID = @of_id
		and (mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 1 or (mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL = 0 and pc.COMP_ID is null))
		and pPai.P_TEM_STOCK = 0
		and case when @arm_id is null then 1 else p.P_ARM_ID end = isnull(@arm_id,1)		
	group by
		m.mov_id,
		tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + '(*)',
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		m.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		pPai.P_NOME,
		mPai.MOV_OBSERVACOES,
		mpai.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL

	insert into @acess (MOV_ID, tp_nome, p_id, p_nome, mov_quantidade, P_ARM_ID, ARM_NOME, of_id, MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL, p_tem_stock, mov_observacoes)
	select distinct
		m.MOV_ID,
		tp.tp_nome,
		p.p_id,
		p.p_nome + isnull(' (' + a.p_nome + ')',''),
		m.mov_quantidade,
		p.P_ARM_ID,
		arm.ARM_NOME,
		of_id,
		a.MOV_ACESSORIO_ADICIONAL,
		p.P_TEM_STOCK,
		isnull(' [** ' + a.p_nome + ' **]','')
	from 
		@acess a
		inner join movimento pai on a.MOV_ID = pai.MOV_ID /* 2023-02-23 adicionei para poder ir buscar produtos associados dos movimentos q tenham atributo */
		inner join movimento m on a.mov_id = m.mov_mov_id
		inner join PRODUTO p on m.MOV_P_ID = p.P_ID
		inner join PRODUTO_TIPO tp on P_TP_ID = tp.TP_ID
		left join ARMAZEM arm on p.P_ARM_ID = arm.ARM_ID
	where 
		(a.p_tem_stock = 0 or pai.MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null 
		or p.p_saidas_auto = 0  /* Produtos associados que não têm saidas automaticaS*/
		) /* 2023-02-23 adicionei "or pai.MOV_ATRIB_ID is not null" para poder ir buscar produtos associados dos movimentos q tenham atributo */
		and p.P_ARM_ID in (13,9,18)

	delete from @acess where p_tem_stock = 0 or P_ARM_ID not in (13,9,18)
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.of_SensorTemperaturaData`(@of_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2026-05-06 13:08 · modificado 2026-05-06 13:08* · 🔎 `OF_FP`, `OFFP`

**Devolve:** `sd_id` int, `sd_date` date, `sd_temperature` float, `sd_hum` float, `RowN` int, `Inicio` smalldatetime, `Fim` smalldatetime

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION of_SensorTemperaturaData 
(
	@of_id int
)
RETURNS @t TABLE (sd_id int, sd_date date, sd_temperature float, sd_hum float, RowN int, Inicio smalldatetime, Fim smalldatetime)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @lam smalldatetime, @des smalldatetime
	select top 1 @lam = offp_datafim from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (1,67)

	select top 1 @des = offp_datainicio from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 6

	insert into @t
	SELECT 
		sd_id, sd_date, cast(isnull(sd_temperature,0) as float) sd_temperature, cast(isnull(sd_hum,0) as float) sd_hum,
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY sd_date ASC) AS RowN, @lam, @des
	FROM 
		IOT_SENSOR_DATA
		--cross apply (select top 1 offp_datafim Inicio from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and offp_fp_id in (1,67)) z
		--cross apply (select top 1 offp_datainicio Fim from of_fp where OFFP_OF_ID = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 6) zDes
		--inner join (select offp_datafim offp_datainicio, dateadd(hh,24,offp_datafim) offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 1) z on sd_date between z.OFFP_DATAINICIO and z.OFFP_DATAFIM
		--inner join (select offp_datafim offp_datainicio, dateadd(hh,24,offp_datafim) offp_datafim from of_fp where offp_of_id = @of_id and offp_fp_id = 6) zDes on sd_date between zDes.OFFP_DATAINICIO and zDes.OFFP_DATAFIM
	WHERE 
		SD_SENSOR_ID = 14
		and sd_date between @lam and @des
	
	RETURN 
END
```
