#### `dbo.Performance_Func`(@di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @e_id1 int, @fp_id1 int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

**Devolve:** `Barcos` int, `extPint` float, `extDesm` float, `rtns` int, `culpado` int, `tot` float, `totRet_New` float, `e_nome` nvarchar, `e_id` int, `fp_id` int, `fp` nvarchar, `fp_sequencia` int, `faltas` float, `ferias` float, `h_Ext` float, `h_Trb` float, `aj_ext` float, `h_Perdidas` float, `percent_absent` float, `equipa` int, `fp_hora_coef` float, `hProdTotal` float, `e_fp_id` int, `percent_hTrab` float, `tolerancia` int, `premioHora` float, `ret_Provocados` int, `tempo_a_descontar` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Performance_Func] 
(
	@di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max), @e_id1 int = null, @fp_id1 int = null
)
RETURNS 
@perf TABLE 
(
	Barcos int, extPint float, extDesm float, rtns int, culpado int, tot float, totRet_New float, e_nome nvarchar(max), e_id int, fp_id int, fp nvarchar(max), fp_sequencia int,
	faltas float, ferias float, h_Ext float, h_Trb float, aj_ext float, h_Perdidas float, percent_absent float, equipa int, fp_hora_coef float, hProdTotal float, e_fp_id int, percent_hTrab float,
	tolerancia int, premioHora float, ret_Provocados int, tempo_a_descontar float
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @di1 smalldatetime = @di, @df1 smalldatetime = @df, @hi1 nvarchar(max) = @hi, @hf1 nvarchar(max) = @hf, @e_id int = @e_id1, @fp_id int = @fp_id1

	declare @tolerancia int = 8, @premioHora float = 12.5, @fp int = @fp_id, @e int = @e_id

	declare @ajud_id int
	if @e_id is not null
		select @ajud_id = e_e_id from entidade where e_id = @e_id

	set @di1 = convert(nchar(10),@di1,101) + @hi1
	set @df1 = convert(nchar(10),@df1,101) + @hf1

	declare @h_trb int = dbo.fabrica_Horas_Teoricas(@di1, @df1)
						--(select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df1 as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df1 as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df1 as date), @df1) - 8 end)) 
						--from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df1))
	
	insert into @perf (Barcos, extPint, extDesm, rtns, culpado, tot, totRet_New, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp, fp_sequencia,
						faltas, ferias, h_Ext, h_Trb, aj_ext, h_Perdidas, percent_absent, equipa, fp_hora_coef, hProdTotal, /*Total_OFs, Total_Retornos, Total_RetCulpados,*/ e_fp_id, percent_hTrab, tolerancia, premioHora, ret_Provocados, tempo_a_descontar)
	select sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end/*case when fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) else 0.0 end*/)) as Barcos,
			sum((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extPint,
			sum((case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as extDesm,
			--sum(fpMain.offp_coeficiente/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)) as coefs,
			sum(case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as rtns,
			sum(case when eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0 else 1 end) as culpado,

			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) 
			else
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) end) as tot,

			sum(round(cast((case when (fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null) or fpMain.offp_return = 0 then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3 )) as totRet_New,

			e_nome + (case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id and func.e_chefe = 0 then ' (ajudante)' when e_fp_id <> fpMain.offp_fp_id then ' (*)' else '' end) as e_nome, 
			e_id,
			fp_id,
			fp_nome as fp,
			fp_sequencia,
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0) else 0 end) as faltas, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.ferias,0) else 0 end) as ferias, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0) else 0 end) as h_Ext, 
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
			coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0) as aj_ext,

			(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo2.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
							when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
							else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
						* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
							when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
							when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
						+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
						+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo2.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end)
			else
			(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0) 
				when hTeo.hProdTotal > 0 then  
					((sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
						when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
						else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
					* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
						when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
						when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
					+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
					+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) * fp_hora_coef)/hTeo.hProdTotal)*(@h_trb+coalesce(eMovs.hExtra,0)-coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0)+isnull(eMovs.hPerdidas,0)+coalesce(eMovs.hAjuda,0))
				else 
					0
				end) end) as h_Perdidas,

				(case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then coalesce(eMovs.faltas,0) else 0 end) / (case when e_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 1 end) as percent_absent,

			coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
			fp_hora_coef, (case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as hProdTotal, 
			--fpTot.ofs as Total_OFs, fpTot.retornos as Total_Retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado as Total_RetCulpados, 
			e_fp_id,
			(fp_hora_coef * (case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then 0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0)  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) end) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) as float),3)) 
			else
			sum(round(cast((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is not null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is not null then 0.0
					when fpMain.offp_return = 1 and eqResp.offpeq_e_id is null and eqResp1.offpeq_e_id is null then dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(fpMain.offp_datainicio, fpMain.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) * 
																	((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
																	when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
																	when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
																	+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + fpMain.offp_coeficiente))  
					else 1.0/isnull(nFs.n,1.0) 
				* ((case when fpMain.offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.1 
					when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 5 then 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then 0.2
					when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 0.5 when of_pfora_class = 2 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 1 when of_pfora_class = 3 and fpMain.offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 else 0 end)
				+ (case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)
				+ fpMain.offp_coeficiente) end) as float),3)) end))/(case when fp_retornos_por_tempo = 0 then hTeo2.hProdTotal else hTeo.hProdTotal end) as percent_hTrab,
			@tolerancia as tolerancia, 
			@premioHora as premioHora,
			sum(isnull(retProv.ids,0)) as Ret_Provocados,
			sum(isnull(retProv.tempo,0)) as tempo_a_descontar
	from 
		of_fp as fpMain
		left join offp_eq as eq on fpMain.offp_id = eq.offpeq_offp_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		left join entidade as func on eq.offpeq_e_id = func.e_id			/* Chefe e Aj. */
		inner join ordemfabrico on fpMain.offp_of_id = of_id
		inner join fases_producao on fpMain.offp_fp_id = fp_id
		--left join of_fp as fpResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return = fpResp.offp_id			/* Fase responsavel pelo retorno */
		left join offp_eq as eqResp on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp.offpeq_chefe = 1
		left join offp_eq as eqResp1 on fpMain.offp_offp_id_return /*fpResp.offp_id*/ = eqResp1.offpeq_offp_id and eq.offpeq_e_id = eqResp1.offpeq_e_id /* Chefe e Aj. retorno */ and eqResp1.offpeq_chefe = 0
		left join (select movent_eId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId) as eMovs on e_id = eMovs.movent_eId
		left join (select movent_eId, movent_fpId, sum(faltas) as faltas, sum(ferias) as ferias, sum(hExtra) as hExtra, sum(hAjuda) as hAjuda, sum(hPerdidas) as hPerdidas from dbo.funcionario_movimentos(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date),null) group by movent_eId, movent_fpId) as eMovsFP on e_id = eMovsFP.movent_eId and fp_id = eMovsFP.movent_fpId
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo on e_id = hTeo.eid 
		left join dbo.funcionario_horasTeoricasTotal_Coef_Metade(cast(@di1 as date), cast(@df1 as date)) as hTeo2 on e_id = hTeo2.eid 
		left join (select offp_id, count(offpeq_e_id) as n from of_fp inner join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id group by offp_id) as nFs on fpMain.offp_id = nFs.offp_id
		outer apply (select 
					count(offp_id) as ids,
					offp_offp_id_return as id_Pai,
					offp_fp_id as fase_Id,
					--sum(dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.offp_datainicio, f.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float), dbo.of_Vale_Horas(p.p_nome)*0.5)) as tempo,
					sum(dbo.minimo(cast(dbo.minutos_Trabalhados(f.offp_datainicio, f.offp_datafim)/60.0 as float)/fp.fp_hora_coef, 
																	0.5 * 
																	((case when fp.fp_coef_extra = 1 then o.of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end) + f.offp_coeficiente))) as tempo
				from 
					of_fp as f
					left join offp_eq as e on f.offp_id = e.offpeq_offp_id and e.offpeq_chefe = 1
					left join offp_eq as e1 on f.offp_id = e1.offpeq_offp_id and e1.offpeq_chefe = 0
					inner join ordemfabrico as o on f.offp_of_id = o.of_id
					inner join produto as p on o.of_p_id = p.p_id
					inner join fases_producao as fp on offp_fp_id = fp_id
				where
					fpMain.offp_id = f.offp_offp_id_return 
					and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e.offpeq_e_id ,0)
					and eq.offpeq_e_id <> isnull(e1.offpeq_e_id ,0)
					and f.offp_fp_id = fpMain.offp_fp_id
				group by 
					offp_offp_id_return, offp_fp_id) as retProv
	where of_id not between 70000 and 89999 and
		fpMain.offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) 
		and cast(fpMain.offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di1 as date) and cast(@df1 as date) 
		and ((case when @e is null then 1 else e_id end) = isnull(@e,1) or (case when @e is null then 1 else e_e_id end) = isnull(@e,1) or (case when @e is null then 1 else e_id end) = isnull(@ajud_id,1))
		and (case when @fp is null then 1 else e_fp_id end) = isnull(@fp,1)
		and (case when @fp is null then 1 else fp_id end) = isnull(@fp,1) -- fpMain.offp_fp_id = e_fp_id -- 
	group by 
		eMovs.faltas, eMovs.ferias, eMovs.hExtra, eMovs.hPerdidas, eMovs.hAjuda, eMovsFP.hPerdidas, hTeo.hProdTotal, hTeo2.hProdTotal, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_nome, e_fp_id, e_e_id, fp_sequencia, fpMain.offp_fp_id, fp_hora_coef, func.e_chefe,
		--fpTot.ofs, fpTot.retornos, fpTot.ret_culpado, 
		e_fp_id, fp_retornos_por_tempo
	--order by fp_sequencia

	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.phc_Facturacao`()
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-05-06 16:47 · modificado 2024-05-09 14:45* · 🔎 `transp`

**Devolve:** `Ano` int, `Mes` int, `Pais` nvarchar, `Destino` nvarchar, `Barcos` float, `Pecas` float, `Transporte` float, `Total` float, `TotalAcumulado` float, `BarcosAcumulado` float, `PecasAcumulado` float, `TransporteAcumulado` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[phc_Facturacao] 
(
	
)
RETURNS 
@t TABLE 
(
	Ano int, Mes int, Pais nvarchar(max), Destino nvarchar(max), Barcos float, Pecas float, Transporte float, Total float, TotalAcumulado float default 0.0, BarcosAcumulado float default 0.0, PecasAcumulado float default 0.0, TransporteAcumulado float default 0.0
)
AS
BEGIN

	declare @tProvisoria TABLE 
	(
		Ano int, Mes int, Pais nvarchar(max), Destino nvarchar(max), Barcos float, Pecas float, Transporte float, Total float, TotalAcumulado float default 0.0, BarcosAcumulado float default 0.0, PecasAcumulado float default 0.0, TransporteAcumulado float default 0.0
	)

	declare @datas table(Ano int, Mes int)
	insert into @datas (Ano,Mes)
	select year(getdate()) -4, 1
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 2
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 3
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 4
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 5
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 6
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 7
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 8
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 9
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 10
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 11
	union select year(getdate()) - 4, 12
	union 
	select year(getdate()) -3, 1
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 2
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 3
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 4
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 5
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 6
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 7
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 8
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 9
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 10
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 11
	union select year(getdate()) - 3, 12
	union 
	select year(getdate()) - 2, 1
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 2
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 3
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 4
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 5
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 6
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 7
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 8
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 9
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 10
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 11
	union select year(getdate()) - 2, 12
	union 
	select year(getdate()) - 1, 1
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 2
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 3
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 4
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 5
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 6
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 7
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 8
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 9
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 10
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 11
	union select year(getdate()) - 1, 12
	union 
	select year(getdate()), 1
	union select year(getdate()), 2
	union select year(getdate()), 3
	union select year(getdate()), 4
	union select year(getdate()), 5
	union select year(getdate()), 6
	union select year(getdate()), 7
	union select year(getdate()), 8
	union select year(getdate()), 9
	union select year(getdate()), 10
	union select year(getdate()), 11
	union select year(getdate()), 12

	declare @destinos table(Pais nvarchar(max), Destino nvarchar(max))
	insert into @destinos (Pais, Destino)
	select distinct display_name, region_name from entidade inner join entidade_phc on ephc_e_id = e_id inner join PAISES_SITE ps on E_PAIS_ID = ps.ID where e_nelo = 0
	union select '*** NO MATCH! ***', '*** NO MATCH! ***'
	
	insert into @tProvisoria(Ano, Mes, Pais, Destino, Barcos, Pecas, Transporte, Total)
	select 
		year(f.fdata) Ano,
		month(f.fdata) Mes,
		isnull(display_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***') Pais,
		isnull(region_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***') Destino,
		sum((case when f1.familia in ('EC', 'ET', 'PC', 'PT', 'S', 'SP', 'R') then (case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end) else 0 end)) as Barcos,
		sum((case when f1.familia not in ('EC', 'ET', 'PC', 'PT', 'S', 'SP', 'R') and f1.ref <> 'H' then (case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end) else 0 end)) as Pecas,
		sum((case when f1.ref = 'H' then (case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end) else 0 end)) as Transporte,
		sum((case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end)) as tot
	from 
		[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft as f 
		inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi as f1 on f.fno = f1.fno
		left join (select e_id, e_nome, ephc_phc_id, display_name, region_name from entidade inner join entidade_phc on ephc_e_id = e_id inner join PAISES_SITE ps on E_PAIS_ID = ps.ID where e_nelo = 0) x on f.no = ephc_phc_id
	where 
		(f.nmdoc = 'Factura' 
			or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') 
		and f.anulado = 0
		and year(f.fdata) >= year(getdate()) - 4
		and f.fno not in (select distinct fno from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi where design like '%Only%' or design like '%só para%' or design like '%fins ad%' or design like '%purpose%' or design like '%consignment%')
	group by 
		year(f.fdata), month(f.fdata), isnull(region_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***'), isnull(display_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***')

	insert into @t(Ano, Mes, Pais, Destino, Barcos, Pecas, Transporte, Total)
	select 
		a.Ano,
		a.Mes,
		b.Pais,
		b.Destino,
		isnull(Barcos,0) Barcos,
		isnull(Pecas,0) Pecas,
		isnull(Transporte,0) Transporte,
		isnull(Total,0) tot
	from
		@datas a join @destinos b on 1 = 1
		left join (select Ano, Mes, Pais, Destino, Barcos, Pecas, Transporte, Total from  @tProvisoria) c on a.Ano = c.Ano and a.Mes = c.Mes and b.Destino = c.Destino and b.Pais = c.Pais
	order by 
		Ano, Mes


	/*****************************************************************************************************/
	--insert into @t(Ano, Mes, Pais, Destino, Barcos, Pecas, Transporte, Total)
	--select 
	--	year(f.fdata) Ano,
	--	month(f.fdata) Mes,
	--	isnull(display_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***') Pais,
	--	isnull(region_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***') Destino,
	--	sum((case when f1.familia in ('EC', 'ET', 'PC', 'PT', 'S', 'SP', 'R') then (case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end) else 0 end)) as Barcos,
	--	sum((case when f1.familia not in ('EC', 'ET', 'PC', 'PT', 'S', 'SP', 'R') and f1.ref <> 'H' then (case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end) else 0 end)) as Pecas,
	--	sum((case when f1.ref = 'H' then (case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end) else 0 end)) as Transporte,
	--	sum((case when f1.ivaincl = 1 then round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido)/(1+(convert(float,f1.iva)/100)), 2) else round(convert(float,f1.etiliquido),2) end)) as tot
	--from 
	--	[SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft as f 
	--	inner join [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi as f1 on f.fno = f1.fno
	--	left join (select e_id, e_nome, ephc_phc_id, display_name, region_name from entidade inner join entidade_phc on ephc_e_id = e_id inner join PAISES_SITE ps on E_PAIS_ID = ps.ID where e_nelo = 0) x on f.no = ephc_phc_id
	--where 
	--	(f.nmdoc = 'Factura' 
	--		or f.nmdoc = 'Nota de Crédito') 
	--	and f.anulado = 0
	--	and year(f.fdata) >= year(getdate()) - 2
	--	and f.fno not in (select distinct fno from [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.fi where design like '%Only%' or design like '%só para%' or design like '%fins ad%' or design like '%purpose%' or design like '%consignment%')
	--group by 
	--	year(f.fdata), month(f.fdata), isnull(region_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***'), isnull(display_name, '*** NO MATCH! ***')
	--order by 
	--	Ano, Mes

	update t set TotalAcumulado = tAnt, BarcosAcumulado = tBarcosAnt, PecasAcumulado = tPecasAnt, TransporteAcumulado = tTransportessAnt
	from
		@t t
		outer apply (select sum(total) tAnt, sum(Barcos) tBarcosAnt, sum(Pecas) tPecasAnt, sum(Transporte) tTransportessAnt from @t where Ano = t.Ano and Mes <= t.Mes and Destino = t.Destino and Pais = t.Pais) y
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.PrecoCusto_OF_Detail`(@of_id int, @tipo int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`, `custo`, `preco`

**Devolve:** `tp_nome` nvarchar, `p_id` nvarchar, `p_id_ant` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `p_medida` nvarchar, `mov_quantidade` float, `pai` nvarchar, `pai_nome` nvarchar, `fp_nome` nvarchar, `p_precocusto` float, `tpcomp` int, `data_mov` smalldatetime, `data_entrada` smalldatetime, `preco_a_data` float, `fornc_a_data` nvarchar, `nivel` int

```sql
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[PrecoCusto_OF_Detail]
(
	@of_id int,
	@tipo int
)
RETURNS 
@t table
(
	tp_nome nvarchar(max), 
	p_id nvarchar(max), 
	p_id_ant int, 
	p_nome nvarchar(max), 
	p_medida nvarchar(max), 
	mov_quantidade float, 
	pai nvarchar(max), 
	pai_nome nvarchar(max), 
	fp_nome nvarchar(max), 
	p_precocusto float, 
	tpcomp int, 
	data_mov smalldatetime, 
	data_entrada smalldatetime, 
	preco_a_data float, 
	fornc_a_data nvarchar(max),
	nivel int
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	declare @total float

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	declare @data smalldatetime, @modelo nvarchar(max), @fact float
	select @data = coalesce(of_datainicio, of_data), @modelo = p_nome from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id;

	-- @fact em 27/05/2011 foi 1.15 para custos das OFs para a KPMG
	-- @fact em 31/05/2011 foi 1.15 para custos das Matrizes

	set @fact = 1
	
	
	declare @counter int
	set @counter = 1

	insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	(select tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),p.p_id) + coalesce(convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id),''), 
			p.p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
		m.mov_quantidade * (case when p.p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), 
		convert(nvarchar(max),p1.p_id) as pai, p1.p_nome, fp_nome, 
		(case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 and m.mov_precounitario = 0 then p.p_precocusto when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else m.mov_precounitario end) as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, @counter
	from produto as p inner join movimento as m on p.p_id = m.mov_p_id
			left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id left join produto as p1 on m1.mov_p_id = p1.p_id
			inner join produto_tipo on p.p_tp_id = tp_id left join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
	where m.mov_of_id = @of_id)

	while @@rowcount > 0
	begin
		set @counter = @counter + 1

		insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
		(select pt.tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),comp_p_p_id) + t.p_id, comp_p_p_id, p.p_nome, uni_nome, 
			comp_quantidade * (case when p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), 
			t.p_id, t.p_nome, 
			convert(nvarchar(max),''), (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 0 then p.p_precocusto else 0 end) as p_precocusto, comp_tpcomp_id, t.nivel + 1
		from @t as t inner join produto_componente on t.p_id_ant = comp_p_id and t.p_id_ant not in (select p_id from produto where p_tp_id = 84)
			inner join produto as p on comp_p_p_id = p.p_id inner join unidade on p.p_uni_id = uni_id
			inner join produto_tipo as pt on p.p_tp_id = pt.tp_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 2 and nivel = @counter - 1)
	end

	declare @interno bit = (select p_fabricointerno from ordemfabrico inner join produto on of_p_id = p_id where of_id = @of_id)
	
	if @interno = 1
	begin
		insert into @t (tp_nome, p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, p_medida, mov_quantidade, pai, pai_nome, fp_nome, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
		select 'Gel Coat', (case when @data < '2011/05/01' then convert(nvarchar(max),21934) else convert(nvarchar(max),22391) end), 
			(case when @data < '2011/05/01' then convert(nvarchar(max),21934) else convert(nvarchar(max),22391) end), 'Clear', 'Kg', 2.0, NULL,
		NULL, 'Pintura', 0, 1, 1 
	end

	update @t set data_mov = dt, data_entrada = mov_datasaida, preco_a_data = coalesce(mov_precounitario, p.p_precocusto), fornc_a_data = e_nome 
	from @t as t left join movimento on t.p_id_ant = mov_p_id left join 
		(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
			where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_data <= @data and mov_arm_id is not null and mov_e_id is not null and mov_datasaida is not null
			group by mov_p_id) as ult on mov_p_id = id and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1
		inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	where t.p_id not in (select distinct pai from @t where tpcomp = 2) and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_arm_id = 1

	declare @nivel int 
	set @nivel = (select max(nivel) from @t)

	while (@nivel > 1)
	begin
		update ts set ts.preco_a_data = (case when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id, @data),0) else t.val end)
			from (select pai, sum(mov_quantidade * coalesce(preco_a_data, p_precocusto)) as val 
				from @t where  nivel = @nivel and tpcomp = 2 group by pai) as t inner join @t as ts on t.pai = ts.p_id  
				inner join produto as p on ts.p_id_ant = p.p_id
		where ts.nivel = @nivel - 1

		set @nivel = @nivel - 1
	end
		
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.precoInterno_X_detalhado`(@p_id int, @dt smalldatetime)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `custo`, `preco`, `preço`

**Devolve:** `p_id` nvarchar, `p_id_ant` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `comp_qtd` float, `pai` nvarchar, `p_precocusto` float, `tpcomp` int, `nivel` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Nuno André
-- Create date: 18/05/2018
-- Description:	Lista detalhada do preço de custo dos modelos
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[precoInterno_X_detalhado] 
(
	@p_id int,
	@dt smalldatetime = null
)
RETURNS 
@x TABLE 
(
	p_id nvarchar(max), p_id_ant int, p_nome nvarchar(max), comp_qtd float, pai nvarchar(max), p_precocusto float, tpcomp int, nivel int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @preco float

	declare @data smalldatetime, @fact float--, @dt smalldatetime--, @modelo nvarchar(max)
	set @data = @dt
	
	set @fact = 1;

	with cte (p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel) as
	(
		select cast(p1.p_id as nvarchar(max)) + coalesce(cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)),''), 
				p1.p_id, p1.p_nome, comp_quantidade * (case when p.p_uni_id in (12,14,11,5,6) then 1.0 else @fact end), cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, 1 as tpcomp, 1
		from produto as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where p.p_id = @p_id --and comp_tpcomp_id = 1
		union all
		select cast(p1.p_id as nvarchar(max)) + coalesce(cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)),''), 
				p1.p_id, p1.p_nome, comp_qtd * comp_quantidade, cast(p.p_id as nvarchar(max)) as pai, 0 as p_precocusto, comp_tpcomp_id as tpcomp, p.nivel + 1
		from cte as p inner join produto_componente on p.p_id_ant = comp_p_id inner join produto as p1 on comp_p_p_id = p1.p_id
		where comp_tpcomp_id = 1
	)

	insert into @x (p_id, p_id_ant, p_nome, comp_qtd, pai, p_precocusto, tpcomp, nivel)
	select * from cte 

	if @dt is not null
		update @x set p_precocusto = (case when p.p_tp_id = 84 then /*dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(p.p_id, null)*/0 when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id,@dt),0) else p.p_precocusto /*coalesce(mov_precounitario, p.p_precocusto)*/ end)
		from @x as t left join 
		(select mov_p_id, mov_precounitario, mov_e_id from movimento inner join 
			(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
				where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_data <= @data and mov_e_id is not null and mov_datasaida is not null 
				group by mov_p_id) as ult on mov_p_id = id and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 where mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on t.p_id_ant = m.mov_p_id
			left join entidade on m.mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	else
		update @x set p_precocusto = (case when p.p_tp_id = 84 then /*dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno_X(p.p_id, null)*/0 when p.p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p.p_id,@dt),0) else p.p_precocusto /*coalesce(mov_precounitario, p.p_precocusto)*/ end)
		from @x as t left join 
		(select mov_p_id, mov_precounitario, mov_e_id from movimento inner join 
			(select mov_p_id as id, max(mov_data) as dt from movimento inner join entidade on mov_e_id = e_id 
				where mov_tpmov_id = 1 and mov_e_id is not null and mov_datasaida is not null 
				group by mov_p_id) as ult on mov_p_id = id and mov_data = dt and mov_tpmov_id = 1 where mov_tpmov_id = 1) as m on t.p_id_ant = m.mov_p_id
			left join entidade on m.mov_e_id = e_id inner join produto as p on t.p_id_ant = p.p_id
	
	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.produto_PesquisaPorId`(@p_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2024-02-20 09:37 · modificado 2024-02-20 09:49* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`

**Devolve:** `p_id` int, `p_nome` nvarchar, `p_tp_id` int, `tp_tp_id` int

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION produto_PesquisaPorId
(
	@p_id int
)
RETURNS 
@tFinal TABLE 
(
	p_id int, p_nome nvarchar(max), p_tp_id int, tp_tp_id int
)
AS
BEGIN
	declare @t table(tpid int, tptpid int, pos int, visto bit default 0)

	insert into @t (tpid, tptpid, pos) select p_tp_id, tp_tp_id, 1 from produto inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id where p_id = @p_id

	while exists(select * from @t where visto = 0)
	begin
		declare @tpid int, @tpTpId int, @pos int
		select top 1 @tpid = tpid, @tpTpId = tptpid, @pos = pos from @t where visto = 0

		insert into @t (tpid, tptpid, pos) select tp_id, tp_tp_id, @pos + 1 from produto_tipo where tp_id = @tptpid

		update @t set visto = 1 where tpid = @tpid
	end

	declare @count int
	select @count = count(*) from @t

	declare @classe int, @tipo int

	select @tipo = tpid from @t inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on tpid = TP_ID where pos = 1

	select @classe = tpid from @t inner join PRODUTO_TIPO on tpid = TP_ID where pos = @count
	
	insert into @tFinal (p_id, p_nome, p_tp_id, tp_tp_id) select @p_id, p_nome, @tipo, @classe from produto where P_ID = @p_id

	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.produto_PrecoCustoDetalhado`(@p_id int)
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `custo`, `preco`, `molde`

**Devolve:** `id` int, `nome` nvarchar, `unidade` nvarchar, `preco` float, `qtd` float, `tipo` nvarchar, `origem` nvarchar, `p_stock` float, `p_stockmin` float, `p_qtdencomenda` float, `consumido` float, `p_necessidades` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<xxxxxxxxxxxx>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[produto_PrecoCustoDetalhado]
(
	@p_id int = null
)
RETURNS @detalhe TABLE 
(
	id int, nome nvarchar(max), unidade nvarchar(max), preco float, qtd float, tipo nvarchar(max), origem nvarchar(max), p_stock float, p_stockmin float, p_qtdencomenda float, consumido float, p_necessidades float
)
AS
BEGIN
	if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id = @p_id) in (select tp_id from produto_tipo where tp_id in (1,82,83,84) or tp_tp_id in (1,82,83,84))) -- Barcos, Moldes, Matrizes, Construções
	begin

		with p (id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo_Id, tipo, origem) as
		(
			select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when tp_id = 84 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Construcao(p_id, null) when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else convert(float,p_precocusto) end), convert(float,comp_quantidade), tp_id, tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),'')
					from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 1 inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id 
					left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
				where comp_p_id = @p_id --and p_tp_id <> 84
			union all
			select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when tp_id = 84 then dbo.PrecoProduto_Construcao(p_id, null) when p_fabricointerno = 1 then coalesce(dbo.PrecoProduto_Interno(p_id, null),0) else convert(float,p_precocusto) end), convert(float,comp_quantidade*qtd), tp_id, tp_nome, nome
					from p inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join 
							produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id and comp_tpcomp_id = (case when tipo_Id = 84 then 1 else 2 end)
					inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
		)

		insert into @detalhe (id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, p_stock, p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, consumido, p_necessidades)
		(
			select id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end) as p_stock, p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, coalesce(sum(mov_quantidade),0) as consumido, p_necessidades
				from p inner join produto on id = p_id 
							left join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id and mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(getdate())
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id
			group by id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end), p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, p_necessidades
		--union
		--select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, convert(float,dbo.PrecoProduto_Construcao(p_id, null)), convert(float,comp_quantidade), tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),''), 0 as p_stock, 0 as p_stockmin, 0 as p_qtdencomenda, 0 as consumido, 0 as p_necessidades
		--	from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id
		--			left join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
		--		where comp_p_id = @p_id and p_tp_id = 84
		)

	end
	else
	begin

		with p (id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem) as
		(
			select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else convert(float,p_precocusto) end) as p_precocusto, convert(float,comp_quantidade), tp_nome, convert(nvarchar(max),'')
					from produto_componente inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id and comp_tpcomp_id = 2 
					inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
				where comp_p_id = @p_id
			union all
			select p_id, p_nome, uni_nome, (case when p_fabricointerno = 1 then 0 else convert(float,p_precocusto) end) as p_precocusto, convert(float,comp_quantidade*qtd), tp_nome, nome
					from p inner join produto_componente on id = comp_p_id inner join produto on comp_p_p_id = p_id and (comp_tpcomp_id = 2 or p_id = 22394) inner join 
							produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id  /*Gastos gerais de fabrico*/ 
					inner join unidade on p_uni_id = uni_id
		)
		insert into @detalhe (id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, p_stock, p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, consumido, p_necessidades)
		(select id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end) as p_stock, p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, coalesce(sum(mov_quantidade),0) as consumido, p_necessidades
			from p inner join produto on id = p_id 
							left join movimento on p_id = mov_p_id and mov_tpmov_id = 2 and year(mov_data) = year(getdate())
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 1 group by mov_p_id) as ent on p_id = ent.mov_p_id
					left join (select mov_p_id, sum(mov_quantidade) as qtdd from movimento where mov_tpmov_id = 2 group by mov_p_id) as sai on p_id = sai.mov_p_id
			group by id, nome, unidade, preco, qtd, tipo, origem, (case when p_tem_stock = 1 then coalesce(ent.qtdd,0) - coalesce(sai.qtdd,0) else 0 end), p_stockmin, p_qtdencomenda, p_necessidades)

	end

	RETURN 
END
```

#### `dbo.Rep_PerformanceSub`(@ano int, @semana int, @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max))
*Table-Valued Function · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:27* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `OFFP`, `FP_PRODUCAO`, `producao`, `retorno`

**Devolve:** `Barcos` int, `coefs` float, `rtns` int, `culpado` bit, `fp` nvarchar, `e_nome` nvarchar, `e_id` int, `fp_id` int, `fp_sequencia` int, `faltas` float, `h_Ext` float, `h_Trb` float, `aj_ext` float, `h_Perdidas` float, `equipa` int, `fp_hora_coef` float

```sql
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[Rep_PerformanceSub]
(
	@ano int,
	@semana int,
	@di smalldatetime,
	@df smalldatetime,
	@hi nvarchar(max),
	@hf nvarchar(max)
)
RETURNS 
@tb TABLE 
(
	Barcos int, coefs float, rtns int, culpado bit,	fp nvarchar(max), e_nome nvarchar(max), e_id int, fp_id int, fp_sequencia int, 
		faltas float, h_Ext float, h_Trb float, aj_ext float, h_Perdidas float, equipa int, fp_hora_coef float
)
AS
BEGIN
	--declare @di smalldatetime, @df smalldatetime, @hi nvarchar(max), @hf nvarchar(max)
	--set @di = '2017/06/18'
	--set @df = '2017/06/22'
	--set @hi = ' 08:00'
	--set @hf = ' 17:00'
	set @di = convert(nchar(10),@di,101) + @hi
	set @df = convert(nchar(10),@df,101) + @hf
	--select @di, @df, datepart(weekday,@df), datepart(hh,@df)

	----declare @h_trb int = (select count(*) * 8 from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and dateadd(dd,-1,@df)) + ((case when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) < 13 then datepart(hh,@df) when datepart(weekday,@df) in (2,3,4,5,6) and datepart(hh,@df) >= 13 then datepart(hh,@df) -1 else 8 end)-8)
	declare @h_trb int = (select sum((case when dtrb_data <> cast(@df as date) then 8 when dtrb_data = cast(@df as date) and datediff(hh, cast(@df as date), @df) - 8 > 4 then datediff(hh, cast(@df as date), @df) - 9 else datediff(hh, cast(@df as date), @df) - 8 end)) 
						from dias_trabalho where dtrb_data between cast(@di as date) and cast(@df as date)) --and dateadd(dd,-1,@df))
	
	--select @h_trb
	insert into @tb (Barcos, coefs, rtns, culpado,	fp, e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, faltas, h_Ext, h_Trb, aj_ext, h_Perdidas, equipa, fp_hora_coef)
	select sum((case when offp_return = 0 then 1 else 0 end)) as Barcos, 
		sum((case when offp_return = 1 then 0 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 5 then of_coeficiente + 0.25 when of_pint_class = 2 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then of_coeficiente + 0.1 
			when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 5 then of_coeficiente + 0.5 when of_pint_class = 3 and offp_fp_id in (22,40,42,33) then of_coeficiente + 0.2
			when of_pfora_class in (0,1) and offp_fp_id = 35 then 2 when of_pfora_class = 2 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 4 when of_pfora_class = 3 and offp_fp_id = 35 then 8 else of_coeficiente end) + 
				(case when fp_coef_extra = 1 then of_coeficiente_extra else 0 end)) + (case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(rt.coef_Return,0) else 0 end) as coefs,
		sum((case when offp_return = 0 then 0 else 1 end)) as rtns, isnull(culpado,0) as culpado,
		fp_nome as fp,
		(case when e_fp_id <> offp_fp_id then '(*) ' + e_nome when e_chefe = 1 then e_nome else 'Ajudante: ' + e_nome end) as e_nome, e_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then coalesce(horas.faltas,0) else 0 end) as faltas, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then coalesce(horas.h_ext,0) else 0 end) as h_Ext, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then @h_trb else 0 end) as h_Trb, 
		coalesce(horas.aj_ext,0) as aj_ext, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(horas.h_perd,0) else isnull(perd_fase.h_perd,0) * -1 end) as h_Perdidas,
		coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, 
		fp_hora_coef
	from of_fp 
		inner join ordemfabrico on offp_of_id = of_id 
		left join offp_eq on offp_id = offpeq_offp_id and offpeq_chefe = 1 
		left join entidade on offpeq_e_id = e_id 
		inner join fases_producao on offp_fp_id = fp_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, sum((case when movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) else 0 end)) as faltas,
					sum((case when movent_met_id = 1 then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) else 0 end)) as h_ext,
					sum((case when movent_met_id = 13 then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) else 0 end)) as aj_ext,
					sum((case when movent_met_id = 12 then (case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end) else 0 end)) as h_perd 
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (1,12,13,4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di and @df group by movent_e_id) as horas on e_id = horas.movent_e_id
		left join (select movent_e_id, movent_fp_id,  
			sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)>13 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)<12 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)+1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_perd
				from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di and @df group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and offp_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
		left join  (select Funcionario, Fase, sum(rtns) as rtns, sum(case when culpado = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as culpado, sum(coefs) as coef_Return from dbo.retornosFuncionario where cast(dataRep as date) between cast(@di as date) and cast(@df as date) group by Funcionario, Fase) as rt on e_id = Funcionario and fp_id = Fase
	where offp_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38)) and cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di as date) and cast(@df as date)
	group by 
		isnull(culpado,0), fp_nome, offp_fp_id, (case when e_fp_id <> offp_fp_id then '(*) ' + e_nome when e_chefe = 1 then e_nome else 'Ajudante: ' + e_nome end), e_id, e_fp_id, fp_id, fp_sequencia, coalesce(horas.faltas,0), coalesce(horas.h_ext,0), coalesce(horas.aj_ext,0), coalesce(e_e_id, e_id), fp_hora_coef, 
		(case when e_fp_id = offp_fp_id then isnull(horas.h_perd,0) else isnull(perd_fase.h_perd,0) * -1 end), rt.coef_Return
	--union

	--	isnull(perd_tot.h_perd,0) as h_Perdidas, coalesce(e_e_id, e_id) as equipa, fp_hora_coef
	--from entidade_tipo inner join entidade on ent_id = e_ent_id and e_chefe = 1 and e_chefe = 1 inner join fases_producao on e_fp_id = fp_id
	--	left join (select movent_e_id,

	--			from ent_mov where movent_met_id in (4,5,6,7,8,9,10) and movent_data_i between @di and @df group by movent_e_id) as f  on e_id = f.movent_e_id
	--	left join (select movent_e_id, 
	--		sum((case when datepart(hh,movent_data_i)<12 and datepart(hh,movent_data_f)>13 then datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f)-1 else datediff(hh,movent_data_i, movent_data_f) end)) as h_ext 
	--			from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 1 and movent_data_i between @di and @df group by movent_e_id) as x on e_id = x.movent_e_id
	--	left join (select movent_e_id,

	--			from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di and @df group by movent_e_id) as perd_tot on e_id = perd_tot.movent_e_id

	--			from ent_mov where movent_met_id = 12 and movent_data_i between @di and @df group by movent_e_id, movent_fp_id) as perd_fase on e_id = perd_fase.movent_e_id and e_fp_id = perd_fase.movent_fp_id
	--where e_activo = 1 and e_id not in (select offpeq_e_id from offp_eq inner join of_fp on offpeq_offp_id = offp_id where cast(offp_datafim as date) between cast(@di as date) and cast(@df as date)/* and offp_return = 0*/) and e_fp_id in (select distinct fp_id from fases_producao where fp_producao = 1 and fp_id not in (11,32,36,37,38))
```
