```sql
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[ActualizaOFsEmCursoDelete]
   ON  [dbo].[PRODUTO_COMPONENTE]
   AFTER DELETE
AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    declare @prod int,
			@sub_prod int,
			@qtd float,
			@tpcomp_id int,
			@dif float,
			@tp int

select @prod=comp_p_id, @sub_prod=comp_p_p_id from deleted

set @tp = (select p_tp_id from produto where p_id=@prod)

if (@tp in (select tp_id from produto_tipo where tp_tp_id in (2,51)))   --Serralharia/Acessorios; Materia Prima
begin

	if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id=@sub_prod) not in (10,11,12,14,62,74,73,134,135,65))   --Banco;Finca-Pés;Strap;Leme;Finca-Pés Trás;Golas;Capas
	begin
		with m (id) as
		(
			select m.mov_id from deleted inner join movimento as m on comp_p_p_id = m.mov_p_id 
								 inner join ordemfabrico on m.mov_of_id = of_id inner join movimento as m1 on m.mov_mov_id = m1.mov_id
					where of_fp_id in (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,11) and comp_tpcomp_id = 1 and m1.mov_p_id = comp_p_id
			union all
			select mov_id from movimento inner join m on mov_mov_id = id
		)

		delete movimento from movimento inner join m on mov_id = id

		declare CurActualizaOFsEmCursoDelete cursor for
		select comp_p_id, comp_p_p_id, comp_quantidade from deleted where comp_tpcomp_id = 2

		open CurActualizaOFsEmCursoDelete

		fetch next from CurActualizaOFsEmCursoDelete into @prod, @sub_prod, @qtd while @@fetch_status=0
		begin

			select @dif=(p_stock-p_necessidades-p_stockmin) from produto where p_id=@prod

			if (@dif)<0
			begin
				update produto set p_necessidades = (case when (p_necessidades-((@dif*-1.0)*@qtd))>0 then (p_necessidades-((@dif*-1.0)*@qtd)) else 0 end) where p_id=@sub_prod
			end

		fetch next from CurActualizaOFsEmCursoDelete into @prod, @sub_prod, @qtd
		end
		close CurActualizaOFsEmCursoDelete
		deallocate CurActualizaOFsEmCursoDelete

	end

end
```

#### `dbo.ActualizaOFsEmCursoInsert`
*Trigger · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2026-05-19 10:42* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `PRODUTO_TIPO`, `v_of`, `producao`

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[ActualizaOFsEmCursoInsert]
   ON [dbo].[PRODUTO_COMPONENTE]
   for INSERT,UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

declare @prod int,
		@sub_prod int,
		@qtd float,
		@tpcomp_id int,
		@tp int,
		@fp int,
		@of_id int,
		@quant float,
		@mov int,
		@sub_prod_ant int,
		@mov_mov_id int

select 
	@prod=comp_p_id, 
	@sub_prod=comp_p_p_id, 
	@qtd=comp_quantidade,
	@tpcomp_id=comp_tpcomp_id
from inserted

set @sub_prod_ant = (select comp_p_p_id from deleted)

select @tp = p_tp_id, @fp = fp_sequencia from produto inner join produto_tipo on p_tp_id = tp_id left join fases_producao on tp_fp_id = fp_id where p_id=@prod

if (@tp in (select tp_id from produto_tipo where tp_tp_id in (2,51) or tp_id in (2,51))) --Retirei o 84 (construções) "tp_tp_id in (2,51,84) or tp_id in (2,51,84)"
begin

	if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id=@sub_prod) not in (10,11,12,14,62,74,73,84,134,135,65))
	begin

		if @tpcomp_id=1
		begin

			declare cur10 cursor for
			select distinct of_id, m1.mov_id, m.mov_quantidade * @qtd, m.mov_id
				from fases_producao inner join ordemfabrico on fp_id = of_fp_id inner join movimento as m on of_id = m.mov_of_id 
					left join movimento as m1 on m.mov_id = m1.mov_mov_id and m1.mov_p_id = @sub_prod 
				where fp_sequencia < @fp and m.mov_p_id = @prod

			OPEN cur10 

			fetch next from cur10 into @of_id, @mov, @quant, @mov_mov_id while @@fetch_status=0
			begin
				if (@mov is null)
				begin
					--set @quant = @quant / @qtd

					--exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio null, @quant, @of_id, @tp

					exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @sub_prod, @quant, @of_id, @tp, @mov_mov_id

				end
				else
				begin

					exec ProdutosAssociados_Upd @sub_prod, @quant, @of_id, @mov

				end

			fetch next from cur10 into @of_id, @mov, @quant, @mov_mov_id

			end
			close cur10
			deallocate cur10
		end
		else if @tpcomp_id=2
		begin

			declare @dif float
			select @dif=(p_stock-p_necessidades-p_stockmin) from produto where p_id=@prod

			if (@dif)<0
			begin

				update produto set p_necessidades=(case when (p_necessidades+((@dif*-1)*@qtd))>0 then (p_necessidades+((@dif*-1)*@qtd)) else 0 end) where p_id=@sub_prod

			end

		end

	end
	else if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id=@sub_prod) = 84)
	begin

		declare cur11 cursor for
		select distinct of_id from ordemfabrico where of_p_id = @prod and of_fp_id in (11,32)

		OPEN cur11 

		fetch next from cur11 into @of_id while @@fetch_status=0
		begin

			if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id = @sub_prod) = 84)
			begin

				exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio null, 1, @of_id, 84

				exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @sub_prod, 1, @of_id, 84

			end
			
		fetch next from cur11 into @of_id

		end
		close cur11
		deallocate cur11

	end
end
else if (@tp in (select tp_id from produto_tipo where tp_tp_id = 1 or tp_id = 1))
begin
	if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id=@sub_prod) = 84)
	begin

		declare cur11 cursor for
		select distinct of_id from ordemfabrico inner join movimento on of_id = mov_of_id inner join produto on mov_p_id = p_id 
			where of_p_id = @prod and of_fp_id in (11,32) and p_tp_id = 84 and p_id = @sub_prod_ant

		OPEN cur11 

		fetch next from cur11 into @of_id while @@fetch_status=0
		begin

			if ((select p_tp_id from produto where p_id = @sub_prod) = 84)
			begin

				exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio null, 1, @of_id, 84

				exec OrdemFabrico_AddAcessorio @sub_prod, 1, @of_id, 84

			end
			
		fetch next from cur11 into @of_id

		end
		close cur11
		deallocate cur11

	end
	--else if (@sub_prod_ant is not null)
	--begin
```

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[anularFatura] 
   ON  [dbo].[AGENTE_FATURA] 
   AFTER UPDATE
AS 
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Insert statements for trigger here
	DECLARE @ano INT
	DECLARE @tri INT
	DECLARE @eid INT
	DECLARE @fno NUMERIC(10,0)
	DECLARE @valor float
	DECLARE @contabilizar bit

	if (SELECT TOP 1 aft_contabilizar FROM deleted) = 1 
	BEGIN

		print 'desconta'

		SELECT @eid = aft_e_id, @fno = aft_f_no, @contabilizar = aft_contabilizar FROM inserted
		SELECT @ano = YEAR(fdata), @tri = DATEPART(q, fdata), @valor = etotal - ettiva FROM [SERVER\SQLSERVER_2017].[MAR_PHC].dbo.ft WHERE ft.fno = @fno

		UPDATE AGENTE_FATURACAO
			SET AF_VALOR = AF_VALOR - @valor
			WHERE AF_E_ID = @eid AND AF_ANO = @ano AND AF_TRIMESTRE = @tri
	END
END
```

#### `dbo.AspNetUserRoles_Del`

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[AspNetUserRoles_Del]
ON [dbo].[ENTIDADE_FASE]
After DELETE
AS
BEGIN
	set Context_Info 0x55555

	delete [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] 
	from 
		inserted	
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUsers] as u on efp_e_id = u.ExternalIdUser
		inner join fases_producao on efp_fp_id = fp_id
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetRoles] as r on fp_aspnet_roles like '%' + r.Id + '%'
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] as ur on u.Id = ur.UserId and r.Id = ur.RoleId

	set Context_Info 0
end
```

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[AspNetUserRoles_Ins]
ON [dbo].[ENTIDADE_FASE]
FOR INSERT
AS
BEGIN
	set Context_Info 0x55555

	insert into [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] (UserId, RoleId)
	select u.Id, r.Id
	from 
		inserted	
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUsers] as u on efp_e_id = u.ExternalIdUser
		inner join fases_producao on efp_fp_id = fp_id
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetRoles] as r on r.Id like '%' + fp_aspnet_roles + '%'
		left join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] as ur on u.Id = ur.UserId and r.Id = ur.RoleId
	where 
		ur.UserId is null
end
```

```sql
ON [dbo].[ENTIDADE_FASE]
After Update
AS
BEGIN
	set Context_Info 0x55555

	delete [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] 
	from 
		inserted	
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUsers] as u on efp_e_id = u.ExternalIdUser
		inner join fases_producao on efp_fp_id = fp_id
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetRoles] as r on fp_aspnet_roles like '%' + r.Id + '%'
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] as ur on u.Id = ur.UserId and r.Id = ur.RoleId
	where 
		efp_datafim is not null

	insert into [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] (UserId, RoleId)
	select u.Id, r.Id
	from 
		inserted	
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUsers] as u on efp_e_id = u.ExternalIdUser
		inner join fases_producao on efp_fp_id = fp_id
		inner join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetRoles] as r on fp_aspnet_roles like '%' + r.Id + '%'
		left join [MARIPS_DB].[dbo].[AspNetUserRoles] as ur on u.Id = ur.UserId and r.Id = ur.RoleId

end
```

#### `dbo.trgAlteracaoProduto`
*Trigger · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:45* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trgAlteracaoProduto] ON [dbo].[VendaLojaProduto] 
AFTER UPDATE 
AS 
	declare @movid int;
	declare @md smalldatetime;
	declare @mp int;
	declare @mo varchar(max);
	declare @vq int;
	declare @pv decimal;

	IF NOT UPDATE(vp_qtd)
		RETURN

	select @movid = vp_mov_id FROM inserted;
	select @vq = vp_qtd FROM inserted;
	select @md = mov_data FROM movimento WHERE mov_id = @movid;
	select @mp = p_id FROM inserted;
	select @pv = preco_venda FROM inserted;
	select @mo = obs FROM inserted;

	exec Inventario_Upd_Movimento @mov_id = @movid, @mov_data = @md, @mov_p_id = @mp, @mov_observacoes = @mo, @mov_tpmov_id = 2, @mov_quantidade = @vq, @mov_precovenda = @pv;
```

#### `dbo.trgSaidaProduto`
*Trigger · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2019-06-18 23:45* · 🔎 `preco`

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trgSaidaProduto] ON [dbo].[VendaLojaProduto] 
FOR INSERT
AS
	declare @p_id int;
	declare @qtd int;
	declare @obs varchar(250);
	declare @data VARCHAR(10);
	declare @mov_id int;
	declare @venda_id int;
	declare @preco_venda float;
	declare @cliente int;

	SELECT @p_id = i.p_id FROM inserted i;
	SELECT @qtd = i.vp_qtd FROM inserted i;
	SELECT @venda_id = i.venda_id FROM inserted i;
	SELECT @obs = obs FROM inserted ;
	SELECT @data = LEFT(CAST(v_data as VARCHAR), 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(CAST(v_data as VARCHAR), 5, 2) + '-' + RIGHT(CAST(v_data as VARCHAR), 2) FROM inserted INNER JOIN vendaloja ON vendaloja.venda_id = inserted.venda_id;
	SELECT @preco_venda = preco_venda FROM inserted;
	SELECT @cliente = v_cliente FROM VendaLoja WHERE venda_id = @venda_id

	-- 21608 -> Douro Academy
	exec @mov_id = Inventario_Add_Movimento @mov_data = @data, @mov_p_id = @p_id, @mov_tpmov_id = 2, @mov_quantidade = @qtd, @mov_observacoes = @obs, @mov_e_id = @cliente, @mov_precovenda = @preco_venda, @mov_arm_id = 4;

	UPDATE VendaLojaProduto SET vp_mov_id = @mov_id WHERE venda_id = @venda_id AND p_id = @p_id;
```

#### `dbo.UpdatePrecoEncomenda`
*Trigger · criado 2019-06-18 23:27 · modificado 2022-10-27 06:09* · 🔎 `ORDEMFABRICO`, `OF_FP`, `preco`

```sql
CREATE TRIGGER	[dbo].[UpdatePrecoEncomenda] on [dbo].[ORDEMFABRICO]
FOR INSERT, UPDATE
AS 
BEGIN TRANSACTION

declare @of_id int, @of_enc_id int, @of_precovenda float, @of_valorpago float, @of_p_id_mld_ins int, @of_p_id_mld_del int, 
		@of_eof_id_ins int, @of_eof_id_del int, @of_p_id_ins int, @of_p_id_del int

declare curUpdPrecoEnc cursor for
select inserted.of_id, inserted.of_enc_id, inserted.of_precovenda, inserted.of_valorpago, inserted.of_fp_id,
		deleted.of_fp_id, inserted.of_p_id, deleted.of_p_id from inserted left join deleted on inserted.of_id = deleted.of_id where inserted.of_enc_id is not null

open curUpdPrecoEnc

fetch next from curUpdPrecoEnc into @of_id,@of_enc_id,@of_precovenda,@of_valorpago,@of_eof_id_ins,@of_eof_id_del,@of_p_id_ins,@of_p_id_del while @@fetch_status=0
begin

	if (@of_enc_id is not null)
	begin

		declare @EncOFs int, @EncOFsAcab int, @EncOFsCurso int, @enc_ee_id int

		select @EncOFs = coalesce(count(of_id), 0) from ordemfabrico where of_enc_id = @of_enc_id

		select @EncOFsAcab = coalesce(count(of_id), 0) from ordemfabrico where of_enc_id = @of_enc_id and of_fp_id in (9,10,12,13,14)

		select @EncOFsCurso = coalesce(count(of_id), 0) from ordemfabrico where of_enc_id = @of_enc_id and of_fp_id in (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,18)

		update encomenda set 
				enc_precototal = (select sum(of_precovenda*((100-of_desconto)/100)) from ordemfabrico where of_enc_id = @of_enc_id),
				enc_totalpago = (select sum(of_valorpago) from ordemfabrico where of_enc_id = @of_enc_id),
				enc_ee_id = (case when @EncOFsAcab = 0 and @EncOFsCurso = 0 then 1
							when @EncOFs > @EncOFsAcab then 2
							when @EncOFs = @EncOFsAcab then 3 end)
		where enc_id = @of_enc_id

	end

	if (@of_p_id_ins <> @of_p_id_del)
	begin
		update ordemfabrico set of_coeficiente = (select p_coeficiente from produto where p_id = @of_p_id_ins) where of_id = @of_id
	end

fetch next from curUpdPrecoEnc into @of_id,@of_enc_id,@of_precovenda,@of_valorpago,@of_eof_id_ins,@of_eof_id_del,@of_p_id_ins,@of_p_id_del

end
close curUpdPrecoEnc
deallocate curUpdPrecoEnc

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF @@ERROR<>0
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
```
